notes.title: Cyrodiil Cries Out Again for PvP Vengeance!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/90da7f942fa77ff4cd9dac2891f25449.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Return to the Vengeance PvP campaign to help test newly performant additions, including tweaks to siege weaponry, armor skill lines, and guild skill lines.[/i]
 
We’re continuing to add to the options in the Vengeance campaign for Cyrodiil, and we need your help to test our latest additions! Join in a newly updated Vengeance campaign during its return on all platforms from [b]today until Monday, September 29 at 10 AM EDT,[/b] and help provide vital data and feedback for the Alliance War.

 [h2]Vengeance Basics[/h2] 
For those warriors unfamiliar with the Vengeance champaign, you can participate by following the below steps: 
    [olist][*]Navigate to the Alliance War menu[/*][olist][*]Either by pressing L on your keyboard or navigating directly via the UI[/*][/olist][*]Select the Campaigns tab[/*][*]Select Cyrodiil and then the Vengeance campaign[/*][/olist]
The Vengeance campaign is open to all players level 10-50 and introduces a special ruleset to the Alliance War, templatizing player builds to help improve game stability and performance.
      [list][*]All players have normalized stats regardless of level[/*][*]Each Class has a modified set of abilities and items[/*][*]While in Vengeance, you cannot access your bank, vendors, or crafting nodes[/*][*]Only Experience Points, Alliance Points, gold, and Champion Points are retained upon leaving the campaign, and no items can be taken out[/*][*]The Champion System is disabled in this campaign[/*][*]All quests are disabled in this campaign[/*][/list]
Upon entering the campaign, your character is changed to match a specific template for their class. As mentioned above, this includes pre-determined abilities, attributes, consumables, and item sets. It also includes a backpack of supplies that cannot be removed from the campaign.
 
Note that the templatizing of characters is an experiment and does not necessarily mean that these changes will be made to the Alliance War in the future. By introducing templatized characters for this specific test, we can isolate the variables that impact performance, helping us plan future improvements.

 [h2]New Options for War[/h2] 
For your battles in the Vengeance campaign, we’ve now enabled meatbag catapults, as well as performance-tailored skill lines for the Fighters Guild and Mages Guild, plus an armor skill line with active abilities for light, medium, and heavy armor. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/fb7024a83e53bdd996e033fca7b216a9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/fb7024a83e53bdd996e033fca7b216a9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Watch the skies! [/i]
 
As with other additions to Vengeance, these new options are tuned to minimize their disruption to the game’s performance while still providing satisfyingly devastating combat power. For example, meatbag catapults can still cause massive damage on impact with players, but no longer leave a lingering ground effect. Missed a kill the first time? Reload and fire again!
 
Additionally, certain progression and cosmetic systems have been brought to Vengeance to test their performance impact. Skyshards, mount selection (along with any collectibles normally allowed in Cyrodiil), titles, and achievements have been re-enabled. No need to leave Cyrodiil to swap to your favorite horse (or guar). Dazzle your fellows at a siege with your stylish choices—just don’t get distracted from the fight!

 [h2]The Three Banners March On[/h2] 
Are you excited to fling putrefied meat over a keep wall or wield the techniques of the Fighters and Mages Guilds? Perhaps you’re just pleased to see Vengeance return again with its massive battles? Whatever your thoughts, let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Golden Pursuits—Descend Dungeons this September!
notes.content:

[i]Unlock 50 Undaunted Keys and more when you brave Tamriel’s dungeons during a new Golden Pursuits campaign. [/i]
 [h2]Dungeon Descent[/h2] 
September’s new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/goldenpursuits]Golden Pursuits campaign[/url], Dungeon Descent, is [b]now live and runs until September 30[/b]. During this campaign, you can earn bonus rewards by completing various dungeons, slaying mighty bosses, and other activities. These rewards include: 
   [list][*]Complete five activities—25,000 Gold [/*][*]Complete 10 activities—500 Seals of Endeavor [/*][*]Complete 15 activities—×50 Undaunted Keys[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/767453fc672b09d905bcd2171e4b184b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/767453fc672b09d905bcd2171e4b184b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Complete activities to earn extra rewards[/i]
 
A [b]total of 21 activities[/b] are available during this campaign period, ranging from clearing dungeons, defeating delve or public dungeon bosses, or completing Undaunted Pledges. To see the full list of activities, visit the Golden Pursuits section of the in-game Activity Finder. 
 
In addition, the Undaunted Celebration in-game event will kick off on [b]Thursday, September 18, [/b]and run until September 30, providing adventurers with even more exciting rewards for their dungeon delving. Check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68695]this article[/url] to learn more.

 [h2]Brave the Dark! [/h2] 
Earn bonus gold, Seals of Endeavor, and Undaunted Keys when conquering perilous dungeons this September. Are you and your fellow adventurers prepared to explore the darkest corners of Tamriel and loot the spoils within? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Brave Tamriel’s Dungeons and Reap the Spoils During the Undaunted Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/f450121379403a4d6e4df3637ae89284.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Enjoy bonus rewards for clearing Tamriel’s most-dangerous dungeons during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event![/i]

 [h2]Conquer Tamriel’s Depths[/h2] 
To arms, adventurers! The Undaunted Celebration returns Thursday, September 18 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, September 30 at 10AM EDT. Throughout this period, you and fellow warriors can receive special rewards and Event Tickets by conquering any of [i]ESO[/i]’s group dungeons. 
 
Following the event’s kickoff, you can begin delving into dungeons across Tamriel with your map, the Activity Finder, or simply via the dungeon's entrance. You can also pick up the Undaunted Celebration’s introductory quest “Glory of the Undaunted” by speaking with Serileth (found at any Undaunted Enclave), heading over to an Impresario tent, or claiming it for free from the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/0a904c7a75a9a154b112e73780e41ba0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/0a904c7a75a9a154b112e73780e41ba0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Be warned: a dungeon hosts many dangers[/i]

 [h2]Valor is Rewarded[/h2] 
Tamriel’s dungeons are filled with all manner of beasts and evildoers, but if you can overcome them, tantalizing rewards await. Every day of the event, the first time you complete a dungeon, you’ll receive a Glorious Undaunted Reward Box as an additional loot drop. These special boxes contain various goodies including gold, consumables, style pages, Undaunted Keys, Opal weapon styles, and more!
 
Additionally, each subsequent final dungeon boss you defeat will drop a regular Undaunted Reward Box, which can include the following items:
                                        [list][*]A chance to drop an item set piece from the dungeon in which the box was acquired.[/*][*]A chance to drop one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A random motif style page from the following:[/*][list][*]Mazzatun[/*][*]Silken Ring [/*][*]Bloodforge[/*][*]Scalecaller[/*][*]Fang Lair[/*][*]Huntsman[/*][*]Silver Dawn[/*][*]Moongrave Fane[/*][*]Stags of Z’en[/*][*]Icereach[/*][*]Pyre Watch[/*][*]Thorn Legion[/*][*]Hazardous Alchemy[/*][*]True Sworn[/*][*]Waking Flame[/*][*]Crimson Oath[/*][*]Silver Rose[/*][*]Ascendant Order[/*][*]Dreadsail[/*][*]Y’ffre’s Will[/*][*]Drowned Mariner[/*][*]Scribes of Mora[/*][*]Blessed Inheritor[/*][*]The Recollection[/*][*]Blind Path Cultist[/*][/list][*]1,000 Gold[/*][*]An Undaunted Key[/*][*]A Crown Repair Kit[/*][*]A Riding Lesson[/*][/list][*]A chance to drop an Opal monster weapon style for:[/*][list][*]Iceheart [/*][*]Lord Warden [/*][*]Nightflame[/*][*]Swarm Mother[/*][*]Velidreth[/*][*]Sentinel of Rkugamz[/*][/list][*]A chance to drop a [b]NEW[/b] Scourge Harvester weapon style [/*][/list]
The Glorious Undaunted Reward Box can contain any of the items found in the regular variant, but it will also always drop one of the following Opal monster weapon styles: 
      [list][*]Iceheart [/*][*]Lord Warden [/*][*]Nightflame[/*][*]Swarm Mother[/*][*]Velidreth[/*][*]Sentinel of Rkugamz[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/224a0da5e3b33cb5a84fc703c0bb470e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/224a0da5e3b33cb5a84fc703c0bb470e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock new weapon styles[/i]
 
Itching to pick up more goodies? Complete Bolgrul’s Daily Undaunted Delve quest to earn a regular Undaunted Reward Box in addition to any others you’ve collected that day. You can locate Bolgrul at any Undaunted Enclave.  
 
[b]Opal Monster Mask Style Pages[/b]
 
Working toward collecting every Opal Monster Mask style available during the Undaunted Celebration? Keep in mind that slaying and looting a dungeon’s final boss on veteran hard mode increases your chance of obtaining its associated Opal Monster Mask style page. This includes the following bosses and dungeons: 
      [list][*]Iceheart (Direfrost Keep)[/*][*]Lord Warden (Imperial City Prison) [/*][*]Nightflame (Elden Hollow II)[/*][*]Swarm Mother (Spindleclutch I)[/*][*]Velidreth (Cradle of Shadows)[/*][*]Sentinel of Rkugamz (Darkshade Caverns I)[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/6ba6310db5e1ae2028651076a2276478.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/6ba6310db5e1ae2028651076a2276478.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find previous Opal rewards[/i]
 
[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style Pages[/b]
 
Already own the base version of a specific monster shoulder style? You can snag the Opal version of that same style by bringing 50 Undaunted Keys to any Undaunted vendor. Feeling lucky? These merchants also sell special mystery boxes that contain random Opal shoulder style pages for 25 Keys. Fortunately, throughout the event, all Undaunted Pledges grant double the Key rewards, so you can take advantage of these limited-time offers!

 [h2]Event Tickets & The Impresario[/h2] 
During the Undaunted Celebration, you can earn [b]two Event Tickets[/b] the first time you defeat a final dungeon boss each day. If you participate every day of the event, you’ll amass a whopping 26 by the conclusion! However, remember that you can hold up to 12 Event Tickets at once. Be sure to spend them regularly, otherwise you’ll lose them. 
 
During the Undaunted Celebration, you can spend your Event Tickets at the Impresario vendor to acquire the following items: 
           [list][*]All three [b]Stonewisp of Truth and Law[/b] pet fragments [/*][list][*]Axiomatic Runestones[/*][*]Glyph of Law[/*][*]Powdered Wisp Remains[/*][/list][*]All three [b]Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider[/b] mount fragments [/*][list][*]Comfortable Spider Chassis[/*][*]Dwarven Control Rod[/*][*]Whirring Dwarven Dynamo[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the [b]NEW[/b] Scourge Harvester weapons and Opal Masks and Shoulders[/*][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/12911b7b3a27f4c3fd21b1a4d728eaf8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/12911b7b3a27f4c3fd21b1a4d728eaf8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Acquire fragments  for this mechanical mount! [/i]
  
In addition, the Impresario’s Assistant’s shop will offer:
  [list][*]All three [b]Unstable Morpholith [/b]pet fragments [/*]   [list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*]    [*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*]    [*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*]   [/list][*]All three [b]Deadlands Firewalker [/b]personality fragments       [/*]   [list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*]    [*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew [/*]    [*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew[/*]   [/list][*]All three [b]Soulfire Dragon Illusion Imp [/b]pet fragments       [/*]   [list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*]    [*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*]    [*]Kvatchian Incense[/*]   [/list][*]All three [b]Aurielic Quasigriff [/b]mount fragments [/*]   [list][*]Aurelite Gryphon Feather[/*]    [*]Gilded Gryphon Barding[/*]    [*]Sacred Seeds of Akatosh[/*]   [/list][*]All three [b]Meadowbreeze Memories[/b] skin fragments [/*]   [list][*]Bottled Skin Dyes[/*]    [*]Ground Jade Lily Powder[/*]    [*]Pressed Silver Leaves[/*]   [/list][/list]
Lastly, the Indrik vendor Nenulaure will have the following  goodies in stock: 
          [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Onyx Indrik Berries[/*][*]Mossheart Indrik Berries[/*][*]Ebon-Glow Indrik Pet[/*][*]Sapling Indrik Pet[/*][/list]

[h2]Fortune Favors the Fearless! [/h2]  
Bring down the evils that stalk Tamriel’s darkest corners  and be showered with fantastic rewards for your heroic efforts during this  year’s Undaunted Celebration! Are you ready to gather your courageous comrades  and overcome ESO’s deadliest PvE challenges? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
  
[i]The Undaunted Celebration begins on Thursday, September 18  from 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, September 30 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: New Elder Scrolls Online update introduces sad Argonians and a giant mouth organ
notes.content:
If your bedtime reading consists mostly of lusty Argonian maids, this tale may not be for you. Instead of romance, Elder Scrolls Online is telling a tragedy, as the Feast of Shadows update tells the story of the poor denizens of Solstice, whose lives are impacted by the actions of the Worm Cult. We join Seekxilts, a lizard fella whose home was destroyed by the villainous cultists, as he treks to find a hidden entrance to Naj-Caldeesh, a mythical Xanmeer that many do not believe exists. Along the way, you'll battle necromancers and avoid traps as you unravel the mystery of the citadel's legendary power.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Feast of Shadows Preview—Black Gem Foundry
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/dc52af2da865560fd698dfbe9b927049239918.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Get an early look at Black Gem Foundry, a new dungeon coming to ESO in Update 47 with the Feast of Shadows dungeon pack.[/i]
 
The second dungeon pack of 2025, [i]Feast of Shadows[/i], is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.

 [h2]Toil and Turmoil in a Foundry Full of Foes[/h2] 
You can reach the entrance to the Black Gem Foundry from a cave in Western Solstice, but the Foundry itself—both a quarry and forge for black soul gems—is deep within Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm. A planar portal marks the work of nefarious hands, but so much worse awaits you in the foul pits of Coldharbour once you enter. What could possibly drive you to seek out such a place? 
 
“It's the classic conundrum of something terrible being cooked up in Coldharbour and players being tasked to stop it,” explains Writer-Designer Juli Comstock. 
 
The terrible something in question is weapons laced with soul magic, capable of ripping the vital animus directly out of a person. These armaments are the main product manufactured in this vile place, and they pose a terrible danger to Solstice and beyond if allowed to leave its forges. 
										      							    							      								      		
“Dalenor, the summoner who discovered the true nature of this place, realizes too late that he's naively helped the Soulbinders ramp up foundry production with the aid of his summoned atronachs,” says Comstock. “He's desperate for someone strong enough to shut the place down and help him make things right.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/4f34fff86b2411b9ff18e7b5ee1cbdc6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/4f34fff86b2411b9ff18e7b5ee1cbdc6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Foundry is a forbidding sight[/i]
 
The weapons have not yet reached mass production, giving you a fighting chance to stop the whole operation—if you can conquer the Foundry’s defenses. The Fellowship of Stirk, the Alliances, and perhaps of all of Tamriel, are counting on you to defeat them and deny the Worm Cult access to these terrible tools of death.

 [h2]Dark Innovations and Deadly Designs[/h2] 
Terrible foes throng within the dungeon, including bosses wielding—or forged from—powerful soul magic. These dungeon bosses won't easily allow you to put a stop to their dire work.
 
“I love how the arenas for Quarrymaster Saldezaar and the Black Gem Monstrosity present very different field hazards to players, calling for the need to be really spatially aware to mitigate and even survive certain attacks,” shares Comstock. “High Soulbinder Vykand also tests that awareness, plus the player's attention and memory. It's the type of fight that rewards players for group coordination and communication.”
 
“The Black Gem Monstrosity is a towering atronach made from black gems that are held together with chains and twisted summoner magic,” says Senior Content Designer and Dungeon Team Product Owner Shane Slama. “It's a tough fight because you have to pay attention to the lava that rises and falls, all while making sure no one in your group gets singled out by its hyper-focused beam attacks.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/ce455c23f8bfa889665afc79f120cea4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/ce455c23f8bfa889665afc79f120cea4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Test yourself against the Foundry’s challenges[/i]
 
“Keep your eyes peeled for any objects of interest, and don't hesitate to explore off the beaten path,” hints Slama. “Your efforts may provide a leg up in the toughest boss battles. Even more so for those with high-level crafting that know how to maximize the power of black gems.”

 [h2]Black Gems and Glittering Gold[/h2] 
Doing good deeds is its own reward, but you may well want more material compensation for your efforts in halting this threat in the form of new item sets, collectibles, achievements, and more.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/a5a5289dfd8a8d72c503158545a7d7e8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/a5a5289dfd8a8d72c503158545a7d7e8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Feast of Shadows rewards[/i]
 
“Skill styles are one of my favorite rewards and we've got one of those for the Fire Rune ability,” says Slama. “And if you love showing off the mementos you've earned, we've got an abnormally slick black gem that nobody seems capable of holding on to.”
 
You can also acquire several items from four new gear sets in the dungeon—one for each armor weight and a monster mask featuring the Black Gem Monstrosity. These include the Lustrous Soulwell light armor set, which greatly boosts your group’s recovery whenever you use an Ultimate ability. In the Black Gem Foundry, the rewards are worth the risk! 

 [h2]Fracture the Foundry[/h2] 
Daedric domination awaits Tamriel if the Worm Cult triumphs, so be sure to oppose the forces of Molag Bal in the [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack. Let us know if you'll be doing your part in this necromantic war via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Feast of Shadows dungeon pack arrives for 2025 Content Pass owners and ESO Plus™ members alongside the Update 47 base game patch on August 18 on PC/Mac and September 3 for Xbox and PlayStation Consoles. The dungeons will be available for purchase in the crown store.[/i]

notes.title: Feast of Shadows Preview—Naj-Caldeesh
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/aa122385147ca199034370aef24bccc4.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Step into Naj-Caldeesh, an all-new dungeon arriving with the Feast of Shadows dungeon pack and Update 47.[/i]
 
Included as part of the [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack along with [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68567]Black Gem Foundry[/url] (arriving August 18 for PC/Mac and September 3 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles), Naj-Caldeesh, an ancient Argonian citadel once thought lost to legend, awaits your exploration. 

 [h2]Ruins and Ruination[/h2] 
“Naj-Caldeesh is a lost Xanmeer that’s said to house a legendary power,” says Writer-Designer Helena Wachhaus. “An Argonain called Seekxilts uncovered a hidden entrance only for Wuj-Laxul necromancers to storm in and overrun it.”
										      							    							      								      									      							    							      								      									 
Naj-Caldeesh tells a unique story within the Seasons of the Worm Cult saga, delving deeper into the unique Argonian presence on the island and the machinations of the necromantic cult.
 
“[In this dungeon] we wanted to explore ways that the Worm Cult’s activity impacts the people living on Solstice,” explains Wachhaus. “The Worm Cult destroyed Seekxilts’ village, which led her to seek out Naj-Caldeesh as temporary housing. It’s unfortunate that the Worm Cult’s activities also inspired the Wuj-Laxul to grow their power using the xanmeer.”
 
It’s up to you and your allies to enter the citadel and stop the necromancers before they can further corrupt the ancient citadel and unleash it upon the people of Solstice. 

 [h2]Perils of the Past[/h2] 
Remote and mysterious, the Wuj-Laxul are not the only dangers you and you party will encounter within the halls of Naj-Caldeesh. Be sure to watch your step as you explore its halls!
 
“Deadly traps abound, and a wrong move could get you scorched or sliced,” warns Senior Content Designer and Dungeon Team Product Owner Shane Slama. “Plus, your enemies can also trigger the traps, so paying attention to where every foot is planted is smart. You might just find that certain traps are quite helpful in dealing with bones that are particularly hard to break.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/92557fc5b887d38e0ce9a659c5e41322.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/92557fc5b887d38e0ce9a659c5e41322.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Watch your step![/i]
 
Survive the dungeon's deadly traps and bosses, and you might find your skills challenged in other ways as you explore.
 
“Because Naj-Caldeesh is an ancient xanmeer, it has a lot of secrets lost to time. One of them is the vossa-saxtl. It’s an instrument that predates the (much smaller) vossa-satl,” shares Wachhaus. “The sacred pipe-organ takes at least four people to play it, but the music it makes can echo throughout a xanmeer. I heard it’s pretty rewarding to play if you can find it.”

 [h2]Ancient Treasures[/h2] 
Fortunately for you and your allies, in addition to its dangers, this perilous ruin is also home to great rewards, including four all-new item sets, a monster mask, and special collectibles.
 
“The Key to the Stone achievement is a tough one to get, but if your group is up for it, you'll earn the Deathbringer title,” says Slama. “And if you can't resist the urge to blow the seeds off of dandelions, you'll enjoy the Seed-Heavy Hist Bulb memento that is chock-full of seeds to send flying into the wind. Wishes may or may not be granted, but it's worth a shot!”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/a5a5289dfd8a8d72c503158545a7d7e8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/08/a5a5289dfd8a8d72c503158545a7d7e8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Feast of Shadows rewards[/i]
 
Also found among the dungeon’s item set rewards, the Xanmeer Spellweaver light armor may be of particular interest if you make extensive use of subclassing. The five piece bonus on this set rewards an elemental approach mixing Flame, Frost, and Shock damage. 

 [h2]Halt the Worm Cult’s Corruption[/h2] 
Are you ready to delve into the lost secrets of Naj-Caldeesh? Mysterious new dangers, secrets, and rewards await those willing to explore its ancient, perilous halls. Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Feast of Shadows dungeon pack arrives for 2025 Content Pass owners and ESO Plus™ members alongside the Update 47 base game patch on August 18 on PC/Mac and September 3 for Xbox and PlayStation Consoles. The dungeons will be available for purchase in the Crown Store.[/i]

notes.title: Conquer to Claim Bonus Rewards during Whitestrake’s Mayhem!
notes.content:

[i]Seize glory and the spoils of war when you clash in ESO’s PvP game modes during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event![/i]

 [h2]Mayhem Descends Upon Tamriel[/h2] 
The Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event returns this [b]Thursday, July 24 at 10AM EDT[/b], and will run until [b]August 6 at 10AM EDT[/b]. Throughout the event, you can enjoy a massive 100% increase to Alliance Points, XP from PvP zones, and Tel Var Stone gains as well as special rewards when competing in [i]ESO[/i]’s [b]Alliance War[/b], [b]Battlegrounds[/b], and [b]Imperial City[/b] PvP modes.
 
Ready to face off against your fellow players? Just follow the steps below:
      [olist][*]Head over to the in-game Crown Store to receive the “Details on the Whitestrake’s Mayhem" quest[/*][*]Visit your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities[/*][/olist][list][*]Please note that you are [b]not[/b] required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off this event[/*][/list][*]Locate the NPC “Predicant Maera" to continue the quest[/*][list][*]If you already completed this quest during a previous event, you won't need to do it again[/*][/list][*]Lastly, complete the quest to receive a complimentary Pelinal’s Boon Box[/*]										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/02/4312ec3ee78e93c7412336316faecb91.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/02/4312ec3ee78e93c7412336316faecb91.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Rise to meet the challenge[/i]
 
Note that you no longer need the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity to enjoy the buff to Alliance Point, XP, and Tel Var Stone gains. All these bonuses are passively granted simply by participating in Whitestrake’s Mayhem. 

 [h2]Seize Glory (and Bonus Rewards) [/h2] 
An array of in-game loot awaits Tamriel’s courageous warriors during this event, including special reward boxes and in-game collectibles.  
 
[b]NEW—Truth in Wisdom[/b] [b]Outfit Style[/b]
 
Outwit your foes while sporting the imposing Truth in Wisdom outfit style, dropped in Pelinal Boon Boxes.
 
[b]Arkay Unending Cycle[/b] [b]Outfit Style[/b]
 
Terrify your opponents with the macabre visage of the Arkay Unending Cycle outfit style, dropped in Pelinal Boon Boxes and by roaming bosses in the Imperial City.
 
[b]Ayleid Lich Outfit Style[/b]
 
Overcome any challenge through the power of undeath with the Ayleid Lich outfit style, dropped in Pelinal Boon Boxes and by roaming bosses in the Imperial City.

[b]Pelinal’s Boon Boxes[/b]
 
Pelinal’s Boon Boxes can be collected by completing the following activities during this event:
     [list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests[/*][/list]
Each time you receive and open a Pelinal’s Boon Box, you have a chance to receive the following items:
 [list][*]Parcel of Tel Var Stones [/*]  [*]Cyrodiil Repair Kit [/*]  [*]Soul Gems[/*]  [*][b]ONE[/b] of the following:[/*]  [list][*]Alchemy ingredients [/*]   [*]Style item for your       Alliance's armor style [/*]   [*]Style item for Akaviri       armor style [/*]   [*]Daedric siege weapon [/*]   [*]Whitestrake's Mayhem book       furnishing [/*]   [*]Forward Camp for your       Alliance [/*]   [*]Chapter of your       Alliance's armor motif [/*]   [list][*]There is a small chance        that the full book may drop instead of a single chapter[/*]   [/list][*]Prismatic Runestone [/*]   [*]Chapter for the Akaviri       armor motif [/*]   [list][*]There is a small chance        that the full book may drop instead of a single chapter[/*]   [/list][/list][*]Small chance to receive one      or two fragments of the Alliance Breton Terrier pet [/*]  [*]Small chance to receive a      Transmute Geode[/*]  [*]Very      small chance to receive a [b]NEW Truth      in Wisdom[/b] [b]outfit style page[/b].[/*]  [list][*]An Arkay Unending Cycle style page may drop instead if you’ve       already collected the Truth in Wisdom style pages[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/07/fab5667ae7361e8bc092801eb47fc344.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/07/fab5667ae7361e8bc092801eb47fc344.jpg[/img]																[/url]

Last but not least, Adhazabi Aba-daro, also known as “The Golden,” is updating her store with rotating CP160 legendary-quality jewelry from various Cyrodiil item sets. Necklaces will be available during the first weekend of the event, and rings from the same sets during the second. Note that The Golden will not be offering Monster Masks during Whitestrake’s Mayhem. Additionally, she will only haggle using Alliance Points throughout the event. Take your gold elsewhere (her words, not ours).

 [h2]The Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
Each day of Whitestrake’s Mayhem, you can earn up to three Event Tickets by completing the following PvP activities:
   [list][*]Two Event Tickets from the first Cyrodiil or Battleground daily quest [/*][list][*]These include Bounty Board quests, a Town Daily, the Conquest Board quests, or the daily Battleground quest[/*][/list][*]One Event Ticket from an Imperial City District daily quest[/*][/list]
If you make sure to obtain three Event Tickets each day of the event, you’ll amass a staggering [b]39[/b] Tickets by its conclusion. But remember, the total number of Event Tickets you can carry at one time is capped at 12. If you’re carrying way too many tickets, swing by the Impresario’s bazaar!

Here's what the Impresario is offering players during Whitestrake’s Mayhem:

[i]Check out Philius Dormier’s offers![/i]
 
Not to be outshone by his employer, the Impresario’s Assistant will have the following items in stock, which can also be purchased with Event Tickets:
                           [list][*]Unstable Morpholith pet fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments[/*][list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*][*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*][*]Kvatchian Incense[/*][/list][*]All three Deadlands Firewalker personality fragments [/*][list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew [/*][*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew [/*][/list][*]All three Aurielic Quasigriff mount fragments [/*][list][*]Aurelite Gryphon Feather[/*][*]Gilded Gryphon Barding[/*][*]Sacred Seeds of Akatosh[/*][/list][*]All three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments [/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]All three Meadowbreeze Memories skin fragments [/*][list][*]Bottled Skin Dyes[/*][*]Ground Jade Lily Powder[/*][*]Pressed Silver Leaves[/*][/list][*]Alliance Standard Bearer’s License[/*][*]Alliance Banner-Bearer’s Certificate[/*][*]Alliance Banner-Bearer’s Endorsement[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/dc0df2fd14d1a13961e0c2f767083484.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/dc0df2fd14d1a13961e0c2f767083484.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Adopt a new feathery friend![/i]
 
And finally, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor will also be refreshing her inventory with the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:

The Public Test Server (PTS) has now been updated to include both the upcoming [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack and the Update 47 base-game patch, giving you access to two new dungeons, mount swimming, stackable survey reports, and more! notes.title: The Vengeance Campaign Returns with Newly Revamped Skill Lines and Golden Pursuits!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/bf9662622b245befc4d870f310e73d3b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]The Vengeance Campaign returns with all-new options for use in mass battles across Cyrodiil.[/i]
 
Our effort to make Cyrodiil the best it can be continues—and you can help! 
 
Participate in the updated Vengeance Campaign during its return [b]on PC/Mac from today until July 8, 2025[/b] to provide crucial data and feedback that will help shape the future of the Alliance War. 
 
This time, [b]console players can participate as well[/b], offering information about console performance and enabling another segment of the community a chance to provide their feedback. The Vengeance campaign will run [b]on consoles from today until July 9, 2025[/b].

 [h2]Vengeance Basics[/h2] 
For those unfamiliar with the last round of testing in Vengeance, here’s a quick summary of how to participate and what the campaign entails. To enter:
    [olist][*]Navigate to the Alliance War menu[/*][olist][*]Either by pressing L on your keyboard or navigating direct via the UI[/*][/olist][*]Select the Campaigns tab[/*][*]Select Cyrodiil and then the Vengeance campaign[/*][/olist]
The Vengeance campaign is open to all players level 10-50 and introduces a special ruleset to the Alliance War, templatizing player builds to help improve stability.
      [list][*]All players have normalized stats regardless of level[/*][*]Each Class has a modified set of abilities and items[/*][*]While in Vengeance, you cannot access your bank, vendors, or crafting nodes[/*][*]Only Experience Points, Alliance Points, gold, and Champion Points are retained upon leaving the campaign, and no items can be taken out[/*][*]The Champion System is disabled in this campaign[/*][*]All quests are disabled in this campaign[/*][/list]
Upon entering the campaign, your character is changed to match a specific template for their class. As mentioned above, this includes pre-determined abilities, attributes, consumables, and item sets. It also includes a backpack of supplies that cannot be removed from the campaign.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/f6b7c3ce4801af5828354429cf096617.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/f6b7c3ce4801af5828354429cf096617.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Return to Cyrodiil for a new test[/i]
 
Note that the templatizing of characters is an experiment and does not necessarily mean that these changes will be made to the Alliance War in the future. By introducing templatized characters for this specific test, we can isolate the variables that impact performance, helping us plan future improvements.

 [h2]New Vengeance Skill Lines[/h2] 
Whether Vengeance is new to you or a familiar warzone, you’ll find it a little changed this time around. Among the adjustments we’ve made after our last test are new Skill Lines included in the character templates. In addition to your templatized Class skills, you can also slot versions of skills from [b]all Weapon skill lines and the Assault and Support Skill lines[/b] that offer better performance in mass battles.
 
During this test, you can unleash the elemental fury of a Destruction Staff, smash through shieldwalls with a mighty Two-Handed weapon, and more, all with significant improvements in how they perform amidst the chaos of Cyrodiil’s biggest battles.

 [h2]Cyrodiil Scramble [/h2] 
Not only can you help make Cyrodiil better, you’re rewarded for doing so! A new set of Golden Pursuits, Cyrodiil Scramble, is running alongside Vengeance with rewards of Alliance Points and Gold. Complete various PvP activities from today to July 8 to claim your rewards. 
 
To earn everything on offer (including up to a total of 300,000 Alliance Points), you need to complete 8 activities out of the 12 on offer.

 [h2]Fight for Cyrodiil’s Future[/h2] 
Are you excited for the return of the Vengeance campaign? Will this be your first time entering the open-world warzone? Or are you already a hardened veteran of the Alliance War? Let us know your plans for battle via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Your Labors Are Blessed During the Zeal of Zenithar In-Game Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/2d3db63154c3ef97d1bb0e0b63bef5bf.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Honor the Trader God and he shall honor you with bonus rewards during this returning in-game event![/i]

 [h2]Honest Rewards for Honest Work[/h2] 
The Zeal of Zenithar in-game event returns on [b]June 26 at 10AM EDT[/b], and it runs until [b]July 8 at 10AM EDT[/b]. To get started, pick up the introductory quest "The Unrefusable Offer" from Amminus Varo at the Belkarth festival grounds or acquire the free quest starter from the Crown Store.
 Having trouble locating Belkarth? Don’t worry; just head over to the nearest Impresario tent and take the nearby portal. Upon finishing the intro quest for the first time, you unlock the daily quest, "Honest Toil." This daily quest is available immediately if you have completed “The Unrefusable Offer” in a previous year.
 										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/cf32d1606fe20e7ba98a25fc0898d0ad.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/cf32d1606fe20e7ba98a25fc0898d0ad.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Amminus Varo can guide your labors[/i]
 
During the event, the first time you complete the daily quest each day, you receive a Zenithar’s Sublime Parcel box as a bonus reward. Each subsequent completion of the “Honest Toil” quest during that same day rewards you with a Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel box.
 
In addition, you can earn Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel boxes by participating in the following activities:
 [list][*]Completing the introductory quest “The Unrefusable Offer”[/*]  [*]Completing any Master Writ, per discipline, per account,      each day[/*]  [list][*]Subsequent Master Writs of the same discipline won’t       provide further boxes until the daily reset[/*]  [/list][*]First daily Crafting Writ, per account, completed each day[/*]  [*]Each time you defeat a world boss while grouped with a      player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*]  [*]Each time you complete a world event while grouped with a      player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*] [/list]
You also have a [b]chance[/b] to earn a Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel box when conquering each round of a group-based arena challenge or completing a Cycle in the Infinite Archive while teamed up with a player who is a member of at least one of your guilds. Additionally, the final round’s reward chest contains a guaranteed parcel, as will Tho’at Replicanum’s reward chest.
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/c637101915c3343968961e6c5b7b4ae3.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/c637101915c3343968961e6c5b7b4ae3.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/530b73cd44a34a1fbf3ba8bcbd9b0c28.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/530b73cd44a34a1fbf3ba8bcbd9b0c28.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Toil and trade are the purview of Zenithar[/i]
 
If honest labor isn’t to your liking (scandalous!), you may discover parcels scattered across Tamriel by pickpocketing citizens and looting strongboxes or Thieves Troves. They say crime doesn’t pay, but the determined can prove them wrong!
 
Within either parcel box (Sublime or Delightful), there is a chance to receive the following rewards:
 [list][*]A tradeable outfit style page for the [b]new [/b]Zenithar      Battlesmith outfit style armor[/*]  [list][*]If you’ve already earned a Zenithar Battlesmith style       page for the day, you have a chance to instead get a style page for a       past Zeal of Zenithar event set such as the Gold Road Dragoon outfit       style armor, High Rock Spellsword outfit style armor, Kwama Miner’s Kit       armor outfit style, or Ashen Militia weapon outfit style.[/*]  [/list][*]Durable crafting materials, provisioning ingredients,      alchemy reagents, runestones, or a motif style item[/*]  [*]Crafting boosters[/*]  [list][*]Chance to drop a gold-tier booster or a research time       scroll[/*]  [/list][*]Furnishing or provisioning recipes[/*]  [*]Repair kits, siege repair kits, or a small chance for an      Impresario Group Repair Kit[/*]  [*]Treasure Maps, Survey Reports, Imperial City vault keys,      Companion gear, or a random currency pouch[/*]  [list][*]The random currency pouch can contain either gold or Tel       Var stones; there is an extremely small chance that you discover a       jackpot that allots 100,000 of the associated currency![/*]   [list][*]The earnings from this pouch, jackpot or otherwise, are        unaffected by any form of currency boosts[/*]   [/list][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/710916c37f84521381a175defe869de7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/710916c37f84521381a175defe869de7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Forge yourself in combat with the Zenithar Battlesmith outfit style[/i]
 
Both boxes can contain any of the above, but the Sublime Parcel boxes provide a higher chance to contain the more valuable rewards.

 [h2]Your Work Makes Nirn Go Round[/h2] 
These boxes won’t be the only bonus rewards you can enjoy during the Zeal of Zenithar event. Throughout the duration, you’ll benefit from the following modified global in-game effects:
 [list][*]Wayshrine travel costs are reduced by 75%[/*]  [*]Repair costs on vendors are reduced by 50%[/*]  [*]Crafting inspiration gain from all sources is increased by      100%[/*]  [*]Vendor prices across Tamriel are reduced by 10%[/*]  [list][*]These include:[/*]   [list][*]Vendors that sell items for gold, AP, or Tel Var stones,        including the Golden Vendor[/*]    [*]Houses purchasable for gold[/*]   [/list][/list][/list]

[h2]Event Tickets & Vendors[/h2] 
If you participate in the Zeal of Zenithar event, you also receive three Event Tickets the first time you complete the “Honest Toil” quest each day. By the end of the event, you could collect a whopping 39 tickets!
 
Thankfully, the Impresario is well-stocked to help you make good use of your earnings. You’ll even have your first opportunity to complete the Robes of Truth and Law costume with the release of its third fragment.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/a9e5f081fa8cb78ef456c8b0745afb3f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/a9e5f081fa8cb78ef456c8b0745afb3f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]It’s only logical to receive a fair reward[/i]
 
During the event period, the Impresario stocks:
 [list][*]All three Stonewisp of Truth and Law pet fragments[/*]  [list][*]Axiomatic Runestones[/*]   [*]Glyph of Law[/*]   [*]Powedered Wisp Remains[/*]  [/list][*]All three Robes of Truth and Law costume fragments[/*]  [list][*]Golden Fabric[/*]   [*]Sapphire Fabric[/*]   [*](NEW) Torc of Wisdom[/*]  [/list][*][b]NEW[/b] bound style pages for the Zenithar      Battlesmith outfit style armor[/*]  [*]Group Repair Kits[/*]  [*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*] [/list]
Additionally, during the event, the Impresario’s Assistant Philius Dormier offers the following goodies:
 [list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments[/*]  [list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*]   [*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*]   [*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*]  [/list][*]All three Deadlands Scorcher skin fragments[/*]  [list][*]Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide[/*]   [*]Rune-Scribed Daedra Sleeve[/*]   [*]Rune-Scribed Daedra Veil[/*]  [/list][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments[/*]  [list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*]   [*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*]   [*]Kvatchian Incense[/*]  [/list][*]All three Scales of Akatosh skin fragments[/*]  [list][*]Aureate Anointing Oils[/*]   [*]Lustrous Ritual Sand[/*]   [*]Sacred Scale[/*]  [/list][/list][list][*]All three Passion Dancer’s Blossom pet fragments[/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]All three Passion’s Muse personality fragments[/*][list][*]Bottle of Silver Mist[/*][*]Delicate Dancer’s Baton[/*][*]Pressed Lily Petal Insoles[/*][/list][/list]
Last but certainly not least, the Indrik vendor Nenulaure’s shop is stocked with the following items:

 [h2]Divines Grant You Prosperity[/h2] 
With Zenithar watching over you during this event, you are sure to reap great rewards for your efforts. Ready to get to your honest (or dishonest) work? notes.title: Delve Deeper into Update 46’s Base Game Additions with ESO’s Developers
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/30005eb49447675ba10f3b307e9d01f6.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]ESO’s Developers discuss some of the big additions included in the Update 46 base-game patch.[/i]
 
The Update 46 base-game patch introduces a huge host of new features and adventures for [i]ESO[/i]’s players. This includes the unlocking of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68105]Western Solstice zone[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68079]story[/url] for [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] owners in addition to the new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68091]Subclassing system[/url]. However, these are far from the only new features and improvements included in the [b]free update[/b]. A new Furnishing Vault comes to ESO Plus™ to alleviate storage issues, returning players can join the action faster with Hero’s Return, add-ons arrive for console players, and more! 
 [h2]A First Time for the Hero’s Return[/h2] 
If you’ve ever come back to [i]ESO[/i] after a lengthy absence, you might have found getting back into the swing of things took time and energy you’d rather have spent on your adventures. That’s why the Hero’s Return feature was created.
 
“We often see players overwhelmed when deciding what to do first when returning to the bustling land of Tamriel,” says Systems Designer Carlos Ruiz. “With Hero's Return, we guide players across a handful of key activities while helping showcase the fun and value of doing them on their own.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Make your Hero’s  Return[/i]
  
“Many of us have taken a break  from a game and returned to it and asked ourselves, 'What are the controls, how  do I catch up, what can I do currently?'” says Ruiz. “We saw Hero’s Return as  our opportunity to help answer those questions and get players back into the  fun of the game with ease!” 
  
Hero's Return begins with a 10-15 minute quest that  refreshes you on key combat mechanics. Afterward, you receive helpful bonus  login rewards as you keep playing and a series of short Hero's Return Golden  Pursuits designed to get you back into your Tamrielic  groove. It keeps things simple—get reacquainted with the game and receive handy  rewards for doing so!
 
[h2]Unpacking the Furnishing Vault[/h2]  
The Furnishing Vault is a new addition to the ESO Plus benefits. If you have a membership, you can claim the Furnishing Vault for free  in the Crown Store as soon as Update 46 is live on your platform of choice.  Once claimed, it can store up to 500 stacks of furnishing items, freeing up  bank and housing space dramatically.
  
“Player requests and interests over the years for housing  storage were certainly a main motivator for the creation of the Furnishing  Vault,” says Systems Designer Lyndsay Beaver. “We also have a strong desire to  ease inventory pressure where we can, coupled with finding ways to improve the  quality of life for all housing players.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/e3fd47ad6ddc7a14ab986553f72e116e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/e3fd47ad6ddc7a14ab986553f72e116e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Store your spare furnishings easily! [/i]
 
For the team, when designing the vault, they had some clear goals in mind. 
 
“Essentially, we want to make decorating a house, much less multiple houses, a bit more seamless. And again, working to ease inventory bloat for players who have a lot of furnishings,” adds Senior UI Engineer James Sammartino. “No more having to carry furnishings from one place to another in your inventory or having a house that’s just full of unplaced furniture.”
 
As you might expect, this new storage option had its own technical hurdles, too, which in turn led to greater Housing functionality. 
 
“In building the vault, we needed to tackle a particular technical hurdle: providing players with a way to choose where to store retrieved furnishings,” explains Sammartino. “To address this, we have added a new Retrieve To option to the Housing Editor's Retrieve tab, allowing you to choose to send retrieved furnishings to your inventory, bank, storage chests, and, of course, the Furnishing Vault.”

 [h2]Adding Add-Ons on Console[/h2] 
Since [i]ESO[/i]’s initial launch in 2014, players have customized their time in Tamriel with add-ons—on PC at least. Now, the option to customize your game experience through add-ons is [b]coming to consoles (Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5) on June 23[/b]. 
 
“We've wanted console add-ons since we first launched on consoles,” notes Lead UI Engineer Dan Batson. “Originally it was simply something first-party didn't really have a process for. That eventually changed, but things were always moving so fast that the timing was never right to get the resources. Lately, we've had a bigger focus on shoring up player experiences and closing gaps, so we pushed to make console add-ons a priority.” 
 
Of course, the work itself was no simple matter, and it led to some limitations, but also learnings, for the team.
 
“The biggest challenge is that consoles have incredibly strict memory limits,” explains Batson. “This is why we support add-ons only on next gen consoles. Beyond that, we had to provide a built-in process not just for using add-ons but hosting and acquiring them. Caveat emptor still applies as it always has, but being responsible for this part of the process means a heightened level of deliberateness and scrutiny.”
 
As a result, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 players can begin downloading and enjoy add-ons when the functionality turns on starting June 23. Even better, if you’re an add-on creator, you can [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/addon/ESOAddOnUploader.zip]upload your add-ons to the system now.[/url] 

 [h2]Stacking on Convenience for Crafters[/h2] 
How many writs could a master crafter stack, if a master crafter could stack writs? No, that’s not a tongue twister, it’s a question players will soon be able to answer for themselves.* 
 
Master writs have been a vital part of the crafting economy in [i]ESO[/i] for many years now, but they’ve been accompanied by the problem of inventory pressure since their inception. As unique items with similarly unique requirements and reward amounts, getting them to take up less space was a challenge for the team, but also an important need.
 
“With 10 plus years of content, we’re always cognizant of a player’s inventory and how it fills over the course of a game,” says Senior Systems Designer Matthew Bloise. “One of the primary goals of making master writs stackable was to alleviate the bloat in player inventories, so the design needed not to make the problem inadvertently worse down the line. This is why we avoided using something like a container—we know that they don’t stack. So, Engineering had to come up with a way to grant an item, in which the item itself was able to be stacked, while granting a distinct item upon its use.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/9807ae6a78141860f64c64cc6c4ee53d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/9807ae6a78141860f64c64cc6c4ee53d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Receive and complete writs without filling up your inventory[/i]
 
Even better, the team doesn’t want this work to stop at crafting writs alone.
 
“As Rich said in the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67911]2025 ESO Direct[/url], we’re now looking to see how this can be applied to other areas of the game to further alleviate inventory pain for players.”


These great additions (almost all of them entirely free!) are just the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/678310/pc-mac-patch-notes-v11-0-5-update-46]highlights of the Update 46 base-game patch[/url], which also includes map improvements, UI adjustments, and Champion tree changes. Which of these additions are you most excited to try? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]*Spoilers, the answer is 200 in a single stack![/i]
 
[i]The free Update 46 base-game patch is live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2025.[/i]
