notes.title: Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 & Update 46 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/608eb51e5069423f957bada4dfbd7a72.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Explore the mysterious island of Solstice and discover an old foe returned in the Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 and Update 46, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
[i]The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Epic Store. Featuring a brand-new saga and a true sequel to [i]ESO[/i]’s base game questline, [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is set in a land wholly new to the [i]Elder Scrolls [/i]and is included in [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i], both [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/contentpass]available now[/url].
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=DvdEWHAIxpE;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DvdEWHAIxpE?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/DvdEWHAIxpE/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]	[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
Also releasing is the free Update 46 base-game patch, which features a host of new additions and fixes, including the Subclassing system, a new system to welcome back returning heroes, and more. 

 [h2]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 [/h2] 
In [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i], you will delve into the mysterious new land of Solstice and investigate the resurgence of the dreaded Worm Cult. Note that this is only the first part of this adventure, with Part 2 arriving in Q4 of this year. 
 
[b]A True Sequel Story[/b]
 
In this new adventure and story, you will continue the narrative from [i]ESO[/i]’s original main questline as you investigate the resurgence of the infamous Worm Cult. Together with new and returning allies, you must venture into the isle of Solstice, discover the cult’s plans, and uncover the secrets of the mysterious Writhing Wall that divides it.  
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=OOfYaCdkGTE;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/OOfYaCdkGTE?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/OOfYaCdkGTE/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]		[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
Discover more about this new storyline in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68079]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Western Solstice Zone[/b]
 
This new release also introduces Solstice, a tropical island paradise never-before-seen in the [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] series. As you explore the Western Solstice zone (with Eastern Solstice arriving later in Q4), a host of new locations and dangers await, including unique World Bosses and Delves, a Public Dungeon, special standalone story quests, and more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cb896c02031e151415d1100dc56f7225.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cb896c02031e151415d1100dc56f7225.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore a brand-new zone[/i]
 
You can learn more about the new zone in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68105]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Ossein Cage Trial[/b]
 
Tamriel’s PvE players can put their teamwork and skills to the test with Western Solstice’s new Trial, Ossein Cage. This new 12-player challenge, set in Coldharbour but accessible from the new zone, sees teams venture into one of Molag Bal’s most infamous fortresses to capture a dangerous relic. New dangers, mechanics, and rewards await those willing to brave the Ossein Cage—the Fighter’s Guild needs your help! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/3f8e8ef8332db14a1c96c85048488539.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/3f8e8ef8332db14a1c96c85048488539.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Team up for a new Trial[/i]
 
You can find more information about the new trial [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68145]in this deep dive[/url]. 
 
[b]Unique Rewards[/b]
 
While adventuring within Solstice, you can earn and unlock a series of new and unique rewards. This includes 16 new Antiquities (with three Mythic items), new item sets (in both the Trial and zone), and a ton of collectibles, ranging from crafting motifs to pets. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/05560b10b145aea499eb8d0fecb91e8e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/05560b10b145aea499eb8d0fecb91e8e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn unique rewards in Solstice[/i]
 
Even better, all adventurers will receive a 10% experience boost while adventuring in Solstice throughout this entire year!
 
[h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
Access to the [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 [/i]is included in two editions of the game, the [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i]. 
 
Both editions are [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]available for purchase now[/url] and feature a whole year’s worth of adventure, including:
      [list][*][i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack (now live)[/*][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i](now live on PC/Mac)[/*][*][i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack (arriving Q3)[/*][*]Access to the Writhing Wall event (arriving Q4)[/*][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2[/i] (arriving Q4)[/*][*]A unique mount, pet, and memento[/*][/list]
In addition to the above, the [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i] also includes access to the game and ALL of [i]ESO[/i]’s previous Chapters. For a full breakdown of everything included in both editions, visit the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/contentpass]Content Pass page[/url]. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/f1c83849575efe6ab48c78d1e68dac50.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/f1c83849575efe6ab48c78d1e68dac50.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]2025 Content Pass[/i]
										      							    							      								      				<nav class="button-nav						align-center		">[url=/en-us/joinus]																																																						Buy Now																																																																				[/url]	        																																																																																																																																														</nav>							      							    							      								      									


 
Note that to run [i]ESO[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].

 [h2]Getting Started [/h2] 
Once you have access to [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i], you can begin your new adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the zone by accessing your map, selecting Solstice, and then selecting the automatically unlocked Sunport Docks Wayshrine.
 
[b]Via the Seasons of the Worm Cult Main Quest[/b]
 
You can have the game lead you to Western Solstice by picking up the storyline’s first main story quest, “The Stirk Fellowship.” You can find it via your Collections menu by navigating to Stories, then New Releases, and finally selecting Solstice. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/68e19451cf5777fe86b1059f350cb3a4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/68e19451cf5777fe86b1059f350cb3a4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Get started in Sunport[/i]
 
Note that while the zone features a sequel story to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, there are no level or story requirements for jumping into your [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult[/i] adventure. You can play with a new or existing character. 

 [h2]Update 46 [/h2] 
Releasing alongside the [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is Update 46. A [b]free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players[/b], Update 46 introduces a series of new features, improvements, and fixes. 
 
[b]Subclassing System[/b]
 
With the new Subclassing System, you can mix and match up to two different class skill lines with your existing characters, unlocking new realms of customizability for your builds and playstyles. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=_VUphPv0Y6Y;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/_VUphPv0Y6Y?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/_VUphPv0Y6Y/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]	[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
To get started with the Subclassing system, all you need is one character at level 50. You can then pick up the short system quest to begin—build a character uniquely you! 
 
You can learn more about the Subclassing system in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68091]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Hero’s Return[/b]
 
Been away from Tamriel for a while? The new Hero’s Return system provides tools and guidelines to help get you back into the game and world of [i]ESO[/i] as quickly as possible.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Welcome back with  Hero’s Return[/i]
  
In addition to a short quest that reminds you of the game’s combat  basics, this system also enables the Hero’s Return Golden Pursuits campaign and  unique Login Rewards. Put your best foot forward when stepping back into  Tamriel’s Second Era! 
  
[b]Furnishing Vault[/b]
  
A new ESO Plus™ benefit, the Furnishing Vault allows you to  store up to 500 unique furnishing stacks in a special vault accessible for any  of your homes in Tamriel.

										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/ba4dea577bb52244d38060a3c82ecd3e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/ba4dea577bb52244d38060a3c82ecd3e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Store almost anything in the Furnishing Vault![/i]
 
All ESO Plus members can acquire this new collectible for free. You can access the Furnishing Vault via the Housing Editor while home decorating or by interacting directly with the item itself. 
 
[b]Console Add-Ons[/b]
 
When Update 46 arrives on consoles June 18, for the first time, Xbox and PlayStation players will enjoy add-on support previously available only to [i]ESO[/i]’s PC/Mac players. Note that add-on support will be fully [b]enabled on June 23[/b] (the week after launch) and allow players to download add-ons from within the in-game UI on [b]Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 consoles[/b]. Only UI add-ons are available. 
 
If you are a console add-on developer, you are invited to upload your creations [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/addon/ESOAddOnUploader.zip]using the uploader tool[/url]—we can’t wait to see how the console community reacts to add-on support! 
 
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
 
Finally, Update 46 also introduces a series of tweaks and improvements to the base-game experience. This includes improvements to the in-game map and better tutorials for the game’s Wayshrine system. Master crafters will also be thrilled to discover they are now awarded Master Writs in stackable envelopes—dramatically saving inventory space! 
 
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
 
These are just some of the highlights of the changes and additions coming to [i]ESO[/i] with Update 46. For a full list of absolutely everything you can expect from this base-game patch, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/678310]Patch Notes[/url].
										      							    							      								      																																																																																																																																																							      							    							      								      									 

Don’t forget, aside from the Furnishing Vault (which requires ESO Plus membership), the above Update 46 features are [b]free for all base-game players[/b].

 [h2]The War Begins[/h2] 
The dreaded Worm Cult has returned, and the people of Solstice need your help. Explore an island paradise, investigate the cult’s mysterious return, and discover the secrets of the Writhing Wall that now divides it all. Are you ready to begin your [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult[/i] adventure? Perhaps you’re most looking forward to customizing your builds with the Subclassing system? Share your plans with us via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]—we’ll see you in Tamriel! 
 
[i]The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 and Update 46 are now live on PC/Mac and arrive June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Part 1 is part of the 2025 Content Pass and 2025 Premium Edition, now available for purchase on elderscrollsonline.com.[/i]

notes.title: ESO’s Developers Share Subclassing System Secrets
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/3b1b0c8325c402cf7dd64372a85beebc.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Customize your knowledge of the new Subclassing system with this developer deep dive. [/i]

 [h2]Customize Your Class[/h2] 
When the Update 46 base-game patch arrives June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, all [i]ESO [/i]players can further customize their characters with the new Subclassing system.

[previewyoutube=_VUphPv0Y6Y;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									
The team wants this new system to further bolster one of the game’s core elements: play your way. Subclassing allows you to replace up to two of your native class skills lines with those from other classes for your current build.

“Honestly it’s something we’ve talked about for a long time … a really long time,” explains Brian Wheeler, [i]ESO[/i]’s Lead Combat Designer. “Subclassing leans into the core [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] tenet that allows you to build your character how you want, with all the options available in the game.”

“In [i]ESO[/i], players can change their appearance, names, races, and even faction, but this has not been true with class,” notes Carrie Day, one of the Systems Designers behind the Subclassing system. “If players wished to experience other classes and their combat capabilities, they were forced to create a new character. With the Subclassing system, we really want customization to give players more control over their player fantasy.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/bf3001342fcae59227026580312abc18.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/bf3001342fcae59227026580312abc18.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Further customize your builds with Subclassing[/i]
 
There’s a lot of different types of [i]ESO[/i] players, and whether you’ve principally stuck to one character throughout all your adventures or have maxed out your character slots, the Subclassing system will be of interest to you. 
 
“We wanted to introduce a way to allow our players to expand their experiences and try out all the different class skill lines we have introduced since launch,” says Day. “Players who have played on multiple classes and characters will also need to think about these skill lines, and how they might be combined, totally differently than they have for the last 11 years.” 

 [h2]Keeping Subclassing Simple[/h2] 
When the Subclassing system arrives with Update 46,  almost everyone can pick up and start experimenting with it easily since it requires only a single character on your account to be level 50.
 
"There’s a very short quest that on-ramps you to the system, and then you’re off and running,” explains Wheeler. “It should take you about five to 10 minutes at the most going through the tutorial.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/61dfee40ba83019046806320373ca537.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/61dfee40ba83019046806320373ca537.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock Subclassing with a short quest[/i]
 
 
 
“As there are now 21 total skill lines you can unlock and play on your account, it will be a long-term project to max all of them out,” says Day. “However, there is also a new champion star, called Disciple's Artisan, to help you level your skill lines faster."
 
Once utilized, your new skill lines will look and behave like any other class skill lines you have experienced previously. 
 
“One of the primary questions early on was what should a subclassed player have access to? Should it include all of a skill line’s passives, abilities, and ultimate? Should the abilities function differently if subclassed or not? We decided to maintain continuity between the abilities so your experience with the skill lines is consistent. This also gives value to our long-term players who already know abilities and makes it easier to jump straight into the system.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cab3f881d9894e38cfb4384c2d2217cf.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cab3f881d9894e38cfb4384c2d2217cf.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Subclassing offers many options [/i]


 [h2]Meta and Class Identity[/h2] 
Subclassing offers a whole new way to play if you want to engage. However, player choice remains at the forefront of [i]ESO[/i]’s design philosophy—including the choice to keep your character as it is now.
 
“We know the Subclassing system will infuse power into the player community. For example, players can drop their tank and support skill lines for more damage-dealing abilities and passives,” notes Day. “However, there is a trade-off—by taking all damage skill lines, you are more reliant on your team for support healing, shielding, and protection. Also, there is no desire to reduce the effectiveness of pure classes and their ability to complete content, and overall, the system should make the content more accessible to all players.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/e46026170abd429d59db9351db652f54.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/e46026170abd429d59db9351db652f54.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Oops all pets build coming soon! [/i]
 
You might wish to push the limits of subclassing to the max, or maybe you’re attached to your character’s class and playstyle. Fortunately, this system allows you to use as much or as little as you like. 
 
“Class identity is still important for key aspects of our game: Achievement, class styles, class scripts, class item sets, and so much more,” Day emphasizes. “If you wish to have two or more skill lines of a class, you must be that class. You can keep your character pure and continue to complete content as you have before, but you are still locked into that character creation decision.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/6a8c0da8c6d45bb8fffa05d4294c1516.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/6a8c0da8c6d45bb8fffa05d4294c1516.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Become the light of death[/i]
 
Of course, with a change of this magnitude, there are balance concerns, but the team is prepared for what may come.
 
“In general, with more options comes more combinations, which can lead to different capabilities beyond what players had prior to the Subclassing system,” Wheeler explains. “That’s something we’ll monitor while also looking for outlier combinations of abilities and item sets, so the game’s content isn’t suddenly a lot easier to complete. We will be looking at feedback as always, and we plan to make adjustments as needed after we go live.”


 [h2]Your Hero, Your Way[/h2] 
When it comes to builds and playstyles, a lot of new options are on the horizon, and many decisions must be made. 
 
 “My personal first subclassing build will be to modify my March 30, 2014, Templar to be a duality of life and death,” says Day. “I want to incorporate the Grave Lord skill line into my magicka Templar rotation, which has been a lot of fun in playtesting already.”
 
“I may snag the Sorcerer’s Storm Calling skill line for my main, so I can get a bit more offense and movement with the Streak ability,” says Wheeler. “Honestly, I’m just excited we’ll have all the options out there!”
 
How will the Subclassing system change your builds? What class combinations will you try out first? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Subclassing system is free for all players and arrives as part of the Update 46 base-game patch on June 2, 2025, for PC/Mac and June 18, 2025, for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Ready Your Expedition into Western Solstice with this Deep Dive
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/4bb5086b05cb15a9683769a5e29ab940.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Is Western Solstice a tropical paradise, necromantic warzone, or maybe a little of each? Learn more about the new zone in this deep dive from ESO’s own developers.[/i]
 
The island of Solstice is coming soon as part of the Seasons of the Worm Cult saga, available via the new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67821][i]2025 Content Pass[/i][/url]. This tropical zone is split in two by a magical barrier, and you’ll start your adventures in Western Solstice with the release of Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 on June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.

 [h2]A Brand-New World [/h2] 
When you arrive on Solstice, you’ll experience a new land never-before-seen in both [i]ESO [/i]and the [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] series in general. 
 
“[When designing the new zone] we wanted a setting that could fully support the story we’re telling with the rise of the Worm Cult,” explains Jason Barnes, [i]ESO[/i]’s Zone Lead in charge of the new zone. “Building a new location gave us the freedom to craft something that fits the narrative while expanding the lore in fresh and exciting ways.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/0f5fa96423492db0d854c85e4cc347bd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/0f5fa96423492db0d854c85e4cc347bd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A dangerous paradise[/i]
 
You can find this island in the waters south of Black Marsh, positioned somewhat similarly to the Summerset Isles but much farther east, and it features echoes of both regions. While you’ll recognize plenty in Solstice, when it comes to its familiar cultures, the zone offers a twist. 
 
“Not only can you now visit a lush, tropical paradise in Tamriel, but you’ll also get to experience a combination of Argonian and High Elf culture,” explains Writer-Designer Andrew Sianez-De La O. “You’ll also get to meet a brand-new Argonian culture, the Tide-Born, whose beliefs may be a little alien to those familiar with mainland traditions. Keep an eye out for mentions of the tide and the search for one’s ‘destined scales.’”
										      							    							      								      						      							    							      								      									 
This combination of Argonian and High Elf peoples is not one seen elsewhere in Tamriel, and the two groups get along… mostly well.
 
“The Argonians have been here for an exceptionally long time and the High Elves weren’t the kindest of island arrivals,” explains Sianez-De La O. “You’ve arrived in a time of relative peace, but the echoes of this conflict can still be felt in quests across the zone. I think it will be fun for folks to try to piece together what happened, with little hints and additional information hidden in dialogue and lore books.”

 [h2]Solstice’s Sights, Scenes, and Slayings[/h2] 
Solstice isn’t just beaches and backstory, of course. There’s plenty to do as well, including quests to complete, characters to meet, and enemies to beat. 
 
“Not only do we have a number of returning characters joining us on Solstice, but we also have a few newcomers with connections to fan favorites,” says Sianez-De La O. “You’ll meet them as you adventure across the island. Our adventures in Tamriel have always been built on amazing characters and Solstice is both highlighting and broadening our fantastic cast.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/4627c576754cff1f1e4e74fb0c61dae9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/4627c576754cff1f1e4e74fb0c61dae9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Encounter new world bosses in Solstice[/i]
 
New and returning allies will be more than welcome, given the island's unique dangers. 
 
“We have several new monsters causing trouble across Solstice, and while the Voskrona Guardians hold a special place in my heart as a lover of all things Argonian, I think the new rolling Vahath Behemoth earns a digital chef’s kiss,” says Sianez-De La O. “I personally can’t wait to jump into the fray and get squished alongside players.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/75d8f2b6647e39b209f4d56feec368d7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/75d8f2b6647e39b209f4d56feec368d7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Discover (and survive) the local Argonians[/i]
 
In addition to all this, you’ll find plenty to do as an explorer as well. 
 
“Keep an eye out for a wild carnival packed with zany hijinks—it’s hard to miss thanks to its massive, colorful tents and the strange oddities that surround it,” says Barnes. “If you’re looking for something with a spookier edge, make your way to the haunted Corelanya Manor. There, you’ll uncover the deeper lore behind House Corelanya and its long, mysterious ties to the island of Solstice. There are also several fun hidden achievements scattered throughout the zone for players to discover, offering some extra surprises for those who love to explore every corner.”

 [h2]Tropical Treasures[/h2] 
Achievements are an exciting reward for exploration, but there’s plenty more you can earn as well, including new item sets, skyshards, style pages, and other collectibles. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/01fcb7fd07d79852c67770c86e82cd65.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/01fcb7fd07d79852c67770c86e82cd65.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Seasons of the Worm Cult rewards[/i]
 
For example, wearing five pieces of the new Three Queens Wellspring item set offers a bonus to your Magicka Recovery that increases based on your maximum Magicka, providing a new double benefit for stacking that resource!
 
“I’ve always been a fan of our antiquities system, and this go around we’ve added a new music box that I absolutely adore,” says Sianez-De La O. “It also features codex entries from our new Argonian member of the Antiquarian Circle, so good luck to all our lead hunters and codex completionists!”
 
“Sloth pet,” asserts Barnes. “That’s all I have to say about that.”

 [h2]Ready Your Expedition [/h2] 
New sights, stories, challenges, and rewards await those intrepid explorers venturing into Western Solstice this June. Are you excited to explore this dangerous island paradise? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 is included within the 2025 Content Pass and 2025 Premium Edition and arrives on June 2, 2025, for PC/Mac and June 18, 2025, for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Make a Dishonest Living with the New Crime Wave Mini-Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/2be72528d66a0013eca1e8cd99fecd69.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Be rewarded for being on the wrong side of the law with this exciting new event![/i]

 [h2]Crime Pays (For a Limited Time)![/h2] 
The criminals of Tamriel are becoming bolder (and richer!) during the new Crime Wave mini-event, now live and running from [b]May 1 to May 6, 2025[/b]. During the event window, you will enjoy increased rewards for engaging with the Justice system by pickpocketing and murdering citizens of Tamriel, as well as stealing from Thieves Troves and Lockboxes. During the event, you'll gain:
  [list][*]100% increased Fence interactions[/*][*]25% increased gold received for sales of stolen goods to Fences[/*][/list]
These bonuses stack additively with other similar bonuses, such as from the “Haggling” or “Trafficker” Legerdemain passives.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/44e66a2516d2c5ddde68eee4ebde1014.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/44e66a2516d2c5ddde68eee4ebde1014.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]What does an NPC need with all that gold anyways?[/i]

 [h2]Ill-Gotten Gains[/h2] 
In addition, you’ll receive a [b]Pouch of Ill-Gotten Goods[/b] for each Dark Brotherhood and Thieves Guild daily quest completed during the mini-event. Note that repeatable non-daily quests, such as “The Covetous Countess” from the Thieves Guild tip board, don’t grant this reward—perhaps the Countess is just too covetous to shell out extra payment for the occasion? 
 
You also have a chance of acquiring a Pouch of Ill-Gotten Goods from any criminal activity you undertake, such as pickpocketing or looting a murdered citizen. These pouches are, as with other items acquired in this way, subject to confiscation by guards if you get caught. However, the chance of acquiring a pouch of Ill-Gotten Goods goes up along with your bounty. In other words, if you remain upstanding in the eyes of the law, you have a lower chance of getting these illicit rewards. The more crime you do, the more it pays—just be careful the guards don’t get their hands on you!
 
Pouches of Ill-Gotten Goods always contain sellable contraband, and may also contain any of the following:
     [list][*]Furnishings obtainable through theft[/*][*]Several new furnishings[/*][*]Rogue’s Potions and Monk Disguise consumables[/*][*]A new [b]tradeable [/b]consumable item that grants XP in the Legerdemain skill line[/*][*]Bounty pardons, including an extremely low chance of a pardon for one million gold. (What’d you do that the guards want you that badly?)[/*][/list]

[h2]Don’t Get Caught! [/h2] 
Note that the Impresario is not participating in this illicit event, and there will be no Event Tickets awarded for your dastardly deeds—only the bonuses and items detailed above.
 
Are you excited for this boom in Tamriel’s shadow economy? Let us know your schemes and plots via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

      [list][*]Game access ([i]Standard Edition[/i]) [/*][*]ALL previous [i]ESO[/i] Chapters ([i]Morrowind [/i]through to [i]Gold Road[/i])[/*][*]ALL previous Classes (base-game Classes and the Warden, Necromancer, and Arcanist)[/*][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Parts 1[/i] and[i] 2[/i] (zone and story)[/*][*]Access to the Writhing Wall event[/*][*][i]Fallen Banners[/i] and [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon packs[/*][/list]

This edition also includes a set of unique collectibles:

   [list][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Parts 1[/i] and[i] 2[/i] (zone and story)[/*][*]Access to the Writhing Wall event[/*][*][i]Fallen Banners [/i]and [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon packs[/*][/list]

To learn more about the [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i], check out [b][url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/675896/eso-2025-content-pass-faq]this FAQ on the official forums[/url][/b].

Experience a year of new quests, stories, and challenges with [i]2025 Content Pass [/i]and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i], now available for early purchase. The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 (ESO’s first zone and story release of the year) arrives June 2 on PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles—your Elder Scrolls saga has only just begun! notes.title: 2025 ESO Direct—Seasons of the Worm Cult Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/8cf5508fa8fb4c7e327cb5efcb2430db.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Get a closer look at 2025’s new zone and storyline, plus discover the Worm Cult’s return to their vile schemes in this preview![/i]
 
[i]ESO[/i]’s [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/contentpass]next big adventure is here as part of the new [i]2025 Content Pass[/i],[/url] and it returns to the root of it all for a storyline 10 years in the making! The villainous Worm Cult from the game’s original main story questline is back, and it’s eager to resume their plans of domination. 

[previewyoutube=OOfYaCdkGTE;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																				      							    							      								      									 
You can experience your first taste of the Worm Cult’s revenge in-game right now with the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67845]free prologue quest[/url]. Prepare for the challenges ahead and face off against the cult’s new weapons, the Soul Reapers, in a story that leads directly into Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1.
 [h2]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/h2] 
Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 launches on June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles and is included as part of the [i]2025 Content Pass[/i]. In this new storyline and zone, you must uncover and investigate the Worm Cult’s new base of operations on the tropical island of Solstice. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/fcb8ae5d0159cfd98bc2c826c9668b17.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/fcb8ae5d0159cfd98bc2c826c9668b17.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The city of Sunport in Solstice[/i]
 
In Part 1, as you explore Western Solstice, you will quickly discover that the Worm Cult is far from defenseless. They’ve erected a massive arcane barrier using soul magic—the Writhing Wall—that divides the island, and for now, Eastern Solstice (and its secrets) is sealed off by this arcane edifice. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/99981971040cd1b654cbfe943b999fd5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/99981971040cd1b654cbfe943b999fd5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Worm Cult has gathered great strength[/i]
 
Despite being a zone divided, you will find that Western Solstice is full of challenges and rewards, including new World Bosses, Delves, a Public Dungeon, and a brand-new Trial, the Ossein Cage. There are 16 Antiquities (including three new Mythic items), four new Trial item sets (including Perfected versions), and a host of other rewards, including even more item sets, and a ton of Collectibles, from crafting motifs to pets. You’ll also receive a 10% experience boost from adventuring in Solstice all year!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/01fcb7fd07d79852c67770c86e82cd65.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/01fcb7fd07d79852c67770c86e82cd65.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Parts 1 and 2 Rewards[/i]

 [h2]Writhing Wall Event[/h2] 
As exciting as all that is, Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 is only the beginning, with more unlocking over 2025 as part of [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67821]the same purchase[/url]. In Q3/Q4 (exact timing TBD), you can band together with other players across Tamriel to bring down the Writhing Wall in a world-changing one-time event. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/19a1d66d4e1472c1a400e3341fc5dab9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/19a1d66d4e1472c1a400e3341fc5dab9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bring down the Writhing Wall[/i]
 
Using the advantages gained in your Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 adventures, the forces opposing the Worm Cult have a plan to pierce the barrier and prepare for a true assault on the Worm Cult’s base in Eastern Solstice. 
 
They’ll need help to do it though—help from all across Tamriel. Join with other players for activities in Solstice and beyond to complete the event and unbar the way forward. You can even help the war effort with just base game access, as people all across Tamriel can gather resources to help fuel the assault.

 [h2]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2[/h2] 
Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2 arrives in Q4 and gives you the opportunity to finally uncover just what these villains have been hiding behind the arcane barrier. Be warned, Eastern Solstice is far less welcoming than the previous territory, thanks to the Worm Cult’s malign influence.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/70c23dd18906913948271301d4e7a590.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/70c23dd18906913948271301d4e7a590.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]What lurks in Eastern Solstice?[/i]
 
Solstice’s second half introduces yet more challenges and rewards, with additional World Bosses, Delves, another Public Dungeon, and new rewards both exclusive to the new content and shared across the unified Solstice zone. You can expect three new overland item sets (giving Solstice six in total once Part 2 unlocks), three more Mythic items, and many more items and collectibles to earn.

 [h2]Dungeon Packs[/h2] 
The year’s new content isn’t limited to Solstice, as the 2025 Content Pass also includes access to a host of four-player dungeons in 2025. Two of them—Exiled Redoubt and Lep Seclusa—are already available as part of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/fallenbanners]Fallen Banners dungeon pack[/url].
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/5330263e07b09cf699c38fbba9c9d12c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/5330263e07b09cf699c38fbba9c9d12c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Tamriel is beset with strife on all sides[/i]
 
In Q3, you’ll also face new threats in the [i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack, which contains the dungeons Black Gem Foundry and Naj Caldeesh. Assault a Daedric forge supplying the Worm Cult from Coldharbour and fight to stop their corruption of an ancient Xanmeer as you battle through these new four-player challenges, each with their own unique rewards!

 [h2]Seasons of Adventure & Danger [/h2] 
With four major releases, including both Western and Eastern Solstice, four dungeons, and a special one-time event, there's a full year of adventures, challenges, and changes coming your way with the [i]2025 Content Pass[/i]. How do you plan to make your stand against the Worm Cult’s return? Are you excited to begin your journey into Solstice? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 is included within the 2025 Content Pass and 2025 Premium Edition and arrives on June 2, 2025, for PC/Mac and June 18, 2025, for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Indulge in Cake, XP Buffs, and Bonus Rewards during the 2025 Anniversary Jubilee Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/c8dbda8d167514a13fcfeb1e2815ee93.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Savor a slice and claim exclusive rewards while celebrating ESO’s birthday during the Anniversary Jubilee in-game event![/i]
 
[h2]ESO Turns Eleven![/h2] 
Celebrate another year of adventures in Tamriel during the 2025 Anniversary Jubilee in-game event from April 3 at 10AM EDT and until April 22 at 10AM EDT. Throughout the jubilee period, you can earn various bonus rewards while enjoying a passive 100% XP buff. Veteran players might recall that this buff was once obtained by eating slices of anniversary cake, and while the cake is no longer necessary to obtain the bonus XP, that doesn’t mean you shouldn't secure a slice of this sweet treat!
 
To earn this year’s anniversary treat, complete the quest “For Cake’s Sake,” which you can acquire by either speaking with the young Khajiit chef, Apprentice Mogh, near the docks of Vulkhel Guard, Davon’s Watch, and Daggerfall, or by picking it up for free in the Quest Starters section of the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/d7431e5c399c32dbcd50d8f11854c3ff.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/d7431e5c399c32dbcd50d8f11854c3ff.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Help Mogh and  share a slice![/i]
  
After securing the 2025 Jubilee Cake memento, you can use  the item once per day to earn three Event Tickets each day of the event. Eat a  slice of cake every day, and you’ll collect up to a  whopping 60 Event Tickets by the festival’s conclusion!
  
[h2]Collect Celebratory Prizes[/h2]  
XP gains, event tickets, and cake aren’t  the only things to look forward to, since during the event, you can also earn exclusive  [b]Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes,[/b] offering multitudes of exciting rewards  you won’t want to miss out  on. Even better, the first Gift Box you collect each day will be a [b]Glorious  Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box[/b] containing even more incredible rewards!
  
You can obtain Gift Boxes from any of the following sources (bear  in mind that only the first Gift Box earned each day will be a Glorious box, no  matter where you get it):
                            [list][*]Any daily quest in the game, as in previous years, including:[/*][list][*]Daily crafting writs[/*][*]Daily Delve, World Boss, and Incursion event quests[/*][*]Daily Alliance War and Battlegrounds quests[/*][*]Daily Dungeon and Trial quests[/*][*]Daily Heist and Sacrament quests[/*][/list][*]Killing and looting any final Dungeon boss[/*][*]Killing and looting any final Trial boss[/*][*]Killing and looting any World boss[/*][*]Killing and looting any final Arena boss[/*][*]Killing and looting Tho'at Replicanum in Infinite Archive[/*][*]Completing any Incursion event, such as a Dark Anchor, Abyssal  Geyser, Bastion Nymic, or similar[/*][*]Rewards for the Worthy reward mails (the box will appear inside  the parcel received)[/*][list][*]Note that you must open the Rewards for the Worthy mail reward container before the end of the event if you wish to obtain an Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box inside it.[/*][/list][*]A chance from Tales of Tribute reward mails, with a higher chance  to receive one based on the challenge of the opponent or the number of  opponents face during a daily (the box will appear inside the parcel received)[/*][list][*]Note that you must open the Tales of Tribute mail reward container before the end of the event if you wish to obtain an Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box inside it.[/*][/list][/list]
Interested in the goodies you can find within these boxes? Check  them out below.
  
[b]Glorious Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box rewards[/b]
            [list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]A motif chapter, furnishing recipe, or style item[/*][*][b]NEW:[/b] A tradeable outfit style page for the Worm Cult  Hunter armor style[/*][*]A fragment for the Jubilee Steed mount (please note  that you need 25 total fragments to make the steed)[/*][*]1 to 10 Transmute Crystals[/*][*]Desecrated Grave Soil, the Worm Cult motif style item[/*][/list]
[b]Regular Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes rewards[/b]
          [list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]A small chance for a motif chapter, furnishing recipe, or style  item[/*][*]A chance for 1 to 10 Transmute Crystals[/*][*]A chance for Desecrated Grave Soil, the Worm Cult motif style  item[/*][*]Another small chance for a tradeable style page from any of the  Bonemold, Earthbone Ayleid, or Worm Cult outfit styles[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/035ababf109e1dc7695ff57af0a8963a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/035ababf109e1dc7695ff57af0a8963a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hunt down Mannimarco’s Minions[/i]
 
In conjunction with these Gift Boxes, you can also receive some special cosmetic rewards you might recognize from last year’s Anniversary Jubilee, but this time you have an even higher chance of acquiring them:
        [list][*]Fishing nodes have a small chance of dropping outfit style pages for the Trueflame Sword Replica.[/*][list][*]Your chances of obtaining this drop are higher if you have the Dominion, Covenant, or Pact Fisherman achievement, and even higher still if you have all base-game Master Angler achievements.[/*][/list][*]Dolmen reward chests have a small chance to contain a style page for the Staff of Worms Replica[/*][list][*]Your chances of obtaining this drop are higher if you have the Dominion, Covenant, or Pact Anchor Shatterer achievement and even higher still if you have the Anchors Away achievement.[/*][/list][*]World Bosses in Vvardenfell have a small chance to drop a style page for either the Sunna’rah Replica or the Barbas Helmet Replica.[/*][list][*]Your chances of obtaining this drop are higher if you have the Defender of Morrowind achievement and are even higher still if you have the Savior of Morrowind achievement.[/*][/list][*]Abyssal Geyser trove clams in Summerset have a small chance to drop a style page for the Ul’vor Staff.[/*][list][*]Your chances of obtaining this drop are higher if you have the Abyssal Devastator achievement and even higher still if you have the Savior of Summerset achievement.[/*][/list][/list]

[h2]Event Tickets & The Impresario [/h2] 
Earned too many Event Tickets and nearing the cap? Head over to your local Impresario bazaar! In preparation for [i]ESO[/i]’s big day, the Impresario has refreshed her store’s stock with a host of rewards. Don’t forget you can only ever hold up to 12 tickets at a time, so be sure to spend them before you go over the cap or you’ll lose them. 
 
Here's what the Impresario will stock during the jubilee:
                            [list][*]All three Stonewisp of Truth and Law pet fragments[/*][list][*]Axiomatic Runestones[/*][*]Glyph of Law[/*][*]Powdered Wisp Remains[/*][/list][*]The first two fragments for the Robes of Truth and Law costume[/*][list][*]Golden Fabric[/*][*]Sapphire Fabric[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the Worm Cult Hunter armor style[/*][*]Anniversary Cake furnishings[/*][list][*]Note that these require you to own the respective year’s cake memento to buy[/*][/list][*]Anniversary Cake Slice furnishings[/*][list][*]Unlike the full cakes, you do not need to own the respective year’s cake memento to buy these[/*][*]Collect seven Anniversary Cake Slice furnishings from 2016 – 2024 to claim the[b] Cake Devourer Achievement[/b]![/*][/list][*]Bags of Jubilee Yesteryear, containing the following and providing only items you do not currently own:[/*][list][*]Bound Worm Cult motif chapters [/*][*]Jephrine Paladin armor style pages[/*][*]Imperial Champion armor style pages[/*][*]Prophet armor style pages[/*][*]Lyris armor style pages[/*][*]Sai Sahan armor style pages[/*][*]Abnur Tharn armor style pages[/*][*]Bound Earthbone Ayleid armor style pages[/*][*]Bound Bonemold armor style pages[/*][*]Aurora Firepot Spider parts (excluding the instructions, which are available from the Impresario’s assistant, Philius Dormier)[/*][*]Desecrated Grave Soil, the Worm Cult motif style item (note that this is a chance in addition to whatever else the bag contains)[/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
During the 2025 Anniversary Jubilee, you can pick up the first two fragments needed for the Robes of Truth and Law costume. Be sure to watch for updates on when you can acquire the remaining fragments soon.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/a7ca904e25d88b2d90b3c9ad89d516fd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/04/a7ca904e25d88b2d90b3c9ad89d516fd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Uphold Justice with the Law and Truth costume[/i]

After you’ve finished checking  out the Impresario’s shop, be sure to stop by her assistant, Philius Dormier’s  store and take advantage of his unique offers:
        [list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments[/*][*]All three Deadlands Scorcher skin fragments[/*][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments[/*][*]All three Scales of Akatosh skin fragments[/*][*]Jubilee Steed mount fragments[/*][*]Bound pages for Replica Trueflame, Replica Barbas Helmet, Replica Sunna’rah, Replica Staff of Worms, and Replica Ul’Vor Staff outfit styles[/*][/list]
Lastly, Nenuluare the Indrik Vendor will have the following  items available to purchase with Event Tickets throughout the event:
          [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Luminous Indrik Berries[/*][*]Icebreath Indrik Berries[/*][*]Shimmering Indrik Pet[/*][*]Rimedusk Indrik Pet[/*][/list]

[h2]Raise a Glass to Another Year of ESO![/h2]  
Indulge in a delectable slice while enjoying a massive boost  to XP gains and exclusive event rewards with the Anniversary Jubilee in-game  event! How do you plan on celebrating [i]ESO[/i]’s 11<sup>th</sup> birthday?  Let us and the #ESOFam know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X  (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
  
[i]The Anniversary Jubilee in-game event starts at 10 AM EDT  on April 3 and runs until 10 AM EDT on April 22.[/i]

notes.title: To Arms! Help Us Collect Vital Data by Battling Your Fellow Players in Cyrodiil
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/badf7341087ad983cce1c4de9df01580.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Join the new Vengeance Alliance War campaign and help us test changes and collect data that could inform future improvements to the game.[/i]

 [h2]Put Cyrodiil to the Test[/h2] 
Part of the ongoing effort to improve performance and stability in [i]ESO[/i]’s open-world PvP experience, Cyrodill Champions has now found its way to the PC/Mac live servers with the Vengeance campaign. 
 
This test Alliance War campaign is now live until the morning of March 31 (during scheduled maintenance). Note that during this time, this will be the ONLY Alliance War campaign available for PC/Mac players. 
 
If you’d like to help us test changes to Cyrodiil and its open-world combat, you can do so by following the process below: 
    [olist][*]Navigate to the Alliance War menu[/*][olist][*]Either by pressing L on your keyboard or navigating direct via the UI[/*][/olist][*]Select the Campaigns tab[/*][*]Select Cyrodiil and then the Vengeance campaign[/*][/olist]

[h2]Vengeance Campaign[/h2] 
The Vengeance campaign is open to all players level 10-50 and introduces a special ruleset to the Alliance War, templatizing player builds to help improve stability. 
       [list][*]All players have normalized stats regardless of level[/*][*]Each Class has a modified set of abilities and items[/*][*]While in Vengeance, you cannot change your class[/*][*]While in Vengeance, you cannot access your bank, vendors, or crafting nodes[/*][*]Only Experience Points, Alliance Points, gold, and Champion Points are retained upon leaving the campaign, and no items can be taken out[/*][*]The Champion System is disabled in this campaign [/*][*]All quests are disabled in this campaign [/*][/list]
Upon entering the campaign, your character is changed to match a specific template for their class. As mentioned above, this includes pre-determined abilities, attributes, consumables, and item sets. It also includes a backpack of supplies that cannot be removed from the campaign. 
 
Note that the templatizing of characters is an experiment and does not necessarily mean that these changes will be made to the Alliance War in the future. By introducing templatized characters for this specific test, we can isolate the variables that impact performance, helping us plan future improvements.
 
For more, check out [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/674932]this Vengeance Campaign Q&A[/url] on the official forums. 
 
Not only does this campaign help test Cyrodiil’s performance while under specific conditions, but it also allows you to battle your fellow players on a completely even playing field. No matter your experience level or items, everybody who enters the Vengeance campaign is at the same power level—leaving only your skill to determine the victor! 

 [h2]Help Us Help Cyrodiil[/h2] 
As you fight to control Cyrodiil, a [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67737]bonus Golden Pursuits campaign[/url][b][/b] is running at the same time, allowing you (on any platform) to earn even more Gold and Alliance Points. Take up arms on behalf of your chosen Alliance and help us chart the future of [i]ESO[/i]’s open-world PvP game mode—we need you!

notes.title: Madcap Merriment Marks Marvelous Rewards as the Jester’s Festival Event Returns
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/57908f210a6709eeb15614594e114daa.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Spread cheer and chaos in equal measure to receive raucous rewards during this year’s Jester’s Festival in-game event![/i]

 [h2]A Festive Frolic for All[/h2] 
The Jester’s Festival in-game event makes its grand return on March 27 at 10AM EDT and will continue until April 3 at 10AM EDT, 2025. Once the fun begins, you can enjoy increases to XP gains and revel in raucous rewards after completing event-specific quests.
 
To receive admission to the festivities, head over to the event pavilions located within Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, or Daggerfall, and speak with one of the three jesters posing as an alliance leader. If the buffoonery of the bash is making your head spin while trying to locate these event sites, open the in-game Crown Store and pick up the Jester's Festival Invitation Quest.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/118336fae112056cb93d9878651a515c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/118336fae112056cb93d9878651a515c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Everybody’s getting in on the party[/i]
 
Upon completing the introductory quest, you’ll earn the delectable Pie of Misrule memento reward, which can be located within the Mementos section of your Collections. However, unlike some previous years, you will no longer need to obtain or use the Pie of Misrule to take advantage of the [b]100% XP buff.[/b] This bonus will now be shared passively to all adventurers participating in Tamriel’s most hilarious holiday. Still, the Pie doesn’t seem to get stale despite the time passing, so feel free to dig in!

 [h2]Complete Quixotic Quests, Grab Goofy Goodies[/h2] 
Throughout the Jester’s Festival, you can pick up various event-specific daily quests. For each one completed, you’ll receive a Jester's Festival Box. Furthermore, the [b]first[/b] Jester’s Festival daily quest you complete each day will reward you with one [b]Stupendous Jester's Festival Box[/b].
 
Each of these boxes can include the following items:
 [list][*]Festive Dazzlers[/*]  [*]Cherry Blossom Confetti[/*]  [*]Revelry Pies[/*]  [*]Festive furnishings[/*]  [*]Jester’s Festival provisioning recipes[/*]  [*]Treasures that can be sold to vendors for Gold[/*]  [*]Previous years’ style pages[/*]  [*]One of the following:[/*]  [list][*]A random unbound page for either the Broom or Bucket       styles.[/*]   [*]Regal Regalia, Second Seed, or Jester’s Seeker Suit style       pages[/*]   [*]A fragment for previous Jester’s collectibles:[/*]   [list][*]Cadwell's Surprise Box memento[/*]    [*]Sovereign Sow pet[/*]    [*]Playful Prankster's Surprise Box memento[/*]    [*]Jester’s Daedroth Suit costume[/*]   [/list][/list][/list]
In addition to the aforementioned rewards, the Stupendous Jester’s Festival Box has a chance to contain the following goodies:
 [list][*][b]NEW:[/b] A random unbound page of the Alliance      Mimicry outfit style[/*]  [list][*]Note that this style consists of head and chest pages for       each alliance[/*]  [/list][*][b]NEW:[/b] An unbound Jester’s Deadly Headband adornment      Runebox[/*]  [*]Jester's Scintillator Runebox[/*]  [*]Cherry Blossom Branch Runebox[/*]  [*]Cadwell's Kitchen weapon style page[/*]  [*]High-value treasures[/*]  [*]Festive Noise Maker Parts[/*]  [*]Joke Popper Parts[/*] [/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/b451053c81365df62838a6e5506d29fe.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/b451053c81365df62838a6e5506d29fe.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Alliance Mimicry Styles and Jester’s Deadly Headband adornment[/i]

 [h2]Event Tickets and Merchants[/h2] 
During the festivities, you can collect three Event Tickets for the first Jester’s Festival quest completed each day. Participating in the festivities every day of the event can earn you up to 24 tickets total.
 
Note that the total number of Event Tickets you can carry at one time is capped at 12. If you are close to the limit, then be sure to spend a few to avoid wasting any Tickets. That’d be a little too silly even for Jester’s Festival!
 
Never one to miss a party, the Impresario has special wares on sale during the event:
 [list][*]All three [b]Stonewisp of Truth and Law [/b]pet      fragments[/*][list][*][b]Axiomatic Runestones[/b][/*][*][b]Glyph of Law[/b][/*][*][b]Powdered Wisp Remains[/b][/*][/list][*]All three fragments for the [b]Logical Rune      Extraction[/b] customized action[/*][list][*][b]Exalted Icon of Logic[/b][/*][*][b]Flawless Prism[/b][/*][*][b]NEW Jhunal's Magnificent Extrication[/b][/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the Alliance Mimicry outfit[/*][*]The Jester's Deadly Headband adornment[/*] [/list]
This is the first showing of the full set of fragments you need for the Logical Rune Extraction customized action. Be sure to grab it now that you’ll have the opportunity!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/f04053db6909f13d822e6593d9acedd1438432.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/f04053db6909f13d822e6593d9acedd1438432.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Logical Rune Extraction customized action[/i]
 
In addition to the above items, Nenulaure, the Indrik vendor, will offer the following items for Event Tickets:
 [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*]  [*]Dawnwood Indrik Berries[/*]  [*]Spectral Indrik Berries[/*]  [*]Springtide Indrik Pet[/*]  [*]Haunting Indrik Pet[/*] [/list]
Lastly, the Impresario’s Assistant will sell the following items, also purchasable with Event Tickets:
 [list][*]Unstable Morpholith pet fragments[/*]  [*]Doomchar Plateau house fragments[/*]  [*]Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments[/*]  [*]Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh fragments[/*] [/list]

[h2]Step Right Up![/h2] 
Spread cheer across Tamriel and leave all grinning in your wake! There’s a host of ridiculous rewards available when you do. Let us know what manner of mischief you plan to pull via  [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Jester’s Festival in-game event begins Thursday, March 27 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Thursday, April 3 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Fallen Banners & Update 45 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/1b8ed7104cb38ea5dadd00b4d2fe8630.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Defend an Elder Scroll and experience a host of changes and additions to the game with the Fallen Banners dungeon pack and Update 45 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack and free Update 45 base-game patch are now live on PC/Mac and arrives March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. In this release, you can save Cyrodiil from plunging further into chaos with two new dungeons and experience a host of changes and quality-of-life additions. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6a99ceaf637e19dc2680e92c25db153a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6a99ceaf637e19dc2680e92c25db153a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Fallen Banners  dungeon pack[/i]
  
You can get access to the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack  at launch via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url]. Note that alternative means of acquiring it will be  revealed as part of the upcoming ESO Direct on April 10.

[h2]Fallen Banners[/h2]  
Gather your party for two challenging new PvE dungeon  experiences: Lep Seclusa and Exiled Redoubt. Unlock new achievements and earn  new rewards including item sets, collectibles, and more as you fight to  preserve what little peace remains in the war-torn region of Cyrodiil. 
  
[b]Lep Seclusa[/b]
  
The Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa are besieged, and the  cunning Orpheon the Tactician is set on seizing the power of the Elder Scroll  they safeguard. You must help Sister Chana defend the sanctuary against an army  of deserters, protect its people and secrets, and confront Orpheon before he  can use the power of the scroll to forever change the face of Cyrodiil. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3e890dfac396411246bb61663793e8dc.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3e890dfac396411246bb61663793e8dc.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Defend the Moth Priest sanctuary[/i]
 
To learn more about Lep Seclusa, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67577]this preview blog[/url]. 
 

[b]Exiled Redoubt[/b]
 
Soldiers of the Alliance War, regardless of their faction, are vanishing, and all trails lead to the Imperial fortress known as the Exiled Redoubt. Team up with the Battlemage Lucilla, infiltrate this mysterious stronghold, and put a stop to the schemes of a once noble Imperial house before its chaos can spread beyond its stone walls and throughout Tamriel. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3c5a1e34a6048948637a9f085afad681.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3c5a1e34a6048948637a9f085afad681.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle your way into an Imperial stronghold[/i]
 
To learn more about the Exiled Redoubt, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67647]this preview blog[/url].  
 

[b]New Dungeon Loot[/b]
 
Those who brave Lep Seclusa and the Exiled Redoubt also have a chance to loot and unlock a host of special rewards, such as new collectibles, item sets, and Achievements. This includes the Tactician’s Gold Lattice Skin, earned by completing both dungeons on veteran difficulty—no easy task!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/be3c94df60cf7ffc72b87d3d7322ca8c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/be3c94df60cf7ffc72b87d3d7322ca8c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock a new Cyrodiil-inspired skin[/i]
 

[h2]Getting Started[/h2] 
At launch, you can access the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack with an ESO Plus membership. If your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or acquire it by other means. 
 
Note that while at launch ESO Plus membership is the only way to access the dungeon pack, there will be additional ways to acquire it in the future—stay tuned for more information during the April ESO Direct. 
 
Once you have access to [i]Fallen Banners[/i], you can dive right into the two new dungeons via the following methods: 
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool [/*][*]By visiting their specific dungeon entrances within the Hew's Bane (Lep Seclusa) and West Weald (Exiled Redoubt) zones[/*][/list]
As a base-game patch, Update 45 will be automatically downloaded by your game clients when it launches. 


 [h2]Update 45 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
Arriving in tandem with the dungeon pack is the Update 45 base-game patch, a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players that features additions, bugfixes, and improvements to the game. 
 

[b]Starter Zone Refresh[/b]
 
To help keep [i]ESO[/i] as welcoming to new (and returning) players as possible, the game’s starter zones have received a visual refresh, bringing them closer to the quality of more recent additions. Bleakrock Isle, Bal Foyen, Stros M’kai, Betnikh, and Khenarthi’s Roost have each received improvements to their lighting, enhanced ground and water textures, updated structures, and the addition of more clutter or props. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6f2cd232f72d4e943f714e6005cd0e4f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6f2cd232f72d4e943f714e6005cd0e4f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Discover updated starter zones[/i]
 

[b]Cyrodiil Champions PC/Mac Test[/b]
 
[i]ESO[/i]’s Alliance War veterans can help the team test future changes and iterations on the game’s open-world PvP with a PC/Mac-only test called Cyrodiil Champions. With the goal of improving stability and performance in Cyrodiil (and perhaps other environments), look for a special Alliance War campaign called Vengeance to participate from March 24-31, 2025. 
 

[b]General Changes and Improvements [/b]
 
Along with the above, Update 45 also boosts mount starting speed, overhauls the Craft constellation to ease micromanagement, and introduces a general UI cleanup of the in-game map to help improve readability. It also moves the game’s disguises out of the inventory and into your collections and improves the visibility of Mundus Stone boons—phew! 
 
You can discover more about the update’s features in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67601]this preview blog[/url]. For everything arriving as part of the base-game patch, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url]. Don’t forget, the Update 45 base-game patch is FREE for all [i]ESO[/i] players and is downloaded automatically at launch.
 

[h2]Delve into the Endless Conflict[/h2] 
Gather your party and prepare to delve into two challenging new PvE experiences with the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack. Are you ready to witness the true cost of the Alliance War? Are you excited to make use of the base-game patch’s various improvements and additions? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Fallen Banners dungeon pack and Update 45 is now live for ESO Plus members on PC/Mac and arrives March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Look for more details on additional ways to acquire Fallen Banners during the upcoming April ESO Direct.[/i]

notes.title: Golden Pursuits—Clash with Your Fellow Players to Unlock a New Customized Action
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/86a47ce9b0e38029a4b369341a5557ce.jpg[/img]
