notes.title: Update 44 Base-Game Patch Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/c8025a77e15bd60cc886fba25dd47de1.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Find glory in the updated Battlegrounds, recruit new Companions, and develop your mastery of Scribing in the Update 44 base-game patch.[/i]
 
The Update 44 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac, and it introduces a host of changes, fixes, and additions to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/cc93cba524ad27b5a90ca696e65ee07d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/cc93cba524ad27b5a90ca696e65ee07d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 



This update is free for all [i]ESO[/i] players (and will be automatically downloaded and patched by the game), but note that the two new Companions require either ESO Plus™ membership or purchase from the Crown Store to access. Check out the full patch notes for Update 44 on our official forums. [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/667797]Follow this link for full patch notes[/url]. 
										      							    							      								      							      							    							      								      									 
[h2][u]New Features[/u][/h2] 
The Update 44 base-game patch adds a ton of new features, challenges, and rewards to the game. 
 
[b]Battlegrounds Update[/b]
 
[i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced PvP experience, Battlegrounds, has undergone a series of dramatic changes designed to make the game mode (originally introduced with the [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter back in 2017) more competitive and fun for every type of player.
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=VT3Dq5A6LHg;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																											      							    							      								      									
Changes include a shift from the original 4v4v4 to the new 4v4 and 8v8-sized matches, the addition of seven brand-new maps of various sizes, new rewards and mechanics, and a unique leaderboard for the 4v4 competitive-styled option.

To jump right into the action, use the Activity Finder, select Battlegrounds, and select your match size. No matter what kind of PvP player you are, you can enjoy the frenetic action of the new-look Battlegrounds—to glory!

[b]New Companions[/b]

Update 44 also introduces two brand-new Companions for you to recruit and adventure with: Tanlorin and Zerith-var. The High Elf outcast Tanlorin mixes Dragonknight and Soul Magic abilities (the first Companion to do so). Zerith-var, on the other hand, is a Khajiit Necromancer from the distant past.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1ac957846eeb4ca1aef76999becc34a1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1ac957846eeb4ca1aef76999becc34a1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Tanlorin and Zerith-var[/i]
 
Both Companions have their own passive abilities to unlock along with their own questlines and stories to tell, giving you the opportunity to discover more about these interesting adventuring allies. 
 
Note that to unlock both new allies, you need to find them within the Companions section of the in-game Crown Store. They are listed as free for ESO Plus members or available for purchase with crowns if you don’t currently have an active membership. Once unlocked, you can find Tanlorin just outside Vulkhel Guard in Auridon and Zerith-var near Moonmont in Reaper’s March. 
 
[b]New Grimoire, Scripts, Skill Styles, and More[/b]
 
First introduced with the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter and Update 42 in June, the Scribing System also continues to expand with Update 44. This includes a brand-new Grimoire to unlock and customize, called Banner Bearer. Banner Bearer is part of the Support Skill Line and grants you the ability to throw a banner on your back and buff your group’s abilities based on your chosen Focus. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/a8e267c3b1340e2c207e38853c1f9371.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/a8e267c3b1340e2c207e38853c1f9371.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Master new abilities and styles[/i]
 
In addition to this new ability, 14 existing scripts are now applicable to nine launch Grimoires, and a selection of four new Skill Styles help you stand out on the battlefield. Skill Styles include a molten variant for the Puncture ability, a wildburn variant for Force Shock, and more. 
 
You can acquire the new Banner Bearer Grimoire from Chronicler Firandil within the Scholarium. Check the patch notes for a complete list of Scribing additions. Don’t forget, you need access to the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter to begin your Scribing journey. 
 
[b]Golden Pursuits[/b]
 
A new way to earn in-game collectibles, items, and currencies, Golden Pursuits is a new reward system included with Update 44. Highly variable, a Golden Pursuits campaign asks players to complete various tasks as they adventure in Tamriel with a series of rewards granted for specific milestones.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1039ac2c96420cb9d14bcda05b9850ed.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1039ac2c96420cb9d14bcda05b9850ed.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn rewards with Golden Pursuits[/i]
 
The first Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active until the middle of November, so keep an eye out for an official announcement and get ready to earn new in-game rewards. 
 
[b]Imperial City Changes[/b]
 
If you enjoy battling both your fellow players AND invading Daedra in the heart of the empire, the Imperial City has also undergone a few changes within its war-torn streets and sewers. This includes improvements to how Imperial Vaults work. For starters, Imperial City keys and key fragments convert to Imperial Fragments, and vault treasure chests become vendors.
 
In addition, many of the area’s existing vendors have enjoyed upgrades to their wares, including their quality and selection. With Update 44, plundering the capital has never been more rewarding!
 [h2]Additional Features & Improvements[/h2] 
Arriving in tandem with the above new features are a series of improvements, additions, and features that all [i]ESO[/i] players will appreciate. This includes:
        [list][*]An increase of furnishing base materials in regular harvest nodes[/*][*]HDR support for PC players[/*][list][*]Including various new visual settings such as HDR scene brightness and contrast[/*][/list][*]The addition of quest pips for Master Writs[/*][list][*]Including both quest markers and objective tracking[/*][/list][*]The addition of bonus PvP perks for ESO Plus members[/*][list][*]10% boost to Alliance Points earned (the currency), your PvP Skill Line ranks, and Alliance rank (not leaderboards or Rewards of the Worthy grant rate)[/*][*]10% boost to Tel Var Stones gained from killing monsters[/*][/list][/list]
These are just some of the changes and additions coming with Update 44. For more on all of the above and info on the bugfixes and balance tweaks arriving with this new base-game patch, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]New Battles, Allies, and Rewards[/h2] 
Whether you’re an experienced veteran of [i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced PvP mode, a humble adventurer seeking new allies, or an explorer of the unknown pursuing new powers and rewards, Update 44 has something for you! Are you ready to rejoin the Battlegrounds? Which Companion will you recruit first? Tell us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on November 13.[/i]

notes.title: Update 44 Preview—Golden Pursuits
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/c269ddc478209a5e1f2157fe3f78df00.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]In addition to the [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66847][i]Battlegrounds update[/i][/url][i], [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66831][i]new Companions[/i][/url][i], and more, Update 44 also introduces Golden Pursuits, a new reward system that allows you to complete activities to earn additional in-game items, currencies, and collectibles. [/i]
 
This new system will arrive when Update 44 goes live on October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, but note that the first Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active until later in November—keep an eye out for details! 

[h2]A New Way to Earn Rewards[/h2] 
When designing Golden Pursuits, the team wanted to create new reasons to play and new ways for players to earn in-game rewards. 
 
“Golden Pursuits are intended to give players the opportunity to earn extra rewards for trying out different systems and features,” explains Katie Yu, one of [i]ESO[/i]’s Systems Designers. “They’re meant to highlight specific aspects of the game, or to support an event or theme. We want to ensure that players know exactly what they have the opportunity to earn and that they feel rewarded for completing the Golden Pursuit.”
 
While Daily Login Rewards are set every month, almost every aspect of a Golden Pursuits campaign can vary. This includes its ease or difficulty of activities, volume and quality of rewards, and even when they’re active and duration. 
 
“Unlike many of the systems in [i]ESO[/i], Golden Pursuits don't operate on a regular daily or weekly cadence. There may be anywhere from days, to weeks, to months in between them, and Golden Pursuits will vary in length when they are live. They're meant to be exciting, spontaneous events. But don't worry, they're pretty difficult to miss: Golden Pursuits will always appear on the Announcement Panel and in the Group and Activity Finder when they're active.”

[h2]A Variety of Challenges [/h2] 
As mentioned above, each Golden Pursuits campaign will vary greatly in size and scope, and this variability will be reflected in the activities and rewards each individual campaign may offer. 
 
“Generally, the activities will be very similar to what players have been seeing from Endeavors,” says Yu. “The number can vary—some Golden Pursuits may offer only a few activities, while others may provide more options for players to peruse before deciding how they want to earn their rewards. Broadly, Golden Pursuits activities are meant to highlight different parts of the game, whether that's encouraging players to engage in some friendly PvP, or try out Housing and Home Tours, or even simply explore what the wide world of Tamriel has to offer.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/ac34612c32d60aa52569c9f00b0c0567.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/ac34612c32d60aa52569c9f00b0c0567.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Pursue new challenges[/i]
 
When it comes to the individual rewards, it was important to the team that Golden Pursuits campaigns varied the kinds of things you can earn. 
 
“Players can expect to see mounts, pets, costumes, furnishings—the list goes on,” explains Yu. “There’s a wide variety of cosmetics, minor utility items such as potions and meals, currencies, and more from Golden Pursuits, and we're really excited to give players new opportunities to earn them.”
 
With this broad selection of reward types in mind, the team worked to ensure that the ideal balance is struck between the effort required to complete a Golden Pursuit and what it awards. 
 
“Each Golden Pursuit is designed to be fully completable within the duration that it's active. To give a peek behind the curtain, Golden Pursuits are typically put together by a multidisciplinary group before launch. We have data gathered from player feedback, and we review the performance of similar systems in [i]ESO [/i]to inform the design and expected level of investment. Our goal is to make sure playing with an active Golden Pursuit is both exciting and rewarding.”

[h2]Golden Opportunities[/h2] 
With Update 44’s Golden Pursuits, the team is adding even more ways for you to earn rewards as you play. Note that at launch, a Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active, but keep an eye out for an official announcement for the first of its kind around the middle of November. Are you excited to complete your first Golden Pursuit? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Hack at Horrors and Harrow Hollowjack Himself as the Witches Festival Returns
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/4280e902d3771c04640124ffe367e184.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Face down the horrors of Tamriel, including Lord Hollowjack himself, for special in-game rewards during 2024’s Witches Festival in-game event![/i]
 
This year’s Witches Festival begins next Thursday, October 24 and runs until Wednesday, November 6 at 10AM EST. During this spoopy seasonal event, you can claim ghoulishly good event-specific rewards including Plunder Skulls, XP boosts, Event Tickets, and more!
 
During the Witches Festival, all adventurers will enjoy a passive 100% boost to XP gain at all times. However, the Witchmother’s Whistle, once the source of this bonus (and a skeletal transformation!), is still available. To collect the whistle and down ladles of hag’s brew for frightful fun, simply follow the steps listed below:
[list][*]Open the Crown Store and acquire the free quest “The Witchmother's Bargain.”[/*][list][*]You can also pick up this quest by speaking with the Crow Caller, who you’ll find outside of each Olyve's Brewery in Stonefalls, Glenumbra, or Auridon.[/*][/list][*]Complete the introductory quest to receive the Witchmother's Whistle tool.[/*][list][*]You won’t need to acquire the Witchmother’s Whistle if you finished the quest in a previous year’s event.[/*][/list][*]Blow the whistle to summon the “Witchmother's Cauldron,” from which you can drink to polymorph yourself into a spooky scary skeleton.[/*][list][*]You cannot summon the Cauldron in Cyrodiil.[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/991d1046fcd318cc37e6a3c7474bb240.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/991d1046fcd318cc37e6a3c7474bb240.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Drink the witches’ brew straight from the cauldron[/i]
 [h2]A Wicked Harvest[/h2] 
During the Witches Festival event, whenever you defeat a boss monster, you’ll be offered a Plunder Skull container in addition to any regular rewards.
 
When you open a Plunder Skull, you have the chance to receive the following items:
         [list][*]Alchemy reagents[/*][list][*]A festival-themed furnishing recipe[/*][*]A festival-themed provisioning recipe[/*][*]A complete festival-themed furnishing[/*][*]A festival-themed sellable treasure[/*][/list][*]A small chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]A Hollowjack style item[/*][*]A Dremora style item[/*][/list][*]Worms, Crawlers, Guts, or Insect Parts[/*][/list]
What’s more, whenever you fell a unique boss type for the first time each day, you’ll be rewarded instead with a special Dremora Plunder Skull that contains some of the above items in addition to a chance at one of the following:
       [list][*]A Witches Festival Writ[/*][*]A Glenmoril Treasure Map[/*][*]A Glenmoril armor outfit style page[/*][*]A Crowborne Hunter outfit style page[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Plunder Skull Blunder Memento Runebox[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Senchal Horned Owl pet fragment[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]tradeable style page for the Eltheric Revenant outfit style[/*][/list]
Both varieties of Plunder Skull are offered by arena bosses, incursion bosses (from Dark Anchors, Harrowstorms, Volcanic Vents, etc.), delve bosses, final dungeon bosses, Trial bosses, public dungeon bosses, world bosses, and Tho’at Replicanum in Infinite Archive (new for this year!).
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/2214c2af9555ae05cfeb6d375a6b7eba.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/2214c2af9555ae05cfeb6d375a6b7eba.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Perilous plunder, yours for the taking[/i]
 
There are two additional Plunder Skulls acquirable by those brave (or foolish) enough to face the worst of the Witches Festival's horrors. 
 
The first of these frightful fiends, the Crowborne Horror, returns to Tamriel to bedevil its denizens. To locate and slay this living nightmare, acquire the daily quest “Plucking the Crow” by speaking with Witchmother Taerma, located inside Olyve’s Brewery and at every Impresario tent found throughout Tamriel.
 
For your courage, the first time you overcome the Crowborne Horror and turn in your quest each day, you’ll be rewarded with a Dremora Plunder Skull. This creepy container has a small chance to grant you an incredible offering of tradeable Witches Festival valuables instead of regular Dremora Plunder Skull items, including:
     [list][*]The FULL style book for the Dremora motif[/*][*]A folio of ALL Glenmoril treasure maps[/*][*]All 10 Senchal Horned Owl Pet Fragments[/*][*]Runebox: Plunder Skull Blunder[/*][*]All of the Eltheric Revenant Outfit style pages[/*][/list]
If even the Crowborne Horror does not daunt you, you may test that fearlessness against the master of monstrosity and sovereign of spookiness, Lord Hollowjack himself. You can acquire the quest to challenge him from the Priest Maxien, located inside Olyve’s Brewery. Once you’ve completed this quest at least once on a given character, you can take it again on subsequent days and skip ahead to challenge Hollowjack directly.
 
Should you emerge victorious against the Daedric Lord, you’ll find the quest reward each day grants a special Dremora Plunder Skull unique to Lord Hollowjack. It has a chance to contain a jackpot like that from the Crowborne Horror, and it awards a special achievement and trophy furnishing to commemorate your victory. A matching collectible bust furnishing can sometimes be acquired from looting Lord Hollowjack.

Of note: The Witches Festival will be your first opportunity to begin gathering the fragments for the final event morphing collectible of 2024, the Haven of the Five Companions house!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/97dea21c97fb3c7b4e1acf590083b989.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/97dea21c97fb3c7b4e1acf590083b989.jpg[/img]																[/url]

Additionally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase using Event Tickets:

Lastly, the Impresario’s Assistant is offering the following, which you can acquire with Event Tickets:
 [list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith fragments[/*]  [list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*]   [*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*]   [*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*]  [/list][*]All three Dagonic Quasigriff fragments[/*]  [list][*]Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather[/*]   [*]Black Iron Bit[/*]   [*]Bridle Black Iron Stirrups[/*]  [/list][/list][list][*]All      three Soulfire Dragon Illusion Imp pet fragments[/*]  [list][*]Hallowed       Hourglass Basin[/*]   [*]Illuminated       Dragon Scroll[/*]   [*]Kvatchian       Incense[/*]  [/list][/list][list][*]All three fragments for the Daggerfall Paladin outfit[/*][list][*]Blessed Rubedite Enamel[/*][*]Captured Dragonflame[/*][*]Sanctified Metalworking Tools[/*][/list][/list]

[i]Make the most out of buffs to XP and more during the Explorer’s Celebration in-game event![/i]

The #ESOFam completed an immense number of quests during the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/fallenleaves]Fallen Leaves of West Weald[/url] event. Now, it's time to reap the rewards! During the event, you can gain bonuses from the following sources:

notes.title: Seek Ayleid Relics to Unlock Rewards during the Fallen Leaves of West Weald Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/6253fe1592c434ba342735c098e603e6.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Delve into the history of the Heartland elves and unlock special rewards for all Gold Road players during a new event! [/i]
 
The Fallen Leaves of West Weald in-game event kicks off on Thursday, September 26 at 10AM EDT and continues until Tuesday, October 8. During the event, you can seek out lost relics of the ancient Ayleid empire, learn about the history surrounding Cyrodiil’s ancient rulers, and unlock collectible rewards for ALL [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter owners. 
 [h2]Seek Lost Knowledge, Together![/h2] 
Throughout the event period, you can acquire the new daily quest, “Fallen Leaves of West Weald,” available from Gandrinar, located outside the Skingrad Impresario’s tent. To complete this new daily, collect lost Ayleid relics, bundle them, and bring them back to Gandrinar. Doing so will grant event quest rewards (and on occasion, some additional lore about the region’s ancient rulers), in addition to progressing the Fallen Leaves of West Weald meter, found on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/fallenleaves]event’s official page[/url]. 
 
As the community completes the new daily quest, they help progress a new event meter, unlocking three tiers of rewards:
   [list][*]33%—Vineyard Voriplasm pet[/*][*]66% —Luminescing Varla Stone memento[/*][*]100%—Russet Brekka mount, Tree-Sap Legion arms pack, and a nesting rewards box [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/3c1a54c350bddc00784efdb8f3d12c41.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/3c1a54c350bddc00784efdb8f3d12c41.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock these event rewards[/i]
 
When the event ends on October 8 (or as soon the meter reaches 100%), the community can claim all unlocked rewards free from the in-game Crown Store for a limited time. Note that these rewards can be unlocked and claimed ONLY by [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter players, so if you’ve yet to own [i]ESO[/i]’s latest adventure, be sure to pick it up. 
 
Be sure to visit the official [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/fallenleaves]Fallen Leaves of West Weald page[/url] often to check the community’s progress and see what rewards have been unlocked. 
 
[b]Bonus Explorer’s Celebration[/b]
 
In addition to the event’s main meter and rewards, you and your fellow players can also unlock additional days of the subsequent Explorer’s Celebration event by completing ANY quests within the West Weald zone. 
 
For every 33% of the bonus meter completed (also found on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/fallenleaves]official event page[/url]), we’ll enable three days of the Explorer’s Celebration. This bonus mini-event kicks off as soon as the Fallen Leaves of West Weald event ends on October 8 and grants additional XP, Gold, and resource harvesting for everybody in Tamriel during the event period. 
 [h2]Earn Coffers While Adventuring[/h2] 
While the event (and community chase) is ongoing, you can receive a [b]special Sublime Fallen Leaves Coffer[/b] for the first West Weald zone daily quest you complete each day AND then earn [b]regular Fallen Leaves Coffers[/b] for various activities after. 
 
Note that you can also acquire regular Fallen Leaves Coffers by defeating bosses and monsters, harvesting resource nodes, pickpocketing, or opening treasure chests, safeboxes, psijic portals, Thieves Troves, or other lootable objects within West Weald. 
 
Fallen Leaves Coffers can contain the following items: 
              [list][*]A chance for random crafting materials [/*][*]A chance for a [i]Gold Road[/i] saleable treasure[/*][*]A chance for a style item for [i]Gold Road[/i] motifs [/*][list][*]Lucent Guardian[/*][*]West Weald Legion[/*][*]Shard Knight [/*][/list][*]A chance for a [i]Gold Road[/i] overland set item[/*][*]A chance for Companion gear (with any Companion unlocked) [/*][*]A chance for one of the following[/*][list][*][i]Gold Road[/i] furnishings [/*][*][i]Gold Road[/i] furnishing recipe [/*][*][i]Gold Road[/i] Treasure Map or Survey Report[/*][*][i]Gold Road[/i] motif page (Lucent Guardian, West Weald Legion, Shard Knight) [/*][/list][*]A small chance for a tradeable style page of the new Tree-Sap Legion armor style. [/*][/list]
Note that the once-daily Sublime Fallen Leaves Coffer has a higher chance of containing the above rewards than the regular one, but there’s no limit to the number of regular coffers you can earn in a single day. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/a54e54d4bef3518d0179f300a02cbcee.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/a54e54d4bef3518d0179f300a02cbcee.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Adventure in Gold Road to earn coffers[/i]
 
[b]Additional Rewards [/b]
 
As you collect coffers during the event, you can also enjoy the following bonuses within West Weald: 
   [list][*]Zone daily quests and Trial weekly quests (Lucent Citadel) award double non-event reward boxes[/*][*]Harvest node yields within [i]Gold Road[/i] are increased (not including fishing holes)[/*][*][i]Gold Road[/i] world bosses, public dungeon bosses, Trial bosses, and delve bosses all award double loot[/*][/list][h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
During the Fallen Leaves of West Weald event, you can earn two Event Tickets per day by completing Gandrinar’s quest, any zone daily quest, or the Lucent Citadel weekly quest. In addition, the Impresario will stock the following items: 
           [list][*]All three [b]Molag Bal Illusion Imp [/b]pet fragments [/*][list][*]Anchor Chain Fragment[/*][*]Dark Anchor Pinion[/*][*]Effigy of the Dominator[/*][/list][*]All three [b]Anchorborn Welwa[/b] mount fragments[/*][list][*]Bizarre Daedric Meat[/*][*]Fine Ebonsteel Chain[/*][*]Strengthened Welwa Muzzle[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the Tree-Sap Legion style [/*][*]Group Repair Kits [/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
This is your chance to complete the fearsome Anchorborn Welwa mount! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/af0386db601ae6d77643abe680d4f866.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/af0386db601ae6d77643abe680d4f866.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Anchorborn Welwa mount[/i]
 
At the same time, the Impresario’s Assistant will stock the following goods:
                 [list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]All three Deadlands Firewalker personality fragments[/*][list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew[/*][/list][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion Imp pet fragments[/*][list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*][*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*][*]Kvatchian Incense[/*][/list][*]All three Aurelic Quasigriff mount fragments[/*][list][*]Aurelite Gryphon Feather[/*][*]Gilded Gryphon Barding[/*][*]Sacred Seeds of Akatosh[/*][/list][/list]
Finally, the Indrik vendor will have Nascent Indrik Feathers, Onyx Indrik Berries, Mossheart Indrik Berries, the Ebon-Glow Indrik pet, and the Sapling Indrik pet—phew!
 [h2]Return to Gold Road[/h2] 
Scour West Weald for the remnants of the Heartland elves and you can help your fellow players unlock rewards for all [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter owners. Are you excited to return to this autumnal Imperial region? Let us know if you’re excited for the Fallen Leaves of West Weald event via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url], and don’t forget to check the community’s progress on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/fallenleaves]official event page[/url]! 
 
[i]The Fallen Leaves of West Weald in-game event begins Thursday, September 26 from 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, October 8 at 10AM EDT. [/i]

notes.title: Earn Bonus Loot When Delving into Tamriel’s Dungeons during the Undaunted Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/c629c32077f04cbce3e489482b00e791.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Receive exciting bonus rewards when conquering Tamriel’s dungeons during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event.[/i]
 [h2]Adventure Fearlessly[/h2] 
Take up arms, brave warriors! The Undaunted Celebration returns Thursday, September 12 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, September 24 at 10AM EDT. During this in-game PvE event, you and other hardy adventurers can obtain special rewards and Event Tickets by conquering any of [i]ESO[/i]’s group dungeons. 
 
Once the event kicks off next week, you can begin your expedition into any of Tamriel’s many dungeons via your map, the Activity Finder, or the dungeon’s entrance. Additionally, you can obtain the Undaunted Celebration’s introductory quest “Glory of the Undaunted” by speaking to Serileth (located at any Undaunted Enclave), traveling to an Impresario tent, or snagging free from the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/73f5287c12ad2a1ac276c76934e2f4bb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/73f5287c12ad2a1ac276c76934e2f4bb.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Locate Serileth![/i]
 [h2]Great Deeds Yield Greater Rewards[/h2] 
The dungeons scattered across Tamriel are dangerous and challenging, but the rewards that await are worth the risk! Each day, the first time you complete a dungeon throughout the duration of the event, you’ll receive a Glorious Undaunted Reward Box as an additional loot drop. Contained within these boxes are various goodies including gold, consumables, style pages, Undaunted Keys, Opal Weapon styles, and more.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/ab8d5573767012eeb4141a834d3abaa0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/ab8d5573767012eeb4141a834d3abaa0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Slay Dungeon Bosses to Unlock Bonus Rewards[/i]
 
In addition, each subsequent final dungeon boss defeated yields a regular Undaunted Reward box, which can include the following items:
                                       [list][*]A guaranteed chance to drop an item set piece from the dungeon in which the box was acquired.[/*][*]A guaranteed chance to drop one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A random motif style page from the following:[/*][list][*]Ascendant Order [/*][*]Blessed Inheritor [/*][*]Blind Path Cultist [/*][*]Bloodforge [/*][*]Crimson Oath [/*][*]Dreadsail [/*][*]Drowned Mariner [/*][*]Fang Lair [/*][*]Hazardous Alchemy[/*][*]Huntsman  [/*][*]Icereach [/*][*]Mazzatun [/*][*]Moongrave Fane [/*][*]Pyre Watch [/*][*]Scalecaller [/*][*]Scribes of Mora [/*][*]Silver Dawn [/*][*]Silken Ring [/*][*]Silver Rose [/*][*]Stags of Z’en [/*][*]Recollection [/*][*]Thorn Legion [/*][*]True Sworn [/*][*]Waking Flame [/*][*]Y’ffre’s Will[/*][/list][*]1,000 Gold[/*][*]An Undaunted Key[/*][*]A Crown Repair Kit[/*][*]A Riding Lesson[/*][/list][*]A chance to drop an Opal monster weapon style for:[/*][list][*]Bloodspawn[/*][*]Chokethorn[/*][*]Engine Guardian[/*][*]Ilambris [/*][*]Troll King [/*][/list][*]A chance to drop an Earthgore Opal weapon style [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/2902ba89fc08efd34d77bb9f81e55f91.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/2902ba89fc08efd34d77bb9f81e55f91.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earthgore Opal weapon style[/i]
 
The Glorious Undaunted Reward Box can contain any of the above items, but instead always drops one of the following Opal monster weapon styles: 
     [list][*]Bloodspawn[/*][*]Chokethorn[/*][*]Engine Guardian[/*][*]Ilambris [/*][*]Troll King[/*][/list]
You can obtain regular Undaunted Reward Boxes by completing Bolgrul’s Daily Undaunted Delve quest. You can locate Bolgrul within any Undaunted Enclave.  
 
[b]Opal Monster Mask Style Pages[/b]
 
Throughout the Undaunted Celebration, slaying and looting a specific dungeon’s final boss on veteran hard mode provides a greater chance to obtain its associated Opal Monster Mask style page. This includes the following bosses and dungeons: 
     [list][*]Bloodspawn (Spindleclutch II)[/*][*]Chokethorn (Elden Hollow I) [/*][*]Engine Guardian (Darkshade Caverns II)[/*][*]Ilambris (Crypt of Hearts I)[/*][*]Troll King (Blessed Crucible)[/*][/list]
[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style Pages[/b]
 
If you happen to own a base version of a specific monster shoulder style, you can also acquire the Opal version of that same style from Undaunted vendors at a cost of 50 Undaunted Keys. These vendors also sell mystery boxes that provide random Opal shoulder style pages for 25 Keys. Luckily, all Undaunted Pledges provide double the Key rewards throughout this event’s duration to help you take advantage of these limited-time offers.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/9ba1f1d588e3187458648345f4a149d9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/9ba1f1d588e3187458648345f4a149d9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Trade your Undaunted Keys for style pages[/i]
 [h2]Event Tickets & The Impresario[/h2] 
Throughout the event, you can earn [b]two Event Tickets[/b] for the first time you’ve defeated a final dungeon boss each day. Please keep in mind that you can hold up to 12 Event Tickets at any one time. If you earn any more while already at that Event Ticket limit, they’ll be lost to Oblivion!
 
During the Undaunted Celebration, you can spend your Event Tickets at the Impresario vendor to acquire the following items:

notes.title: Next ESO update gives PvP some love with new battlegrounds and modes
notes.content:
It's probably fair to say that if you're into PvP in your MMOs, the Elder Scrolls Online isn't your first port of call. Generally players dive into Tamriel for the lore, world, quests, and the weird stuff you find along the way, with PvP being a distant consideration. There is a dedicated core of PvPers, however, and they haven't been eating very well recently. That is all set to change, as update 44 for the game will launch soon and players will be waving goodbye to one PvP mode, and hello to another.

notes.title: Update 44 Preview—Battlegrounds, New Companions, & More!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/9f9c36591da3f78b4e7df29c2cb2059b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Learn about the upcoming Update 44 base-game patch,  including major changes to Battlegrounds, new Companions, and more.[/i]
  
The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac  and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. This new update introduces  new features, changes, and quality-of-life improvements, and it is free for all  existing [i]ESO[/i] players (with the notable exception of the new Companions, who  you can purchase for free with ESO Plus™ membership or with crowns from the  Crown Store…more on them below!). 
  [h2]Major Battlegrounds Update[/h2]  
If you enjoy the fast-paced PvP combat of the Battlegrounds,  Update 44 introduces big changes to the current format. In this update,  Battlegrounds is shifting to [b]two-sided matches[/b], instead of the traditional  three-sided. At launch, there will be two main Battlegrounds match types: 
    [list][*]4v4—a competitive mode between two teams of four [/*][*]8v8—a standard mode featuring powerups and two teams of eight[/*][/list]
The traditional 4v4v4 game mode will no longer be available  for queues; however, it may return in the future for limited times during  special mini-PvP events. This new two-sided format also includes[b] seven  brand-new maps[/b] to battle your fellow players within. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/38ce45c859249d7d4cb06d8314a73e6d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/38ce45c859249d7d4cb06d8314a73e6d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle within all-new maps[/i]
 
All the traditional Battlegrounds game modes will remain, including Team Deathmatch, Crazy King, Domination, Chaosball (8v8 mode only), and Capture the Relic (8v8 mode only). In addition, the 8v8 matches will also house four unique powerups that spawn during the game. Powerups can provide temporary boosts to your damage absorption, speed, damage output, and ultimate—everything you and your team need to dominate the match. 
 [h2]New Companions[/h2] 
Update 44 also introduces[b] two brand-new Companions[/b] to [i]ESO[/i]: Tanlorin and Zerith-var. Tanlorin is a scrappy High Elf who mixes Soul Magic with Dragonknight abilities, while the stoic Khajiit Zerith-var utilizes the power of Necromancy.
 
At launch, you can acquire both new allies for free with an active ESO Plus membership or purchased with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Once acquired, you can find and recruit them within the zones of Auridon (Tanlorin), and Reaper’s March (Zerith-var). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/6565ad019450efd7fff6347ba2ac1040.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/6565ad019450efd7fff6347ba2ac1040.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Tanlorin and Zerith-var[/i]
 
Like previous Companions, each will have their own introductory quest that you will need to complete before you can summon them. In addition to being unique new characters (with their own stories, personalities, and quest lines), these two new Companions each also provide a special passive perk when adventuring with them: 
  [list][*]Tanlorin grants “Tanlorin’s Finesse,” which provides an increase to the time it takes to pick a lock, an increased chance to force a lock, and a reduced chance to break a lockpick. [/*][*]Zerith-var grants “Zerith’s Guidance,” which highlights valuable bags of loot found throughout Tamriel.[/*][/list]
While these perks are active when adventuring with each Companion in question, they can be permanently unlocked by completing each ally’s unique Achievement. 
 [h2]Scribing Powers Up (Your Whole Party)[/h2] 
Update 44 also introduces the game’s [b]first brand-new Grimoire[/b] since Update 42’s launch in June: Banner Bearer. The scribes of the Mages Guild, under the leadership of Votary Nahlia, have been studying Ulfsild’s work in the Scholarium at Eyevea. Banner Bearer is their newest creation, the first new Grimoire of the Second Era.
 
Banner Bearer is from the Support Skill Line and allows you to throw a banner on your back, leading the charge with an AoE buff to your group’s abilities that match your chosen Focus. No matter what shape your party takes, this new Grimoire will ensure you can give your allies the support they need! 
 
In addition to Banner Bearer, this patch also adds greater support for nine Grimoires by granting them access to [b]14 additional Focus Scripts[/b], providing more damage options and utility. Check the Patch Notes when they arrive for info on which specific scripts are being added for which Grimoires.
 [h2]Additional Update 44 Changes and Additions [/h2] 
In addition to the above, this base-game patch introduces a host of fixes, changes, and quality-of-life improvements that all [i]ESO[/i] players will appreciate. 
 
[b]Update to the In-Game Tutorial[/b]
 
Update 44 reinstates the first chapter of [i]ESO[/i]’s main questline as the game’s primary tutorial. This means that the old tutorial quest “Gates of Adamant” will be retired (although if you’re still in progress you can complete it as normal) in favor of the original “Soul Shriven in Coldharbour” quest. 
 
In addition to returning, [i]ESO[/i]’s original tutorial quest has undergone a series of changes and improvements. This includes changes to the quest structure, new and additional weapon drops, a more gradual introduction to game systems, and a modernizing of the combat, lockpicking, stealth tutorials, and more. There’s never been a better time for you (or a friend) to adventure in and explore Tamriel’s Second Era. 
 
[b]Imperial City Itemization Improvements[/b]
 
With this update, the heart of the empire also receives a series of itemization improvements, designed to help better reward those brave warriors willing to battle both the Daedra and their fellow players within the city’s streets and sewers. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/c62b98fe9b2295365c5729b81d9e3a6a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/c62b98fe9b2295365c5729b81d9e3a6a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Chase improved rewards in the Imperial City[/i]
 
This includes changes to how the Imperial Vaults work. For example, Imperial City keys and key fragments have been converted to new Imperial Fragments, the key fragment requirement to enter vaults have been removed, treasure chests have been replaced with vendors, and more. 
 
In the sewers, you can find many changes to the existing vendors, improving the quality and selection of wares, including both item sets and collectibles. 
 
[b]Golden Pursuits [/b]
 
Complete challenges, earn rewards! A brand-new [b]activity and rewards system [/b]coming with Update 44, Golden Pursuits are[b] dynamic, one-off campaigns [/b](accessed from the Group & Activity Finder)[b] [/b]that allow you to earn additional rewards during special limited-time windows. When a Golden Pursuit is active, you can complete a batch of curated, unique activities to claim in-game items while working towards a special capstone reward.
 
Rewards will vary but can include collectibles, items, in-game currencies, and more. Keep an eye out for the first Golden Pursuit campaign sometime after Update 44 launch. 
 
[b]New Skill Styles[/b]
 
Helping you stand out in the crowd in this update are four new Skill Styles. To start, both Psijic Order skills Accelerate and Undo (the ultimate) are getting purple variants. Even more dramatically, the One-Hand and Shield skill line’s Puncture ability is getting a molten variant, while the Destruction Staff’s Force Shock ability is getting a wildburn variant. Both Puncture, Lavaburst and Force Shock, Wildburn feature all-new special effects—the first of their kind! 
 
You can acquire these new Skill Styles via new in-game Achievements or with Archival Fortunes, with the exception of the Accelerate, Purple style, which can be rarely found within Psijic Portals. Keep an eye out for specifics on how to get your hands on these exciting new styles at launch!   
 
These are just some of the major changes coming with Update 44, but there’s a host of additional improvements, changes, and features we’re not quite ready to share fully yet. For example, this update also includes [b]an increase of furnishing base materials[/b] in regular harvest nodes, [b]adds HDR support[/b] for PC, and provides [b]quest pips for Master Writs[/b]. Finally, as part of this update, ESO Plus members will also enjoy a [b]10% bonus to Tel Var Stone and Alliance Point gains[/b]—phew![b] [/b]
 
For everything you need to know, keep an eye out for the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]patch notes[/url] when this base-game update arrives soon! 
 [h2]New Battles, Allies, Powers, and More [/h2] 
We’ve only just begun to delve into what’s coming soon with the Update 44 base-game patch. Keep an eye out for more on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] in the coming months as we get closer to release. Are you excited to take to the new Battlegrounds? Which new Companion will you recruit first? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].  
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Anniversary Spotlight—Dungeon Runners, Rise Up
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/8787fc99a79102570403cf9050d2801b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Delve deep into special rewards, including free DLC dungeons, during September’s Anniversary Spotlight![/i]
 
The latest 10-Year Anniversary Spotlight comes to you this September as it shines into the hidden corners of Tamriel’s dungeons. Get free dungeon DLC from Daily Login Rewards, unlock and claim a free costume and arms pack, and earn Undaunted Keys as you complete daily Endeavors!

 [h2]DLC Dungeons Delivered Free[/h2] 
Log in for just a few days during September 2024 to unlock free DLC dungeons. Your third login during the month unlocks the Fang Lair dungeon, while your fourth unlocks the Scalecaller Peak dungeon. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/0a7d6b72b5a8ff28ae7cdddc5205c7cd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/0a7d6b72b5a8ff28ae7cdddc5205c7cd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock (and survive) Fang Lair[/i]
 
These exciting dungeons feature unique rewards including item sets, titles, motifs, and more. Challenge the Blackmarrow necromancers or the cult of Peryite to claim them—good luck! 

 [h2]Dress from Success[/h2] 
Of course, the rewards included in the dungeon content itself aren’t the only things you can claim. The Anniversary Spotlight also includes additional unlockable rewards. Complete both dungeons to earn the “Fang Lair Vanquisher” and “Scalecaller Peak Vanquisher” achievements and you can acquire the Dungeon Explorer Costume for free by claiming it from the Crown Store between September 3 and September 24. You can also claim the costume if you have the achievements from prior completions of the dungeons.
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/643d1913ad7c32b4b4281a842b17166a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/643d1913ad7c32b4b4281a842b17166a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/ef5c43c99a04ccd93eee2c44f004e3b6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/ef5c43c99a04ccd93eee2c44f004e3b6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn achievements to unlock free rewards[/i]
 
The Undaunted are of course eager to get in on any dungeon-delving action, so you can earn rewards by completing Undaunted Pledges as well. If you earn or already have the achievement “Returned Undaunted” for completing 10 Undaunted Pledges bestowed by Maj al-Ragath, you can claim the Thurvokun Arms Pack from the Crown Store completely free during the same period as the costume.

 [h2]Endeavor Alongside the Undaunted[/h2] 
Of course, one of the things the Undaunted are most known for is their treasure, shared with the worthy who earn their Undaunted Keys. During the month of September, these rewards are easier to earn than ever, with certain thematic Endeavors available during the month awarding Undaunted Keys in addition to the normal seal amount for the day’s Endeavors.
 
Get ready to dive into dungeons and deal with terrible foes! Are you excited for the treasures of this new spotlight? Tell us all about your adventures via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Huge ESO update adds big new challenges to the MMO's roguelike mode
notes.content:
When people talk about the Elder Scrolls Online, it's always the world-building, the quests, and the exploration of areas of Tamriel that haven't been seen in games before that get bigged up. What's often missed off in the list of things it does really well is its player housing and its PvE roguelike mode titled the Infinite Archive. Well, these two features have received some big changes in the most recent ESO update, alongside tons of other new stuff that's hitting the MMO.
