notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road & Update 42 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ab7441b3abfa4ddc788528fb315ab9e1.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Uncover the mystery of the Forgotten Prince with the Gold Road Chapter and Update 42 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Epic Game Store. This new Chapter for [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] introduces a new zone to explore, West Weald, along with a new system to master called Scribing. It also concludes the story of Ithelia, the Forgotten Prince, which began with 2023’s Shadows Over Morrowind saga.  
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/459638ba6ddd36869757f1ff8004d442.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/459638ba6ddd36869757f1ff8004d442.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Forgotten Prince returns[/i]
 
In addition to the Chapter, this release also includes the U42 base-game patch, introducing a host of bug fixes, balance changes, and other improvements free for all [i]ESO [/i]players. You can view the full patch notes for [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42 [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Gold Road Chapter[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] you can venture into the heart of Colovian Imperial culture as you unravel the mystery of the return of a never-before-seen Daedric Prince—Ithelia. While [i]Gold Road[/i] continues (and concludes) the Shadow Over Morrowind narrative that began in 2023, you can experience and enjoy the latest Chapter’s storyline without having to play any of the game’s previous content. 
 
[b]West Weald Zone[/b]
 
Located along Cyrodiil’s southwest border and neighboring Valenwood and the Gold Coast, this new Chapter allows you to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66003]explore West Weald[/url], a wealthy Imperial province thrown into chaos. Home to the proud and cosmopolitan Colovians, West Weald has found itself besieged by mysterious unknown Daedra. Even worse, a large part of the region has seemingly overnight become overgrown by the vast jungles of Valenwood, resulting in the migration of local Wood Elves. 

[previewyoutube=znogunEB5V0;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																								      							    							      								      									 
Within this new zone, you can explore the city of Skingrad in addition to both the Gold Road region and emergent Dawnwood, where you’ll discover a multitude of new side quests, world bosses, delves, public dungeons, and more. Discover more about the zone in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66003]this preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Scribing System[/b]
 
An all-new system introduced with [i]Gold Road[/i], Scribing grants you the ability to craft and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66057]customize your own handmade abilities[/url]. With Scribing, you can select a base Grimoire and tailor it with scripts to create an ability that perfectly fits your playstyle and build. 

[previewyoutube=_yWOpQ6_T0M;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
With this new system, you’ll discover a robust questline that has you restore an ancient Scholarium while diving deep into the mysteries of magicka in Tamriel. Whether you’re looking for greater power, versatility, or roleplaying opportunities, Scribing introduces a powerful new way to tailor your builds and play your way. 
 
[b]Group Activities[/b]
 
In addition to the zone’s multiple world bosses, delves, and public dungeons, [i]Gold Road[/i] also introduces two new group activities to challenge you and your allies: the Lucent Citadel and Mirrormoor Incursions. 
 
In the Lucent Citadel Trial, you and your large group (12 players total) must venture into a long-forgotten Daedric vault within the realm of Fargrave, contend with its unique boss encounters, and seek out the mysterious Arcane Knot. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/82f94f90370d384feb55d981391e73aa.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/82f94f90370d384feb55d981391e73aa.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Team up to defend West Weald[/i]
 
Mirrormoor Incursions are a new type of world event plaguing West Weald and threatening to overwhelm the region with the minions of Ithelia. You can discover more about both activities in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66085]this preview blog[/url].  
 
[b]New Rewards[/b]
 
In addition to a new zone to explore, stories to experience, and challenges to overcome, the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter is full of new Achievements, items, and collectibles for you to loot and earn. 
 
Specifically, West Weald features 10 powerful item sets to loot and craft in addition to three unique Mythic items to uncover using the Antiquities system. Completing Achievements can also earn you a wide range of collectibles, such as style pages for King Nantharion’s Royal Armor or even the Wildburn Lynx mount. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ad5fa21a49f122ad3b119ca16cf333b5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ad5fa21a49f122ad3b119ca16cf333b5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]New collectibles, styles, and more[/i]
 
Rewards also include fragments for the all-new Tales of Tribute patron and deck, Saint Alessia, in addition to a new type of collectible, called Skill Styles. Skill Styles are cosmetic collectibles that allow you to change the visuals for your existing abilities. With [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42, there are 22 Skill Styles for you to unlock and apply from various sources, including quest rewards, public dungeons, and other activities. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/1d948b29fef327a9c9c14a8ce284f2c1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/1d948b29fef327a9c9c14a8ce284f2c1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Great challenges lead to great rewards![/i]
 
Finally, [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42 also introduces the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66017]Adventurer Across a Decade[/url] Achievement, celebrating [i]ESO[/i]’s 10-Year Anniversary by granting you the Fractured Glory skin for having completed the game’s story content (including [i]Gold Road[/i]) throughout its long history. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] is available [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]to buy now[/url], with four editions:
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Upgrade: Gold Road[/i] [/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new or lapsed player, both [i]Collection [/i]editions include the base game, the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter, and ALL previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, both [i]Upgrade [/i]editions grant access to the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter. Note that to run [i]Gold Road[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the game, both versions of [i]Gold Road[/i] are also available in [i]Deluxe[/i] editions, which feature a unique mount, pet, memento, outfit style, and emotes.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Gold Road Deluxe Edition items[/i]
 
To find out more about [i]Gold Road[/i] and its editions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/65365]check out this blog[/url].
 [h2]Getting Started in Gold Road[/h2] 
Ready to venture into West Weald? You can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the zone by accessing your map, selecting Gold Road, and then selecting the automatically unlocked Skingrad Vineyards Wayshrine.
 
[b]Via the Gold Road Main Quest[/b]
 
You can have the game lead you to West Weald by picking up the Chapter’s first main story quest, “Paths of Chaos.” You can find it by navigating to your Collections and then viewing Stories, selecting Chapter, and then Gold Road.  
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to West Weald by creating a new character and completing the tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select the zone as your destination and begin.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/178df5daaf8d02cd7580ae91c5a6519b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/178df5daaf8d02cd7580ae91c5a6519b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Adventure awaits in Gold Road[/i]
 
Note that there are no level or story requirements for the [i]Gold Road [/i]Chapter, allowing you to jump right in with any of your characters—existing or brand new! 
 [h2]Update 42 [/h2] 
Launching in tandem with Gold Road is Update 42, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players. Update 42 introduces a series of balance changes, fixes, and additions with no purchase required (beyond access to the game itself). 
 
[b]Improvements to In-game Mail[/b]
 
With Update 42, we’ve made a series of improvements to in-game mail, focusing on its interface and notifications. This includes the addition of categories (player mail, system mail, and system alerts), improved sorting, attachment preview, and inventory space display. 
 
This update also adds a “Delete After Claim” option (helping you keep inboxes under control), a “Take All” function, and notifications for mail with attachments. In addition, messages received from your Hirelings will now be automatically recorded in the Lore Library under “Hireling Correspondence.”
 
Finally, as part of the team’s efforts to improve server performance and stability, Update 42’s mail changes also include reduced expiration times based on the mail types. 
 
[b]Environment Sustainability Features[/b]
 
With this update, we’re joining Team Xbox in reducing our game’s environmental impact with the following new features:
      [list][*]Reduced GPU use during periods of inactivity for PC/Mac, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. [/*][list][*]Reducing resolution and imposing a framerate cap during inactivity. [/*][/list][*]Screen dimming during periods of inactivity on PC/Mac. [/*][list][*]Note that this already occurs on consoles.[/*][/list][*]Reduced GPU use in Contextual Menus for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. [/*][list][*]When viewing most menus on consoles, the framerate is capped.[/*][/list][/list]
Note that the improvements to Xbox and PlayStation consoles won’t occur until Update 42 launches on those platforms on June 18. 
 
For more on Xbox’s sustainability efforts, [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/community/sustainability]visit this page[/url]. 
 
For everything changing and coming with Update 42, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on the official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Forgotten No More[/h2] 
The Forgotten Prince walks Tamriel, and chaos follows in her wake. Investigate the emergence of Ithelia and confront her scions, explore the Colovian region of West Weald, and unlock and customize new abilities with the Scribing System in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i]. Tell us if you’re excited to dive deep into this new Chapter via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road is now live on PC/Mac and arrives June 18 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5.[/i]

notes.title: Anniversary Spotlight—Earn a Multi-Rider Mount with Scribing!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/94407a059066148c8650612951a42f37.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Unlock a free multi-rider mount by delving deep into the Gold Road Chapter’s new Scribing system this month of June![/i]
 [h2]Unravel the Mysteries of Magicka[/h2] 
With the upcoming launch of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] (arriving June 3 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles), you can explore the origins of magic in Tamriel via the all-new Scribing system. With Scribing, you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yWOpQ6_T0M]create your own handmade abilities[/url] with a near-limitless number of options available. 
 
To celebrate this incredible new feature and Chapter launch, we’re happy to announce the Anniversary Spotlight—Gold Road. Running from[b] June 3 until July 1 for PC/Mac [/b]and [b]June 18 until July 16 for console players[/b], this new Anniversary Spotlight grants everyone who delves deep into the system [b]a special reward[/b]. 
 [h2]Unlock a Multi-Rider Mount[/h2] 
What special reward? Complete the Scribing meta-achievement “Inheritor of the Scholarium” during the Anniversary Spotlight window and you can claim the coveted Wayrest Vanner Pillion Steed mount from the in-game Crown Store [b]for free[/b]. 
 
To unlock this achievement, you need to complete every quest in the Scribing questline (six in total) and restore the Scholarium. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/967e64a3a506864ce4bb9f2fe7603af0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/967e64a3a506864ce4bb9f2fe7603af0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Travel Tamriel together[/i]
 
While a striking and handsome beast, the Wayrest Vanner Pillion Steed is no normal mount, as it supports two adventurers riding at once! What better way to explore West Weald? 
 
Note that you need [b]access to the Champion System[/b] or have a [b]level 30 character[/b] to begin the Scribing quest line. This mount can be claimed only during the promotion window (June 3 until July 1 for PC/Mac and June 18 until July 16 for console players)—get ready to prove your worth to the Luminaries of Magic! 
 [h2]Endeavor to Craft New Abilities[/h2] 
In addition to the unique achievement reward, after [i]Gold Road[/i]’s launch, you’ll discover a selection of Scribing-themed Endeavors to complete as well. These new Endeavors task you with using your custom-made abilities in your adventures throughout Tamriel, such as defeating enemies, healing your allies, and more. 
 
Note that these Endeavors will reward you with the typical number of Seals you might expect from other similar tasks and won’t be active until June 18 (when the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter and Update 42 are live on all platforms). 
 [h2]Celebrating [i]ESO [/i]& [i]Gold Road[/i][/h2] 
With the upcoming launch of the new Chapter, we can’t wait to see what kind of unique handcrafted abilities the community comes up with during the Anniversary Spotlight—Gold Road. Don’t forget, the only way to get your hands on that multi-rider mount is to complete the Scribing questline. Let us know if you’re excited about the new system in [i]Gold Road[/i] and how you plan to use it via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]—have fun!

notes.title: Gold Road Preview—Lucent Citadel & Mirrormoor Incursions
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/0ac2165e839bbc67c44b61c9671e1697.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]The Forgotten Prince Ithelia returns in the Gold Road Chapter, and with the Prince of Paths comes strange new group challenges that you and your allies will need to overcome together. This includes both the Lucent Citadel, an all-new 12-player Trial, and Mirrormoor Incursions, new West Weald world events.[/i]
 [h2]Brave the Lucent Citadel[/h2] 
“The Lucent Citadel is an ancient Daedric vault located in the wastelands of Fargrave, and until recently the monstrous residents of the citadel have been dormant,” says Senior Content Designer Shane Slama. “Ithelia’s return has triggered their awakening and attracted a number of interested parties in search of something called the Arcane Knot.” 
 
Alarmingly, these parties seem to have conflicting agendas for the Knot, and they are willing to do anything to get their hands on it.
 
“Your old ally Keshargo from Scrivener’s Hall was dispatched by Hermorah and the Scribes of Mora to secure the Knot, but after setting up a base camp, they were attacked by a Dremora called Xoryn. Keshargo needs all the help he can get in stopping Xoryn and finding a way to extract the volatile Arcane Knot from the Citadel.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/424a410eadeae3a4cef55f31a0b1e3fd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/424a410eadeae3a4cef55f31a0b1e3fd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Lucent Citadel awaits[/i]
 
Be warned, the path through the Lucent Citadel will not be easy for you and your allies, with all sorts of unusual monsters and magic at play. Every encounter, whether with any of the four total bosses or their assorted minions, will test your party’s power and ingenuity.
 
“As you adventure through the Citadel and chase after Xoryn, you’ll encounter a mix of awoken Mirrormoor creatures and Xoryn’s powerful allies,” explains Slama. “These include Lightbringers that can reanimate the dead and Darkcasters that attempt to suffocate their targets with a mounting darkness.” 
 
“Not all the challenges inside the citadel are combat-focused.” adds Slama. “There are moments where your path to Xoryn requires more than running, jumping, or falling. Being light on your feet won’t be enough. You’ll have to ditch your feet entirely and try your best to avoid looking down!”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/bc422df94bab8ee90b60bbad7a65d97d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/bc422df94bab8ee90b60bbad7a65d97d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Be knot afraid[/i]
 
As with any Trial, the Lucent Citadel features new ways to challenge you and your group. This is especially so for the final encounter, which is completely different from anything the team has done before.
 
“The constant that runs throughout the trial is the presence of light magic and dark magic, and learning how the two clash is important,” says Slama. “Be warned, the Arcane Knot is unstable and chaotic, and once it has been disturbed, it must always have a carrier bonded to it. However, a single adventurer is not going to be able to shoulder the burden of this powerful object alone. When the time comes, remember that sharing is caring!”
 [h2]Turn Back Mirrormoor Incursions[/h2] 
In addition to the Lucent Citadel, [i]Gold Road[/i] also features a new kind of world event that anybody adventuring within the zone can help overcome. 
 
“With Mirrormoor Incursions, powerful forces from the mysterious realm are attempting to spread their influence across West Weald and infiltrate the land,” explains Encounter Designer Lauren Kaiser. “Three elite Valkynaz have positioned themselves at key points surrounding the crux of the incursion, and together, they work to perform a ritual that paves the way for a powerful Mirrormoor champion.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/6d1f75d8d2c19ada52bf7e8387ed346e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/6d1f75d8d2c19ada52bf7e8387ed346e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Mighty foes await[/i]
 
Of course, there’s more to this than just a straight-up fight with the Valkynaz and their champion. To shut down the operation in full, you’ll first need to search the wilderness around the mosaic for Daedric ritualists and force them to abandon their efforts. 
 
“One of the main design goals for Mirrormoor Incursions was to make them feel like they’re having a real impact on the world,” says Kaiser. “You’ll find all manner of hazards and creatures from the Daedric realm have appeared within the wilderness surrounding the mosaics and are attempting to spread their influence.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ec5107a64d998bfd3fef5c4dec65c179.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ec5107a64d998bfd3fef5c4dec65c179.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Ithelia’s servants stage Mirrormoor Incursions[/i]
 
Fortunately, the increased scope of these new events comes with new ways to track progression.
 
“Because the event takes players on a monster hunt in the wilds, it’s important that they can track progress no matter where they are,” says Kaiser. “To do this, players can look up at the portal above the Mirrormoor mosaic—the number of orbs orbiting the portal corresponds with the number of Valkynaz that have been defeated. There are also additional audio and visual cues that will appear throughout the world event area. Major kudos to the VFX and audio teams for their phenomenal work on these critical elements!”
 
This wider scope makes Mirrormoor Incursions very different from[i] ESO[/i]’s past world events, and certain key elements can change with each encounter.
 
“There are six different Valkynaz total, and three of them will appear at random during an incursion. The Valkynaz are much stronger together, so the knowledge that players gain while fighting them alone in the wilderness will be key during the battle with the champion. There are also three different champions total, each with their own unique kit of abilities, and one of them will appear at random for each incursion.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/e2aaf655685378d4274c7df7a5573aeb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/e2aaf655685378d4274c7df7a5573aeb.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Drive back the Daedra of Mirrormoor[/i]
 
Mirrormoor Incursions may appear imposing at first, but there are tools you can use to prepare yourself.
 
“Players may notice that a champion’s power extends into the wilds in the form of environmental hazards,” explains Kaiser. “Each champion has an associated hazard, so players will know which champion they're facing based on those that are present.”
 [h2]Change Your Fate with Rich Rewards[/h2] 
Opposing the Daedra of Mirrormoor is not without benefits, as triumphing in these new group activities can earn you all-new item sets and collectibles, found only in the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter. 
 
Shattering the forces across each of the zone’s Mirrormoor Mosaics, for example, earns you the Glass Sky Defender achievement and a red Reverse Slash Skill Style! In fact, Mirrormoor Mosaics are the source of several new Skill Styles, including an orange one for the Warhorn skill (earned via the Mirrormoor Incursion Disruptor achievement).
 
You can earn some rewards just for completing Mirrormoor Incursions, and incursion completion also adds progress toward larger zone-wide rewards such as the Wildburn Lynx mount, the Saint Alessia patron for Tales of Tribute, or the piece-by-piece unlock of the Nantharion’s Regalia outfit style.
 
Find even more rewards in the Lucent Citadel, including four potent item sets, unique furnishings, body and face markings (earned via completing two different Trial Achievements), a red Skill Style for the Expert Hunter skill (earned via the Lucent Citadel Vanquisher achievement), and the fabulous Refulgent Mirrormoor Steed (earned via completing the Knot Worthy meta Achievement).
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/5710ac76f217d65544a559031e8b6897.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/5710ac76f217d65544a559031e8b6897.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The spoils of Mirrormoor[/i]
 
The new item sets include the Lucent Echoes heavy armor set. The set boosts the critical damage and healing of other group members while the wearer is healthy and reduces their incoming damage after taking punishment—a great tool for tanks in group content!
 [h2]Travel New (Challenging) Roads[/h2] 
Exciting new activities await you within the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter, and overcoming these new PvE challenges can earn you all sorts of unique in-game rewards. Gather your allies and put out the call so you can dive right into the fight against Ithelia’s forces when they arrive this June. Are you excited to tackle this challenging group content? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road arrives for PC/Mac on June 3, 2024, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2024. Pre-purchase Gold Road now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount. Don’t miss out.[/i]

notes.title: Follow-up Q&A from ESO 10-Year Celebration Event Community Roundtable
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/7c1c91911c4d35c3ead081d60af55b48.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! Below are some questions we received during the in-person Community Roundtable session at the ESO 10-Year Celebration Event in April that we promised to follow up with answers. We hope you find these answers helpful!

[b]Q: Has there been any consideration for guild mounts that show off the guild tabard in some way? (Maybe a raised banner?) What would that take?[/b]
A: We love this idea and hear it often from our many players in guilds. We’ve talked about this internally over the years as well. It’s one of those things that is quite a bit trickier on the technical side than it sounds due to how guild tabards and overhead guild nameplates are coded, players being able to be in five guilds, etc. Know that we are aware of the desire for this as a guild feature.

[b]Q: Have there been any discussions about integrated voice chat for PC/Mac, even if just to coordinate for instanced group content? Sometimes people don’t want to install new apps to talk with each other and instead opt to communicate via in-game chat. This is especially painful for pick-up groups. [/b]
A: While many players do opt to use Discord or other external voice chat solutions, we understand the pick-up group communication pain point. We’ve discussed integrated voice chat for PC/Mac servers and while it’s not a hard “No, never”, this is another one that requires a significant technical investment and isn’t something we currently have on the roadmap. 

[b]Q: What happens to guilds if the guild leader passes away? What is the official process for passing on the role of guild leader?[/b]
A: If a guild leader becomes inactive for at least 60 days, for any reason, someone from the guild can contact Customer Support to request transfer of the guild leader role. From there, we look to transfer the role of guild leader to the person who meets the following criteria:
[list]
[*] Active within the last 60 days
[*] A member of the next highest rank in the guild (one of the guild’s existing “officers”)
[*] The person who has been in the guild the longest, if everyone else is the same guild rank
[*] Not already the leader of another guild
[/list]
We use this specific ranking system because it is fair, neutral, and allows us to be consistent. It also helps us minimize situations where guild leadership is stolen, passed to a newer member of the guild, etc. Once guild leadership is transferred, that person is welcome to pass it to someone else in the guild if they wish.

While it is a bit more involved, there is also a process in place if someone wants or needs to claim a deceased family member’s account. This process is in accordance with similar laws related to what happens to online accounts when someone passes away.

[b]Q: Will we ever get proper guild halls in ESO?[/b]
A: We love the idea of guild halls in ESO and recognize that our community has asked for them since the game launched. We have had many internal conversations about them over the years. The current challenge is the necessary caps. Much like the item limit caps in player housing, there is also a limit to how many characters can simultaneously be in a player home (it’s 25). As with items, these caps are in place to ensure that players on lower spec machines don’t encounter significant performance issues while in player homes.

When we’ve asked ourselves in the past if a 25-person cap would feel good for a guild hall, especially if it’s a guild of 500 active players, the answer has always been no. It’s not the kind of guild hall experience we’d want to give you. So, while the idea of guild halls isn’t completely off the table, it’s important to us that we find a solution that allows us to do it right, and support the ability to have more than 25 simultaneous players in the guild hall.

[b]Q: Do you have any plans for improved guild tools in ESO?[/b]
A: While we don’t have any specific plans to share currently, there are many things on our backlog that we’d love to do with ESO’s guild system and the related tools. Over the years, we’ve collated pages of ideas from you, our community, as well as from internal suggestions. 

We do want to improve guilds, in general, and the tools that players use to run them. As with anything we add to ESO, it all comes down to time and resources, determining what will have the greatest positive impact for our players, and prioritizing against all the other items on our game features and improvements backlog.

Please keep the suggestions and ideas coming, though. We do want to hear them!

[b]Q: Will we ever get the ability to hide our guild tabard, like we can hide helms?[/b]
A: This is another request that has come up often over the years. We understand how important this is to some of our players, especially our roleplay and ESO fashion enthusiasts! Like the suggestion for guild heraldry on mounts, this is something we do have on our backlog and want to improve the overall experience. It’s also not as simple as turning off the visibility of armor pieces such helms and shoulders, for example, due to how our guild tabards and overhead guild nameplates are coded on the back-end.

[b]Q: You all should send out surveys to guilds to get feedback about guild tools and what quality-of-life guild features players want. Would you consider that?[/b]
A: Great idea! Yes, we will talk with our amazing Research team about creating a guild-focused survey. Thank you for the suggestion!

One thing you all can do to help us is ask your guild members to consider opting into getting emails from us here. While we can share links to surveys on our social media channels, forums, and in Discord, being able to email it to more players who are in guilds would greatly help us hit a much broader and more diverse population.

[b]Q: Could we get a solution for the guild MOTD text getting bumped/interrupted by automated game messages when typing it up? It’s so frustrating when that happens![/b]
A: Thank you for sharing this with us! We agree that isn’t a great experience. We’ve passed this along to our UX and QA teams for investigation.

[b]Q: Will we ever get Steam achievements for ESO?[/b]
A: Steam achievements require a separate (and additional) process from achievements on any other platform. Due to this, we have no current plans to add Steam achievements for ESO.

[b]Q: We’d like to be able to get empty plots of existing player houses, or the ability to “remove” the house from the plot. Is that something you might consider?[/b]
A: Interesting suggestion! Historically, the empty plots aren’t nearly as popular as the houses; that said, we will pass this suggestion along to the Housing team for consideration. Due to how we build out the housing spaces, it is unfortunately not as simple as just “removing” the house from an existing space. Even existing player housing spaces would require additional world building where the house is/was.

notes.title: Earn a New Skin with this Special 10-Year Anniversary Achievement
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/bc7c74000e84fa02c96c17453b921ac3.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about an all-new Achievement and reward coming with the Gold Road Chapter and Update 42. [/i]
 
Since 2014, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] has enjoyed 10 years of adventure, taking you and your fellow players from the myriad provinces of Tamriel to the otherworldly planes of Oblivion. As part of our ongoing 10-Year Anniversary Celebration, we are adding an all-new Achievement that celebrates and showcases the game’s ever-growing world, titled Adventurer Across a Decade. 
 
This new Achievement arrives with the launch of the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter and Update 42 in June, and it touches on practically every zone and main story quest in the game.
 
To earn Adventurer Across a Decade, you need to complete the following: 
                      [list][*]Earn the Hero of the Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, and Ebonheart Pact Achievements*[/*][*]Complete [i]ESO[/i]’s main storyline and triumph against Molag Bal[/*][*]Complete the main storylines for the following zones:[/*][list][*]Coldharbour[/*][*]Craglorn[/*][*]Wrothgar[/*][*]Hew’s Bane[/*][*]Gold Coast[/*][*]Vvardenfell[/*][*]Clockwork City[/*][*]Summerset[/*][*]Murkmire[/*][*]Northern Elsweyr[/*][*]Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]Western Skyrim[/*][*]The Reach[/*][*]Blackwood[/*][*]The Deadlands[/*][*]High Isle[/*][*]Galen[/*][*]Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha[/*][*]West Weald[/*][/list][/list]
That’s a lot of questing, but don’t worry—if you’ve previously completed the story quests (and earned the Achievements) for any of the above zones, they will be automatically counted when Update 42 is live. 
 
Upon earning this new achievement, you’ll also unlock an exclusive skin: Fractured Glory.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/785271d6e014752d6037201f58137a9a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/785271d6e014752d6037201f58137a9a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]10 years unbroken[/i]
 
Whether you adventure alone or with allies, this unique skin will allow you to proudly show your dedication to the game and mark you as a true veteran of Tamriel’s Second Era. 
 
Are you excited to earn this new 10-Year Celebration Achievement? Which zone storylines do you need to complete? There’s still time before [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42 launch in June! Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.content:

notes.title: Gold Road Zone Preview—West Weald
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/ad7347becebf4dc332691d89d57a2ec3.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about West Weald, its myriad threats, and the valuable rewards you can obtain while exploring this new zone, coming soon with the Gold Road Chapter.[/i]
 [h2]Beset by Mystery[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i], arriving June 3 on PC/Mac and June 18 on Xbox and PlayStation consoles, introduces West Weald, a brand-new zone filled with unique locations, quests, challenges, and rewards for Tamriel’s intrepid adventurers to uncover.
 
While exploring West Weald, you’ll discover the geography of this prosperous Imperial region is far from uniform and is divided into three regions: the Gold Road, the Colovian Highlands, and Dawnwood. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/d60f6dabef03c521495f99e71af30f3a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/d60f6dabef03c521495f99e71af30f3a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Visit Skingrad in the Second Era[/i]
 
Both the Colovian Highlands and the Gold Road are primarily home to the local Imperials, including the wealthy city of Skingrad. From the rocky reaches and vineyards of the highlands to the temperate and well-traveled Gold Road, the area is ruled by Count Calantius, who shepherded the region away from the strife in Cyrodiil. However, recent events have introduced brand-new dangers and mysteries to the region. 
 
“The big threat to West Weald is not knowing what’s going on,” explains Ed Stark, [i]Gold Road[/i]’s Zone Lead. “Everything that’s happening seemingly happened overnight. And the ‘Mirrormoor Incursions’ popping up across the region? No one knows where these new Daedra are coming from or how to stop them.”
 
In addition to this new Daedric threat, a mysterious jungle recently emerged from the region’s southwest border. Known as Dawnwood, this region has rapidly become home to newly arrived Wood Elves.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/b88b42e4c41b4a4f985c480d1108766a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/b88b42e4c41b4a4f985c480d1108766a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore the emergent Dawnwood[/i]
 
“The inhabitants of Dawnwood are Valenwood Elves who ‘followed nature’ to West Weald,” shares Stark. “Following their chieftain—now king—Nantharion to the new land, they were surprised to see the ruins of Colovian buildings (and more than a few confused Colovians) in the region, but they have mostly acted as peaceful immigrants.” 
 
In addition to the Daedric incursions and settling Wood Elves, the region’s final mystery lies not in the influx of new arrivals, but in the twisted lands of the Wildburn. 
 
“The Wildburn is the forward edge of whatever magic created the jungle growth of Dawnwood,” Stark hints. “Whatever energy or magic caused the explosive jungle growth clashed with the natural flora and fauna. This left a region of devastation and created wildburn creatures, animals corrupted by the clash of magic and nature.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/8d04d6898686fd6633e09ba4bc36fe0f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/8d04d6898686fd6633e09ba4bc36fe0f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Investigate the Wildburn[/i]
 
As you explore this new zone, you’ll have to unravel these mysteries and uncover the source of the chaos that has enveloped West Weald.
 [h2]West Weald Threatened[/h2] 
When adventuring within West Weald, you’ll encounter all manner of threats in this once-peaceful land. In the new zone, you can explore six new Delves, including ancient Ayleid ruins and the remnants of Varen Aquilarios’ war, in addition to two new Public Dungeons, six World Bosses, and a new Trial.  
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/f50319f2b07e90e058de24ab892778c4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/f50319f2b07e90e058de24ab892778c4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Test yourself against strange new foes[/i]
 
You can also experience a wide variety of additional quests in the region as you explore and meet its inhabitants, each helping to tell the tale of this unique part of Tamriel.
 
“A number of the West Weald quests deal with aspects of Colovian and Wood Elf society and culture,” explains Stark. “The Colovian desire for a cosmopolitan society is tested, as are many of the Wood Elves’ core beliefs.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/e2aaf655685378d4274c7df7a5573aeb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/e2aaf655685378d4274c7df7a5573aeb.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Mirrormoor invades Tamriel[/i]
 
Finally, strange Daedra of unknown varieties roam the land, invading through a new type of world event called Mirrormoor Incursions. 
 
“Without giving too much away, Mirrormoor Incursions are what happen when a forgotten Daedric Prince from a lost Oblivion realm suddenly reappears,” notes Stark. “Ithelia’s newly reawakened scions and servants have rallied what’s left of her forces and hunt for her—and they believe West Weald is a likely place to start.”
 
It's up to you and your allies to confront these new challenges to help bring stability back to West Weald.
 [h2]Treasures of the Gold Road[/h2] 
Those who face great challenges deserve great rewards, and the wealth of the Gold Road obliges with a series of item sets, collectibles, and achievements to earn and unlock.  
 
For starters, West Weald features 10 new item sets for you to find and craft. This includes the Threads of War, which causes your Light and Heavy Attacks to inflict a guaranteed Status Effect of the damage type of your weapon. Normally, Light and Heavy attacks cannot directly inflict Status Effects at all—a major change!
 
Additionally, antiquarians can find three different Mythic items available in the zone, such as the Rourken Steamguards that reward precision timing on blocks.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/2c0a23c10c96f5d5fd43f84920f79a93.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/2c0a23c10c96f5d5fd43f84920f79a93.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Opportunities await exploration[/i]
 
Complete various [i]Gold Road[/i] achievements, and you can earn style pages for King Nantharion’s Royal Armor in addition to other styles, mementos, an emote, a pet, and more, providing you with an abundance of collectibles to acquire on your adventures. If you play Tales of Tribute, you can also earn fragments of an all-new patron and deck—Saint Alessia.
 
Most notably, [i]Gold Road [/i]also features a mount earnable by completing multiple West Weald achievements—the Wildburn Lynx. This magnificent mount requires some time investment to earn, including completing the Chapter story, defeating all World and Delve Bosses, and other feats of prowess and exploration. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/1784f93a133ad09c1946b3d6bd42dc62.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/1784f93a133ad09c1946b3d6bd42dc62.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Rewards of the Gold Road[/i]
 
Finally, this Chapter introduces an entirely new type of Collectible called Skill Styles.
 
“Skill Styles are an exciting new cosmetic that change existing Skill visuals,” explains Project Lead Kira Schlitt. “These initial 22 Skill Styles override the original Skill colors to a fun new variant, such as a violet purple version of Wall of Elements, or shifting Meteor from blue to blazing orange!”
 
Skill Styles are earnable in-game through a variety of sources, including the Scribing questline, daily quests, Public Dungeons, and elsewhere within the zone. 
 [h2]Venture into A New Zone[/h2] 
[i]ESO[/i]’s newest zone, West Weald, is full of challenges, including new Delves, Public Dungeons, World Bosses, and the invasion of mysterious new Daedra. However, should you face the myriad threats to the local Wood Elf and Imperial residents, you’ll emerge with all-new items and collectibles, including an earnable mount, Achievements, and more. Are you excited to walk the streets of Skingrad, explore the mountainous Colovian Highlands, or battle strange new Daedric foes? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road arrives for PC/Mac on June 3, 2024, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2024. Pre-purchase Gold Road now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount. Don’t miss out.[/i]

notes.title: Anniversary Spotlight—Make A Home Away from Home with These Free Housing Rewards
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ec015f0e2283df6f7f37c42795a7225e.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Homeowners across Tamriel can claim the Sword-Singer’s Redoubt House and friendly houseguests for FREE during May’s 10-Year Anniversary promotion.[/i]
 [h2]There’s No Place Like Home[/h2] 
Part of the ongoing 10-Year Anniversary Celebration, the “Anniversary Spotlight—Hearth & Home” kicks off today and continues until Friday, May 31, 2024. If you’re a weary adventurer in need of a place to call home, you can pick up the all-new FREE Sword-Singer’s Redoubt house and various other goodies during the promotional period. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/795f50a09dd23756ecd8977fe02c1ad5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/795f50a09dd23756ecd8977fe02c1ad5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Log in to claim this home[/i]
 
Collecting your complementary household is as simple as claiming the Sword-Singer’s Redoubt as part of this month’s [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/65939]Daily Login Rewards[/url]. You’ll need to log in during May three times to get it—don't miss out!
 
Of course, to transform this desert oasis into your new home, you’ll need to decorate! Luckily, starting today, you can pick up various furnishings and houseguests on discount in the in-game Crown Store.
 [h2]Host Friendly Houseguests [/h2] 
During the promotion period, you can claim the Necrom Guard Miraso houseguest from the in-game Crown Store [b]free [/b]after earning the Party Planner achievement. To unlock this achievement, have three players visit your home simultaneously. Better start sending out those invitations!
 
Additionally, you can also claim the Alchemy Houseguest [b]free [/b]from the in-game Crown Store after completing the Expert Resin Harvester and Novice Alchemy Furnisher achievements. To earn the Expert Resin Harvester achievement, harvest 25 Alchemical Resin, and to unlock the Novice Alchemy Furnisher, learn any Alchemy formula.
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/e9120514d38b418764e7b8375ed854b8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/e9120514d38b418764e7b8375ed854b8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ded43ab4e89227fc8511ecbc56359bb8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ded43ab4e89227fc8511ecbc56359bb8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock these two houseguests free! [/i]
 [h2]Build Upon Your Endeavors[/h2] 
Throughout the Anniversary Spotlight, Daily and Weekly Endeavors will more frequently feature challenges related to housing, with increased rewards received upon completion. These include placing furnishings.
 [h2]Welcome Home![/h2] 
Experience the vast sea of opportunities for customization and decoration that came with owning your own household in Tamriel during the Anniversary Spotlight—Hearth & Home! Don’t miss your chance to claim valuable free rewards during this promotion period, taking place between now and May 31. How will you transform the Sword-Singer’s Redoubt into your dream home? Share screenshots of the finished product with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Grab Your Tickets for the 2024 ESO Tavern in Germany Today!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/bdc53e8669d3f6a4c05a29882a079080.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Meet up with your fellow fans to enjoy a weekend of mirth and merry fun during this year’s ESO Tavern community event.[/i]
 
The ESO Tavern returns once again this July as part of the year-long celebration of [i]ESO[/i]’s 10-Year Anniversary Celebration! Since its inception in 2013, the ESO Tavern has remained the major European event for fans and developers alike to meet up and share their love for the game and community.
 
This year, the ESO Tavern is moving to Wasserburg Heldrungen in Thuringia, Germany, and will run from Saturday, July 13 at 2PM CEST, until Sunday, July 14 at 4PM CEST. Community members will gather at this gorgeous castle to mingle, take part in various fun activities, and enjoy live musical performances. 
 
Throughout the weekend, Creative Director Rich Lambert, Art Director CJ Grebb, Project Lead Kira Ross Schlitt, Lead Encounter Designer Mike Finnigan, Lead Combat Designer Brian Wheeler, and Senior Community Manager Kai Schober will also be engaging with fans and celebrating [i]ESO[/i]’s 10th anniversary. 
 
Admissions will be managed via Eventbrite. Please follow [url=https://www.eventbrite.de/e/eso-taverne-2024-tickets-875930500707]this link[/url] to register for the ESO Tavern 2024. There are three distinct ticket packages available:
      [list][*][b]The Weald package (€45)[/b][/*][list][*]Includes a goodie bag with exclusive merch and codes, participation in all activities, access to musical performances, free campfire bread on a stick and marshmallows, as well as complimentary breakfast on Sunday.[/*][/list][*][b]The Dawnwood package (€55)[/b][/*][list][*]Includes everything from the Weald package plus one overnight stay in your own tent on the castle grounds, as well as car access to the site on arrival and departure.[/*][/list][*][b]The Skingrad package (€75)[/b][/*][list][*]Includes everything from the Weald package plus one overnight stay in one of the castle rooms*, and parking on the grounds.[/*][/list][/list]
After registering for a ticket, you will be placed on a waiting list. If you’d like to register as a group (or just generally increase your odds of admission), email us directly at [url=mailto:community_de@bethsofteurope.com]community_de@bethsofteurope.com[/url] with "Tavern 2024" in the subject line. Include the email address(es) you used to register on Eventbrite and let us know why you would love to be invited. If you are accepted, you will need to confirm and pay for your purchase within 28 days. Your ticket(s) will remain refundable up to seven days before the event.
 
Be sure to keep an eye out for further news on additional special guests and activities. Are you excited to continue celebrating [i]ESO[/i]’s 10th birthday alongside your fellow fans in Germany? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (Formerly Twitter[/url]), [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]*Note that the accommodation in the castle consists of (comfortable) youth hostel rooms. A total of eight 2-bedrooms, four 3-bedrooms, five 4-bedrooms, six 5-bedrooms, four 6-bedrooms and two 8-bedrooms are available. If you are interested in the Skingrad package, please organize yourselves into groups in advance and send an email with the subject "Skingrad" to [/i][url=mailto:community_de@bethsofteurope.com][i]community_de@bethsofteurope.com[/i][/url][i] so that we can allocate the beds fairly.[/i]

notes.title: Anniversary Spotlight—Pick a Pocket to Claim the Thieves Guild DLC for Free & More
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/b64ef251738565b6610a1b00e085a664.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Tamriel’s stickiest fingers can claim the Thieves Guild DLC, a special mount, and more during this new 10-Year Anniversary promotion!  [/i]
 [h2]Thieves of Tamriel [/h2] 
The Thieves Guild Anniversary Spotlight is part of the ongoing 10-Year Anniversary Celebration and begins this Monday, April 15, and continues until Monday, April 29, 2024. If you’re the kind of adventurer who enjoys operating on the wrong side of the law, you'll enjoy additional rewards and goods by playing the outlaw during this time. 
 
To begin, should you earn (or have already earned) the “Pocket Picker” in-game achievement, you can claim the entire [i]Thieves Guild [/i]DLC for free from the in-game Crown Store. Earning the Pocket Picker achievement is as easy as taking a sweetroll from a baby—simply pick the pocket of any citizen of Tamriel. If you’re already an adept footpad, you might have not only Pocket Picker, but other achievements progressing from it that change the name in the in-game Achievements menu. Not to worry—should you have moved on to earn “Purse Snatcher” or “Sneak Thief Extraordinaire,” you can claim the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC all the same.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/4494a70f116fc065381a665b787798e1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/4494a70f116fc065381a665b787798e1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Pick a pocket to unlock a DLC![/i]
 
The [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC grants you access to the Hew’s Bane zone, the Thieves Guild organization and storyline, and the Thieves Guild Skill Line, helping you stay one step ahead of the law. 
 
Furthermore, [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC owners can also claim the Treasure Hunter Horse mount for free from the in-game Crown Store by earning the Hew’s Bane Cave Delver achievement. To unlock this achievement, simply visit and defeat the bosses within both explorable caves in the Hew’s Bane zone. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/6447adf58112a16c5525c0ed21e0c895.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/6447adf58112a16c5525c0ed21e0c895.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Treasure Hunter Horse mount[/i]
 [h2]Endeavor to Get Rich[/h2] 
During the promotion window (April 15-29), some of the Daily and Weekly Endeavors will feature challenges relevant to both Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood members. For example, a Daily Endeavor may ask you to pick pockets or locks, while another may ask you to use poisons or even the Blade of Woe. Even better, the rewards for these thematic Endeavors will be increased—keep an eye out for them! 
 [h2]Dark Brotherhood Discounted![/h2] 
If you don’t own or have access to the [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] DLC and want to make the most out of the bonus Endeavors, you can acquire it during the promotion window from the Crown Store at 20% off. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/67cfd6ca2622f55e78b565419431ed03.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/67cfd6ca2622f55e78b565419431ed03.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]We know … you’ll enjoy this discount![/i]
 
The [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] DLC gives you access to the Gold Coast zone, the Dark Brotherhood organization and storyline, and access to both the Blade of Woe ability and the Dark Brotherhood Skill Line—everything an aspiring assassin needs!
 [h2]Crime Pays[/h2] 
During the Thieves Guild Anniversary Spotlight, you can experience Tamriel on the wrong side of the law for free, simply by picking a pocket—easy! Are you planning a heist or two during this new promotion? Don’t forget, this Anniversary Spotlight will take place only between April 15-29—don’t miss it! Let us know if you’re an existing or soon-to-be member of the Thieves Guild via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: ESO’s 10th Anniversary Celebration Begins Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/a49f7cac36961bfe337d25898aba6a0d.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Join us for 15 months of reveals, retrospectives, rewards, and more as we celebrate 10 amazing years of The Elder Scrolls Online. [/i]
 
We are thrilled to announce that [i]ESO[/i]’s 10th Anniversary Celebration has officially begun! This massive celebration puts a spotlight on you (our players), the game, and the development team over the next 15 months*.  
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															

[previewyoutube=sWP7NIOcBQo;full][/previewyoutube]

																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
Kicking off with the (still ongoing) event in Amsterdam, the fun will continue all the way from today until June 2025. Between now and then, however, we’re going to bring you a host of incredible 10th Anniversary-themed goodies, including new livestreams, special promotions, additional in-person events hosted all over the globe, and in-game activities and rewards. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/282ce3a2ad324038af70dcc7d911d144.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/282ce3a2ad324038af70dcc7d911d144.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
Want to ensure you don’t miss a beat? Visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/anniversary]official 10th Anniversary page[/url] to stay on top of everything you need to know. 

 [h2]10th Anniversary Livestream & Amsterdam Event[/h2] 
Of course, the celebration began today with the opening of the [i]ESO [/i]10-Year Celebration Event in Amsterdam. Right now, attendees are mingling with their fellow #ESOFam members and the development team while also enjoying a host of unique panels, activities, and fun. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/5e725d7546636e28c6c198e161abf708.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/5e725d7546636e28c6c198e161abf708.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/12f9e2cded2e59c88d5741a1cfefa7c6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/12f9e2cded2e59c88d5741a1cfefa7c6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]10-Year Celebration In-Person Event[/i]
 
Keep an eye out for recaps and highlights from this first massive in-person event soon, but until then, you can check out the opening acts of the celebration livestreamed via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]Twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]. 
 [h2]More In-Person Events Coming[/h2] 
The fun in Amsterdam is just the beginning of the 10th Anniversary festivities. There’s going to be plenty of exciting events all over the globe between now and the celebration’s end, too! 
 
Below, you can find some details on the next two upcoming in-person events. If you don’t see an in-person event for your local territory, don’t worry, we’ll share more details on additional upcoming events in the coming months—keep an eye out. 
 
[b]
[/b]

[b]10th Anniversary Celebration at Elfia [/b]
 
Join us at the Elfia fantasy cosplay festival this April! Meet fellow members of the #ESOFam and development team (including Creative Director Rich Lambert), enjoy giveaways, fun community cosplay-themed activities, and play the upcoming [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter!
 
[b]When: [/b]April 20-21
 
[b]Where: [/b]Haarzuilens, Netherlands
 
[b]Signup and tickets:[/b] [url=https://www.elfia.com/en/tickets/]https://www.elfia.com/en/tickets/[/url][/b]



[b]2024 ESO Tavern [/b]
 
The ESO Tavern returns in 2024, with a 10th Anniversary twist! Tickets for the longstanding community event will go on sale soon. Keep an eye on the official website for details. 
 
[b]When: [/b]July 13-14
 
[b]Where: [/b]Wasserburg Heldrungen, Germany
 
[b]Signup and tickets:[/b] Coming soon! 
 [h2]Alienware Plays ESO![/h2] 
In celebration of [i]ESO[/i]’s 10th anniversary, the team at Alienware is running a Steam community event, inviting all of Tamriel’s adventurers to log in and unlock special community rewards. 
 
If you play [i]ESO[/i] on Steam, you can help unlock a bunch of goodies including XP scrolls and even the coveted Karthwolf Charger mount, simply by playing the game between now and April 9. Don’t own [i]ESO[/i]? As it so happens, you can play free this week on Steam during the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]April 2024 Free Play Event[/url]—go grab it!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/88b60d7712d5ec5af3ebfcbcd2a8acdf.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/04/88b60d7712d5ec5af3ebfcbcd2a8acdf.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Kathwolf Charger mount[/i]

Visit [url=https://na.alienwarearena.com/steam/community-event/the-elder-scrolls-online-community-event]Alienware Arena[/url] for details on how you can sign up and participate in their Steam community event, and be sure to look out for additional 10th Anniversary Celebration fun from our friends at Alienware in the future. 
 [h2]A [i]Sneaky[/i] April ESO Promotion[/h2] 
If you’re accustomed to living on the wrong side of the law, you’ll enjoy our upcoming 10th Anniversary April promotion. We’re staying mum and [i]remaining silent[/i] on the key details for now, but if you enjoy picking pockets and deadlier endeavors, you’ll want to keep an eye out for more information later this month! 

 [h2]GeForce Now is Live! [/h2] 
In these last 10 years, [i]ESO [/i]has found its way to many additional platforms beyond PC/Mac, and we are pleased to announce that this now includes NVIDIA GeForce NOW! [i]ESO[/i] players** with access via [b]Steam[/b] or the [b]Epic Games Store[/b] can play the game streamed to their device of choice, including PC, Mac, under-powered laptop, mobile devices, and more, using GeForce NOW cloud gaming. 

Those who sign up with an Ultimate membership can stream at up to 4K and 120 fps, or experience the game at ultrawide resolutions on [url=https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5462]supported devices[/url]. 
 
To sign up or find more information and support, visit [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/]their official website[/url].
 [h2]Celebrate on your Desktop or Device[/h2] 
To help you get into the spirit of the 10th Anniversary Celebration, we’ve created wallpaper versions of that incredible 10th Anniversary Celebration art. You can download it for your specific size below—enjoy!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/7c1c91911c4d35c3ead081d60af55b48.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/7c1c91911c4d35c3ead081d60af55b48.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/28868d371805efdf0109a0e36ce4d794.jpg?no-resize]1920x1200[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/0355d9307d6b5d536550995bf23a3837.jpg?no-resize]1920x1080[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/9e4673e5efa313f9ad29e1d6e74e566f.jpg?no-resize]1242x2208[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/f1b027fea5e687c8da5cfaa6f295519f.jpg?no-resize]1440x900[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/de9f71c14e827b97fb33c21e39823b74.jpg?no-resize]1366x768[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/e626add416beedbab45c87d373d0e1d1.jpg?no-resize]1280x1024[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/690d218040e7477a177b915ff43624c8.jpg?no-resize]1024x768[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/38c220b8fbc7f23deb7ea1c11987bc5e.jpg?no-resize]750x1334[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/b6eb3e3285ede5e9cd84d29952f83ffe.jpg?no-resize]2880x2560[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/ac2c45d7a1a453a4e45410c13a19f3e2.jpg?no-resize]2048x2732[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/cbabe2b4efb1362c59a841ba88c1803b.jpg?no-resize]1536x2048[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/01e5b5f8b50630943e4928420d66d771.jpg?no-resize]2560x1440[/url]  |  [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/7c1c91911c4d35c3ead081d60af55b48.jpg?no-resize]3840x2160[/url]

 [h2]10 Years of Adventures[/h2] 
We can’t wait to reveal more about what we have in store for you during the 10th Anniversary Celebration, but don’t worry, you won’t have to wait long. Keep an eye on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url], the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/anniversary]10th Anniversary page[/url], and our social channels for the latest 10th Anniversary-themed fun and promotions. 
 
Are you excited to celebrate 10 years of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] with us? Will you be joining us at any of our upcoming in-person events? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]*Why 15 months? While ESO initially launched for PC/Mac on April 2014, console launch was on June 2015, and we want to celebrate both! [/i]
 
[i]**Available in [/i][url=https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5023/~/what-are-the-supported-locations-for-geforce-now%3F][i]supported GeForce NOW and GeForce NOW Alliance territories[/i][/url][i]. Currently requires ESO on Steam or the Epic Games Store to stream on GeForce NOW. GeForce NOW is not available on consoles.[/i]
