notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road Editions & Pre-Purchase Rewards
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/14fa2268b5b4572eef0f0d5f0dbc2c60.jpg[/img] [i]Learn more about the various editions of The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road and discover which version is best for you! [/i] [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/h2] [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] Chapter launches June 3 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. In this exciting new Chapter of the [i]ESO [/i]saga, you must investigate the schemes of the followers of the Forgotten Prince Ithelia, explore the new West Weald zone (including the city of Skingrad), and customize unique skills to your liking with Scribing, an all-new game system. Are you excited to begin your adventure and experience a multitude of stories from across all of Tamriel before [i]Gold Road[/i]’s launch in June? Pre-purchase either [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] [i]Collection: Gold Road [/i]or its [i]Deluxe [/i]edition to get [b]immediate access[/b] to the [i]ESO[/i] base game and [b]all [/b]previous Chapters as well as a bounty of in-game collectibles. [h1][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]> Pre-Purchase Gold Road <[/url][/h1] [h2]Pre-Purchase and Pre-Purchase Rewards[/h2] When you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i], you will immediately receive the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet*. In addition, you will gain access to the following bonus content at launch: [list][*]Eyebright Raven pet[/*][*]Strid River Fisherfolk costume[/*][*]x1 Diamond Anniversary Crate[/*][*]Gold Road Treasure Maps[/*][*]×2 Experience scrolls (+100% for 1 hour)[/*][/list] [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0c212799a57b494daca841f37cc41950.jpg] [img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0c212799a57b494daca841f37cc41950.jpg[/img] [/url] [i]Gold Road pre-purchase rewards[/i] Please be aware that the Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet is available as a pre-purchase reward only from [b]now until March 18, 2024[/b], so don’t miss out! [h2]Choose Which Edition Best Fits You [/h2] When pre-purchasing [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i], you can select from two main editions: [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road[/i][/*][list][*]This includes the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter (available at launch in June) and [b]immediate access[/b] to both the base game and all seven previous Chapters ([i]Necrom, High Isle[/i], [i]Blackwood[/i], [i]Greymoor[/i], [i]Elsweyr[/i], [i]Summerset[/i], and [i]Morrowind[/i])[/*][/list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Upgrade: Gold Road [/i][/*][list][*]Includes the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter (available at launch in June)[/*][/list][/list] If you’re a fresh-faced adventurer and new to the grand world of Tamriel, or if you’ve missed some of the previous Chapters and want access to them all, then the [i]Collection[/i] edition may be just what you need! In addition to receiving access to the base game and [i]Gold Road[/i], you can also experience each of the seven previous [i]ESO[/i] Chapters in whichever order you deem fit. Hundreds of hours of exciting exploration, daring quests, and thrilling adventure await! For our veteran players who already own the previous Chapters, we recommend the [i]Upgrade[/i], which will unlock the latest Chapter when it arrives in June. In addition to the basic [i]Collection[/i] and [i]Upgrade[/i] versions of [i]Gold Road[/i], you can also get a Deluxe edition for either, which includes the following [b]exclusive in-game rewards[/b] that you can access at launch: [list][*]West Weald Tharriker mount  [/*][*]Skingrad Guard Mastiff pet[/*][*]Skingrad Vedette Armor Pack  [/*][*]Ulfsild’s Tome of Legends memento[/*][*]Colovian Emote Pack[/*][/list] [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg] [img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg[/img] [/url] [i]Deluxe Edition items[/i] Even better, if you purchase the [i]Deluxe Collection[/i] version of [i]Gold Road[/i], you’ll also receive the [i]Collector’s/Deluxe[/i] edition rewards from [b]all previous [i]ESO[/i] Chapters[/b] (this [b]does not [/b]include the previous pre-purchase rewards). It’s a bargain so enticing, you’d think Clavicus Vile came up with it! You can see a complete list of each [i]Gold Road[/i] edition and what they contain below.

The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road[/i] includes [b]immediate access[/b] to the base game and all seven previous Chapters ([i]Necrom, High[/i] [i]Isle[/i], [i]Blackwood[/i], [i]Greymoor[/i], [i]Elsweyr[/i], [i]Summerset[/i], and [i]Morrowind[/i]) in addition to the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter in June. This edition also includes these [i]Deluxe [/i]rewards at launch: [list][*]West Weald Tharriker mount  [/*][*]Skingrad Guard Mastiff pet[/*][*]Skingrad Vedette Armor Pack  [/*][*]Ulfsild’s Tome of Legends memento[/*][*]Colovian Emote Pack[/*][/list] Additionally, you’ll gain access to the [i]Collector’s/Deluxe[/i] edition digital items for all previous Chapters. Pre-purchase now to gain [b]instant access[/b] to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and the Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet* as well as even more awesome pre-purchase items at launch.

This edition also includes these [i]Deluxe [/i]rewards at launch: [list][*]West Weald Tharriker mount  [/*][*]Skingrad Guard Mastiff pet[/*][*]Skingrad Vedette Armor Pack  [/*][*]Ulfsild’s Tome of Legends memento[/*][*]Colovian Emote Pack[/*][/list] Pre-purchase now to gain [b]instant access[/b] to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount as well as the Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet* plus additional pre-purchase items available at launch.

If you can’t wait to begin, pick up one of the [i]Collection[/i] editions to gain immediate access to the base game and all previous Chapters. Don’t forget, all [i]Gold Road[/i] pre-purchases will also instantly grant you access to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and the Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet*! notes.title: ESO 2024 Global Reveal–Introducing Scribing
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/e616bdb61ba3bb4e6bd6d96fbf82ea12.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover new ways to play with Scribing, arriving as part of The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road. [/i]
 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road [/i](arriving June 3 on PC/Mac and June 18 on Xbox and PlayStation consoles), you can unlock access to an all-new game system: Scribing. With Scribing, you can manipulate the nature of magic itself by collecting and customizing special skills, granting you even more ways to tailor specific builds and play your way. 
 [h2]Customize New Skills[/h2] 
When designing this new system, the team focused on improving opportunities for roleplay and choice for [i]ESO[/i]’s adventurers by providing greater agency when it comes to selecting and adapting the skills that are right for them. What exactly does this mean for you and your characters? Scribing introduces Grimoires, which are new types of skills for your existing skill lines. You can customize these Grimoires beyond their basic functions, transforming them into exactly what you want on your action bar. 
 
For example, one new Grimoire, called Soul Touch, allows you to pull soul magic from the core of your being and cast it at a nearby enemy or ally. You can customize Soul Touch by choosing its Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary Scripts. You could use the Primary to create a Damage Shield for an ally, pull an enemy to you, or even change it to Magic, Shock, or Physical Damage. In addition, you could use the Soul Infusion Secondary to enable the ability to consume a soul gem and gain Ultimate, or you can use a Recovery Secondary to regain resources for a targeted ally.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/website/Q3ZeOwb7aw/s41bng_preview.jpg]																					[img]https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/website/Q3ZeOwb7aw/s41bng_preview.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Customize your Grimoires with Scripts[/i]
 
The above is just one example, but the Scribing system will give you a ton of new ways to change your build and playstyle, since you can unlock a host of Grimoires and Scripts at launch. 
 [h2]Explore the Origins of Magic[/h2] 
To master the art of Scribing you'll need the [i]Gold Road [/i]Chapter, which grants access to a brand-new questline. In this unique story, ancient magic arising in the world attracts the attention of the Mages Guild, who send one of their best to investigate.  
 
Working alongside a brave Knight of the Lamp, you'll discover a mysterious new location and altar and discover the secrets of the mage who built it. Throughout the questline, you'll learn how to scribe, gain a Grimoire or two, and meet new friends along the way.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/862d82507bb6a5d566ac10fc40af81d1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/862d82507bb6a5d566ac10fc40af81d1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Ally with the Luminaries of magic[/i]
 
Fantastic untold lore awaits those willing to delve into the esoteric mysteries of magic, but those who commit to unraveling its secrets will find new power and freedom as they do. 
 [h2]Style Your Existing Skills, Too! [/h2] 
With the ability to mix and match a wide variety of classes, races, skills, and gear sets, [i]ESO[/i] has always striven to provide you with the freedom and power to customize your characters’ unique playstyles. 
 
In the spirit of this core pillar, [i]Gold Road[/i] also introduces a new type of collectible, called Skill Styles. Skill Styles are color variation of popular abilities from various weapon, guild, and world skill lines, helping you further stand out on the battlefield. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/995744a34de5715f92ef734cc8d5ed38.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/995744a34de5715f92ef734cc8d5ed38.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Customize existing abilities with Skill Styles[/i]
 
At the launch of [i]Gold Road[/i], you can unlock these Skill Styles as in-game rewards, but there’s a lot more planned for them beyond the Chapter, too.
 [h2]Play Your Way[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i]’s new Scribing system will be a powerful and flexible new tool for Tamriel’s adventurers, and we can’t wait to see how the community reacts to it. Are you ready and willing to explore the mysteries of magic? Are you excited to experiment with Grimoires and Scripts to create a playstyle uniquely your own? Tell us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (Formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road arrives for PC/Mac on June 3, 2024, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2024. Pre-purchase Gold Road now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet*. Don’t miss out![/i]
 
[i]*The Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet is available only until March 18, 2024.[/i]

notes.title: ESO 2024 Global Reveal—Gold Road’s West Weald Zone
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0b177a588e1c2d830a4408eb434f3ad9.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Discover West Weald, ESO’s newest zone just announced as part of The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road![/i]
[h2]Explore West Weald[/h2]  
In [i]ESO[/i]’s upcoming [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter (arriving  June 3 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles) you can  explore and quest within the West Weald zone, which introduces brand-new  locations, characters, challenges, rewards, and stories. If you’re already  familiar with southeast Cyrodiil, this Chapter allows you to explore this  bountiful part of Tamriel for the first time since 2006’s [i]The Elder Scrolls  IV: Oblivion. [/i]
  
Recently, strange happenings have thrown the region into  turmoil, changing the landscape in bizarre ways and introducing new threats you’ll  have to contend with. In the southeast lies the Gold Road, a temperate  environment similar to that found on the Gold Coast. It's home to the region’s capital  city, Skingrad, the bustling center of the zone and lynchpin for the Colovian  Imperials who call the province home. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/6c423bf1ee34492fa4f12665295066b6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/6c423bf1ee34492fa4f12665295066b6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Discover (or rediscover) Skingrad[/i]
 
Toward the southwest, you will find Dawnwood. Formerly under Imperial control, this area is now home to the encroaching jungles of nearby Valenwood. There, you’ll discover a dense wilderness and the Wood Elf settlement of Vashabar. Even more alarming is the Wildburn, a dangerous area that separates Dawnwood from the Colovian Highlands and Gold Road, comprised of sickened, magically twisted land and even more warped beasts. 
 
In the north of West Weald lies the Colovian Highlands, a mountainous region that is home to an Imperial settlement and numerous ruins.  
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0132c96d607b2c17834eff2d9e101c41.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0132c96d607b2c17834eff2d9e101c41.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Venture into ancient Ayleid ruins[/i]
 
Classic Colovian architecture inspired many of the zone's structures, although as you explore its varied terrain you’ll also encounter many Ayleid ruins that speak to an older heritage. These ruins are less “spoiled” than many other similar locations and show off structures and architectural pieces of Ayleid culture never seen before.
 [h2]New Challenges and Rewards[/h2] 
While the land itself is changing, it is also under attack from a host of new, unfamiliar foes, bringing all-new dangers to West Weald’s adventurers. 
 
These challenges include new delves and public dungeons to explore, world bosses to face, and a bevy of stand-alone quests that tell stories unique to this zone. In addition, new world events, called Mirrormoor Incursions, set you and your fellow adventurers against waves of invading Daedra. 
 
[i]Gold Road[/i] also introduces a 12-player Trial, the Lucent Citadel, which has you and your band venture into a long-forgotten Daedric vault—new bosses, mysteries, and rewards await! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/b3f88397b7ef3c74acc22192a8210d3d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/b3f88397b7ef3c74acc22192a8210d3d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Prepare for a new Trial[/i]
 
Speaking of rewards, if you venture into the zone, you’ll find that West Weald is home to no shortage of new riches. This includes 10 item sets to wear, more Antiquities to dig up, fun collectibles to unlock, and a host of Achievements and Titles to earn. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/476564f980c157efe4fb816337f842de.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/476564f980c157efe4fb816337f842de.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Seize the treasures of West Weald[/i]
 
Finally, [i]Gold Road[/i] also introduces an entirely new type of reward collectible called Skill Styles, which provide visual changes to popular abilities, with more planned for future updates!
 [h2]Wonders Old and New Await[/h2] 
The return of Ithelia and the Wildburn introduces threats both old and new in West Weald. Will you meet these rising dangers? Or perhaps you’re excited to return to Skingrad and discover the Colovian Highlands of Tamriel’s Second Era? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road arrives for PC/Mac on June 3, 2024, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2024. Pre-purchase Gold Road now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet*. Don’t miss out![/i]
 
[i]*The Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet is available only until March 18, 2024.[/i]

notes.title: ESO 2024 Global Reveal—The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road & Scions of Ithelia
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/ab8ecfcda37467c57e92e21d9640df68140488.jpg[/img]																											      								      									
[i]Discover new adventures and revelations in The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road Chapter and Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC, announced during the ESO 2024 Global Reveal.[/i]

[previewyoutube=zt-ZIb2dKIw;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																										      							    							      								      									 [h2]The Forgotten Prince[/h2] 
A secret long held by Hermaeus Mora has been uncovered and the existence of the Forgotten Prince has come to light. Now, Ithelia’s return puts reality itself at risk.
 
Arriving March 11 for PC/Mac and March 26 for Xbox and Playstation consoles, the [i]Scions of Ithelia [/i]dungeon DLC pack continues the story from last year's [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter. Learn more about the spreading threat via the two dungeons featured in this pack, then experience its stunning conclusion in the upcoming Chapter, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] (arriving June 3 for PC/Mac and June 18 for consoles).
 [h2]Scions of Ithelia[/h2] 
Begin 2024’s adventures with the [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] dungeon DLC pack in March, which introduces two new 4-player dungeons, [b]Oathsworn Pit[/b] and [b]Bedlam Veil[/b]. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0f8e293fb7357fbc6fb495ff3d1fe216.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0f8e293fb7357fbc6fb495ff3d1fe216.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scions of Ithelia[/i]
 
These dungeons allow you to explore a training ground for the followers of Malacath and a secret vault within the Oblivion demi-realm of Maelstrom. Both dungeons help set the stage for the upcoming Chapter in their own way, but their storylines can be enjoyed individually, too.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/8d3598bca482bc066b10f4d0ba031dcf.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/8d3598bca482bc066b10f4d0ba031dcf.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle the followers of the Forgotten Prince[/i]
 
These two new dungeons are set to challenge you and your team with Normal and Veteran difficulties (including Hard Mode) and each feature their own Achievements and rewards (including unique collectibles and item sets).
 [h2]Gold Road Chapter[/h2] 
Featuring a new zone, storyline, Scribing system, rewards, and more, The[i] Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] is [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]now available for pre-purchase on all platforms[/url]. This new Chapter takes you to West Weald, a region situated on the borders of Cyrodiil, the Gold Coast, and Valenwood. Those [i]Elder Scroll[/i]s fans who played 2006’s [i]The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion[/i] might be familiar with this part of Tamriel, including its capital city of Skingrad. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/f2cd8a3b84c6f30e3f4845e3871d9ec8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/f2cd8a3b84c6f30e3f4845e3871d9ec8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i]
 
Ruled by the Colovian Count Calantius, this province is an independent nation allied to the Imperial forces occupying nearby Cyrodiil. However, seemingly overnight, the sweltering jungles of Valenwood have replaced a third of the region, and the Count seeks answers to avoid losing any more of his realm.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/57157de818d13beccec9405bffeefba9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/57157de818d13beccec9405bffeefba9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The unraveling of reality is everyone’s problem[/i]
 
That said, the new forest (that the Wood Elves call Dawnwood) may not be the most pressing concern for you and your allies, as you must also investigate the reappearance of Ithelia, the Forgotten Prince.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/5328189025afe0c9fdaea85b654c8a59.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/5328189025afe0c9fdaea85b654c8a59.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Beware the Scions of Ithelia[/i]
 
While her followers cause chaos in her name, many mysteries remain. Why does she now walk West Weald, and what are her Scions’ plans for her return? Reality itself hangs in the balance! While it continues a narrative that began in 2023, like [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i], [i]Gold Road[/i] tells its own stand-alone tale and does not require having played the [i]Necrom [/i]Chapter.
 [h2]A Clash of Fates[/h2] 
The Forgotten Prince may soon return to power, and fate itself trembles in anticipation. What impact will you, a mortal adventurer, have on West Weald and its myriad threats? You’ll have to play [i]Gold Road[/i] to find out!
 
In the meantime, let us know your hopes and predictions for how this conflict will play out via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. Keep an eye out for more information about both the new Chapter and dungeon DLC in the future, too!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road arrives for PC/Mac on June 3, 2024, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2024. Pre-purchase Gold Road now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf mount and Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet*. Don’t miss out![/i]
 
[i]*The Welkyndstone Ruins Pup pet is available only until March 18, 2024.[/i]

notes.title: Quest, Hunt, Pilfer, and Conquer during the Guilds and Glory Celebration Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/0f2c8ee823f58f84e37879f9cd4c64f0.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Find adventure and excitement within Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, the Gold Coast, and the Imperial City during the new Guilds & Glory Celebration in-game event.[/i]
 [h2](Re)Discover Classic Adventures  [/h2]
 The Guilds and Glory Celebration begins Thursday, January 18 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, January 30 at 10AM EST. Throughout the event, as you quest and adventure within Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, the Gold Coast, and the Imperial City, you’ll earn an assortment of bonus goodies including Reward Boxes and Event Tickets. 
 
These bonus rewards include: 
       [list][*]Double reward boxes earned during Daily Quests in Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, the Gold Coast, and Imperial City as well as the Maw of Lorkhaj Weekly Quests[/*][*]Double reward boxes earned during Thieves' Guild Heists and Dark Brotherhood Sacraments[/*][*]Increased resource node drops [/*][list][*]This does not include fishing holes or crafting materials obtained from animals[/*][/list][*]Additional loot from World Bosses in Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, and the Gold Coast as well as Delve Bosses and Public Dungeon Bosses[/*][*]Additional loot from Sweepers and Coldharbour Elite Guard inside Imperial City and Imperial Sewers as well as bosses in the Maw of Lorkhaj [/*][*]Additional loot from bosses in Maelstrom Arena, Imperial City Prison, and White-Gold Tower dungeons[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/2eaa11226556c30ed9444d98ca52b67e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/2eaa11226556c30ed9444d98ca52b67e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Return to Wrothgar and other classic DLC zones[/i]
 
To participate in every aspect of this new event, you will need access to the [i]Orsinium [/i]DLC, the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC, and the [i]Dark Brotherhood [/i]DLC. Each is available within the Crown Store or can be accessed via an ESO Plus membership. The [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC is free for all and can be claimed from the Crown Store at no cost. 
 [h2]Claim Glory & Rewards  [/h2] 
During the Guilds and Glory Celebration, you can earn Glorious Reward Boxes once per day from the first daily quest completed in Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, or the Gold Coast, or by finishing the Maw of Lorkhaj weekly quest. These Reward Boxes may contain the following items:
                [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]Saleable treasures [/*][*]A style item [/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac if the box is dropped in Wrothgar[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch if the box is dropped in Hew’s Bane[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour if the box is dropped in the Gold Coast[/*][/list][*]Overland item set [/*][*]Companion gear [/*][*]A chance for one of the following items [/*][list][*]Crafting recipes (from the zone in which you earn the box)[/*][*]Treasure Maps and Survey Reports (from the zone in which you earn the box)[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac if the box is dropped in Wrothgar[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch if the box is dropped in Hew’s Bane[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour if the box is dropped in the Gold Coast[/*][/list][/list][*]A chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/8357e4d381fe5ae8af17ac6f505709f2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/8357e4d381fe5ae8af17ac6f505709f2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn a host of rewards including a new style[/i]
 
In addition, you can collect more common Regular Reward Boxes by completing consecutive dailies in the event-related zones. These may contain the following items: 
                [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]A chance for saleable treasures [/*][*]A chance for a style item [/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac if the box is dropped in Wrothgar[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch if the box is dropped in Hew’s Bane[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour if the box is dropped in the Gold Coast[/*][/list][*]Overland item set [/*][*]A chance for Companion gear [/*][*]A small chance for one of the following items[/*][list][*]Furnishing recipes (from the zone in which you earn the box)[/*][*]Treasure Maps and Survey Reports ( from the zone in which you earn the box)[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac if the box is dropped in Wrothgar[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch if the box is dropped in Hew’s Bane[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour if the box is dropped in the Gold Coast.[/*][/list][/list][*]A small chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/142ee222ee424efc254c420573591f11.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/142ee222ee424efc254c420573591f11.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/f4cc5bf1893cc948603ccf44ce969d71.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/f4cc5bf1893cc948603ccf44ce969d71.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Pilfer or slay your way to new riches[/i]
 
You may also receive a second Glorious Reward Box once per day by looting the final boss within the Imperial City Prison, White-Gold Tower, and Maelstrom Arena. These Reward Boxes may contain the following items:
                  [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]Saleable treasures [/*][*]A style item [/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour[/*][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][*]Dungeon item set, from Imperial City Prison, White-Gold Tower, or Maelstrom Arena[/*][*]Companion gear [/*][*]One of the following items [/*][list][*]Furnishing recipes[/*][*]Treasure Maps and Survey Reports[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour[/*][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][/list][*]A chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page[/*][/list]
You can also earn Regular Reward Boxes by looting the final boss of an event-related dungeon subsequent times. These may contain the following items: 
                  [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]A chance for saleable treasures [/*][*]A chance for a style item [/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour[/*][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][*]Dungeon item set, from Imperial City Prison, White-Gold Tower, or Maelstrom Arena[/*][*]A chance for Companion gear [/*][*]A small chance for one of the following items [/*][list][*]Furnishing recipes[/*][*]Treasure Maps and Survey Reports[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Ancient Orc, Malacath, or Trinimac[/*][*]Outlaw, Thieves' Guild, or Abah’s Watch[/*][*]Assassin’s League, Minotaur, Dark Brotherhood, or Order of the Hour[/*][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][/list][*]A small chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/166b7d169eea8771d741688e4d790ba7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/166b7d169eea8771d741688e4d790ba7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle in the heart of the empire[/i]
 
Lastly, you can collect a third Glorious Reward Box once per day after you complete your first Imperial City daily quest or slay your first Sweeper boss. Additionally, there is a chance to receive a Glorious Reward Box after felling a Coldharbour Elite Guard. These Rewards Boxes may contain the following items:
             [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]Tel Var Stones [/*][*]Imperial City Key Fragments [/*][*]Saleable treasures [/*][*]A style item[/*][list][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact
[/*][/list][*]Imperial City item set [/*][*]One of the following items [/*][list][*]Furnishing Recipes from Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, or the Gold Coast[/*][*]Cyrodiil Treasure Maps[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][/list][*]A chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page [/*][/list]
Regular Reward Boxes may also be earned by finishing subsequent Imperial City dailies, killing additional Sweeper bosses, and defeating additional Coldharbour Elite Guards. These may contain the following items: 
     [list][*]Crafting materials [/*][*]Tel Var Stones [/*][*]A chance for Imperial City Key Fragments [/*][*]A chance for a saleable treasure [/*][*]A chance for a style item[/*][list][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][*]Imperial City item set[/*][*]A chance for one of the following items [/*][list][*]Furnishing recipes from Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, or the Gold Coast[/*][*]Cyrodiil Treasure Maps[/*][*]Motif chapters[/*][list][*]Xivkyn, Aldmeri Dominion, Daggerfall Covenant, or Ebonheart Pact[/*][/list][/list][*]A small chance for a Bristleback Hunter outfit style page [/*][/list]
Additionally, you can collect further Regular Reward Boxes by participating in the following activities:
 [list][*]Slaying World Bosses in the Wrothgar,      Hew's Bane, or the Gold Coast zones[/*]  [*]Defeating the final boss in[i] [/i]Imperial City Prison,      White-Gold Tower, or Maelstrom Arena dungeons[/*]  [*]Opening treasure chests[/*]  [*]Opening safeboxes[/*]  [*]Looting objects such as barrels, crates, etc.[/*]  [*]Looting Psijic portals[/*]  [*]Cracking open Thieves Troves[/*]  [*]Harvesting crafting resource nodes[/*][/list]
Phew! That’s a TON of ways to earn a host of bonus rewards during this massive new in-game event. Whether you’re stalking your prey on behalf of the Dark Brotherhood, pilfering unsuspecting nobles with your Thieves Guild allies, battling your fellow players in the Imperial City, or delving into the politics and strife of the home of the Orcs, this event has bonus rewards for you! 
 [h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
Of course, we can’t forget about those precious Event Tickets! During the Guilds and Glory Celebration, you will receive two Event Tickets for the first of the following activities completed each day:
         [list][*]Daily Delve and World Boss quests in Wrothgar[/*][*]Daily Delve, World Boss, and Thieves' Guild quests in Hew's Bane[/*][*]Daily Delve, World Boss, and Dark Brotherhood quests in the Gold Coast[/*][*]Daily Quests in Imperial City[/*][*]Weekly Trial Quest for Maw of Lorkhaj[/*][*]Killing and looting a Sweeper in Imperial City[/*][*]Killing and looting a Coldharbour Elite Guard in Imperial City Sewers[/*][*]Killing and looting the final boss of Imperial City Prison and White-Gold Tower[/*][*]Killing and looting the final boss of Maelstrom Arena[/*][/list]
By the end of the event, you could have earned an impressive 26 Tickets total! But keep in mind, you can only carry 12 Tickets at one time. To help you lighten the load, here’s what the Impresario has in stock during the event:
            [list][*]All three [b]Molag Ball Illusion Imp [/b]pet fragments [/*][list][*]Anchor Chain Fragment[/*][*]Dark Anchor Pinion[/*][*]Effigy of the Dominator[/*][/list][*]The first [b]Planemeld’s Master[/b] marking fragment [/*][list][*]Crematory Ash[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the following:[/*][list][*]Bristleback Hunter outfit style[/*][/list][*]Stonefire Scamp Pet [/*][*]Soul-Shriven Skin [/*][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/677ee127fccca9ad7e770092b8a14e2e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/677ee127fccca9ad7e770092b8a14e2e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Molag Bal Illusion Imp pet[/i]
 
The Guilds and Glory Celebration is your first chance this year to purchase Crematory Ash, the first of three morphing fragments for the Planemeld’s Master markings! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/2cc73bbf5b381f94f4d8772f0263a57b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/2cc73bbf5b381f94f4d8772f0263a57b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Planemeld’s Master markings[/i]
 
Additionally, the Impresario’s Assistant, Philius Dormier, will gladly take your precious Event Tickets in exchange for some tantalizing treasures:
  [list][*]Unstable Morpholith Pet Fragments[/*][*]Doomchar Plateau House Fragments[/*][/list]
Last but not least, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor is ready to barter away the following goodies:
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Dawnwood Indrik Berries[/*][*]Spectral Indrik Berries[/*][*]Springtide Indrik Pet[/*][*]Haunting Indrik Pet[/*][/list][h2]Greatness Waits for No One[/h2] 
Adventure across Wrothgar, Hew's Bane, the Gold Coast, and the Imperial City and you’ll[i] [/i]earn a mountain of bonus rewards during the Guilds and Glory Celebration. Are you ready to find glory, honor, and untold riches during this new in-game event? Share your story with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Guilds and Glory Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, January 18 at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, January 30 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Complete Merry Quests & Earn Special Rewards During the New Life Festival Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/7fb58ed22b9ed6eb2d51e46ecf196a49.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Spread holiday cheer while enjoying bonus XP gains and seasonal rewards during this year’s New Life Festival.[/i]
 [h2]Warm Wishes for a Happy Holiday[/h2] 
The 2023 New Life Festival in-game event begins Thursday, December 21, 2023, at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, January 9, 2024, at 10AM EST. During this year’s festivities, you can earn a variety of jolly rewards including New Life Boxes, XP boosts, Event Tickets, and more.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2021/12/06a63559559303a3d0f3ec1d0d0e98a8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2021/12/06a63559559303a3d0f3ec1d0d0e98a8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find Breda in Eastmarch to begin[/i]
 
During the New Life Festival, you will automatically enjoy a 100% boost to XP gain whenever you log into the game, with no extra steps required! If you’d like to join the party and toast the passing of another year, complete the New Life Festival’s introductory quest and collect Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug memento via the following steps:
      [olist][*]Open the Crown Store and acquire the free quest, “The New Life Festival.”[/*][/olist][list][*]You can also pick up this quest by speaking with Breda at the New Life Festival tent in Eastmarch. [/*][list][*]You can instantly transport yourself to Breda by using the portal located at any Impresario tent location.[/*][/list][/list][*]Complete the introductory quest to receive the Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug memento.[/*][list][*]You won’t need to acquire Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug if you finished the quest during a previous year.[/*][/list][*]Enjoy your endless supply of winter spiced mead![/*] 
After wrapping up the event’s introductory quest, you’ll unlock 10 special New Life Festival daily quests: nine from Breda and one from Petronius Galenus. The pair will task you to travel across the vastness of Tamriel and share seasonal merriment with its denizens.
 [h2]Good Deeds, Great Rewards[/h2] 
Whenever you complete one of the 10 daily quests, you’ll be rewarded with a New Life Festival Box. Contained inside these seasonal cases is the chance to receive the following rewards:
                 [list][*]Assortments of alchemy crafting materials [/*][*]New Life Festival Toys: [/*][list][*]Sword Swallower Kit[/*][*]Juggling Knives[/*][*]Fire-Breather’s Torches[/*][*]Mudballs[/*][/list][*]Wolfsbane Incense [/*][*]One of the following: [/*][list][*]A Skinchanger motif page[/*][*]New Life Festival Recipes[/*][*]New Life Furnishings[/*][*]Deep Winter Charity Writs[/*][*]Imperial Charity Writs[/*][/list][*]A [i]chance[/i] for one of the following:[/*][list][*]An Evergreen outfit style page[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] A Morningstar Frostwear outfit style page[/*][list][*]If you’ve already earned a Morningstar Frostwear page that day, an Evergreen outfit style page or a Nord Carved armor outfit style page will be given instead[/*][/list][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/9564abde54b5b07e0516046e09da2a40.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/9564abde54b5b07e0516046e09da2a40.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn a new armor style[/i]
 [h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
The first New Life Festival daily quest you complete each day rewards three Event Tickets in addition to the reward box. You can earn up to a colossal [b]60 Event Tickets[/b] by the event’s end! Don’t forget that you can only ever hold up to 12 Event Tickets in your inventory at once.
 
During the New Life Festival, the Impresario will update her stock with the following items:
                        [list][*]All three [b]Passion Dancer Blossom [/b]pet fragments [/*][*]All components for this year’s morphing collectibles:[/*][list][*]Passion’s Muse personality[/*][*]Meadowbreeze Memories skin[/*][*]Passion Dancer Garment costume[/*][/list][*]All three [b]Hoardhunter Ursauk[/b] mount fragments[/*][list][*]Blessed Honeycomb[/*][*]Gilded and Dyed Saddle[/*][*]Sorcerous Golden Ink[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the following:[/*][list][*][b]NEW[/b] Morningstar Frostwear pages [/*][/list][*]New Life Festival Grab Bag [/*][list][*]Mud Ball Pouch memento[/*][*]Nordic Bather’s Towel costume[/*][*]Colovian Fur Hood hat[/*][*]Colovian Filigreed Hood hat[/*][*]Sword-Swallower’s Blade memento[/*][*]Juggler’s Knives memento[/*][*]Fire-Breather’s Torches memento[/*][*]Snowball Buddy pet[/*][*]Powderwhite Coney pet[/*][/list][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
The New Life Festival is also your last chance to pick up the third fragment needed to construct this year’s final event Morphing Collectible, the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/11/b3a53d6fcf9e1741482c56e2734daf3f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/11/b3a53d6fcf9e1741482c56e2734daf3f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Hoardhunter Ursauk[/i]
 
Additionally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Pure Snow Indrik Berries[/*][*]Crimson Indrik Berries[/*][*]Frost-Light Indrik Pet[/*][*]Rosethorn Indrik Pet[/*][/list]
Lastly, the Impresario’s Assistant is offering the following, which you can also acquire with Event Tickets:
        [list][*]Unstable Morpholith fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]Dagonic Quasigriff fragments[/*][list][*]Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather[/*][*]Black Iron Bit[/*][*]Bridle Black Iron Stirrups[/*][/list][/list][h2]Tamriel Rings in the New Year[/h2] 
As this year draws to a close, you can send 2023 off in merry style during the New Life Festival and collect some special event rewards as you do. How do you plan to spend the holidays in [i]ESO[/i]? Let us know and be sure to share any fun New Life-themed creations with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (Formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The New Life Festival in-game event begins this Thursday, December 21 at 10AM EST, and continues until Wednesday, January 9 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: ESO’s 10th Anniversary Is Coming–Join Us for a Very Special In-Person Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/955b1752b1e3849f351554ad8e203a17.jpg[/img]																																									      								      									 
[i]Commemorate a decade of The Elder Scrolls Online and our amazing community with a special in-person event that kicks off our massive 10th Anniversary Celebration![/i]

 [h2]Celebrating 10 Amazing Years[/h2] 
Next year, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] will reach its 10<sup>th</sup> anniversary since it first launched on PC/Mac in April 2014. To celebrate this incredible milestone, we’re kicking off a massive 10<sup>th</sup> Anniversary Celebration in April.
 
During the celebration, we’ll look back on [i]ESO[/i]’s history and celebrate the game itself, its dedicated group of developers, its passionate, ever-growing community, and its bright future.  
 
Whether you’ve been a member of the #ESOFam since early beta, have recently begun your journey into Tamriel, or are looking for a new epic online roleplaying game—you won’t want to miss this incredible celebration. It all kicks off next year in Amsterdam!

 [h2]Join Us in Amsterdam[/h2] 
The fun begins next year with the first [i]ESO[/i] 10-Year Celebration Event, a two-day in-person event we’re hosting at the [url=https://www.sugarfactory.nl/en/]SugarFactory[/url] just outside of Amsterdam, Netherlands, from Friday, April 5, until Saturday, April 6. You can grab your tickets now by visiting the official signup website below. 

[b][h1][url=https://www.showclix.com/tickets/ESOTenYearCelebrationNL]->Get Tickets<-[/url][/h1][/b]
																																
At the event, you can mix and mingle with your fellow [i]ESO[/i] adventurers [i]and [/i]developers while enjoying two days of fun. This will include developer panels and roundtable discussions (with some livestreamed), hands-on gameplay, food and drink, live music, community activities, and more. In addition, the April 2024 event will host our first-ever [b]in-person [i]ESO[/i] cosplay competition[/b], so if you’ve got an amazing [i]ESO[/i] costume in mind that you think the community will love and are planning to attend, get crafting! 
 
We'll share more specifics on the event with the community in the future, so keep an eye out on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] and our social channels.

 [h2]Celebrate ESO with Us![/h2] 
We’re planning to make this the biggest in-person community event we’ve ever had, but it’s not the only one we plan to host during this massive anniversary celebration. There’s going to be a ton of special 10<sup>th</sup> Anniversary in-person events all over the globe throughout, including a big one in the United States in 2025. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/c96164c1534c5cb313f541b93c8a14c0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/12/c96164c1534c5cb313f541b93c8a14c0.jpg[/img]																						          																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Celebrate ESO’s anniversary with us![/i]
 
Stay tuned for additional announcements in April 2024 when we unveil more.  
 
Are you excited to celebrate 10 years of adventure in Tamriel’s Second Era with us? Let us know if you’re planning to make your way to the Netherlands for this initial event via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (Formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]—we hope to see you there!

notes.title: Gates of Oblivion Celebration Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/11/06f512f6c40b4e0859d8d5b805c8ead1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Unravel Dagon's Schemes[/h1]
The Gates of Oblivion Celebration begins Thursday, November 16 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, November 28 at 10AM EST. During the festivities, players will enjoy an assortment of goodies including special Reward Boxes, Event Tickets, and increased drops to Daily Quests, Dungeons, Resource Nodes, as well as World Bosses and Delves throughout the Blackwood and the Deadlands zones. 

To participate, you'll need access to Blackwood, Flames of Ambition, Waking Flame, or Deadlands, all of which are obtainable through [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™[/url] or available for purchase from the in-game Crown Store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2b43d62431acd1891631dc81dbe95099cd44f8fa.jpg[/img]
[center][i]Find Plokun in Gideon to begin![/i][/center]

You can then kick things off by picking up the introductory quest "Burdensome Beasts" available for free within the in-game Crown Store or from Plokun, a Dremora found northwest of Gideon in the Blackwood zone.

[h1]Amass Incredible Rewards[/h1]
Throughout the event, you can earn a Glorious Reward Box once per day each time you complete your first Daily Quest in either the Blackwood or Deadlands zones, or from the first Rockgrove Weekly Quest completed. You can also obtain a second Glorious Reward Box once per day by looting the final boss of any [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] and [i]Waking Flame[/i] dungeons.

Glorious Reward Boxes may contain the following items:
[list][*] Random crafting materials 
[*] A Fine or Superior rarity sellable treasure 
[*] One of the following [i]Blackwood/Deadlands [/i]motif style items: 
[list][*] If the reward box was obtained in the Overland:
[list][*] Sul-Xan
[*] Black Fin
[*] Ivory Brigade
[*] House Hexos
[*] Fargrave Guardian
[*] Annihilarch's Chosen[/list][/list]
[list][*] If the reward box was obtained in a Dungeon:
[list][*] True-Sworn
[*] Waking Flame
[*] Knights of the Silver Rose
[*] Crimson Oath[/list][/list]
[*] A Fine, Superior, or Epic  rarity Blackwood or Deadlands overland set item
[list][*] A Dungeon set item will be given instead if you obtained the Reward Box in a Dungeon[/list] 
[*] Companion Gear 
[*] One of the following drops 
[list][*] [i]Blackwood[/i] or [i]Deadlands[/i] furnishing recipes
[*] [i]Blackwood[/i] or [i]Deadlands[/i] Treasure Maps or Survey Reports
[*] Motif Chapters
[list][*] If the reward box was obtained in the Overland:
[list][*] Sul-Xan
[*] Black Fin
[*] Ivory Brigade
[*] House Hexos
[*] Godgrave Guardian
[*] Annihilarch's Chosen[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] If the reward box was obtained in a Dungeon:
[list][*] True-Sworn
[*] Waking Flame
[*] Knights of the Silver Rose
[*] Crimson Oath[/list][/list]
[*] A chance for a style page for the NEW Y'ffre's Fallen-Wood armor[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/52d0095410a867518f32e6d2bf1da88d75fbfe43.jpg[/img]
[center][i]The new Y'ffre's Fallen-Wood armor style[/i][/center]

In addition, you can collect the more common Regular Reward Boxes by participating in the following activities:
[list][*] Slaying Delve and World Bosses in the Blackwood and Deadland zones
[*] Defeating Flames of Ambition and Waking Flame dungeon bosses
[*] Opening treasure chests
[*] Opening safeboxes
[*] Looting objects such as barrels, crates, etc.
[*] Looting Psijic portals
[*] Cracking open Thieves Troves
[*] Harvesting crafting resource nodes[/list]
These reward boxes may contain the following items:
[list][*] Random crafting materials 
[*] A chance for a Fine or Superior rarity sellable treasure 
[*] A chance for one of the following Blackwood/Deadlands motif style items: 
[list][*] Sul-Xan
[*] Black Fin
[*] Ivory Brigade
[*] House Hexos
[*] Godgrave Guardian
[*] Annihilarch's Chosen[/list]
[*] A Fine, Superior, or Epic  rarity Blackwood or Deadlands Overland set item 
[list][*] A Dungeon set item will be given instead if you obtained the reward box in a Dungeon[/list] 
[*] A chance for Companion gear 
[*] A chance for one of the following drops 
[list][*] [i]Blackwood[/i] or [i]Deadlands[/i] furnishing recipes
[*] [i]Blackwood[/i] or [i]Deadlands[/i] Treasure Maps or Survey Reports
[*] Motif Chapters
[list][*] Sul-Xan
[*] Black Fin
[*] Ivory Brigade
[*] House Hexos
[*] Godgrave Guardian
[*] Annihilarch's Chosen[/list][/list]
[*] A small chance for a style page for the NEW Y'ffre's Fallen-Wood armor[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8889fd5885b8582b294bc046604e5962e038c551.jpg[/img]
[center][i]Complete daily quests to earn bonus rewards[/i][/center]

[h1]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h1]
But that's not all! Throughout the duration of the celebration, players will receive two Event Tickets for the first of the following activities completed each day:
[list][*] First Daily Quest completed in the Blackwood zone
[*] First Daily Quest completed in the Deadlands zone
[*] Weekly trial quest completed in Rockgrove
[*] Slaying and looting the final boss in either [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] or [i]Waking Flame[/i] dungeons[/list]
In total, you can amass a whopping 26 Event Tickets during this event! Don't forget that you can carry only 12 Tickets at one time. 

Here's what the Impresario has in stock:
[list][*] All three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments 
[list][*] Chartreuse Lily Petals
[*] Enchanted Silver Flute
[*] Mystical Sheet Music[/list]
[*] The first and second Hoardhunter Ursauk mount fragment 
[list][*] Blessed Honeycomb
[*] [b]NEW[/b] Gilded and Dyed Saddle[/list]
[*] Bound style pages for the following:
[list][*] [b]NEW[/b] Y'ffre's Fallen-Wood[/list]
[*] Impresario Group Repair Kits
[*] Companion Guild Commendations[/list]
The Gates of Oblivion Celebration is your first chance to purchase the Gilded and Dyed Saddle, the second of three morphing fragments for the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2ae4aaeb16a2384c1cde4b3ee9692b5b731001da.jpg[/img]
[center][i]The Hoardhunter Ursauk mount[/i][/center]

Learn more about morphing collectibles and upgrade fragments by checking out this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]guide[/url]. Be sure to keep your eyes peeled for the reveal of the final morphing fragment later this year!

Additionally, the Impresario's Assistant, Philius Dormier, is offering these valuable treasures in exchange for your hard-earned tickets:
[list][*] Unstable Morpholith Fragments
[*] Dagonic Quasigriff Fragments[/list]
Finally, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor is stocking her shop with the following goodies:
[list][*] Nascent Indrik Feathers
[*] Crimson Indrik Berries
[*] Pure-Snow Indrik Berries
[*] Frost-Light Indrik Pet
[*] Rosethorn Indrik Pet[/list]
[h1]Ward Off Destruction[/h1]
Dismantle Daedric schemes while enjoying an assortment of tantalizing rewards and useful bonuses as you explore Blackwood and the Deadlands during the Gates of Oblivion Celebration. Are you prepared to free these lands from the corrupting influence of Mehrunes Dagon? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]The Gates of Oblivion Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, November 16 at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, November 28 at 10AM EST. [/i]
