notes.title: Infinite Archive & Update 40 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/93b563f90ddef66e9abade33ebe4014a.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the Update 40 base-game patch, featuring the unending battle of the Infinite Archive and more, now live on PC/Mac! [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Infinite Archive[/i] and Update 40 are now live on PC/Mac. If you are a console player, don’t worry. Update 40 arrives on November 14 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5, too! 
 
This base-game patch introduces an all-new PvE activity for Tamriel’s adventurers and a host of new features and quality-of-life improvements—completely free for all [i]ESO [/i]players!   
[previewyoutube=aypqJhUi0eM;full][/previewyoutube]									      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 [h2]Infinite Archive[/h2] 
In the Infinite Archive, you can discover an unending challenge as you battle your way through the shifting libraries and twisting pathways of one of Hermaeus Mora’s most mysterious strongholds.
 
A malignant force is causing chaos within the once solemn archive, and its custodian, Master Malkhest, needs brave explorers to investigate and fight back against the corruption. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/4f5eb2f67d03541aa8697d37debdc896.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/4f5eb2f67d03541aa8697d37debdc896.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle through the Archive[/i]
 
[b]Unending Challenge[/b]
 
In this all-new PvE activity, you can team up with a trusted ally or go it solo as you contend with randomly generated stages filled with waves of monsters and perilous boss encounters. 
 
The further you progress into this eternal arena, the more dangerous and numerous your foes become. Fall to the Archive’s dangers three times, and your run ends, plus you have to start over. But don’t let that phase you, as there’s always another expedition into the Infinite Archive waiting, and the greater the dangers, the greater the rewards are in turn! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Community/Article/Achievement_ELAR_ThoatReplicanum_GlassMantikoraCombat%20%201%20.jpg]																					[img]https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Community/Article/Achievement_ELAR_ThoatReplicanum_GlassMantikoraCombat%20%201%20.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Survive twisted maligraphies[/i]
 
Helping you survive these encounters are two types of boons you can choose along the way: Verses (temporary buffs that last until the end of the next Stage), and Visions (more permanent buffs that last your entire run). The Verses and Visions you choose can have a major impact on your run, so choose wisely! 
 
[b]Infinite Rewards[/b]
 
As you continue your expedition into the Infinite Archive, you can discover and unlock a host of specials rewards, including unique collectibles, item sets, and more—all granted by the Prince of Knowledge himself! 
 
These rewards include class set items, the first of their kind, which provide powerful boons to select Class Skill Lines. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Empower class skills with new item sets[/i]
 
However, that’s not all. As you complete expeditions, you also earn a new currency called Archival Fortunes. With Archival Fortunes, you can purchase all manner of helpful items from the vendors within the Infinite Archive’s central hub. This includes one-time use buffs, individual item set items, fragments of collectibles, and even permanent account unlocks that provide boons for future runs! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Endless Archive collectible rewards[/i]
 
Finally, the Infinite Archive also features a host of unique in-game collectibles that you can’t earn anywhere else in Tamriel or Oblivion, including the Maligraphic Mount, Maligraphic Skeever pet, a unique Tales of Tribute deck, and much more. Check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64891]our preview[/url] for more information on the Infinite Archive’s rewards.
 [h2]Getting Started[/h2] 
The Infinite Archive is a [b]free[/b] base-game addition to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] and is part of the Update 40 patch. There is no additional purchase necessary, although ESO Plus members will enjoy a bonus to Archival Fortune gains during their expeditions. 
 
You can access the Infinite Archive via two methods:
  [list][*]If you own the Necrom Chapter, you can find the entrance to the Infinite Archive northeast of Cipher's Midden in Apocrypha.[/*][*]If you don’t own the Chapter, select the Infinite Archive icon on your map of Apocrypha to teleport directly there.[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8900c6e9c570f3ec8db144c6e6fce32c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8900c6e9c570f3ec8db144c6e6fce32c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Prepare for adventure[/i]
 
Brave adventurers may wish to dive right in to the archive’s myriad mazelike passages, but you may wish to review these [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64837]developer tips[/url] before you begin your expedition. Preparation is key—good luck!
 [h2]Update 40 [/h2] 
In addition to the new PvE activity, Update 40 also includes a host of new features and quality-of-life improvements that all of Tamriel’s adventurers can enjoy. 
 
[b]Group Finder[/b]
 
The new Group Finder tool makes it easier than ever to find likeminded players to join you for practically any in-game activity, including typical group challenges such as Trials or Dungeon runs, but also more social activities such as zone explorations, roleplay sessions, or fashion contests! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group Finder UI[/i]
 
There are a host of categories you can choose from when finding a group, but the Custom category allows you to create or find fellow players for any unique activity you can dream up! 
 
In addition, the Group Finder allows you to set up requirements for your groups, including roles, CP levels, voice chat, and many more. 
 
[b]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/b]
 
Update 40 also introduces a new type of end-game furnishing for Tamriel’s master crafters: Grand Master Crafting Stations. These special items allow you to consolidate your home’s (likely many) attuned crafting stations into one, severely reducing the amount of housing slots your crafting stations take up AND freeing up space in general. The more attuned crafting stations you “feed” to your Grand Master station, the more visually distinct that specific furnishing will appear as it evolves over time. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/i]
 
You can acquire Grand Master Crafting Stations using Writ Vouchers from the Achievement Mediator, Faustina Curio, with a unique furnishing available for each of Blacksmithing, Jewelry Crafting, Clothing, and Woodworking. 
 
You can dive deeper into both the Group Finder and Grand Master Crafting Stations in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64897]this preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Jewelry Crafting Rebalance[/b]
 
This patch also establishes a broad rebalancing of Jewelry Crafting to help align its costs with the game’s other crafting disciplines. This includes the removal of Jewelry Crafting grains and conversion into platings in addition to increasing the total boosters needed to upgrade your jewelry. As a result, upgrading rings and amulets is now easier and cheaper than ever before.
 
[b]Quest XP & Gold Standardization[/b]
 
Finally, Update 40 also standardizes the Experience Point and Gold rewards for many of the game’s quests, including those associated with zones, main storylines, prologues, dailies, guild storylines, and more. This will result in more consistent rewards for the game’s various quests based on their complexity or length. 
 
Of course, these are just some of the changes implemented with the base-game patch. Be sure to visit our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url] to review everything coming with this massive update. 
 [h2]Infinite Challenges[/h2] 
In the Update 40 base-game patch, you can discover an all-new challenge for you and your fiercest allies as you delve ever-deeper into the dynamic galleries of a corrupted library. How far will your expedition into the Infinite Archive get? The only limits are your preparation and skills! Tell us if you’ll be venturing into the free Infinite Archive PvE activity via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—good luck!
 
[i]The Update 40 base-game patch and Infinite Archive are now live on PC/Mac and arrive November 14 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5. [/i]

notes.title: Conquer Tamriel’s Fears and Earn Special Rewards during the Witches Festival Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/2a97cd6fcb87cdfc399c1743347f27e5.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Slay Tamriel’s most horrific monstrosities to obtain unique in-game rewards during 2023’s Witches Festival in-game event![/i]
 [h2]The Festival of Frights Returns![/h2] 
This year’s Witches Festival in-game event begins next Thursday, October 26 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, November 7 at 10AM EST. During this [b]spoopiest[/b] of occasions, you can claim terrifyingly awesome event-specific rewards including Plunder Skulls, XP gain boosts, Event Tickets, and more!
 
During the Witches Festival, all adventurers can enjoy a passive 100% boost to XP gain at all times. To collect the Witchmother’s Whistle and down ladles of hag’s brew, simply follow the steps listed below:
      [list][*]Open the Crown Store and acquire the free quest, “The Witchmother's Bargain.”[/*][list][*]You can also pick up this quest by speaking with the Crow Caller, who you’ll find outside of each Olyve's Brewery in Stonefalls, Glenumbra, or Auridon.[/*][/list][*]Complete the introductory quest to receive the Witchmother's Whistle tool.[/*][list][*]You won’t need to acquire the Witchmother’s Whistle if you finished the quest in a previous year’s event.[/*][/list][*]Blow the whistle to summon the “Witchmother's Cauldron,” which you drink from to polymorph yourself into a spooky scary skeleton.[/*][list][*]You cannot summon the Cauldron in Cyrodiil.[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/5aeb94e9326505ab14ed6d3167d985f7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/5aeb94e9326505ab14ed6d3167d985f7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Take a sip from the Witchmother’s Cauldron[/i]
 [h2]Acquire Cursed Rewards[/h2] 
During the Witches Festival event period, whenever you defeat a boss monster, you’ll be offered a [b]Plunder Skull[/b] container in addition to any regular rewards.
 
When you open a Plunder Skull, you have the [b]chance [/b]to receive the following items:
      [list][*]Alchemy reagents[/*][*]A festival-themed furnishing recipe[/*][*]A festival-themed provisioning recipe[/*][*]A complete festival-themed furnishing[/*][*]A festival-themed treasure[/*][*]A small chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]A       Hollowjack style item [/*][*]A Dremora style items[/*][/list][*]Worms,      Crawlers, Guts, Insect Parts[/*] [/list]
What’s more, whenever you fell a different unique type of boss for the first time each day, you’ll be rewarded with a special [b]Dremora Plunder Skull[/b] that contains some of the above items in addition to these:
 [list][*]Dremora motif chapter[/*]  [*]A chance for one of the following items:[/*]  [list][*]A       Witches Festival Writ[/*]   [*]A Glenmoril Teasure Map or Glenmoril armor outfit style       page[/*]   [*]A Grave Dancer weapon style page[/*]   [*][b]NEW[/b] A Tome of       Forbidden Appetites Memento Runebox [/*]   [*][b]NEW[/b] A Witches       Festival Ghost Netch pet fragment [/*]   [*][b]NEW[/b] A tradeable       style page for the Crowborne Hunter outfit style [/*]  [/list][/list]
The different types of bosses that offer these Dremora Plunder Skulls include arena bosses, invasion bosses (from Dark Anchors, Harrowstorms, Volcanic Vents, etc.), delve bosses, final dungeon bosses, public dungeon bosses, and world bosses. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/585589416bb9e049ce19a73b2eb8525e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/585589416bb9e049ce19a73b2eb8525e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Reap a host of haunted rewards[/i]
 
Monsters of all shapes and sizes lurk throughout Tamriel this time of year, but there is one creepy beastie that is feared above all: [b]The Crowborne Horror[/b]. To locate and slay this living nightmare, acquire the daily quest “Plucking the Crow” by speaking with the Witchmother Taerma, located inside of Olyve’s Brewery and at every Impresario tent found throughout Tamriel. 
 
For your courage, you’ll be rewarded with a Dremora Plunder Skull that has a [b]small chance [/b]to grant you an incredible offering of tradeable[i] [/i]Witches Festival valuables [b]instead [/b]of regular Dremora Plunder Skull items, including: 
     [list][*]10 Witch-Tamed Bear Dog fragments[/*][*]The FULL style book for the Dremora motif[/*][*]A folio of ALL Glenmoril Treasure Maps[/*][*]Runebox: Tome of Forbidden Appetites[/*][*]A random Crowborne Hunter outfit style page[/*][/list][h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
During the Witches Festival, you can collect two Event Tickets from the first boss you defeat each day, earning up to 26 tickets by the end of the event. But don’t forget: You can hold up to 12 Event Tickets only. 
 
For this event, the Impresario will stock the following items:
                              [list][*]All three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments: [/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]The first fragment for Hoardhunter Ursauk mount:[/*][list][*]Blessed Honeycomb[/*][/list][*]Crowborne Hunter outfit style pages [/*][*]Witches Festival Ghost Netch pet fragment [/*][*]Tome of Forbidden Appetites memento [/*][*]Assorted Spooky Witches festival-themed Furnishings[/*][list][*]Webs, Cone furnishing [/*][*]Hollowjack Lantern, Ouroboros furnishing [/*][*]Specimen Jar, Spare Brain furnishing [/*][*]Ruby Candlefly Gathering furnishing [/*][*]Vampiric Lamp, Azure Tall furnishing [/*][*]Vampiric Lightpost, Azure Single furnishing [/*][*]Vampiric Container, Yellow Liquid furnishing [/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kit [/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations [/*][*]Witches Grab Bag [b](This is purchasable only if you haven’t yet collected all the items contained within)[/b][/*][list][*]Skeletal Marionette memento[/*][*]Spectre Mask collectible[/*][list][*]There are four variations of this collectible[/*][/list][*]Apple-Bobbing Cauldron fragment[/*][*]Throw Bones Memento fragment[/*][*]Marshmallow Toasty Treat emote[/*][*]Witch's Bonfire Dust[/*][*]Ghastly Visitation memento[/*][*]Witch-Tamed Bear-Dog pet fragment[/*][*]Witchmother's Servant outfit style pages[/*][/list][/list]
Of note: The Witches Festival will be your first opportunity to begin gathering the fragments for the final event morphing collectible of 2023, the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/03b4980cc9b98474c52101a5989b108e.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/03b4980cc9b98474c52101a5989b108e.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hoardhunter Ursauk morphing collectible[/i]
 
Additionally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase using Event Tickets:
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Pure Snow Indrik Berries[/*][*]Crimson Indrik Berries[/*][*]Frost-Light Indrik Pet[/*][*]Rosethorn Indrik Pet[/*][/list]
Lastly, the Impresario’s Assistant is offering the following, which you can acquire with Event Tickets:
        [list][*]Unstable Morpholith fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]Dagonic Quasigriff fragments[/*][list][*]Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather [/*][*]Black Iron Bit [/*][*]Bridle Black Iron Stirrups[/*][/list][/list]
The spooky season has returned, and Nirn need heroes to help bring Tamriel’s terrors under control. Will you come to their aid and enjoy the XP boosts, collectibles, and other rewards during the 2023 Witches Festival in-game event? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Witches Festival in-game event begins Thursday, October 26 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, November 7 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: ESO Devs Talk Update 40’s Group Finder and Grand Master Crafting Station
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/75f24f34ef071fbace0b19f56124674c.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn more about two of the big new additions arriving as part of the Update 40 base-game patch.[/i]
 
Dive deep into [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64689]Update 40[/url]’s two major base-game additions with two members of the development team responsible for the upcoming Group Finder tool and Grand Master Crafting Stations. These changes, along with everything else coming in Update 40, will be free for all players!
 [h2]Group Finder Tool[/h2] 
“Group content can be difficult to break into when you don't have a social circle or are just stepping into it,” says Bobby Weir, [i]ESO[/i]’s Lead UI Designer. “We aimed to create a tool that would help bridge that gap and make it easier for folks to meet others with similar goals. This is especially true for content that requires a group but doesn't have an easy way to find one.” 
 
Arriving in Update 40, the new Group Finder tool allows you to quickly jump into [i]ESO[/i]’s various activities, from Trial or Dungeon runs, World Boss zone tours, or social events like roleplaying or fashion contests.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/67df998dd2e392b1d75921537c6677a2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/67df998dd2e392b1d75921537c6677a2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group up to take on almost any challenge[/i]
 
To ensure the Group Finder covered as many needs as possible, the team started with major content categories that typically require a group, such as Dungeons and Trials, but they did not stop there. They also included content where players generally group together, even if it’s not required. 
 
“Cyrodiil and the Imperial City are good examples of activities where there's safety in numbers, as are the game’s world bosses and world events,” explains Bobby. “We also looked at activities that may have only small gameplay benefits while grouped, but potentially strong social benefits. You may not strictly need someone to quest or explore with for example, but it can be more enjoyable with a friend. We also added a Custom category to fill in any of the gaps.”
 
Because the tool needed to cover these many different activities, the development of the Group Finder proved to be a complex process for the team. 
 
“It can be difficult to strike a balance between usability and a wide variety of functionality,” says Bobby. “With most new features, we look back at similar things we've done in the past, either for learnings or to leverage UI paradigms from it. Guild Finder was a common reference point for this feature, since a lot of components are similar. With our UI, we focus on consistency across features so that if you learn it in one place, you have a good idea of how it'll work in this new place.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group Finder helps you find like-minded adventurers[/i]
 
“The trickiest part was finding ways to fit all of the niche requirements for each content category together in a way that flowed well,” explains Bobby. “The UI design consisted of over 260 mockup screenshots!” 
 
All that hard work has translated into a new tool for players to come together and explore Tamriel in any way they choose.
 [h2]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/h2] 
Since their introduction in 2017, Attunable Crafting Stations have been highly sought-after by Tamriel’s master crafters. Perhaps even [b]too [/b]sought after—as new sets have been added to the game over time, the space required for a full set of these desirable furnishings has ballooned. Now, with Update 40, a new feature resolves the issue for good. 
 
“Grand Master Crafting Stations build on our prior Attunable Crafting Stations and help to solve a fundamental problem with the way they expand over time,” says Senior Systems Designer Cullen Lee. “If you’ve got 75+ sets for four different professions, that’s 300+ crafting stations to organize. They also eat up a huge chunk of your home’s furnishing budget, and that problem gets bigger with every zone. With Grand Master Crafting Stations, you can squish all those sets down into a single station per trade skill, so instead of 300+ stations, it’s just four, forever.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Grand Master Crafting Stations distill the essence of a craft[/i]
 
Players can feed their Attunable Crafting Stations to Grand Master Crafting Stations, giving them access to the function of any consumed station. Of course, getting your hands on these new stations won’t be easy, as they require the Unsurpassed Crafter Achievement* and significant resources.  
 
“Grand Master Crafting Stations represent the top end of crafting mastery. As such, they have a significant cost associated with them while still making up a relatively small fraction of the overall cost of building a collection of set stations,” Cullen notes. “These are something really special, and they’re not something most folks should feel pressured to spend Vouchers on early in their Master Writ career.”
 
For those who do make the journey as a Grand Master crafter, the new stations appear visually distinct from regular Attunable ones.  
 
“We wanted people with a large collection of set stations to feel proud when they looked at their station,” says Cullen. “After some iteration, we landed on a design where the station grows physically more complex at certain thresholds as you add sets. There's also a visual projection of the tradeskill symbol above the station once you’ve unlocked every set.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/45437f689ab857e601ca2d1ce5e31714.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/45437f689ab857e601ca2d1ce5e31714.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Refined designs for refined work[/i]
 
These exciting new features should be a great boon to the [i]ESO [/i]community, with one assisting in forging new bonds in battle, and the other with forging new gear with which to undertake those challenges! Which Update 40 feature are you looking forward to the most? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]Update 40 arrives free for all players on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]
 
[i]*Requiring the completion of 100 Master Writs to unlock—no easy task![/i]

notes.title: Preview the Infinite Rewards of the Infinite Archive
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8851a4426f32ac549abbdaf35fe7a4a2.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the unique in-game rewards you can earn during your expeditions into the Infinite Archive. [/i]
 
The new Infinite Archive PvE activity arrives October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. While this new arena-like experience pits you against waves of monsters and boss encounters, creating endless challenge, it also provides near-endless rewards in the form of unique currencies, item sets, and collectibles. 
 
Discover some of the in-game rewards you can earn during your expeditions into the Infinite Archive below! 
 [h2]Archival Fortunes[/h2] 
An all-new currency introduced exclusively within the Infinite Archive, Archival Fortunes can be found within Muniment Chests (appearing at the end of each Cycle, Arc, and bonus encounter) along with assorted gold, items, and soul gems. 
 
With Archival Fortunes, you can trade with the Endless Archive’s merchants to acquire a host of useful items and boons, including treasure maps, rare Antiquity leads, class set gear (more on them below) and Companion gear, and even style pages and other collectibles. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/7c61d1467ba8b272921c093677274292.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/7c61d1467ba8b272921c093677274292.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Trade Archival Fortunes for unique boons and fragments[/i]
 
Most notably, Archival Fortunes, along with the accompanying Achievement, allow you to acquire upgrades, which provide permanent buffs to your future Infinite Archive runs. These include Filer Kor’s Truesight, which gives you access to a third Vision choice, or Tentacular Motivation, which grants you a bonus to move speed while in the archive. 
 
The more times you run the Infinite Archive, the more Archival Fortunes you’ll earn. The more Fortunes you earn, the more you can empower your future Infinite Archive runs! 
 [h2]Collectibles & Achievements[/h2] 
In addition to Archival Fortunes, the Infinite Archive is home to a wealth of unique Achievements and collectibles for you to unlock. For example, while exploring the archive, you may acquire fragments for the Maligraphic Mount when completing its daily quest, or fragments of the Maligraphic Skeever pet from chests.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn these rewards in Endless Archive[/i]
 
There’s also a host of body and face markings, mementos, furnishings, titles, an emote, and fragments of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64851]Hermaeus Mora Tales of Tribute deck[/url]. Many of these can be earned via Achievements, such as the Malkhest’s Accursed Mirror memento, which is rewarded upon collecting all the Infinite Archive’s many visions, or the Inkslayer title, which requires you defeat the final evolution of Tho’at Replicanum. Others, however, can be acquired in fragments from traders in the Archive Index (the entrance hub).
 [h2]Class Item Sets[/h2] 
In addition to the above collectibles, consumables, and other boons, the Infinite Archive is also your first and only opportunity to earn an all-new type of gear: class item sets. When wearing one of the seven new sets, you can unlock powerful buffs to specific class skill lines. 
 
For example, the Basalt-Blooded Warrior set for the Dragonknight grants a buff to either your Ultimate generation (if on your front bar) or your healing and damage shields (if on your back bar) when casting an Earthen Heart ability. 
 
Another good example is the new class set for the Arcanist, called Reawakened Hierophant, which provides a unique buff for your allies when you cast Curative Runeform abilities on them, with the effect changing depending on how much Crux you have at the time. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Uncover new Class Item Sets[/i]
 
With the new class item sets, you are encouraged to find all-new ways to play certain roles for each class, creating new and unique builds. Don’t forget, these powerful new items are available ONLY while touring the myriad halls of the Infinite Archive. 
 [h2]Infinite Challenge, Infinite Rewards[/h2] 
You can unlock these rewards and more for yourself by completing the Infinite Archive’s Achievements (with 77 in total!) and opening Muniment Chests. Simply completing your first Arc and turning in the quest will grant you Experience Points, Gold, 500 Archival Fortunes, Mystery Verse scrolls, and a Skill Point! 
 
Which unique rewards will you be hunting in your expeditions into the Infinite Archive? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url], and good luck!
 
[i]The Infinite Archive is a new PvE activity free for all ESO players that arrives with the Update 40 base-game patch on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Explore the Necrom Chapter & Unlock Bonus Rewards during the Secrets of the Telvanni In-Game Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/ae4b9368b38d467f598a83f8789e07b1.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Team up with your fellow players within the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha to unlock unique rewards for all Necrom owners. [/i]
 [h2]Explore the Unknown[/h2] 
The Secrets of the Telvanni in-game event kicks off this Thursday, September 28 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, October 10 at 10AM EDT. During the celebration event, you can earn bonus rewards and collectibles as you complete daily quests and adventure within the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha zones. 
 
Work together with your fellow players to complete the new event-unique daily quest, titled “Turn the Page” to progress the community meter found on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/secretsofthetelvanni]Secrets of the Telvanni event page[/url]. By the event’s end, [b]all[/b] [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter owners can claim all unlocked rewards. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/465fa8e917cecd80c6133b75bce12ced.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/465fa8e917cecd80c6133b75bce12ced.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Complete a new daily quest[/i]
 
Every day, we’ll update the meter on the event page with the #ESOFam’s progress. The more of you who complete the quest each day, the quicker the meter will fill and unlock the rewards.
 
You can see the percentage goal for each of the three rewards below: 
   [list][*]33% Ebony Dwarven Scarab pet[/*][*]66% Nightmare Nest body and face markings[/*][*]100% Kelesan’ruhn house [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/7bccc2dcdba8feca0070c0a31a336ff2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/7bccc2dcdba8feca0070c0a31a336ff2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/d07883828451b46064ce7aed1ee404e6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/d07883828451b46064ce7aed1ee404e6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock these unique rewards (and more)[/i]
 
To get started, acquire the quest titled “The Telvanni Secret” free from the Crown Store or find Master Faras outside the city of Necrom. Don’t forget, this event and its rewards are available only for those who own the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter. 
 
In addition, when turning in the unique event daily quest, you must choose between Tralise and Yensa for one additional end-of-event reward: 
  [list][*]Oath of the Keepers music box (from Tralise)[/*][*]Apocryphal Tome furnishing (from Yensa)[/*][/list]
Throughout the event, you can vote for which reward you’d like to unlock by choosing to either favor [b]Tralise[/b] (to unlock the music box) or [b]Yensa[/b] (to unlock the furnishing) when turning in the “Turn the Page” daily quest. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/527f7eb6feaec7a56365cfba209b437f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/527f7eb6feaec7a56365cfba209b437f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/0c8b5839a15c783a7c1a4932c2de4c79.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/0c8b5839a15c783a7c1a4932c2de4c79.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Only one of these two bonus rewards can be unlocked![/i]
 
The sister with the most favor by the event’s end will determine which bonus reward is unlocked. You can check which of the two sisters is currently favored during the event on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/secretsofthetelvanni]official page[/url]. 
 [h2](Re)Discover Necrom[/h2] 
During the event period, as you adventure within the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha, you receive event reward boxes, called Secret Telvanni Coffers, each time you complete a daily quest. In addition, you have a [b]chance[/b] to receive a coffer when you complete the following activities in either of the two zones: 
       [list][*]Defeat a Delve or World Boss [/*][*]Defeat a Bastion Nymic Herald or Boss[/*][*]Defeat any monster[/*][*]Opening treasure chests, safeboxes, Psijic Portals, etc.[/*][*]Harvesting resource nodes[/*][*]Pickpocketing[/*][*]…and more! [/*][/list]
When you open a Secret Telvanni Coffer, you have a [b]chance[/b] to receive the following items:
     [list][*]Random crafting materials[/*][*]Valuables (that can be sold to vendors) or style items[/*][*]Zone set items or Companion gear (only while either Azandar or Sharp are active)[/*][*]Necrom furnishings, furnishing recipes, Treasure Maps, Survey Reports, or a motif page (Dead Keeper, Clan Dreamcarver, or Kindred’s Concord)[/*][*]A small chance for a tradeable style page of the [b]NEW[/b] Apocrypha Expedition armor style[/*][/list]
Take note, the first time you complete a Telvanni Peninsula or Apocrypha daily quest, you receive a [b]Sublime Secret Telvanni Coffer[/b] instead of a standard one. Sublime coffers can contain the same items as regular ones, but also have a [b]much[/b] [b]greater[/b] [b]chance[/b] of containing the rarer rewards (such as pages for the Apocrypha Expedition armor style).

[previewyoutube=5jOUum46eqI;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																										      							    							      								      									 
[i]Venture into the Necrom Chapter[/i]
 
Finally, in addition to the reward coffers, during the event period adventurers enjoy these additional bonuses when venturing into the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha:
   [list][*]ALL zone daily quests and Trial weekly quests have their usual non-event reward boxes doubled.[/*][*]Harvest node yields are increased. [/*][*]World, Delve, and Trial Bosses all award double loot.[/*][/list][h2]Impresario Event Goods[/h2] 
During the Secrets of the Telvanni event, you can earn [b]two event tickets per day[/b], awarded by completing [b]any[/b] daily quest in either the Telvanni Peninsula or Apocrypha zones.
 
The Impresario stocks the following items during the event period:
           [list][*]All three [b]Passion Dancer Blossom[/b] pet fragments:[/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]All three [b]Passion Dancer’s Attire [/b]costume fragments:[/*][list][*]Bolt of Indigo Cotton[/*][*]Bolt of Silver Silk[/*][*]Enchanted Sewing Kit[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the [b]NEW[/b] Apocrypha Expedition style[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Passion Dancer’s Attire costume[/i]
 
Also during the event, the Indrik Vendor Nenulaure stocks: 
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Onyx Indrik Berries[/*][*]Mossheart Indrik Berries[/*][*]Ebon-Glow Indrik Pet[/*][*]Sapling Indrik Pet[/*][/list]
Finally, the Impresario’s Assistant has the following items:
        [list][*]All three [b]Unstable Morpholith [/b]pet fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]ll three [b]Deadlands Firewalker [/b]personality fragments[/*][list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew[/*][/list][/list][h2]Wonderful Worlds Await [/h2] 
Venture into the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha zones, complete daily quests, choose your favored sister, and unlock unique rewards for ALL [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter players. Don’t forget, the only way you can participate in this event and receive its unique rewards is to first own [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i]. Are you excited to delve into the weird and wonderful worlds of the [i]Necrom [/i]Chapter? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url] and don’t forget to check the community’s progress on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/secretsofthetelvanni]event’s official page[/url]—good luck!

notes.title: Discover Infinite Adventure in the Infinite Archive
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/0fc0f8e8228a09c90561a2791f268bf8.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Delve into an all-new PvE activity with the Infinite Archive, arriving soon with the free Update 40 base-game patch.  [/i]
 [h2]Infinite Exploration[/h2] 
Prepare yourself for an all-new PvE challenge in the Infinite Archive, a unique unending dungeon-like activity. Whether you go it solo or team up with a fellow player or Companion, your success in the Infinite Archive is limited only by your preparation, skills, and determination. 
 
Of all the infinite libraries of Hermaeus Mora’s realm, the archive is one of Apocrypha’s most mysterious secrets. However, a malevolent Daedra now threatens to corrupt everything collected within its myriad halls, and Master Malkhest, its custodian, needs your help confronting this strange new foe. 
										      							    							      								      									 
The Infinite Archive arrives with the Update 40 base-game patch on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. As a base-game addition, this new PvE activity is completely free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players with no additional DLC or Chapter purchase required. You can enter the Infinite Archive via your map (from anywhere in the game) or the physical entrance found in Apocrypha (if you own the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter). Take note, while exploring the archive, ESO Plus members will enjoy a +10% boost to Archival Fortunes gains, a unique currency we share more on below! 
 [h2]Eternal Challenge[/h2] 
In the Infinite Archive, you must battle your way through dynamic stages and untold dangers, including monsters and boss encounters drawn from all over Nirn. No two expeditions into the Archive will ever be the same, as each Stage and encounter is randomly generated. Complete four Cycles (each comprised of three Stages and a boss battle) and your fifth boss battle with be against a monster unique to the Infinite Archive—thus completing an Arc! 
 
Of course, after you defeat the corruption at the archive’s heart, your expedition doesn’t end there, as you can traverse ever deeper into more Stages, Cycles, and Arcs, with the difficulty gradually increasing as you do! How deep you delve into the Infinite Archive is ultimately up to you.   
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/b6d8c9e3eefbdbb42db7cf03d5854256.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/b6d8c9e3eefbdbb42db7cf03d5854256.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Survive Infinite foes[/i]
 
While you have a limited number of deaths (or team wipes) permitted before your run ends, helping you get as far as possible are two unique boons you can collect as you progress: Verses and Visions. Verses are temporary buffs you can select at the end of each Stage that last until the end of the next Stage. Visions, on the other hand, are available at the end of each Cycle and provide a boon that lasts for your entire run. For example, Flame Aura is a Verse that envelops you in fire, damaging nearby enemies, while Crystalline Support is a Vision which explodes for frost damage and snares foes. The Visions and Verses you select as you progress can go a long way to determining how far you can go—choose wisely! 
 [h2]Infinite Rewards[/h2] 
As you battle your way deeper into the Infinite Archive and climb the leaderboards, you can loot and unlock a host of unique rewards not found in any other activity in game. This includes a broad selection of collectibles, including a mount, pet, cosmetics, and all-new Class sets. 
 
A new and unique type of item set, Class sets buff the abilities for the game’s seven unique classes, providing synergy with specific Skill Lines. You can collect these powerful new items via loot drops or the Archive’s unique vendor. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Collect powerful Class sets[/i]
 
In addition to the above items and collectibles, the Infinite Archive also rewards you with a unique currency, called Archival Fortunes. Fortunes can be traded to vendors in the Archive’s starting area for a host of consumables, Class set items, style pages, and most notably, unique buffs for your excursions. 
 
These purchasable buffs are permanently active for your future Infinite Archive runs. For example, some buffs grant additional Vision or Verse choices while others simply increase their power. The more Archival Fortunes you collect, the more you can empower further expeditions into the Archive’s ever-changing halls. 
 [h2]Unlimited Dangers [/h2] 
In the Infinite Archive, you can discover a new dynamically generated PvE challenge where no two runs are ever the same. Clear Stages, Cycles, and Arcs, and contend with an ever-growing host of dangers as you climb the leaderboards and unlock unique rewards. Are you ready to delve into this all-new activity? Don’t forget, as part of Update 40, it’s free for ALL existing [i]ESO[/i] players. Let us know if you’re ready to begin your expedition into the Infinite Archive via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url], and good luck! 
 
[i]The Infinite Archive is a new PvE activity free for all ESO players that arrives with the Update 40 base-game patch on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. [/i]

notes.title: Update 40 Brings All-New Improvements to Tamriel’s Adventurers
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/884ff6f8d40a995420d6fcfd1f78be27224025.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the key additions and changes arriving with the free Update 40 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The Update 40 base-game patch arrives October 30 on PC/Mac and November 14 on Xbox and PlayStation consoles. In addition to the [b]Infinite Archive PvE activity[/b], this update also introduces a host of new features and additions completely free for all existing [i]ESO [/i]players, no additional purchases required. 
 [h2]New Grouping Tool[/h2] 
If you enjoy teaming up with your fellow adventures, the new Group Finder allows you to create parties for almost any group activity in [i]ESO[/i]. This includes dungeons, arenas, the upcoming Infinite  Archive, trials, PvP, and more. 
 
You can choose to make a listing to find players to fill out your existing group (even when starting solo), or you can search for a group that already exists and wants to do the same content that you do. This new tool also allows you to tune the criteria your group members must meet, including these examples:
    [list][*]Player CP levels[/*][*]Whether they use in-game voice chat[/*][*]Their playstyle[/*][*]A desired group role composition [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														
 
With the new Group Finder, teaming up with your fellow adventurers should be as easy as ever! 
 [h2]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/h2] 
Update 40 also introduces Grand Master Crafting Stations, allowing you to consolidate all your home’s attuned crafting stations for a crafting skill line into a single furnishing. If your base of operations is packed full of attuned crafting stations supporting many of [i]ESO[/i]’s myriad item sets, these new consolidated stations will go a long way to improving the amount of housing slots spent without giving up any of the functionality you enjoyed previously.
										      							    							      								      									
You can acquire Grand Master Crafting Stations using Writ Vouchers from the Achievement Mediator, Faustina Curio. There will be a consolidated station for Blacksmithing, Jewelry Crafting, Clothing, and Woodworking—happy crafting!
 [h2]Assorted Additional Improvements [/h2] 
[b]Jewelry Crafting Rebalance[/b]
 
Also included in Update 40 is a rebalance of Jewelry Crafting to help bring its costs more in line with the game’s other crafting disciplines. This includes [b]completely removing[/b] Jewelry Crafting grains and [b]converting them into platings[/b]! However, to ensure that Jewelry Crafting’s costs line up with the other crafting types, we’ve also increased the total boosters needed to upgrade your jewelry, too. But don't worry, upgrading your rings and amulets in Update 40 will be easier and cheaper when compared to how it is currently. 
 
[b]Quest XP & Gold Standardization[/b]
 
With Update 40, we conducted a broad audit and standardization of the Experience Point and Gold rewards for many of the game’s quests. This includes those for quests and questlines associated with zones, main storylines, prologues, dailies, guild storylines, and many more. Now, you should receive more consistent rewards for the game’s various quests based on their complexity or length. In addition, the daily quest rewards for Mages Guild, Fighters Guild, and Undaunted have received a general boost. 
 
These are just some of the many changes and additions coming to [i]ESO [/i]with the Update 40 base-game patch. You can experience them (and the Infinite Archive) for yourself when the update arrives on the PC/Mac Public Test Server in a few days  (Monday, September 18) or when it all arrives on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Are you excited for the Update 40 base-game patch? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]Update 40 base-game patch arrives on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. [/i]

notes.title: Dungeon Delvers Rejoice! The Undaunted Celebration Event Returns
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/55b65a6e41b37e0a74eb64b62f71fb9e.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Get bonus rewards when you explore Tamriel’s four-player dungeons during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event.[/i]
 [h2]Group Up for Adventure[/h2] 
The Undaunted Celebration begins [b]Thursday, September 7 at 10AM EDT,[/b] and runs until [b]Tuesday, September 19 at 10AM EDT[/b]. Throughout this PvE in-game event, you and your intrepid band earn special rewards and Event Tickets by delving into any of [i]ESO[/i]’s group dungeons. 
 
Once the event begins, you can head into Tamriel’s dungeons via your map, the Activity Finder, or any dungeon entrance. In addition, you can acquire the introductory quest “Glory of the Undaunted” by speaking to Serileth at any Undaunted Enclave, traveling to an Impresario tent, or free from the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/73f5287c12ad2a1ac276c76934e2f4bb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/73f5287c12ad2a1ac276c76934e2f4bb.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Look for Serileth![/i]
 [h2]Undaunted Rewards[/h2] 
Tamriel’s dungeons are challenging PvE encounters, but throughout the event, big dangers can also lead to big rewards. The first time you complete a dungeon each day throughout the Undaunted Celebration, you receive a Glorious Undaunted Reward Box as an additional loot drop. You can open this unique container to receive various reward items including gold, consumables, style pages, Undaunted Keys, Opal Weapon styles, and more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/ac97ded8d7b519ef75b9a96bf30e5aa0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/ac97ded8d7b519ef75b9a96bf30e5aa0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Slay bosses for bonus rewards[/i]
 
After you have defeated your first final dungeon boss each day, keep going! Subsequent final dungeon bosses reward regular Undaunted Reward boxes, which can include the following goods:
                          [list][*]A guaranteed drop of an item set piece from the dungeon in which the box was acquired.[/*][*]A guaranteed drop of one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A random motif style page from the following:[/*][list][*]Ascendant Order[/*][*]Bloodforge[/*][*]Crimson Oath[/*][*]Dreadsail[/*][*]Fang Lair[/*][*]Huntsman[/*][*]Hazardous Alchemy[/*][*]Icereach[/*][*]Mazzatun[/*][*]Moongrave Fane[/*][*]Pyre Watch[/*][*]Silken Ring[/*][*]Scalecaller[/*][*]Silver Dawn[/*][*]Stags of Z’en[/*][*]Silver Rose[/*][*]Thorn Legion[/*][*]True Sworn[/*][*]Waking Flame[/*][/list][/list][*]1,000 Gold[/*][*]An Undaunted Key[/*][*]A Crown Repair Kit[/*][*]A Riding Lesson[/*][/list]
The daily Glorious Undaunted Reward Box can contain any of the above items, but it also has a chance to drop one of the following: 
       [list][*]Opal monster weapon styles for:[/*][list][*][b]NEW[/b] Sentinel of Rkugamz[/*][*]Velidreth[/*][*]Iceheart[/*][*]Lord Warden[/*][*]Nightflame[/*][*]Swarm Mother[/*][/list][/list]
Regular Undaunted Reward Boxes can also be earned by complete Bolgrul’s (found within any Undaunted Enclave) Daily Undaunted Delve quest. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/dacc1d3e26f379623682139c009234fc.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/dacc1d3e26f379623682139c009234fc.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn Opal style pages[/i]
 
[b]Opal Monster Mask Style Pages[/b]
 
During the event, when you defeat and loot a specific dungeon’s final boss on [b]veteran hard mode[/b], you’ll also enjoy a greater chance to loot its associated Opal Monster Mask style page. This includes the following bosses and dungeons: 
     [list][*]Sentinel of Rkugamz (Darkshade Caverns I)[/*][*]Velidreth (Cradle of Shadows)[/*][*]Iceheart (Direfrost Keep)[/*][*]Lord Warden (Imperial City Prison)[/*][*]Nightflame (Elden Hollow II)[/*][/list]
[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style Pages[/b]
 
If you own a base version of a monster shoulder style, you can also acquire the Opal version of that same style from Undaunted vendors at a cost of Undaunted Keys. Specific Opal style pages cost 50 keys, while special coffers with a random Opal Shoulder style page cost 25. 
 [h2]Impresario Stocks Up[/h2] 
During the Undaunted Celebration, you can earn [b]two Event Tickets[/b] for defeating your first final dungeon boss each day. Note that with the Update 39 base-game patch, should you fail to loot your Event Tickets for whatever reason, you will be granted subsequent opportunities to loot your daily Event Tickets from other sources. Don’t forget you can loot only two Event Tickets per day during the event, but now your chances of missing out on your daily allotment are minimized. 
 
During the event, you can spend your Event Tickets at the Impresario vendor to acquire the following items: 
          [list][*]All three [b]Passion Dancer Blossom [/b]pet fragments[/*][list][*][b]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/b][/*][*][b]Enchanted Silver Flute[/b][/*][*][b]Mystical Sheet Music[/b][/*][/list][*]The first TWO [b]Passion Dancer’s Garment [/b]costume fragments[/*][list][*][b]Bolt of Indigo Cotton[/b][/*][*][b]Bolt of Silver Silk[/b][/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the Sentinel of Rkugamz Opal weapons and Opal masks and shoulders[/*][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Passion Dancer’s Garment[/i]
 
In addition, the Impresario’s Assistant will stock:
              [list][*]All three [b]Unstable Morpholith [/b]pet fragments[/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]All three [b]Deadlands Firewalker [/b]personality fragments[/*][list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew[/*][/list][*]Finally, the Indrik vendor Nenulaure will have: [/*][list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Onyx Indrik Berries[/*][*]Mossheart Indrik Berries[/*][*]Ebon-Glow Indrik Pet[/*][*]Sapling Indrik Pet[/*][/list][/list][h2]Undaunted, Undaunted! [/h2] 
Who knows no fear of beast or blade? Undaunted! Delve into Tamriel’s dungeons, defeat final bosses, and collect shiny event-specific rewards during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event. Is your party ready to venture forth into some of [i]ESO[/i]’s toughest PvE content? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Undaunted Celebration begins Thursday, September 7 from 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, September 19 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Update 39 Base-Game Patch Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2e966846125f5b8145838f4247202990.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the host of additions and improvements arriving with the free Update 39 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The Update 39 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac and introduces a series of long-awaited improvements and additions to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], completely free of charge for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players. If you’re a console player, don’t worry: Update 39 arrives September 5 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, too! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2aae9b31906a3c66e2128b4d1cf5b7d1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2aae9b31906a3c66e2128b4d1cf5b7d1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Update 39 Base Game Improvements[/i]
 
As a base-game patch, Update 39 includes a wide array of bug fixes, but also features a series of long-awaited improvements to your in-game experience. 
 
[b]Quest & Content Improvements for New Players[/b]
 
If you’re a new player feeling overwhelmed when first entering Tamriel, you can enjoy a series of changes that [b]reduce the volume and frequency of quests [/b]offered to your low-level characters. This includes quests from NPCs for the main story, Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, Battlegrounds, Undaunted, and others. Instead, these quests are now delivered more gradually as you level up, helping your journal stay in a manageable state for longer!
 
Tamriel’s navigator NPCs that can transport your characters between destinations have also received some improvements with this update. Now, these navigators [b]indicate whether they can transport you to a location for one of your tracked quests[/b] (active or inactive.) When exploring, you now see the “door” pin above relevant navigator NPCs, indicating that they can help you in your journey. In addition, appropriate dialog lines with those same NPCs have similar pins, ensuring you make the right choice and go where you need to go—happy travels! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/71d1ea150e994d1d9a33e1959bbe5942.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/71d1ea150e994d1d9a33e1959bbe5942.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Taking your first steps into Tamriel is daunting[/i]
 
[b]Inventory Management Improvements[/b]
 
If you’re struggling with an overburdened Inventory, Update 39 also includes changes to key item types to help improve management and reduce clutter. Some (but not all) similar Crown Store items that came from separate sources (such as Tri-Restoration Potions) can now all be [b]stacked together using the “Stack All Items” option[/b]. Also, this patch adds [b]better communication regarding which items in your Inventory can or cannot be sold[/b], helping you identify and clear out unwanted items and make a little gold in the process!
 
[b]PvP Additions & New Rewards [/b]
 
This update adds new rewards for Tamriel’s PvP victors in the form of [b]three new monster mask sets[/b]: Jerall Mountains Warchief, Nibenay Bay Battlereeve, and Colovian Highlands General. Each grants unique and powerful boons, and you can trade Alliance Points for these new masks with Cyrodiil Elite Gear Vendors within the Eastern Elsweyr Gate, Southern High Rock Gate, and Northern Morrowind Gate. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Chase down new PvP rewards[/i]
 
In addition, you can now claim [b]new Unfeathered Battle Body and Face Markings[/b] from Gladiator’s Rucksacks (earned by completing Cyrodiil Conquest Mission Board daily quests), and the Imperial City’s hapless [b]Treasure Scamps now[/b] [b]drop even better loot [/b]when hunted down. In particular, Cunning Scamps drop more Tel Var Stones and Trove Scamps drop tradable pieces of Imperial City gear sets. 
 
Finally, while battling in Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds, you can now see [b]new death notifications[/b] that help you plan your next move (or avoid that incoming zerg!).
 
[b]Home Editor Improvements[/b]
 
With Update 39, this patch gives you the ability to [b]place a furnishing directly from your Inventory or Collectibles UI [/b]while in your home. You can now find a “Place” option when viewing the specific furnishings. In addition, you can [b]preview Crown Store furnishings[/b] in your home before you buy, helping you determine how a new item might look when placed. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/1c12c700d99b7f15c2d3bffeba283673.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/1c12c700d99b7f15c2d3bffeba283673.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Place furnishings from Inventory and Collectibles[/i]
 
Of course, these are just some of the changes and additions that arrive with Update 39. To see a complete list of everything this new base-game patch introduces to [i]ESO[/i], visit our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/641025/pc-mac-patch-notes-v9-1-5-update-39]Patch Notes forum[/url].
										      							    							      								      				
																																			[h1][url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/641025/pc-mac-patch-notes-v9-1-5-update-39]Patch Notes[/url][/h1]																																	
				      								      									
[h2]Getting Started in Update 39[/h2]
As a base-game update, your version of [i]ESO[/i] automatically updates on PC/Mac via the [i]ESO [/i]Launcher. Note that to run [i]ESO[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url]. Don’t forget, Update 39 arrives on consoles September 5.

As mentioned above, this is a free base-game update for all [i]ESO[/i] players. Anybody with access to the game can download and enjoy these new additions and changes. There is no previous purchase required (aside from the game itself).
[h2]Tamriel Evolves[/h2]
With the free Update 39 base-game patch, you can enjoy the above improvements and more to help you get the most out of your time in Tamriel. Which of the above changes and additions are you most excited to experience? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Update 39 base-game patch is now live PC/Mac and arrives September 5 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Begin Your Legend with the QuakeCon 2023 Free Play Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/9bfe3c6c4765defbfd750344acd74690.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Take your first steps into Tamriel and play ESO for free during QuakeCon 2023! [/i]
 [h2]Tamriel Unlimited[/h2] 
The QuakeCon 2023 Free Play Event is now live and continues until Monday, August 21, 2023. During the free play period, you can begin your adventures and experience a world without limit at no cost on PC/Mac (The Elder Scrolls Online Store), Xbox consoles, and PlayStation consoles. 
	
									      							    							      								      																																							[h1][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Play Free[/url]																																			      							    							      								      									 
[/h1]


To get started, simply visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Free Play page[/url] and select your platform. The QuakeCon 2023 Free Play Event gets you access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, which includes four of the game’s classes (Sorcerer, Nightblade, Templar, and Dragonknight), 24 zones to explore and quest in, and access to [i]ESO[/i]’s PvP game modes such as the Battlegrounds and the Alliance War. In addition, you will also gain access to the [i]Necrom[/i] Prologue, a free quest that introduces the Shadow Over Morrowind saga and leads directly into the game’s latest Chapter. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/f790db622efd085ce47c74bed1dc4539.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/f790db622efd085ce47c74bed1dc4539.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Begin your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure[/i]
 
If you’ve played in previous free play events, you can continue your adventures with no loss to progression. All brand-new [i]ESO[/i] accounts will also receive 500 crowns to spend in the in-game Crown Store. Even better, from August 10 until August 15, all of Tamriel’s adventures will enjoy a 100% boost to XP gains—go level up! 
 
Once the QuakeCon Free Play Event has concluded on August 21, you can purchase the game via our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url] to pick up right where you left off! Finally, both the [i]ESO[/i] base game and the new [i]Necrom [/i]Chapter are currently on sale for a limited time. Check [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64497]this announcement blog[/url] for more information, including key dates and platforms. 
 [h2]Free For All[/h2] 
Discover a world without limits for free during QuakeCon 2023 and venture into the ever-growing world of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] at no cost. Are you excited to take your first steps into Tamriel’s Second Era and begin your legend? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
