notes.title: Work Hard to Earn Bonus Rewards During the Zeal of Zenithar In-Game Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/b09b0273744ac0e25bd1fdbcfa75bb88.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]The God of Commerce ensures hard work pays off for the laborers of Tamriel during the Zeal of Zenithar in-game event. [/i]
 [h2]Honest Labor Rewarded[/h2] 
The Zeal of Zenithar in-game event returns on July 27 at 10AM EDT, and it runs until August 8 at 10AM EDT. To get started, pick up the introductory quest "The Unrefusable Offer" from Amminus Varo at the Belkarth festival grounds or acquire the free quest starter from the Crown Store. Having trouble locating Belkarth? Don’t worry; just head over to the nearest Impresario tent and take the nearby portal. Upon finishing the intro quest, you unlock the daily quest, "Honest Toil."
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/0c03398b136d5db5ad007f789dd8f4c2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/0c03398b136d5db5ad007f789dd8f4c2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find Amminus Vario to begin[/i]
 
During the event, the first time you complete the daily quest each day, you receive a Zenithar’s Sublime Parcel box as a bonus reward. Each subsequent completion of the Honest Toil quest during that same day rewards you with a Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel box. 
 
In addition, you can earn Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel boxes by participating in the following activities:
      [list][*]Completing the introductory quest “The Unrefusable Offer”[/*][*]Completing any Master Writ, per discipline, per account, each day[/*][list][*]Subsequent Master Writs of the same discipline won’t provide further boxes until the daily reset[/*][/list][*]First daily Crafting Writ, per account, completed each day [/*][*]Each time you defeat a world boss while grouped with a player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*][*]Each time you complete a world event while grouped with a player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*][/list]
You also have a [b]chance[/b] to earn a Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel box when conquering each round of a group-based arena challenge while teamed up with a player who is a member of at least one of your guilds. Additionally, the final round’s reward chest contains a guaranteed parcel.
 
Alternatively, if you prefer to earn your rewards through less-than-honest means, you may discover parcels scattered across Tamriel by pickpocketing citizens and looting strongboxes or thieves troves. Why not let others do all the hard work for you? 
 
Within either parcel box (Sublime or Delightful), there is a chance to receive the following rewards:
          [list][*]A tradeable outfit style page for the new Kwama Miner’s Kit outfit style armor[/*][*]A tradeable outfit style page for the new Ashen Militia weapon style[/*][*]Durable crafting materials, provisioning ingredients, alchemy reagents, runestones, or a motif style item[/*][*]Crafting boosters[/*][list][*]Chance to drop a gold-tier booster or a research time scroll[/*][/list][*]Furnishing or provisioning recipes[/*][*]Repair kits, siege repair kits, or a small chance for an Impresario Group Repair Kit[/*][*]Treasure Maps, Survey Reports, Imperial City vault keys, Companion gear, or a random currency pouch[/*][list][*]The random currency pouch can contain either gold or Tel Var stones; there is an [i]extremely [/i]small chance that you discover a jackpot that allots 100,000 of the associated currency! [/*][list][*]The earnings from this pouch, jackpot or otherwise, are unaffected by any form of currency boosts[/*][/list][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/1622c2c8aa33e3da65ed7b770e96d6bd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/1622c2c8aa33e3da65ed7b770e96d6bd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn new outfit and weapon styles[/i]
 
Both boxes can contain these goodies, but the Sublime Parcel boxes provide a higher chance to contain the more valuable rewards.
 [h2]Global Event Modifiers[/h2] 
These boxes won’t be the only bonus rewards you can enjoy during the Zeal of Zenithar event. Throughout the duration, all players benefit from the following modified global in-game effects:
       [list][*]Wayshrine travel costs are reduced by 75%[/*][*]Repair costs on vendors are reduced by 50%[/*][*]Crafting inspiration gain from all sources is increased by 100%[/*][*]Vendor prices across Tamriel are reduced by 10%[/*][list][*]These include:[/*][list][*]Vendors that sell items for gold, AP, or Tel Var stones, including the Golden Vendor[/*][*]Houses purchasable for gold[/*][/list][/list][/list][h2]Event Tickets & the Impresario [/h2] 
If you participate in the Zeal of Zenithar event, you also receive three Event Tickets the first time you complete the Honest Toil quest each day. By the end of the event, you can collect a whopping 39 tickets! But don’t forget: 12 Event Tickets is the maximum number you can carry at any one time. If you happen to earn more while already at the cap, Zenithar will penalize you for your hoarding by not rewarding any tickets! 
 
After you’ve gathered enough Event Tickets, head on over to the Impresario’s tent and exchange them for any of the following rewards:
          [list][*]All three [b]Passion Dancer Blossom [/b]pet fragments [/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]First [b]Passion Dancer Garment[/b] costume fragment [/*][list][*]Bolt of Indigo Cotton[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the Kwama Miner’s Kit outfit style armor [/*][*]Bound style pages for the Ashen Militia weapon style[/*][*]Group Repair Kits [/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/72f6c741dec03864b7ae6048f5261b1f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn the first fragment for the Passion Dancer Garment[/i]
 
Additionally, during the event, the Impresario’s Assistant Philius Dormier offers the following goodies:
        [list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments [/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint[/*][*]Rune-Etched Striker[/*][*]Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]All three Deadlands Firewalker personality fragments [/*][list][*]Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew[/*][*]Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew[/*][/list][/list]
Last but certainly not least, the Indrik vendor Nenulaure’s shop is stocked with the following items: 
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Onyx Indrik Berries[/*][*]Mossheart Indrik Berries[/*][*]Ebon-Glow Indrik pet[/*][*]Sapling Indrik pet[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/06/b764115589c925a07aa225b167f62102.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/06/b764115589c925a07aa225b167f62102.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor[/i]
 [h2]Zenithar’s Blessing to You![/h2] 
The assortment of collectibles you can amass during the Zeal of Zenithar in-game event is proof that the harder the work, the greater the rewards. Ready to apply some elbow grease and receive compensation in the form of bonus goods? Let us know if you’re planning to make Zenithar proud via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Zeal of Zenithar in-game event begins July 27 at 10:00AM EDT, and it runs until Tuesday, August 8 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Level Up Your Arcanist to Unlock a Free In-Game Reward Bundle
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/a77d4b3195aa2f304d4b9ecbd9875479.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Unleash the power of Necrom’s new class and reach level 10 during the Ascent of the Arcanist promotion to unlock a slew of magical rewards![/i]
 
Introduced with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i], the Arcanist class allows Tamriel’s adventurers to wield [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63997]the eldritch energies[/url] of Hermaeus Mora’s realm. To celebrate this all-new way to play and encourage the [i]ESO[/i] community to create their very own Arcanist character, we have created a unique bundle as a free in-game reward for those delving into the new class.
 
The Ascent of the Arcanist promotion is now live until [b]Friday, July 28 at 10AM EDT[/b]. During this limited-time celebration, you can claim the free Ascent of the Arcanist bundle from the in-game Crown Store by having a level 10 or higher Arcanist character (thus unlocking the prerequisite achievement, titled “Neophyte Researcher”). If you’ve already reached level 10 and unlocked the achievement, don’t worry, you can immediately claim the rewards! 
 
The Ascent of the Arcanist bundle includes the following mystical items:

notes.title: Update 39 Preview—Base Game Improvements and Additions
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/5765884d53498ed201a23cdcb4dc84ed.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the key changes and additions coming with the Update 39 free base-game patch. [/i]
 
During the [i]ESO [/i]Global Reveal back in January, we announced that we were taking the time during this development cycle to focus on polishing in-game systems and addressing some of the community’s longstanding requests. We are happy to announce that the first round of these changes, in addition to a host of various bug fixes, will be arriving August 21 on PC/Mac and September 5 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles in the Update 39 base-game patch. As a base-game update, Update 39 is free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players, with no additional purchase required. Discover some of the changes coming with Update 39 below!
 [h2]General Improvements[/h2] 
[b]Quest & Content Improvements for New Players[/b]
 
To help new players who are feeling overwhelmed upon first entering Tamriel, the team has implemented a host of changes designed to reduce the volume and frequency of quest choices presented to players in early content. Specifically, this update changes when certain quest bestowers appear and how fervent they are in chasing you down. This includes quests bestowers for the main story, Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, Battlegrounds, Undaunted, and other questlines. With Update 39, as you level up and explore, these quests will more gradually become available for you to pick up—keeping that journal in a more manageable state! 
 
[b]Navigator Quest Pins[/b]
 
This update also introduces a new system that utilizes Tamriel’s navigators: NPCs that transport players between critical destinations for free. Tracked quests (active or inactive) will now indicate whether these navigators can take you where you need to go. When approaching a navigator NPC, you’ll see a “door” pin indicating that they can help you in your journey. When conversing with these NPCs, the appropriate dialog line will also have the same pin next to it, ensuring you’re sent to the right location to continue your quest. 
 
[b]New[/b] [b]Endeavor Activity Types[/b]
 
Update 39 also includes the addition of new types of weekly and daily Endeavors, giving you a greater variety of ways to earn your Seals of Endeavor. Examples include Endeavors that ask you to complete Tales of Tribute matches; capture Farms, Keeps, or Towns in Cyrodiil; and complete Trials with guildmates. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/d395155906ddeec4b35afdfbbcc2a688.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/d395155906ddeec4b35afdfbbcc2a688.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn more Seals of Endeavors in Cyrodiil[/i]
 
[b]Item Management Improvements[/b]
 
In addition, this patch features changes that help you better understand and manage your inventory’s various items. With Update 39, certain Crown Store items that appear the same but come from different sources will all stack together, freeing up valuable inventory space. Additionally, to help clear up what items can and cannot be sold, unsellable items will now be listed as worth zero gold in your inventory. Previous zero gold items that [b]can now[/b] be sold will be valued at one gold. This includes items such as low-level gear, some crafting materials, low-level provisions, lockpicks, and tutorial items.
 [h2]PvP Additions[/h2] 
[b]PvP Death Notifications[/b]
 
With Update 39, a new death notification system has been added during your PvP clashes in Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds. This new chat feature alerts you as to who defeated whom, tells you around what area the death occurred, and displays the Alliance ranks of those in the battle. Furthermore, you can find more information on the “Crossed Swords” map icons, showing who’s currently winning a specific battle in Cyrodiil or the Imperial City.
 
[b]New PvP Rewards[/b]
 
Update 39 also introduces various new items for players to spend their Alliance Points on including three Cyrodiil-based Monster Masks: Jerall Mountains Warchief, Nibenay Bay Battlereeve, and Colovian Highlands General. These new Monster Masks each provide unique boons to Tamriel’s PvP warriors. For example, the Nibenay Bay Battlereeve mask automatically generates a damage shield for you whenever you are forcefully moved via a pull, knockback, or teleport ability. You can acquire these new Monster Masks from Cyrodiil Elite Gear Vendors located at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate, Southern High Rock Gate and Northern Morrowind Gate by trading Alliance Points.
 
Additionally, you can adorn yourself with the new Unfeathered Battle Body and Face Markings, revealing your warrior spirit. You can obtain these Markings from Gladiator's Rucksacks after completing Cyrodiil Conquest Mission Board daily quests.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn new Monster Masks for your Scamp hunts![/i]
 
[b]Treasure Scamp Drop Boosts[/b]
 
The Imperial City’s Treasure Scamps have also received a buff* in Update 39 to the number of rewards they drop when defeated. Cunning Scamps will now drop a much greater quantity of Tel Var Stones, and Trove Scamps will now drop a tradable piece of Imperial City Gear. Even more reasons to chase the hapless Daedra down should you see them—happy hunting!
 [h2]Home Editor Improvements[/h2] 
[b]Preview Crown Furnishings[/b]
 
For Housing aficionados, Update 39 includes the ability to preview the placement of Crown Furnishings (furnishings you buy from the in-game Crown Store) before making a purchase. This allows you to see exactly how a furnishing might fit into your home before committing. 
 
[b]Inventory Furnishing Placement[/b]
 
This new update also introduces the ability to place furnishings directly from your Inventory and Collectibles UI while in your home. To do so, simply find the item in your Inventory or Collectibles UI, select it, and select the “Place” option—easy!
 
These are just some highlights from the upcoming base-game patch. If you’d like to see the complete list of fixes, improvements, and additions, check out the patch notes on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]official forums here[/url] and be sure to keep an eye out more regarding Update 39 in the near future. 
 
You can try out the update for yourself right now by logging into our [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/#en/answer/20663]PC/Mac Public Test Server[/url]. Be sure to let us know what you think and don’t forget that this update is completely free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players. Are you looking forward to Update 39? Let us know what you’re most excited for via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]*Although the scamps themselves might not see it that way![/i]

										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/f466844640f747a631635cddcf75bbb6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/f466844640f747a631635cddcf75bbb6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A mystery collection of Wild Hunt-related items![/i]
 
Wild Hunt Crate will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 20 to August 3, 2023, at 10AM EDT.


 
 [h2]Events [/h2] 
[b]Currency[/b]
 
[b]Event Tickets[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/a04731cdadc2a849e73ab60299d1fa3d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/a04731cdadc2a849e73ab60299d1fa3d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i] A ticket used to purchase rare goods from The Impresario, Event Merchant. Curious as to what goods? Well, chat with her to see what she has to offer![/i]
 
Single Event Tickets will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time during Zeal of Zenithar. Stay tuned for event details! Event Tickets are also giftable to other players from within the Crown Store.

 
 [h2]Furniture [/h2] 
[b]Apocryphal Shifting Sculpture[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/50a5d609e5d7fdba547e90cbfaea4454.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/50a5d609e5d7fdba547e90cbfaea4454.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Watch mesmerized as this sculpture from Apocrypha shifts and morphs languidly. Perfect for those times when you just need to stare at something while organizing your thoughts.[/i]
 
The Apocryphal Shifting Sculpture will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 13 to July 27, 2023, at 10AM EDT.


 
[b]Sithis, The Dread Father[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/942ddfb0c8f3a3812617b65863ec44c7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/942ddfb0c8f3a3812617b65863ec44c7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hail to Sithis, blood's drop on blade's edge. Before you, nothing. Behind you, the Void. Catalyst, agitator, many-fanged maw.[/i]
 
The Sithis, The Dread Father statue will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 13 to July 27, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.

 
[b]Music Box, Deeproot Dirge[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/56a49484a8288db0ab37055049a74d27.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/56a49484a8288db0ab37055049a74d27.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the meditative "Deeproot" composition.[/i]
 
The Music Box, Deeproot Dirge will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 24 to July 27, 2023, at 10AM EDT.

 
[b]Music Box, Enigmas of the Elder Way[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/567e772ca4d7cf85fa7aa8deba15af29.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/567e772ca4d7cf85fa7aa8deba15af29.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the mesmerizing "Enigmas of the Elder Way" composition.[/i]
 
The Music Box, Enigmas of the Elder Way will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 27 to August 3, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.


 
[b]Statue, Ancestor-King Auri-El[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4345c39c3c91b9bc822c20ea220a86a8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4345c39c3c91b9bc822c20ea220a86a8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Ayleid artist-enchanters captured the might of the king of the Aldmer and his avian companion in this commanding statue! Light up this focal piece with the eagle's golden glow, Auri-El's lambent eyes, scintillating sunbeams, or a combination of these.[/i]
 
The Statue, Ancestor-King Auri-El will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 27 to August 3, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Houses[/h2] 
[b]The Erstwhile Sanctuary[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/45cf9db8b8ae12e0ca7efc05f375add5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/45cf9db8b8ae12e0ca7efc05f375add5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Built into the foundations of Kvatch itself, this ancient complex was abandoned by the Dark Brotherhood after a subterranean collapse tumbled one wall of the Speaker's bedchamber into a massive natural cavern.[/i]
 
The Erstwhile Sanctuary will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 13 to July 27, 2023, at 10AM EDT. Furnished and unfurnished versions will be available.



 
[b]Grand Psijic Villa[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/b20b633a9ebd916de0e6aa2eb08aa517.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/b20b633a9ebd916de0e6aa2eb08aa517.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]When Artaeum was "removed" from Tamriel, a few neighboring isles went with it, including the site of the Grand Psijic Villa, a monumental estate with magnificent views of the south coast of the main island.[/i]
 
Grand Psijic Villa will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 27 to August 10, 2023, at 10AM EDT. Furnished and unfurnished versions will be available.



 [h2]Houseguests[/h2] 
[b]Erilthel[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/aeb8aa86a67d7e3eefe4995ba7683a3e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/aeb8aa86a67d7e3eefe4995ba7683a3e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Erilthel's quest to become Lady Twilight, Tamriel's greatest thief, brought her to your door until her teacher, Seeks-the-Dark, finds her again. After adding Erilthel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.[/i]
 
Erilthel will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 13 to July 20, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Relic-Apprentice Marafar[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/c08db64b5b577d30d8e4e23ac2a83f32.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/c08db64b5b577d30d8e4e23ac2a83f32.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]With her initial Daedric studies finished, Marafar hopes to uncover more secrets as she assists Artaeum's Relicmaster. Will you host her efforts? After adding Marafar to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.[/i]
 
Relic-Apprentice Marafar will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 27 to August 3, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Assistants[/h2] 
[b]Hoarfrost, Takubar Trader[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/a40c6af47f45ff561d6d0283a9a91689.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/a40c6af47f45ff561d6d0283a9a91689.jpg[/img]																[/url]

Hoarfrost, Takubar Trader will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms starting July 6, 2023, at 10AM EDT.

 
[b]Pyroclast, Infernace Conservator[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/0711fbc84013303de3b8215bc1c636a3.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/0711fbc84013303de3b8215bc1c636a3.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hailing from the pocket realm of Infernace, Pyroclast will holdfast your items (or the items of your groupmates) in the fiery pits of Oblivion. Minor scorching may occur.[/i]
 
Pyroclast, Infernace Conservator[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms starting July 6, 2023, at 10AM EDT.



 [h2]Mounts[/h2] 
[b]Black Drake Howler[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/5816435e344f02e8215d0327f0679057.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/5816435e344f02e8215d0327f0679057.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]These wolves were among the first creatures to storm Evermore when the Reachmen's attack broke through the city's walls. Each wolf's unique markings display their lineage with some incorporating designs from Durcorach's beloved howler herself.[/i]
 
The Black Drake Howler will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 6 to July 13, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Manelord Nightmare Senche[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/cb9d290e464722ecec30e25b1c6cca15.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/cb9d290e464722ecec30e25b1c6cca15.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]King of the Nightmare Pride, this night-black senche-tiger has burning paws and flames hissing from its face; rumor says Mehrunes Dagon is responsible.[/i]
 
The Manelord Nightmare Senche[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 13 to July 20, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Hivethief Vvardvark[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/84d9d57bda8a2010b67082383ef02e10.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/84d9d57bda8a2010b67082383ef02e10.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]"Look at that tongue! You can thank Spellwright Domavas for these bug-eating beauties, expanding on Magister Varkenel's work. I hear he first tried to give them feathers, failed, then came up with this gorgeous steed."—Cidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster[/i]
 
The Hivethief Vvardvark mount[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 27 to August 3, 2023, at 10AM EDT.


 
[b]Queen's Claw Senche-raht[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/13a8fcdf7b9bf25029522fd5a0cab288.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/13a8fcdf7b9bf25029522fd5a0cab288.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A scholar studying Mnemoli the Blue Star as well as a Whispering Claw warrior, this Senche-raht serves Queen Khamira with both brain and brawn. He volunteered to travel with you, lending you speed and steady companionship.[/i]
 
The Queen's Claw Senche-raht[b] [/b]mount[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 31 to August 7, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Emotes[/h2] 
[b]Soul Gem, Parchment, Clippers[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/81537160d504e5a2eed1dfbde90cedcb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/81537160d504e5a2eed1dfbde90cedcb.jpg[/img]																[/url]

[i] [/i]
 [h2]Pets[/h2] 
[b]Silver Daenian Werewolf Tracker[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4479871938c11cf82dbf095d1cbd49e5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4479871938c11cf82dbf095d1cbd49e5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The werewolf hunters of the Silver Dawn rely on the courage and keen noses of these great High Rock hounds to help them track Tamriel's lycanthropes to their lairs. [/i]
 
Silver Daenian Werewolf Tracker will be[b] [/b]available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 6 to July 10, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Sep Adder[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/9bd64ff32803753d108e727a9875ebba.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/9bd64ff32803753d108e727a9875ebba.jpg[/img]																[/url]

The Sep Adder pet will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from July 10 to July 13, 2023, at 10AM EDT. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.


There is no shortage of incredible items arriving in the Crown Store this month, including some truly outlandish mounts and pets, two breathtaking households, and more. Be sure to show off these new collectibles while exploring the recently released Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom!

notes.title: Strike Down Your Rivals & Reap the Rewards During Whitestrake’s Mayhem
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/3ddbcb4bf46435b5155c21679956864a.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Engage in glorious combat throughout Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event and earn in-game rewards, XP, and more![/i]
 [h2]Mayhem Returns to Tamriel[/h2] 
The counterattack has begun! The Whitestrake’s Mayhem makes its triumphant return this Thursday, June 29 at 10AM EDT, and runs until July 11 at 10AM EDT. During this in-game event, you can enjoy significant boosts to both Alliance Point and Experience Point gains and earn exciting in-game rewards by competing in [i]ESO[/i]’s various[i] [/i]PvP modes.
 
Ready to battle against your fellow players? Follow these steps below:
  [olist][*]Visit the in-game Crown Store to acquire the “Details on the Whitestrake’s Mayhem" quest[/*][*]Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities[/*][/olist][list][*]You are not required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off the event[/*][/list][*]Find the NPC named “Predicant Maera" and continue the quest[/*][list][*]If you already completed the quest in a previous year, you won't need to do it again[/*][/list][*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Boon Box[/*][*]Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:[/*][list][*]Alliance Points gained[/*][*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/3a8b4e07dce891197c96d10eff00516d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/3a8b4e07dce891197c96d10eff00516d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle to claim Cyrodiil[/i]
 
Feel free to use the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity throughout the duration of Whitestrake’s Mayhem. Don’t worry if you happen to lose the scroll or it is destroyed. You can always return to Predicant Maera to obtain another or use the Basin of the Gore Virtuous. Keep in mind that the Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity is an inventory item, [b]not[/b] a memento.
 [h2]Take What’s Yours[/h2] 
But what is competition without the opportunity to collect some awesome loot? During the event, you can acquire the following in-game rewards. 
 
[b]NEW—Sancre Tor Sentry Armor Style[/b]
 
Stand steadfast against any threat you face in the stoic Sancre Tor Sentry armor, dropped by Imperial City sweepers and bosses.
 
[b]NEW—Sancre Tor Sentry Weapon Style[/b]
 
Protect the innocent wielding ancient Sancre Tor Sentry weaponry, found within Pelinal Boon Boxes.
 
[b]Gloamsedge Armor Style[/b]
 
Blend into the shadows as you stalk your prey in the Gloamsedge armor, dropped by Imperial City sweepers and bosses.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4389ffc83f4f14725b702aa7d82cbdc4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/4389ffc83f4f14725b702aa7d82cbdc4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Fight with new arms and armor[/i]
 
[b]Pelinal’s Boon Boxes[/b]
 
Throughout your battles across Cyrodiil, Battlegrounds, and the Imperial City, you can obtain Pelinal’s Boon Boxes by participating in following activities:
     [list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests[/*][/list]
Whenever you open a Pelinal’s Boon Box, you have the chance to receive the following items:
 [list][*]Parcel      of Tel Var Stones [/*]  [*]Cyrodiil repair kit [/*]  [*]Soul Gems [/*]  [*]A guaranteed drop of [b]ONE[/b] of the      following:[/*]  [list][*]Alchemy       ingredients [/*]   [*]A style item for your Alliance's armor style[/*]   [*]A style item for Akaviri armor style [/*]   [*]A Daedric siege weapon [/*]   [*]A Whitestrake's Mayhem book furnishing[/*]   [*]A Forward Camp for your Alliance [/*]   [*]A chapter of your Alliance's armor motif [/*]   [list][*]There is a small chance that the full book may drop        instead of a single chapter[/*]   [/list][*]A Prismatic Runestone[/*]   [*]A chapter for the Akaviri armor motif[/*]   [list][*]There is a small chance that the full book may drop        instead of a single chapter[/*]   [/list][*]Fragment       of the Alliance Breton Terrier pet [/*]   [list][*]There        is a small chance you discover two fragments instead of only one[/*]   [/list][/list][*]Transmute Geode[/*]  [*]Sancre Tor Sentry Weapon Style Page[/*]  [list][*]There is a small chance that a Tools of Domination style       page may drop if you already own the Sancre Tor Sentry Weapon style page[/*]  [/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/5fab3e5bafd807fec26e1bb860a0acaa.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/5fab3e5bafd807fec26e1bb860a0acaa.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Gather your  forces[/i]
  
[b]Bonus Resources & The Golden[/b]
  
Any players engaging with harvesting nodes during the event may notice they drop extra resources, and all Tel Var stone earnings are increased by 100% from all non-player sources. Additionally, the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi “The  Golden” Aba-daro offers an updated stock that contains jewelry from Cyrodiil’s  item sets, in CP160 Legendary quality. Players can purchase necklaces during  the first weekend of the Whitestrake’s Mayhem and rings from the same set during  the second. 
  
Please be aware that Aba-daro is not selling Monster Masks  during the event and all purchases in her shop must be made with Alliance  Points. She will [b]not[/b] accept gold.
  [h2]Event Tickets & Rewards[/h2]  
During Whitestrake’s Mayhem, you can earn up to three Event  Tickets each day by completing two different PvP activities:
      [list][*]Two Event Tickets from the first Cyrodiil or Battleground daily repeatable  quest [/*][list][*]These can include Bounty Board quests, a Town Daily, the Conquest  Board quests, or the daily Battleground quest[/*][/list][*]One Event Ticket from a District daily quest within the Imperial  City[/*][/list]
That’s a whopping total of [b]39[/b] Event Tickets you can acquire  by the end of the event! Don’t forget that you can hold up to a maximum of 12  Event Tickets only, so if you happen to earn more while already at the cap, they  will be lost!
  
Once you’ve obtained a hefty number of tickets, travel to  the Impresario merchant to get your hands on some of her exclusive event offers:

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom & Update 38 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/b0cd0751b407e6cab9fb794b55f8ba71.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Uncover the Shadow Over Morrowind with The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom and the Update 38 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
This new Chapter in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] saga introduces two new zones to explore, a brand-new class to master, and a sinister plot to uncover that threatens reality itself. If you play on consoles, don’t worry. You can dive into [i]Necrom[/i] on Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on June 20. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=AI9J2INfbEE;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 
This release also includes the free Update 38 base-game patch, introducing new fixes, additions, balance changes, and improvements. 
 [h2]Necrom Chapter[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i], you can delve deeper into the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, explore the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha zones, and master an all-new class, the Arcanist. [i]Necrom[/i] continues the story that began with March’s [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, but you do not need to have completed the previous DLC to experience everything this Chapter has to offer. 
 
[b]Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha[/b]
 
Home to the cunning mages of House Telvanni and the city of Necrom, the Telvanni Peninsula’s towering mushroom forests might feel familiar to those who have ventured to other parts of Morrowind. However, in addition to the city itself, this new zone contains a host of unique encounters for you to discover in your explorations, including new side quests, world bosses, delves, public dungeons, and more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom city[/i]
 
[i]Necrom[/i] also allows you to explore Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Apocrypha. While this mysterious part of Oblivion contains knowledge untold, be warned—many mortals have lost their souls while navigating its endless libraries. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=Q4zewvOHlL4;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
In this Chapter, you can explore an all-new part of Aprocypha called Chroma Incognito, a region comprised of fates that never came to pass. This new area is unlike anything you have experienced before, including myriad hazards and secrets for you to discover. Learn more about [i]Necrom[/i]’s two zones [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64097]in this preview[/url]. 
 
[b]The Arcanist[/b]
 
Helping you tackle these new worlds is the all-new Arcanist class. The first new class added to [i]ESO[/i] since the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter’s Necromancer in 2019, the Arcanist wields the forbidden powers of Apocrypha to deal damage, absorb incoming blows, and heal yourself or your allies. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=5Bxo6SA1GGg;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
In addition to three skill lines that allow the class to perform any role, the Arcanist introduces a new combat mechanic: Crux. When activating specific Arcanist abilities, you generate Crux, which you can then spend to empower other abilities. How you utilize this unique resource in combat can have a major impact on your effectiveness as an Arcanist. You can read more about the Arcanist class [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64201]in this preview[/url]—use these new powers wisely! 
 
[b]Group Challenges[/b]
 
If you’re looking for a challenge, [i]Necrom[/i] also introduces new group activities. [b]Sanity’s Edge[/b] is a 12-player trial which tasks you and your allies with defending the fractured mind of a stricken member of the Mages Guild. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/d05768762d119b2bf235744d10e1f7fd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/d05768762d119b2bf235744d10e1f7fd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Sanity’s Edge trial[/i]
 
In addition,[b] Bastion Nymic[/b] is a new kind of world event where groups of up to four can help the Prince of Fate reclaim one of his lost fortresses from mysterious invaders. However, even getting access to this hidden part of Apocrypha requires special items found only on roaming Seekers. Read more about these [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64113]two PvE activities here[/url].
 
[b]New Companions & Rewards[/b]
 
As you venture throughout both zones, you can encounter new allies including two unique Companions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64107]Sharp-as-Night[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64159]Azandar al-Cybiades[/url]. Both Companions can be recruited, leveled up, and equipped in this new Chapter, and each brings their own stories, combat skills, and questlines for you to unlock. 
 
[i]Necrom[/i] also features a host of in-game rewards you can earn as you explore and complete the game’s various quests and Achievements. This includes a series of new item sets (via crafting or earned from monster drops) and unique collectibles (such as the Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed mount or the Shroomtender’s Garb style). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom zone rewards[/i]
 
You can also dig up new Antiquities throughout both zones (including three mythic items) and unlock a Tales of Tribute deck (Almalexia) that introduces an all-new patron ability and cards. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i] is available [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]to buy now[/url] in four editions: 
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Upgrade: Necrom[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new or lapsed player, both [i]Collection [/i]editions include the base game, the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, and ALL previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, both [i]Upgrade [/i]editions grant you access to the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter. Note that to run [i]Necrom[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the game, both versions of [i]Necrom[/i] are also available in [i]Deluxe[/i] editions, which feature a unique mount, pet, memento, outfit style, and emotes. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/a5724b8c52ed004fa4f3273297844327.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/a5724b8c52ed004fa4f3273297844327.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom Deluxe Edition items[/i]
 
To find out more about [i]Necrom[/i] and its editions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63499]check out this blog[/url]. 
 [h2]Getting Started in Necrom[/h2] 
Once you have access to the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and continue your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the Telvanni Peninsula by opening your map, selecting the Necrom zone, and then selecting the Necrom Outskirts Wayshrine icon (the only one active in the zone). 
 
[b]Via the Necrom Main Quest[/b]
 
You can acquire the [i]Necrom[/i] main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select [i]Necrom[/i] and pick up the first quest, titled “Fate's Proxy” to begin. The quest points you toward where you need to go to travel to the zone. 
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to the Telvanni Peninsula by creating a new character and completing the tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select Telvanni Peninsula as your destination and begin. 
 
[b]Getting to Apocrypha[/b]
 
You can find portals to Apocrypha's two regions, the Endless Library and Chroma Incognito, in Leramil's base of operations in the Necrom Bindery. Travel east from the Necrom interior wayshrine and find the entrance past the guild trader's plaza. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/54ce8aa652f15647fce47fb725d32b83.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/54ce8aa652f15647fce47fb725d32b83.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Jump straight into the Necrom story[/i]
 
Don’t forget, there are no level requirements for any PvE zone in [i]ESO[/i], allowing you to immediately jump into the new content with any of your existing or new characters—have fun! 
 [h2]Update 38[/h2] 
Launching at the same time as the new Chapter is Update 38, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that adds quality-of-life improvements, fixes, and new features to the game. 
 
[b]Collectible Favorites[/b]
 
With Update 38, you can now designate favorites among your collectibles, moving them to the top of your Collections UI. You can choose up to 100 various collectibles with no limit on mounts, but some categories do not support this functionality at this time. 
 
[b]Random[/b] [b]Mounts[/b]
 
Update 38 also allows you to set your active mount to either “Random Favorite Mount” or “Random Mount.” When either one of these options is toggled, activating your mount in the world then summons a mount from either your selected favorites or from your entire collection—mix it up!
 
[b]Filleting Multiple Stacks of Fish[/b]
 
Tamriel’s many fishers can now fillet multiple fish simultaneously with Update 38. This can be done by visiting any Provisioning Station and selecting the new tab. You can still fillet fish one at a time from your inventory, but if you’ve got a huge catch, you will be casting more lines in no time. 
 
[b]New PvP Keep Messaging[/b]
 
Finally, Update 38 also introduces improved messaging for when a keep and its resources are claimed. If your guild owns a keep, the owner will be notified when its resource guards are killed. 
 
These are just some of the new features and changes coming with the new base-game update. You might notice changes to the reset timers for Cyrodiil and Tales of Tribute campaigns and that the indomitable Stuga is less fanatical when it comes to chasing you down in the streets of Daggerfall, Davon’s Watch, and Vulkhel Guard. To review everything coming with this base-game patch, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Become an Agent of Mora [/h2] 
The Prince of Knowledge is under siege and needs your help defending a long-held secret. Become an Arcanist and master the power of Apocrypha, explore two new zones, recruit new allies, uncover unique rewards, and continue your Shadow Over Morrowind saga in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i]. Are you willing to become an agent of Hermaeus Mora? Reality itself stands on the precipice! Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on June 20, 2023, for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. [/i]

notes.title: Necrom Preview—Conjuring the Arcanist
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/55d17bd59efc548a83b5f3081b4c66b7.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about the all-new Arcanist class, arriving soon as part of The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom, and see how the ESO dev team crafted this new way to play.[/i]
 
The Arcanist is [i]ESO[/i]’s first new class since 2019’s [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter and introduces three skill lines (Curative Runeforms, Herald of the Tome, and Soldier of Apocrypha) in addition to an all-new combat mechanic: the Crux System. Adding a new class to the game is a major undertaking, so we spoke to members of the development team to learn more about the Arcanist’s key features, design, and development.
 [h2]Conjuring a New Class[/h2] 
When planning [i]ESO[/i]’s newest class, including its abilities, background, and aesthetic, the team knew that first and foremost, the Arcanist had to stand apart.
 
“We set out to create something new and unique that doesn’t look or play like any class we’ve made before,” explains Brian Wheeler, [i]ESO[/i]’s Lead Combat Designer. “The Arcanist had to be different and not just a new coat of paint or a collection of ‘best hits’ from the game’s other classes.”
 
In addition, the team wanted to ensure that the new Arcanist class appealed to both new and existing players alike, regardless of experience level. 
 
“One of the tenets we had when making the Arcanist was to create abilities that explored new ground and concepts, while still having some that long-time players could see and draw comparisons to,” explains Stephen Cerretani, one of the Arcanist’s Combat Designers. “A great example are the first two abilities in the Herald of the Tome skill line. Runeblades has the makings of a long-range spammable, akin to Flame Skull or Force Shock. On the other hand, we have Fatecarver, a channeled beam that you can freely aim, wreaking havoc to anything before you.”

[previewyoutube=5Bxo6SA1GGg;full][/previewyoutube]
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
Finally, it was also important that the Arcanist support multiple roles (damage, tanking, healing) while presenting a single consistent identity. 
 
“The ability to perform any role using its own skills helps provide for a cohesive class experience,” explains Wheeler. “Whether you’re taking damage or dishing it out, the FX, audio, and animations all feel like they’re part of the same suite. This keeps the fantasy of playing an Arcanist intact without breaking up the visuals and overall vibe by over-relying on other abilities from other skill lines.”
 [h2]Apocrypha-Inspired Power[/h2] 
To help create this special identity, the team made the decision* to connect the Arcanist to the realm of Apocrypha. This unique thematic background became the foundation for not only the class’s combat abilities, but its entire aesthetic, including its FX and sounds. 
 
“The Arcanist, stylistically, is worlds apart from our other classes,” explains Dylan Hairston, the Arcanist’s Senior Sound Designer. “Where the Dragonknight might wield fire and poison, the Arcanist wields knowledge, runes, tentacles, etc. This allowed me to develop sounds that don’t have a strong real-world precedent, and I had a blast figuring out how some of the more obscure things would sound.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/38d8e7e8943dba97bed0c7c0430e04b7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/38d8e7e8943dba97bed0c7c0430e04b7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Arcanist utilizes eldritch runes of power[/i]
 
“We really wanted to make players feel like Arcanists are drawing from ancient knowledge, so focusing more on text, ink, and larger drawn runes helps that idea come across,” says Brian Hahn, the Arcanist’s Senior FX Artist. “Incorporating one of the black books into a lot of the casting animation also plays on this idea. We had a lot of fun coming up with ways to use it as a casting focus.”
 
Of course, when looking for inspiration, the team immersed themselves in the sinister, mysterious lore of Hermaeus Mora and Apocrypha.**
 
“Hermaeus Mora has a strong Lovecraftian draw, and I leaned into that heavily to try to make sounds that invoke this sense of being in your head,” says Hairston. “We included elements of whispers or unintelligible murmurs as though the sounds themselves contain infinite knowledge and power.”[i] [/i]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/88bb382bc995f254938544a580879d90.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/88bb382bc995f254938544a580879d90.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bring Apocrypha to Nirn with unique abilities[/i]
 
“We also played around a bit with the idea of forbidden knowledge,” explains Hahn. “Abilities like Abyssal Impact and Runes of Eldritch Horror are supposed to feel like they came from the darker depths of Apocrypha. As opposed to abilities like Remedy Cascade and Runeblades, which feel like you’re drawing from powers that would be more widely available in this part of Oblivion.”
 [h2]Getting to the Crux of It [/h2] 
In addition to three unique Skill Lines (complete with active, passive, and ultimate abilities) that each support the three playstyles, the Arcanist also introduces the Crux System. When playing an Arcanist, certain abilities will generate Crux, a new resource that you can use by activating Crux-spending abilities. Those abilities then enjoy additional benefits like cheaper resource costs, additional damage, and more. 
 
“Similar to the Necromancer’s corpse mechanic, with an Arcanist, you can enhance your abilities via the Crux system,” explains Wheeler. “However, with the new class, you’re able to stay mobile and build and spend Crux as you wish. This gives the Arcanist the chance to choose their own destiny on the fly, and it adds a layer of mastery outside of simply putting together your gear sets and ability bar.”   
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/698060e58652360604ab241f0a120c9d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/698060e58652360604ab241f0a120c9d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Empower your abilities with Crux[/i]
 
“The Crux system gives more of a direct ebb and flow to the class,” says Cerretani. “You can cast your abilities whenever you feel the opportunity requires it, but when you have all three Crux available to you and your ability buttons are shining, it’s a great feeling to know you’ll be firing at maximum effect.”
 
Because of the Crux System, the Arcanist features has customization that helps it stand apart from previous classes. 
 
“You can go as simple or complex as you want with the Arcanist’s Crux System, and we designed the full suite of abilities that way,” says Wheeler. “Not all your abilities build or spend, and some abilities provide benefits for simply building Crux and not spending it. Some players can even play with just no builders or spenders at all if they want, while others can load up all kinds of combinations to juggle building, spending, and sitting on three Crux for the right opportunity.” 

[previewyoutube=AhoKaHaHxt8;full][/previewyoutube]
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
How you build and play your Arcanist is up to you, and the team worked hard to ensure that no matter your experience level, you can both have fun and be effective when playing the new class.
 
“With the Arcanist we wanted to make sure that you could still have fun and fire off cool-looking abilities without having to worry about if you met some additional prerequisite,” explains Cerretani. “All the while leaving room for our veterans and number crunchers to have the opportunity to really get into the weeds with how the abilities interacted with one another.”
 [h2]Master the Power of Apocrypha[/h2] 
With the new Arcanist class, you can manipulate the eldritch energies of Hermaeus Mora’s realm to sunder your foes, stand steadfast against any attack, and restore your allies. How you chose to use this new class is up to you, and a near-limitless number of builds and playstyles await those willing to delve into the secrets of Apocrypha. How will you utilize these spectacular new powers? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and arrives for PC/Mac on June 5, 2023, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 20, 2023. [/i]
 
[i]Pre-purchase Necrom now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Sadrith Mora Spore Steed mount.[/i]
 
*Perhaps influenced by the Prince of Knowledge himself?
 
[i]**[/i]No developers were transformed into Hushed during the making of the Arcanist.

notes.title: Necrom Preview—Fear Apocrypha's Most-Monstrous Inhabitants
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/eb373391025ff2a3a68a5862d3b9a78e.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn more about some of the horrific monstrosities that call the Daedric realm of Apocrypha home.[/i]
 
In the upcoming[i] Necrom[/i] Chapter, you can visit Apocrypha, the twisted realm of Hermaeus Mora. However, endless knowledge is not all that awaits within the Daedric Prince’s dominion. Creatures ranging from the bizarre to the terrifying litter the ethereal landscape and threaten those who journey too far in search of Mora’s secrets.
 
Take a quick look at four of these cursed creatures and learn more about what roles they play in the vast sea of forbidden knowledge that is Apocrypha.

 [h2]Seekers[/h2] 
Perhaps first and foremost among the denizens of Mora’s realm are the Seekers. You’re likely to come across these levitating, tentacled Daedra anywhere treasured knowledge may be found, as they tend to the endless stacks of tomes and loose pages scattered throughout Apocrypha.
 
“Seekers are the Daedric creatures most loyal to Hermaeus Mora, resembling spawn from the Inevitable Knower himself,” says Michael Zenke, [i]ESO[/i]’s Loremaster. “While some sources (often tomes of ill repute written by half-mad scholars) indicate that Seekers can speak out loud, reliable witnesses claim that Seekers make only the most basic and uncanny of sounds as they silently prowl their Master’s realm.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/d4ff7c29f0f555649136e1fe116f96fb.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/d4ff7c29f0f555649136e1fe116f96fb.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Seeker[/i]


Seekers are said to be the administrators and guardians of  Apocrypha’s Endless Library, and they will reportedly go to extreme lengths to  protect their lord’s trove of unfathomable lore. 
  
“Indeed, the average Seeker will not pause to engage a  mortal in Apocrypha in pleasant conversation,” says Zenke. “They instinctively  feel that intruding mortals are a danger that should be destroyed immediately.”
  
You can find Seekers throughout much of Apocrypha, but it is  said one uniquely mighty variant resides in one of the realm’s most unholy  sites.
  
“A particularly ancient Seeker, the Prime Cataloguer, makes  its home in the Libram Cathedral, waiting for groups of daring adventurers to  challenge it,” warns Tom Murphy, [i]Necrom[/i]’s Zone Lead.
  
Mortals curious about what knowledge they can procure from  within Mora’s realm should be careful, lest they fall victim to a Seeker ready  to punish any intruders for their trespasses.

  [h2]Lurkers[/h2]  
While Seekers may guard Apocrypha’s libraries, Lurkers stalk  its shores, ready to devour any unfortunates that cross their paths. These unsightly  beasts are rumored to be birthed from the abyssal pools that make up the very  foundation of Apocrypha. It is said that they represent the evolution of life  pushed to its very extreme, resulting in a hideous monster that barely  resembles any natural lifeform.
  
“Looking at these beasts, it’s easy to see their physiology  was inspired by some of the strangest creatures of Nirn,” says Zenke. “Perhaps it’s  this tenuous link back to the Nirn that makes them so truly disgusting, because  deep down we recognize the shapes that inspired the Lurker. And we fear them.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/2f2e4adf2696b0250d6b88098401a6c6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/2f2e4adf2696b0250d6b88098401a6c6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Lurker[/i]

The Lurker’s hulking frame disguises their unnatural speed, and its unending desire to feed drives them forward to consume whatever poor soul draws their attention.
 
“They feast equally on the flesh of trespassers and on the detritus of moldering libraries that are pulled into their dark waters,” explains Murphy. “Players will find them in Apocrypha’s mires and lowlands, hiding and basking in the sinister waters of their Prince’s domain.”
 
Those who have braved the marshlands of Apocrypha talk of a titanic Lurker, “Vro-Kuul-Sha,” who has made its home in an area referred to as Deepreave Quag. Facing this beast is a reckless pursuit, but if it can be killed, great rewards await its slayer.

 [h2]Hushed[/h2] 
Unlike Seekers and Lurkers, the Hushed do not appear to be naturally occurring residents of Apocrypha. Instead, they are theorized to be the husks of mortal loreseekers who have been degraded both mentally and physically after peering too long into the Lord of Knowledge’s darkest secrets.
 
“The Hushed are the result of prolonged exposure to the boundless secrets of Mora’s realm,” says Zenke. “Once dedicated researchers and scholars, these misshapen, mouthless beings are now driven only by a thirst for knowledge. They are hostile in the extreme to mortal interlopers.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/035ba43a3bebe5830df6cc0857792f94.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/035ba43a3bebe5830df6cc0857792f94.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Hushed[/i]


These horrific reflections of our own mortal form wander  across the wastes of Apocrypha, supposedly in search of the very knowledge that  led to their ghastly transformation. Despite their pitiful appearance, the  Hushed are not to be underestimated.
  
“Though their  minds are destroyed, they retain the skills and abilities they wielded in  life–and in some cases, have unlocked new powers at the cost of mind and body,”  warns Murphy. “Don’t treat them as mindless zombies.”
  
Hermaeus Mora’s  gifts may appear tantalizing at first, but remember that few dealings with  Daedric Princes come without a price.

  [h2]Mind Terrors[/h2]  
The last and most disturbing creature you may encounter in  your travels throughout Apocrypha are the nightmarish Mind Terrors. Everything  about these unnerving monstrosities seems to be designed to instill terror into  the minds of mortals. Fear is their weapon, and they wield it expertly.
  
“They are nightmares out of childhood,” says Zenke. “The  shadows on the wall of our bedrooms given flesh, intellect, and a mouth full of  hundreds of pointed teeth.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/7f4e91a1c99a6b34bf2f302f53eb0e69.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/7f4e91a1c99a6b34bf2f302f53eb0e69.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Mind Terror[/i]

Although Mind Terrors prowl across various regions of Apocrypha, they seem oddly distinct from the realm’s other inhabitants. They appear almost alien when compared to Mora’s spawn and seem to act in opposition to the Prince’s goals. 
 
“Mind Terrors have arrayed themselves against Hermaeus Mora,” explains Murphy. “They are nightmares given form, feasting on mental anguish and terror.”
 
While each these monsters are extremely dangerous, one is feared above all others and has reportedly escaped from Oblivion.
 
“A particularly virulent Mind Terror, the Walking Nightmare, has broken free of any control and now runs rampant in the Telvanni Peninsula,” says Murphy. “Groups of adventurers can tackle this monstrosity in the Nightmare Den.”
 
Are you prepared to face your greatest fears and banish this abhorrent creature back to Oblivion?
 
Now that you’ve glimpsed the sort of adversaries you can encounter during your journeys through Apocrypha, do you feel prepared to plunge into the accursed realm of Hermaeus Mora when [i]Necrom[/i] launches next month? Do you have a favorite monster from the horrors above? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
