Pre-purchase Necrom now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Sadrith Mora Spore Steed mount.[/i]

notes.title: Necrom Zone Preview—Telvanni Peninsula & Apocrypha
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/3824eb3023689ea477ac1d9b1db38b9b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the weird and wonderful worlds you can explore within the upcoming Necrom Chapter. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i], arriving June 5 on PC/Mac and June 20 on Xbox and PlayStation consoles, introduces two brand-new zones for Tamriel’s adventurers to experience: the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha. Both new zones include their own unique locations to explore, quests to complete, challenges to overcome, and rewards to earn.  
 [h2]Telvanni Peninsula & Necrom[/h2] 
Currently ruled over by House Telvanni, the Telvanni Peninsula with its towering mushroom forests, bizarre creatures, and craggy steppes might feel familiar to those who have ventured into Vvardenfell or Stonefalls, but this region remains politically distinct from the rest of Morrowind. 
 
[url=https://kuula.co/share/55QNM?fs=1&vr=1&sd=1&initload=0&thumbs=1&info=0&logo=0]“The Telvanni Peninsula is isolated from Dunmer politics and the Three Banners War,” explains Tom Murphy, [i]Necrom[/i]’s Zone Lead. “The leaders of House Telvanni saw little to gain by throwing in with the Ebonheart Pact. While the main leadership has centered itself on Sadrith Mora in Vvardenfell, a handful of masters rule over the peninsula in a conclave.”[/url]
 
While House Telvanni controls most of the peninsula, Necrom, the region’s largest city, remains independent. Also called the City of the Dead, the ancient city serves as a spiritual hub for Dark Elves across Morrowind. 
 
“The city of Necrom arose as Dark Elf (formerly Chimer) culture carried ancestral worship to the region in the First Era,” says Michael Zenke, [i]ESO[/i]’s Loremaster. “The edicts and suggestions of their living gods, the Tribunal, led this region to be a hub for veneration of the dead and departed—a confluence on the mortal plane of Nirn to commune with the spirits of Aetherius.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The City of the Dead[/i]
 
The city allows all the Dark Elves to participate in their traditions, and it hosts great pilgrimages from all over Nirn. Due to its importance, Necrom enjoys a kind of neutrality when it comes to the political machinations of the Great Houses. 
 
“Necrom is a holy city for Dark Elves of all houses and affiliations,” explains Murphy. “All acknowledge that such a place belongs to the Dunmer, and the Keepers of the Dead—the order that maintains the city—have fought tooth and nail to fend off the few conquerors foolish enough to try to claim it.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/64b169be111cda34f648200cdf7d14fd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/64b169be111cda34f648200cdf7d14fd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The streets of Necrom[/i]
 
For would-be adventurers and explorers, Necrom features all the amenities and opportunities of any major Tamrielic city, and it is home to daily quest NPCs, crafting stations, an Outlaw’s Refuge, and vendors.  
 
The city bustles with traders, explorers, and hidden dangers, and yet there’s greater adventure beyond its high walls. With a host of delves and a public dungeon to experience, world bosses to conquer, side quests to discover, and all manner of wonderous sights, you’ll find no shortage of excitement within both Necrom and the Telvanni Peninsula.
 [h2]Apocrypha & Chroma Incognito[/h2] 
The second explorable zone in the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter allows [i]ESO[/i]’s undaunted adventurers to venture to the Daedric realm of Apocrypha. As the dominion of Hermaeus Mora, Apocrypha houses the collected knowledge of the Prince of Fate, and all manner of native Daedra and knowledge-seeking mortals call it home.  
 
“Mortals have long sought the forbidden secrets of Apocrypha for their own gain, leading to a number of factions that vie for control of the stacks,” explains Zenke. “The Ciphers of the Eye, the favored of Hermaeus Mora, are a particularly powerful and well-established group. Their settlement, Cipher’s Midden, is one of the few areas that can be said to be ‘safe’ for mortals in this twisting realm.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/e54f038d030611a71d59d30758ecd5a5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/e54f038d030611a71d59d30758ecd5a5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Venture into Apocrypha[/i]
 
This warped Daedric realm is also home to a tentacled host of Daedra and Dremora, all (mostly) loyal to the Prince of Knowledge. 
 
“Daedra abound in Apocrypha, as in any Daedric realm, with the most numerous being the floating Seekers–archivists of the endless library,” says Zenke. “Lurkers also slouch and squelch through the abyssal pools of Apocrypha. Adventurers can discover that these heavyweight soldiers defend Mora's secrets at all costs."
 
You might be an agent of Hermaeus Mora during your adventures in this part of Oblivion, but don’t let that lower your guard—many dangers prowl the shadows of Apocrypha, and all who walk its paths in search of knowledge should be wary.

“Knowledge is power, and power corrupts,” warns Murphy. “Mortal adventurers will almost certainly run afoul of the Hushed–ill-fated readers of forbidden lore that have mutated into monsters. Eerie and horrific Daedra, like Seekers and Lurkers, prowl in the shadows of books. And new invaders have established footholds in Apocrypha.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/4177a84f6f647afa95176ee2d77f6b25.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/4177a84f6f647afa95176ee2d77f6b25.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Beware Apocrypha’s dangers[/i]
 
You can experience these dangers for yourself when you venture into this strange world. However, when exploring Apocrypha in the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, you can also discover an all-new part of Mora’s realm: [b]Chroma Incognito[/b]. 
 
Distinct from the rest of Apocrypha, Chroma Incognito is home to fates that never came to pass. It is a world of unclaimed potential, missed opportunities, and impossible futures that, for whatever reason, the Prince of Fate hoards within his ream.
 
“Hermaeus Mora is not just one thing—he is many,” states Zenke. “Chroma Incognito is a reflection of that, as all Daedric realms are a reflection and extension of the Prince that rules it. Chroma represents the ‘color out of space’ from Lovecraftian lore—the twisting threads of fate that Mora views and judges. Think of it as that feeling of being very, very small you get from gazing up at the night sky on a cloudless night. As a result, this ever-shifting region of Apocrypha contains multitudes: a crucible of faded fates, a drifting vortex of lost ships and sunken vessels, and a menagerie unlike any seen in all of Aetherius.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/86d0b5b504d4aea425797a6fbb2bf6ed.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/86d0b5b504d4aea425797a6fbb2bf6ed.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Chroma Incognito[/i]

This bizarre piece of Apocrypha becomes yours to explore at will, but be warned: like any other part of Oblivion, it exposes you to new mysteries and dangers that you need to overcome throughout your journeys. Between these two portions of Mora’s realm, you encounter unique delves to explore, a public dungeon to clear, world bosses to confront, and side quests to complete. 
 [h2]Reveal Secret Rewards[/h2] 
As you quest throughout the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha, you can earn rewards specific to the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter. This includes a host of Achievements, six item sets (three crafted, three that drop in the world), three powerful mythic items (dug up via antiquities), a new Tales of Tribute deck (Almalexia), and a huge mix of astonishing collectibles. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/c96ca995809f209ee45ec88dce279e94.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/c96ca995809f209ee45ec88dce279e94.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Check your in-game Achievements[/i]
 
These collectibles include the Shroomtender’s Garb armor style (earned by completing various [i]Necrom[/i] achievements), the Graht-Oak Squirrel pet (earned via both of [i]Necrom[/i]’s public dungeons), the Obsidian Dwarven Sphere pet (earned via the new Bastion Nymic world event), unique outfit styles, mementos, emotes, and much more. 
 
Complete almost every [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter Achievement and you receive the stunning Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed—the ideal mount for your adventures across the peninsula and Apocrypha. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom’s Unique Collectibles[/i]
 
The Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha might hold untold mysteries and dangers, but those brave or foolhardy enough to dive deep into these two spectacular worlds find no shortage of in-game rewards awaiting them. Good luck!
 [h2]New Worlds Await![/h2] 
Whether you’re excited to delve into the volatile political world of House Telvanni and Necrom or the unknowable wonders and horrors of Apocrypha, the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter’s two unique zones provide explorers with all manner of adventures, challenges, and rewards. Are you ready and willing to venture to the Telvanni Peninsula, the city of Necrom, and Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Oblivion? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and arrives for PC/Mac on June 5, 2023, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 20, 2023.[/i]
 
[i]Pre-purchase Necrom now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and [b]immediate access[/b] to the Sadrith Mora Spore Steed. Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Stalk Tamriel’s PvP Battlefields & Earn Bonus Rewards During Whitestrake’s Mayhem

[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/8995dd1aa96655208d72c34d38a0830a.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Clash across Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event and you’ll earn bonuses to Alliance Points and XP gains, in-game rewards, and more![/i]
 [h2]The Mayhem Never Ends![/h2] 
The Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event returns Thursday, May 11 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, May 23 at 10AM EDT. During this period, you and your fellow adventurers can enjoy big boosts to both your Alliance Point and XP gains while earning awesome in-game rewards by participating in [i]ESO[/i]’s[i] [/i]PvP modes.
 
Ready and eager to join your fellow warriors? Simply follow the steps below:
          [olist][*]Visit the in-game Crown Store to acquire the “Details on the Whitestrake’s Mayhem" quest[/*][*]Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities[/*][/olist][list][*]You are not required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off the event[/*][/list][*]Find the NPC named “Predicant Maera" and continue the quest[/*][list][*]If you already completed the quest in a previous year, you won't need to do it again[/*][/list][*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Boon Box[/*][*]Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:[/*][list][*]Alliance Points gained[/*][*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*][/list][*]In addition, enjoy a 100% boost to Tel Var Stones gained throughout the course of Whitestrike’s Mayhem; no scroll required![/*]										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/3a8b4e07dce891197c96d10eff00516d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/3a8b4e07dce891197c96d10eff00516d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle to claim Cyrodiil[/i]
 
You can use the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity throughout the Whitestrake’s Mayhem event period. If for whatever reason the scroll is lost or destroyed, return to Predicant Maera to obtain another, or use the Basin of the Gore Virtuous. Be aware that the Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity is an inventory item, [b]not[/b] a memento.
 [h2]Claim the Spoils[/h2] 
As you battle throughout Tamriel, gaining fame and glory beyond compare, you can earn event-specific loot.
 
[b]House Dufort Banneret Outfit Styles[/b]
 
Brandish your chivalric pride for all to witness through the armament of the Knights of the House of Dufort, dropped by Imperial City sweepers and bosses.
 
[b]NEW—Gloamsedge Armor Style[/b]
 
Blend into the shadows as you stalk your prey in the Gloamsedge armor, dropped by Imperial City sweepers and bosses.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/15cce0425286af7831f4fd002c396101.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/15cce0425286af7831f4fd002c396101.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Ambush your foes in Gloamsedge armor[/i]
 
[b]Pelinal’s Boon Boxes[/b]
 
As you compete across Cyrodiil, Battlegrounds, and the Imperial City, you can earn Pelinal’s Boon Boxes in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers and PvP daily quest rewards. You can receive these boxes from participating in the activities listed below:
     [list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests[/*][/list]
Within Boon Boxes, you have the chance to receive the following items:
 [list][*]Parcel      of Tel Var Stones [/*]  [*]Cyrodiil repair kit [/*]  [*]Soul Gems [/*]  [*]A guaranteed drop of [b]ONE[/b] of the      following:[/*]  [list][*]Alchemy       ingredients [/*]   [*]A style item for your Alliance's armor style [/*]   [*]A style item for Akaviri armor style [/*]   [*]A Daedric siege weapon [/*]   [*]A Whitestrake's Mayhem book furnishing [/*]   [*]A Forward Camp for your Alliance [/*]   [*]A Chapter of your Alliance's armor motif [/*]   [list][*]There is a small chance that the full book may drop        instead of a single chapter[/*]   [/list][*]A Prismatic Runestone [/*]   [*]A Chapter for the Akaviri armor motif (or very rarely,       the full book) (0.5%)[/*]  [/list][*]Fragment      of the Alliance Breton Terrier pet [/*]  [list][*]There       is a small chance you discover two fragments instead of only one[/*]  [/list][*]Transmute Geode[/*]  [*]Tools of Domination Weapon Style Page[/*] [/list]
[b]Bonus Resources & The Golden[/b]
 
Players making use of harvesting nodes during the Whitestrike Mayhem event will loot extra resources. Additionally, the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi, “The Golden” Aba-daro will update her shop’s stock to contain jewelry from Cyrodiil’s item sets, in CP160 Legendary quality. Aba-daro’s Bazaar will offer valuable necklaces during the first weekend of the event and rare rings during the second. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/07/6c9cdeb5665f0465a54ec509d43ba703.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/07/6c9cdeb5665f0465a54ec509d43ba703.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Purchase PvP jewelry from Aba-daro[/i]
 
Note that during Whitestrake’s Mayhem, Aba-daro will not be selling Monster Masks and all purchases in her shop must be made with Alliance Points. She will [b]not[/b] accept gold.
 [h2]Event Tickets & Rewards[/h2] 
During this event, you can earn up to three Event Tickets each day by completing two different PvP activities:
   [list][*]Two Event Tickets from the first Cyrodiil or Battleground daily repeatable quest [/*][list][*]Note that these can include Bounty Board quests, a Town Daily, the Conquest Board quests, or the daily Battleground quest[/*][/list][*]One Event Ticket from a District daily quest within the Imperial City[/*][/list]
This means by the end of Whitestrike’s Mayhem you could accumulate a mighty [b]39[/b] Event Tickets! Keep in mind that you can hold up to a maximum of 12 Event Tickets at a time. If you happen to earn more while already at the cap, those tickets will not be added to your inventory.
 
Once you’ve collected enough tickets, head on over to the Impresario merchant to barter for some exclusive event collectibles:
 [list][*]All      three [b]Passion Dancer Blossom [/b]pet fragments [/*]  [list][*]Chartreuse       Lily Petals[/*]   [*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*]   [*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*]  [/list][*]All three [b]Passion's Muse [/b]personality fragments      [/*]  [list][*]Bottle       of Silver Mist[/*]   [*]Delicate Dancer's Baton[/*]   [*]Pressed Lily Petal Insoles[/*]  [/list][*]The first two [b]Meadowbreeze Memories[/b] skin      fragments [/*]  [list][*]Bottled       Skin Dyes[/*]   [*]Ground Jade Lily Powder[/*]  [/list][*]Bound Gloamsedge armor style pages [/*]  [*]Bag of Veteran's Glory containing one guaranteed drop of a previous Whitestrake's/Midyear rewards      that you haven’t already collected[/*][list][*]Black Drake Clanwrap style pages[/*][*]Second Legion style pages[/*][*]Legion Zero style pages[/*][*]Legion Zero Vigiles pages[/*][*]Ebonsteel Armor pages[/*][*]Black Drake's body or face markings[/*][*]Battle-Scarred body or face markings[/*][*]Standard-Bearer emotes[/*][*]Standard-Bearer staves and shields[/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations for Fighters Guild, Mages      Guild, and Undaunted[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/104dde65ca8458da5592d14ccf25fe51.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/104dde65ca8458da5592d14ccf25fe51.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Meadowbreeze Memories skin[/i]
 
Finally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Luminous Indrik Berries[/*][*]Icebreath Indrik Berries[/*][*]Shimmering Indrik pet[/*][*]Rimedusk Indrik pet[/*][/list][h2]Glory and Honor Awaits![/h2] 
Compete across Tamriel’s many battlefields during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event, and you can earn special rewards as compensation for your epic deeds. Are you ready to test your mettle against your fellow players? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event begins Thursday, May 11 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, May 23 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Explore Tamriel during the April 2023 Free Play Event & Sale
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/20626761358619821177de6ee60e84e0.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Venture into a world without limits during the April 2023 Free Play Event and Sale.[/i]
 [h2]Explore Tamriel for Free[/h2] 
The [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] April 2023 Free Play Event is now live and will continue until [b]Monday April 17, 2023[/b]. During the event period, you can dive into the world of Tamriel during the Second Era at no cost on PC/Mac, Xbox consoles, and PlayStation consoles. 
 
To begin, visit our Free Play page and select your platform. This event grants you access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, which includes four of the game’s classes (Sorcerer, Nightblade, Templar, and Dragonknight), 24 unique zones to explore, and access to [i]ESO[/i]’s PvP game modes such as the Battlegrounds and the Alliance War. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/68d380996b69bd3acd432c9f555caa41.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/68d380996b69bd3acd432c9f555caa41.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Return to Morrowind during the Free Play Event[/i]
 
If you’ve already played [i]ESO[/i] during a previous free play event, you can jump back in with no loss of progression. In addition, all brand-new accounts created will also receive 500 crowns to spend in the in-game Crown Store.

							      				
[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay][u][b][h2]Click Here For Play Free Access[/h2][/b][/u][/url]

Once the free play period has concluded on April 17, 2023, you can continue your journey right where you left off by purchasing [i]ESO[/i] from the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url]. 
 [h2]High Isle & Base Game Sale[/h2] 
In addition to the Free Play Event, the April 2023 Sale is now also live on select platforms, with some major savings up for grabs on [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle [/i]Chapter[i] [/i](including the[i] Upgrade[/i], [i]Deluxe Upgrade[/i], [i]Collection[/i], and[i] Deluxe Collection [/i]editions)[i] [/i]is now available at up to 67% off on The Elder Scrolls Online Store, Steam, and Xbox Store[b] until April 20, 2023. [/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/03/0ec0aba047ca22c16ad153de135b9dcf.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/03/0ec0aba047ca22c16ad153de135b9dcf.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]High Isle on sale now![/i]
 
In addition, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online Standard Edition[/i] is also on sale at up to 70% off on The Elder Scrolls Online Store, Steam, and Xbox Store[b] until April 20, 2023[/b], and on the PlayStation Store [b]until April 26, 2023[/b]. 
 
If you’re looking to take your first steps into the world of Tamriel or discover its latest Chapter, now is the time!
	      		
					    							      								      																																						[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][h2][b][u]Click Here To Buy Now[/u][/b][/h2][/url]																																				      							    							      								      									 

Note that the sale may differ based on platform and territory, so be sure to check your preferred retailer and don’t miss out.
 [h2]Crown Pack Sale[/h2] 
During the Free Play Event and Sale, select Crown Store Crown Packs are also available at discounted prices. This sale is now live on The Elder Scrolls Online Store, Steam, Xbox Store, and PlayStation Store[b] until April 13[/b], [b]2023[/b], providing the following discounts: 
     [list][*]21,000—40% off[/*][*]14,000—35% off[/*][*]5,500—30% off[/*][*]3,000—25% off[/*][*]1,500—20% off[/*][/list]
You can enjoy these savings right now by navigating to the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]Buy Crowns page[/url] and selecting your pack.
										      
							    							      								      																																							[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns][h2][u][b]Click Here To Buy Crowns[/b][/u][/h2][/url]																																	


You can use crowns to acquire a huge number of useful and unique items from the in-game Crown Store, including collectibles such as pets, mounts, costumes, styles, and more. If you’re interested in seeing what kind of items and collectibles the Crown Store currently has in stock, visit [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]this page[/url]. 
 [h2]Don’t Miss Out![/h2] 
Whether you want to play for free, pick up the game while it’s on sale, or enjoy a big discount on Crown Packs, there’s a massive world of adventure that awaits new and returning adventurers alike during the April 2023 Free Play Event and Sale—we’ll see you in Tamriel! 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online April 2023 Free Play Event runs from Thursday, April 6, 2023, until Monday April 17, 2023.[/i]

notes.title: Gift Event Tickets during the Anniversary Jubilee and Receive Free Crown Crates!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/04/83e2df7d15451330a558b2e4a26565da.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Celebrate nine years of ESO by gifting Event Tickets to your fellow adventurers during the Anniversary Jubilee and you’ll receive four free Ragebound Crown Crates![/i]
 
As part of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]’s [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63919]anniversary fun[/url], starting today and running until April 18, 2023 at 10AM EDT, when you gift [b]five[/b] (or more) Event Tickets to your friends or guildmates, you’ll receive four [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63897]Ragebound Crown Crates[/url] from us on the house!
 
To get your hands on these valuable containers, follow these simple steps:
     [list][*]From the Crown Store, gift five or more Event Tickets to anybody in-game during the Anniversary Jubilee event.[/*][list][*]You can find Event Tickets within the Events section.[/*][*]You can split the gifts between multiple recipients, so all five tickets don’t need to go to the same individual.[/*][/list][*]Following the conclusion of the Anniversary Jubilee, you’ll receive four Ragebound Crown Crates.[/*][list][*]Your Crown Crates will be delivered by May 31, 2023.[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/dd2e82fd5572d160370a52bc80485178.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/dd2e82fd5572d160370a52bc80485178.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/2719ac34ce8e5224a0bd3ccd3b980605.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/2719ac34ce8e5224a0bd3ccd3b980605.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Some of the items you can acquire from Ragebound Crown Crates[/i]
 
If you’re the lucky recipient of a gifted Event Ticket, visit the Impresario merchant to take advantage of a variety of event-specific offers. Check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63919]Anniversary Jubilee announcement blog[/url] to see a complete list of items that will be in stock. 
 
Brighten someone’s day with the gift of Event Tickets and we’ll reward your generosity with some free Crown Crates. It’s that easy! Don’t forget, this offer is available only during the Anniversary Jubilee, which ends April 18, 2023. Let us know which lucky individual  will soon be finding a shiny Event Ticket in their Gift Inventory via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Delve Into Apocrypha’s Secrets during the Necrom Chapter Preview Livestream
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/04/b0790267c459cde3b52905624fdcac26.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Uncover Hermaeus Mora’s mysteries and learn more about ESO’s upcoming Chapter during the Necrom Chapter Preview Event! [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i] is right around the corner (June 5 for PC/Mac and June 20 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles), but we’ve still got a lot more to share with the [i]ESO[/i] community about this exciting new Chapter. 
 
To kick off the ESO Celebration 2023 community event in Las Vegas, USA, we’ll be streaming [i]The[/i] [i]Elder[/i] [i]Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i] Chapter Preview live via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url] so the entire #ESOFam can get the inside scoop on the game’s next big adventure. 
   [list][*][b]What:[/b] The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom Chapter Preview[/*][*][b]When:[/b] Wednesday, April 12 at 1PM PDT/4PM EDT[/*][*][b]Where:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url] [/*][/list]
During the livestream, [i]ESO[/i]’s developers and Community Team will dive deep into the upcoming Chapter, including Hermaeus Mora, the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha, the Arcanist class, the 12-player Trial, and more. Some of Mora’s (and the [i]ESO[/i] development team’s) most closely guarded secrets will be revealed!* 
 
Tune in to watch the show with a [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/41809/]Twitch-linked [i]ESO[/i] account[/url] and you’ll also earn a free Ouroboros Crate AND brand-new Moon and Star Earrings adornment. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/04/d1fbf8317c1b4f579c1df4ef76dc4043.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/04/d1fbf8317c1b4f579c1df4ef76dc4043.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]The Moon and Star  Earrings adornment[/i]
  
Discover more about the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter AND acquire  some fashionable new jewelry for your most stylish adventurers!

[u][b]Friday, April 14[/b][/u]
[b]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom Chapter Preview – DE[/b]
  
Find out what new features you can expect in [i]ESO[/i]’s  upcoming Chapter and discuss the new information with DE Community Manager Kai  and members of the ESO Stream Team.
  
[b]When:[/b] Friday, April 14 at 7AM EDT/1PM CEST
  
[b]Where: [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda_DE]Twitch.tv/Bethesda_DE[/url]



  
Are you excited to learn more about the Telvanni Peninsula  and more esoteric realms? Be sure to tune in to the Necrom Chapter Preview next  [b]Wednesday, April 12 at 4PM EDT[/b] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url] for the big show,  and as always, keep an eye on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url]  and our social channels on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url] for all the  latest news leading into [i]Necrom[/i]’s launch in June—we’ll see you there!
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow  Over Morrowind adventure and arrives for PC/Mac on June 5, 2023, and for Xbox and  PlayStation consoles on June 20, 2023. Pre-purchase Necrom now to receive  unique bonus rewards at launch and immediate access to the Sadrith Mora Spore  Steed mount and Sadrith Mora Spore Pony pet**.[/i]
  
[i]*Without subjecting us to the wrath of the Prince of Knowledge  OR Bethesda Game Studios.[/i]
  
**Sadrith Mora Spore Pony pet available only until April 18,  2023.

notes.title: Gorge on Cake, Enjoy Bonus XP, and Earn Special Rewards During ESO’s Anniversary Jubilee!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/b76cbe1ef3135f5a37f661bd24e7299b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Celebrate ESO’s birthday with cake and more during the 2023 Anniversary Jubilee in-game event.[/i]
 [h2]ESO Turns Nine![/h2] 
The 2023 Anniversary Jubilee kicks off [b]April 6 at 10am EDT[/b] and continues until [b]April 18 at 10am EDT[/b]. Before you can join the festivities, you’ll need to grab the best part of any birthday: a delicious slice of cake. To do so, locate the free event quest, Ache for Cake, in the Quest Starters section of the in-game Crown Store or by picking up a Cake Voucher at any Jubilee Bakery Barge located in Vulkhel Guard, Davon's Watch, and Daggerfall. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/5712911ff3d3ee5fa2caa4a7c88231a9.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/5712911ff3d3ee5fa2caa4a7c88231a9.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find Chef Donolon to begin![/i]
 
Once you’ve completed the quest, you’ll be rewarded with this year’s scrumptious cake (called Jubilee Cake 2023), which you can summon from the Tools section in your Collections menu. Each time you take a bite of this celebratory confection during the event, you’ll receive a 2-hour 100% XP boost as well as three Event Tickets! 
 
Remember to enjoy a slice of cake every day of the event to maximize your rewards.
 [h2]Earn Jubilee Gifts[/h2] 
During the event period, you’ll receive exclusive Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes as additional rewards each time you complete a daily quest anywhere in Tamriel. These daily quests include:
     [list][*]Daily crafting writs[/*][*]Daily Delve and World Boss quests[/*][*]Daily Alliance War and Battlegrounds quests[/*][*]Daily Dungeon and Trial quests[/*][*]Daily Heist and Sacrament quests[/*][/list]
Jubilee Gift Boxes have a chance to contain some of the following goodies:
      [list][*]Basic crafting materials [/*][*]Rare crafting materials or a small chance for a motif chapter, furniture recipe, or style item [/*][*][b]New[/b]: A small chance for a tradeable outfit style page for the [b]Bonemold armor style[/b][/*][list][*]If you’ve already collected a Bonemold armor style earlier that day, you will instead be rewarded with either a Saberkeel style page or a Worm Cult style page[/*][/list][*]A small chance for the Worm Cult style item, “Desecrated Grave Soil”[/*][*]A small chance for Transmutation Crystals [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/7511f7b4596d60b5319c1f35705646ac.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/7511f7b4596d60b5319c1f35705646ac.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bonemold Armor style[/i]
 [h2]The Impresario & Event Tickets [/h2] 
If you continue to enjoy cake every day throughout the event, you can earn up to a maximum of 39 Event Tickets. Don’t forget you can only ever hold up to 12 tickets at a time, so if you receive more while already at the cap, you’ll lose them!
 
After you’ve accumulated some tickets, find your way to the Impresario’s emporium located at any of the main cities and exchange them for some of the valuable wares listed below:
 [list][*]All      three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments [/*]  [list][*]Chartreuse       Lily Petals[/*]   [*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*]   [*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*]  [/list][*]All three fragments for the Passion's      Muse personality [/*]  [list][*]Bottle       of Silver Mist[/*]   [*]Delicate Dancer's Baton[/*]   [*]Pressed Lily Petal Insoles[/*]  [/list][*][b]New:[/b] One fragment for the Meadowbreeze      Memories Skin [/*]  [list][*]Bottled       Skin Dyes[/*]  [/list][*][b]New:[/b] Bound style pages for the Bonemold armor      style [/*]  [*]Anniversary Cake furnishings[/*]  [*]Bag of Jubilee Yesteryear [/*]  [list][*]You are guaranteed to receive one of the following       items that you don’t currently own:[/*]   [list][*]Worm        Cult bound motif chapters[/*]    [*]Jephrine Paladin armor style pages[/*]    [*]Imperial Champion armor style pages[/*]    [*]Prophet armor style pages[/*]    [*]Lyris armor style pages[/*]    [*]Sai Sahan armor style pages[/*]    [*]Abnur Tharn armor style pages[/*]    [*]Saberkeel armor style pages [/*]    [*]Aurora Firepot Spider Parts [/*]    [*]Desecrated Grave Soil [/*]    [*]Group Repair Kits [/*]    [list][*]If you already own all         the aforementioned collectibles, the bag will always contain Group         Repair Kits[/*]    [/list][/list][/list][*]Companion Guild Commendations [/*] [/list]
During the Anniversary Jubilee, you’ll have the chance to snag BOTH sets of fragments for the Passion Dancer Blossom pet and the Passion’s Muse personality from the Impresario. This event will also be your first chance to pick up the Bottled Skin Dyes; one of three fragments needed to obtain the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.
										      							    							      								      									
In addition, the Impresario’s Assistant, Philius Dormier, has a few other offerings you’ll want to take advantage of:
[list][*]The fourth Aurora Firepot Spider pet fragment[/*][*]Hide Shoulder Collectible[/*][/list][h2]Here’s to Another Year of ESO![/h2]
Scarf down some cake, earn special event rewards, and enjoy a big buff to XP gains during the Anniversary Jubilee event! Can you believe we’ve already spent nine years adventuring together? How are you planning to celebrate [i]ESO[/i]’s birthday? Let us and the #ESOFam know by reaching out via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]ESO’s Anniversary Jubilee in-game event begins Thursday, April 6 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, April 18 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Earn Bizarre Rewards During the Jester’s Festival Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/daa65a403569c0d648e46c16a1a2e4f4.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Spread mirth and mayhem across all of Tamriel with the return of the Jester’s Festival in-game event.[/i]
 
The Jester’s Festival event returns on March 29 at 10:00AM EDT and will continue until April 6 10:00AM EDT! During Tamriel’s silliest season, you can acquire buffs to XP gains and earn ridiculous rewards by completing special event-specific quests.
 
Prepared to participate in Nirn’s most-preposterous party? Travel to the jester pavilions found within the cities of Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, and Daggerfall, and meet with one of three jesters masquerading as Jorunn the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric. If you find yourself getting all topsy-turvy searching for these sites, navigate to the Crown Store and acquire the Jester's Festival Invitation Quest. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/fccaa50cd46182ba464448c29c01b9fe.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/fccaa50cd46182ba464448c29c01b9fe.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The ridiculous rule during the Jester’s Festival[/i]
 
After you’ve completed the introductory quest, you’ll earn the delectable Pie of Misrule memento reward, which can be located within the Tools section of your Collections. Devour this tasty treat during the event period, and you’ll be granted a 2-hour long 100% XP buff!
 [h2]Crack Open Crates![/h2] 
During the Jester’s Festival, you can complete various event-specific daily quests. For each quest you complete, you’ll receive one [b]Jester's Festival Box[/b] as compensation for your hard work. Even better, the [b]first[/b] Jester’s Festival quest you complete each day will replace your normal reward with a [b]Stupendous Jester's Festival Box[/b], containing even-more fantastical prizes!
 
All boxes can include the following items:
       [list][*]Festive Dazzlers [/*][*]Cherry Blossom Confetti[/*][*]Revelry Pies[/*][*]Festive Furnishings [/*][*]Jesters Festival Provisioning Recipes [/*][*]Treasures that can be sold to vendors for Gold[/*][*]Previous years’ style pages [/*][/list]
On top of the above prizes, the Stupendous Jester’s Festival Box has a chance to contain the following goodies:
       [list][*]Jester's Scintillator Runebox [/*][*]Cherry Blossom Branch Runebox [/*][*]Cadwell's Kitchen Weapon Style Page[/*][*]High value Treasures [/*][*]Festive noise maker parts [/*][*]Joke Popper Fragments [/*][*][b]New:[/b] Jester's Minstrel Daedroth Costume Fragment[/*][/list]
In addition to the above, Stupendous Jester’s Festival Boxes also have a small chance to include the following items instead of a Costume Fragment.
   [list][*][b]New:[/b] Bucket Style Page [/*][*][b]New:[/b] Broom Style Page [/*][*]A [b]previously[/b] available style page [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/7228d14447202c8b3467a3f42127b05f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/7228d14447202c8b3467a3f42127b05f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]New Jester’s Festival rewards[/i]
 
Don’t miss the event quest introduced just last year, [b]Getting the Band Together[/b]. You can kick this quest off by speaking to Samuel Gourone, who can be found at each festival pavilion. As a reward for completing this quest, you’ll receive an additional daily reward box!
 [h2]Snag Zany Prizes[/h2] 
During the event, you will earn three Event Tickets for the first Jester’s Festival quest completed each day. That means you can earn up to 24 tickets total! [b]DON’T FORGET:[/b] The maximum number of Event Tickets you can carry is 12 at a time. If you earn more while already at the ticket cap, they’ll be lost to Oblivion!
 
Take these Event Tickets to the Impresario event merchant and you’ll be able to trade them for the following wares:
    [list][*]All three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments [/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][/list][list][*]The all three fragments for the Passion's Muse personality[/*][list][*]Bottle of Silver Mist[/*][*]Delicate Dancer's Baton[/*][*]Pressed Lily Petal Insoles[/*][/list][/list][list][*][b]New:[/b] Bound fragments for the Jester's Minstrel Daedroth Costume[/*][*][b]New:[/b] Bound Style Page: Bucket[/*][*][b]New:[/b] Bound Style Page: Broom [/*][*][b]New:[/b] Hide Shoulder Collectible[/*][/list]
If you miss your chance to snag the Hide Shoulder Collectible during this Jester’s Festival, don’t worry! You’ll be able to return to her assistant, Philius Dormier, at any time and pick up the Collectible there.
 
Additionally, the second and third fragments of the Passion's Muse personality, the Delicate Dancer's Baton and the Pressed Lily Petal Insoles, all arrive during this period.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/532d5e97fde64bd4a809262b5f486bee.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/532d5e97fde64bd4a809262b5f486bee.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Passion’s Muse personality[/i]
 
Be sure to grab it and any of the other fragments you need so you can complete the set!
 [h2]Let Lunacy Run Wild![/h2] 
Revel in the ridiculous during this year’s Jester’s Festival by completing event quests and acquiring unique rewards as you help spread the silly season to all corners of Tamriel. Tell us what wacky hijinks you’re planning during this event via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Jester’s Festival in-game event begins Wednesday, March 29 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Thursday, April 6 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Scribes of Fate & Update 37 Now Live On PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c35885c86b4446dd587aad711c9eb3ea.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Begin your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure with the Scribes of Fate dungeon DLC and Update 37 base-game patch. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC game pack and free Update 37 base-game patch are both now live on PC/Mac. If you play on Xbox or PlayStation, don’t worry because this dungeon DLC and update will arrive on consoles March 28. 
 
Challenge yourself and your team with two exciting new dungeons, Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall, and commence your Shadow Over Morrowind saga. 

[previewyoutube=_B1-fgKZZdI;full][/previewyoutube]
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																      							    							      								      									 
You can access the DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store[/url].
 
This release also includes the free Update 37 base-game patch, which provides all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of additions and improvements to the game, completely free. Check out the patch notes for both Scribes of Fate and Update 37 on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]our official forums[/url].
 [h2]Scribes of Fate DLC Game Pack[/h2] 
Gather your allies and venture into brand-new four-player PvE dungeons: Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall. In these dungeons, you discover two unique stories that kick off the larger Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, leading into the upcoming [i]Necrom [/i]Prologue and [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter release later this year. 
 
[b]Bal Sunnar[/b]
 
The Telvanni township of Bal Sunnar has begun emanating mysterious temporal magics, and the Psijic Order needs your help investigating this dangerous phenomenon. However, House Telvanni is not fond of outsiders meddling in its business and stand ready to defend its secrets at any cost.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bal Sunnar[/i]
 
In Bal Sunnar, you and your allies must battle through time itself as you race to uncover the truth behind the temporal anomaly before its chaotic influence can spread to all of Morrowind. Learn more about this dungeon’s setting, challenges, and rewards in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63745]our recent preview[/url]. 
 
[b]Scrivener’s Hall[/b]
 
The Scribes of Mora were once a peaceful organization dedicated to the collection of information on behalf of the Lord of Knowledge, Hermaeus Mora. However, a sinister new leader has usurped control over the cult and threatens to lead the Scribes of Mora down a dangerous path. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scrivener’s Hall[/i]
 
Team up with the Scribes of Mora’s former leader, Keshargo, and travel between realms as he seeks a powerful relic that is key to reclaiming his position as Magnastylus. As you do this, you also need to stop the ambitious Valinna before she can forever damn the souls of her followers. Discover more about Scrivener’s Hall’s dangers, settings, and rewards [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63775]in this preview[/url].
 
You can also attempt both dungeons in normal, veteran, and hard mode difficulties. Each mode features unique rewards and Achievements, including six new item sets, two monster sets, and a host of collectibles including a new skin, emotes, and more—good luck!
 [h2]Getting Started with Scribes of Fate[/h2] 
You can access [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC game pack via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus membership[/url] or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store[/url] (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.
 
The Scribes of Fate Collector’s Bundle is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Antecedent Scholar’s Guar mount, the Blightlord’s Skeever pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c5ef13a1db262eaa6a14911b50387a5b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c5ef13a1db262eaa6a14911b50387a5b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scribes of Fate Collector’s Bundle[/i]
 
With access to the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, you can begin your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure by the following methods:
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Stonefalls (Bal Sunnar) and The Rift (Scrivener’s Hall)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you receive the Lost emote! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Lost emote and other dungeon rewards[/i]
 [h2]Update 37 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
In addition to the dungeon DLC, this launch also includes the Update 37 base-game patch. This new patch is completely free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players and introduces a host of fixes, additions, and improvements to the game. 
 
[b]Screen Narration[/b]
 
With Update 37, we’ve added an all-new accessibility feature: screen narration. With screen narration turned on, the majority (but not all) of the game’s menus are narrated. You can enable this new setting in the Accessibility menu under Settings. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Screen Narration[/i]
 
With this setting enabled, you can choose between a masculine or feminine voice and set the volume and speed of the narration. It is available in English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
 
[b]Hide Shoulders[/b]
 
This new patch also introduces a new cosmetic tool: Hide Shoulders. Available for Event Tickets from the Impresario event vendor, Hide Shoulders works like Hide Helm and allows you to hide this part of your outfit when customizing your look in an Outfit Station. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hide Shoulders[/i]
 
Look for future event announcements to find out when you’ll have your first opportunity to acquire this new outfit option.
 
[b]Housing Improvements[/b]
 
Finally, Update 37 also includes a host of quality-of-life improvements for the Housing System, including new filters for the editor’s placement and retrieval tabs, the ability to reset training dummies, and the ability to see a full list of furnishings when shopping both furnished and unfurnished homes. 
 
These are just some of the free additions and improvements coming to the game, so be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url] to discover more! 
 [h2]Your Fate Beckons [/h2] 
The Shadow Over Morrowind saga kicks off with Update 37 and [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] dungeon DLC. Are you ready to explore Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall? A whole new adventure beginsone that will take you and your fellow adventurers to the Telvanni Peninsula and realms beyond! Tell us if you’ll be tempting fate and delving into these challenging two dungeons via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—have fun!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate DLC game pack and free Update 37 base-game patch are now live on PC/Mac and arrives on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Scribes of Fate Preview—Scrivener’s Hall
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/8fa35d1105709ca51f4bd961089d2ef8.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Reclaim a powerful Daedric artifact and save the Scribes of Mora from a dangerous usurper in Scrivener’s Hall.[/i]
 
Part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, Scrivener’s Hall is one of the two all-new dungeons included in the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, arriving on PC/Mac on March 13 and on Xbox and PlayStation consoles March 28.
 [h2]A Change in Leadership[/h2] 
Since their founding, the Scribes of Mora have dedicated their lives in secret to the Lord of Knowledge, Hermaeus Mora. However, the Scribes’ long-time leader Keshargo was recently ousted by the upstart Valinna, who has other, more sinister plans for the cult.
 
“The Scribes of Mora were a passive organization dedicated to mapping the Daedric planes,” explains Mike Finnigan, [i]ESO[/i]’s Encounters Lead. “Their primary goal was seeking information and gathering knowledge as befits followers of Hermaeus Mora. However, Valinna's goal is to transform the Scribes into a militant force of devout zealots.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/2ff1822e47dcd7c2a07e07df266b60cc.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/2ff1822e47dcd7c2a07e07df266b60cc.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore the library of the Scribes of Mora[/i]
 
“In order to achieve her goals, she knows she needs to locate the Itinerant Staff, the traditional symbol of power for the Scribes, which has the ability to instantly return the wielder to Scrivener's Hall,” explains Finnigan. “Keshargo knows where the staff is hidden, but he is not talking.”
 
To reclaim the title of “Magnastylus,” Keshargo must retrieve the Itinerant Staff himself before Valinna can find it. He’ll need your help sneaking into the Scrivener’s Hall, battling back Valinna’s devout followers, and returning the Scribes of Mora to their original purpose. 
 [h2]Empowered by Mora[/h2] 
The Scribes of Mora might have been a peaceful order in the past, but under Valinna’s twisted leadership, they have become fearsome battlemages, capable of wielding dangerous spells and controlling massive magical constructs. 
 
“The Scribes of Mora being dedicated followers of Hermaeus Mora is an obvious connection to the larger Shadow Over Morrowind story,” explains Finnigan. “And as a result of their devotion, you will see monsters within the dungeon using powerful Arcanist abilities.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Face cultists empowered by Hermaeus Mora[/i]
 
“As a group dedicated to traveling through Daedric planes, players can also expect to encounter some different realms of Oblivion,” says Finnigan. “Some will seem familiar, such as the Deadlands, but players will also get to explore the Spiral Skein, the Daedric Plane of Mephala, too.”
 
As you make your way to the Itinerant Staff and venture between realms, in addition to the Scribes, you’ll need to contend with bloodthirsty Dremora and hulking Daedric monsters, such as one of the dungeon’s bosses, Ozezan. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/ca09f8923509582d1c4406c2f0e024da.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/ca09f8923509582d1c4406c2f0e024da.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The monstrous Ozezan the Inferno[/i]
 
“All of the dungeon’s bosses have unique mechanics that players haven't seen before,” says Finnigan. “But I think Ozezan the Inferno is worth highlighting as we have not used an Infernium in a dungeon before. Monster placement is key in this battle, and it will test players’ positioning to ensure the boss doesn’t fill the entire space with lava.”
 
Ultimately, you and your allies must help Keshargo finally confront Valinna herself, empowered by an unknown force, and stop her before the Scribes of Mora are forever damned. As part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, what you uncover in Scrivener’s Hall will lead directly into the story to come, and this might not be the last time you encounter the Itinerant Staff.  
 [h2]Gifts of Knowledge (and Power)[/h2] 
Should you help Keshargo reclaim the mantle of leadership, you’ll unlock a mysterious collection of collectibles and items, some unique to Scrivener’s Hall. This includes the Iterative Onyx Glyphic memento (for completing the dungeon on Veteran difficulty), the Sextant emote (for completing optional content in both dungeons), and the Lost emote (earned simply by entering one of the two new dungeons). 
 
In addition to the above, Scrivener’s Hall also drops three unique gear sets and a new monster set. This includes the Runecarver’s Blaze light set, which can help boost the damage you do with your damage over time abilities. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/d6eac3c9f54cbd47bcb0a4c439651036.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/d6eac3c9f54cbd47bcb0a4c439651036.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
“Runecarver's Blaze adds even more fuel to your fire,” explains Nadav Pechthold, the Combat Designer behind the dungeon's item sets. “Lay on multiple damage over time abilities and watch your enemies light up every time one of them hits that three-second tick.”
 
With these arcane new item sets and collectibles, Scrivener’s Hall allows you to claim Hermaeus Mora’s boons for yourself. 
 [h2]Save the Scribes[/h2] 
The Scribes of Mora’s new leader has set them upon a destructive path, and Keshargo needs your help returning the Daedric cult to their original purpose. Are you ready to travel between realms and claim the Itinerant Staff? Tell us if you’re excited to delve into Scrivener’s Hall when the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC launches this month via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].  
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate and Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Scribes of Fate Preview—Bal Sunnar
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/4f2fb4a4fd544affe8a1b3eab2386d12.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Battle your way through time as you and your allies investigate a temporal anomaly in Bal Sunnar, one of the two new dungeons arriving with the Scribes of Fate DLC![/i]
 
Kicking off the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, Bal Sunnar is one of two exciting new dungeons included in the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, arriving on PC/Mac on March 13 and on Xbox and PlayStation consoles March 28. 
 [h2]Telvanni Temporal Tribulations[/h2] 
Located in the eastern region of Stonefalls, the remote Telvanni township of Bal Sunnar has endured in isolation for centuries. However, mysterious magical energies have begun to emanate from the village, prompting one of Tamriel’s most-secretive orders to investigate. 
 
“Bal Sunnar is kind of tucked away in the mountains and generally keeps to itself,” explains Mike Finnigan, [i]ESO[/i]’s Encounters Lead. “The problem is that there is a temporal anomaly present in the town. Someone is using time magic, so the Psijic Order has come to investigate.”
 
To this end, Saresea has arrived at the gates of Bal Sunnar, and you and your party must help the Psijic Order agent explore the Telvanni town, find the source of the temporal magics, and shut it down.
										      							    							      								      		<iframe width="100%" height="480" style="width: 100%; height: 480px; border: none; max-width: 100%;" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="" allow="xr-spatial-tracking; gyroscope; accelerometer" scrolling="no" src="https://kuula.co/share/Nyss6?fs=1&vr=1&sd=1&initload=0&thumbs=1&info=0&logo=0"></iframe>							      							    							      								      									 
As part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, what you find in Bal Sunnar will reverberate throughout the adventures to come.
 
“Why the temporal anomaly is here in this place is a mystery,” says Finnigan. “But WHAT the anomaly truly is and its ultimate purpose is an even bigger one.” 
 [h2]Battle Through Time[/h2] 
Despite the danger the anomaly represents, House Telvanni has no love of outsiders meddling in their affairs, and they stand read to defend their secrets by any means necessary. 
 
“When you first arrive in Bal Sunnar, the Telvanni seem to recognize you, even calling you the ‘scourge,’” says Finnigan. “This is a bit weird considering you haven’t been here before, but as you dive deeper into the dungeon, you will begin to realize why that is. Even worse, some of the enemies seem to have embraced the temporal magic and use it to their advantage in battle.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bal Sunnar’s defenders utilize temporal magics[/i]
 
House Telvanni conjurers, mages, and even more fearsome beasts guard the town, and as you progress, you’ll discover the anomaly’s full power and find yourself and your allies unstuck in time—with each area bringing new experiences and challenges. 
 
“The dungeon’s first section is Dark Elf in the traditional sense, and it features common allies they have co-opted,” explains Finnigan. “The second section adds more animalistic enemies common to Morrowind (such as nix-oxen and nix-hounds), while the third section sees the town in the throes of Peryite worship with heavy influences from poison and disease effects.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/2b73e8d704b8ed07952c38ecb78ee8f5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/2b73e8d704b8ed07952c38ecb78ee8f5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Encounter Bal Sunnar across time[/i]
 
Temporal magics are powerful and unpredictable, and the Telvanni have made good use of them to bolster their defenses. This is especially true in each of the dungeon’s three boss fights, such as Roksa the Warped, a massive, mutated nix-ox that is sure to keep your party on its toes. 
 
Despite these challenges, you are not without help, and you and your allies should look to Saresea’s own power as a member of the Psijic Order to overcome Bal Sunnar’s various threats. 
 [h2]Eternal Rewards[/h2] 
Should you battle your way through time and succeed in stopping the anomaly, you’ll uncover a host of rewards, many unique to this dungeon. This includes four new item sets (including a new monster set) in addition to new titles, Achievements, collectibles, and more. 
 
Collectibles you can earn from Ban Sunnar include the Lost emote (earned by simply entering either one of the two Scribes of Fate dungeons), the Taskmaster’s Banner skin (earned via completion on Veteran difficulty), and the Sextant emote (earned via completing optional content in both dungeons). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock new rewards with Scribes of Fate[/i]
 
Some of the new gear you’ll have an opportunity to acquire in Bal Sunnar includes the Nix-Hound’s Howl medium set, which buffs your Weapon and Spell Damage while also debuffing your foes. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/32ef96d66dc7b98d68f822136ed1850f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/32ef96d66dc7b98d68f822136ed1850f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
“Nix-Hound's Howl makes you the ultimate pest by taking your opponent's strength for yourself,” explains Nadav Pechthold, the Combat Designer behind Bal Sunnar’s new gear. “Not only does this set make you more powerful, but your allies will benefit from your weakened foe!”
 [h2]Scribe the Future[/h2] 
Telvanni mages, time-warped beasts, and Daedric cultists stand between you and the mystery at the heart of Bal Sunnar. In this new dungeon, you can commence your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and begin pulling at the threads of a larger storyline—one that threatens Nirn and Oblivion both. 
 
Are you ready to venture into time itself, confront House Telvanni, and assist the Psijic Order in putting an end to the temporal anomaly? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate and Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]
