notes.title: Update 37 Preview—Screen Narration, Hide Shoulders, & More
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/b7c5728ab43064c315e6dac7117909a2.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the new features everybody who plays ESO can enjoy with the Update 37 base-game patch. [/i]
 
Arriving in tandem with the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC pack on March 13 for PC/Mac and March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, the Update 37 base-game patch is a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players—no additional purchase required. This patch introduces a series of balance changes, bug fixes, and new features. 
 [h2]Screen Narration[/h2] 
The latest in [i]ESO[/i]’s ongoing accessibility-focused improvements, Update 37 introduces Screen Narration, allowing you to have the majority of the game’s menus (with some exceptions) narrated to you as you navigate. 
 
This option becomes available for everybody who enables Accessibility Mode in the game’s settings menu (navigate to Settings, then Accessibility), and it allows you to choose between a masculine or feminine voice and set both the speed and volume of the narration.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Screen Narration option[/i]
 
The narration is computer generated in the language you choose to play in (English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese). 
 
Note that some menus and UI elements are not supported by Screen Narration at this time, including Scrying, Excavating, Tales of Tribute, lockpicking, and certain fishing and Champion Point screens. In addition, some gameplay elements, such as combat, in-world navigation, and interactable objects are not narrated in addition to interactions with NPCs and character dialog (to ensure it does not conflict with the voice acting).
 
We plan to integrate additional menus into screen narration in the future, and we hope this new addition to our Accessibility Mode options helps our players get the most out of the game. 
 [h2]Hide Shoulders[/h2] 
Also arriving as part of Update 37 is Hide Shoulders, a new cosmetic Collectible that allows you to, well, hide whatever shoulder gear your character is currently wearing. Like Hide Helm, this option can be enabled when customizing your look in the Outfit Station. Simply navigate to Armor Styles, select Shoulders, and then select the Hide Shoulders “style.” 
 
To enable Hide Shoulders, you must first acquire it by spending Event Tickets at the Impresario during any of [i]ESO[/i]’s upcoming in-game events. Keep an eye out on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] for information on when the next event arrives—hint: it’s a silly one! 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/f944eba367ce20bf6c4aef74b0f42eaa.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/f944eba367ce20bf6c4aef74b0f42eaa.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Before and after using Hide Shoulders[/i]
 
We know the community has been asking for the ability to free their shoulders (without losing gear bonuses) for a long time now, and we can’t wait to see the stylish-AND-functional new looks that come with it! 
 [h2]Housing Improvements[/h2] 
Finally, we squeezed in some new quality-of-life improvements for the Housing System. This includes a set of new filters for the Housing Editor’s placement and retrieval tabs, allowing you to place items specifically from your bank, inventory, house storage, or collectibles, items that are bound or unbound, and items by the furnishing limit type they fall under.
 
We also added the ability to reset training dummies you're in combat with (making it easier to restart a parse) and improved your ability to see and manage who is in your home from the Housing Editor’s Settings menu. This includes real-time notifications when guests arrive and depart, plus an option to kick occupants out if they’re getting too rowdy! 
 
In addition, when shopping for a new house, you can see a full list of the furnishings that come with both the furnished and unfurnished versions before you buy. If you’re a Housing aficionado, look for these new features and more soon!
 [h2]Update 37 For All[/h2] 
These are just some of the highlights you can enjoy with the Update 37 base-game patch, and a host of further changes, additions, and improvements are not mentioned above. This includes updates to target markers (improving enemy player targeting and adding new settings) and a realignment of daily and weekly reset timers (10AM UTC for NA servers and 3AM UTC for EU servers) for daily quests, daily Enlightenment bonuses, daily writs, and more. 
 
Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Don’t forget, as a base-game patch, this update is [b]free for all[/b] existing [i]ESO[/i] players, with no purchase required! You can check out everything coming in Update 37 in the patch notes found in our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]Public Test Server forum right now[/url], or check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]live patch notes forum[/url] when it arrives in March!
 
Are you excited to dig into the changes and improvements coming with Update 37? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]! 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate and Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Crown Store Showcase—February 2023
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/152dcb4c5284779ba38203acdbfa104c.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover a host of fantastical and outlandish treasures coming to the in-game Crown Store in February 2023![/i]
 
Below, you can review all the items arriving in the in-game Crown Store this February 2023, but don’t forget to also check out those [b]currently available[/b] on the official website’s [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store page[/url], too. If you fancy any of these items, be sure to pick up some Crowns from the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/buycrowns]Buy Crowns page![/url]



 [h2]ESO Plus Deals[/h2] 
All ESO Plus™ members have access to a monthly selection of exclusive deals and items. You can find more information about them in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54825]this article[/url].



 
[b]Exclusive Free Items[/b]
 
[b]Statuette: Baron-Admiral Olo[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/400959b8067d592acf2b72d2fc96cf0c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/400959b8067d592acf2b72d2fc96cf0c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A miniature statue of Bendu Olo, Baron-Admiral of the All Flags Navy, as sculpted in High Isle.[/i]
 
The Statuette: Baron-Admiral Olo will be available in the Crown Store FREE, exclusively to ESO Plus Members on all platforms for a limited time, from February 16 to March 30, 2023, at 10AM EST.



 [h2]Crown Gem and Seals of Endeavor Items[/h2]
[b]Mounts[/b]
 
[b]Icereach Wicker-Steed [/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/b131e486b9222a4f08118091ce877717.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/b131e486b9222a4f08118091ce877717.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A bloodied Daedric dagger used by a spurned lover. The tears of a victim tormented by Molag Bal. When used in a wicked Icereach coven ritual, they help shape a wicker mount that is worthy of bearing everyone's worst nightmare: you. [/i]
 
The Icereach Wicker-Steed[b] [/b]will be available for Crown Gems and Seals of Endeavor on all platforms for a limited time, from February 6 to March 6, 2023, at 10AM EST.




 
 [h2]Adornments[/h2] 
[b]The Standing Wave[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/285102c42fc25c112d7cd133473f6b35.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/285102c42fc25c112d7cd133473f6b35.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Do you stand tall and proud, adventurer? Then so should your hair! Add to your already impressive height with The Standing Wave, the hairdo that's sweeping the Fighters Guild.[/i]
 
The Standing Wave will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 20 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Crafting[/h2] 
[b]Motifs[/b]
 
[b]Crown Crafting Motif: Drowned Mariner[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/e4970d908a5f36724ee53cdaef2c24f4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/e4970d908a5f36724ee53cdaef2c24f4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]"Growler" Silaine, Marine Salvager, urges you to outfit yourselves properly before venturing into Graven Deep or other dangerous locations—perhaps with this well-fashioned style. Use to learn the Drowned Mariner crafting style. Also has a chance to drop by defeating the final boss in Graven Deep.[/i]
 
The Crown Crafting Motif: Drowned Mariner[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms starting February 22, 2023 at 10AM EST. The Drowned Mariner Motif chapters, and very rarely the complete book, are also available in game from Zelvraak the Unbreathing in the dungeon Graven Deep, in High Isle.



 
[b]Outfit Styles[/b]
 
[b]Elder Scrolls Artifact: Fork of Horripilation[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/167b672887016e7f9bd3df620e19204e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/167b672887016e7f9bd3df620e19204e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Alter your one-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Fork of Horripilation Elder Scrolls Artifact, a weapon created by the Daedric Prince Sheogorath.[/i]
 
The Elder Scrolls Artifact: Fork of Horripilation Outfit Style[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 2 to February 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Sentinel of Rkugamz Arms Pack[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/22ddcf945c1ca6d3e5fe304d1fb036e6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/22ddcf945c1ca6d3e5fe304d1fb036e6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Dwarven centurion that guards Rkugamz may surprise those familiar with fighting these automatons. Undaunted, prepare yourselves well before venturing into this abandoned city. Alter your weapon's appearance to match the Undaunted Sentinel of Rkugamz awards by using this set of Outfit styles.[/i]
 
The Sentinel of Rkugamz Arms Pack[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 16 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item. The Sentinel of Rkugamz Mask Style Page has a chance to drop from the eponymous boss in Veteran Darkshade Caverns. The matching Shoulder Style Page can be obtained either by purchasing it for 50 Undaunted Keys from Maj al-Ragath or as a chance from Maj’s Mystery Coffer for 1 Undaunted Key. Having the achievement “Well Out of Warranty” will increase the drop chances of both items.



 [h2]Wardrobe[/h2] 
[b]Costumes[/b]
 
[b]Queen's-Eye Spymaster[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/eaf94b53cab5c46a72176bf1c2c43b70.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/eaf94b53cab5c46a72176bf1c2c43b70.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]You wish to maintain a low profile and yet exude competence, sexy coolness, and undeniable predatory intimidation all at once, yes? Then this one advises investing in a Queen's-Eye Spymaster costume and flipping a coin in the tavern's dark corner.[/i]
 
The Queen's-Eye Spymaster[b] [/b]costume will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 2 to February 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.




 
 
[b]Ancestral Homage Formal Gown[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/5a1ef36411404b741877c1df8cc7fca3.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/5a1ef36411404b741877c1df8cc7fca3.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]"There's nothing wrong with showing some healthy gray skin while paying homage to the Ancestors," says Voldsea Arvel. "The Ancestors won't mind, and your current incarnation deserves to be seen!"[/i]
 
The Ancestral Homage Formal Gown[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 6 to February 13, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.




 
 
[b]Vinedusk Vigilant[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/a1a3e26a838cd8afc4e2e58fdaa9d273.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/a1a3e26a838cd8afc4e2e58fdaa9d273.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Among the Vinedusk Rangers lurks an even more dangerous force: assassin-scouts who move quietly through forests, dealing with any who pose a threat. Sometimes called "tree ghosts," they wear custom-made gear that works with their preferred combat styles.[/i]
 
The Vinedusk Vigilant[b] [/b]costume will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 16 to March 2, 2023, at 10AM EST.




 
 
[b]Subterrane Excavator[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/fd5e4f4081b75d2383d5e20b5710cc85.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/fd5e4f4081b75d2383d5e20b5710cc85.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Spelunk in luxury! This mining gear is practically a home away from home when you're excavating precious underground resources—if you like living in your clothes![/i]
 
The Subterrane Excavator Costume[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 23 to March 2, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Crown Crates[/h2] 
[b]Akaviri Potentate Crate[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/324b15aabd2a15cd3a8fb04aa4da2904.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/324b15aabd2a15cd3a8fb04aa4da2904.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A mystery collection of Akaviri Potentate-related items![/i]
 
The Akaviri Potentate Crates[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 9 to March 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. You are guaranteed at least four rewards within each crate. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on the 15 Crate Bundle.



 [h2]Furniture [/h2] 
[b]Furnishing Pack: Heart's Day Retreat[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/32dba646dc20f7b7f70591864c43c09f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/32dba646dc20f7b7f70591864c43c09f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Set the scene properly for Heart's Day with this romantic furniture bundle, which includes flowers, sweetrolls, and more! Each item helps those so inclined fulfill on the day's delightful promise with their partners in the adventure called life.[/i]
 
The Furnishing Pack: Heart's Day Retreat will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 9 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Furnishing Pack: Steam Bath Serenity[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/14d8fdda247707428e5efb88dbc9b754.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/14d8fdda247707428e5efb88dbc9b754.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Pamper yourself by creating a relaxing retreat away from the travails of Tamriel! Featuring a replica of the alluring Mermaid of Anvil statue, this bundle includes burbling fountains, luscious greenery, comfortable seating, and more.[/i]
 
The Furnishing Pack: Steam Bath Serenity will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 9 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Music Box, Gonfalon Galliard[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/c3a9ada6cefc6d5b012c95ea823dd4d0.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/c3a9ada6cefc6d5b012c95ea823dd4d0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the sprightly "Gonfalon Galliard" composition.[/i]
 
The Music Box, Gonfalon Galliard will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 9 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST.



 
[b]Music Box, That Breezy Night in Bruma[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/397c011a38ae842511690801c325aeca.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/397c011a38ae842511690801c325aeca.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the romantic Heart's Day favorite, "That Breezy Night in Bruma."[/i]
 
The Music Box, That Breezy Night in Bruma will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 13 to February 20, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Furnishing Pack: Maormer Boarding Party[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/0492d3939f367d7044af23eb4c6c1928.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/0492d3939f367d7044af23eb4c6c1928.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Sea Elves rule the waves, but you've beaten them just the same. Celebrate your victory in battle by furnishing your home with "liberated" serpentine items, including a raiding party tent and a Maormer ship's prow![/i]
 
The Furnishing Pack: Maormer Boarding Party[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 23 to March 9, 2023, at 10AM EST.



 
[b]Furnishing Pack: The Clockwork God's Domain[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/4bf9268c55e82f06d9a212fb84119987.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/4bf9268c55e82f06d9a212fb84119987.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A wide selection of furnishings from Sotha Sil's mechanical simulacrum of Tamriel, the Clockwork City.[/i]
 
The Furnishing Pack: The Clockwork God's Domain[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 27 to March 6, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Houses[/h2] 
[b]Sweetwater Cascades[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/285bac5b7d915c196784a3a5208ca1d6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/285bac5b7d915c196784a3a5208ca1d6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Set in an idyllic location between Khajiiti and Imperial lands, this tranquil villa draws upon the Anequina Aqueduct for its dancing fountains and deep cisterns. After relaxing outside, retreat indoors to enjoy healthy nourishment and restful sleep.[/i]
 
The Sweetwater Cascades[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 9 to February 23, 2023, at 10AM EST. Furnished and unfurnished versions will be available.



 
[b]Colossal Aldmeri Grotto[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/f8bebb2dc4031309a3d83f1815dc6a54.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/f8bebb2dc4031309a3d83f1815dc6a54.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Once a watering stop for the High Elf navy, this great cavernous grotto on the Summerset coast west of Dusk features shipboard compartments, magnificent Aldmeri ruins, weathered wood from several shipwrecks, and a sparkling subterranean waterfall.[/i]
 
The Colossal Aldmeri Grotto[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 23 to March 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. Furnished and unfurnished versions will be available.



 [h2]Houseguests[/h2] 
[b]Makes-Many-Soups[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/111e8129447a4fb02202a1253fe69f00.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/111e8129447a4fb02202a1253fe69f00.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A chef of many soups, but perhaps only one at a time, the Argonian Makes-Many-Soups seeks to add her culinary creativity to your abode. After adding Makes-Many-Soups to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her. [/i]
 
Makes-Many-Soups[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 23 to March 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Mounts[/h2] 
[b]Dro-m'Athra Senche[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/ef93dbf8849624cf071592b3217730df.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/ef93dbf8849624cf071592b3217730df.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Senche-shaped dro-m'Athra are known to the Twilight Cantors as the sar-m'Athra, but everyone else just calls these eerie and uncanny mounts the Dro-m'Athra Senche.[/i]
 
The Dro-m'Athra Senche[b] [/b]mount will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 2 to February 9, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 
[b]Quasigriff[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/a3637e724a42f285b2fca46a79864944.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/a3637e724a42f285b2fca46a79864944.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]A product of wizardry and selective breeding, these chimeric steeds descend from Summerset gryphons. According to creator Irastimil Direnni, their wingless frame kept upkeep costs low, while maintaining superiority over the upstart Bretons' clumsy steeds.[/i]
 
The Quasigriff mount[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 16 to March 2, 2023, at 10AM EST.




 
 
[b]Vale Sabre Cat Growler[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/8ed10c2cd870f29fd3f20f7b11697797.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/8ed10c2cd870f29fd3f20f7b11697797.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bards in Skyrim claim these luminous sabre cats gain their glow from Kyne. Scholars in the College of Sapiarchs refute this, each with their own pet hypotheses. Everyone agrees that this growler's fur is silky soft and its rumbling purr soothing.[/i]
 
The Vale Sabre Cat Growler[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 20 to March 2, 2023, at 10AM EST.




 
 [h2]Personality[/h2] 
[b]Drunk[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/6d15bd912117fe2126e59f8df7851239.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/6d15bd912117fe2126e59f8df7851239.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Thish ish gonna make you wobble an' weave like you're intoxit … inebriash … drunk ash a skunk. It even worksh on High Elves.[/i]
 
The Drunk[b] [/b]personality[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 23 to March 2, 2023, at 10AM EST. ESO Plus Members will receive a discount on this item.



 [h2]Emotes[/h2] 
[b]Bright Moons Greeting[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/bf0abb9771f039592997b0b8b56b833c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/bf0abb9771f039592997b0b8b56b833c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Sweep your hands into a gesture revering the moons, Jone and Jode, with this Khajiiti greeting.[/i]
 
The Bright Moons Greeting[b] [/b]will be available in the Crown Store on all platforms for a limited time, from February 2 to February 9, 2023, at 10AM EST.




 
 
[b]Soul Gem, Parchment, Clippers[/b]
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/2ab471be1bf19e53e0ee5bbde5170331.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/2ab471be1bf19e53e0ee5bbde5170331.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go![/i]

notes.title: 2023 Global Reveal–Unveiling the New Arcanist Class
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/c5072476057afd103910cca1d5f690cd.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn more about ESO’s new Arcanist class, just announced as part of the 2023 ESO Global Reveal! [/i]
 [h2]Master the Power of Apocrypha[/h2] 
Unimaginable power is yours to wield at will with the all-new Arcanist class. Just unveiled today as part of the 2023 ESO Global Reveal, the Arcanist is [i]ESO[/i]’s seventh and newest class. Arriving with the upcoming [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter in June, it brings powerful new abilities and mechanics drawn from Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Oblivion. 
 
As a practitioner of this mystical new class, you can harness powerful runes, tomes of ancient knowledge, and the energy of Apocrypha itself to unleash destructive, defensive, or restorative magics. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/151fd4f1d928b181b53c325b0cdf9429.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/151fd4f1d928b181b53c325b0cdf9429.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Arcanist wields the secrets of Apocrypha[/i]
 
The Arcanist class also introduces a new combat mechanic: Crux. As you activate certain Arcanist class abilities, you generate Crux, which you can save up and spend when activating other specific abilities. The more Crux you generate before spending (up to a maximum of three), the more your ability is empowered when you do spend it! How you utilize the Crux generating and spending abilities in your combat rotations can have a major impact on your effectiveness, so plan accordingly! 
 [h2]Wield Three New Skill Lines[/h2] 
No matter your character or role, the Arcanist class unlocks exciting new abilities and creates new ways to play via its three unique skill lines. 
 
If you like to play offense, when wielding the destructive magics of the damage-focused [b]Herald of the Tome [/b]skill line, you manipulate arcane energies to bombard your foes with damaging blasts, beams, and more. This includes active abilities such as [b]Runeblades[/b], which launches lethal projectiles at your foes, generating Crux as you do.
 
Prefer to play a supporting role? With the restorative [b]Curative Runeforms s[/b]kill line, you can make use of healing runes to keep your party (or yourself) healthy, shield your allies from damage, or even help them navigate the battlefield via portals with the [b]Apocryphal Gate[/b] ability, which summons a passage between worlds!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/bbded8b03068e895c00735af0f168bd6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/bbded8b03068e895c00735af0f168bd6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Walk between worlds with the Arcanist[/i]
 
If you like to play defensively and protect your allies, the magic of the [b]Apocryphal Soldier[/b] skill line allows you to dominate your foes’ attention, buff yourself or your party’s defensive capabilities, and even conjure an explosive damage shield with [b]Runespite Ward[/b], which can be improved with Crux.
 
This is, of course, just a taste of the kind of power you can unlock when wielding the Arcanist class, as each skill line features a full suite of potent active, passive, and Ultimate abilities, many of which generate or utilize Crux.
 
Keep an eye out for more on the new Arcanist class as we get closer to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i]’s launch in June, and don’t forget to check out everything related to [i]ESO[/i]’s newest Chapter and the 2023 Global Reveal on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url]. 
 
Are you excited to begin your journey into the arcane mysteries of Apocrypha? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and arrives for PC/Mac on June 5, 2023, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 20, 2023. Pre-purchase Necrom now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and [b]immediate access[/b] to the Sadrith Mora Spore Steed mount and Sadrith Mora Spore Pony pet*. Don't miss out![/i]
 
[i]*Sadrith Mora Spore Pony pet is available only until April 18, 2023.[/i]

notes.title: 2023 Global Reveal—Necrom’s Telvanni Peninsula & Apocrypha Zones
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/9ac505c887bb3b706b7686794b6fc4f7.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the two new zones just announced as part of the upcoming Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom Chapter! [/i]
 [h2]Two New Zones[/h2] 
[i]ESO[/i]’s intrepid adventurers will get the opportunity to explore two all-new zones in the upcoming [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter: the [b]Telvanni Peninsula[/b] and [b]Apocrypha[/b]. First shown today as part of the 2023 ESO Global Reveal livestream, these new regions will be open to outsiders when the new Chapter launches in June. 
 
Located along the eastern coast of Morrowind, the [b]Telvanni Peninsula[/b] is home to House Telvanni. If you’ve previously explored Sadrith Mora within the island of Vvardenfell, you might be familiar with the region’s alien landscape, including its giant mushrooms and the mages who call it home. However, separate from the Telvanni yet at the center of it all is the zone’s capital, Necrom. Also known as the city of the dead, Necrom has not been seen in an [i]Elder Scrolls [/i]game since 1994’s [i]The Elder Scrolls: Arena.[/i] In this new Chapter, you’ll have an opportunity to venture through the Dark Elf city, experience its solemn purpose, and uncover its ancient history and lore. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/9d0e781258f560f12443867c41981257290950.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/9d0e781258f560f12443867c41981257290950.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Dive Deep into a new region of Morrowind[/i]
 
In this new Chapter, you can also explore the endless library of [b]Apocrypha[/b], Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Oblivion, and uncover secrets hidden from mortals and Daedra alike. Home to both the followers of the Lord of Knowledge and the lost souls of those who once sought to learn its secrets, Apocrypha is unlike any Daedric realm you have experienced in [i]ESO[/i] before. You might have delved into some aspects of this part of Oblivion from [i]The Elder Scrolls Online V: Skyrim—Dragonborn[/i], but in the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, you should be prepared to discover all-new areas not seen before in any of your previous adventures.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/258247049ad14aa8805c12c8d7e05cc3.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/258247049ad14aa8805c12c8d7e05cc3.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Don’t Get Lost in Mora’s Endless Library[/i]
 
Both new regions host all manner of challenges, including new delves, public dungeons, world bosses, a new Trial, and a brand-new type of world event. As you may expect from an [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] game, each zone has its own mysteries for you to uncover, and as you progress your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, you can also discover a host of stand-alone side quests and encounter a diverse assortment of non-player characters.
 [h2]Encounter New Allies & Rewards[/h2] 
In your journeys into the new zones, you can recruit [b]two all-new Companions[/b], the Redguard Arcanist Azandar Al-Cybiades and Argonian Warden Sharp-As-Night. Each Companion features their own personalities, abilities for you to unlock, and stories to tell (including their own quests). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/16eca308c332ceb72b3408f4b9b60829.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/16eca308c332ceb72b3408f4b9b60829.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Azandar Al-Cybiades and Sharp-As-Night[/i]
 
Both new zones also provide no shortage of rewards for those brave enough to venture into their darkest corners. This includes 10 new item sets, new Antiquities to dig up, new collectibles to unlock, and a host of new Achievements and Titles to earn. Finally, [i]Necrom[/i]’s zones also allow you to unlock [b]the newest Tales of Tribute deck[/b]—Almalexia! 
 [h2]Explore Worlds Beyond[/h2] 
Two bizarre and wonderful worlds await you in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i]. Are you excited to explore the city of the dead? Or perhaps you’re eager to lose yourself in the endless libraries of Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Oblivion? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and arrives for PC/Mac on June 5, 2023, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 20, 2023. notes.title: Explore Elsweyr’s Warm Sands During the Season of the Dragon Celebration Event
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/aa4472c588625b38e46653b975098243.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Defend the home of the Khajiit from the Dragon threat and earn bonus rewards during this new in-game event![/i]
 
’Tis the Season for Drake-Slaying! The Season of the Dragon Celebration begins Thursday, January 26 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, February 7 at 10AM EST. Throughout the event, you can collect special Reward Boxes and benefit from increased drops to Daily Quests, Dungeons, and Trials throughout the regions of Northern and Southern Elsweyr.
 
To participate, you must have access to the [i]Elsweyr[/i], [i]Dragonhold[/i], [i]Wrathstone[/i], or [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLCs, which are all available right now via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or available for purchase from the in-game Crown Store. You can then kick off the festivities by obtaining the introductory quest “Bane of Dragons,” available for free within the in-game Crown Store or from Samara, found near the Impresario tent outside of Rimmen.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/e665b3e844caab820fa842cd93f43e02.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/e665b3e844caab820fa842cd93f43e02.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore Northern or Southern Elsweyr[/i]
 [h2]Reap Marvelous Treasures[/h2] 
During the Season of the Dragon Celebration, you and your fellow adventurers can net a Glorious Elsweyr Reward Box once per day upon finishing the first Daily Quest in Northern or Southern Elsweyr, or from the first Sunspire Trial Weekly Quest completed that day. 
 
Glorious Elsweyr Reward Boxes can contain the following items:
             [list][*]Guaranteed one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A green, blue, or purple Elsweyr salable treasure[/*][/list][*]Guaranteed one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A blue or purple Elsweyr overland set item[/*][/list][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Elsweyr crafting style item[/*][*]Elsweyr crafting motif style page[/*][list][*]Anequina, Pelletine, Dragonguard, Shield of Senchal, and New Moon styles[/*][/list][/list][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Transmutation Crystals, Dragon's Blood, Dragon's Plunder, Dragon’s Rheum, or Dragon's Bile[/*][*]Elsweyr treasure map[/*][*]Dragon document recipes[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Claw-Dance Acolyte armor style page[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/6b5ce5e5f8bbd69addce1b6be0709423.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/6b5ce5e5f8bbd69addce1b6be0709423.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn a new style when defending Elsweyr[/i]
 
In addition, you can earn Regular Elsweyr Reward Boxes by participating in the following activities:
          [list][*]Finishing the Bane of Dragons introductory quest[/*][*]Repeating Daily Quests[/*][*]Slaying Dragons/world bosses in Northern or Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]Defeating [i]Wrathstone[/i] and [i]Scalebreaker[/i] dungeon bosses[/*][*]Opening treasure chests[/*][*]Opening safeboxes[/*][*]Looting objects such as barrels, crates, etc.[/*][*]Looting Psijic portals[/*][*]Cracking open Thieves Troves[/*][*]Harvesting crafting resource nodes[/*][/list]
These less-rare-but-equally-as-enticing Regular Elsweyr Reward Boxes can contain the following items:
             [list][*]Guaranteed one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A green or blue Elsweyr salable treasure[/*][/list][*]Guaranteed one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A green, blue, or purple Elsweyr overland set item[/*][/list][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Elsweyr crafting style item[/*][*]Elsweyr treasure map or survey report[/*][*]Elsweyr crafting motif style page[/*][list][*]Anequina, Pelletine, Dragonguard, Shield of Senchal, and New Moon styles[/*][/list][/list][*]Transmutation Crystals, Dragon's Blood, Dragon's Plunder (1k salable), Dragon’s Rheum, or Dragon's Bile[/*][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Dragon document recipes[/*][*]Claw-Dance Acolyte armor style page[/*][/list][/list][h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
Additionally, during the event period, you’ll receive one Event Ticket for the first Daily Quest completed in Northern Elsweyr and another for the first Daily Quest finished in Southern Elsweyr. This means you can earn up to 26 Event Tickets during this event, allowing you to acquire the following items from the Impresario event vendor:
          [list][*]All three Passion Dancer Blossom pet fragments[/*][list][*]Chartreuse Lily Petals[/*][*]Enchanted Silver Flute[/*][*]Mystical Sheet Music[/*][/list][*]The first Passion Muse personality fragment[/*][list][*]Bottle of Silver Mist[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the following:[/*][list][*]Claw-Dance Acolyte Armor Pack[/*][/list][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
The Season of the Dragon Celebration will serve as your first opportunity to obtain this year’s Morphing Collectible: Passion Dancer Blossom pet. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/3416c0e0014e2d00113dda648255fb78.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/01/3416c0e0014e2d00113dda648255fb78.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
Additionally, you can get your hands on the first of three morphing fragments for this pet, the Bottle of Silver Mist, which serves as one of the ingredients to build the Passion’s Muse personality. Learn more about how morphing collectibles and upgrade fragments work in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]guide article[/url] and keep an eye out for the reveal of the next morphing fragment!
 
Finally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:
     [list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Dawnwood Indrik Berries[/*][*]Spectral Indrik Berries[/*][*]Springtide Indrik pet[/*][*]Haunting Indrik pet[/*][/list][h2]Defend Elsweyr[/h2] 
Join the Khajiit in their battle to protect their homeland and earn a host of bonus rewards as you explore Elsweyr and confront the Dragon threat. Are you excited to experience (or revisit) one of [i]ESO[/i]’s most beloved zones and adventures? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Season of the Dragon Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, January 26 at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, February 7 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Celebrate a Big 2022 with these End-of-Year Official ESO Livestreams
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2021/12/82391b73b43a3c51b3d9f0bc6b148ff9.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Tune in as ESO Community Managers from across the world  make merry and usher in the new year through a variety of light-hearted  livestreams![/i]
  
After a year of foiling sinister plots, restoring peace to  the Systres Archipelago, and playing a few hands of Tales of Tribute along the  way, it’s time we bring 2022 to a close. notes.title: Make Merry & Earn Special Rewards During the New Life Festival Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/12/7f9f471676e35bd75f30bdfcbd7cc80b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Pick up the final fragment of the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh and other goodies during Tamriel’s end-of-year celebration.[/i]
 [h2]’Tis the Season in Tamriel[/h2] 
The New Life Festival in-game event begins Thursday, December 15, 2022, at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, January 3, 2023, at 10AM EST. If you’d like to take part in this end-of-year jubilee, you’ll first need to acquire the event’s starter quest, “The New Life Festival,” located within the in-game Crown Store.
 
Once you’ve acquired the quest, make your way to the New Life Herald Breda’s tent, found south of the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch. You can also teleport directly to her location via the portal found at any Impresario location. Completing this quest grants you Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug, which can be used from your Collectibles/Tools menu to gain a +100% XP buff for two hours during the event runtime.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/12/3d491a1995c48e415d3bb39b8945beca.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/12/3d491a1995c48e415d3bb39b8945beca.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find New Life Herald Breda to begin![/i]
 
Upon completing the introductory quest, you unlock 10 event-specific daily quests, nine from Breda and one from Petronius Galenus. These special assignments send you to each of the four corners of Tamriel, spreading holiday cheer wherever you go.
 [h2]No Good Deed Goes Un-gifted[/h2] 
Each time you complete one of the event’s daily quests, you’re rewarded with a New Life Festival Box. Within each of these wintery coffers, you can find some of the following rewards:
                   [list][*]Guaranteed one of the following items:[/*][list][*]A parcel of alchemy, provisioning, or enchanting crafting materials[/*][/list][*]A chance to receive one of the following items:[/*][list][*]2016 New Life Runebox[/*][*]2017 New Life Runebox[/*][*]2017 New Life Recipe[/*][*]New Life Furnishing[/*][*]Skinchanger Motif Page[/*][*]Imperial Writ[/*][*]Skaal Master Writ[/*][*]Snowball Pet Runebox[/*][*]Powderwhite Coney Pet Runebox[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Evergreen Armor Style Page[/*][*]Last Year’s Nord Carved Armor Style Page[/*][/list][*]A chance to receive one of the following items:[/*][list][*]Frost Miriam[/*][*]Bervez Juice[/*][/list][*]A chance to receive a bundle of consumable festival toys [/*][*]A chance to receive a Skinchanger style item[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/12/3b0d49876099dc0e444815c927b4d674.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/12/3b0d49876099dc0e444815c927b4d674.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn the new Evergreen Armor Style[/i]
 [h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
Throughout this holiday event, the first New Life Festival daily quest you complete rewards three Event Tickets in addition to the reward box. This means you can earn up to a whopping [b]60 Event Tickets[/b] by the end! However, keep in mind that you can hold up to 12 Event Tickets at any one time, so any further tickets you receive while already at cap are lost.
 
During the New Life Festival, the Impresario will update her stock with the following items:
                 [list][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments:[/*][list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*][*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*][*]Kvatchian Incense[/*][/list][*]All components for 2022’s morphing collectibles:[/*][list][*]Scales of Akatosh[/*][*]Aurelic Quasigriff[/*][*]Daggerfall Paladin[/*][/list][*]All three Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh fragments: [/*][list][*]Engraved Glassblowing Tools[/*][*]Hallowed White-Gold Ingot[/*][*]Mysterious Time-Lost Sands[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the following:[/*][list][*]Evergreen Armor Style Pages[/*][/list][*]Powderwhite Coney pet[/*][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
This event also includes the last remaining fragment needed to construct this year’s final event Morphing Collectible, the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh. Decorate your house with this exclusive furnishing that gives you the ability to adjust the time of day in your home!
										      							    							      								      		

							      							    							      								      									
Additionally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:
[list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Pure Snow Indrik Berries[/*][*]Crimson Indrik Berries[/*][*]Frost-Light Indrik Pet[/*][*]Rosethorn Indrik Pet[/*][/list][h2]Usher in the New Year[/h2]
The current year may be nearing its conclusion, but you still have plenty of time to spread merriment and get your hands on some special end-of-year rewards. How do you plan to celebrate this year’s New Life Festival? Share your holiday plans, new year’s resolutions, and any winter-themed creations you’d like to flaunt with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. Happy Holidays!

[i]The New Life Festival in-game event begins this Thursday, December 15 at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, January 3 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Earn Rewards During the Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/0392ce033fa02b7ac8cf81506c0d5c86.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Get bonus rewards as you explore and quest in Western Skyrim and the Reach during the Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration Event! [/i]
 [h2]Delve into Darkness[/h2] 
The Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, November 17 at 10AM EST, and runs until Wednesday, November 29 at 10AM EST. During this in-game event, you can collect event-specific rewards and Event Tickets.
 
To kick off the event and begin your hunt, complete the free intro quest, [b]“Bloody Reunion,”[/b] found within the in-game Crown Store. You can also begin this quest at the Impresario’s tent or by receiving it from Mel Adrys, a Dark Elf found near Karthwatch.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/7bba2524b137cc09b452e3ad551ed8cc.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/7bba2524b137cc09b452e3ad551ed8cc.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore Western Skyrim and the Reach[/i]
 [h2]Secure Doomed Treasures[/h2] 
During the Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration, you can pick up a Glorious Box of the Grey Host Pillage once per day after completing a daily quest in Western Skyrim or The Reach, or after completing the weekly quest for the Kyne’s Aegis trial. 
 
Glorious Boxes of the Grey Host Pillage can contain the following items:
          [list][*]Green, Blue, or Purple Quality Skyrim Treasures[/*][*]Blue or Purple Quality Skyrim Overland Set Items[/*][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Skyrim Crafting Style Item (from among Blackreach Vanguard, Greymoor, Nighthollow, Arkthzand Armory, or Wayward Guardian)[/*][*]Skyrim Crafting Motif Style Page (from among Blackreach Vanguard, Greymoor, Nighthollow, Arkthzand Armory, or Wayward Guardian)[/*][/list][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Chaurus Egg, Vile Coagulant, or Crimson Nirnroot[/*][*]Western Skyrim or the Reach Treasure Map[/*][*]Skyrim Furnishing Recipes[/*][*][b]NEW:[/b] Saarthal Scholar Armor Style Page or a Sovngarde Stalwart Armor Style Page (returning from Lost Treasures of Skyrim)[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/4c61cb58af67441700d6e22111d6f2f8.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/4c61cb58af67441700d6e22111d6f2f8.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock event-specific rewards[/i]
 
You can also obtain Regular Boxes of the Grey Host Pillage containing similar rewards of lesser rarity through the completion of additional daily quests within the aforementioned zones or via the following activities:
          [list][*]Defeating Delve and World bosses[/*][*]Conquering Harrowstorms[/*][*]Slaying bosses from the [i]Harrowstorm[/i] and [i]Stonethorn[/i] DLC dungeons, Kyne’s Aegis trial, and Vateshran Hollows arena.[/*][*]Defeating monsters[/*][*]Opening Treasure Chests[/*][*]Opening Safeboxes[/*][*]Opening Clickables[/*][*]Looting Psijic Portals[/*][*]Cracking open Thieves Troves[/*][*]Harvesting Crafting Resource nodes[/*][/list]
Boxes of the Grey Host Pillage may contain some of the following items:
          [list][*]Green or Blue Quality Skyrim Treasures[/*][*]Green or Blue Quality Skyrim Overland Set Items[/*][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Skyrim Crafting Style Item (from among Blackreach Vanguard, Greymoor, Nighthollow, Arkthzand Armory, or Wayward Guardian)[/*][*]Western Skyrim or the Reach Treasure Map or Survey Report[/*][*]Skyrim Crafting Motif Style Page (from among Blackreach Vanguard, Greymoor, Nighthollow, Arkthzand Armory, or Wayward Guardian)[/*][/list][*]A chance for one of the following:[/*][list][*]Chaurus Egg, Vile Coagulant, or Crimson Nirnroot[/*][*]Skyrim Furnishing Recipes[/*][*][b]NEW:[/b] Saarthal Scholar Armor Style Page or a Sovngarde Stalwart Armor Style Page (returning from Lost Treasures of Skyrim)[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f3f6b9aceb1427fa2fca4fdf9c330431.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f3f6b9aceb1427fa2fca4fdf9c330431.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn bonus rewards when slaying Skyrim’s monsters[/i]
 
In addition to all these reward box treasures, you’ll benefit from bonus loot dropped during the following activities:
        [list][*]Western Skyrim and the Reach daily quest rewards[/*][*]Kyne's Aegis weekly quest[/*][*]Harrowstorm world events[/*][*][i]Harrowstorm[/i] and [i]Stonethorn[/i] DLC dungeons: Icereach, Unhallowed Grave, Castle Thorn, and Stone Garden[/*][*]World and delve bosses in Western Skyrim and the Reach[/*][*]Kyne's Aegis trial [/*][*]Vateshran Hollows arena[/*][*]Crafting resource nodes[/*][/list][h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2] 
Throughout the Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration, you can earn one Event Ticket for completing a daily quest in Western Skyrim or the Kyne’s Aegis weekly quest, and one additional Event Ticket for completing a daily quest in the Reach. You can therefore collect two Event Tickets each day of the event for a grand total of 26 tickets! But be sure to keep in mind that you can hold up to 12 Event Tickets at any one time. If you happen to earn more while you’ve already reached the ticket cap, they’ll be lost! 
 
During the celebration, the Impresario will stock the following items:
          [list][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments[/*][list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*][*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*][*]Kvatchian Incense[/*][/list][*]The first two Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh fragments[/*][list][*]Engraved Glassblowing Tools[/*][*]Hallowed White-Gold Ingot[/*][/list][*]Bound Saarthal Scholar Outfit Style Pages[/*][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
This event unlocks the next fragment you’ll need to craft this year’s final event Morphing Collectible, the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh. This unique furnishing allows you to adjust the time of day in your homestead, so you’ll want to get your hands on these fragments!
    							      								      									
Additionally, the Impresario’s colleague, Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor, has the following items available for purchase with Event Tickets:
[list][*]Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Pure Snow Indrik Berries[/*][*]Crimson Indrik Berries[/*][*]Frost-Light Indrik Pet[/*][*]Rosethorn Indrik Pet[/*][/list]
It’s up to you to confront the evil that lurks deep within the homeland of the Nords. Are you prepared to delve back into Skyrim’s dark heart? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Dark Heart of Skyrim Celebration begins Thursday, November 17 at 10AM EST, and runs until Wednesday, November 29 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong & Update 36 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/4d4e6816f31e84c0e13b65e170059659.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Protect the Legacy of the Bretons and bring your year-long adventure to its conclusion in The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong and Update 36. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i] and Update 36 base game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles November 15. 
 
Explore an all-new zone, discover the ancient lore of the druids of the Systres, and confront the Ascendant Lord in this final part of the year-long Legacy of the Bretons adventure. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=mfbTtfyb7Fk;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/h2] 
The untamed island of Galen, home to the druidic circles of the Systres Archipelago, is mired in chaos. The Breton city of Vastyr suffers unrelenting raids from Dreadsail pirates, while the Firesong Circle has started a war between the druids of the Systres. 
 
In this new story DLC, you will venture into the heart of a primeval new zone, assist the noble Society of the Steadfast and House Mornard, and uncover the forces and motives behind the chaos that has engulfed the island before it encompasses all the Systres. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Face the Ascendant Lord[/i]
 
This new DLC also includes bonus quests that you can unlock only by completing the [i]Firesong[/i] AND [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter main questlines. In these additional adventures, you’ll bring a final close to the year-long Legacy of the Bretons saga and confront the Ascendant Lord once and for all. 
 
[b]Explore Wild Galen[/b]
 
Primeval and wild, Galen has been home to the druids of the Systres for an age. In this new zone, you will have an opportunity to explore a world apart from those you’ve already experienced in the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter and get lost within the mysterious island’s dense jungles and perilous lava rivers. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/10/4a76830bb61fde86da3e693ee47a343f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/10/4a76830bb61fde86da3e693ee47a343f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore an all-new zone[/i]
 
In the new zone, you’ll have an opportunity to dive deep into the druids of the Systres and their connection to the Bretons of High Isle and Tamriel. From the city of Vastyr, a bastion of “civilization” in an otherwise untamed land, you’ll set out into the deep wilds and discover a host of new challenges, including new delves, roaming world bosses, volcanic vents, and stand-alone quests and storylines. Learn more about the new zone [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63087]in this preview[/url]. 
 
[b]Uncover Unique Rewards[/b]
 
As you venture into Galen, you’ll have an opportunity to earn unique rewards equal to the zone’s dangers, including new item sets, titles, Achievements, and collectibles. This includes the Firesong Obsidian Mask (a free adornment earned simply by entering the new zone), the Phoenix Moth pet (one of many quest rewards), a host of special styles earned via the Antiquities system and Tales of Tribute, and much more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/86c91038e846ed1edc2dfad29024eb03.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/86c91038e846ed1edc2dfad29024eb03.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Receive unique rewards[/i]
 
In addition to the above, [i]Firesong[/i] also introduces a brand-new Tales of Tribute patron: the Druid King. Unlocked by completing various zone activities, the Druid King patron and deck rewards those who carefully set up combos, and it can set up big swings in both the mid and late game. Learn more about the new patron and deck [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63009]in our preview[/url]. Don’t forget, you’ll need both [i]Firesong[/i] and the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter to unlock and play this new Tales of Tribute deck. 
 [h2]Getting Started in Firesong[/h2] 
The [i]Firesong[/i] DLC is free for all ESO Plus™ members and available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns, but you won’t lose any items or progress you earned while you had access.
 
If you acquired access to [i]Firesong[/i] via the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63067]Heroes of High Isle Reward Bundle[/url], the DLC will be waiting for you in your collections and you can jump right in. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f491aad23e3a7469ff2bc68eb58bdb9e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f491aad23e3a7469ff2bc68eb58bdb9e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i]
 
Releasing in tandem with the base DLC, the [i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available in the in-game Crown Store for 4,000 crowns and includes Cinderstone Kagouti mount, the Companion's Wolf Pup pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find the [i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i] in the Featured section of the Crown Store.
 
Once you have access to the [i]Firesong[/i] DLC, you can begin your exploration of this volatile part of Oblivion by the following methods:
 [list][*]By teleporting directly to the Vastyr Outskirts Wayshrine from      your map[/*]  [*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting      the “A Sea of Troubles” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*] [/list]
When you arrive in Galen, you can discover the new zone, begin the DLC’s storyline, or simply explore—it’s up to you! The first time you enter the zone, you’ll receive the Firesong Obsidian Mask collectible completely free as a bonus collectible reward.
 [h2]Update 36-Base Game Patch[/h2] 
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Firesong [/i]DLC, the Update 36 base-game patch is a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players that introduces Simplified Chinese localization to the game’s text along with a host of balance changes, bug fixes, and new features. These new additions include the ability to place unique target markers on enemies (allowing you to better coordinate with your allies), a text-to-speech accessibility option, the option to hide class pets within cities and towns (no longer will your crafting station be blocked by an unwelcome bear butt!), and a series of improvements to the Housing system.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/62961f94f19a4b06735848c05a50a591.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/62961f94f19a4b06735848c05a50a591.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
In particular, the Housing improvements feature the ability  to create chat links within your homes, provides greater visibility as to whose  house you’re currently visiting and how many people are currently present, grants  the ability to see a full list of furnishings within a home, allows you to  cycle through items with the Tab key, and implements improved placement  alignments for hundreds of different wall-hanging furnishings. We can’t wait to  see how the Housing community makes use of these new features and improvements! 

For everything related to [i]Firesong [/i]and Update 36, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url].


  [h2]Conclude Your Legacy[/h2]  
Explore an untamed world, dive deep into the lives and  culture of the druids, and fight to defend Galen from threats within and  without. In the [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i], you’ll finally be  able to confront the Ascendant Lord and bring your Legacy of the Bretons  year-long adventure to its epic conclusion. Are you ready to venture deep into  the perilous wilds of Galen? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong and Update 36 base  game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S,  PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles on November 15. [/i]
