notes.title: Hard Work Is Rewarded During the New Zeal of Zenithar In-Game Event
notes.content:
[i]Zenithar, the Divine of labor and commerce, is here to reward Tamriel’s many crafters, traders, and workers, with a new in-game event.[/i]
[h2]Honor Zenithar (and Make Some Coin)[/h2]
The Zeal of Zenithar in-game event kicks off on June 30 at 10AM EDT, and it continues until July 12 at 10AM EDT. To access the event, pick up the introductory quest "The Unrefusable Offer" from Amminus Varo at the Belkarth festival grounds in the Craglorn region (or get the free quest starter from the Crown Store). If you need help locating Belkarth, travel to the nearest Impresario tent, and use the portal nearby to transport yourself to the city.
 
Upon finishing the intro quest, you may then pick up the daily quest, "Honest Toil."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/97e51cc111458bc5f06799cea55801ad6447a9c6.jpg[/img]																																														      							    							      								      									 
[i]Craft, trade, and work to earn bonus rewards[/i]
 [h2]The Fruits of Your Labor[/h2] 
During the event, each time you complete the daily quest, you’ll receive one of Zenithar’s Sublime Parcel boxes. In addition, you can net Zenithar’s Delightful Parcel boxes by participating in the following activities:
       [list][*]Completing the introductory quest[/*][*]Completing any Master Writ[/*][*]First daily Crafting Writ, per account, completed each day [/*][*]Defeat a world boss while grouped with a player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*][*]Complete a world event while grouped with a player who is in at least one of your player guilds[/*][*]Conquering each round of a group-based arena challenge while grouped with a player who is in at least one of your player guilds has the chance of dropping a box [/*][list][*]The final round's reward chest contains a guaranteed parcel[/*][/list][/list]
Alternatively, if you're not interested in hard work, Akatosh forbid, there’s a small chance to steal parcels from hard-working Tamrielic citizens through pickpocketing, strongboxes, or thieves' troves.
 
Within a parcel box, there is a chance to acquire the following rewards for your efforts:
         [list][*]A tradeable outfit style page for the new High Rock Spellsword armor[/*][*]Crafting materials, provisioning ingredients, alchemy reagents, runestones, or a motif style item[/*][*]Crafting boosters[/*][list][*]Small chance of a gold-tier booster or a research time scroll[/*][/list][*]Furnishing or provisioning recipes[/*][*]Repair kits, siege repair kits, or a small chance for an Impresario group repair kit[/*][*]Treasure Maps, survey reports, Imperial City Vault Keys, companion gear, or a Random Currency Pouch[/*][list][*]The Random Currency Pouch can contain either gold or Tel Var stones; there is an extremely small chance that this is a jackpot amount that gives you 100,000 of the associated currency! [/*][list][*]The earnings from this pouch, jackpot or otherwise, are unaffected by any form of currency boosts[/*][/list][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3c7da1f2d33dc701fa86e7dab62d3e69a7c4fbe4.jpg[/img]																																													      							    							      								      									 
[i]Do your writs![/i]
 
Both boxes offer an opportunity to pick up these rewards, but the Sublime Parcel boxes provide the best chance to obtain the most valuable rewards.
 [h2]Global Event Modifiers[/h2] 
These event rewards aren’t the only thing you’re eligible to receive during the Zeal of Zenithar event! Throughout the span of the event, everybody will benefit from modifiers to the following in-game global effects:
        [list][*]Wayshrine travel costs are reduced by 75%[/*][*]Repair costs on vendors are reduced by 50%[/*][*]Crafting inspiration gain from all sources is increased by 100%[/*][*]Vendor prices across Tamriel are reduced by 10%[/*][list][*]These include:[/*][list][*]Vendors that sell items for gold, AP, or Tel Var stones, including the Golden Vendor[/*][*]Houses purchasable for gold[/*][/list][/list][*]New rare social and combat wilderness encounters are peppered throughout Tamriel for you to find, related to Zeal of Zenithar[/*][/list][h2]Event Tickets & the Impresario [/h2] 
In addition to the parcel boxes, you’ll also receive three Event Tickets each time you complete the Honest Toil daily quest. In total, you can collect 39 tickets by the end of the event. Just remember: You can hold up to 12 Event Tickets at any one time, so if you earn more while already at the ticket cap, you’ll lose them!
 
Once you’ve earned a hefty number of Event Tickets, head on over to the Impresario event merchant and exchange them for these rewards:
    [list][*]All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments [/*][list][*]Hallowed Hourglass Basin[/*][*]Illuminated Dragon Scroll[/*][*]Kvatchian Incense[/*][/list][/list][list][*]All three fragments for the Aurelic Quasigriff mount [/*][list][*]Aurelite Gryphon Feather[/*][*]Gilded Gryphon Barding[/*][*]Sacred Seeds of Akatosh[/*][/list][/list][list][*]Bound style pages for the High Rock Spellsword armor style [/*][*]Group Repair Kits [/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Companion Guild Commendations[/*][/list]
This is your chance to complete the morph for the shining Aurelic Quasigriff mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1fe493e07e25270f0ce76e3335ad554564448f9f.jpg[/img]																																										      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Aurelic Quasigriff mount[/i]
 
In addition, the Impresario is selling a [b]brand-new item[/b] to help improve your companion’s skill lines: Companion Guild Commendations. Each of the three major guilds in [i]ESO[/i], including the Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, and Undaunted, have a commendation associated with their organization. Upon using a commendation on an active companion, they immediately reach the next skill rank for that specific guild. 
 
The Companion Guild Commendations will be available to purchase whenever the Impresario makes an appearance during any future events.
 
Finally, the Impresario will be joined in the Belkarth festival grounds by a new colleague during the Zeal of Zenithar and all upcoming events: Nenulaure! This special merchant will offer a selection of indriks from previous years and events, with a cycling inventory as seasons change.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/550b57d9afc6efe3d04bc545f1ff5c19628c96ad.jpg[/img]																																														      							    							      								      									 
[i]Nenulaure the Indrik Vendor[/i]
 
During the Zeal of Zenithar, Nenulaure will offer:
    [list][*]Luminous Indrik Berries[/*][*]Icebreath Indrik Berries[/*][*]Shimmering Indrik pet[/*][*]Rimedusk Indrik pet[/*][/list]
These items will only stick around for a brief period before returning next year, so be sure to grab them before they’re gone!
 [h2]Tamriel Celebrates Zenithar[/h2] 
There are so many awesome prizes to collect and with a little bit of elbow grease, they can all be yours! Are you ready to get to work and earn some unique rewards during the Zeal of Zenithar in-game event? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Zeal of Zenithar in-game event begins June 30 at 10:00AM EDT, and it runs until Tuesday, July 12 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle & Update 34 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Defend the Legacy of the Bretons with The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle and the Update 34 base-game patch, available now on PC/Mac.[/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Stadia*. This new Chapter allows you to explore a never-before-seen part of Tamriel, the island home of the Breton elite, and uncover an ascending threat from within a noble chivalric society. If you’re a console player, don’t worry, [i]ESO: High Isle[/i] will be available June 21 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles. 

[previewyoutube=XaI-EOVpDvo;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      							    							      								      									 
This release also includes the free Update 34 base-game patch, providing all [i]ESO[/i] players with a host of fixes, additions, and improvements to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e3980ddbe5a6c17fd150f73f5dde5d17890aee90.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/30ab774d4cdf36a6f949877b40cd2d7271c1154c.jpg[/img]																																				      							    							      								      									 [h2]High Isle Chapter[/h2] 
In this new [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] Chapter, you can continue (or begin) your Legacy of the Bretons adventure by journeying to the faraway Systres Archipelago. As part of the year-long saga, [i]High Isle[/i] progresses the story that began with the [i]Ascending Tide[/i] DLC in February and will continue throughout the rest of 2022. This Chapter also provides a new zone to explore, new ways to play, and a bounty of unique rewards and Achievements to earn. [b] [/b]
 
[b]High Isle Zone[/b]
 
A home away from home for the Breton elite, the Systres Archipelago has long enjoyed a kind of neutrality from the ongoing Three Banners War. While High Isle itself is an idyllic paradise frequented by the Breton court and its noble houses, the Chapter also features a second location to explore called Amenos, an inhospitable penal island for political prisoners, criminals, and malcontents. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7aaa0ef337bf5196a520208ff59db8360d5dfc15.jpg[/img]										      							    							      								      																																																																																																									      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore the regions of High Isle and Amenos[/i]
 
As you journey throughout the Systres, you have an opportunity to venture into each island and discover the true nature of this ancient-but-mysterious land, including both its indisputable wonders and hidden dangers.
 
[b]An Ascending Threat[/b]
 
In the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you dive headfirst into a tale of political intrigue and strife, as the nobles of the Systres find themselves threatened by the mysterious Ascendant Order. This covert organization has infiltrated nearly every level of Breton society and has, behind the scenes, begun to push High Isle towards the brink of disaster. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/61b829fe0bc4798961c074bc5200230408d99100.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Ascendant Order works from the shadows[/i]
 
What you uncover in your investigations within this troubled land will have consequences for both the Bretons of High Isle and the mainland, and while [i]High Isle[/i] provides a standalone story experience, the events of this new Chapter will continue and set up the story for the Legacy of the Bretons saga to come. 
 
[b]Tales of Tribute[/b]
 
A new way to play, Tales of Tribute is a unique game system you can enjoy with your fellow players and NPCs in almost any tavern in Tamriel. A deck-building card game that challenges you to gain Prestige points while also garnering the favor of the patrons, Tales of Tribute is a fast-paced, strategic experience that anybody who owns [i]High Isle[/i] can pick up and play. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a9c73c906284feea97b4492662b2802dd750e1d8.png[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/23df603c92a3ad560d84526e74e91f57a710072a.jpg[/img]																																						      							    							      								      									 
Discover a new game within the game
 
With its own leaderboards, questline, and rewards (including unique collectibles and Achievements), whether you’re a competitive or casual player, there’s plenty of reasons to play a hand of Tribute. 
 
[b]New Companions[/b]
 
As you venture into the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you also have an opportunity to recruit two new Companions to your cause: Ember the Khajiit and Isobel Veloise the Breton Knight. Once enlisted, these very-different allies accompany you on your journeys throughout the Systres and beyond, and they even have their own unique questlines and stories that you can unlock as you adventure with them. 
 
[b]New Challenges & Rewards[/b]
 
As you might expect, High Isle is home to no shortage of dangers, but you can also find ample rewards for your troubles in this new land, too. New world events, called Volcanic Vents, have begun to erupt across both High Isle and Amenos, requiring a team to shut them down before they permanently scar the idyllic isles. The Dreadsail Reef 12-player Trial is a new challenge for large groups that pits your team against the fearsome Dreadsail pirates. Finally, this new zone also features a host of new delves, public dungeons, and world bosses to challenge your skills and teamwork.
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3906b2f72be21600982f6d631da6b14a4f5d73f7.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock new collectibles, item sets, styles, and more[/i]
 
All these experiences feature their own rewards, including unique item sets, collectibles, and Achievements not found anywhere else in Tamriel. 
 
To review everything coming with this new Chapter and update, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/category/highisle]previews on our official website[/url]. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle [/i]is available in four editions, including:
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Upgrade Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new player, the[i] ESO Collection: High Isle [/i]includes the base game, [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, and all previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, the [i]ESO: High Isle Upgrade[/i] grants you access to the new Chapter. Note that to run [i]High Isle[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the Chapter itself, the [i]Collector’s Editions[/i] also include a selection of unique in-game items, including a pet, mount, outfit style, and more.
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f984fe0a30fd18a587b4bf0e8c064539662994d9.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]High Isle Collector’s Edition Items[/i]
 
For everything on [i]High Isle’s[/i] editions, [i]Collector’s Edition[/i] items, and more, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61499]check out this article[/url].
 [h2]Getting Started in High Isle[/h2] 
Once you have access to the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways:
 
[b]By Wayshrine[/b]
 
If you’d like to explore High Isle with an existing character, you can teleport to the new zone directly via the Westbay Wayshrine. To do so, simply open your map, select the High Isle zone, and then select the Westbay Wayshine icon (it should be the only one active in the zone).
 
[b]Via the High Isle Main Quest[/b]
 
You can acquire the [i]High Isle[/i] main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select [i]High Isle[/i] and pick up the first quest, titled “Of Knights and Knaves,” to begin. The quest will point you toward where you need to go to make your way to the zone.
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to High Isle by creating a new character and completing the new tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select High Isle as your destination zone and get started.
 
Of course, because there’s no level requirements for any PvE zone in [i]ESO[/i], you can explore High Isle with an existing or brand-new character—have fun! 
 [h2]Update 34[/h2] 
Also launching in tandem with the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter is the Update 34 base-game patch. This update includes a host of new features, quality-of-life improvements, and fixes, completely free for all current [i]ESO[/i] players with no Chapter purchase required. 
 
[b]Spanish Language Support[/b]
 
With Update 34, our growing Spanish-language community from all over the world can now experience a completely translated Tamriel. This update provides Spanish-language translations for all in-game texts and subtitles, including menus, and dialog.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a1e2c0b708202a53c9b673be8b80ff380631abd7.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Enjoy Spanish-language support in game[/i]
 
Note that English voice-overs remain with Spanish subtitles. You can enable Spanish-language text in game by selecting your language from the PC/Mac launcher (within the Settings menu) if playing on PC/Mac, or by ensuring your console’s system settings are set to Spanish if playing on console.
 
[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]
 
This update also introduces two player-requested improvements to the base game. With U34, the Armory System now supports the addition of specific Mundus Stone selections, allowing you to set and select different boons for individual builds. Note that when you first log into the game, your current Mundus Stone selection on your character is automatically applied to [b]all[/b] your Armory builds, so you may need to make some edits when you first get in. 
 
In addition to the Armory System update, we’ve also made some improvements to the Quick Select Wheel on PC/Mac, allowing you to place items within primary or secondary wheels, so you can focus your combat-oriented items up front while still giving you quick access to other types of items such as mementos, emotes, or tools. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5f28175a82b9378d4e27c9220e75b2e12a10f3c3.jpg[/img]																																						      							    							      								      									 
[i]U34 improves the Quick Select Wheel[/i]
 
These are, of course, just some of the improvements coming with Update 34, so be sure to check out everything arriving as part of this base-game patch by checking out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Defend the Legacy of the Bretons[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle,[/i] a darkness looms over the Systres Archipelago, and an ascending threat rises from the Breton elites’ island paradise. Explore a faraway land never-before-seen in the [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] series, uncover a deadly conspiracy at the heart of Breton society, play a hand of a new deck-building card game, and defend the Legacy of the Bretons before the chaos of war engulfs both High Isle and all of Tamriel. Are you excited to begin your journey to High Isle? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle is now live for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arrives for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 21. [/i]
 
[i]*Available only in limited territories.[/i]

notes.title: 5 Ways to Prepare for The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online’s next big Chapter is almost here! Check out these tips on how you can prepare for your adventures in the Systres Archipelago. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle[/i] arrives on June 6 for PC/Mac and June 21 for consoles. Featuring a new zone, storyline, and Tales of Tribute card game, there’s a host of new activities and adventures right around the corner for all [i]ESO[/i] players. To ensure you’re ready to venture into High Isle and beyond when the new Chapter launches in June, check out these five easy-to-follow tips!

 [h2]Create Your Own Shining Knight[/h2] 
[i]High Isle[/i] is all about Bretons, and so what better way to explore this new zone’s chivalric feudal society than with your very own knight in shining armor? Every character you make is uniquely your own, but here are some suggestions for how to make your character the embodiment of knightly ideals:
         [list][*]Join the Fighters Guild (found in Vulkhel Guard, Daggerfall, and Davon’s Watch)[/*][list][*]With powerful abilities like the Dawnbreaker ultimate and defensive powers like Circle of Protection, the Fighters Guild Skill Line is great for would-be beast hunters[/*][/list][*]Acquire the One Hand and Shield weapon Skill Line[/*][list][*]Abilities like Puncture (thanks to its taunt) and Defensive Posture are ideal for defending the innocent[/*][/list][*]Using the Outfit System, tailor your look to meet the needs of both the noble courts and battlefields with these styles:[/*][list][*]Breton Style (a classic that’s easy to acquire in your adventures or from guild traders)[/*][*]Daggerfall Covenant Style (looted in the Imperial City and Cyrodiil or from guild traders)[/*][*]Knight of the Circle Style (earned by acquiring Arena Gladiator’s Proofs from Conquest daily quests in Cyrodiil)[/*][*]Ebony Style (acquired with Writ Vouchers from Rolis Hlaalu in Tamriel’s capital cities)[/*][/list][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7aaa0ef337bf5196a520208ff59db8360d5dfc15.jpg[/img]																																														      							    							      								      									 
[i]Be sure to look the part when exploring High Isle[/i]

 [h2]Find Adventure in the Glenumbra Zone[/h2] 
It’s no secret that the main and zone stories featured within the [i]High Isle [/i]Chapter[i] [/i]and the Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure are focused on the Breton people. To get an introduction to the kind of characters you’ll encounter during your adventures in [i]High Isle[/i], we recommend you make your way to the Glenumbra zone, part of [i]ESO[/i]’s base game content. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b2993117541efb7ff8a5c06f5add8e5049b168d.jpg[/img]																																		      							    							      								      									 
[i]You’ll find no shortage of adventure in Glenumbra [/i]
 
There, you’ll find plenty of courtly intrigue, the Wyrd, and of course, dashing knights!
 [h2]Venture into the Ascending Tide DLC Dungeons[/h2] 
If you’re looking to kick off your Legacy of the Bretons adventure with a challenge, you should venture into Coral Aerie and Shipwright’s Regret, the[i] Ascending Tide[/i]’s two DLC dungeons. The quests in these PvE activities set up the Legacy of the Bretons adventure to come while introducing some of the characters (and villains) you’ll encounter in the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7f8db83c306b41bc770b97d2b3f9d59f68a9e7a7.jpg[/img]																																														      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore the Coral Aerie[/i]
 
You can find [i]Ascending Tide [/i]within the DLC section of the in-game Crown Store or get access via an active ESO Plus membership.
 [h2]Complete the High Isle Prologue[/h2] 
The [i]Ascending Tide[/i] DLC isn’t the only piece of content preceding the launch of [i]High Isle[/i]. Every [i]ESO[/i] player now also has access the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61951][i]High Isle[/i] Prologue questline[/url], leading directly into the upcoming Chapter’s main storyline. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/89076c564e1e5f9297ea1a593b4592bf30ed4fbf.jpg[/img]																																													      							    							      								      									 
[i]Get special rewards by completing the High Isle Prologue[/i]
 
In the [i]High Isle[/i] Prologue, you’ll team up with the dashing rogue Jakarn, and his employer, Lady Arabelle Davaux, to investigate the schemes of the rising Ascendant Order. If you previously didn’t have access to the Vvardenfell zone where the questline takes place, don’t worry, it’s now [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61935]free for all [i]ESO[/i] players[/url]!
 
To begin your adventure, find the quest starter within the in-game Crown Store, located under the Quest Starters category, and pick up the quest titled “Ascending Doubt.”
 [h2]Study Tales of Tribute[/h2] 
In the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you’ll finally get your hands on [i]ESO[/i]’s new deckbuilding card game, Tales of Tribute. If you’re looking to gain an edge over your opponents after this new game mode launches, a bevy of content breaks down exactly how Tales of Tamriel works, including this complete tutorial video!

[previewyoutube=joDdRTgTYz0;full][/previewyoutube]
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																							      							    							      								      									
In addition to the tutorial video, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62081]guide[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62165]preview[/url] content, and be sure to keep an eye out for a slew of excellent community-made guides and resources, too!  

And there you go! We hope with these ideas, you’ll be ready to experience everything [i]High Isle[/i] has to offer. How are you preparing for the upcoming Chapter? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Chapter arrives for PC/Mac and Stadia* on June 6, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles June 21. [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]Pre-purchase High Isle[/i][/url][i] now to receive unique bonus rewards at launch and get immediate access to the Palefrost Elk mount.[/i]

[i]*Available only in limited Territories[/i]

notes.title: Survey the Systres during the Stream Team Team Stream
notes.content:
[i]Watch Stream Team members and ESO’s Community Team livestream their adventures in the Systres Archipelago as they dive into the new High Isle Chapter during PC/Mac launch week![/i]

[h2]Stream Team Streams[/h2] 
Kicking off Monday, June 6, with the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter launch on PC/Mac, you can watch a host of [i]ESO[/i] Stream Team members as they continue their Legacy of the Bretons adventures in the Systres Archipelago. During the launch week, the team will explore everything the islands of High Isle and Amenos have to offer, including the new questline and story, PvE challenges, and of course, the Tales of Tribute card game. 
 
Check out the livestreams and you can win some amazing prizes, including Crown Packs, copies of the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, and more via giveaways. There will also be Twitch Drops active thanks to the recently announced [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62175]Set Sail for High Isle promotion[/url], so don’t forget to [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/41809/]link your accounts[/url]!
 
Review the streaming schedule below for a full breakdown of everything going on during this launch week—note that times are US Eastern (EDT). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/990be82a135e748f5aec3f86b6c1e3a526e6c0c6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 10 Things You Need to Know About Tales of Tribute
notes.content:
[i]Learn more about The Elder Scrolls Online’s upcoming deck-building card game and ensure you have the stronger hand this June.
[/i]
The launch of High Isle, ESO’s latest Chapter, arrives June 6 on PC/Mac and June 21 on PlayStation and Xbox consoles. Accompanying its release will be Tales of Tribute, a brand-new, in-game card game that you can play whenever you need a break from closing Daedric portals or slaying dragons.

Tales of Tribute is quick and easy to pick up but takes time to master. To ensure you get off to a fast start when the new Chapter launches, here are 10 things you need to know about this new way to play—let’s dive right in!

[h2]You Can Unlock Eight Decks in High Isle[/h2]
You can acquire eight patron decks in Tales of Tribute, and each is themed around an organization or individual in the world of Tamriel that helps define a playstyle.

The first four are:
[list]
[*] Loremaster Celarus
[*] Delmene Hlaalu
[*] Duke of Crows
[*] St. Pelin
[/list]
You unlock these four immediately upon completing the tutorial, and you can unlock four additional decks by completing quests and unlocking achievements related to Tales of Tribute as well as coming across them in drops while participating in High Isle’s overworld content—look out for them!

[h2]Each Player Selects Two Patrons to Start[/h2]
Before the beginning of the match, both you and your opponent will each select two patron decks to bring to the match, each containing 20 cards. These 80 cards, along with 20 neutral cards, are shuffled into the Tavern. The Tavern is a pool of five cards that you and your opponent acquire cards from throughout the game.  

[h2]Patrons Are Potent—But Costly[/h2]
Each deck is also accompanied by a patron of the same name, and when they’re activated by you or your opponent, they provide special boons. You can choose to activate one each turn, but some card effects or combos may allow you to interact with an additional patron.

Be aware, earning the favor of a patron often requires the trade of another material including Power, Coin, or even your cards themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5e64bd40838bd624b452c4a10156a93fea62ed94.jpg[/img]
[i]How you win is up to you![/i]

[h2]Two Ways to Win[/h2]
In Tales of Tribute, there is more than one path to victory. In fact, there are two!

The first method of defeating your opponent is to collect [b]40 or more Prestige[/b]. Prestige is earned via card or patron abilities or by converting Power at the end of your turn.

Beyond scoring 40 or more Prestige, you must also maintain that lead through your opponent’s next turn. If your opponent can score higher than you in their following turn, then you must attempt to gain an even larger lead. This process will continue until one player cannot gain a lead over the other during their turn or either one of you hits 80 total.

The second path to victory involves gaining the favor of all four patrons by the end of your turn. If you do, regardless of accumulated Prestige, you automatically win.

[h2]Agents Stick Around[/h2]
Agents are a special type of card. Unlike most cards, which go to the cooldown pile at the end of your turn, agents remain in play. At that point, you can remove agents by one of two methods:

[list]
[*] After collecting Power, you can select your opponent’s agent and use the Power to attack and remove the agent. Each agent has an allotted amount of health, and you need enough Power to match their health to knock out (KO) them. Some agents have the ability to taunt you. Cards with taunt prevent you from converting Power to Prestige, and must be destroyed before you can strike at other agents. You can readily identify agents with taunt—their health is in a shield icon.
[*] Some cards (and a patron) can KO an agent. If you purchase one of these cards, you can select one of the active agents in your opponent’s hand to remove them from play.
[/list]

[h2]You Have Only [u]90[/u] Seconds Per Turn[/h2]
In Tales of Tribute, time is a luxury when playing ranked or casual matches via the Activity Finder. You and your opponent are provided 90 seconds per turn to analyze the situation and take whatever actions required. Neither you nor your opponent are required to use the entire 90 seconds, and you may choose to end your turn early. But be warned: Once those 90 seconds have passed, your turn automatically concludes. (But don’t worry about those friendly matches or bouts against NPCs—you can take your time there!)

[h2]Each Deck Has a Unique Playstyle[/h2]
Every deck in Tales of Tribute has been designed with unique gameplay to match its lore. For example, the St. Pelin deck, themed around High Rock’s Order of St. Pelin, are all about defensive agent cards and Power. Therefore, St. Pelin cards tend to be focused on the acquisition of Power and slow down your opponent's ability to convert Power into Prestige—Stendarr's grace in action.

[h2]Contracts Are One-Time Cards[/h2]
Most cards you acquire from the Tavern move into your cooldown pile upon purchase (and eventually, your draw pile), but this isn’t always the case. Several cards are designated as contracts, and you’ll know these cards by their unique styling and their tooltip information.

Contracts provide a one-time ability or agent that instantly takes effect on the table. Be careful when choosing which contracts to acquire, since after you have used them, they’re gone for the rest of that match!

[h2]Combo Cards for Extra Boons[/h2]
You can’t access all card abilities just by playing them from your hand. Some cards require combos to activate bonus effects that can quickly turn the tide in your favor.

You can trigger these combos by first playing a combo card to activate its primary effect and then playing another card from that same patron to trigger its secondary ability.

Example: You could play the Loremaster Celarus card “Ceporah’s Insight” and benefit from its primary effect of replacing two cards from the Tavern and tossing three cards from the top of your deck. Then when playing any other Loremaster Celarus cards that turn, the Ceporah’s Insight would activate its secondary effect and provide 3 Prestige.
Combo cards can also have tertiary effects that you can access by repeating the process a second time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5d71fd4bcf49666901de082c5bb8ceb501f56273.jpg[/img]
[i]Set up a combo using cards from the same patron to gain bonus effects[/i]

[h2]Power Is a Versatile Resource[/h2]
Power is one of the most important resources in Tales of Tribute. You can gain it through various means, including card effects and combos, as well as patron abilities.

You can use Power aggressively to remove agents from your opponent’s board, or Power can be transferred 1:1 into Prestige. Use it wisely.

We hope these notes give you a better idea of what to expect from Tales of Tribute and help you dominate your opponents once [i]High Isle[/i] arrives in June. We’ll be sharing more tips and tricks on how to play Tales of Tribute between now and launch, so keep an eye on elderscrollsonline.com for more! If you can’t wait to start playing the new tavern card game sweeping Tamriel, then hop onto the PTS where Tales of Tribute as well as [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter content is available to play right now!

Are you ready to master Tales of Tribute? Share your excitement with us via Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook.

notes.title: Begin Your Legacy of the Bretons Saga During the ESO Free Play Event & Sale
notes.content:
[i]Discover almost everything Tamriel has to offer and begin your year-long adventure during The Elder Scrolls Online Free Play Event and Sale.[/i]

[h1]Play For Free[/h1]
The Elder Scrolls Online Free Play Event is now live and runs until Tuesday, April 26 at 10AM EDT. During the free-play period, anybody on PC/Mac, Xbox consoles (Xbox Live Gold required), PlayStation consoles, and Stadia can download and play The Elder Scrolls Online for free!

If you’d like to join over 20 million players and explore Tamriel for free, visit the Free Play page and select your platform. This event will give you access to the ESO base game (including four classes, 23 story zones, Battlegrounds and Alliance War PvP, and more) and the Morrowind DLC (Vvardenfell zone).

Even better, because the Free Play Event grants you access to the base game, you can play the High Isle Prologue questline and begin your Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure—setting the scene for this year’s big Chapter release, The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle*. If you’d like to continue your story beyond the Free Play Event, pick up The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle from our Buy Now page to get immediate access to the game and previous Chapters.

If you’ve already played ESO during a previous event, you can continue your adventures as normal. Even better, all new ESO accounts created also receive 500 crowns to spend in the in-game Crown Store.

[h1]Base Game & Blackwood Sale[/h1]
During the Free Play Event, we’ve also put The Elder Scrolls Online Standard Edition on sale at up to 70% off and The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood on sale at up to 67% off.

This sale is now live and, depending on your platform, will end on different dates:

Crowns allow you to acquire many different types of items from the in-game Crown Store, such as mounts, pets, costumes, consumables, Crown Crates, and more. This Crown Packs sale will only be available on all platforms from now until April 20. Note that as with the game, the Crown Pack sale end times might vary by platform, so visit our Buy Crowns page to check your preferred retailer and don’t miss out!



With hundreds of hours of quests, characters, and worlds to explore, and a brand-new saga just on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to jump into The Elder Scrolls Online—we’ll see you in Tamriel!

*The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle is coming for PC/Mac and Stadia** on June 6, and for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 21.

**Available only in limited territories.

notes.title: Dive Deep into Your Next Big Adventure During the ESO: High Isle Chapter Preview
notes.content:
[i]Discover what adventures, stories, and challenges lie across the Abecean Sea during The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Chapter Preview.[/i]

[h2]A High Isle Discussion[/h2]
The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Chapter Preview livestream will begin Thursday, April 14 at 4PM EDT/9PM BST, on [url=Twitch.tv/Bethesda]Twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]. During the show, Creative Director Rich Lambert, Art Director CJ Grebb, and Writer-Designer Taylor Cyr team up to discuss the latest Elder Scrolls year-long adventure (spoiler-free!) and share some High Isle gameplay.

Together, they’ll provide an inside look at their approach to developing High Isle and talk about their inspirations when it came to designing this new world and saga. notes.title: ESO Turns 8! Enjoy Bonus XP, Rewards, & Cake During the Anniversary Jubilee!
notes.content:
[i]Grab a slice of cake and join us as we celebrate The Elder Scrolls Online’s eighth birthday with bonuses to XP gains, tons of Event Tickets, and more![/i]

[h2]Eat Cake & Celebrate[/h2]
The Anniversary Jubilee in-game event kicks off on April 7 at 10am EDT, and the partying won’t stop until April 19 at 10am EDT. Once the event begins, you can acquire the free Jubilee Cake Voucher quest from the Crown Store (listed under Quest Starters) and make your way over to the kitchen of the famous Chef Donolon.

Complete the Chef’s quest and you’ll receive this year’s delectable Jubilee Cake, which you can summon from the Tools section in your Collections menu. Each time you enjoy a slice of the tasty dessert during the Anniversary event, you’ll receive a 2-hour 100% XP boost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2200ad04e804771156a9c9678ea0f14e56dbae13.jpg[/img]
[i]Celebrate with a new anniversary cake![/i]

[h2]Receive Birthday Rewards[/h2]
When you complete any of ESO’s many daily quests during the event period, you’ll receive special Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes as additional rewards. These daily quests include:
[list][*] Daily crafting writs
[*] Daily Delve and World Boss quests
[*] Daily Alliance War and Battlegrounds quests
[*] Daily Dungeon and Trial quests
[*] Daily Heist and Sacrament quests[/list]
Within the anniversary boxes, you have a chance to acquire the following commemorative prizes:
[list][*] Basic crafting materials
[*] Rare crafting materials, Motif Chapter, Furniture Recipe, Style Item, or Outfit Style page.
[*] Transmutation Crystals
[*] Desecrated Grave Soil
[*] (NEW) Fragment for the Aurora Firepot Spider
[*] (NEW) Outfit style page for the Saberkeel armor style - If you’ve already collected a Saberkeel armor style page on the same day, this instead gives you an Aurora Firepot Spider fragment.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6f1c10876be185772c1d1fbb67a3cb9470c4167c.jpg[/img]
[i]Anniversary Jubilee rewards[/i]

[h2]Event Tickets & the Impresario[/h2]
In addition to the Jubilee cake’s XP buff, the first time you enjoy a slice each day, you’ll also receive three Event Tickets. In total, you can collect 39 tickets by the end of the event. Just remember: You can hold up to 12 event tickets at any one time, so if you earn more while already at the ticket cap, you’ll lose them!

After you’ve accumulated a healthy number of tickets (via an unhealthy amount of cake), you can find your way to the Impresario event merchant and exchange them for these enticing treasures:
[list][*] Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments
[list][*] Hallowed Hourglass Basin
[*] Illuminated Dragon Scroll
[*] Kvatchian Incense[/list]
[*] Fragments for the Aurelic Quasigriff mount
[list][*] Aurelite Gryphon Feather
[*] Gilded Gryphon Barding[/list][/list]
[list][*] (NEW) Bound style pages for the Saberkeel Armor Style
[*] Anniversary Cake Furnishings
[*] Aurora Firepot Spider instructions
[list][*]Use to combine the Aurora Firepot Spider Front Legs, Rear Legs, and Firepot fragments into the Aurora Firepot Spider pet![/list][/list]
[list][*] Bag of Jubilee Yesteryear - Contents of the bag include:
[list][*] Worm Cult Motif pages
[*] Jephrine Paladin Outfit Style pages
[*] Imperial Champion Outfit Style pages (weapon only)
[*] The Five Companions Style pages (armor only)
[list][*] Prophet
[*] Lyris
[*] Sai Sahan
[*] Abnur Tharn[/list][/list][/list]
[list] [*] Group Repair Kits[/list]

After the event ends, the Aurora Firepot Spider Instructions will forevermore be available on the Impresario's assistant, Philius Dormier, for the same ticket cost. That way, if you later collect enough tradeable fragments for the rest of the spider, you will be able to put it together with any excess tickets or future ticket earnings.

This event provides the first opportunity for you to acquire the fragments for the Aurielic Quasigriff mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1fe493e07e25270f0ce76e3335ad554564448f9f.jpg[/img]
[i]The Aurielic Quasigriff mount[/i]

Collect all three fragments (with the final one available during a later Q2 event), and you can morph your Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet into this fearsome new mount.

[b]Celebrate With Us![/b]
Enjoy awesome event rewards in addition to boosts to your XP during the Anniversary Jubilee in-game event and celebrate ESO’s eighth birthday with us! Are you excited to join in the celebration and share some cake with the rest of the ESO community? Let us know via Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook.

ESO’s Anniversary Jubilee in-game event begins Thursday, April 7 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, April 19 at 10:00AM EDT.

notes.title: Propagate the Preposterous & Earn Unique Rewards During the Jester’s Festival!
notes.content:
[i]That spectacular time of year has come around once again: friends and foes alike come together, don the mask of the Harlequin, and commemorate all things absurd![/i]

The Jester’s Festival officially kicks off March 31 at 10:00AM EDT, and continues causing chaos until April 7 at 10:00AM EDT! During this jovial romp, you can acquire buffs to XP gains and earn event-specific rewards by completing Jester’s Festival quests.

To join the festivities, head over to the jester pavilions found within the major cities of Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, and Daggerfall, and speak to one of three jesters who bear a striking resemblance to Jorunn the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric. If you’re having trouble locating these sites of frivolity, you can get directions by navigating to the Crown Store and picking up the Jester's Festival Invitation Quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a43a5402b1558d3ff3107324890254927db024c7.jpg[/img]

[i]The jesters of the Jester’s Festival![/i]

After you’ve completed the introductory quest, you’re handsomely rewarded with a delectable Pie of Misrule memento that you can find by opening up the Tools section of your Collections. Upon use during the event period, this tasty treat provides a two-hour, 100% XP buff!

[h2]Receive Ridiculous Rewards[/h2]
There are several daily quests for you to complete during the Jester’s Festival event, and each time you complete one you receive a Jester's Festival Box for your good work. However, the first Jester’s Festival quest you complete each day instead grants you a Stupendous Jester's Festival Box, awarding even more stupendous prizes.

All boxes can include the following items:
[list][*] Festive Dazzlers
[*] Cherry Blossom Confetti
[*] Revelry Pies
[*] Festive Furnishings
[*] Jesters Festival Provisioning Recipes
[*] "Stealies" that can be sold to vendors for Gold
[*] NEW: Cadwell's Surprise Box memento fragment
[/list]
In addition to the previously mentioned prizes, the Stupendous Jester’s Festival Box has the chance to contain the following goodies:
[list][*] Jester's Scintillator Runebox
[*] Cherry Blossom Branch Runebox
[*] Cadwell's Kitchen Weapon Style Page
[*] Joke Popper Fragments
[*] Fragment for 2020's Sovereign Sow Pet
[*] NEW: Second Seed Style Outfit Style Pages
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6fb4cf168d8e887bcc7a7e0345bafae1e2eb4f2a.jpg[/img]
[i]Cadwell’s Surprise Box memento[/i]

As part of this year’s celebration of mischief, we’re also adding a brand-new quest for you to enjoy, titled Getting the Band Together. You can acquire this quest from the mysterious Samuel Gourone, who you can find at every festival pavilion. Upon completion, you’ll earn an additional daily reward box!

[h2]Procure Preposterous Prizes[/h2]
Of course, the festival boxes aren’t the only goodies you can collect during this exuberant experience. Three Event Tickets are rewarded for the first Jester’s Festival quest completed each day. Participate in each day of the festivities, and you can earn up to 24 tickets before the end. But remember: You can hold up to 12 event tickets only, so if you earn more while already at the ticket cap, you’ll lose them!

Bring these Event Tickets to the Impresario event merchant, and you can trade them in for the following prizes:
[list][*] All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion Pet Fragments
[list][*] Hallowed Hourglass
[*] Illuminated Dragon Scroll
[*] Kvatchian Incense[/list]
[*] All Three Fragments for the Scales of Akatosh skin
[list][*] Aureate Anointing Oils
[*] Lustrous Ritual Sand
[*] Sacred Scale[/list]
[*] Bound Style Pages for the Second Seed Outfit Style
[*] Cadwell's Surprise Box memento fragments[/list]

[h2]Crown Store Items[/h2]
During the run of the Jester’s Festival, you can get your hands on some new loony items from the in-game Crown Store, including a new Stitchedwell Stick Guar mount and an adorable Catwell pet! These items hit live servers on April 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/69cf4986b973092b50d09b982b058f4645aea9fd.jpg[/img]
[i]The Adorable Catwell Pet[/i]

But that’s not all that hits the Crown Store during the duration of the festival! A number of old favorites are returning, including the Jester's Music Box and the Nightmare Stick Horse mount. Be sure to keep an eye out for these items and more coming to the Crown Store page!

[h2]Sow Senselessness[/h2]
Revel in the ridiculous during this year’s Jester’s Festival in-game event, and you’ll acquire unique event-specific rewards as you bring frivolity to every corner of Tamriel. Don’t forget, there’s pie! How do you plan to celebrate this foolish fete? Tell us via Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook.

The Jester’s Festival in-game event begins Thursday, March 31 at 10AM EDT, and runs until Thursday, April 7 at 10AM EDT.

notes.title: Enjoy Bonus Gold, XP, & More During the Explorer’s Celebration In-Game Event!
notes.content:
[i]Pack your bags and get adventuring because for the next six days you can earn bonus XP, gold rewards, and resource node drops across Tamriel during the Explorer’s Celebration![/i]

Kicking off today, March 17 at 10AM EDT, and running until Tuesday, March 22 at 10AM EDT, the limited-time Explorer’s Celebration in-game event grants you bonus rewards as you explore Tamriel.

During the event period, ESO’s intrepid adventurers enjoy the following boons:

[list]
[*] Increased drops from harvest nodes (this does not include fishing or creature drops such as leather)
[*] +100% XP gains from every source
[*] These bonuses stack with other XP boosts such as scrolls or group multipliers
[*] +100% gold earned from monster kills, quest rewards, and similar sources

Something to keep in mind: The Explorer’s Celebration isn’t a quest or ticket-based event, and no unique achievements or collectibles are available. Additionally, the Impresario will not be accessible during the event. The Explorer’s Celebration runs for a limited time, so don’t miss out—have fun!

[i]The Explorer’s Celebration starts on March 17 at 10AM EDT, and it runs until Tuesday, March 22 at 10AM EDT. [/i]

notes.title: Ascending Tide DLC & Update 33 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Your Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure sets sail with the Ascending Tide dungeon DLC pack and Update 33 base-game patch.[/i]

The [i]Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide[/i] DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia* (Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 DLC launch will follow on March 29). It introduces two new dungeons to challenge your group and begins an adventure that takes you to the distant shores of High Isle and the chivalric Bretons who call it home**.

[previewyoutube=jwmfzVAdZMM;full][/previewyoutube]

This release also includes the free Update 33 base-game patch, which provides all ESO players with a series of additions and improvements to the game.

You can access the DLC via ESO Plus™ membership or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both Ascending Tide and Update 33 on our official forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/94071d42fd8e747e6e1a029d385f6934fd93fc85.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bf8347191f69d8dfb665ef4696e8805da998d810.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ascending Tide DLC Game Pack[/h2]
Experience two new daring adventures with your PvE crew in the Coral Aerie and Shipwright’s Regret. Both four-player dungeons feature unique stand-alone stories while also kicking off your Legacy of the Bretons year-long epic adventure.

[h3]Coral Aerie[/h3]
Invade a secret hideout of the mysterious Ascendant Order and rescue the dashing rogue Jakarn beneath the island home of the High Elves in Coral Aerie. Team up with Captain Kaleen and explore the site’s stunning coral formations and Elven ruins as you battle your way through both the cave’s new residents and monstrous local inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7f8db83c306b41bc770b97d2b3f9d59f68a9e7a7.jpg[/img]
[i]Expose the secretive Ascendant Order[/i]

You can learn more about Coral Aerie in our preview.
[b]
Shipwright’s Regret[/b]
Believed to be one of the shipyards for the legendary All Flags Navy, the dilapidated docks and rotted work halls of Shipwright’s Regret is now home to the uneasy dead, wrathful spirits, and Dreadsail pirates. Of course, that won’t stop the ever-enterprising Khajiit Captain Za’ji from entering the cursed site in search of upgrades for his beloved ship, the Perfect Pounce!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/63d5f6a3535d327814c0e5af50ce5ce74bac1646.jpg[/img]
[i]Survive the haunted remnants of Shipwright’s Regret[/i]

Help the swashbuckling captain as he searches for a special kind of treasure amongst ancient history and the dead. Learn more about Shipwright’s Regret in this preview.

Both dungeons can be completed in Normal, Veteran, and Hard Mode difficulties, plus feature unique challenges and rewards not found anywhere else in Tamriel. The characters and forces you encounter and the stories you uncover in Ascending Tide set the scene for the upcoming High Isle* Chapter and Legacy of the Bretons year-long saga—get ready to set sail for a new adventure!

[h1]Getting Started[/h1]
You can access The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide DLC game pack via ESO Plus membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.

The Ascending Tide Collector’s Bundle is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Dreadsail Howler mount, the Iliac Bay Crab pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bf4e4476d5ce903034025427d0a29833e8a2b154.jpg[/img]
[i]Ascending Tide Collector’s Bundle[/i]

With access to the Ascending Tide DLC, you can begin your Legacy of the Bretons adventure by the following methods:

[list]
[*] By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map
[*] By using the Dungeon Finder tool
[*] By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Summerset (Coral Aerie) and Rivenspire (Shipwright’s Regret)
[/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you receive the Abyssal Embrace face markings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b6d130ff88893ec74b20ccd817ed2cff2a3eaf36.jpg[/img]
[i]Unlock new rewards in Ascending Tide[/i]

[h1]Update 33 Base-Game Patch[/h1]
Also launching in tandem with Ascending Tide is the Update 33 base-game patch, a free update that introduces new bug fixes, balance changes, performance improvements, and features.

[h2]Account-Wide Achievements[/h2]

To ensure ESO’s performance remains stable as new content continues to be added to the game, most in-game achievements become account-wide with Update 33. As a result, when you earn a new achievement with one of your characters, that same achievement could count as being earned by all others. This change also alters how the Undaunted skill line advances, and your rank now increases as you complete quests within dungeons and finish Undaunted dailies. Read more about this big change to how achievement works in our preview article and forum Q&A.

[h2]New PvP Rewards
[/h2]
Update 33 also introduces powerful new item sets that you can earn when receiving your Rewards for the Worthy PvP loot. These three new sets (Rallying Cry, Hew and Sunder, and Enervating Aura) create new ways to play for your characters when battling in the Battlegrounds, Cyrodiil, and Imperial City. In addition to this, all PvP players can also receive style pages for the Dragonguard Berserker armor by trading in Tel Var Stones to the Tel Var merchants in the Imperial City Sewers (Alliance Rank 20 required). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6e7beb0150a08b391c42f17a89e14fc3a68744f6.jpg[/img]

[i]The Dragonguard Berserker style[/i]

These are just some of the changes and additions coming with the free Update 33 base-game patch, so be sure to check out the full patch notes on our official forums for everything.

[h1]Your Legacy Begins[/h1]
Two swashbuckling adventures await in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide[/i]! Explore Coral Aerie and Shipwright’s Regret, challenge your crew with a host of dangerous monsters and bosses, and uncover powerful and unique new rewards found only in this DLC. Are you excited to set sail on your Legacy of the Bretons journey? Tell us via Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook.

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and arrives on Xbox and PlayStation consoles March 29. You can get access to this new dungeon DLC via ESO Plus™ membership or via purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store.

*Available only in limited territories.

**The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle arrives on PC/Mac and Stadia* June 6 and Xbox and PlayStation consoles June 21.[/i]

notes.title: Battle in ESO’s PvP Modes & Earn Bonus Rewards during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem!
notes.content:
[i]Clash with your fellow players across Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds as you collect bonus XP, collectibles, and more![/i]

[h2]Mayhem Returns[/h2]
The Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event begins this Thursday, February 17 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, March 1 at 10AM EST. During the event period, you and your allies can enjoy huge bonuses to both your Alliance Point and XP gains and get your hands on unique rewards while participating in ESO’s various PvP activities.

Here’s how you join the fight:

[list]
[*] Visit the in-game Crown Store to acquire the “Details on the Whitestrake’s Mayhem" quest.
[*] Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities.
[*] You are not required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off the event.
[*] Find the NPC named “Predicant Maera" and continue the quest.
[*] If you already completed the quest last year, you won't need to do it again.
[*] Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Boon Box.
[*] Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:
[*] Alliance Points gained.
[*] XP gains for PvP player kills.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/04f16cec1e3eeeaf99161e35028c2ce8c0dab56c.jpg[/img]

[i]Begin your campaign in Cyrodiil[/i]

You can use the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity throughout the entirety of the event, but if you happen to misplace it, you can always speak with Predicant Maera to obtain another or use the Basin of the Gore Virtuous instead. Remember: the Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity is an inventory item rather than a Memento/Tool.

[b]Conquer Your Foes; Reap the Rewards[/b]
When participating in Whitestrake’s Mayhem, you have the opportunity to earn event-specific exclusive loot.

[b]NEW Black Drake Clanwrap Style Pages[/b]

Adorn yourself in the wargear of the Reach with this new outfit style dropped by Imperial City sweepers and bosses.

[b]NEW Black Drake Body and Face Markings[/b]

Stain your skin with warpaint depicting the might of the Black Drake, dropped by bosses within the Imperial City.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e4e38fe501091cbe448d34a0d425734626539aa4.jpg[/img]
[i]The Black Drake Clanwrap armor style[/i]

[b]Legion Zero Vigiles Outfit Style Pages[/b]

Bring order to the capital with this intimidating outfit found on the corpses of bosses and sweepers inside the Imperial City.

[b]Mayhem Victor’s Laurel Wreath[/b]

Claim the Mayhem Victor’s Laurel Wreath collectible by completing the Whitestrake’s Mayhem Achievements below:

[list]
[*] Mayhem Connoisseur: Receive the blessing of the Whitestrake at one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.
[*] Echo of Pelinal's Fury: Read a Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem.
[*] Hand of the Whitestrake: Acquire your 25th Boon Box.
[*] Wrath of the Whitestrake: Defeat 50 opponents during the Whitestrake Mayhem.
[*] Pelinavant the Scourge: Win a Battleground match during the Whitestrake Mayhem.
[*] Pelinaline the Bloody: Capture a Keep in Cyrodiil during the Whitestrake Mayhem.
[*] Pelinerrif Insurgent: Capture an Imperial District during the Whitestrake Mayhem.
[/list]
Note that access to the Imperial City DLC game pack is required to earn the above Achievements, so pick it up FREE from the in-game Crown Store!

[b]Pelinal’s Boon Boxes
[/b]
As you and your allies clash against your fellow players in Cyrodiil, the Battlegrounds, and the Imperial City, you’ll also find yourself regularly earning event-exclusive Pelinal’s Boon Boxes. You can get these in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers and as PvP daily quest rewards from the following:

Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn
Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions
Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests
Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol
Imperial City daily quests
Inside Boon Boxes, you have a chance to receive the following items:

[list]
[*] Parcel of Tel Var Stones
[*] Cyrodiil Repair Kit
[*] Soul Gems
[*] Alchemy Ingredients
[*] An item for your Alliance's armor style
[*] An item for Akaviri armor style
[*] A Coldharbour siege weapon
[*] A Whitestrake's Mayhem book furnishing
[*] A Forward Camp for your Alliance
[*] A Chapter of your Alliance's armor motif (or possibly even the full book!)
[*] A Prismatic Runestone
[*] A Chapter for the Akaviri armor motif (or possibly even the full book!)
[*] A Transmute Geode
[*] Container with two tradeable runeboxes for Black Drake body and face markings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ec463f1ee9b999704d2323ecd74a21acf4f06851.jpg[/img]
[i]
Clash for glory and loot[/i]

[b]Bonus Resources & The Golden[/b]

Throughout the event, harvesting nodes within Cyrodiil and the Imperial City provide double their regular resources. Additionally, the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi, “The Golden,” Aba-daro will update her stock to contain legendary-quality Alliance War jewelry, with necklaces for sale during the first weekend and rings during the second.

[b]Event Tickets & Rewards[/b]
During the Whitestrake’s Mayhem event, you can earn up to three Event Tickets per day by completing two different PvP activities:

[list]
[*] Two Tickets come from the first Cyrodiil or Battleground repeatable quest you do each day. These can include Bounty Board quests, a Town Daily, the Conquest Board quests, or the daily Battleground quest.
[*] One Ticket if you complete a District daily from the Imperial City.
[/list]

That means you can earn up to 39 Event Tickets if you complete each activity every day of the event! Keep in mind that the Event Ticket timer resets at 2:00AM EST each morning, so if you earn new Event Tickets over the regular 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

Once you’ve gathered a healthy collection of tickets, be sure to visit the Impresario event merchant to barter for some tantalizing collectibles. Here’s everything the Impresario will have in stock during the Whitestrake’s Mayhem event. Spend wisely!

[list]
[*] Soulfire Dragon Illusion Pet Fragments
[*] Hallowed Hourglass Basin
[*] Illuminated Dragon Scroll
[*] Kvatchian Incense
[*] Scales of Akatosh Skin Fragments
[*] Aureate Anointing Oils
[*] Lustrous Ritual Sand
[*] Black Drake Clanwrap Outfit Style Pages
[*] Black Drake Body Marking
[*] Black Drake Face Marking
[*] Bag of Veteran's Glory
[*] Containing a collectible that you don’t currently own from previous years’ Mayhem events
[*] Group Repair Kits
[/list]
This event is your opportunity to pick up the second fragment of the Scales of Akatosh skin morphing collectible—don’t miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c83d0b74d82f840c4e389b7fa21a23ce00b8cf88.jpg[/img]
[i]The Scales of Akatosh skin[/i]

[b]Mayhem Reigns[/b]
Take up your sword, bow, staff, or whatever means of destruction you prefer and clash with your fellow players across the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds for loot and glory. Are you ready to dive back into ESO’s PvP game modes? Tell us via Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook. 

The Whitestrake’s Mayhem in-game event begins this Thursday, February 17 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT, and runs until Tuesday, March 1 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT.

notes.title: Venture into Worlds Bizarre and Beautiful During the Daedric War Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Explore the regions of Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, and Summerset during the Daedric War Celebration in-game event and you’ll earn bonus rewards and Event Tickets.[/i]

[h2]Worlds of Wonder[/h2]
The Daedric War Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, January 20 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, February 1 at 10AM EST. To participate, you need access to the Morrowind Chapter/DLC, Clockwork City DLC, or Summerset Chapter/DLC, available right now via ESO Plus™ membership or available for purchase from the in-game Crown Store. Once you have access, you can get started by picking up the introductory quest “Guidance for Guides,” available free from the in-game Crown Store or from the event NPC Calonir, found near any Impresario tent.

During the celebration period, as you explore, quest, and adventure, you have a chance to receive an event-specific Daedric War Spoils reward box when you complete the following activities:

[list]
[*] Finishing the event introductory quest
[*] Slaying Delve and World Bosses
[*] Slaying monsters
[*] Opening Treasure Chests, Safeboxes, lootable objects, Psijic Portals, Thieves Troves, and harvest nodes
[*] Closing Abyssal Geysers
[*] Slaying bosses within the Halls of Fabrication, Asylum Sanctorum, and Cloudrest Trials
[/list]

When you earn and open a Daedric War Spoils reward box, you’ll have a chance to receive the following items:

[olist]
[*] NEW Evergloam Champion weapon style pages
[*] NEW Gloam Gryphon Fledgling pet runebox
[*] Crafting materials
[*] Style items for styles found in the Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, and Summerset zones
[*] Overland set items
[*] Valuables you can sell for gold
[*] Treasure maps for Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, and Summerset zones
[*] Transmutation Crystals
[*] Motif chapters for styles found in the Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, and Summerset zones
[*] Snowhawk Mage armor style pages
[*] Slag Town Diver Skin runebox
[*] Thetys Ramarrys’s Bait Kit runebox
[*] Microtized Verminous Fabricant pet fragment
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/086161c4c4a1808c7e9d8e3fc024089fa19f630d.jpg[/img]
[i]The Gloam Gryphon Fledgling pet[/i]

Even better, each day when you complete your first daily quest in Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, or Summerset, or the weekly Asylum Sanctorum or Cloudrest quest, you’ll receive a Glorious Daedric War Spoils reward box instead. These magnificent reward boxes have a much greater chance to contain rarer event rewards (such as the unique styles or pets), so be sure to complete your dailies!

Finally, throughout the event period, you also receive the following bonus rewards when completing various in-zone activities:

[olist]
[*] Double (non-event) reward boxes for zone daily quests and Trial weekly quests
[*] Increased rewards from harvest nodes
[*] Not including fishing holes or heavy sacks
[*] World, Delve, and Trial bosses drop additional loot when defeated
[*] Vvardenfell and Clockwork City public dungeons and world bosses have a chance to drop a tradeable style page for the Doctrine Ordinator outfit style
[*] The final boss in both the Asylum Sanctorum and Halls of Fabrication have a guaranteed chance to drop a tradeable style page for the Doctrine Ordinator outfit style
[/olist]

[h2]Event Tickets & Rewards[/h2]
During the Daedric War Celebration, you can earn up to two Event Tickets each day by completing the following activities:

[olist]
[*] One ticket from turning in your first Vvardenfell or Clockwork City daily quest
[*] One ticket from turning in your first Summerset daily quest
[/olist]
This means you can earn up to 26 Event Tickets total during this event. Note that you need access to the respective zones to complete their daily quests. To unlock Morrowind’s Ashlander dailies, you need to first complete the Ancestral Ties questline in Ald’ruhn. In addition, you need to complete the Clockwork City’s zone story quest “Lost in the Gloam” to unlock the Blackfeather Court dailies and the zone’s two delve quests “The Halls of Regulation” and “The Shadow Cleft” to unlock their delve dailies.

Throughout the event, the Impresario vendor stocks the following items:

[olist]
[*] All three Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet fragments
[*] Including the Hallowed Hourglass Basin, Illuminated Dragon Scroll, and Kvatchian Incense
[*] The first fragment for the Scales of Akatosh skin, the Aureate Anointing Oils
[*] Evergloam Champion weapon style pages
[*] Gloam Gryphon Fledgling pet
[*] Group Repair Kits
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/865185b55520c5fab2ca3e96e49e35c4451c5378.jpg[/img]

This event is your first opportunity to begin collecting a brand-new morphing collectable, the Soulfire Dragon Illusion and the first fragments for this year’s first morphable event reward! Keep an eye out on future event articles for information on the other fragments you’ll need to morph your Soulfire Dragon Illusion pet into the Scales of Akatosh skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c83d0b74d82f840c4e389b7fa21a23ce00b8cf88.jpg[/img]

Explore (or rediscover) the Vvardenfell, Clockwork City, and Summerset zones, and you’ll earn a host of bonus event-specific rewards (including brand-new collectibles) and Event Tickets. Grand tales of a conflict as old as the gods await those delving into the worlds of the Dark Elves, High Elves, and Sotha Sil. Are you excited to dive into some of ESO’s earlier DLC and Chapter content? Let us know via Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook, and we’ll see you there!

The Daedric War Celebration in-game event begins next Thursday, January 20 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, February 1 at 10AM EST.

notes.title: Bring Cheer to Tamriel during the New Life Festival In-Game Event
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrate New Life[/h1]
The New Life Festival in-game event begins this Thursday, December 16 at 10AM EST, and continues until Tuesday, January 4 at 10AM EST. To join the joyful fete, acquire the New Life Festival quest from the in-game Crown Store and use it to make your merry way to the New Life Herald Breda, found south of the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch. You can also teleport directly to the New Life Festival tent via the portal found at Impresario locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6b781c15c391cbaa83cd546458a358d171828cd3.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Life Herald Breda[/h1]
Complete the intro quest and you’ll unlock 10 special daily quests (nine from Breda and one from Petronius Galenus) that see you travel across Tamriel and bring cheer to its myriad inhabitants.
Give and Receive
Each time you successfully complete a New Life Festival daily quest, you’ll receive a New Life Festival Gift Box as a reward. Within these cheerful curios, you’ll have a chance to receive some of the following goodies:
•	Skinchanger Motif chapters
•	New Life recipes
•	New Life collectibles (packaged in Runeboxes and tradeable):
o	Sword-Swallower's Blade memento
o	Juggler's Knives memento
o	Fire-Breather's Torches memento
o	Mud Ball Pouch memento
o	Nordic Bather's Towel costume
o	Colovian Filigreed Hood hat
o	Colovian Fur Hood hat
o	Snowball Buddy pet
o	New Powderwhite Coney pet
o	New random page for the Nord Carved Armor style

Even better, each time you tear open a New Life Festival Gift Box, you have a chance to also receive one of two types of Charity Writs:
•	Deep Winter Charity Writs—Complete to unlock pages from the Skaal Explorer outfit style.
•	Imperial Charity Writs—Complete to unlock pages from the Rkindaleft Dwarven Weapon Style.
Complete any 12 of the above Charity Writs and you will also unlock the “Newly Charitable” Achievement and Crystalfrost skin.
Impresario & Event Tickets
During the event period, the first time you complete a New Life Festival daily quest, you’ll receive three Event Tickets in addition to your Gift Box and other rewards. This means you can earn up to 60(!) Event Tickets during this event, allowing you to acquire the following items from the Impresario event vendor:
•	All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments
o	Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder
•	All Deadlands Scorcher skin fragments
o	Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide, Rune-Scribed Daedra Sleeve, and Rune-Scribed Daedra Veil
•	All Deadlands Firewalker personality fragments 
o	Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew, Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew, and Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew
•	All Dagonic Quasigriff mount fragments 
o	Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather, Black Iron Bit and Bridle, and Black Iron Stirrups
•	All Doomchar Plateau house fragments 
o	Scorching Pillar, Searing Column, Molten Key, Profane Pedestal, and Unholy Tablet
•	Bound style pages for the Nord Carved Armor outfit style 
•	The Powderwhite Coney pet 
•	Group Repair Kits 
Phew! As you can see, we’re bringing back the fragments for all of 2021’s quarterly event rewards, allowing you to catch up and complete previously available morphs. This is also your first and final opportunity to collect all the fragments for the Doomchar Plateau house.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5199d6dfa0b3290f8709c21697d348698613c75a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Claim your very own piece of Oblivion![/h1]
Learn more about how morphing collectibles and upgrade fragments work in our guide article and keep an eye out for future in-game event news.

[b]Bring Cheer to Tamriel (and Oblivion)[/b]
Celebrate the end of another amazing year of adventure and help spread merriment to all four corners of Tamriel during the New Life Festival event and you’ll enjoy bonuses to XP and earn unique rewards while doing so! How are you celebrating New Life this year? We’d love to see your holiday homes and seasonal outfits during the New Life Festival period, so don’t hesitate to share them with us via Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook.
