notes.title: Delve Into Tamriel’s Dungeons During the Undaunted Celebration & Earn Bonus Loot
notes.content:
[i]Show no fear of beast or blade, and you can earn unique rewards during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event. We are Undaunted![/i]

[h2]Take the Pledge[/h2]
The Undaunted Celebration begins next Thursday, November 18 from 10AM EST, and it runs until Tuesday, November 30 at 10AM EST. During this in-game event, you can earn bonus rewards when completing [b]any[/b] of [i]ESO[/i]’s challenging four-player PvE dungeons. 

Get started by jumping into any dungeon in the game (via your map, Activity Finder, or the dungeon’s overland entrance) or by completing the introductory quest titled “Glory of the Undaunted” (found in Crown Store). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/909116b4fb1a7c8b9b2acd5c415e7553519e7182.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																						      						    						      						        
[i]Tackle the Gates of Oblivion dungeons (and more) for bonus rewards[/i]

[h2]Earn Shiny Rewards[/h2]
When you slay a dungeon’s final boss during the event period, it will drop a unique [b]Undaunted Reward Box[/b], containing a host of valuable items and consumables that can include treasure maps, survey reports, valuables (to sell to vendors), crafting materials, motif style pages, Undaunted Keys, and more. 

If you can’t take on a dungeon right now, don’t fear! You can also earn one Undaunted Reward Box a day by completing Bolgrul’s daily Undaunted delve quest. You can find Bolgrul within any Undaunted Enclave.  

[b]Glorious Undaunted Reward Boxes[/b]

The first time you defeat a dungeon’s final boss each day, it will drop a [b]Glorious Undaunted Reward Box [/b](instead of a regular Reward Box)[b] [/b]that has a chance to[b] [/b]include the regular Reward Box items and is [b]guaranteed[/b] to contain an Opal Weapon Style page. Note that while the only way to get a guaranteed Opal Weapon Style drop is within a Glorious Reward Box, there’s still a (rare) chance you might find one in a regular box, too! 

The Opal Weapon style pages can include the Iceheart, Lord Warden, Nightflame, and Swarm Mother styles, however, for the first time, you can also acquire the [b]Chokethorn Opal Weapon Style[/b]. 

During the event period, when defeating the final boss within certain dungeons on [b]veteran hard mode[/b], you also have a bonus chance to receive an Opal Monster Mask Style page relevant to that dungeon. You can see the dungeons and mask styles they have a chance to drop below:
[list][*]Chokethorn (Elden Hollow I)[/*][*]Iceheart (Direfrost Keep)[/*][*]Lord Warden (Imperial City Prison)[/*][*]Nightflame (Elden Hollow II)[/*][*]Swarm Mother (Spindleclutch I)[/*][/list]
[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style Page[/b]

If you own the non-Opal version of a monster shoulder style, you can also acquire the Opal version of that style with Undaunted Keys from Undaunted vendors. These vendors will also sell mystery coffers that provide random Opal shoulder style pages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/19e934a0a4a2b7b96fa7f11559916c7c66713c54.jpg[/img]																								      						    						      						        
[i]Trade Undaunted Keys for Shoulder Style pages[/i]

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Undaunted Celebration, you can earn two event tickets per account from the first final dungeon boss you defeat per day—make sure you have space! Throughout the event period, the Impresario will stock the following goods:
[list][*]All three [b]Unstable Morpholith[/b] pet fragments [/*][list][*]Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]Three [b]Doomchar Plateau[/b] house fragments [/*][list][*]Scorching Pillar, Searing Column, and Molten Key[/*][/list][*]Bound style pages for the following Opal weapons and Opal Masks and Shoulders:[/*][list][*]Chokethorn[/*][*]Iceheart[/*][*]Lord Warden[/*][*]Bogdan the Nightflame[/*][*]Swarm Mother[/*][/list][*]Impresario Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
This is another opportunity to collect the fragments for the Doomchar Plateau house, the Q4 event morphing collectible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/fd976a9485e641f7d33565ec7182c21d50ce1629.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																														      						    						      						        
[i]Claim a plot of land in Dagon’s realm of Oblivion[/i]

As a reminder, if you wish to acquire this house by the end of the year, you need to have an Unstable Morpholith pet to morph AND all five upgrade fragments. Learn more about how morphing collectibles and upgrade fragments work in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]guide article[/url] and keep an eye out for future in-game event news. 

[h2]Tackle Tamriel’s Dungeons[/h2]
Gather your team and dive into [i]ESO[/i]’s PvE four-player challenges and you can earn shiny new loot and bonus rewards for your troubles. Are you geared up and ready to tackle some dungeons during the Undaunted Celebration in-game event? Let us know on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. We. Are. Undaunted!

[i]The Undaunted Celebration begins next Thursday, November 18 from 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, November 30 at 10AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands & Update 32 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Experience the cataclysmic conclusion to the Gates of Oblivion adventure in The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands and Update 32. [/i]

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/i] and Update 32 base game patch are now live on PC/Mac and Stadia. If you’re a console player, don’t fear. [i]Deadlands[/i] arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles on November 16. 

[previewyoutube=GAWh5dt9z-A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      						    						      						        [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/h2]
Mehrunes Dagon’s plans for Nirn in the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter were not thwarted, only delayed, and now Tamriel’s heroes must face the Daedric Prince of Destruction within his own realm. The final part of the year-long Gates of Oblivion adventure, [i]Deadlands[/i] concludes the exciting saga of ambition and destruction that began with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC in February. 

[b]A Gates of Oblivion Story[/b]

In this story DLC, you can explore Dagon’s plane of Oblivion and the mysterious city of Fargrave while unraveling the Daedric Prince’s ultimate plans for Nirn and the people of Tamriel. In your adventures, you’ll experience tales and locations that showcase the life and society of those who call Oblivion home and be challenged by all-new encounters and threats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/200fbed23b481ed96bbd2a4f946e23bd0025052c.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Daedric Prince of Destruction awaits[/i]

While featuring a unique, standalone storyline, [i]Deadlands[/i] also contains three bonus quests that are only unlocked if you complete the [i]Blackwood[/i] and [i]Deadlands[/i] main questlines first. During these exclusive quests, you’ll finally have your opportunity to confront Mehrunes Dagon himself and put a stop to his dread plans … for now. 

[b]Deadlands Zone & Fargrave[/b]

Chaotic, perilous, and unrelenting, Dagon’s realm of Oblivion is a dangerous world where only the strong survive. In this new zone, you can venture into the regions known as the Burn and Sever, two equally volatile aspects of the Daedric Prince made manifest. 
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8dc21481644111bfa10557479e6d632f20e47df3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e672ace80e2f04817f6030f79e294475ad0db5cf.jpg[/img]																							      						    						      						        
[i]Explore two unique biomes in the Deadlands[/i]

When exploring the Deadlands, you’ll encounter the vicious followers of Dagon and those few who’ve eked out an existence in this hellscape. With new delves to investigate, world bosses to vanquish, and a host of stories to experience, the Deadlands is a world unlike any other in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. Luckily for you, you can find refuge beyond Dagon’s reach. 

A player hub and “safe haven” in a realm between realms, the mysterious city of Fargrave is home to both mortal and Daedric residents alike, living and working in relative harmony. This bizarre city serves as the base of your operations as you explore and continue your adventures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/633ef67d6e78ab6987fc0a25c2573463bfc7a679.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																						      						    						      						        
[i]Fargrave, home to mortals and Daedra alike[/i]

In Fargrave, you’ll encounter new allies, such as the heroic Anchorite or mysterious Madam Whim, and learn more about those who call Oblivion home. Check out our recent previews on the[i] [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61117]zone[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61141]stories[/url] for more on the kind of experience waiting for you in the Deadlands. 

[b]New Challenges and Rewards[/b]

As you quest and explore in both the Deadlands zone and Fargrave, you’ll find no shortage of new challenges to overcome, including the patrolling Havocrel Executioners, hulking giants who walk Dagon’s realm in search of outsiders and require large groups to vanquish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ceaa3a85810d6052fdc08a94abcdda32bb1de261.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																														      						    						      						        			  
[i]Dagon’s most-fearsome warriors guard his realm[/i]
  
This zone also includes a host of stand-alone quests to  complete, memorable characters to encounter, and a series of unique rewards that  include item sets (three crafted and three zone), Oblivion-touched  collectibles, and Achievements—a bounty of loot and glory for those willing to  set foot in Dagon’s realm.

  [h2]How Do I Get the Deadlands?[/h2]  
The [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC is free for all ESO Plus™ members and  available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed  under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access  to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns, but you won’t lose  any items or progress you earned while you had access.
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7e12d4075faf4aa692eee3f4952b66804c99589b.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i]

Releasing in tandem with the base DLC, the [i]Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available in the in-game Crown Store for 4,000 crowns and includes the Nightmare Bear mount, the Deadlands Bantam Guar pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find the [i]Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i] in the Featured section of the Crown Store. 
[h2]Getting Started in the Deadlands[/h2]
When you have access to the [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC, you can begin your exploration of this volatile part of Oblivion by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly to the Fargrave Outskirts wayshrine from your map[/*][*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting the “The Celestial Palanquin” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*][/list]
Once you set foot in Dagon’s realm, you can explore the new zone (including Fargrave), begin the DLC’s storyline, or simply explore—it’s up to you! The first time you enter the zone, you’ll receive the Oblivion Explorer’s Headwrap collectible completely free as a bonus reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c97c9f3be40b61ac973fd4edbb59089153cc41e1.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																												      						    						      						        
[i]Prepare to explore Oblivion[/i]
[h2]Update 32 Base-Game Patch[/h2]
Also releasing alongside the DLC is the Update 32 base-game patch. This free update for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players includes a host of new features, bug fixes, and improvements. 

[b]Armory System[/b]

Designed to help you effortlessly switch builds, the new Armory System allows you to quickly swap a character’s attributes, abilities, items, Champion Points, and more. With the Armory Station (free from the in-game Crown Store) you can set, equip, and organize your character’s builds from the comfort of your home. 									      						    						      						        																											

With this system, you can engage in different activities more-easily and reduce the amount of time spent re-customizing your character. In addition to the free Armory Station, you can also acquire an Armory Assistant from the in-game Crown Store for crowns and purchase additional Armory Slots, too (you always start with two for free). 

[b]Curated Item Set Drops[/b]

Part of an ongoing effort to reduce the amount of grind required to collect [i]ESO[/i]’s many powerful sets, Update 32 also introduces a curation system that changes the way items drop. Now, when you defeat a monster, the system attempts to drop set items that you don’t already have in your collection. 

With this change, you can more quickly complete your set collections and perfect your builds, dramatically reducing the amount of frustration that comes when hunting specific item set rewards. Note that some drops will remain completely randomized (such as those found in dungeon chests or items tied to specific bosses). You can find more on curated drops and the Armory System in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61131]preview article[/url]—happy item hunting!

For everything arriving with Update 32, check out the patch notes section on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. 

[h2]Bring Destruction to the Deadlands[/h2]
The Gates of Oblivion year-long saga ends in fire with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/i], and it’s time to take the fight to Mehrunes Dagon himself and explore one of the most inhospitable and dangerous realms of Oblivion. Are you ready and willing to battle the Prince of Destruction’s forces on his home turf? Are you looking forward to the incredible new features arriving free as part of Update 32? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Gates of Oblivion epic concludes with the Deadlands DLC game pack and Update 32, now available for PC/Mac and Stadia* and coming November 16 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4, and PlayStation®5.[/i]

notes.title: A Frightful Fete Comes to Tamriel with the Return of the Witches Festival
notes.content:
[i]Unlock unique collectibles and goodies by slaying Tamriel’s monsters during the Witches Festival in-game event![/i]

[h2]A Ghoulish Gala![/h2]
The Witches Festival begins next Thursday, October 21 at 10AM EDT, and will run until Tuesday, November 2 at 10AM EDT. During this spoopy spectacle, you can acquire unique event-specific rewards including Plunder Skulls, boosts to XP, Event Tickets, and collectibles. 

To take part in the frightful festivities:
[olist][*]Navigate to the Holiday section of the Crown Store and acquire the free quest.[/*][*]Complete the quest “The Witchmother's Bargain" to receive the Witchmother's Whistle memento.[/*][olist][*]If you completed the quest in previous events, you don’t need to acquire the Witchmother’s Whistle or complete the quest again, and you can use the whistle already found in your Collections menu.[/*][/olist][*]Use the whistle to receive a two-hour 100% XP buff and summon the “Witchmother's Cauldron.”[/*][*]Use the Witchmother's Cauldron to transform your character into one of the undead.[/*][olist][*]Note that you do not have to use the Witchmother's Cauldron to gain the XP buff, just the whistle. The Cauldron cannot be summoned in Cyrodiil.[/*][/olist][/olist][h2]Earn Repulsive Rewards[/h2]
During the Witches Festival, when you defeat a boss monster, you’ll receive a Plunder Skull container in addition to your regular rewards. These bloodcurdling boxes have a chance to contain some of the following items: 
[list][*]Fragments of the [b]new[/b] Witch-Tamed Bear Dog pet called Bonedust Pigments[/*][list][*]Combine 10 fragments to craft this collectible[/*][/list][*]Hollowjack style items[/*][*]Dremora style items[/*][*]Witches Festival-themed recipes[/*][*]Witches Festival-themed furnishings and furnishing recipes[/*][*]Bewitching Alchemy reagents[/*][*]… and an assortment of creepy and valuable items![/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																												
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e43a2273423d3af3c553a037bca1ae5a86915e80.jpg[/img]																												      						    						      						        
[i]Drink from the cauldron to transform into the undead[/i]

Even better, the [b]first[/b] [b]time[/b] you slay each different type of boss, you’ll receive a special Dremora Plunder Skull that can contain the above items and has a chance to also include these additional rewards, too: 
[list][*]Dremora Motif chapter pages[/*][*]·Witches Festival Writs[/*][list][*]Complete these writs to unlock an Achievement that’ll grant you the Witch hat collectible AND the “Witch” title![/*][/list][*]Glenmoril Treasure Maps[/*][list][*]Use the map to find Glenmoril Weapon Style pages scattered all over Tamriel[/*][/list][*]Glenmoril Armor Outfit Style pages[/*][*]Grave Dancer Weapon Style pages[/*][*]A [b]new[/b] Marshmallow Toasty Treat emote Runebox[/*][*]A [b]new[/b] Bonefire memento Runebox[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        	
					      						    						      						        
Depending on the type of boss you defeat, you’ll receive one of two different Dremora Motif pages:
[list][*]Final Arena Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Bows and Legs[/*][*]Dark Anchor, Geyser Bosses, Craglorn Focus Points, Harrowstorms, and zone Dragons drop Dremora Motif pages for Daggers and Gloves[/*][*]Delve Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Staves and Belts[/*][*]Final Dungeon Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Helmets and Maces[/*][*]Public Dungeon, Imperial City Bosses, and Quest Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shields and Boots[/*][*]Final Trial Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Swords and Chests[/*][*]World Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shoulders and Axes[/*][/list]
No matter what monsters you hunt during the Witches Festival event period, you’ll always receive bonus rewards for your efforts!

In addition to the above goodies, this year’s event also introduces a new daily quest, titled [b]Plucking the Crow[/b]. This new quest is available each day from Witchmother Taerma, who is within Olyve’s Brewery AND at every Impresario tent in Tamriel. Her daily quest charges you with collecting 50 Cursed Feathers, found within Plunder Skull containers. Once you have collected all 50, you can transform them into an effigy that you can then use to transport yourself into a special realm to battle a new world boss monster—good luck! 

[h2]The Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
Throughout the Witches Festival event, you can earn up to two Event Tickets from the first boss monster you defeat each day, allowing you to earn up to 26 tickets total. Don’t forget to loot those dropped tickets or you might lose them! For this event, the Impresario will stock the following items:
[list][*]All three Unstable Morpholith pet fragments [/*][list][*]The Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]The first TWO fragments for Doomchar Plateau, the morphing collectible house[/*][list][*]The Scorching Pillar and Searing Column[/*][/list][*]Marshmallow Toasty Treat Emote [/*][*]Witch's Bonfire Dust Memento [/*][*]Fragments for the Witch-Tamed Bear-Dog pet [/*][list][*]Called Bonedust Pigments[/*][/list][*]A host of spooky furnishings[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Witches Grab Bags[/*][list][*]Containing collectibles from previous Witches Festival events[/*][/list][/list]
This is your first opportunity to begin collecting the fragments for the Doomchar Plateau house, the Q4 event morphing collectible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/aafe473db61319be09eb94f433feed6c4e83dae7.jpg[/img]																														      						    						      						        
[i]Claim a plot of land in Dagon’s own realm![/i]

Don’t forget, to acquire this house by the end of the year, you’ll need to have an Unstable Morpholith pet to morph AND all four upgrade fragments. Keep an eye out on announcements for 2021’s remaining events! Learn more about how morphing collectibles and upgrade fragments work in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]guide article[/url]. 

[h2]Share Your Spooky Creations with Us![/h2]
Do you have a haunted house or ghastly outfit that you love to show off during Tamriel’s spooky season? Share your creations with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url] and we might share some of our favorites with the rest of the community and on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url]! 

Stalk all the creatures that go bump in the night during the Witches Festival, and you’ll earn a host of exciting event-specific goodies, collectibles, and Achievements. So get ready to hunt monsters, collect Plunder Skulls, and earn some freaky new rewards—we’ll see you in Tamriel! 

[i]The Witches Festival in-game event begins Thursday, October 21 at 10AM EDT, and will run until Tuesday, November 2 at 10AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Get Bonus Drops, Gold, and XP With the Explorer’s Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Thanks to the community’s efforts during the [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/bountiesofblackwood][i]Bounties of Blackwood event[/i][/url][i], you can enjoy bonus XP, resource node drops, and gold in any zone in Tamriel for a limited time.[/i]

[h2]Explore All of Tamriel[/h2]
Kicking off today, October 12 at 10AM EDT, and running until Wednesday, October 20 at 10AM EDT, the limited-time Explorer’s Celebration grants you additional rewards for the following in-game activities:
[list][*]Increased drops from harvest nodes (not fishing!)[/*][*]Increased XP gains from every source[/*][list][*]This stacks with other XP boosts such as scrolls or group multipliers[/*][/list][*]Increased gold earned from monster kills, quest rewards, and similar sources[/*][/list]

Note that the Explorer’s Celebration doesn’t grant Event Tickets and doesn’t have its own unique quests, Achievements, or collectibles associated with it. Additionally, the Impresario isn’t available during this limited period.

Finally, if you own the [i]Blackwood [/i]Chapter, there’s still time to claim your [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/bountiesofblackwood]Bounties of Blackwood rewards[/url] from the in-game Crown Store—don’t miss out!

                      

[i]The Explorer’s Celebration is now live and will run until October 20 at 10AM EDT. [/i]

notes.title: Save Up To 50% on ESO’s Latest Chapter during the Bounties of Blackwood Sale
notes.content:
[i]You can save big on The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood and the base game during our limited-time Bounties of Blackwood Sale.[/i]

The Bounties of Blackwood Sale is now live, giving you the opportunity to save up to 50% on [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i] and up to 60% on [i]The Elder Scrolls Online Standard Edition[/i] on all platforms, including Xbox (Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S), PlayStation (PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5), and PC/Mac (Elder Scrolls Online Store, Bethesda.net, Steam, and Stadia).


Are you a new player? notes.title: Unlock New Rewards Together During the Bounties of Blackwood Event
notes.content:
[i]Work together with your fellow players to unlock new rewards during the Bounties of Blackwood in-game event. [/i]

[h2]Explore Blackwood, Unlock Rewards![/h2]
The Bounties of Blackwood in-game event kicks off this Thursday, September 30 at 10:00AM EDT, and it runs until Tuesday, October 12 at 10:00AM EDT. During the event period, you and your fellow [i]ESO[/i] players can work together to unlock incredible new rewards by earning the [b]Blackwood Pathfinder[/b] achievement. 

To do so, simply visit the six unique striking locales in the zone, and every day, we’ll update the meter found on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/bountiesofblackwood]Bounties of Blackwood page[/url] with the community’s ongoing progress. Once the meter reaches 100% or the event ends, we’ll add the unlocked rewards to the Crown Store (in a single bundle) for [b]ALL[/b] [i]Blackwood[/i] owners to claim. These rewards can include:  
[list][*]The Pellucid Swamp Jelly pet, unlocked at 33%[/*][*]The Shadows of Blackwood markings, unlocked at 66%[/*][*] A cascading bounty box, unlocked at 100%[/*][list][*]With a chance to include items such as Undaunted Plunder, rare materials, or item sets, and guaranteed to include attunable crafting stations and a unique [b]Ogrim target dummy[/b][/*][/list][*]An incredible [b]Mystery Prize[/b] we’ll reveal during the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60911]Gates of Oblivion Year-End Stream[/url], also unlocked at 100%[/*][/list]
						      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a2771ec7db03a79e177349461986c1d6b199a63c.jpg[/img]
																																	      						    						      						        
You’ll have to wait until the Gates of Oblivion Year-End Stream to learn about the fourth and final prize, but trust us, it’s amazing, and well worth risking the dangerous wilds of Blackwood—so get exploring! 

We’ll first update the meter on the Bounties of Blackwood page on the 30<sup>th</sup> to include everybody who has already earned the Blackwood Pathfinder achievement, so don’t worry if you already have it—you’ve helped. We’re adding progress to the meter for each time the achievement is earned for each character, not account, so even if you’re already earned it before, you can always earn it again with a different adventurer.
[h2]Celebrate Blackwood[/h2]
In addition to the community challenge, you can also earn bonus rewards during this event while adventuring in the Blackwood zone. To get started, pick up the Bounties of Blackwood introductory quest from the in-game Crown Store or Impresario tent. 
									      						    						      						        																												
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4def8d503e1fbfc50e9194951309ea8edfed590a.jpg[/img]
																																			      						    						      						        
[b]Blackwood Legates’ Coffers[/b]

During the event period, the first time you complete a daily quest in Blackwood (or the Rockgrove Trial weekly quest instead) you receive a Glorious Blackwood Legates’ Coffer. This new reward box [b]has a chance [/b]to contain some of the following items: 
[list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]Valuables you can trade to merchants for gold[/*][*]Style items for Blackwood motifs[/*][*]Blackwood gear items[/*][*]Treasure maps or Survey reports[/*][*]Blackwood motif chapters[/*][*]A fragment of the new Voriplasm pet[/*][list][*]Combine seven fragments to summon your own Voriplasm pet![/*][/list][*]Blackwood-themed furnishings and furnishing recipes [/*][*]If you have Bastian or Mirri active, a piece of Companion gear[/*][/list]
If you continue to complete daily quests after the first, you can earn regular Blackwood Legates’ Coffers, which have a lower chance to contain the rarer rewards. You can also find regular Blackwood Legates’ Coffers in the following ways:
[list][*]As drops from Delve and World Bosses[/*][*]Earned when completing Oblivion Portals[/*][*]As drops from Blackwood monsters[/*][*]Found in treasure chests, safeboxes, thieves troves, Psijic Portals, or other containers[/*][*]Found when harvesting crafting resource nodes[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Rewards[/b]

In addition to the above, all Blackwood daily quests and the weekly Rockgrove Trial quest have their regular reward boxes doubled, harvest note yields are increased, and World, Public Dungeon, Trial, and Delve bosses drop additional rewards. That’s a ton of great reasons to quest, explore, and battle in Blackwood! 
[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Bounties of Blackwood event, you can earn up to two Event Tickets per day the first time you complete a Blackwood daily, meaning you can earn up to 26 tickets over the entire event. Don’t forget the Event Ticket timer resets at 2:00AM EDT each morning and that if you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them. 

Here’s what the Impresario event merchant will have in stock during the event: 
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]All three fragments for the Dagonic Quasigriff (to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith with)[/*][list][*]The Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather, Black Iron Bit and Bridle, and the new Black Iron Stirrups[/*][/list][*]Voriplasm pet fragments[/*][*]Assorted Blackwood-themed furnishings[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]		
				      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b3a42f0ae26ad1d6fc480a84570baa7941696ca.jpg[/img]	
																													      						    						      						        
This is your first and only opportunity to acquire all the fragments you need to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith into the new Dagonic Quasigriff mount—don’t miss it!
[h2]Pathfinders Unite[/h2]
Discover all of Blackwood’s striking locales and you’ll help the #ESOFam unlock new collectibles for everybody who owns the Chapter, all the while earning bonus rewards as you explore and adventure! Don’t forget, we’re going to announce the final mystery reward during the upcoming [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60911]Year-End Stream[/url], and be sure to check the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/bountiesofblackwood]official page[/url] often to see the community’s progress. Let us know if you’re excited to unlock new rewards with your fellow players during Bounties of Blackwood via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Bounties of Blackwood in-game event begins this Thursday, September 30 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, October 12 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Explore ESO’s Early Adventures during the Year One Celebration Event
notes.content:
[i]Explore some of ESO’s post-launch adventures and you can earn bonus rewards, unique collectibles, and Event Tickets. [/i]

[h2]Sand, Snow, & Blood[/h2]
Kicking off this Thursday, August 26 at 10AM EDT, and running until Tuesday, September 7 at 10AM EDT, you can earn bonus rewards, event-specific collectibles, and Event Tickets while adventuring within the Wrothgar, Craglorn, and Imperial City zones. 

To get started, pick up the introductory quest titled “Sand, Snow, and Blood” from the Crown Store or Impresario tent and then travel directly to one of the three zones.
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/effca5715d4636cfcf11d1bda8ede1caaf8de520.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        			  
As part of the [i]ESO[/i] base game, Craglorn can be  accessed by all [i]ESO [/i]players, and the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC can be purchased  for [b]zero[/b] crowns from the in-game Crown Store. You can get access to the [i]Orsinium[/i]  DLC with ESO Plus™ membership or buy it directly from the Crown Store on sale  for 1,500 crowns (50% off the DLC’s regular price). In addition to this, you  can pick up the [i]Orsinium[/i] Collector’s Bundle from the in-game Crown Store  for 2,000 crowns (also 50% off its regular price), containing the Cave Bear  mount, the Cave Bear Cub pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls.
  
Finally, you can also pick up the 4-DLC Mega Pack  (containing the [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Imperial City[/i], [i]Thieves Guild[/i],  and [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] DLCs) for 2,000 crowns (50% off) or the [i]Imperial  City[/i] Collector’s Bundle for 2,000 crowns (also 50% off) containing the Mind-Shriven  Horse mount, Mind-Shriven skin, Daedrat pet, and five Crown Experience scrolls.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c0756e4885336e36bd4fa1e001b9cae1a76fb106.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/35656d703ebd8cbb19e575a4a2af689413279e22.jpg[/img]																														      						    						      						        
These discounts are available only during the Year One Celebration, and there’s a host of event-specific items also [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60571]arriving in the in-game Crown Store[/url] during the event period, too—don’t miss out!
[h2]Ancient Worlds, New Rewards[/h2]
When you complete quests within Wrothgar, Craglorn, or Imperial City zones, you can receive event-specific bonus rewards and loot.

[b]Year One Coffers[/b]

When you complete various activities in any of the event’s three zones, you have a chance to receive a Year One Coffer in addition to your regular rewards. These activities include:
[list][*]Completing the Year One Celebration intro quest[/*][*]Completing daily quests[/*][*]Defeating Delve and World Bosses[/*][*]Opening treasure chests, safeboxes, or Thieves Troves[/*][*]Claiming a Psijic Portal[/*][*]Harvesting a Harvest Node[/*][*]Defeating a boss in a Craglorn Trial[/*][*]Defeating a boss in the Dragonstar Arena[/*][*]Defeating a boss in the Maelstrom Arena[/*][*]Defeating a boss in either the White-Gold Tower or Imperial City Prison [/*][*]Looting monsters or objects (such as barrels, crates, etc.)[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c28004f31efed9338c49cde864aa348a84fa2915.jpg[/img]
																																		      						    						      						        			  
When you receive a Year One Coffer, they have a chance to  contain the following valuable items: 
                      [list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]Imperial City key fragments[/*][*]Style items for the styles found within Wrothgar, Imperial City, and Craglorn[/*][*]Zone gear set items[/*][*]Transmutation Crystals[/*][*]Valuables you can sell to vendors for gold[/*][*]Motif Chapters style pages from the Wrothgar, Imperial City, and Craglorn zones[/*][list][*]Including Yokudan, Celestial, Ra Gada, Trinimac, Ancient Orc, Malacath, and Xivkyn[/*][/list][*]Pages for the new Old Orsinium weapon styles[/*][*]Pages for Maelstrom Arena weapon styles[/*][*]Pages for the Legion Zero Vigiles armor styles[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        	
					      						    						      						        
Take heed: Each day, [b]the first time[/b] you complete a Daily Quest in Wrothgar, Craglorn, or the Imperial City, you’ll receive a Glorious Year One Coffer, which is guaranteed to contain either a Motif Chapter style page or a page for the new Old Orsinium weapon style.

[b]Bonus Rewards[/b]

In addition to the Year One Coffers, during the event period, the following activities have bonus rewards:
[list][*]Double reward boxes for all Daily Quests in Wrothgar, Imperial City, and Craglorn[/*][*]Increased resource node rewards (not including those from fishing holes or crafting materials obtained from creatures)[/*][*]Bonus loot from World Bosses, Dungeon Bosses, and Delve Bosses[/*][*]Bonus loot from chests in the Maelstrom and Dragonstar Arenas[/*][*]Bonus loot from the bosses in the Craglorn Trials (in addition to earning two coffers for the Trial’s Weekly Quest)[/*][*]Bonus Tel Var stones earned in the Imperial City[/*][/list]
That’s a ton of great reasons to explore some of [i]ESO[/i]’s earliest adventures!

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Year One Celebration, you can earn up to two Event Tickets per day by completing the following:
[list][*]One Event Ticket for completing a Daily Quest in Wrothgar or Craglorn[/*][*]One Event Ticket for completing a District Daily Quest in the Imperial City[/*][/list]
Note that Wrothgar’s Daily Quests are split between the city of Orsinium and Morkul Stronghold. The Event Ticket timer resets at 2:00AM EDT each morning. If you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

Here’s what the Impresario event merchant stocks during the event period:
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]The first [b]and second[/b] fragment for the Dagonic Quasigriff (to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith with)[/*][list][*]The Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather and Black Iron Bit and Bridle[/*][/list][*]Old Orsinium Weapon Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
This event is your second opportunity to acquire fragments required to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith into the new Dagonic Quasigriff mount!
									      						    						      						        																												
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b3a42f0ae26ad1d6fc480a84570baa7941696ca.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
Don’t forget, you’ll need to own an Unstable Morpholith and all three upgrade fragments to unlock this mount, so keep an eye out for future event announcements to snatch up the third and final fragment.
[h2]Orcs, Imperials, & Buried Secrets[/h2]
Return to some of [i]ESO[/i]’s earliest adventures and you’ll have a chance to earn a host of unique rewards and bonus loot during the Year One Celebration in-game event. Which zone will you travel to first? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 

[i]The Year One Celebration in-game event begins at 10:00AM EDT on Thursday, August 26, and it will end at 10:00AM EDT on Tuesday, September 7.[/i]

notes.title: Waking Flame DLC & Update 31 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Continue your Gates of Oblivion adventure with the Waking Flame dungeon DLC and Update 31 base-game patch. [/i]

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online:[/i] [i]Waking Flame [/i]DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia, and it challenges players with two new dungeons, each with their own unique Gates of Oblivion stories. If you play on console, don’t fret—[i]Waking Flame[/i] arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on [b]September 8[/b]. 

This release also includes the free Update 31 base-game patch, which provides all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of additions and improvements to the game. 

[previewyoutube=EeGZQS4ebxE;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																			      						    						      						        
You can access the DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both [i]Waking Flame[/i] and Update 31 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h2]Waking Flame DLC Game Pack[/h2]
Uncover evils in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame[/i] with two amazing new dungeons: Red Petal Bastion and the Dread Cellar. While both PvE challenges explore unique stand-alone stories, they also expand upon the year-long Gates of Oblivion adventure and set up the events of the upcoming [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC (arriving later in 2021). 

[b]Red Petal Bastion[/b]

For centuries, the noble Knights of the Silver Rose had protected the people from Tamriel from the forces of Oblivion, but recently, the order has begun indiscriminately looting nearby shrines to collect holy relics, which they add to their fortress, the Red Petal Bastion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/db38f8e1d9374c0f9a5386bc74f11118f4a8a3d2.jpg[/img]																												      						    						      						        
A devotee of Azura needs your help to confront this once-noble order, reclaim his stolen artifacts, and discover the secret behind the order’s sudden and violent turn. 

[b]The Dread Cellar[/b]

Whispered to be one of the Empire’s most-feared prisons, the Dread Cellar, long thought abandoned, has begun emanating mysterious magical energies. Now home to the cultists of the Waking Flame and their Daedric minions, this once-feared site holds new evils for any would-be adventurers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6de42719eff5d82a8de5b3d3b161933b01403ef5.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
A pair of Imperial Battlemages needs your assistance in their investigation of the prison’s activity, but what role does the Dread Cellar’s own past have in the cultists’ fiendish plans? And to what lengths might the Battlespire go to protect the Empire’s secrets? 

Both dungeons are filled with a host of challenging boss battles to overcome and mysteries to uncover, and both are available in Normal, Veteran, and Hard Mode difficulties for groups seeking difficult opposition. Finally, each dungeon also holds a series unique item sets, Achievements, and collectibles for you to loot and earn, ensuring the rewards are equal to the risks—good luck!   

[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
You can[b] [/b]access [i]The Elder Scrolls Online:[/i] [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC game pack via ESO Plus membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.

The [i]Waking Flame Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Silver Rose Senche-Serval mount, the Ironclad Senche-Serval Kitten pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e4e1ae723cd0cbf5235987fdd030bea342269da0.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
With access to the [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC, you can continue your Gates of Oblivion adventure by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Blackwood (Dread Cellar) and within Glenumbra (Red Petal Bastion)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you’ll receive the Scorion Pyreling pet!
									      						    						      						        																												
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f3283e541ff048af5dd90e7127b9170514d97ce4.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        [h2]Update 31[/h2]
In addition to [i]Waking Flame[/i], the Update 31 base-game patch will arrive in tandem with the DLC as a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players. This update includes assorted bug fixes, balance changes, performance improvements, and a series of quality-of-life additions.

This includes the ability to toggle between HDR modes on consoles in your Settings menu, the addition of Dynamic Resolution Scaling (creating a more responsive framerate experience and providing generally higher resolutions when running in Performance Mode on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5), a beta for Multithreaded Rendering on PC (potentially improving framerates), and a Reply function for your in-game mail. In addition to this, an assortment of new houses, furnishings, and houseguests will arrive in in-game Crown store in the coming months.  

For more on the graphical improvements arriving with Update 31, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60649]this article[/url], and be sure to visit our official forums to review the complete [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/584299/pc-mac-patch-notes-v7-1-5-waking-flame-update-31]patch notes[/url] for both [i]Waking Flame[/i] and Update 31 to get the whole picture.

[h2]The Waking Flame Rises[/h2]
With two exciting dungeons that expand upon the Gates of Oblivion adventures and a slew of graphical enhancements and changes, the [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC and Update 31 base-game patch bring new challenges, rewards, and improvements for all of Tamriel’s adventurers. Are you ready to continue the fight against the forces of Mehrunes Dagon? Tell us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Play ESO Free During the QuakeCon 2021 Free Play Event
notes.content:
[i]You can explore Tamriel for free during the QuakeCon 2021 Free Play Event![/i]

[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay][i]The Elder Scrolls Online QuakeCon 2021 [/i]Free Play Event[/url] is [b]now live[/b] and runs until [b]Monday, August 30 at 10AM EDT[/b]. During the free-play period, anybody on PC/Mac, Xbox consoles (Xbox Live Gold required), PlayStation consoles, and Stadia (Stadia Pro required) can download and play [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] for free!

To join over 18 million players and discover this award-winning RPG for yourself, simply visit [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]our Free Play page[/url] and select your platform. This event gives you access to [i]Morrowind[/i]'s zone (Vvardenfell) and [i]ESO[/i] base game, which includes four of the game’s original classes, 23 unique zones, and countless hours of adventure.

notes.title: Walk Warm Sands & Earn Bonus Rewards During the Pan-Elsweyr Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Adventure in Northern and Southern Elsweyr during the Pan-Elsweyr Celebration in-game event and you’ll unlock new rewards, bonus loot, and Event Tickets. [/i]

[h2]Return to Elsweyr[/h2]
The Pan-Elsweyr Celebration in-game event begins Thursday, July 22 at 10AM EDT, and will run until August 3 at 10AM EDT. During this event period, you can receive bonus loot, unique event rewards, and Event Tickets by exploring and adventuring in the regions of Northern and Southern Elsweyr (from the [i]Elsweyr[/i] and [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLCs, respectively). 

To get started, simply grab the introductory quest titled “A Visit to Elsweyr” from the in-game Crown Store or travel directly to the two unique zones. 

If you don’t own [i]Elsweyr[/i] or [i]Dragonhold[/i], you can acquire both from the in-game Crown Store on sale during the event period, with 50% off the [i]Elsweyr[/i] DLC (and 50% off the Elsweyr Collector’s Pack!) as well as the new addition of the Season of the Dragon mega-pack, which includes the [i]Dragonhold[/i], [i]Wrathstone[/i], and [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLCs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/43333260105afbc5fdd319db14e06e182fac9c34.jpg[/img]																									      						    						      						        			 
[i]Get Elsweyr and explore the home of the Khajiit[/i]

Don’t forget, you can get access to all of the above DLCs with an active [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url], too!

[h2]A Dragon’s Hoard[/h2]
As you complete quests, explore, and adventure in the two zones during the Pan-Elsweyr Celebration, you can receive event-specific rewards. 

[b]Elsweyr Coffers[/b]

When you complete certain activities in either Northern or Southern Elsweyr during the event, you’ll have [b]a chance[/b] to receive an Elsweyr Coffer as an additional bonus reward. These activities include: 
[list][*]Defeating Dragons[/*][*]Defeating Delve and World Bosses[/*][*]Opening treasure chests, safeboxes, or Thieves Troves[/*][*]Claiming a Psijic Portal[/*][*]Harvesting a Harvest Node[/*][*]Defeating a boss in the Sunspire Trial[/*][*]Opening a Dragonguard Sanctum Supply Cache[/*][*]Looting monsters or objects (such as barrels, crates, etc.)[/*][/list]
When you happen to receive a new Elsweyr Coffer, these colorful cartons have a chance to include a host of valuable items, such as: 
[list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]Style items for the styles found within Northern and Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]Zone gear set items[/*][*]Treasure maps for Northern or Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]Transmutation Crystals [/*][*]Motif Chapters style pages from the Northern and Southern Elsweyr zones[/*][*]Pages for the [b]new[/b] Ja’zennji Siir style[/*][/list]
Even better, [b]the first time[/b] you complete a Daily Quest in either Northern or Southern Elsweyr each day, you’ll receive a [b]Glorious Elsweyr Coffer[/b], which is guaranteed to contain either a Motif Chapter style page or a page for the new Ja’zennji Siir style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b123a5322c2c94c7aaf58ac6d8c85ef046b7c811.jpg[/img]																      						    						      						        
[i]The new Ja’zennji Siir[/i] [i]style[/i]

[b]Bonus Rewards[/b]

In addition to the new coffers, during the event period, the following activities will have bonus rewards: 
[list][*]Double reward boxes for all Daily Quests in Northern and Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]Increased resource node rewards (not including those from fishing holes or crafting materials obtained from creatures)[/*][*]Bonus loot from World Bosses, Delve Bosses, and Dragons[/*][*]Bonus loot from the bosses in the Sunspire Trial (in addition to earning two coffers for the Trial’s Weekly Quest[/*][/list]
As you can see, rampaging Dragons aside, there are a ton of great reasons to explore the home of the Khajiit during this event!

[h2]The Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Pan-Elsweyr Celebration, you can earn up to two Event Tickets per day by completing the following: 
[list][*]One Event Ticket for completing a Daily Quest in Northern Elsweyr[/*][*]One Event Ticket for completing a Daily Quest in Southern Elsweyr[/*][/list]
Note that to acquire the Dragonguard-specific Daily Quests in Southern Elsweyr, you must progress the [i]Dragonhold[/i] main storyline. The Event Ticket timer resets at 2:00AM EDT each morning. If you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

Here’s what the Impresario event merchant will stock during the event period: 
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]The first fragment for the Dagonic Quasigriff (to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith with)[/*][list][*]Called the Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather[/*][/list][*]Ja’zennji Siir Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
This event will be your first opportunity to acquire fragments required to upgrade your Unstable Morpholith into the new Dagonic Quasigriff mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b3a42f0ae26ad1d6fc480a84570baa7941696ca.jpg[/img]																											      						    						      						        
[i]The fearsome Dagonic Quasigriff mount[/i]

You’ll need to own an Unstable Morpholith and all three upgrade fragments to unlock this mount, so keep an eye out on future events for more information. 

[h2]The Home of the Khajiit[/h2]
Full of bizarre and wonderful characters, stunning environments, and fearsome winged monsters, the regions of Northern and Southern Elsweyr are some of [i]ESO[/i]’s most unique zones, and there’s no better time to experience them than during the Pan-Elsweyr Celebration event! Let us know what your plans are for visiting the home of the Khajiit via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 

[i]The Pan-Elsweyr Celebration in-game event begins at 10:00AM EDT on Thursday, July 22, and it will end at 10:00AM EDT on Tuesday, August 3. [/i]

notes.title: Experience Every Part of Tamriel During the World Plays ESO Promotion
notes.content:
[i]Discover two months of unique livestreams from streamers, developers, and special guests as we showcase and celebrate everything Tamriel has to offer.[/i]

[h2]The World Plays ESO[/h2]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]’s Tamriel is an ever-growing world of adventure, filled with dangerous realms to explore, mysterious quests and stories to uncover, a host of unique activities and challenges to overcome, and over 18 million fellow players—it’s massive, and it’s only getting bigger!

With the recent launch of our fifth Chapter, [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/chapter/blackwood]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/url][/i], and the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60247]Console Enhanced[/url] version of the game, starting [b]tomorrow, June 22 [/b]and continuing all the up to [url=https://quakecon.bethesda.net/en/]QuakeCon 2021[/url] (starting August 19), we’re challenging a host of special guests, streamers, developers, and you (the fans!) to livestream [i]ESO[/i] over two action-packed months, showcasing absolutely everything the game has to offer new and veteran players alike.

[h2]Unlimited Adventures[/h2]
The World Plays ESO’s participants will include our very own Creative Director Rich Lambert, pro wrestler Nicole Savoy, members of the [i]ESO[/i] Stream Team, and many more surprise guests along the way—all incredible [i]ESO[/i] fans, ready to take on Tamriel. Keep an eye out for a complete list of all the participants tomorrow when the promotion formally kicks off.

Together, they’ll tackle everything from the game’s base-game, DLC zones, and Chapter storylines, and activities such as Dungeons, Trials, PvP (Alliance War and Battlegrounds), crafting, Antiquities, Housing, and more. Phew! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8126fa1ff34f3f609bbbe4bcb3283ad6ce5e37c3.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        			  
[i]We’re streaming almost  everything you can see and do in the game[/i]
  
Check out the schedule below for our first week of The World Plays ESO streams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3b948e4eb898ec39c6e3a05906ce00fa0d93857a.jpg[/img]
																																		      						    						      						        [h2]Tamriel All Together[/h2]
Tune in to any of the streams, and you could pick up some fantastic in-game goodies that our participants will be giving away during their shows, including game codes for the latest [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, collectibles such as the Pink Torchbug pet, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8543c3958c866f79a37a23b6b69a46eaba48bc97.jpg[/img]															      						    						      						        
[i]You could win this pet or the Blackwood Chapter by watching![/i]

Of course, we can’t celebrate everything [i]ESO[/i] without involving our players and community, so we’re also inviting you to share your own adventures as we showcase the game’s different zones, activities, and challenges on Twitter and Facebook using the #WorldPlaysESO hashtag. Share your stories with us, and we’ll share your trials and triumphs with the rest of the #ESOFam. 

[h2]18 Million Strong & Growing[/h2]
Over 18 million adventurers have begun their adventures in [i]ESO[/i], exploring almost every part of Tamriel and worlds beyond. We’re so excited to celebrate everything [i]ESO[/i] has to offer with this massive new global celebration, and we can’t wait to see our streamers dive into the ever-growing, ever-surprising world of Tamriel. For information on the latest streams and World Plays ESO news, visit the official website using the button below. 

Finally, don’t forget to share your own adventures with us using the #WorldPlaysESO hashtag on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—we’ll see you in Tamriel!
									      						    						      						        			
[i]Beginning Tuesday, June 22, and continuing until QuakeCon 2021 on August 19, The World Plays ESO is a massive celebration of everything you can experience in The Elder Scrolls Online, shared via a non-stop series of livestreams hosted by developers, special guests, and Stream Team members.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood & Update 30 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Experience a world on the brink of destruction in The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood, a new Chapter in the Elder Scrolls Online saga. [/i]

We are happy to announce that [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i] and Update 30 are both now live on PC/Mac and Stadia. This new Chapter and update will launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One on June 8, with Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 also available via backwards compatibility.

[previewyoutube=s36tayDTjTs;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																						      						    						      						        [h2]Blackwood Chapter [/h2]
The Daedric Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, has dire plans for the people of Tamriel, and they begin in the lush marshlands of Blackwood. This new adventure features a complex tale of ambition and revolution that is part of the larger Gates of Oblivion year-long saga that began with the [i]Flames of Ambition [/i]DLC in February and continues throughout all of 2021. 

In the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you can experience: 
[list][*]A massive new zone to explore: Blackwood[/*][*]A mysterious new main storyline to unravel of Daedric ambitions and schemes[/*][*]A new system: Companions[/*][*]A new 12-player Trial: Rockgrove[/*][*]A new type of world event: Oblivion Portals[/*][*]A host of new and unique side quests, stories, characters, and challenges[/*][*]A selection of new item sets, collectibles, and Achievements [/*][/list]
[b]Blackwood Zone[/b]

In this new Chapter, you can explore the region of Blackwood, nestled among the swamps of the Black Marsh, the warm sands of Elsweyr, and the rolling hills of Cyrodiil. With a local population made up of Imperials, Argonians, and Khajiit, Blackwood is a unique melting pot of different cultures and peoples. Beyond the high walls of the cities of Leyawiin and Gideon, you’ll experience an untamed wilderness filled with ancient sites of long-forgotten empires, dangerous and diverse local creatures, and the rising Daedric threat from realms beyond. 

[previewyoutube=tnnVb1Bd_B4;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      						    						      						        
[b]A New Storyline[/b]

In the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you must uncover the truth behind the emerging Daedric threat and its connection to the Longhouse Emperors. In this tale of Imperial and Daedric ambitions, what you discover in your adventures in Blackwood will have dire consequences for the people of Tamriel and set up the story for the rest of the year-long Gates of Oblivion saga. 

[previewyoutube=Zv4y-LDyMqA;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																									      						    						      						        
[b]Companions System[/b]

With the new Companions system, you’ll never have to explore Tamriel alone again. Recruit, equip, and fight with one of two new Companions available with this Chapter and take them to almost every corner of Tamriel. As you battle beside your new Companions, they’ll level up and gain new unique skills. In addition, you can increase (or lower) your rapport with your Companions by engaging with them and performing certain actions, allowing you to unlock unique quests and other rewards. 

[previewyoutube=s0XcDi9ZrBc;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																				      						    						      						        
[b]Oblivion Portals[/b]

New world events unique to the Chapter, portals to the Deadlands have begun to appear within the wilds of Blackwood. From these doorways to Oblivion, you and your allies can invade Mehrunes Dagon’s realm and confront the Daedric hordes that now prepare for war. 

[b]Rockgrove Trial[/b]

Gather your allies for a new 12-player Trial and defend Rockgrove against the invading Daedric cultists. Contend with the empowered devotees of Mehrunes Dagon and battle your way through the city and into the Deadlands itself. New gear, Achievements, and collectibles await those willing to stand against the forces of the Prince of Destruction! 

You can discover and read more about [i]Blackwood[/i] on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/category/blackwood]our official site[/url].

[h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i] is available in four editions, including: 
[list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood Upgrade Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new player, the[i] ESO Collection: Blackwood [/i]includes the base game, [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, and all previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, the [i]ESO: Blackwood Upgrade[/i] grants you access to the new Chapter. Note that to run [i]Blackwood[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].

In addition to the Chapter itself, the Collector’s Editions also include a selection of unique in-game items, including a pet, mount, outfit style, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/19dfb67c718a5321aba9a45cbe4707e0399229e3.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Collector’s Edition Items[/i]

For everything on [i]Blackwood[/i]’s editions, Collector’s Edition items, and more, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59473]check out this article[/url]. 

[h2]Getting Started in Blackwood[/h2]
Once you have access to the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways: 

[b]By Wayshrine[/b]

If you’d like to explore Blackwood with an existing character, you can teleport to the new zone directly via the Leyawiin Outskirts Wayshrine. To do so, simply open your map, select the Blackwood zone, and then select the Leyawiin Outskirts Wayshine icon (it should be the only one active in the zone). 

[b]Via the Blackwood Main Quest[/b]

You can acquire the Blackwood main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select Blackwood and pick up the first quest, titled “A Deadly Secret,” to begin. The quest will point you toward where you need to go to make your way to the zone. 

[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]

You can also travel to Blackwood by creating a new character and completing the new tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select Blackwood as your destination zone and get started. 

Of course, you can explore Blackwood with an existing or brand-new character, regardless of their level (there’s no level requirements for any PvE zone). Adventure awaits!

[h2]Update 30[/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, Update 30 is a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that includes a host of new features, quality-of-life improvements, and fixes—no additional purchase needed! 

[b]Endeavors System [/b]

With the new Endeavors system, going live later this month, you can complete daily and weekly tasks to earn a new type of currency, called Seals of Endeavor, used to acquire Crown Crate items. Previously, the only way to own these rare items was by either opening Crown Crates or by spending gems, but with this new system, you can acquire them simply by playing the game. The daily and weekly Endeavors includes all kinds of regular [i]ESO[/i] activities such as combat, exploration, questing, crafting, etc., and rewards variable amounts of Seals each day. 
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e94947fcc6773d1c1c4c13c40b71e95472704035.jpg[/img]																					      						    						      						        
[i]View current Endeavors in your Activity Finder[/i]

This new system arrives with Update 30, but it won’t be active until later in June. Keep an eye out for more information on Endeavors later this month and read more about the new system in this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59925]announcement article.[/url] 

[b]New Tutorial System[/b]

Update 30 introduces a brand-new default Tutorial for all [i]ESO[/i] players and all versions of the game. Within the mysterious Isle of Balfiera, you must help the mage Norianwe navigate ancient Direnni ruins and investigate the emergence of mysterious portals. Upon completion of the tutorial quest, you can choose where you wish to begin your adventures in Tamriel via a portal room granting access to the starting locations of any of the Chapters you own or any of the starting locations for the three base-game Alliances. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/942dc6247c41e320dbaa28a9519a577e51f0f813.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Choose your starting location in the new tutorial experience[/i]

Be warned, once you’ve selected your starting location and entered the portal, you can’t go back! For more on the new Tutorial, see [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-gb/news/post/60151]this preview article[/url]. 

[b]Ability Bar Timers[/b]

A new addition to your Combat Settings menu, Ability Bar Timers allow you to see a timer over an ability’s icon that indicates the remaining duration of its effect. You can enable this timer for both your front and back bars, helping you stay on top of things during [i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced combat. These options are set to “off” by default, but you can enable them for both Keyboard and Gamepad within your Settings. 

These are, of course, just some of the most notable features coming with Update 30, but you can discover a host of other additions and improvements with this patch, including new Monster Masks, bankable Outfit Style pages, and Master Writ quest assistance. Read all about this and more in our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official patch notes[/url]. 

[h2]Oblivion Threatens Tamriel[/h2]
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i], the Prince of Destruction has plans for the people of Tamriel, and the minions of Mehrunes Dagon work tirelessly to enact his dread schemes. Explore this wild and dangerous region, investigate the rising Daedric threat, and take on Oblivion itself as you contend with mortal ambitions and otherworldly monsters alike. 

To help you face these new challenges, from now until June 10 on PC/Mac and from June 8 until June 22 on consoles, you’ll be able respec your Champion Points at no cost! Are you excited to continue or begin your Gates of Oblivion adventure with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.content:
Bethesda has delayed Elder Scrolls Online's next-gen update by a week.

notes.title: Celebrate ESO’s 7th Birthday During the Anniversary Jubilee Event
notes.content:

[h2]ESO Turns 7![/h2]
The Anniversary Jubilee event begins Thursday, April 1 at 10AM EDT, and will run until Tuesday, April 13 at 10AM EDT. During this celebration, you can enjoy a double XP boost and earn new and returning event-specific rewards. 

To get started, acquire the free Jubilee Cake Voucher quest starter titled “Ache for Cake” from the Crown Store (listed under Quest Starters) and make your way to the world-famous Chef Donolon. Eat cake, complete dailies, and earn special gifts—easy!

notes.title: Celebrate the Absurd During the Jester’s Festival In-Game Event
notes.content:
[i]Publicize the pointless and the preposterous with a pretend party sure to perplex the pretentious and the pessimistic but please your puerile peers who profess a passion for playfulness and princely porcine prizes. [/i]

[b]Translation:[/b] The Jester’s Festival has returned! 

[h2]A Frivolous Fête[/h2]
The Jester’s Festival in-game event is live from Thursday, March 25 at 10AM EDT/2PM GMT until Thursday, April 1 at 10AM EDT/3PM BST. During this jovial jubilee, you can earn special event-specific rewards and enjoy a 100% XP boost while completing some truly absurd Jester’s Festival quests.

Seek out the Jester’s Festival pavilions located outside the cities of Ebonheart (Stonefalls), Vulkhel Guard (Auridon), and Daggerfall (Glenumbra) to get started. If you’re having trouble and need directions, you can pick up the Jester’s Festival starter quest free from the in-game Crown Store. Look for it in the Quest Starters category.

Chat with the noble jester versions of the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric, and complete the intro quest and you’ll receive the Pie of Misrule memento—a delicious treat that will also grant you a two-hour, 100% XP buff! Once you’ve completed the intro quest, each jester will also provide you with a daily quest to help spread the joy of the silly season to all of Tamriel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4a84f2914063b849f0e4a4ab2be3f5a301fad645.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Find the Jester’s pavilion to join in on the fun![/i]

This year, as a [i]special treat[/i], we’ve added three brand-new daily quests: 
[list][*]A Foe Most Porcine, acquired from any of the three Jester’s Festival tents or Hammerdeath Arena[/*][list][*]If not already there, this quest will point you toward Hammerdeath Arena [/*][/list][*]The King’s Spoils, acquired within Hammerdeath Arena[/*][*]Prankster’s Carnival, acquired from the Jester’s Festival tent in Stonefalls[/*][/list]
You can complete these AND the original three quests each day, each helping to bring frivolous fun to the people of Tamriel! 

[h2]Ridiculous Rewards[/h2]
When you complete a Jester’s Festival daily quest, you’ll receive a Jester’s Festival Reward Box as an additional prize. These wonderful wares can contain goodies such as valuables (to sell to vendors for gold), consumables, recipes, furnishings, Revelry Pies, and fragments of the [b]new[/b] Playful Prankster’s Surprise Box memento. But wait, there’s more! The first time you complete a daily quest each day, you’ll receive a Stupendous Reward Box instead of the regular one. This special box can include the same items as detailed above, but it also has a chance to contain these items: 
[list][*]Cadwell’s Kitchen Arms Style Pages[/*][*]Fragments of two Mementos: the Festive Noise Maker or Jester’s Festival Joke Popper[/*][*]Jokey Stealies to sell to vendors[/*][*]Runeboxes containing the Cherry Blossom Branch or Jester’s Scintillator mementos[/*][*]Fragments of the Sovereign Sow pet[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Regal Regalia Outfit Style Pages[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Fragments of the Playful Prankster’s Surprise Box memento[/*][list][*]These fragments have a higher chance of dropping in Stupendous Reward Boxes than they do in regular ones.[/*][/list][/list]
Once you’ve earned your daily Stupendous Reward Box, you can still complete the other daily quests to grab additional regular Reward Boxes, too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6e283efca68ecf84087c038e0e9ceb1cbc477a58.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Enjoy the Festival’s princely porcine rewards![/i]

In addition to the daily quests and reward boxes, you can earn special Jester’s Festival Achievements by spreading some cheer the old-fashioned way—with pie! When equipped to your quickbar, the Revelry Pies make for spectacular (and tasty!) projectiles, so be sure to share these delicious treats with your fellow players and NPCs alike as you make your way around Tamriel. 

As the people of Tamriel come to fear your sticky wrath, you can earn unique event-specific Achievements: 
[list][*]The Three Fillings War—Throw 10 Pies at players that are in a different Alliance[/*][*]The Upper Crust—Throw a pie at each of the Alliance Leaders[/*][*]More Than You Can Chew—Throw 10 Pies at Guards[/*][*]Dessert Domination—Complete the above Achievements[/*][*]Messy Business—Kill 10 players while they are covered in pie in Cyrodiil[/*][/list]
Take note that not all share your [i]finely honed[/i] sense of humor, and some might object to having a pie thrown in their face—crazy, right?

By completing the above Achievements, you’ll also earn the “Tin Soldier” and “Empieror” titles and the Obnoxious Mute Face Paint head marking. Finally, you can also earn the Crown of Misrule hat and Lord/Lady of Misrule title by completing each of the three original daily quests or the Royal Jester title and some furnishings by completing every Jester’s Festival Achievement. 

[h2]Grab Your Event Tickets [/h2]
The first time you complete a Jester’s Festival daily quest each day, you’ll receive three Event Tickets as a bonus reward. The Event Ticket timer resets at 1:00AM EDT each morning. If you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

The Impresario will stock the following items during the Jester’s Festival event:
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][*]For more on morphing collectibles, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]this guide[/url][/*][/list][*]All three Deadlands Scorcher Skin fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide, Rune-Scribed Daedra Sleeve, and the [b]new[/b] Rune-Scribed Daedra Veil[/*][/list][*]Regal Regalia Outfit Style pages [/*][*]Sovereign Sow Collectible fragments  [/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
