notes.title: Flames of Ambition DLC & Update 29 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Your Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure begins with the Flames of Ambition DLC and Update 29 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]

The [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and brings two new dungeons to the adventurers of Tamriel. This release also includes Update 29, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that introduces a host of changes and improvements. If you play on Xbox One or PlayStation®4, don’t worry, this DLC and update will also arrive on consoles March 16.
									      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        
Within the DLC and free base-game patch, you will find:

[list][*]Two new dungeons: Black Drake Villa and the Cauldron[/*][*]The beginnings of the Gates of Oblivion storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including item sets, Achievements, and collectibles[/*][*]Update to the Champion System[/*][*]New quality-of-life improvements[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
You can access this DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] and Update 29 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h2]Flames of Ambition DLC Game Pack[/h2]
The Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure begins in fire with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack and two exciting new dungeons, the Cauldron and Black Drake Villa. While both dungeons are exciting stand-alone stories in their own right, both also set up the events of the upcoming [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter and beyond.

[b]Black Drake Villa[/b]

Team up with the adventurous Wood Elf scout [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59603]Eveli Sharp-Arrow[/url] and search the hidden archives of the Black Drake Villa before the mercenaries of the True-Sworn put it to the torch. Take note, while the once-proud mansion is now home to monsters and arsonists, it contains many puzzling secrets and pathways just waiting to be uncovered by eagle-eyed adventurers. You can discover more about Black Drake Villa [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59623]in our preview[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ce4780b87d5f49ee4eed6e6a3dd3cf0d8a94a4e7.jpg[/img]																														      						    						      						        
[i]Confront the flame-wielding True-Sworn[/i]

[b]The Cauldron[/b]

The cult of the Waking Flame has enslaved the local townsfolk and now excavates sinister ruins deep within a long-forgotten mine. With the help of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59587]Dremora Lyranth[/url], you must enter the Cauldron, battle your way through Daedric beasts and cultists, free the captives, and put a stop to their plans before they can complete their dread work. You can preview more of the Cauldron in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59559]this article[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a43b6493014072c045616bb32f75abae9d5c9f0c.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Uncover the Waking Flame’s plans in the Cauldron[/i]

These new dungeons provide two very different experiences for would-be adventures, and they come packed with a host of unique rewards, including powerful gear sets, Achievements, and collectibles. You can attempt to complete both dungeons in Normal and Veteran difficulties, and Black Drake Villa has an optional Hard Mode for each of its three bosses—just in case you and your team want a true challenge!

[h2]How to Get Flames of Ambition[/h2]
Access the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack via ESO Plus™ membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access. 

[b]Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/b]

The [i]Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Falinesti’s Faithful Totem Elk mount, the Clearspring Striped Fawn pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f7cb52d426b37c1187be77a7441674bc23a18ab5.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h2]Explore Flames of Ambition & Get a Unique Weapon Style[/h2]
Once you get access to the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC dungeons, you can begin your Gates of Oblivion adventure by the following methods: 
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within the Gold Coast (Black Drake Villa) and within Deshaan (the Cauldron)[/*][/list]
Simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you’ll receive the Fire-Forged Maul outfit style (as seen below on the left)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2068b43cc4298a89ea403cdd8442b2e57d1e7e67.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Flames of Ambition Loot & Rewards[/i]

[h2]Update 29[/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC, Update 29 is a free base-game patch that brings new features and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players. 

[b]Champion System Redesign[/b]

With the redesigned Champion System, you can better tailor your characters and their playstyles based on the way you want to play. This updated system now uses three constellation groups that reflect [i]ESO[/i]’s gameplay and provides more options for creative and unique builds. These changes also introduce a champion bar, allowing you to slot up to four powerful passive boons for each constellation, ensuring that every decision you make with regards to how you spend your Champion Points is an impactful one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/645f6d9721f24742345209e16f4afcb4f2c7891d.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																				      						    						      						        
[i]Customize your characters with the updated Champion System[/i]

For more on the update to the Champion System, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59651]our preview[/url]. 

[b]Improved Character Sheet[/b]

In addition to the Champion System redesign, the team has also updated the character sheet to include additional advanced stats that were previously obscured or missing. With these additions, you can better see how changes to your character (be it via Champion Points, abilities, gear, or attributes) change its effectiveness—now get out there and craft your perfect build!  

For everything coming with the Update 29 base-game patch, check out our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url]. 
[h2]The Gates of Oblivion Beckon[/h2]
Delve into the [i]Flames of Ambition’[/i]s two new dungeons and you’ll kick off an adventure that continues with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter and beyond. The Prince of Destruction has plans for the people of Tamriel, and you can glimpse his terrible schemes within the Cauldron and Black Drake Villa. Are you ready to battle the minions of Mehrunes Dagon in these two new dungeons? Tell us via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Gates of Oblivion year-long saga begins with the Flames of Ambition DLC game pack, now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and coming March 16 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4. This update releases in tandem with Update 29, a free base-game patch for all ESO players. [/i]

[i]*Available only in limited territories.[/i]

notes.title: Get a Free Pet & Respecs During the Heroes Reforged Event
notes.content:
[i]Get a free pet and rebuild your characters from the ground up during the Heroes Reforged in-game mini event. [/i]

[h2]Build A New You[/h2]
To celebrate the arrival of Update 29’s Champion System overhaul, we’re happy to announce the Heroes Reforged mini event. Beginning with the launch of Update 29 for each platform (PC/Mac: Monday, March 8 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT; Xbox One and PlayStation®4: Tuesday, March 16 at 10AM/3PM), this event will run for two weeks and allow you unlimited free respecs from Rededication Shrines for the following:
[list][*]Attributes (Health/Stamina/Magicka)[/*][*]Skills (and Morphs)[/*][*]Champion Points (from the Champion Point system menu)[/*][/list]
Note that the above start times may shift depending on when Update 29 goes live and servers open, and when you first log in, all Skills and Champion Points will be automatically reset. 

While the changes coming with Update 29 impact only the Champion System, we know that you’ll likely want to test many builds, so for two weeks you can reset, respec, and rebuild any and all of your characters as many times as you want for free when using a Rededication Shrine or the Champion Point redistribution function—easy!  

Finally, this is not a full in-game event (such as the Midyear Mayhem or the recent Tribunal Celebration), and as a result it will not have Event Tickets or unique rewards—just free re-specializations. That’s two weeks to experiment and test your builds at no cost. 

[h2]Grab a Free Pet[/h2]
Because Update 29 requires a mandatory skill respec (including both Champion Points and Skill Points), we’re also offering the Ambersheen Vale Fawn pet from the in-game Crown Store, completely free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b228792702c30977fa7f763e916bfd14742d1743.jpg[/img]																											      						    						      						        
[i]The adorable Ambersheen Vale Fawn[/i]

You can find this free pet under the Pets category within the Crown Store, and it is available only during the event period for your platform—don’t miss out! 

[i]The Heroes Reforged Event begins for PC/Mac on Monday, March 8 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT, and it runs until Monday, March 22 at 10AM EDT/3PM BST. For Xbox One and PlayStation[/i]®[i]4, the event starts Tuesday, March 16 at 10AM EDT/3PM BST, and it runs until Tuesday, March 30 at 10AM EDT/3PM BST. [/i]

notes.title: Earn Bonus Rewards During the Tribunal Celebration!
notes.content:
[i]Return to the island of Vvardenfell or to Seht’s world in miniature, and you’ll earn bonus rewards and Event Tickets. [/i]

[h2]Two Wonderful Worlds[/h2]
The Tribunal Celebration in-game event begins this Thursday, February 25 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT, and runs until Tuesday, March 9 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT. During the event period, you can receive the following bonus rewards when adventuring within the Vvardenfell and Clockwork City zones: 
[list][*]Double reward boxes for zone daily quests and Trial weekly quests[/*][*]Increased rewards from harvest nodes[/*][list][*]Not including fishing holes or heavy sacks[/*][/list][*]World, Delve, and Trial bosses will drop additional loot when defeated[/*][*]Public dungeon and world bosses have a [b]chance[/b] to drop a tradeable [b]NEW [/b]style page for the new Doctrine Ordinator outfit style[/*][*]The final boss in both the Asylum Sanctorum and Halls of Fabrication have a guaranteed chance to drop a tradeable style page for the new Doctrine Ordinator outfit style[/*][/list]	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/35b839cb5a6e4100dd23dfa25ab5fc1af1865fe6.jpg[/img]																													      						    						      						        
[i]Earn these new rewards in Vvardenfell & the Clockwork City[/i]

[b]Tribunal Coffers[/b]

That’s a lot of great reasons to return to (or visit for the first time) the regions of Vvardenfell and the Clockwork City. However, in addition to these bonus rewards, when you complete a daily quest in either one of the two zones, you’ll receive a Tribunal Coffer. 

Within this consecrated container, you’ll have a chance to receive some of these thrice-blessed items: 
[list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]Overland set items from the two zones[/*][*]Style pages (and in rare cases, entire Motif Chapters) for the Ashlander, Morag Tong, Telvanni, Redoran, Hlaalu, Ebonshadow, and Clockwork Apostle styles[/*][*]Transmutation Crystals[/*][*]Vvardenfell or Clockwork City treasure maps[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] The Slag Town Diver Skin Runebox (tradeable) [/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Thetys Ramarys’s Bait Kit memento Runebox (tradeable)[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Fragments for the Microtized Verminous Fabricant pet (tradeable) [/*][/list]
Even better, the [b]first[/b] time you complete a daily quest each day, you’ll receive a [b]Glorious Tribunal Coffer [/b]instead. Glorious Tribunal Coffers contain the same items as their regular counterparts but have a higher chance of receiving some of the rarer items, such as the skin, memento, or pet fragments.  

Finally, during the event, regular Tribunal Coffers also have a chance to drop randomly from various zone activities, including defeating bosses, looting objects, and even slaying random monsters. 

[h2]Get Morrowind & Clockwork City [/h2]
If you’ve yet to explore the island of Vvardenfell or delve into the metaphysical realm of the Clockwork City, you can pick up both DLCs and their respective Collector’s Bundles on sale in the in-game Crown Store at up to 50% off from February 25 until March 9 (the event period). 

In addition to these deals, during the same period, the Crown Store will also feature both the new Doctrine Ordinator Weapons Pack and the Mother Morrowind’s Sacred Lullaby music box AND bring back Dwarven Crown Crates! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b3348186a8f6cba536aad64e126c1af5d2cb73d.jpg[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/70d664e67a36350a997e4ca4bb14c948d71d5f23.jpg[/img]								      						    						      						        																																										      						    						      						        
[i]The Doctrine Ordinator Weapons Pack & Mother Morrowind’s Sacred Lullaby music box[/i]

Don’t forget, all [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus members[/url] will automatically have access to both DLCs as part of their membership benefits. 

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
Throughout the event, you can earn two Event Tickets per day via the following activities: 
[list][*]One Event Ticket from the first Vvardenfell daily quest of any kind that you turn in[/*][*]One Event Ticket from the first Clockwork City daily quest of any kind that you turn in[/*][/list]
The Event Ticket timer resets at 1:00AM EST/6:00AM GMT each morning. Note that if you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

The Impresario will stock the following items during the Tribunal Celebration: 
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][*]For more on morphing collectibles, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]this guide[/url][/*][/list][*]The first two Deadlands Scorcher Skin fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide and Rune-Scribed Daedra Sleeve[/*][/list][*]Doctrine Ordinator Outfit Style pages [/*][*]Slag Town Diver skin[/*][*]Thetys Ramarys’s Bait Kit memento [/*][*]Microtized Verminous Fabricant pet [/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
Note that none of the above items are tradeable if acquired with Event Tickets from the Impresario. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c73692797085feed96244701be54f4646626d066.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Collect the second Upgrade Fragment for the Deadlands Scorcher Skin[/i]

[h2]Praise the Three![/h2]
Adventure throughout the home of the Dark Elves and Sotha Sil’s greatest creation and you’ll receive bonus loot and all-new collectibles. Are you excited to return to Morrowind and the Clockwork City? Or are you going to be experiencing these wonderful and often bizarre worlds for the first time? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url][i].[/i]

[i]The Tribunal Celebration in-game event begins this Thursday, February 25 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT, and runs until Tuesday, March 9 at 10AM EST/3PM GMT. [/i]

notes.title: Seize Loot & Glory during the Midyear Mayhem PvP Event!
notes.content:
[i]Battle in the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and Imperial City during the Midyear Mayhem PvP event and you’ll earn bonus XP, collectibles, and more![/i]

[h2]To Battle![/h2]
The Midyear Mayhem in-game event for Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and the Battlegrounds begins this Thursday, January 28 at 10:00AM EST, and the fight will continue until Tuesday, February 9 at 10:00AM EST. 

During this action-packed event, you can earn bonus rewards when battling your fellow players in PvP activities, including double XP and Alliance points and event-specific collectibles, Achievements, and titles. 

Here's how you can join the fight: 
[olist][*]Visit the in-game Crown Store to acquire the “Details on the Midyear Mayhem" quest[/*][*]Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities[/*][/olist][list][*]You are no longer required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off the event[/*][/list][*]Find the NPC named “Predicant Maera" and continue the quest[/*][list][*]If you already completed the quest last year, you won't need to do it again[/*][/list][*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box[/*][*]Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:[/*][list][*]Alliance Points gained[/*][*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																												

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/add111a9d96690993bf7417ea1a08b4fa8adaac7.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Prepare for battle[/i]

The Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity will continue to be usable throughout the entire event, but if you happen to lose it, you can receive another from Predicant Maera or simply use the Basin of the Gore Virtuous instead. 
[h2]Fight for Loot & Glory[/h2]
In addition to the bonus Alliance Points and XP you can gain during this event, you can also loot a host of Midyear Mayhem rewards, collectibles, and Achievements. 

[b]NEW Ebonsteel Armor Outfit Style Pages[/b]

Become a true knight of Tamriel with these new tradeable Outfit Style pages, dropped by bosses in the Imperial City, including those found in the city itself and the sewers. 

[b]Second Legion Outfit Style Pages [/b]

Wear the classically Imperial raiment of the Imperial City’s Second Legion with tradeable Outfit Style pages, dropped by bosses within the Imperial City, including those found in the city itself and the sewers.

[b]Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath[/b]

As usual, you can claim the Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath collectible by completing all of the Midyear Mayhem Achievements below:

·        Mayhem Connoisseur: Receive the blessing of the Whitestrake at one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.
[list][*]Echo of Pelinal's Fury: Read a Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Hand of the Whitestrake: Acquire your 25th Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box.[/*][*]Wrath of the Whitestrake: Defeat 50 opponents during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinavant the Scourge: Win a Battleground match during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinaline the Bloody: Capture a Keep in Cyrodiil during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinerrif Insurgent: Capture an Imperial District during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][/list]
Note that access to the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack is required to earn all of the above Achievements, so pick it up FREE from the in-game Crown Store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a181bb1f9cb6449a6a44fb6c6878d3cc5ac10a3b.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Earn glory by battling your fellow players[/i]

[b]Boon Boxes[/b]

As you battle your fellow players in Cyrodiil, the battlegrounds, and the Imperial City, you’ll also earn Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Boxes. You can get these in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers and as PvP daily quest rewards from the following:
[list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests[/*][/list]
When you receive and open one of Pelinal’s boons, you have a chance to receive the following items:
[list][*]Transmute Crystals[/*][*]Alchemy reagents[/*][*]PvP consumables such as repair kits, forward camps, and siege weapons[/*][*]Motif pages for the Alliance and Akaviri styles[/*][*]Style items for your Alliance[/*][*]Akaviri style items[/*][*]Coldharbour siege weapons[/*][*]Prismatic Runestones[/*][*]Books of Pelinal housing items[/*][*]Resource Notes and “The Golden”[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] fragments for a runebox containing the Alliance Breton Terrier pet[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																																					      						    						      						        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c773e04bf695b8e5413678628acc2cc1d885ff2f.jpg[/img]
[i]The Alliance Breton Terrier pets[/i]

Finally, throughout the event, harvesting nodes within Cyrodiil and the Imperial City will drop double their regular resources, and the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi Aba-daro (also known as “The Golden”) stocks Alliance War Legendary-quality jewelry, with necklaces during the first weekend and rings during the second.

[h2]Event Tickets & Unstable Morpholiths[/h2]
During the Midyear Mayhem event, you can earn up to three Event Tickets per day by completing two different PvP activities:
[list][*]Two tickets for completing any Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds daily quest[/*][*]One ticket for completing any Imperial City district daily quests[/*][/list]
The Event Ticket timer resets at 1:00AM EDT each morning. Note that if you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them.

This Midyear Mayhem event also introduces a brand-new series of base and upgrade fragments for the year! These fragments will allow you to summon the new Unstable Morpholith pet and eventually upgrade the pet into different items throughout 2021. You can begin collecting your pet fragments by picking them up from the Impresario for Event Tickets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6dafa1c8d48555867d0e97eb9e72e2a5e05f03d7.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																														      						    						      						        
[i]Be careful when handling the Unstable Morpholith pet![/i]

Here’s everything the Impresario will stock during the Midyear Mayhem event:
[list][*]Unstable Morpholith base fragments[/*][list][*]Including the Deadlands Flint, Rune-Etched Striker, and Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder[/*][/list][*]The first Unstable Morpholith upgrade fragment[/*][list][*]The Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide[/*][/list][*]Ebonsteel Armor Outfit Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Second Legion Outfit Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Breton Terrier pet[/*][*]Midyear Grab Bags[/*][list][*]Containing a collectible you don’t currently have from previous Midyear Mayhem events[/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
Once you have all three base fragments, you’ll be able to summon your Unstable Morpholith pet from your Collections UI. During the event, you can also collect the first upgrade fragment to eventually upgrade your Morpholith into the Deadlands Scorcher skin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c73692797085feed96244701be54f4646626d066.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Deadlands Scorcher skin[/i]

As you might have guessed, the Unstable Morpholith and fragments work the same way as the Indrik feathers and berries did from previous events. Simply collect them during the events and use them to unlock new collectible rewards! For more on these new rewards and Event Tickets in general, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]our guide[/url]. 

[h2]Mayhem Returns[/h2]
Battle your fellow players in the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and Imperial City and you’ll receive bonuses to XP and Alliance Points AND unlock a host of new and returning event collectibles. Are you ready to take up arms and fight during this action-packed in-game event? Tell us via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. Glory and honor!

[i]The Midyear Mayhem in-game event begins on Thursday, January 28 at 10:00AM EST, and will end on Tuesday, February 9 at 10:00AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Update on Twitch Drops for The Elder Scrolls Online
notes.content:
[i]We’ve updated the way you can earn Twitch Drops when watching your favorite ESO streams. Find everything you need to know to keep earning Drops here![/i]

With Twitch’s changes to the way Drops are now earned and delivered, there are some things you need to do to ensure that you continue (or begin!) to earn Drops when watching a Drops-enabled [i]ESO [/i]stream. 

For starters, you still need to [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/41809/]link your [i]ESO[/i] and Twitch accounts[/url]. This process hasn’t changed:
[olist][*]Log into your [url=https://account.elderscrollsonline.com][i]ESO[/i] account[/url] [/*][*]Click “Linked Accounts” on the left of the page[/*][/olist][list][*]Note that if you don’t know your account info, you can reset your email and activate your account via the additional [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/48788]steps found here[/url]. [/*][/list][*]Click “Link Twitch Account” [/*][*]A Twitch window will appear[/*][list][*]If you are logged into your Twitch account already, you'll be asked to authorize [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] - Live to use your Twitch account[/*][*]If you are not logged into your Twitch account, you'll be prompted to log in[/*][/list][*]Click “Authorize” to link your [i]ESO[/i] account to your Twitch account[/*]
Once you’re sure your accounts are linked, there’s a few things you need to be aware of to ensure you get your goodies:
[list][*]When a stream is Drops-enabled, you’ll get a notification popup letting you know they are live, in addition to a tag on the streamer’s page [/*][*]Per Twitch’s guidelines, you [b]must[/b] watch a Drops-enabled stream for at [b]least 15 cumulative minutes[/b][/*][list][*]You can track your progress on earning a Twitch Drop via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory[/url][/*][/list][*]You are [b]guaranteed[/b] a Drop once you meet the 15 minute requirement[/*][*]Once you earn a Drop, a chat notification will appear that you [b]must select[/b] to claim the Drop[/*][list][*]Alternatively, you can claim the Drop via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory[/url] [/*][*]Note that if watching on console, you will need to swap to PC or Mobile to visit this page and claim your rewards[/*][*][b]Important[/b]: In some cases you may have a limited time to claim your Drops, so be sure to grab them as soon as you see the notification[/*][/list][*]Once claimed, the Drops will be added to your account and you can find them in game as usual[/*][/list]
Drops for [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] can include Ouroboros Crown Crates, which contain a random selection of in-game consumables such as Crown Poisons, Mimic Stones, Riding Lessons, or Experience Scrolls. They also have an extremely rare chance to contain an exclusive Senche of Scarlet Regret mount or Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/16af16ee643221863f94f924d689a6f033f72235.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Senche of Scarlet Regret mount and Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret pet[/i]

During special events or streams, there might be additional drops rewards, too! 

That’s it! Make sure you’re linked, watch a stream, then claim your Drops—easy. Be sure to keep your eye on the Twitch Drops Schedule at the bottom of our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/streamers]Streamers page[/url] for upcoming scheduled Twitch Drops and pay attention to the latest news on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url].

notes.title: Celebrate a Year of Adventure with the New Life Festival Event
notes.content:
[i]Earn bonus XP and rewards during the New Life Festival in-game event and celebrate another year of adventure in Tamriel! [/i]

[h2]Complete Quests & Be Merry! [/h2]
The New Life Festival in-game event begins this Thursday, December 17 at 10AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, January 5 at 10AM EST. To take part in this cross-cultural celebration, pick up the New Life Festival quest from the in-game Crown Store and use it to locate the New Life Herald Breda, found south of the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch. You can teleport directly to the New Life festival tent via the portal found at Impresario locations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/9664ec10af6cb7d9ea7b55e0cb0486c9f4e18a14.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        			  
[i]Celebrate New Life  together[/i]
  
Once you have completed the intro quest, you’ll unlock 10  special New Life-themed daily quests that send you all over Tamriel. These  include a [b]brand-new quest[/b] titled “Old Life Remembrance,” available from  Petronius Galenus in the New Life Festival tent, that allows you to memorialize  the year in true Imperial style.

  [h2]New Life, New Rewards[/h2]  
When you complete one of Breda’s New Life Festival daily quests, you receive a New Life Festival Gift Box. Tear open your gift (don’t worry about saving the wrapping!) to receive some of these New Life-themed items:
[list][*]Skinchanger Motif chapters[/*][*]New Life recipes[/*][*]New Life collectibles (packaged in Runeboxes and tradeable):[/*][list][*]Sword-Swallower's Blade memento[/*][*]Juggler's Knives memento[/*][*]Fire-Breather's Torches memento[/*][*]Mud Ball Pouch memento[/*][*]Nordic Bather's Towel costume[/*][*]Colovian Filigreed Hood hat[/*][*]Colovian Fur Hood hat[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Snowball Buddy pet[/*][/list][*]A selection of lights, lamps, and lanterns for your home to celebrate the Signal Fire Sprint[/*][*]Draughts of Stealth and Escape to celebrate the Trial of Five-Clawed Guile[/*][/list]
In addition to the above, when you open a New Life Festival Gift Box, you may also receive one of these two different types of Charity Writs.
[list][*]Deep Winter Charity Writs—Complete to unlock pages from the Skaal Explorer outfit style.[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Imperial Charity Writs—Complete to unlock pages from the Rkindaleft Dwarven Weapon Style.[/*][/list]		

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/88584fe053b8b940c126662a43ee598b621111e4.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        			  
[i]Unlock  these new weapon styles[/i]
  
Finally, complete any 12 of the above writs and you can also  unlock the “Newly Charitable” Achievement and Crystalfrost skin.

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]  
The first time you complete a New Life Festival quest each day, you’ll receive [b]three Event Tickets[/b] in addition to your Gift Box and other rewards. With Event Tickets, you can purchase the following goods from the Impresario:
[list][*]All four Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]ALL 2020 Indrik Berries for the Spectral, Icebreath, Mossheart, and Crimson Indriks[/*][list][*]Allowing you to complete any evolutions you might have missed this year![/*][/list][*]The Rosethorn Indrik pet[/*][*]The Snowball Buddy pet[/*][*]Pages for the new Rkindaleft Dwarven Weapon Style[/*][list][*]These are bound to your account[/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
The Crimson Indrik will be [i]ESO[/i]’s final Indrik evolution, so don’t hesitate to snatch up this striking red mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ad2bbc211b348e9b53d098038b8241a74e4c6789.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]The Crimson Indrik mount[/i]

[h2]Celebrate Together[/h2]
Enjoy bonus XP, complete New Life quests, and receive unique holiday-themed rewards as the people of Tamriel come together to reflect on the year that has passed and look forward to the future. How are you planning to celebrate New Life? Share your plans with us on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The New Life Festival begins Thursday, December 17 at 10:00AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, January 5 at 10:00AM EST. Part of our [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/tamrieltogether][i]#TamrielTogether celebration[/i][/url][i], the New Life Festival is ESO’s final 2020 event. For more on #TamrielTogether, including the massive Sweepstakes competition and information on how you can join us in our celebration of ESO’s many amazing communities, check out [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58841][i]this article[/i][/url][i].[/i]

notes.title: Earn New Collectibles & More During the Undaunted Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Who has no fear of beast or blade? UNDAUNTED! Earn bonus  loot during the Undaunted Celebration, ESO’s PvE dungeon event![/i]

[b]Important note:[/b] We have made the decision to officially move the upcoming Undaunted Celebration event, and it will now begin December 3 at 10AM EST and run until December 15 at 10AM EST. 

[h2]We Are Undaunted![/h2]  

The Undaunted Celebration begins Thursday, December 3 at 10:00AM EST and runs until Tuesday, December 15 at 10:00AM EST. During this in-game event, you can earn bonus  rewards and glory for completing any of Tamriel’s four-player dungeons. 
  
To join the fight, use the Dungeon Finder tool or travel to  any dungeon in Tamriel and complete it on Normal or Veteran difficulty—you  choose! 

  [h2]Shiny New Collectibles[/h2]  
When you defeat a dungeon’s final boss during this event, in  addition to its regular rewards it also drops an [b]Undaunted Reward Box[/b].  These celebrated containers can hold all kinds of useful and valuable loot,  including Undaunted Keys, Undaunted Plunder (to sell for gold), motif pages,  repair kits, transmute crystals, and more. If you’re not sure that you’re ready  to tackle dungeons (or perhaps don’t have the time), you can also earn one [b]Undaunted  Reward Box[/b] a day by completing Bolgrul’s daily Undaunted delve quest. You  can find Bolgrul within any Undaunted Enclave. 
  
During the event period, the [b]first time [/b]you complete  a dungeon each day, you’ll receive a fancier, [b]Glorious Undaunted Reward Box[/b].  This daily drop will include the same rewards as its less-famous cousin, but  it’s also guaranteed to contain an Opal Weapon Style page for the following  boss styles:
                [list][*][b]NEW[/b] Iceheart (Direfrost Keep)[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Lord Warden (Imperial City Prison) [/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Nightflame (Elden Hollow II) [/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Swarm Mother (Spindleclutch I)[/*][*]Ilambris (Crypt of Hearts I)[/*][*]Troll King (Blessed Crucible)[/*][*]Bloodspawn (Spindleclutch II)[/*][*]Engine Guardian (Darkshade Caverns II)[/*][/list]
Don’t forget to loot the final boss!
  
However, that’s not all you can earn during this event. If you  complete one of the above dungeons on [b]Veteran Hard Mode difficulty[/b], you  also have a chance (just a chance) to earn an [b]Opal Monster Mask style page[/b]  for their respective bosses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/515e56e1a58258777d6e190bbf0abe1455db8a64.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Earn new Opal weapon styles[/i]

Finally, if you own the original, “non-shiny” version of the shoulders already, you can purchase the [b]Opal Monster Shoulder style pages[/b] for 50 Undaunted Keys from their respective Undaunted vendors. If you’re feeling lucky, they also sell Mystery Coffers for 25 Undaunted Keys that can drop a random Opal Monster Shoulder style page, too.
[h2]Event Tickets & The Impresario[/h2]
The first time you slay a final boss in a dungeon each day, you earn three Event Tickets (again don’t forget to loot your fallen foe). With these tickets, you can acquire the following event-specific collectibles and goods from the Impresario:
[list][*]All four Nascent Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Style pages for the new Opal[b] [/b]Weapons, Masks, and Shoulders[/*][list][*]These are bound to your account[/*][/list][*]Three Crimson Indrik Berries (Berries of Budding, Bloom, and Growth)[/*][list][*]The fourth Berry will be available in the upcoming New Life Festival[/*][/list][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][/list]
The Crimson Indrik is [i]ESO[/i]’s final Indrik evolution, so don’t miss out on your chance to earn this majestic mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ad2bbc211b348e9b53d098038b8241a74e4c6789.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        			  
[i]The striking  Crimson Indrik[/i]
  [h2]Triumph Together[/h2]  
Gather your fellow adventurers and take the plunge into any  one of Tamriel’s dungeons and you’ll earn bonus rewards. Whether you’re a  rookie dungeon delver looking to take your first steps into these challenging  group activities or a veteran hunting some of the game’s hardest Achievements,  the Undaunted Celebration brings no shortage of glory and rewards for Tamriel’s  adventurers. What dungeon are you going to run during this new event? Let us  know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
  
[i]The Undaunted Celebration begins Thursday, December 3 at 10:00AM EST and runs until Tuesday, December 15 at 10:00AM EST. Part of our [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/tamrieltogether][i]#TamrielTogether  celebration[/i][/url][i], the Undaunted Celebration is the next event in a series  of end-of-year events coming to The Elder Scrolls Online. For more on #TamrielTogether,  including the massive Sweepstakes competition and information on how you can  join us in our celebration of ESO’s many amazing communities, check out [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58841][i]this article[/i][/url][i].[/i]

notes.title: Get Bonus XP, Gold, and Drops During the Explorer’s Celebration
notes.content:
[i]For this weekend only, you can get double XP, resource node drops, and gold in any zone in Tamriel during the Explorer’s Celebration![/i]

[h2]Explore All of Tamriel[/h2]
Kicking off this Thursday, November 12 at 10AM EST, and running until Monday, November 16 at 10AM EST, the limited-time Explorer’s Celebration grants you additional rewards for the following in-game activities: 
[list][*]Double drops from harvest nodes (not fishing!) [/*][*]Double XP gains from every source[/*][list][*]This stacks with other XP boosts such as scrolls or group multipliers[/*][/list][*]Double gold earned from monster kills, quest rewards, and similar sources[/*][/list]
These bonuses are available to all players in any zone in Tamriel—including [i]Markarth[/i]’s two new zones, the Reach and Arkthzand Caverns!

Note that the Explorer’s Celebration doesn’t grant Event Tickets and doesn’t have its own unique quests, Achievements, or collectibles associated with it. Additionally, the Impresario isn’t available during this limited period. 

To sum up, the Explorer’s Celebration begins tomorrow and runs for this weekend only, so don’t miss out on your chance to get extra XP, gold, and resource node drops—have fun!

notes.title: Markarth & Update 28 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes with Markarth,  our newest DLC game pack for The Elder Scrolls Online. Learn all about the new  DLC and Update 28 base-game patch in this launch article. [/i]
  
The [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack and Update 28 are now  available on PC/Mac and Stadia*, taking you to the wilds of the Reach and  bringing the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim storyline to its epic conclusion. If  you play on Xbox One or PlayStation®4, don’t worry—[i]Markarth[/i] will release  on consoles November 10!
  
Within the DLC and free base-game patch, you will find:
                [list][*]Two new zones to explore: the Reach and Arkthzand Caverns[/*][list][*]Packed full of new quests, characters, and challenges[/*][/list][*]The conclusion to the Dark Heart of Skyrim storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including item sets, Achievements, and collectibles[/*][*]A new solo arenaVateshran Hollows[/*][*]The new Item Set Collection system[/*][*]New quality-of-life improvements[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]

[previewyoutube=GrFpFbwH4K4;full][/previewyoutube]
						      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      						    						      						        
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. You can read the patch notes for both [i]Markarth[/i] and Update 28 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. 

[h2]Markarth DLC Game Pack[/h2]
The Reach is under siege, and the dark forces of the Gray Host prey on the land’s beleaguered tribes from deep beneath the city of Markarth. In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Markarth[/i], you can explore two new zones, discover the proud tribes of Reachfolk, and conclude the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure. 

[b]Explore the Reach & Arkthzand Caverns[/b]

For the first time in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], you can explore the unforgiving wilds of the Reach and the underworld beneath it. Filled with new stories, characters, and challenges, as you venture into this perilous part of Skyrim, you’ll encounter a people both stalwart and resilient, struggling to defend their home against the Gray Host. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1420634848f02794518156637d3603ba90113ecf.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Explore Markarth under Reach control[/i]

In addition to the Reach, you can also venture into the area of Blackreach known as the Arkthzand Caverns, the world beneath the city of Markarth. Filled with new quests, delves, world bosses, Harrowstorms, and more, these two zones will challenge even the strongest adventurers and doom those foolhardy enough to go it alone or unprepared. For more, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58893]our preview[/url]. 

[b]The Dark Heart of Skyrim Concludes[/b]

In the [i]Markarth[/i] storyline, you’ll join forces with the local Reachfolk to confront the Gray Host. As you stand with the “Despot of Markarth” Ard Caddach and other Reach allies, you’ll unravel the terrible schemes of the Vampire Lord Rada al-Saran, and battle your way into the darkest depths of Blackreach to stop him. 

While the [i]Markarth[/i] storyline is a complete tale from start to finish, should you have already completed the [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter’s AND the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC’s main storyline, you’ll unlock additional quests that bring the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure to its final epic conclusion. 

[b]Vateshran Hollows Arena[/b]

Test your mettle and discover if you’re strong enough to call the Reach home in Vateshran Hollows, a new solo arena designed to push even Skyrim’s strongest warriors to the limits of their skill and courage. Within this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59049]new single-player challenge[/url], you’ll have the opportunity to choose your paths as you enter three realms touched by Oblivion and defeat the dangers within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/15283ee931bd7066f3bfa69a486f783440c6f9ed.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Choose your path in Vateshran Hollows[/i]

Filled with challenging boss battles and no shortage of secrets, you’ll earn rewards and honors for completing this new arena, including special item sets, Achievements, and collectibles. Get ready to claim the title of Spiritblood Champion—glory awaits! 

[b]The Reach’s Bounty[/b]

As you explore both the Reach and the world beneath, you’ll uncover and earn rewards unique to the new zone and DLC, such as powerful item sets (three zone sets and three crafted sets), exclusive collectibles, and Achievements. It won’t be easy, but the bounty of the Reach is there for those strong enough to take it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c2b9b380e059318a6d34c41ab4594cf13c036bc5.jpg[/img]																												      						    						      						        
[i]Earn all-new rewards in Markarth[/i]

[h2]How Do I Get Markarth?[/h2]
The [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

In addition to the base DLC, the [i]Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Chaurus Egg Chaser’s Horse mount, the Teacup Chaurus Chitterling pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/096212e212b410d7b9e3c7415a9fd7382dbf2383.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h2]Getting Started in Markarth[/h2]
With access to the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC, you can venture into the wilds of the Reach by the following methods: 
[list][*]By teleporting directly to the North Markarth wayshrine from your map[/*][*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting the “The Despot of Markarth” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*][/list]
Once you’ve entered the Reach, you can explore the new zone, begin the DLC’s storyline, discover its many delves, world bosses, and Harrowstorm locations, or encounter any of the local Reachfolk—it’s up to you!

Finally, the first time you set foot in the Reach, you’ll receive the Arkthzand Anfractuosity Shroud completely free. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e8874fa1377a16d1265d5e6bc7c35908879e86e7.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Get this unique hat when you first enter the Markarth DLC content[/i]

[h2]Update 28 Base-Game Patch[/h2]
Releasing at the same time as the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack, the Update 28 base-game patch brings a host of new features and bug fixes for all [i]ESO[/i] players, completely free. 

[b]Item Set Collection system[/b]

With Update 28, you can now add hundreds of [i]ESO[/i]’s item sets to your Collections UI and reconstruct them at a cost of Transmutation Crystals from any Transmutation Station (such as the one found in Clockwork City). You can find your collected sets within your Collections UI under the new “Sets” section. This new system will allow you to free up much-needed inventory, bank, or coffer space since almost every set in Tamriel (with the exception of crafted ones) can now be safely “stored” in Collections. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/543d3f00859cc0b4fd8a20f2dc7b2ecc637c0e33.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Collect Tamriel’s item sets[/i]

Don’t go deconstructing everything yet! Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59011]preview and FAQ[/url] for everything you need to know about this new system. 

[b]Crafting Writ UI improvements[/b]

Also included in this update are improvements to the way you complete Crafting Writs. With this patch, if you have any Crafting Writ “quests” relevant to a crafting station you’re currently using, it’ll display appropriate details, including what materials or selections need to be picked to complete the quest. No longer will you activate a crafting station only to discover that you’ve forgotten what you need to craft for your writs! 

For everything coming as part of Update 28, check out the patch notes section on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]our official forums[/url]. 
[h2]The Dark Heart of Skyrim Ends Here![/h2]
With the launch of the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC, the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure comes to its thrilling conclusion. Explore the perilous Reach, challenge yourself in Vateshran Hollows, confront the Gray Host, and uncover the dread secrets found beneath the stone city of Markarth—all of Skyrim hangs in the balance! Tell us if you’re planning to venture into Skyrim’s dark heart and conclude your year-long epic via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 

[i]The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes with the Markarth DLC game pack and Update 28, now available for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arriving November 10 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4.[/i]

*Available only in limited territories.

notes.title: Unlock Spooky Rewards during the Witches Festival Event
notes.content:
[i]Tamriel’s most ghoulish gala returns! Put monsters to the sword to receive ghastly goodies and double XP during the Witches Festival in-game event! [/i]

[h2]A Frightful Fete[/h2]
The Witches Festival begins next Thursday, October 22 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST, and will run until Tuesday, November 3 at 10:00AM EST/03:00PM GMT. Throughout this terror-filled term, you can receive repulsive rewards in the form of spoopy Plunder Skull containers, a 100% XP boost, Event Tickets, and collectibles. 

To take part in this ghoulish gala: 
[olist][*]Navigate to the Holiday section of the Crown Store and acquire the free quest.[/*][*]Complete the quest “The Witchmother's Bargain" to receive the Witchmother's Whistle memento.[/*][/olist][list][*]If you completed the quest in previous events, you don’t need to acquire the Witchmother’s Whistle or complete the quest again, and you can use the whistle already found in your Collections menu.[/*][/list][*]Use the whistle to receive a two-hour 100% XP buff and summon the “Witchmother's Cauldron.”[/*][*]Use the Witchmother's Cauldron to transform your character into one of the undead. [/*][list][*]Note that you do not have to use the Witchmother's Cauldron to gain the XP buff, just the whistle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1c90ac001a4fc94361566dade6defdfd522a4758.jpg[/img]																							      						    						      						        
[i]Gah! The Witches Festival has returned![/i]

[h2]Earn Eerie Endowments [/h2]
During the Witches Festival, when you defeat a boss monster, you’ll receive a Plunder Skull in addition to its regular loot. These creepy containers have a chance to award you with the following items: 
[list][*][b]New[/b] Pieces of the Throwing Bones memento[/*][list][*]Combine 10 pieces to craft this collectible[/*][/list][*]Hollowjack style items[/*][*]Dremora style items[/*][*]Witches Festival-themed recipes[/*][*]Witchest Festival-themed furnishings and furnishing recipes[/*][*]Bewitching Alchemy reagents [/*][*] …and an assortment of creepy items![/*][/list]
But hold on to your (witches) hats, there’s more! The first time you slay each different type of boss each day, you’ll receive a Dremora Plunder Skull. This reward contains the same kind of items in the regular Plunder Skulls, but has some additional rewards, too. Here’s what you have a chance to find in Dremora Plunder Skulls: 
[list][*]Dremora Motif chapters[/*][*]Witches Festival Writs[/*][list][*]Complete these writs to unlock an Achievement that’ll earn you a new Witch hat collectible AND the “Witch” title![/*][/list][*]Glenmoril Treasure Maps[/*][list][*]Use the map to find Glenmoril Weapon Style pages scattered all over Tamriel[/*][/list][*]Glenmoril Armor Outfit Style pages[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Grave Dancer Weapon Style pages[/*][/list]			

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/08fb5ee22735c0f479bd7cf6a102efc1016894fe.jpg[/img]																									      						    						      						        
[i]Earn a menacing new weapon style[/i]

Depending on the type of boss you defeat, you’ll receive one of two different Dremora Motif pages:
[list][*]Final Arena Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Bows and Legs[/*][*]Dark Anchor, Geyser Bosses, Craglorn Focus Points, Harrowstorms, and zone Dragons drop Dremora Motif pages for Daggers and Gloves[/*][*]Delve Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Staves and Belts[/*][*]Final Dungeon Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Helmets and Maces[/*][*]Public Dungeon, Imperial City Bosses, and Quest Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shields and Boots[/*][*]Final Trial Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Swords and Chests[/*][*]World Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shoulders and Axes[/*][/list]
Whether you’re clearing Harrowstorms, exploring the Labyrinthian public dungeon, or hunting down Hordrek’s savage werewolf pack, you’ll earn these bonus rewards for slaying Tamriel’s monsters throughout the event period.

[h2]Impresario’s Offerings[/h2]
During the Witches Festival, the first time a boss drops a Dremora Plunder Skull each day, it’ll also drop three Event Tickets—don’t forget to loot it. This event also introduces the final Indrik evolution, the Crimson Indrik.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/57a8e88d9bee831f9e4ffbacb96354fb73323d47.jpg[/img]																													      						    						      						        
Light up Tamriel with the Crimson Indrik!

Throughout the event, the Impresario will also stock the following items for Event Tickets:
[list][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*]The first two Crimson Indrik Berries (Budding and Bloom) [/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]The Throw Bones memento [/*][*]Grave Dancer Weapon Style pages[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Grab Bags! [/*][/list]
What are Grab Bags? These curious containers have a chance to contain a collectible from a previous Witches Festival event. When you open a Grab Bag, it will only ever contain items you don’t already own or know, and once you’ve acquired every possible item within them, they’ll no longer be available for purchase. Be sure to open each bag and remove its items as soon as you acquire it (to avoid duplicate items from subsequent bags). 

If you have acquired every collectible but still have Grab Bags to open, they’ll contain Group Repair Kits instead—useful! For this event, a Grab Bag can contain Hollowjack Motif pages, the Skeletal Marionette memento, Apple-bobbing Cauldron fragments, and the Spectre Mask collectibles. 
[h2]Crown Store Deals[/h2]
There’s a host of ghastly goodies making their way to the Crown Store this month, including these frightening items: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a9df82a5f778230f0233e815cbd13323a35dcf0a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/96bf5bdea25f0d9700d70964dabe8167aeea1a0a.jpg[/img]																													      						    						      						        
[i]Dark Passions Regalia costume & Witches Coven furnishing pack[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/00ea66d822e880e10ddabb9d26c2008d75260a19.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3d1e7fe750c294751b0a47ecbe91b70a96e30a8f.jpg[/img]																											      						    						      						        
[i]Nightmare Firestalker Cub pet & Sister Gellenna houseguest[/i]

To grab some crowns and pick up these items, head over to the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store page[/url]. For everything coming to the Crown Store in October, including even more creepy collectibles, check out our recent [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58863]Crown Store Showcase[/url].  

[h2]A Ghoulish Gala[/h2]
Revel in Tamriel’s spookiest celebration and enjoy bonus XP and rewards for slaying all the things that go bump in the night. Are you excited to take part in the Witches Festival? Let us know via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline/]Facebook[/url]—boo! 

[i]The Witches Festival begins Thursday, October 22 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST, and will run until Tuesday, November 3 at 10:00AM EST/03:00PM GMT. Part of our #TamrielTogether celebration, the Witches Festival is the next event in a series of end-of-year events coming to The Elder Scrolls Online. For more on #TamrielTogether, including the massive Sweepstakes competition and information on how you can join us in our celebration of ESO’s many amazing communities, check out [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58841][i]this article[/i][/url][i]. [/i]

notes.title: #TamrielTogether—Promote Your Guild & Win Custom Collectibles!
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate and showcase your guild by crafting a recruitment poster or video and you could win amazing in-game prizes for your whole guild, including a custom-made mount and furnishings.  [/i]

#TamrielTogether is all about teaming up to do good in Tamriel, and one of the best ways to do that is to be a part of a Guild. To help showcase and celebrate some of [i]ESO[/i]’s amazing guilds, we’re thrilled to announce the Tamriel Together Guild Contest.

[h2]Enter Now![/h2]
Does your guild run Veteran Trials? Or do you like to put on fashion shows or roleplaying events? Maybe you have an amazing guild house that you think deserves to be seen. Whatever makes your guild a unique and welcoming place for its members, we want to see it captured in a recruitment-styled poster or video.

Your entry should celebrate and promote your guild to the larger [i]ESO[/i] community. Here’s what you need to do to enter: 
[olist][*]Create a recruitment-styled poster or video that showcases your guild[/*][/olist][list][*]If you’re recruiting, don’t forget to include information that’ll help players find your Guild![/*][*]Video submissions must be no longer than two minutes and be uploaded to YouTube[/*][*]Poster submissions must be in JPG or PNG format[/*][/list][*]Enter your poster or video [url=https://woobox.com/jasg7h]using this form[/url] by Friday, November 6 at 11:59PM EST[/*]
Please review the [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/website/tamrieltogether/guildcontest/ESO%20Tamriel%20Together%20Guild%20Contest_Rules-EN.pdf]official rules[/url] before submitting your entry. Your guild can submit an entry for each category, but you should only enter each category once, so be sure to submit your best entry for each category to have the greatest chance of winning. Once you’ve successfully submitted, feel free to share it with us on social (@[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]) using the #TamrielTogether hashtag, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/28c0bc45526769f559f65a2475484c1157812fdc.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]We need YOU to showcase your guild[/i]

[h2]Win for Your Guild[/h2]
Once the entry period has closed, the [i]ESO[/i] development team will review entries based on their quality, creativity, and adherence to the theme (guild recruitment), and select two grand and four runners-up prize winners. 

[b]Two Grand Prize Winners (one per category—poster or video)[/b]
[list][*]3,000 crowns Crown Pack for each [u]active[/u] guild member[/*][*]For each [u]active[/u] guild member, a unique mount based on the existing Alliance War Horse, decorated with the winning guild’s tabard colors and crest[/*][*]A wall banner for the interior of the guild’s chosen base-game tavern bearing the winning guild’s tabard colors and crest, and a book retelling one of their favorite in-game memories together[/*][*]For each [u]active[/u] guild member, a house furnishing banner (for the wall) bearing the winning guild’s tabard colors and crest, matching the one that is in the tavern[/*][*]For each [u]active[/u] guild member, a house furnishing book that is a replica of the one we place in the tavern[/*][*]A Guild Spotlight article on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] showcasing your community![/*][/list]
[b]Four Runners-up (two per category—poster or video)[/b]
[list][*]A 1,500 crown Crown Pack for each [u]active[/u] guild member[/*][*]For each [u]active[/u] guild member, a house furnishing banner (for the wall) bearing the winning guild’s tabard colors and crest[/*][*]A small nod to the guild in an in-game “one-sheet note” asset (a note, song, recipe, etc.) based on a favorite in-game memory that the guild experienced together[/*][*]A “one-sheet note” collectible for each [u]active[/u] guild member (matching the one above) that can be placed in their homes[/*][/list]
Phew! That’s a lot of prizes for [b]everybody[/b] in your guild. As mentioned above, only [b]active[/b] guild members will receive these prizes should their guild win, which means they need to have logged into the game at least once from the contest start and be a member of the winning guild by Friday, November 6, 2020 at 11:59 PM EST. Please check the [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/website/tamrieltogether/guildcontest/ESO%20Tamriel%20Together%20Guild%20Contest_Rules-EN.pdf]official rules[/url] for more information. 

Note that winners will not receive all their prizes at once, and the [i]ESO[/i] team will reach out to the submitters of the winning entries to discuss the creation of the custom collectibles and inform them as to when they can expect them in game. 

[h2]#TamrielTogether Guild Contest[/h2]
We can’t wait to see what kind of creative and wacky posters and videos the [i]ESO[/i] community comes up with for this new contest. Don’t forget to share your entries with us using #TamrielTogether on social via @[/url][url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—we’d love to also share them with the rest of the community and maybe get you some new recruits in the process! 

[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/tamrieltogether][i]#TamrielTogether[/i][/url][i] is ESO’s end-of-year promotion, celebrating all the ways the ESO community jointly experiences the world of Tamriel. During this period, you can participate in in-game events, share your stories of camaraderie using the #TamrielTogether hashtag on social, and sign up for our [/i][url=https://woobox.com/2pc9hb][i]massive sweepstakes[/i][/url][i]—have fun![/i]

notes.title: Access the Dark Heart of Skyrim DLCs & More with the ESO Plus Free Trial
notes.content:
[h2][i]You can check out ESO Plus membership during our free trial, running until October 19! No credit card info required; no strings attached–just activate it in the in-game Crown Store now![/i][/h2][h2][i] [/i][/h2][h2]Try ESO Plus Free[/h2]
The ESO Plus Free Trial is live and will run until Monday, October 19, at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST. During the trial period, you gain access to the following ESO Plus benefits:

·        Full access to DLC game packs—new zones, quests, dungeons, and more  

o   Includes [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Thieves Guild[/i], [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i], [i]Shadows of the Hist[/i],[i] Morrowind [/i](zone and story)[i], Horns of the Reach[/i], [i]Clockwork City, Dragon Bones, Summerset [/i](zone and story),[i] Wolfhunter, Murkmire, Wrathstone, Elsweyr [/i](zone and story)[i], Scalebreaker, Dragonhold, Harrowstorm, and Stonethorn [/i](our most-recent DLC!)

·        A Craft Bag offering you unlimited storage for all your crafting materials  

·        Double Bank space for all characters on your account  

·        10% increase to Experience and Gold acquisition, Crafting Inspiration, and Trait Research rates  

·        Double Furnishings and Collectibles space in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/25983]player housing [/url]

notes.title: Dig up Bonus Rewards during the Lost Treasures of Skyrim Event
notes.content:
[i]Uncover antiquities and unlock bonus collectibles (including an incredible new house) for ALL Greymoor players during the Lost Treasures of Skyrim event![/i]

The Lost Treasures of Skyrim event begins Wednesday, September 23 at 10:00AM EDT, and will run until October 5 at 10:00AM EDT. During the event period, you can earn bonus rewards for completing Western Skyrim daily quests and unlock unique collectibles for all [i]Greymoor[/i] players with the Antiquities system. 

[h2]Antiquarians Unite![/h2]
During the Lost Treasures of Skyrim event, you can earn unique collectibles for ALL [i]Greymoor[/i] players by [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58113]digging up antiquities[/url] throughout the entirety of Tamriel. As you and your fellow players seek out, excavate, and discover Tamriel’s hidden histories, you’ll slowly unlock up to three tiers of rewards:
[list][*]Tier 1: Horror Within Face and Body Markings[/*][*]Tier 2: Orchidfall Vale Fawn Pet[/*][*]Tier 3: Antiquarian’s Alpine Gallery home AND Antiquarian Phedre Houseguest[/*][list][*]This is the first Houseguest ever introduced to [i]ESO[/i]![/*][/list][/list]	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/329c5dacf056ead63f046d6ec823ca08ca299824.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Unlock these rewards by completing antiquities[/i]

[b]What are Houseguests? [/b]Houseguests are a new type of collectible character you can add to your home in much the same way you add any other collectible. Each Houseguest is unique with a distinct appearance and can be interacted with, adding more life to your home. You can unlock this first Houseguest, Antiquarian Phedre, for free as part of this event, but look for additional Houseguests in the Crown Store in the future. 

To check the community’s overall progress and see which rewards players have unlocked so far, visit the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/losttreasures]Lost Treasures of Skyrim page[/url] and review the meter. Each day, we’ll update the meter based on the community’s progress. The faster you dig, the faster the reward will be unlocked!

After the community has unlocked all three rewards (or the time runs out), all [i]Greymoor[/i] players can claim the unlocked items from the in-game Crown Store for free. Note that only players who own the [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter can claim the rewards. 

[h2]Lost Treasures[/h2]
As you explore, quest, and battle throughout Western Skyrim during the Lost Treasures of Skyrim event, you’ll also have the opportunity to earn bonus rewards and new collectibles. 

For starters, all Western Skyrim resource nodes will provide double rewards (not including fishing holes or crafting materials obtained from monsters). Also, all Western Skyrim world bosses, delve bosses, and Kyne’s Aegis trial bosses will have a chance to drop additional loot when defeated, and all Western Skyrim daily quests will award double reward boxes when completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3bfbf73997160367eb1ae493adc6b5daf92a3876.jpg[/img]	
																																	      						    						      						        
In addition to these, the first time you complete a Western Skyrim daily quest each day, you’ll receive a Bulging Box of Gray Host Pillage reward box. These well-stuffed containers have a chance to hold the following items: 
[list][*]Crafting materials[/*][*]Valuables to be sold to vendors[/*][*]Style items for the Blackreach Vanguard or Gray Host styles[/*][*]Zone set items[/*][*]Treasure maps and survey reports[/*][*]Chaurus Eggs, Vile Coagulant, or Crimson Nirnroot[/*][*]Blackreach Vanguard Motif Chapter[/*][*]Greymoor Motif Chapter[/*][*][b]NEW [/b]Sovngarde Style pages[/*][*]Greymoor furnishing recipes[/*][/list]
Phew! Once you’ve earned your Bulging Box each day, you will then have a chance to earn regular Boxes of Gray Host Pillage from subsequent daily quests or by completing various activities around Western Skyrim or Blackreach (such as defeating delve and world bosses, completing Harrowstorms, opening chests, and much more). 

While a regular Box of Gray Host Pillage might not contain as many rewards as a Bulging one, they still have a chance to hold any of the above items, including the Sovngarde style pages, so keep adventuring!

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
To earn Event Tickets during the Lost Treasures of Skyrim event, simply turn in either a Western Skyrim daily quest or a Kyne’s Aegis weekly quest—you’ll receive three Event Tickets for doing so each day of the event. 

The Impresario will stock the following goods during the event: 
[list][*]All four Indrik Feathers (to get a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*]Mossheart Berries of Bloom, Budding, Growth, and Ripeness[/*][list][*]All you need to evolve your Nascent Indrik into a Mossheart Indrik![/*][/list][*]Group repair kits[/*][*]Sapling Indrik pet[/*][*]Sovngarde Style pages (bound to your character on purchase)[/*][/list]

[h2]Dig Up Tamriel Together[/h2]
Explore Western Skyrim, complete quests, and acquire ancient relics of a bygone age during the Lost Treasures of Skyrim event and you’ll earn bonus rewards and unlock prizes for all [i]Greymoor[/i] players. Don’t forget to check the community’s progress on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/losttreasures]our tracking page[/url]—get digging! This event is part of our massive end-of-year promotion, Tamriel Together, so be sure to keep an eye on our social channels at @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url] for more information on how you can create a community and win amazing in-game prizes.

[i]The Lost Treasures of Skyrim in-game event begins Wednesday, September 23 at 10:00AM EDT, and will end on Monday, October 5 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]
