notes.title: Fight for the Ruby Throne during the Imperial City Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Battle your fellow players and Daedra under the shadow of  the White-Gold Tower during the Imperial City Celebration and you’ll earn bonus  rewards and collectibles. [/i]

[h2]Capture the Capital[/h2]  
The Imperial City Celebration begins Thursday, September 3  at 10:00AM EDT, and will run until Tuesday, September 15 at 10:00AM EDT. During  this in-game event, you can earn bonus rewards within both the Imperial City PvP  zone and its two PvE dungeons: White-Gold Tower and Imperial City Prison. 
  
To begin your fight for the capital, you must have access to  the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack either via ESO Plus™ membership or [b]free[/b]  from the DLC section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/90e129d7f20544e413a31b54c3984006de663ac5.jpg[/img]																														      						    						      						        
[i]Battle in the city[/i]

To enter the Imperial City PvP zone, open your Alliance War menu, select the Imperial City category, choose either Champion Point or non-Champion point Campaign, and select “Enter Campaign.” (It’ll take you to the Imperial City Sewers to begin.) 

To take on the Imperial City’s four-player dungeons, you can queue for them via the Dungeon Finder or by finding their entrances in the Imperial City districts (White-Gold Tower) or Imperial City Sewers (Imperial City Prison). 

[h2]Loot Lost Riches [/h2]
During the Imperial City Celebration event, you can loot the lost riches of a city under perpetual siege as you earn the following bonus rewards:
[list][*]Double the amount of Tel Var Stones dropped from all monsters[/*][*]Bonus chance of picking up either the Stonefire Scamp pet or the Soul-Shriven skin[/*][*]Double the amount of Key Fragments[/*][*]Bonus loot dropped by Trove Scamps and Cunning Scamps[/*][*]Bonus drops from bosses (including within the Imperial City itself and its dungeons)[/*][/list]
To earn the above, take part in any of the regular Imperial City activities, including battling in the Imperial Sewers and city districts, and taking on either the White-Gold Tower or Imperial City Prison dungeons. 

[b]Legion Zero Strongboxes[/b]

Those willing to fight shield-to-shield in the heart of the lost empire are a special breed of warrior. To reward those few braving the dangers of Cyrodiil’s close-combat warfare, Legion Zero Strongboxes have been added to this event. 

The first time you complete (turn in) an Imperial City district daily quest or defeat the final boss within the Imperial City Prison or White-Gold Tower dungeons, you’ll receive a Glorious Legion Zero Strongbox. These reward boxes can contain valuable and useful items, such as: 
[list][*]Tel Var Stones[/*][*]Crafting Materials[/*][*]Xivkyn Motif style items[/*][*]Key Fragments[/*][*]Valuables to be sold to vendors[/*][*]Pages from the Legion Zero Vigiles armor style[/*][*]Pages from the Tools of Domination weapon style[/*][*]Xivkyn Motif chapters[/*][/list]	
					      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/effca5715d4636cfcf11d1bda8ede1caaf8de520.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]The Legion Zero Vigiles armor style[/i]

After you’ve received your daily Glorious Legion Zero Strongbox, you have a chance to earn regular versions of this box by completing Imperial City activities such as defeating patrolling or sewer bosses, opening chests or safeboxes, defeating bosses in White-Gold Tower or Imperial City Prison, and from subsequent Imperial City district daily quests. 

While the rewards found within regular Legion Zero Strongboxes are not as plentiful as those found in their Glorious counterpart, they still have a chance to contain useful and rare items, including the new style pages if you’re lucky!

[h2]Impresario & Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Imperial City Celebration, you can earn three [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]Event Tickets[/url] per day, awarded the first time you either complete a daily quest in the Imperial City districts or sewers or defeat the final boss in the White-Gold Tower or Imperial City Prison dungeons—make sure you loot your kills!  

Throughout the event period, the Impresario will stock the following items: 
[list][*]Legion Zero Vigiles armor style pages (bound to your character on purchase)[/*][*]Tools of Domination weapon style pages (bound to your character on purchase)[/*][*]All four Indrik Feathers (to get a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*]Mossheart Berries of Bloom, Budding, and Growth[/*][*]Group repair kits[/*][*]Assorted Imperial- and Daedric-themed furnishings[/*][list][*]Daedric Chandelier, Ritual[/*][*]Imperial Bed, Canopy[/*][*]Imperial Dresser, Scrollwork[/*][*]Imperial Mirror, Standing[/*][*]Imperial Divider, Folding[/*][*]Imperial Wardrobe, Scrollwork[/*][*]Imperial Footlocker, Scrollwork[/*][*]Imperial Tapestry, Akatosh[/*][*]Imperial Simple Wall Lantern[/*][*]Imperial Shrine of the Bay[/*][*]Imperial Brazier, Caged[/*][*]Imperial Nightstand, Scrollwork[/*][*]Daedric Brazier, Standing[/*][/list][/list]

[h2]Crown Store Sales & New Items[/h2]
Throughout the event, you can pick up special Imperial City-themed items from the Crown Store, too. This includes ESO Plus membership deals on the Imperial Battlemage Pack, the Imperial Officers Pack, the Imperial War Mastiff pet, and an exclusive [b]free[/b] Wolf and Warrior Statuette. In addition to these, the Legion Zero Charger mount will be available for gems for a limited time only. 
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1be10a242a4f3cc7bad34c2f2a8346c893fce81b.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]The unstoppable Legion Zero Charger mount[/i]

Even better, starting Thursday, September 10, you can pick up the Imperial City Collector’s Bundle at up to 33% off—phew! 

[h2]Battle in the Streets[/h2]
Glory awaits those who fight in the heart of the capital during the Imperial City Celebration event. Whether you’re battling to capture Cyrodiil’s districts for your faction or striving to rid the Ruby Throne of Daedric influence, there’s a host of great reasons to take part in this PvE/PvP event! Will you be joining us in the shadow of the White-Gold Tower? Let us know via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn &Update 27 Now Live
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2b2be837f82b8ef0510542e51383c62c03fc08c3.jpg[/img] [i]Continue your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure with The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn. Explore Castle Thorn and the Stone Garden in this all-new dungeon DLC. [/i] The [i]Stonethorn[/i] DLC game pack and Update 27 is now available on PC/Mac, Steam, and Stadia* and brings a host of new stories, challenges, tools, and improvements to [i]ESO[/i], including: [list][*]Two new four-player dungeons: Castle Thorn and Stone Garden[/*][*]The continuation of the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including unique gear sets, Achievements, and collectibles[/*][*]The new Character Pathing tool for the Housing System [/*][*]Performance improvements and bug fixes[/*][*]And more![/*][/list] This DLC game pack is available free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]purchase with crowns[/url] from the in-game Crown Store. Read the patch notes for both [i]Stonethorn[/i] and Update 27 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. If you play on Xbox One or PlayStation®4, get ready, as [i]Stonethorn[/i] and Update 27 will be making their way to consoles September 1! [url=https://youtube.com/embed/Dd-htqMMF44?autoplay=1&rel=0]"> [/url] [h2]Stonethorn DLC Game Pack[/h2] The threat of the Gray Host did not end with the events of [i]Greymoor[/i], and new dangers arise from ancient holds and deep, hidden places. In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn[/i], you can challenge yourself and your team with two exciting new dungeons: Castle Thorn and Stone Garden. As part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim, [i]Stonethorn[/i] leads into the events of the upcoming Q4 DLC and final part of this year-long adventure! [b]Stone Garden[/b] What horrifying new evils is the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58533]mad alchemist Arkasis[/url] crafting within the hidden laboratory of Stone Garden? Venture into Blackreach, discover the terrible creations of this twisted genius, battle your way through his empowered minions, and put a stop to his dread experiments before he births a new terror for the people of Western Skyrim. Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58659]Stone Garden preview[/url] for more. [i]Battle your way through empowered beasts in Stone Garden[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e17bd003627225eefeb13841f730dfa4b88133e6.jpg[/img] [b]Castle Thorn[/b] Isolated within the mountains of Western Skyrim, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58495]Lady Thorn[/url] raises a fearsome new vampire army behind the strong walls of her keep and prepares to march on Tamriel. You must infiltrate Castle Thorn, seek out the horrifying secret behind this rising force, and confront the ancient Vampire Lord at its heart. Discover more about Castle Thorn in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58513]our preview[/url]. These two new dungeons will challenge your team in exciting ways and provide rewards in the form of unique gear sets, monster masks, collectibles, and Achievements. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6018bec2520b6cfaa631b399822df2054fc966a5.jpg[/img] [i]Earn brand-new rewards[/i] Both can be completed in Normal and Veteran Difficulties, and should you truly wish to challenge your party’s skills and teamwork, Stone Garden allows you to attempt a Hard Mode version of each of its three bosses—good luck! [h2]How to Get Stonethorn[/h2] The [i]Stonethorn [/i]DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you lose access to the DLC dungeons until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c0a9f666359a8decf3cc2ad562213f80b001d248.jpg[/img] [b]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/b] The [i]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Frostborn Durzog Mangler mount, the Snowsnarl Durzog pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. [i]The Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] [h2]Take on Stonethorn & Get a Unique Pet[/h2] Once you have access to the Stonethorn dungeons, you can continue your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure by the following methods: [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances in Western Skyrim (Castle Thorn) and Blackreach (Stone Garden)[/*][/list] By simply entering these two new dungeons, you receive the Energetic Dwarven Shock-Spider pet! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/78ef35e73c7058d8510d43794664da7335784b68.jpg[/img] [i]The perfect companion for Tamriel’s adventurers![/i] [h2]Update 27[/h2] Releasing with [i]Stonethorn[/i], Update 27 brings new features and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players, free! [b]Character Pathing[/b] With the new Character Pathing tool added to the Homestead System, you can now give your pets, mounts, and assistants unique paths for them to follow throughout your home, helping it feel more alive than ever. By simply assigning your companions nodes, you can have them move all around your home along a set path. You can even define speed, set wait times, and choose whether you want them to return along the same path or loop. For more on this new tool, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58669]our preview[/url]. [i]Create unique paths for your pets, mounts, and assistants[/i] [b]Performance Improvements[/b] The team has been working hard on various performance improvements in this update. These include improvements to how persistent AoEs work (starting with the Dragonknight Standard), an item set scripting update, new Critical Memory systems, physic engine improvements, server load handling improvements, database caching, and some intermittent load screen fixes—phew! With these updates, you’ll see fewer crashes, improvements to overall server stability/performance, and fewer random load screens. For everything arriving in Update 27, check out the Patch Notes section on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. [h2]Delve into Skyrim’s Dark Heart[/h2] Continue your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure with [i]Stonethorn[/i] and put a stop to two deadly new threats before they are unleashed upon the Nords of Western Skyrim. Shut down a terrible experiment and defeat an unholy army with two exciting and challenging dungeons that expand upon the year-long narrative that began with [i]Harrowstorm[/i] and will continue throughout the rest of 2020! Are you excited to enter Castle Thorn or the Stone Garden? Tell us via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. [i]Part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure, the Stonethorn DLC game pack is now live for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arrives September 1 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4. This new DLC game pack arrives in tandem with Update 27, a free base-game update for all ESO players.[/i] [i]*Available only in select territories. Find out if Stadia is available in your region [/i][url=https://support.google.com/stadia/answer/9566513][i]here[/i][/url][i].[/i]

notes.title: Save Up to 50% and Play Free during QuakeCon At Home
notes.content:
[i]Play ESO free and pick up the game and Crown Packs at up  to 50% off during QuakeCon 2020![/i]
  
QuakeCon 2020 is here, and that means you can save big on  both the game and Crown Packs while trying out the game free during our  limited-time sale and Free Play event. 

[h2]Free Play Week[/h2]  
If you’d like to take your first steps into the world of  Tamriel, you can play [i]ESO[/i] [b]free[/b] from now through August 19 at 10AM  EDT for Xbox One and PC/Mac and August 20 at 10AM EDT for PlayStation®4.
  
To get started, visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Free Play page[/url] and  select your platform. This event gives you access to the [i]ESO[/i] base  game, which includes four of the game’s original classes, 24 unique zones  (including Morrowind), a huge main storyline, and, if you’re a new player, 500 crowns  to spend in the in-game Crown Store. 
  
Even better, this event gives you the opportunity to begin  your Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long story with the free [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57853][i]Greymoor [/i] Prologue[/url] (part of the [i]ESO[/i] base game).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/496be060725813a6d7b14d27b34389de9a4d0483.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Discover Skyrim’s dark heart with the Greymoor Prologue[/i]

If you’ve played [i]ESO[/i] during a previous event, you can continue your adventures as normal. Happy adventuring!

[h2]Save on Greymoor [/h2]

notes.title: Check Out ESO during QuakeCon At Home!
notes.content:
[i]We’ve got livestreams, giveaways, Twitch Drops (including a free pet), and an exciting new Stonethorn trailer lined up for QuakeCon At Home. Here’s everything you need to know about [i]ESO’s [/i]presence at this year’s special three-day virtual event. [/i]

[h2]Welcome from Matt Firor[/h2]
Studio Director Matt Firor takes part in the QuakeCon Digital Welcome and talks about the year so far, discusses the[i] [/i]Dark Heart of Skyrim, and even shares a new [i]Stonethorn[/i] gameplay trailer! The Digital Welcome (and QuakeCon itself) begins Friday, August 7 at 12:00PM EDT, on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—don’t miss it!

[h2]Giveaways & Twitch Drops[/h2]
During the event, we’re giving away a host of goodies, including [url=https://gear.bethesda.net/products/the-elder-scrolls-reliquary]Reliquaries[/url], a Razer peripheral prize package, Steel Series mouse pads, and several digital goods during the streams and on social media ([url=https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], [url=http://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url]), so keep an eye out for your chance to win.

Even better, watch any of the official [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/streamers][i]ESO[/i] streams[/url] each day (listed below) and you will receive a QuakeCon Twitch Drop, which includes the Flame Atronach Pony pet and an Ouroboros Crown Crate. Make sure you [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/41809/]link your [i]ESO [/i]and Twitch accounts[/url] ahead of time to qualify.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/0731edadc8f7a405901be6ea24a179e9cf5da624.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]While pretty, we recommend NOT petting the Flame Atronach Pony[/i]

Don’t forget, you can now get Twitch Drops for all platforms, including Xbox One and PlayStation 4, so don’t miss out!

[h2][i]ESO [/i]Livestreams[/h2]
Throughout QuakeCon, the Community team is hosting a series of fun livestreams with members of the [i]ESO[/i] development team and special guests. Check out everything we’ve got planned below:

[b]Friday, August 7 at 1PM EDT at [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]

Voice actors [url=https://twitter.com/jhaletweets]Jennifer Hale[/url] (Lyris Titanborn) and [url=https://twitter.com/robbiedaymond]Robbie Daymond[/url] (Fennorian), plus ZOS’s Senior VO Supervisor Becky Ichnoski, join the [i]ESO[/i] Community team to talk about how they give their voice to some of the game’s most-beloved characters.


[b][i]ESO [/i]Developer Interview—Featuring Encounters Lead Mike Finnigan[/b]

[b]Saturday, August 8 at 12PM EDT at [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda_DE]twitch.tv/Bethesda_DE[/url]

German Community Manager Kai Schober talks to Encounters Lead Mike Finnigan about the game, the Dark Heart of Skyrim, and the upcoming [i]Stonethorn[/i] release!


[b][i]ESO[/i] Gearless & Fearless Dungeon Run—Featuring Nicole Savoy[/b]

[b]Saturday, August 8 at 8PM EDT at [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]

Pro wrestler and [i]ESO[/i] fan [url=https://twitter.com/NikiMSavo]Nicole Savoy[/url] squads up with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] team to try to tackle one of [i]ESO[/i]’s perilous dungeons while wearing no gear—what they pick up along the way is what they can wear!

Uncle Pete from Bethesda Softworks and MMA champion [url=https://twitter.com/robwhittakermma]Rob Whittaker[/url] (Aussie Aussie Aussie!) team up to explore Western Skyrim from [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i].



[b][i]ESO [/i]Live Art Creation & Chat [/b]

[b]Sunday, August 9 at 7PM EDT at [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]

ZOS Concept Artist Mike May and Art Director CJ Grebb drop in to talk about [i]ESO[/i]’s art process AND produce a brand-new piece of [i]ESO-[/i]inspired art live on stream. One lucky viewer will win the completed piece, so don’t miss out!


In addition to the above, there are a ton of amazing streams to check out from the community team, [i]ESO[/i] streamers, and community members: 
[list][*]August 7 at 1PM EDT at[b] [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda_DE]twitch.tv/Bethesda_DE[/url]—[i]ESO[/i] Homestead Tour featuring community members FuFuns and Lasuu (in German)[/*][*]August 8 at 8AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda_fr]twitch.tv/Bethesda_FR[/url]—French Community Manager Sanda Mauri hosts community members Artesio, Deastre, and MrElderScrolls for an ESO quiz (in French) [/*][*]August 8 at 4AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—[i]ESO[/i] Charity Stream for UNICEF featuring streamers Thorlar, Michi, and QueenE[/*][*]August 8 at 9AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—Conquering Icereach featuring UK Community Manager Ophelia Noir and Stream Team members Dawnwhisper, kayPOWXD, and Xynode[/*][*]August 8 at 5PM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—The Best Elder Scrolls Online Roleplay on Twitch featuring actors Tony Noto and Dayeanne Hutton[/*][*]August 9 at 12:35AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—[i]ESO[/i] with Tamriel Downunder featuring ANZ Community Managers Jonny Roses and Kim Bender, plus Stream Team members Dacu, IcyIC, AngryWolf, and mApplinator[/*][*]August 9 at 7AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda_DE]twitch.tv/Bethesda_DE[/url]—[i]ESO[/i] Guild vs. Guild Dungeon Runs featuring community members Arkays Segen and Noractis (in German)[/*][*]August 9 at 4AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—My World: Aeyvi’s [i]ESO[/i] featuring Ophelia Noir and Stream Team member Aeyvi[/*][*]August 9 at 11AM EDT at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]—[i]ESO[/i] PvP Masterclass featuring Benelux Community Manager Julian Eriks and Stream Team member Rubensky[/*][/list]
Phew! That’s a ton of great [i]ESO[/i] action and fun throughout the entire event from all over the world. Remember, you can earn a QuakeCon pet and a Crown Crate just for watching!
[h2]Together At Home[/h2]
QuakeCon brings people together like no other event in the world, so we’re thrilled to bring you three days of [i]ESO[/i] fun, give out unique rewards, and support more than a few great causes with our charity drives. Let us know if you’re looking forward to all the reveals, streams, and the chance to earn that fiery new pet on social via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. Don’t forget—it all kicks off Friday, August 7 at 12PM on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]!

notes.title: Defend the Home of the High Elves During the Summerset Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Experience the beauty and danger of the High Elf homeland during the Summerset Celebration event and you’ll earn bonus rewards and collectibles. [/i]

[h2]Summerset’s Bounty[/h2]
The Summerset Celebration begins Thursday, July 23 at 10:00AM EDT and continues until Tuesday, August 4, at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST. During the event period, you can earn bonus rewards and a new event-specific outfit style, simply by exploring and adventuring in Summerset and Artaeum!

As you venture throughout Summerset, you’ll receive extra loot from all daily quest rewards, resource nodes, world, delve bosses, and Psijic Portals (only in Summerset!). Even better, the first time you complete an Abyssal Geyser, delve, world boss daily quest, or the Cloudrest trial weekly quest each day, you’ll earn a Glorious Summerset Coffer in addition to your regular rewards. 

These reward boxes can contain all kinds of valuable items, including set items, crafting materials, furnishing recipes, and pages of the brand-new Snowhawk Mage outfit style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/dc206f5ae8a9919c5607431ca569dae04062b8aa.jpg[/img]
																													      						    						      						        
Even if you have already received and opened your daily Glorious Summerset Coffer, you can keep earning the more-common-but-still-stylish Summerset Coffers by continuing to take on the island’s many threats. These additional boxes might not have quite the same volume of luxuries as their Glorious cousins, but they can be earned from even more activities, including via safeboxes, Psijic Portals, resource nodes, and more—AND you can continue to earn them all day. All the reason you need to keep exploring the isle of Summerset!*

[h2]Start Earning Your New Indrik[/h2]
Indriks are native to the Summerset Isles, so no better event introduces an all-new evolution: the Mossheart Indrik! To acquire this mount, you need to have a Nascent Indrik and all four Mossheart berries. The first two berries are available from the Impresario during this event, and the rest will arrive in later to-be-announced events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5c477911043f48189c7ecdcbb08711d5e352d6bd.jpg[/img]
																																	      						    						      						        			  
[i]Begin your Mossheart  Indrik berry collection[/i]
  
Of course, to acquire these new berries, you [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]need Event  Tickets[/url]. During the event period, you can acquire three as an additional  reward for the first delve, world boss, Abyssal Geyser, or Cloudrest trial  quest you complete each day—the same activities you were already doing for the  event! 
  
Here’s a list of everything the Impresario will have in  stock throughout the Summerset Celebration: 
  [list][*]All four Indrik Feathers (to get a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*]The first two Mossheart Berries of Bloom and Budding[/*][*]Group repair kits[/*][*]Summerset furnishings[/*][list][*]Alinor Wall Mirror, Ornate[/*][*]Alinor Archway, Tall[/*][*]Alinor Monument, Marble[/*][*]Painting of Summerset Coast, Refined[/*][*]Alinor Pergola, Blue Wisteria Peaked[/*][*]Display Case, Specimen[/*][*]Psijic Lighting Globe, Small[/*][*]Alinor Winerack, Polished[/*][*]Display Case, Standing Arched[/*][*]Alinor Desk, Mirrored[/*][/list][*]Snowhawk Mage outfit style pages (bound to your character on purchase)[/*][/list]

[h2]Summerset on Sale![/h2]  
If you don’t own or have access to the zone, you can pick up  the [i]Summerset[/i] DLC from the in-game Crown Store at 50% off throughout the  event. Don’t forget, because it’s a DLC, you also gain access to the zone if  you have an [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url]. 
  
That’s not all you can get from the Crown Store during the  event period, however, since you can also grab the [i]Summerset[/i] Collector’s Pack  at 50% off, acquire returning Psijic Vault Crown Crates, and even snag the  brand-new “Music Box, Enigmas of the Elder Way” furnishing for your home. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/392c17d6d2f606d3e428cea78e9b296c316dfffd.jpg[/img]
									  																																		      						    						      						        
All of these deals, returning items, and brand-new goods are available only for a limited time, so don’t miss out!

[h2]Save Summerset, Get Bonus Rewards[/h2]
Explore the island home of the High Elves during the Summerset Celebration in-game event and you’ll get bonus rewards from drops, daily quests, and more. Whether you’re mer, man, or beast, there are plenty of reasons to hop on that ship to Shimmerene and explore one of Tamriel’s most beautiful and mysterious locations. Are you excited to visit Summerset? Let us know via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Summerset Celebration in-game event begins on Thursday, July 23 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST, and will end on Tuesday, August 4 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST.[/i]

[i]*Y’know, aside from the island’s pristine sandy beaches, majestic local wildlife, and dastardly Daedric conspiracies. [/i]

notes.title: Midyear Mayhem June 2020
notes.content:
[i]Bring glory to your Alliance, your guild, or yourself during the Midyear Mayhem PvP event and you’ll earn double Alliance Points, XP, and unique rewards. [/i]

[u][b]Update:[/b][/u] We're extending our PvP Event to July 8 at 10:00AM EDT! Earn your last-minute Event Tickets and grab those final Berries for the Icebreath Indrik while you still can!

[h2]Join the Battle![/h2]

Midyear Mayhem returns to Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and the battlegrounds this Thursday, June 25 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST, and will continue until Wednesday, July 8 at 10:00AM EDT/03:00PM BST. During this event, you can claim additional rewards when battling your fellow players in PvP activities, including double XP and Alliance points and event-specific collectibles, Achievements, and titles.  

Here’s how you can join the battle: 
[olist][*]Visit the in-game Crown Store to acquire the “Details on the Midyear Mayhem" quest[/*][*]Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu or a Battlegrounds camp outside major cities[/*][olist][*]You are no longer required to travel to Cyrodiil to kick off the event[/*][/olist][*]Find the NPC named “Predicant Maera" and continue the quest[/*][olist][*]If you already completed the quest last year, you won't need to do it again[/*][/olist][*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box[/*][*]Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:[/*][olist][*]Alliance Points gained[/*][*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*][/olist][/olist]						      						    						      						        																												[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2020/06/7a464c59c37ee68301056d24025fea4d.jpg]																[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/9f798a73e030f19bd759fc761d9bd0d2f45730f0.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																				      						    						      						        
[i]Celebrate Pelinal’s (violent) legacy with Predicant Maera[/i]

You can keep reusing the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity throughout the event. If you happen to lose it, don’t worry: you can get another from Predicant Maera or use the nearby Basin of the Gore Virtuous instead.
 
[h2]Claim the Spoils of War[/h2]
Throughout the event, in addition to bonus Alliance Points and XP, you can also earn Midyear Mayhem-specific collectibles, reward boxes, and more.  

[b]NEW Second Legion Outfit Style Pages[/b]

Wear the classically Imperial raiment of the Imperial City’s Second Legion with new tradeable Outfit Style pages, dropped by bosses within the Imperial City, including those found in the city itself and the sewers. 

[b]Legion Zero Outfit Style Pages[/b]

You can also earn tradeable Outfit Style pages for the Legion Zero’s armor, also dropped from bosses in the Imperial City and Imperial City sewers. 

[b]Standard-Bearer Emotes[/b]

Earned by collecting 10 Standard-Bearer’s Emblems, found within the first Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Box you open each day per account. Combine 10 of them with a Standard-Bearer’s License (on sale for 50,000 AP) from Predicant Maera to create a Runebox with the emote.
									      						    						      						        																												[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2020/06/7fe2142a750ab9189d249cce276a05a2.jpg]																[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5ba394ad3a2b6f7f451c3b400845a9f27958b16e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																				      						    						      						        
[i]Dress like an Imperial![/i]

[b]Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath[/b]

As always, you can earn the Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath collectible by completing all of the Midyear Mayhem Achievements below:
[list][*]Mayhem Connoisseur: Receive the blessing of the Whitestrake at one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Echo of Pelinal's Fury: Read a Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Hand of the Whitestrake: Acquire your 25th Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box.[/*][*]Wrath of the Whitestrake: Defeat 50 opponents during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinavant the Scourge: Win a Battleground match during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinaline the Bloody: Capture a Keep in Cyrodiil during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinerrif Insurgent: Capture an Imperial District during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][/list]
Note that access to the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack is required to earn all of the above Achievements, so pick it up FREE from the in-game Crown Store!

[b]Boon Boxes[/b]

As you battle your fellow players in Cyrodiil, the battlegrounds, and the Imperial City, you’ll also earn Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Boxes. You can get these in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers and as PvP daily quest rewards from the following:
[list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																												[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2020/06/11362478178e04e9e0d54b367410b262.jpg]																[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/0b2177eec8d1382f517123b26ca7641d6e86d8e7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																				      						    						      						        
[i]Fight to capture Cyrodiil and glory[/i]

When you receive and open one of Pelinal’s boons, you have a chance to receive the following items: 
[list][*]Transmute Crystals[/*][*]Alchemy reagents[/*][*]PvP consumables such as repair kits, forward camps, and siege weapons[/*][*]Motif pages for the Alliance and Akaviri styles[/*][*]Style items for your Alliance[/*][*]Akaviri style items[/*][*]Coldharbour siege weapons[/*][*]Prismatic Runestones[/*][*]Books of Pelinal housing items[/*][/list]
[b]Resource Notes and “The Golden”[/b]

Finally, throughout the event, harvesting nodes within Cyrodiil and the Imperial City will drop double their regular resources, and the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi Aba-daro (also known as “The Golden”) stocks Alliance War Legendary-quality jewelry, with necklaces during the first weekend and rings during the second.

[h2]Earn Event Tickets[/h2]
During the Midyear Mayhem event, you can earn up to four Event Tickets per day by completing two different PvP activities: 
[list][*]Two tickets for completing any Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds daily quest [/*][*]Two tickets for completing any Imperial City district daily quests[/*][/list]
The Event Ticket timer resets at 1:00AM EDT/6:00AM BST each morning. Note that if you earn new Event Tickets over the 12-limit cap, you’ll lose them. Good thing there’s plenty of things to spend them on at Impresario vendor during the event:
[list][*]Second Legion Outfit Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Zero Legion Outfit Style pages (can’t be traded)[/*][*]Standard-Bearer Emotes[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Icebreath Berries (including Bloom, Budding, Growth, and Ripeness)[/*][*]Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Rimedusk Indrik pet[/*][/list]
Don’t forget, this event is your chance to complete the serene Icebreath Indrik! 
									      						    						      						        																												[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2020/06/11eb169bd37ac78dc1ff744b44c4b785.jpg]

notes.title: Play ESO Free & Save during our April Sale

To participate in the Free Play Event, visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Free Play page[/url] and select your platform. This event gives you access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game,  which includes four of the game’s original classes, 23 massive unique zones, and an epic main storyline. Note that depending on your platform, the Free Play Event and April Sale may have different start and end dates.
  
Because the Free Play Event includes access to the base  game, you can descend into your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure with the  [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57853]Greymoor [/url][/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57853]Prologue[/url]. notes.title: ESO Anniversary Jubilee
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online is six years young, and that means you can enjoy bonus XP, special rewards, and cake during our Anniversary Jubilee event![/i]

[h2]Happy Birthday to ESO![/h2]
[i]ESO[/i]’s six-year Anniversary Jubilee in-game event begins Thursday, April 2 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, April 14 at 10:00AM EDT. To join the celebration, select the free Jubilee Cake Voucher quest starter from the Crown Store (listed under Quest Starters) to find the world-famous Chef Donolon. 

Complete Chef Donolon’s quest to receive the new Jubilee Cake 2020 memento, which you can use to summon the new dessert. Each time you eat a slice during the celebration, you’ll enjoy a two-hour, 100% XP boost! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8d2dec8c2aac8f85fd5a8d8465fa4de93eaaa6e3.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																													      						    						      						        
[i]Eat cake and enjoy bonus XP![/i]

[h2]Presents for All[/h2]
During the event, complete any of the game’s daily quests and you’ll earn special Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes! These daily quests include but are not limited to:
[list][*]Daily crafting writs[/*][*]Daily Delve and World Boss quests[/*][*]Daily Alliance War and Battlegrounds quests[/*][*]Daily Dungeon and Trial quests[/*][*]Daily Heist and Sacrament quests[/*][/list]
Within the Jubilee Gift Boxes, you have a chance to acquire a ton of unique items, including:
[list][*]Crafting Materials[/*][*]Motif Pages for assorted crafting styles[/*][list][*]Too many to list here![/*][/list][*]Furniture Recipes[/*][*]Outfit Style pages for one of the “Five Companions”[/*][*]Worm Cult Motif pages[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Outfit Style pages for the Jephrine Paladin weapon or armor style[/*][*]Transmutation Crystals[/*][/list]						      						    						      						        																												

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/0383f4b309397287385ae42417ef801950651798.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Become a protector of the wilds with the Jephrine style[/i]

[h2]Event Tickets & New Indrik[/h2]
The first time you eat a slice of the Jubilee Cake 2020 each day of the event, in addition to the XP buff, you also receive three Event Tickets. Because there will be fewer events this quarter, you can also receive bonus tickets by defeating any boss in the game (Delve, World, Dungeon, etc.). You can earn two additional tickets per day from this method. This means you can earn a max of five tickets per day, for up to 65 tickets total if you play every day of the event. Don’t forget, you have to loot your tickets and be credited for defeating the boss!

You can find the Impresario in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon, and she will have the following items in stock:
[list][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Icebreath Berries of Bloom and Icebreath Berries of Budding[/*][list][*]For an all-new Indrik evolution![/*][/list][*]Jephrine Paladin Outfit Style pages[/*][*]Group Repair Kits[/*][*]Replica Jubilee Cake furnishings[/*][list][*]Furnishing versions of all five anniversary cakes[/*][*]Note: Each cake furnishing is available for purchase only if you earned their respective mementos during previous Anniversary events [/*][/list][/list]
The Anniversary Jubilee features this quarter’s first two berries for the all-new,[i] very cool[/i] Icebreath Indrik.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f68c53e21eaae75323730948a6b73c3bb47b1a39.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																															      						    						      						        			  
[i]The tranquil Icebreath Indrik[/i]


For more on how Event Tickets and Indriks work, don’t  hesitate to check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]our guide[/url].  
  [h2]Eat Cake & Do Dailies[/h2]  
Celebrate [i]ESO[/i]’s sixth birthday with us with an  amazing new cake and rewards. With dailies for almost every unique activity,  how you earn your Jubilee Gift Boxes is completely up to you. Don’t forget to  grab a slice and enjoy that XP boost, too! Let us know how you’ll be  celebrating this new milestone via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]@TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]ESO’s six-year Anniversary Jubilee in-game event begins Thursday, April 2 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Tuesday, April 14 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Jester's Festival
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate the absurd during the Jester’s Festival in-game event and you’ll earn wacky new rewards and bonus XP![/i]

[h2]The Silly Season Returns[/h2]
The Jester’s Festival [b]begins Thursday, March 26 at 10:00AM EDT, and revels in the ridiculous until April 2 at 10:00AM EDT[/b]. During this frivolous fête, you can earn special event-specific rewards by completing Jester’s Festival quests.

To get started, find the Jester’s Festival pavilions located outside the cities of Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, and Daggerfall. If you’re having trouble, pick up the Jester’s Festival starter quest free from the in-game Crown Store for directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bfbe6b0de5c7f493d52cfad767be70c76edcb766.jpg[/img]
									      						    						      						        																												
[i]Visit a Jester’s Festival pavilion to join in the fun![/i]

Strike up a conversation with the jester versions of the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric (we’re reliably informed that the real Alliance leaders don’t mind the ruse) and complete the intro quest to receive the powerful AND delicious Pie of Misrule memento. When you activate this preposterous pastry, you’ll receive a two-hour, 100% XP buff! Note that you don’t need to complete this quest again if you’ve previously done so—just grab the memento from your collections. 

During the event, each jester can provide your characters with a unique daily quest, meaning each character can complete three of these quests every 24 hours. 

[h2]Labor for Ludicrously Loony Loot[/h2]
Each time you complete a Jester’s Festival quest, you receive a Jester’s Festival Reward Box that can contain goodies such as valuables (to sell to vendors for gold), consumables, recipes, furnishings, and Revelry Pies. Even better, the first time you complete each quest each day, you are rewarded a Stupendous Gift Box instead of the regular reward. This prestigious package has a chance to include: 
[list][*]Cadwell’s Kitchen Arms Style Pages[/*][*]Fragments of two Mementos: the Festive Noise Maker or Jester’s Festival Joke Popper[/*][*]Jokey Stealies to sell to vendors[/*][*]Runeboxes containing the Cherry Blossom Branch or Jester’s Scintillator mementos [/*][*][b]NEW[/b] fragments for the Sovereign Sow pet![/*][list][*]Guaranteed drop within the first Stupendous Gift Box you open each day![/*][*]This is the now the same porcine princess you save in the Jester’s Festival quest “A Noble Guest”[/*][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6865b0a2442229b0748f8026949b08e2a4fc55c3.jpg[/img]						      						    						      																																			      						    						      						        			  
[i]Some animals are  more equal than others[/i]
  
If you’ve earned all three Stupendous Gift Boxes, don’t  worry, you can keep earning regular reward boxes with your other characters, so  keep the party going!
  
Take note, the Revelry Pies make for especially mirthful  missiles, and should you add them to your Quickbar, you can gleefully cover all  of Tamriel with sticky dessert! Fellow players, NPCs, guards (trust us, they  won’t mind), or even the rulers of Tamriel themselves—all fear your delicious  right arm during the Jester’s Festival. 
  
As you cover all of Tamriel in pie, you’ll earn special  event-specific Achievements: 
          [list][*]The Three Fillings War—Throw 10 Pies at players that are in a  different Alliance[/*][*]The Upper Crust—Throw a pie at each of the Alliance Leaders[/*][*]More Than You Can Chew—Throw 10 Pies at Guards[/*][*]Dessert Domination—Complete the above Achievements[/*][*]Messy Business—Kill 10 players while they are covered in pie in  Cyrodiil[/*][/list]
By completing these absurd Achievements, you can earn  special rewards, including the “Tin Soldier” and “Empieror” titles and the  Obnoxious Mute Face Paint head marking! However, that’s not all, since you can also  earn the Crown of Misrule hat and Lord / Lady of Misrule title by completing  each of the three daily quests or the Royal Jester title and some furnishings  by completing every Jester’s Festival achievement. Check your journal for  everything!
  [h2]Event Tickets[/h2]  
The first time you complete a Jester’s Festival quest each  day, you’ll earn three Event Tickets per account, allowing you to earn up to 24  tickets total throughout the event period. During the event, the Impresario  will stock the following goods:
              [list][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*]All four Spectral Indrik Berries[/*][*]The Spectral Indrik pet[/*][*]Sovereign Sow fragments[/*][*]Jester’s Scintillator runebox[/*][*]Cherry Blossom Branch runebox[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Group Repair Kits[/*][list][*]Allows you to repair worn gear for group members in your zone
[/*][/list][/list]
This is your chance to acquire the final berries needed to  evolve your Nascent Indrik into the ghostly Spectral Indrik mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4869e9cfe4c6d380104261a0c96d36ea0ea52935.jpg[/img]		      						    						      						        																																																															      						    						      						        
[i]Spooky yet majestic![/i]

[h2]A Festival of Fun![/h2]
Beset by war, monsters, Dragons, and Necromancers, the world of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] is serious business, but each year, the people of Tamriel get together for an all-too-short period of frivolity and fun. With bonus XP, unique collectibles, and a whole lot of pie, there’s a ridiculous amount of reasons to celebrate the Jester’s Festival. Are you excited to take part in this year’s most foolish fête? Let us know on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]@TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]The Jester’s Festival begins on Thursday, March 26 at 10:00AM EDT and will run until April 2 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Harrowstorm & Update 25 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[h3]Not sure what to expect when downloading Update 25? 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/306130/discussions/0/1746772002633499776/]Check out our FAQ here![/url][/h3]

The [i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC game pack and Update 25 brings a host of new challenges, adventures, rewards, and improvements to [i]ESO[/i], including:
[list][*]Two new four-player dungeons: Icereach and Unhallowed Grave[/*][*]The start of the year-long [b]Dark Heart of Skyrim[/b] storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including unique achievements and collectibles[/*][*]All-new PvP collectibles[/*][*]New [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681]performance improvements[/url][/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]purchase with crowns[/url] from the in-game Crown Store. You can read the patch notes for both [i]Harrowstorm[/i] and Update 25 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].
									      						    						      						        																																																																																																
[previewyoutube=J5A93lsXw0E;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																						      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        			 [h2]Harrowstorm DLC Game Pack[/h2]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Harrowstorm[/i] features two exciting new dungeons for four-player groups: Icereach and Unhallowed Grave. These new PvE challenges also kick off your Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure, beginning a story that will take you to the upcoming [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter and more throughout the entirety of 2020. 

[b]Icereach[/b]

A supernatural storm lashes Skyrim’s northern coast, threatening the longboats and livelihoods of the local Nords. You and your party must investigate the mysterious origin of this storm: the barren island of Icereach. There, you must find the first lost expedition, confront the witches of the Icereach Coven, and put a stop to their terrible ritual before all of Skyrim is lost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7026833eae2614825dd8daa594cbe211a15c9665.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																																      						    						      						        
[i]Confront the witches of Icereach[/i]

[b]Unhallowed Grave[/b]

Deep beneath the sands of Bangkorai, the ancient remnants of a long-forgotten evil lies buried—forgotten to all but the crypt’s last guardians. Now, a gruesome band of Necromancers and monsters has looted the tomb for an unknown purpose. You and your allies must storm the Unhallowed Grave, repulse the mercenaries, and discover the dark secret at the heart of their invasion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6c94d6e5199ab7f17e3cd5814df63808b6eaf989.jpg[/img]				      						    						      						        																																																															      						    						      						        
[i]Explore the Unhallowed Grave[/i]

Both dungeons challenge you and your teammates with cunning enemies and monstrous boss battles, and you can attempt both Icereach and Unhallowed Grave in Normal and Veteran difficulties, with a Veteran Hard Mode option available if you wish to truly challenge yourselves. Finally, you can discover new rewards in both dungeons, including new item sets, Achievements, collectibles, and more.

For more information on these two dungeons, check out our previews of both [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57675]Icereach[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57729]Unhallowed Grave[/url]. 

[h2]How to Get Harrowstorm[/h2]
The [i]Harrowstorm [/i]DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC).

Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you lose access to the DLC dungeons until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

[b]Harrowstorm Collector’s Bundle[/b]

The [i]Harrowstorm Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Hallin's Jackal Pet, the Pyre Watch Jackal Mount, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Harrowstorm Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
									
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/457cc6b923d7f998848b5d5caffbd0ab1d921f94.jpg[/img]      						    						      						        																																																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Harrowstorm Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h2]Discover Harrowstorm & Earn a Unique Emote[/h2]
Once you have access to the [i]Harrowstorm[/i] dungeons, you can begin your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances in the Bangkorai (Unhallowed Grave) and northern Wrothgar (Icereach)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering one of these two dungeons, you’ll earn the Wickerman Mishap emote!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7d345c2bb900837d01b17241ce55773577e8e2e3.jpg[/img]									      						    						      																																							      						    						      						        
[i]Watch your fingers![/i]

[h2]Update 25’s New Rewards & Performance Improvements[/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the new DLC, Update 25 provides a host of new features and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players, completely free. In particular, this update continues the performance work that began last year with a major Patching Overhaul and introduces new, unique rewards for PvP. 

[b]Patching Overhaul & Performance Improvements[/b]

The biggest change arriving with Update 25 is the Patching Overhaul. This update completely changes how the [i]ESO[/i] game client is downloaded, patched, and stored on local hard drives. Because of this change, ALL [i]ESO[/i] players are required to re-download the game client. Once complete, you will see improvements to the game’s load time and reductions in hard drive space requirements for future updates. You can learn more about this major overhaul in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57719]this article[/url]. There’s a free pet to be snatched up, too!

Additional performance updates associated with this patch include improvements to frame rates, the loading of fixtures and characters, and more, so don’t hesitate to check out our performance [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681]improvements timeline[/url] or Update 25’s patch notes on the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url] for everything you need to know. 

[b]New PvP Rewards[/b]

If you enjoy battling your fellow players in Cyrodiil, Update 25 introduces new rewards for PvP players: The Knight of the Circle Armor and Weapon Outfit Styles. You can obtain these new styles by purchasing a Knight’s Resolve or Knight’s Rebuke from a War Researcher in Cyrodiil. 
[list][*]Combine Knight's Resolve with 20 Arena Gladiator Proofs to generate a random style page for armor in the Knight of the Circle style.[/*][*]Combine Knight's Rebuke with 40 Arena Gladiator Proofs to generate a random style page for a weapon in the Knight of the Circle style.[/*][/list]						      						    						      																																								      						    						      						        

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/34e10a0f93b181136a6e6c14c454057136d28e22.jpg[/img]
[i]Show your valor with the Knight of the Circle styles![/i]

Don’t forget, you need to complete Conquest daily quests in Cyrodiil to receive Arena Gladiator Proofs—no easy task! Finally, because the new style pages are not bound, you can trade them with other players.

[h2]The Dark Heart of Skyrim [/h2]
With [i]Harrowstorm[/i], your next big year-long adventure begins, leading you into Skyrim’s dark heart with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i] and continuing throughout all of 2020. Are you ready to begin this exciting new storyline and delve into the frigid island of Icereach and the bone-laden halls of Unhallowed Grave? Let us know on @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]Part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure, the Harrowstorm DLC game pack is now live for PC/Mac and coming March 10 for Xbox One and PlayStation[/i]®[i]4. This new DLC game pack arrives in tandem with Update 25, a free base-game update for all ESO players.[/i]

notes.title: Performance Improvements & Free Pet Coming with the Patching Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f8f72b309929f07d1bb93fd2720f0f1aa63fffb6.png[/img]												      						        			 

[i]Learn about what makes Update 25 and the Patching Overhaul so important and the special pet we’re giving away in thanks![/i]

[h3][b]EDIT: Questions about how this patch works on Steam? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/306130/discussions/0/1746772002633499776/]View our FAQ![/url][/b][/h3]
  
[h2]What is the Patching Overhaul?[/h2]
  
The Patching Overhaul is a massive part of the Update 25  base-game patch (arriving February 24 for PC/Mac and March 10 for PlayStation®4  and Xbox One) that completely overhauls how the [i]ESO [/i]game client is downloaded,  patched, and stored on local hard drives.
 
  
[b]What are the benefits of this update?[/b]
  
Once this update is complete, you will see major  improvements to the game’s load time and the speed at which assets are loaded  into the world.
  
Most notably, this change dramatically reduces the patch  sizes for all future updates, and it results in a major reduction of space  taken up by the client on your machine’s hard drive. Our console players will  feel this improvement most strongly, and PC/Mac players also benefit from this  change.

  
[b]What do I need to do?[/b]
  
ALL [i]ESO[/i] players [b]are required[/b] to completely re-download  the game client upon the launch of Update 25. For the most part, this should  not require any additional effort on your part; the [i]ESO [/i]Launcher for PC/Mac or  your console will begin the download automatically once the update goes live,  so just let it run on its own. You shouldn’t notice any other changes to the  launcher or download process, and your user settings and add-ons should remain  untouched (although it never hurts to back them up!). 
  
Unfortunately, it is not possible to begin the download for  Update 25 early (nor simply use the files from the PTS)—it will begin the  morning of the update’s launch. Once the download has begun, it’s simply a  matter of waiting for it to complete and launching the game as normal. Easy!


[b]Did I hear something about a free pet?[/b]
  
Yes! As a “thank you” to the [i]ESO [/i]community for completing  the re-download, we’re adding the Crimson Torchbug Pet to the Crown Store,  completely free. This glowing gift can be found under the Pets category of the  Crown Store and is available only for two weeks after Update 25’s launch. This  means PC/Mac players can grab their pets from February 24 until March 9, and  console players can get theirs from March 10 until March 24. Plenty of time to  complete the re-download! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3122b4436fd0658134b25952cfba7d5c4f39156a.jpg[/img]
																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Look at that little red butt![/i]


[h2]Update 25 Brings Improvements for All![/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC game pack, the Update 25 base-game patch brings a host of performance fixes that all of [i]ESO[/i]’s players can enjoy. In addition to this patching overhaul, you’ll experience better load times, frame rates, and more To stay up to date on all the performance improvements we are making to [i]ESO[/i] this year and beyond, keep an eye on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681]this article[/url] for its monthly updates! 

Are you ready for the patching overhaul and re-download that is coming with Update 25? More importantly, are you ready for the adorably bright Crimson Torchbug pet? Let us know via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Fight for Glory during the Midyear Mayhem PvP Event
notes.content:
[i]Clash with your fellow players in Cyrodiil, the Battlegrounds, and Imperial City during the Midyear Mayhem event and you’ll earn bonus Alliance Points and exclusive new rewards![/i]

[h2]Mayhem Returns[/h2]
Midyear Mayhem is back, and the horns of war bellow once more from Thursday, January 23 at 10:00AM EST, until Tuesday, February 4 at 10:00AM EST. During this PvP event, you can earn bonus rewards, XP, and Alliance Points by battling your fellow players in the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and Imperial City. 
[olist]
[*] Here’s how you can join the fight: 
[*] Navigate to the in-game Crown Store and acquire the FREE “Details on the Midyear Mayhem" quest from the Quest Starters category.
[*] Travel to your faction's main gate in Cyrodiil from the Alliance War menu.
[*] Locate the NPC called “Predicant Maera" and acquire the quest titled “Midyear Mayhem." (If you completed the quest previously, you won't need to do it again.)
[*] Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box.
[*] Use the scroll to activate a two-hour, 100% buff to Alliance Points and XP from player kills in PvP activities.
[*] To ensure you receive your due honors, hang on to the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity and reuse it during the event period. If you happen to discard it, you can acquire another from Predicant Maera for 100 gold or 100 Alliance Points (look for her near Battleground camps for this purpose also). 
[/olist]
Keep an eye out for three additional PvP campaigns opening up for the duration of the event, too! They won’t be Alliance locked.

[h2]Claim Your Rewards[/h2]
During Midyear Mayhem, you can earn new collectibles as rewards in addition to the Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath.

[b]Legion Zero Outfit Style Pages[/b]

You can don the garb of the legion by picking up the Outfit Style pages for the Legion Zero’s armor, dropped from bosses in the Imperial City, including those found in the sewers and the city proper. 

[b]Standard-Bearer Emotes[/b]

Show your colors with the Standard-Bearer emote! This new emote is earned by collecting 10 Standard-Bearer’s Emblems, found within the first Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Box you open each day per account. Once you have 10, you can combine them with a Standard-Bearer’s License (on sale for 50,000 AP) from Predicant Maera to create a Runebox with the emote for that character’s Alliance. Make sure to use it on a character of the Alliance whose banner you want to hold high!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/49f03af369fc440d81169cb036954ce3efbca751.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        			  
[i]Earn new rewards during Midyear Mayhem[/i]
  
[b]Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath[/b]
  
As always, you can earn the Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath  collectible by earning glory on the battlefield and completing the below  event-specific Achievements:
[list][*]Mayhem Connoisseur: Receive the blessing of the Whitestrake at  one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Echo of Pelinal's Fury: Read a Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity  during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Hand of the Whitestrake: Acquire your 25th Pelinal's Midyear Boon  Box.[/*][*]Wrath of the Whitestrake: Defeat 50 opponents during the Midyear  Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinavant the Scourge: Win a Battleground match during the  Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinaline the Bloody: Capture a Keep in Cyrodiil during the  Midyear Mayhem.[/*][*]Pelinerrif Insurgent: Capture an Imperial District during the  Midyear Mayhem.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ee56aaa30b9c544a40624597208d3701c12b744c.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Become the Star-Made Knight[/i]

Note that access to the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack is required to earn all of the above Achievements (now free in the in-game Crown Store!).

[h2]Pelinal’s Boons[/h2]
When you engage in PvP during the Midyear Mayhem event, you’ll receive Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Boxes in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers AND as rewards from various PvP daily quests. These dailies include:
[list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests (Requires “The Sublime Protector” achievement, earned by completing the Imperial City main questline)[/list]

Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Boxes have a chance to contain the following items:
[list][*]Transmute Crystals[/*][*]Alchemy reagents[/*][*]PvP consumables such as repair kits, forward camps, and siege weapons[/*][*]Motif pages for the Alliance and Akaviri styles[/*][*]Style items for your Alliance[/*][*]Akaviri style items[/*][*]Coldharbour siege weapons[/*][*]Prismatic Runestones[/*][*]Books of Pelinal housing items[/*][/list]
In addition to this, during the event, harvesting nodes within both Cyrodiil and the Imperial City drop double their regular resources, and the Cyrodiil merchant Adhazabi Aba-daro (also known as “The Golden”) stocks Alliance War Legendary-quality jewelry, with necklaces during the first weekend and rings during the second. 

[h2]Earn Event Tickets[/h2]
To earn Event Tickets during Midyear Mayhem, complete any of the following PvP daily quests:
[list][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][*]Imperial City daily quests (Requires “The Sublime Protector” achievement, earned by completing the Imperial City main questline)[/list]
When you complete one of these quests, you receive three Event Tickets in addition to your regular rewards. Note that you can earn only three tickets per day per account, resetting at 1:00AM EST each morning.

During the event, the Impresario will stock the following items:
[list][*]Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Legion Zero Outfit Style pages[/*][*]Standard-Bearer Emotes[/*][*]Spectral Berries of Bloom[/*][*]Spectral Berries of Budding[/*][/list]
This event features the first [i]two[/i] Indrik Berries for this quarter’s evolution, the otherworldly Spectral Indrik! Be aware that if you purchase the Legion Zero Outfit Style pages and Banner Emote items for Event Tickets, they are bound to your account, meaning you can’t trade them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/069296bbd0a7f9e2f64f322c833bead998ba0b7f.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Collect berries for the Spectral Indrik![/i]

You can acquire 39 Event Tickets during this event. Additionally, the Impresario continues to sell all Feathers throughout, allowing you to unlock a new Nascent Indrik, too.

[h2]Fight for Glory[/h2]
Wage war against your fellow players in the Battlegrounds, Cyrodiil, and Imperial City, and you’ll be honored with bonus rewards and new collectibles. Whether you’re a seasoned campaign veteran or a recruit ready to test your mettle, the Midyear Mayhem event is the perfect opportunity to check out [i]ESO[/i]’s unique PvP action. Are you ready and willing to fight for glory? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]The Midyear Mayhem in-game event begins on Thursday, January 23 at 10:00AM EST, and runs until Tuesday, February 4 at 10:00AM EST. [/i]

notes.title: Dark Heart of Skyrim & Greymoor Announcement Recap
notes.content:
[i]Yesterday evening, we announced The Elder Scrolls Online’s next big year-long adventure and Chapter live from the HyperX Esports Arena Las Vegas. In case you missed it, here’s everything we showcased and announced during the big event![/i]

[h2]A New Year-Long Tale[/h2]
The event’s biggest reveals, of course, were the announcement of both the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure and [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter, and the show kicked off on a high note with this new cinematic trailer:

[previewyoutube=VF5gTwvLFWk;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      						    						      						        
ZOS’s Creative Director Rich Lambert and Bethesda Softwork's SVP of Global Marketing and Communications Pete Hines took the stage to discuss the new Chapter, showcasing the content’s new zone, storyline, and systems. You can watch the entirety of the announcement [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/537350362][b]HERE on Twitch[/b][/url].

[h2]Post-Show Fun[/h2]
With the announcement stream complete, we went into a post-show with Community Team members Jessica Folsom and Gina Bruno, who hosted community guests and [i]ESO[/i] Dev Team members such as Dungeon Lead Mike Finnigan and Loremaster Leamon Tuttle! Watch it [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/537351770]HERE on Twitch[/url][/b].

[h2]Viewing Rewards[/h2]
For hitting 80,000 concurrent viewers during our Dark Heart of Skyrim global announcement stream, we're giving all [i]ESO[/i] players the Long-Winged Bat pet. To qualify, simply log into the game and kill any enemy monster any time between now and January 22, 2020 at 11:59 PM EST. 

As long as you qualify, you’ll receive your Long-Winged Bat pet by the first week of February. It’ll be added to your Collections automatically. 

We weren't able to hit our 150,000 concurrent viewer target required to unlock the [i]ESO [/i]team member's IRL “Snow Bear Plunge,” but we're going to do it anyway! Keep an eye out on our social channels for information in the near future on when we dive in, and thank you for watching the show!

[h2]Skyrim Needs Heroes[/h2]
With the announcement of the Dark Heart of Skyrim and [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter, we’re set for another exciting year of adventure. Are you ready to return to the land of the Nords? Let us know on Twitter at @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Greymoor Editions & Pre-Purchase Rewards
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor arrives May 18 for PC/Mac and June 2 for Xbox One and PlayStation[/i]®[i]4. Learn about the new Chapter’s editions and bonus rewards here, including how to pre-purchase.[/i]
									      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        			 [h2]Pre-Purchase Now[/h2]  
You can pre-purchase [i]Greymoor[/i] right now on select digital platforms and storefronts, including the [url=https://account.elderscrollsonline.com/store]ESO Store[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205430]Steam[/url], and [url=https://www.xbox.com/Search?q=elder+scrolls+online]Microsoft Store[/url]. [i]Greymoor[/i] is coming soon to the PlayStation®Store—check this [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/49267]help  article[/url] for more information. To get started, [b][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]click HERE[/url][/b] and select your edition, platform, and retailer.
			      						        			
[i]Greymoor[/i] launches for PC/Mac on May 18 and PlayStation®4 and Xbox One on June 2. In addition to this, [i]Greymoor[/i] will be coming to Stadia. Stay tuned for more information about how you can play [i]ESO[/i] on Stadia in the coming months!

[h2]Pre-Order and Pre-Purchase Rewards[/h2]  
If you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i], you gain access to exclusive rewards, including:
[list][*][b]Pre-Order Costume: Jarl Finery[/b][/*][list][*]This rugged but stylish raiment is typically reserved for northern nobility—just more proof of your heroic stature![/*][/list][*][b]Pre-Order Pet: Sacrificial Pocket Mammoth[/b][/*][list][*]Though the arcane markings indicate its status as a sacrificial offering, these creatures often end up trundling along after soft-hearted souls like yourself.[/*][/list][*][b]Pre-Order Reward: Nightfall Preview Crown Crate[/b][/*][list][*]A select collection of Nightfall-themed items![/*][/list][*][b]Pre-Order Reward: Western Skyrim Treasure Maps[/b][/*][list][*]A collection of three Western Skyrim Treasure Maps. [/*][/list][*][b]Pre-Order Adornment: Jarl Crown[/b][/*][list][*]Crafted from horker leather and metal reworked from weapons, this circlet marks your lofty status among the Nords.[/*][/list][*][b]Pre-Order Reward: Two XP Scrolls[/b][/*][list][*]50% XP scrolls, created by a Priestess of Meridia, to help you  get started on your adventures.[/*][/list][/list]
The above pre-order items arrive upon the game’s launch for your platform. In addition to this, should you pre-purchase [i]Greymoor[/i]  digitally, you also instantly unlock this exclusive in-game mount: 
[list][*][b]Pre-Purchase Mount: Holdbreaker Warhorse[/b][/*][list][*]Even the stoutest castle gates splinter under the thundering  hooves of the exclusive Holdbreaker Warhorse! Astride this hardy steed, victory  on the battlefield is assured.[/*][/list][/list]	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/820bf5f42fdda0e8cbcb570fe23bbb40c50f519f.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Pre-order and pre-purchase rewards[/i]

Finally, should you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Standard Edition[/i] or [i]Digital[/i] [i]Collector’s Edition[/i], you’ll also receive instant access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game and ALL previous Chapter releases, including the [i]Morrowind[/i], [i]Summerset[/i], and [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapters. Immediately begin your adventures in Tamriel! 

[h2]Greymoor Editions[/h2]
There are five unique editions of [i]Greymoor[/i] currently available for pre-purchase. Whether you’re a new player or veteran, there’s bound to be an edition that’s perfect for you.

[h3]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Physical Collector’s Edition[/h3]
The [i]Greymoor Physical Collector’s Edition[/i] is available ONLY as a physical version and includes the brand-new [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter ([b]note[/b]: NOT the base game or previous Chapters) in addition to a selection of unique physical and digital items, including: 

[b]Digital Items (unlocked at launch)[/b]
[list][*][b]Exclusive Pet: Death Hound[/b][/*][list][*]"I grew tired of the crush of humanity, so I got a Death Hound. Now I can't enter most taverns, but I also don't have people crowding my space."—Theldyn Faden[/*][/list][*][b]Exclusive Memento: Orb of Magnus[/b][/*][list][*]Hide from the oppressive light of Magnus with this memento.[/*][/list][*][b]Exclusive Mount: Crypt Warden Death Hound[/b][/*][list][*]Once these death hounds served crypt wardens exclusively, stalking the gloomy barrows of Skyrim in search of prey. [/*][/list][*][b]Exclusive Outfit Style Conversions: Swordthane[/b][/*][list][*]Claim a highly respected role among the Nords, the swordthane, and convert your gear to this distinctive style.[/*][/list][*][b]Exclusive Emote Pack: Skyrim[/b][/*][list][*]Skyrim-themed pack that includes the emotes Arrow to the Knee, Missing Sweetroll, and Ragnar the Red.[/*][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/448c15945c02e6e68dd98c046cba5b657032a0a5.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        			  
[i]Collector’s  Edition digital items (and pre-purchase mount)[/i]
  
[b]Physical Items [/b]
 [list][*][b]Vampire Lord Statue[/b][/*][list][*]A menacing sculpture of a great Vampire Lord.[/*][/list][*][b]Set of Four Collector's Coins[/b][/*][list][*]Based on each of the realms found in [i]ESO[/i]’s Chapters, including Vvardenfell, Summerset, Northern Elsweyr, and Western Skyrim.[/*][/list][*][b]Exclusive Steelbook[/b][/*][list][*]Hardy as a Nord’s ass (donkey!).[/*][/list][*][b]Map of Western Skyrim[/b][/*][list][*]Plan your adventures into the home of the Nords.[/*][/list][*][b]One Month of ESO Plus[/b]™[/*][list][*]Enjoy access to select ESO Plus benefits, including the Craft Bag, DLC access, and more! [/*][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/300be56be9b11bfd2339360e10bd3500e578a997.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        			  
[i]Physical  Collector’s Edition physical items[/i]
  
If you pre-purchase this edition of [i]Greymoor[/i], as mentioned above, you also receive all pre-order rewards and the pre-purchase exclusive mount at launch. The [i]Physical Collector’s Edition[/i] will be available  in stores for all platforms on May 18, however, please note that if you pick up your copy on this date for PlayStation®4 or Xbox One, you won’t be able to play  the new content until the console launch date of June 2.  

[h3]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Digital Collector’s Edition[/h3]
The [i]Greymoor Digital Collector’s Edition [/i]includes[i] [/i]instant  access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game and the [i]Morrowind[/i], [i]Summerset[/i], and [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapters in addition to the brand-new [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter at launch.
