notes.title: Announcing the Dark Heart of Skyrim & The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor
notes.content:
[i]Uncover deathly secrets in the Dark Heart of Skyrim, ESO's next big year-long adventure. Beginning this February with the Harrowstorm DLC, the story continues with the new Chapter, The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor, arriving PC/Mac on May 18 and Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on June 2.[/i]

[previewyoutube=VF5gTwvLFWk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Dark Heart of Skyrim[/h2]  
An ancient evil emerges from the depths, intent on devouring  the souls of Skyrim. A dark tide of monsters rise from Blackreach and threatens to plunge all of Tamriel into darkness. 

In the Dark Heart of Skyrim, you can experience [i]a new[/i] year-long adventure, beginning with the upcoming [i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC dungeon pack and continuing through the [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter and beyond. You can experience the entire massive story in these upcoming releases: 
[list][*][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/dlc/harrowstorm][i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC dungeon pack[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/greymoor][i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter[/url][/*][*]Unannounced Q3 DLC dungeon pack[/*][*]Unannounced Q4 DLC story zone[/*][/list]
Keep an eye on for more updates on this new year-long epic soon, starting with [i]Harrowstorm[/i]!

[h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Harrowstorm[/h2]  
The Dark Heart of Skyrim storyline begins with the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/dlc/harrowstorm][i]Harrowstorm[/i]  dungeon DLC[/url], kicking off as soon as this February. Featuring two new dungeons, [i]Harrowstorm[/i] has you contend with a supernatural storm in Icereach and explore the depths of Unhallowed Grave. As you discover the dark forces that threaten Skryim, the events of this DLC will lead directly into the [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter. 

[h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/h2]  
Supernatural harrowstorms plague Western Skyrim, and dark beasts, led by a powerful Vampire Lord, devour souls to further their mysterious plans. In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i], [i]ESO[/i]’s newest Chapter, you must defend the besieged Nords and uncover the evil behind this monstrous resurgence.  
  
This Chapter brings all-new adventures to [i]ESO[/i] players, including:
[list][*] A new zone to explore: Western Skyrim[/*][*]A gothic main story quest line that ties into the Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure[/*][*]An intriguing new system: Antiquities[/*][*]A massive new 12-player Trial: Kyne’s Aegis [/*][*]New world events: Harrowstorms[/*][*]New delves, public dungeons, and stand-alone quests[/*][*]Updates and quality-of-life improvements including a rework of the Vampire Skill Line (free for all [i]ESO[/i] players)[/*][/list]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i] is coming to PC/Mac on May 18 and Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on June 2. You can  pre-purchase [i]Greymoor[/i] right now for PC/Mac and Xbox One. [i]Greymoor[/i] is coming soon to the PlayStation®Store—check this [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/49267]help  article[/url] for more information.

In addition to this, we are thrilled to announce that [i]Greymoor[/i] will be coming to Stadia. Stay tuned for more information about  how you can play [i]ESO[/i] on Stadia in the coming months!

[b]Explore Skyrim Above and Below[/b]

In [i]Greymoor[/i], you can return to the snow-swept home of  the Nords and explore the region of Western Skyrim. Currently in [i]ESO[/i],  you adventure along Skyrim’s eastern zones of Eastmarch, Bleakrock, and the Rift,  but in this new Chapter, you can explore the other side of the province,  including the city of Solitude and the deepest depths of Blackreach, a  subterranean world beneath!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/498c1833e31640ba4992945773eca506652497b3.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Explore Solitude 1000 years before The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim[/i]

As you venture across this new zone, you’ll encounter the hardy Nords who call it home and discover a host of interesting side quests, delves, public dungeons, world bosses, a trial, and the new harrowstorm world events. Enough to keep any intrepid adventurer busy!

[b]A Gothic Tale[/b]

As part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure[i], Greymoor[/i]’s main story continues the ominous narrative that begins in the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/dlc/harrowstorm][i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC dungeon pack[/url]. In this latest Chapter, you must investigate the evil behind the supernatural storms that have swept across the region. 

While [i]Greymoor[/i]’s main story is part of the year-long tale, you don’t need to have completed the [i]Harrowstorm[/i] DLC to follow and enjoy the adventure. How you choose to experience Tamriel and the Dark Heart of Skyrim is up to you!

[b]Antiquities System[/b]

The new Chapter also features the all-new antiquities system. This in-game activity allows you to uncover lost artifacts scattered across Tamriel. As an up-and-coming archaeologist, you can scry the location of ancient relics and excavate them via a series of new minigames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a82a1a0c5f3a8565f2eafa8680c19c3d401cf9a9.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Discover and unearth lost relics[/i]

The relics you can uncover include unique collectibles such as furnishings and mementos, and they are not limited to the new zone, but instead see you travel to every corner of the continent. Tamriel’s hidden history is yours to discover!

[h2]Pre-Purchase Greymoor Now[/h2]
You can pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor[/i] now to receive unique rewards at launch, including the Jarl Finery costume, Jarl Crown adornment, Sacrificial Pocket Mammoth pet (actual sacrifice optional), Treasure Maps, a Nightfall Preview Crown Crate, and Experience Scrolls. In addition to this, for digital pre-purchases only, you receive immediate access to the Holdbreaker Warhorse mount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2491f2116aa3323d26218cdb536e932a2cace85a.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        			  
[i]The stout  Holdbreaker Warhorse mount[/i]
  
[i]Greymoor [/i]will be available in the following editions:
[list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Standard Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Digital Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Digital Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Digital Collector’s Edition  Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor Physical Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][/list]
The [i]Greymoor Collector’s Edition[/i] comes with all the pre-purchase bonuses in addition to a host of unique digital goodies. For more information on each version of [i]Greymoor[/i] and to find out which one is  right for you, review our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57527]editions article[/url]. Finally, you can pre-purchase [i]Greymoor[/i] on  our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url] right  now! 

[h2]Uncover the Dark Heart[/h2]  
Monsters emerge from the deeps of Western Skyrim, threatening all of Tamriel in the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure. The new [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter is at the center of this amazing new tale, so keep  an eye out for more information regarding the new Chapter and epic storyline in the coming months. Skyrim needs heroes!
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Greymoor is coming for PC/Mac on May 18 and PlayStation[/i]®[i]4 and Xbox One on June 2[/i]. [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]Pre-purchase Greymoor now[/i][/url] digitally[i] to receive unique bonus rewards and gain  immediate access to the Holdbreaker Warhorse in-game mount (digital  only—conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Earn New Rewards & Glory during the Undaunted Celebration
notes.content:
[i]Who knows no fear of beast or blade? The Undaunted Celebration event is back! Clear dungeons to earn bonus rewards and Event Tickets. We are Undaunted![/i]

With the recent implementation of several fixes for the Activity Finder, we are inviting everyone to try out the updated tool on the live servers. To help us reach the desired population and Activity Finder load, we are re-enabling the Undaunted Celebration event from [b]Thursday, January 9 at 10:00AM EST[/b] through [b]Monday, January 13 at 10:00AM EST[/b]. We believe that these latest fixes will allow for a better experience, but we will be closely monitoring performance throughout the event in case of further issues. 

Thank you for your patience throughout this process and for helping us ensure that the overall Activity Finder is improved.

[h2]Undaunted, Undaunted![/h2]  
Kicking off this Thursday, January 9 at 10:00AM EST, and running until Monday, January 13 at 10:00AM EST, the Undaunted Celebration event returns, bringing new rewards for Tamriel’s brave dungeon delvers. 
  
To participate in this event, take on Tamriel’s four-player dungeons by using the Dungeon Finder tool or by traveling to a dungeon with  your group. Normal or Veteran difficulty, it’s up to you!

[h2]Loot and Glory[/h2]  
When you defeat a dungeon’s final boss during the Undaunted Celebration, it’ll drop a special Undaunted Reward Box in addition to its usual  loot. In these containers, you can discover all kinds of useful and valuable  items, such as Undaunted Keys, Undaunted plunder, motif pages, repair kits,  transmute crystals, riding lessons, and more. 
  
However, that’s not all! During this event only, you also have the chance to acquire special “Opal” versions of the classic Monster Weapon, Mask, and Shoulder styles for the following bosses: 
[list][*]Bloodspawn[/*][*]Illambris[/*][*]Engine Guardian[/*][*]Troll King[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3d298c5a7c6312ae127fbd6310b87413e0b4d791.jpg[/img]

Here’s how you can earn these shiny new style pages:

[b]Opal Monster Weapon Outfit Style[/b]

The [b]first[/b] [b]time[/b] you slay a dungeon’s final boss each day, you’ll earn a special Hefty Undaunted Reward box. These larger containers house the same items as their smaller cousins, but they also contain a random page of the new Opal Monster Weapon Outfit style pages. Note that Opal Monster Weapon Outfit style pages can drop from regular Undaunted Reward Boxes on [i]very[/i] rare occasions, but the only way to get one guaranteed is from a Hefty box.

[b]Opal Monster Masks Outfit Style[/b]

If you’re interested in the Masks, the Opal Monster Mask styles can drop from Veteran Hard Mode final bosses within Spindleclutch II (Bloodspawn), Crypt of Hearts I (Illambris), Darkshade Caverns II (Engine Guardian), and Blessed Crucible (Troll King). If you’re interested only in the regular version of the Masks, they will still drop on Veteran difficulty, too. 

[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style[/b]

Finally, the Opal Shoulder Outfit Style pages for the above monsters will be available from Undaunted vendors during the event, too. Note that you must own the normal versions (also available from the same vendors) of the Shoulders first before you can acquire the Opal ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f478d348ae5e9b16d1e2ce30960a21a3d4eac996.jpg[/img]
[i]Grab Shoulder style pages from Undaunted vendors[/i]

[h2]Event Tickets and Impresario[/h2]  
When participating in the Undaunted Celebration, you can earn three Event Tickets the first time you slay any final boss in any dungeon  each day. Here’s a list of goods available at the  Impresario:
[list][*]All four Indrik Feathers (for summoning a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*]Opal Monster Outfit Styles (including Weapons, Masks, and Shoulders)[/*][/list]
[b]Note[/b]: There are no new Indrik Berries arriving with the Undaunted Celebration, but they are coming! Be sure to stock up on Indrik Feathers and Event Tickets for the next, soon-to-be-announced event
									      						    						      						        																																				      						    						      						        			 [h2]We Are Undaunted![/h2]
Tamriel’s dungeons can be daunting for new initiates, but there’s never been a better time to group up and take on some of [i]ESO[/i]’s most fun and challenging PvE content!

Glory and shiny new loot awaits the Undaunted. Are you excited to dive into some dungeons during this event? Let us know on Twitter at @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Undaunted Celebration event begins Thursday, January 9 at 10:00AM EST, and will run until Monday, January 13 at 10:00AM EST. [/i]

Here’s how it works:
[list][*]From the Crown Store, gift [b]five or more[/b] Event Tickets to anybody in game[/*][list][*]You can find Event Tickets within the Events section[/*][*]You can split the gifts between multiple recipients (all five don’t have to go to one lucky player)[/*][/list][*]Once the New Life Festival is over, we’ll send you four Frost Atronach Crown Crates[/*][list][*]Crown Crate delivery date is TBD, but it will occur by the [b]end of January 2020[/b][/*][/list][/list]

With Event Tickets, you can acquire many different items from the in-game Impresario event merchant. For a complete listing of what she has available during the New Life Festival, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57393/]announcement article[/url]. Spoiler: It includes every set of berries you could earn this year! 

Within the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57395]Frost Atronach Crown Crates[/url], you will discover a cool collection of items including unique and returning mounts, pets, costumes, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/223bdc0974beb8d885ca08e37ee256702a3dce70.jpg[/img]
[i]You can find these items and more in Frost Atronach Crown Crates[/i]

New Life is the time to spread holiday cheer and goodwill—so what better way to get into the spirit of the season than to give and to receive? Let us know if you’ll be taking advantage of this limited-time offer via Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Get Bonus Rewards and XP during ESO’s New Life Festival Event
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate an amazing year of adventure and comradery with the return of the New Life Festival. Earn bonus XP, event-unique rewards, and more during this merry fete! [/i]

[h1]Celebrate New Life[/h1]
The New Life Festival in-game event beings this Thursday, December 19 at 10:00AM EST and runs until Thursday, January 2, 2020, at 10:00AM EST. If you’d like to take part in this joyous jubilee, acquire the New Life Festival quest from the in-game Crown Store and use it to find the New Life Herald, Breda, located south of the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch. Even if you’ve already completed this intro quest during a previous event, you can do it again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bef4d21b146eef7c42bb478b88e086927c9d3bc8.jpg[/img]
[i]Find Breda to begin the celebration[/i]

Complete the quest “The New Life Festival” and unlock a ton of unique New Life-themed daily quests (nine total) that help spread cheer and merriment to all the people of Tamriel. The first time you complete your first New Life Festival quest, you also unlock the Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug collectible, which provides a two-hour 100% boost to XP gains when consumed. You can use this festive flagon and enjoy the XP boost throughout the entire event period, and even better, its benefits stack with other XP bonuses.

[h1]Gift Boxes Galore[/h1]
The first time you complete a New Life Festival daily quest each day, you earn two Event Tickets in addition to your Gift Box. These celebratory coffers can contain all manner of festival-themed goods, including Motif chapters, recipes, collectibles, furnishings, and more:
[list][*]Skinchanger Motif chapters[/*][*]New Life recipes[/*][*]New Life collectibles (packaged in Runeboxes and tradeable):[/*][list][*]Sword-Swallower's Blade memento[/*][*]Juggler's Knives memento[/*][*]Fire-Breather's Torches memento[/*][*]Mud Ball Pouch memento[/*][*]Nordic Bather's Towel costume[/*][*]Colovian Filigreed Hood hat[/*][*]Colovian Fur Hood hat[/*][/list][*]A selection of lights, lamps, and lanterns for your home to celebrate the Signal Fire Sprint[/*][*]Draughts of Stealth and Escape to celebrate the Trial of Five-Clawed Guile[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1aa25ea576f83446852038a342e15192f990e7a7.jpg[/img]
[i]The Skaal Explorer Outfit Style[/i]

[b]Charity Writs![/b]
Of course, this festive season is all about spreading holiday cheer and goodwill, and throughout the event, when you open a New Life Festival Gift Box, you have a chance to receive a Charity Writ. This year, you can discover two different Charity Writs within Reward Boxes:
[list][*]New Life Charity Writs–Complete 12 of these to unlock the “Newly Charitable” Achievement and Crystalfrost skin.[/*][*][b]New[/b] Deep Winter Charity Writs–Complete to unlock pages from the new Skaal Explorer outfit style![/*][/list]
[h1]Earn Event Tickets & Acquire ANY Berry[/h1]
The first two times you complete a New Life Festival daily quest, you earn an Event Ticket in addition to your Gift Box for each. You can earn only two Event Ticket this way per day, with the timer resetting at 1:00AM EST each morning. 

However, because of the postponement of the Undaunted Celebration in November, we decided to reward Event Tickets for bosses slain throughout the entirety of the New Life Festival. Each day, when you defeat your first boss you receive three Event Tickets in addition to that boss’ regular rewards. 

Here’s the bosses that’ll count: 
[list][*]World bosses[/*][*]Delve bosses[/*][*]Final dungeon bosses[/*][*]Final trial bosses[/*][*]Final arena bosses[/*][*]Dragon hunt, Dolmen, and Abyssal Geyser bosses[/*][/list]
That means each day, you could earn up to five tickets. Don’t forget to loot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b8a1e573a21cfa9aebf578a88684e9a7de3157e.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete your Pure-Snow Indrik during New Life![/i]

The Impresario has opened her warehouse during the New Life Festival, and has a ton of new and returning items you can spend your Event Tickets on, including:
[list][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*][b]New[/b] Pure-Snow Berries of Ripeness[/*][*]All previous Pure-Snow Indrik Berries[/*][*][b]ALL previous Indrik Berries (!)[/b][/*][*][b]New [/b]Skaal Explorer Outfit Style pages[/*][/list]
That’s right, during the New Life Festival, you can acquire ANY of the year’s Indrik Berries! Before now, these berries were available only during previous in-game events, so if you’re missing one or two berries from past evolutions, now is your chance to catch up.

As usual, Impresario items are bound to your account upon purchase.

[h1]‘Tis the Season[/h1]
Spread joy to all of Tamriel during the New Life Festival and enjoy bonus XP, special holiday-themed rewards, and more. Are you ready to throw some mudballs and take the Snow Bear plunge? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Celebrate a Year of Adventure with the Dawn of the Dragonguard Event!
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate the Season of the Dragon year-long adventure during the Dawn of the Dragonguard event and unlock bonus rewards including double drops, Event Tickets, and more![/i]

[h1]The Dragonguard Rise[/h1]
The Dawn of the Dragonguard event begins on Tuesday, November 26 at 10:00AM EST, and runs until Monday, December 9 at 10:00AM EST. During the event period, earn bonus rewards by taking on Dragons and bosses found within this year’s Season of the Dragon content.

To participate in this new event, pick up the Dawn of the Dragonguard quest from the in-game Crown Store. Note that to participate in this event, you must have access to some or all of this year’s Season of the Dragon content, including the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC, [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC, or [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC.

[h1]A Dragon’s Hoard of Rewards[/h1]
Should you take part in this event, you can earn double drops for the following activities:
[list][*]Defeating a zone Dragon in either Southern or Northern Elsweyr[/*][*]Defeating a boss in [i]Wrathstone[/i] dungeons, [i]Scalebreaker[/i] dungeons, or the Sunspire trial[/*][*] Harvesting resource nodes in Northern and Southern Elsweyr[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ef15396e167ff1f17114bd5b26cd075d48658f10.jpg[/img]
[i]Play the year’s  adventures to earn double drops![/i]
  
Double drops for these activities includes rewards such as gold,  items, and gear sets. If you’ve yet to complete a dungeon or trial set, now is  your chance!

[h1]Event Tickets & Rewards[/h1]  
During the Dawn of the Dragonguard event, you can earn up to two Event Tickets per day by completing the following tasks:
[list][*]Defeat a zone Dragon in Northern Elsweyr or the last Dragon boss in Sunspire trial[/*][*]Defeat a zone Dragon in Southern Elsweyr or complete any dungeon from either the [i]Wrathstone[/i] or [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLCs[/*][/list]
The tasks above grant you one ticket per day each, so to get the maximum amount you need to complete both!
  
Throughout the event, the Impresario returns with a unique  selection of goods, including:
[list][*][b]New[/b] Pure-Snow Berries of Growth[/*][*]Pure-Snow Berries of Bloom and Budding[/*][*]All four Indrik Feathers (for summoning a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*][b]New[/b] Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Helm outfit style[/*][*][b]New[/b] Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Shoulder outfit style[/*][*]Sai Sahan outfit style pages[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7af47cfd0d4b42e1bfe5a731d2462772dd0abe94.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn new collectibles[/i]

Phew! That’s plenty to spend your hard-earned Event Tickets on! Don’t forget: this is your first opportunity to acquire the next berry necessary to evolve your Nascent Indrik into the beautiful Pure-Snow Indrik, with the final berry coming later during the New Life Festival. 
[h1]Celebrating a Year of Adventure[/h1]
Double drops, the next Pure-Snow Indrik berry, and all-new style pages await during the Dawn of the Dragonguard event. This is also your last chance to help support animal welfare charities by slaying Dragons as part of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats#support-the-cause]#SlayDragonsSaveCats promotion[/url], and there’s still time to sign up for the [url=https://woobox.com/pkd5uq]Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes[/url], too! Are you excited to celebrate a year of adventure with us? Let us know on Twitter at @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Dawn of the Dragonguard event begins Tuesday, November 26 at 10:00AM EST, and runs until Monday, December 9 at 10:00AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Earn New Rewards & Glory During the Undaunted Celebration
notes.content:
[i][b]Shortly after the launch of Undaunted Event, we began to see server issues related to the Activity Finder that was affecting your ability to play the game. Our top priority is making sure you can log in and play, so to that end, we have decided to turn off the Undaunted Event. Please keep an eye out for an announcement regarding the Undaunted Event in the near future. Thank you for your continued patience and understanding.[/b][/i]

[i]Who knows no fear of beast or blade? The Undaunted Celebration event is back! Clear dungeons to earn bonus rewards and Event Tickets. We are Undaunted![/i]

[h1]Undaunted, Undaunted![/h1]
Kicking off this Thursday, November 14 at 10:00AM EST, and running until Monday, November 18 at 10:00AM EST, the Undaunted Celebration event returns, bringing new rewards for Tamriel’s brave dungeon delvers. 

To participate in this event, take on Tamriel’s four-player dungeons by using the Dungeon Finder tool or by traveling to a dungeon with your group. Normal or Veteran difficulty, it’s up to you!

[h1]Loot and Glory[/h1]
When you defeat a dungeon’s final boss during the Undaunted Celebration, it’ll drop a special Undaunted Reward Box in addition to its usual loot. In these containers, you can discover all kinds of useful and valuable items, such as Undaunted Keys, Undaunted plunder, motif pages, repair kits, transmute crystals, riding lessons, and more. 

However, that’s not all! During this event only, you also have the chance to acquire special “Opal” versions of the classic Monster Weapon, Mask, and Shoulder styles for the following bosses: 
[list][*]Bloodspawn[/*][*]Illambris[/*][*]Engine Guardian[/*][*]Troll King[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3d298c5a7c6312ae127fbd6310b87413e0b4d791.jpg[/img]

Here’s how you can earn these shiny new style pages:

[b]Opal Monster Weapon Outfit Style[/b]

The [b]first[/b] [b]time[/b] you slay a dungeon’s final boss each day, you’ll earn a special Hefty Undaunted Reward box. These larger containers house the same items as their smaller cousins, but they also contain a random page of the new Opal Monster Weapon Outfit style pages. Note that Opal Monster Weapon Outfit style pages can drop from regular Undaunted Reward Boxes on [i]very[/i] rare occasions, but the only way to get one guaranteed is from a Hefty box.

[b]Opal Monster Masks Outfit Style[/b]

If you’re interested in the Masks, the Opal Monster Mask styles can drop from Veteran Hard Mode final bosses within Spindleclutch II (Bloodspawn), Crypt of Hearts I (Illambris), Darkshade Caverns II (Engine Guardian), and Blessed Crucible (Troll King). If you’re interested only in the regular version of the Masks, they will still drop on Veteran difficulty, too. 

[b]Opal Monster Shoulder Outfit Style[/b]

Finally, the Opal Shoulder Outfit Style pages for the above monsters will be available from Undaunted vendors during the event, too. Note that you must own the normal versions (also available from the same vendors) of the Shoulders first before you can acquire the Opal ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f478d348ae5e9b16d1e2ce30960a21a3d4eac996.jpg[/img]
[i]Grab Shoulder style pages from Undaunted vendors[/i]

[h1]Event Tickets and Impresario[/h1]
When participating in the Undaunted Celebration, you can earn three Event Tickets the first time you slay any final boss in any dungeon each day. Throughout the event, the Impresario will return and stock both the Snow Berries of Bloom (introduced during the Witches Festival) AND the new Snow Berries of Budding. Here’s the complete list of goods available at the Impresario:
[list][*]Pure-Snow Berries of Bloom[/*][*][b]New[/b] Pure-Snow Berries of Budding[/*][*]All four Indrik Feathers (for summoning a Nascent Indrik)[/*][*][b]New[/b] Opal Monster Outfit Styles (including Weapons, Masks, and Shoulders)[/*][/list]
Should you acquire the first two Snow Berries and the next two from the other upcoming Q4 events, you’ll be able to summon the majestic Pure-Snow Indrik!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b8a1e573a21cfa9aebf578a88684e9a7de3157e.jpg[/img]
[i]The Pure-Snow Indrik mount[/i]

[h1]We Are Undaunted![/h1]
Tamriel’s dungeons can be daunting for new initiates, but there’s never been a better time to group up and take on some of [i]ESO[/i]’s most fun and challenging PvE content! Don’t forget, if you happen to slay a Dragon in the Lair of Maarselok dungeon, it’ll help us support animal charities as part of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats#support-the-cause]#SlayDragonsSaveCats promotion[/url]. Even better, as you earn Event Tickets for completing dungeons each day, you’ll also get bonus entries for the [url=https://woobox.com/pkd5uq]Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes[/url]!

Glory and shiny new loot awaits the Undaunted. Are you excited to dive into some dungeons during this event? Let us know on Twitter at @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Undaunted Celebration event begins Thursday, November 14 at 10:00AM EST, and will run until Monday, November 18 at 10:00AM EST. [/i]

notes.title: Experience The Elder Scrolls Online Free During our Next Free Play Event!
notes.content:
[i]Experience The Elder Scrolls Online free during our next Free Play event![/i]

[h1]Play For Free[/h1]
The Free Play Event is happening now until Wednesday, November 13 at 10:00AM EST. During the free play period, you can download and play the [i]ESO[/i] base game for all platforms (PC/Mac, Steam, PlayStation®4, and Xbox One) free, no purchase needed.

If you’ve played [i]ESO[/i] during a previous free play event, you can continue your adventures, and all new [i]ESO[/i] accounts created will also receive 500 crowns to spend in the in-game Crown Store.

With access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, you can begin your adventure by creating characters in four of the game’s classes (Nightblade, Templar, Dragonknight, and Sorcerer), exploring 23 unique zones, and taking on the game’s main questline, Mages and Fighters Guild storylines, and much more. How you play is completely up to you—it’s your story! In addition to this, you’ll also get access to the [i]Morrowind[/i] zone and story, allowing you to discover the home of the Dark Elves. 

Once the event begins, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]visit our Free Play page[/url] to select your platform and begin your adventure. Your progress will carry over if you decide to buy the full game. The Free Play event ends on November 13 at 10:00AM EST.

If you wish to continue or expand upon your adventures in Tamriel, for a limited time, you can acquire either The Elder Scrolls Online Standard Edition at up to 50% off.

The sale will run from Wednesday, November 6 at 10:00AM EST until Monday, December 2. Once the sale is live, visit the Steam Store to pick up the game on sale and experience a world without limits!

notes.title: The Spooky Season Is Here with the Return of the Witches Festival!
notes.content:
[i]Boo! Battle Tamriel’s monsters, get double XP, and earn creepy new rewards during the Witches Festival in-game event! Learn everything you need to know about the frightening fete here.[/i]

[h1]The Witches Festival Returns[/h1]
Tamriel’s Witches Festival returns from Thursday, October 24 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Monday, November 4 at 10:00AM EST. During this chilling celebration, you can enjoy a 100% XP boost, receive creepy collectibles, and acquire Event Tickets! 

To take part in this scary soiree:
[list][*]Navigate to the Holiday section of the Crown Store and acquire the free quest.[/*][*]Complete the quest “The Witchmother's Bargain" to receive the Witchmother's Whistle memento.[/*][/list][list][*]If you completed the quest in previous events, you don’t need to acquire the Crow Caller or complete the quest again, and you can use the whistle already found in your Collections menu.[/*][/list][*]Use the whistle to summon the “Witchmother's Cauldron," which grants you and your party a two-hour 100% XP buff that stacks with all other XP bonuses.[/*][*]Use the Witchmother's Cauldron to transform your character into one of the undead. Spoopy![/*][list][*]Note that you do not have to use the Witchmother's Cauldron to gain the XP buff, just the whistle. The Cauldron cannot be summoned in Cyrodiil. [/*][/list]
[h1]Earn Horrifying Honors[/h1]
During this freaky festival, you can earn some frightful Witches Festival-themed items, collectibles, and more, simply by defeating boss monsters and looting Plunder Skulls. 

When you tear open a Plunder Skull, you have a chance to snatch up some of these items:
[list][*][b]NEW[/b] pieces of the Skeleton Marionette memento[/*][list][*]Combine all 10 pieces to craft this collectible [/*][/list][*]Hollowjack Motif pages or books[/*][*]Pieces of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron memento[/*][list][*]Combine all seven pieces to craft this collectible[/*][/list][*]A Runebox containing a Witches Festival-themed mask[/*][list][*]Collect all four![/*][/list][*]Witches Festival-themed recipes, including furniture and furniture recipes[/*][*]Bewitching Alchemy reagents and style materials[/*][*]…and an assortment of creepy and items![/*][/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b9cf1266b26ac58bff74371c2a9216866351847e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/0b9b976236c4d68c4c2e87c62461ceeeb9d6a7de.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/9caa6ce2d851e2206b31289e869961329993617f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/21efd755d3736cd0a56c576195faeef35b00225b.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Witches Festival goodies![/i]

In addition to this, the [b]first time[/b] you defeat each [b]different type of boss each day[/b] (detailed below) you’ll receive a Dremora Plunder Skull. This special reward contains the same kind of items in the regular Skulls, but also features a Dremora Motif style page. However, that’s not all! Dremora Plunder Skulls also have a chance to contain the following new items: 
[list][*][b]NEW[/b] Glenmoril Armor Outfit Style page[/*][*][b]NEW[/b] Glenmoril Treasure map[/*][list][*]Use the map to find Glenmoril Weapon Style pages scattered all over Tamriel[/*][/list][*][b]NEW[/b] Witches Festival Writ[/*][list][*]Complete these writs to unlock an Achievement that’ll earn you a new Witch hat collectible AND the “Witch” title![/*][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f0022678670cab33d31d785869a270fe74a4c25c.jpg[/img]
[i]The Glenmoril armor style[/i]

Just like last year, depending on the type of boss you slay, you’ll receive one of two different Dremora Motif pages:
[list][*]Final Arena Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Bows and Legs[/*][*]Dark Anchor, Geyser Bosses, and zone Dragons drop Dremora Motif pages for Daggers and Gloves[/*][*]Delve Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Staves and Belts[/*][*]Final Dungeon Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Helmets and Maces[/*][*]Public Dungeon and Quest Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shields and Boots[/*][*]Final Trial Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Swords and Chests[/*][*]World Bosses drop Dremora Motif pages for Shoulders and Axes[/*][/list]
Finally, as part of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats campaign[/url], we’re continuing to donate $1 to animal welfare charities for every five Dragons slain. Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57037]announcement article[/url] for the details. 

[h1]Acquire Event Tickets[/h1]
During the Witches Festival, the first time a boss drops a Dremora Plunder Skull each day, it’ll also drop two Event Tickets. Don’t forget to loot it! This event will be your first opportunity to collect the berries needed to evolve your Nascent Indrik into the stunning Pure-Snow Indrik mount. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/4b8a1e573a21cfa9aebf578a88684e9a7de3157e.jpg[/img]
[i]The Pure-Snow Indrik mount[/i]

During the event, the Impresario will stock the following goods:
[list][*]Snow Berries of Bloom[/*][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*]Glenmoril Weapon Outfit Style pages[/*][*]Glenmoril Armor Outfit Style pages[/*][*]Skeleton Marionette memento[/*][*]Apple Bobbing memento[/*][*]Witches Festival Writ, Wrapped [/*][/list]
Note that all of the above items, when purchased from the Impresario, are bind-on-pickup and non-tradable. The Impresario is located in Daggerfall, Davon's Watch, and Vulkhel Guard.

Don’t forget, every time you spend Event Tickets you’ve earned by doing in-game events (and not purchased directly from the Crown Store) on Feathers or Berries, you’ll earn bonus entries into the Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes, up to a maximum of 10! Check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats page[/url] for more information on the Sweepstakes and its prizes, plus view the [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Events/SlayDragonsSaveCats/Sweepstakes/Rules/ZeniMax_ESO_Q4_2019_Sweepstakes_Official_Rules_EN.pdf]official rules here[/url].

If you have yet to sign up for the Sweeps, there’s still time and tons of prizes to win! 

[url=https://woobox.com/pkd5uq]Enter Sweepstakes[/url]

[h1]Spooky Crown Store Deals[/h1]
This freaky festival also features some returning and new items in the in-game Crown Store. This includes the return of the Reaper’s Harvest and Hollowjack Crown Crates, the Hollowjack and Witches’ Coven furnishing packs, houses, polymorphs, and some truly terrifying new items:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/0040247e2a0bac1f2ca49ed2193dcf63a0640e7a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/03be10d1aa5f1fa9d2b510740c3aee94dd7fe754.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bf0bf1247e5ec0bfe450bd6e995af46dc0c44bc7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5ec9c9d7b934ebfaf30b3f255c18fa7cad991de3.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]The Kynbound Senche-Panther mount & Witch’s Infernal Familiar pet! Aahh![/i]

All of the above items are available for a limited time only, so be sure to check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57075]latest Showcase article[/url] to see when they can be picked up. Don’t miss out!

[h1]A Ghoulish Gala![/h1]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] has no small amount of monsters, ghouls, and ghosts, but you can earn double XP and bonus rewards for hunting all the things that go bump in the night during the Witches Festival event. Are you ready to take the fright to Tamriel’s most dangerous fiends? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The grim spectacle of the Witches Festival returns from Thursday, October 24 at 10:00AM EDT, and runs until Monday, November 4 at 10:00AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Dragonhold and Update 24 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]The Season of the Dragon culminates with Dragonhold, the latest DLC game pack for The Elder Scrolls Online! Venture into Southern Elsweyr, restore the ancient Dragonguard order, and help Sai Sahan put an end to the Dragon threat once and for all. Learn all about the DLC and Update 24 base-game patch in this launch article.[/i]

The [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC and Update 24 brings new adventures and improvements to [i]ESO[/i]:
[list][*]A new zone to explore: the lawless region of Southern Elsweyr[/*][*]An epic new main story to complete[/*][*]All-new side quests, Dragons, world bosses, and delves[/*][*]Exclusive Season of the Dragon bonus quests[/*][*]New rewards, including unique achievements and collectibles[/*][*]The first wave of base-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681]performance improvements[/url][/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. You can read the patch notes for both [i]Dragonhold[/i] and Update 24 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

If you play [i]ESO[/i] on console, don’t worry. This DLC and update will arrive for Xbox One and PlayStation® 4 on November 5. 

[previewyoutube=vibHkVFjtvY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

					      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																									      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        			 [h1]Dragonhold DLC Game Pack[/h1]
The [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC game pack brings the year-long Season of the Dragon storyline to its epic conclusion with a new zone, quests, rewards, challenges, and more.

[b]Explore Southern Elsweyr[/b]
Decades ago, the once-proud region of Pellitine was devastated by a terrible plague and fire. Those that remain struggle to survive in a world reduced to ruin and beset by bandits, slavers, and worse. Only in the southern capital of Senchal does a small bastion of defenders hold firm against the chaos. However, a rage of Dragons invades from the north, and Southern Elsweyr once again stands on the precipice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c75caf44822826a936004e574454feb597754a7c.jpg[/img]
[i]Discover Pellitine’s ancient history[/i]

In the [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC, you can explore this new zone, uncover its history, and confront its many tormentors. Similar in size to previous DLC story zones, such as [i]Clockwork City[/i] or [i]Murkmire[/i], you’ll discover tons of unique quests, bosses, delves and more, and journey through a scarred-but-vibrant world full of adventure. 

[b]Join Sai Sahan & Restore the Dragonguard[/b]
In the [i]Dragonhold[/i] main story questline, you can join Sai Sahan as he reforges the ancient order of Dragon hunters known as the Dragonguard. Only if you work together to uncover the secrets of this long-lost organization do you have a chance at stopping an all-new Dragon from once again dominating Pellitine. During your adventures with Sai and his allies, you receive rewards, including new and unique collectibles. You also gradually unlock improvements and additions to the Dragonguard’s base of operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/375465d4c5ae87c5e36a6223ebd247b304d1d75f.jpg[/img]
[i]Help restore the Dragonguard[/i]

[b]Conclude the Season of the Dragon[/b]
Should you complete both the [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC and [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter main story, you unlock a series of bonus Season of the Dragon quests that conclude the epic year-long story once and for all. The great Dragon Kaalgrontiid was not destroyed during the events of [i]Elsweyr[/i], only delayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7d0afc80360261bc8ddc40bd5958bc8580f6c456.jpg[/img]
[i]Kaalgrontiid returns in fury[/i]

You need all of your might and the help of your most-powerful allies to put a stop to the Dragon’s plans before he can change the face of Tamriel forever.

As you venture into Southern Elsweyr, complete quests, and face the Dragon menace, you earn powerful new gear (including three new zone sets and three crafted sets), complete new achievements, and gather unique collectibles including new pets, furnishings, outfit styles, and more. Pellitine’s hidden riches await!

[h1]Purchase Details[/h1]
The [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC).

Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

[b]Dragonhold Collector’s Bundle[/b]
The [i]Dragonhold Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Legendary Dragon Horse mount, the Legendary Dragon Wolf pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Dragonhold Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f6d67ceca41c8d2fb433986230fb159128ac89f4.jpg[/img]
[i]The Dragonhold Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h1]Explore Southern Elsweyr & Get a Free Hat[/h1]
Once you have access to the [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC, you can begin your journey into Southern Elsweyr by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly to Senchal from your map[/*][*]By using the DLC tab of the Collections menu and accepting the "The Dragon’s Lair" quest from the Zone DLC section[/*][/list]
Once you set foot in the new zone, you’ll be gifted with the free Topal Corsair Helmet collectible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/67d00772429cb8550b0e679a5d647726e8d8e814.jpg[/img]
[i]Become a Pellitine pirate with this free hat![/i]

[h1]Update 24’s  Performance Improvements[/h1]  
In addition to the DLC game pack, we’ve also launched the Update 24 base-game update. This update features a ton of performance upgrades for the base game that improves the experience for all [i]ESO[/i] players. 
  
[b]Memory Management Overhaul[/b]
This change fundamentally alters memory use in [i]ESO[/i] to reduce fragmentation. What does this mean? It means improved game stability,  resulting in reduced instances of crashing or dashboarding. This change is most notable for those who play on base consoles (Update 24 is coming to Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on November 5), but all should see some improvements. 
  
[b]Behind-the-scenes Combat Ability Improvements (Part 1)[/b]
To lessen server load, the team has been working on  rewriting some of the most consumptive combat abilities. While initially this  change might not appear to have a huge impact, eventually these improvements  will lessen the server load and improve performance during larger combat  engagements. Back to Chalman Keep!
  
[b]Complete Rewrite of the Looking for Group System[/b]
Finally, the team completely rebuilt the Looking for Group system from the ground up, improving the tool’s reliability and speed when queuing for Dungeons and Battlegrounds. This change helps ensure the Group Finder works effectively even when under heavy load. 
  
This is just the start of our proposed improvements to the game’s performance, and if you’d like to keep track of everything we’re doing to make the game run better, check out [url=https://www.web-content.z10.zenimaxonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681/]this article[/url] for monthly updates. 
  
To see everything coming and changing in the [i]Dragonhold[/i] and Update 24 patch, check out our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h1]The Year-Long Story  Ends Here[/h1]  
[i]Dragonhold[/i] brings you the lawless region of Southern Elsweyr to explore, an  amazing storyline to complete, a host of all-new rewards and gear to collect, and the epic conclusion to the Season of the Dragon year-long  adventure. Are you excited to join the new Dragonguard order and finally put a stop to Kaalgrontiid’s plans? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!
  
[i]The Dragonhold DLC game pack is  now live on PC/Mac and is coming November 5 for PlayStation[/i]®[i]4 and Xbox One. It is available free with ESO Plus membership or  purchased with crowns from the in-game Crown Store.[/i]
									      																													  [url=/en-us/news/category/announcements]Announcements[/url]																  [url=/en-us/news/category/dragonhold]Dragonhold[/url]																  [url=/en-us/news/category/update24]Update 24[/url]

notes.title: #SlayDragonsSaveCats in ESO to Help Pet Charities & Earn Amazing Rewards
notes.content:
[i]Help rid Elsweyr of its Dragon problem and support two amazing pet welfare charities during #SlayDragonsSaveCats. Learn everything you need to know about this end-of-year promotion including upcoming in-game events, sweepstakes, and rewards![/i]

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] has its fair share of heroes, both in and outside of the game, and during the #SlayDragonsSaveCats promotion, you and all of Tamriel’s heroes can come together for a great cause by taking part in the following activities:
[list][*]Slay Dragons to help raise money for two great charities: Best Friends Animal Society and FOUR PAWS International.[/*][*]Enter a massive Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes that features multiple drawings and the chance to win amazing prizes.[/*][*]Earn tons of new loot and collectibles with in-game events. [/*][*]Share your stories of triumph and pet care with the [i]ESO[/i] community.[/*][/list]

[h1]Support a Noble Cause[/h1]
We are thrilled to work with GlobalGiving to support [url=https://bestfriends.org]Best Friends Animal Society[/url] and [url=https://www.four-paws.us/]FOUR PAWS[/url]. Want to do your part? Become a Dragon slayer!

The [i]ESO[/i] community has already brought down over a million beasts since [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr [/i]launched in June, but from now until December 9, 2019, for every five Dragons slain, we’ll donate $1 to the cause up to a maximum of $200,000! 

You can find Dragons to defeat in the Northern and Southern Elsweyr zones (accessible via the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter or [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC) or in the [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC dungeon “Lair of Maarselok.” This includes the Dragons in the Sunspire Trial, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/329cfdffbb4992f3ede0297cae5734d9175634db.jpg[/img]			      																																			      						    						      						        
[i]Help protect pets inside the game and out[/i]

Visit the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats website[/url] to see the charity fund progress and donate directly yourself!

[h1]Earn New Rewards during In-game Events[/h1]
Theis period also features[i] [/i]a ton of fun in-game events, bringing new rewards for you and your fellow adventurers. Here’s what’s coming up from now until the end of the year:
[list][*][b]Dragon Rise (10/3-10/13)[/b]—Explore the home of the Khajiit and complete the Northern Elsweyr Pathfinder Achievement to unlock new collectibles for all [i]Elsweyr[/i] owners. Check your progress on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/dragonrise]Dragon Rise website[/url] and find more info in the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/57033/]announcement article[/url].[/*][*][b]Witches Festival (10/24-11/3)[/b]—Tamriel’s grim celebration returns with ghastly quests and spooky new rewards—boo![/*][*][b]Undaunted Celebration (11/14-11/17)[/b]—Take on [i]ESO[/i]’s challenging dungeons to receive reward boxes.[/*][*][b]Dawn of the Dragonguard (11/26-12/8)[/b]—Fell Dragons to earn bonus loot and earn double rewards from the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC, [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC, and [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC.[/*][*][b]New Life Festival[/b] [b](12/19-1/1/2020)[/b]—Celebrate the end of another great year and the beginning of the new one with fun quests and mud balls. Lots of mud balls.[/*][/list]
Each event brings both new and returning rewards, including collectibles such as pets, costumes, styles, and furnishings. During each event, you can also earn Event Tickets, allowing you to purchase the Indrik Feathers and Berries you’ll need to acquire the exclusive Pure-Snow Indrik!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/97411313838ad45d206002dd9ca8759ca9b2a3f4.jpg[/img]	    						      						        																																															      						    						      						        
[i]Unlock this magnificent new Indrik mount [/i]

Even better, each time you acquire Indrik Feathers or Berries with Event Tickets earned via in-game activities (as in, not the ones you can purchase from the Crown Store), you’ll get one bonus entry to the Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes (more on that below), up to a maximum of 10! 

Finally, don’t forget that slaying Dragons helps increase the donation tally on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats website[/url], making the Dragon Rise and Dawn of the Dragonguard events the perfect opportunities to support the cause!

[h1]Enter the Sweepstakes[/h1]
In addition to the charity support and events, you can also win in-game and real-world prizes with our Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes. We’re giving away of ton of amazing loot this year, including [i]ESO[/i] merchandise such as the Horn of Ja'darri drinking horn and in-game rewards such as pets, mounts, or Crown Packs. 

We’ll have multiple prize drawings throughout the next few months, culminating in a final draw for the grand prize: a wall-mounted Kaalgrontiid Dragon Head Trophy! The ultra-talented team at [url=http://www.volpinprops.com]Volpin Props[/url] will craft this amazing real-world furnishing for the grand prize winner, forever celebrating their ultimate victory over the Dragons in Elsweyr.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/54764a5e4a8ff1abef010845b2e4c606c30c4b41.jpg[/img]    						      						        																																																      						    						      						        
[i]There’s tons of in-game items to win and unlock![/i]

To enter the Sweepstakes and find a complete list of prizes, visit the official [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats#sweepstakes]#SlayDragonSaveCats website[/url]. You can also check out the [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Events/SlayDragonsSaveCats/Sweepstakes/Rules/ZeniMax_ESO_Q4_2019_Sweepstakes_Official_Rules_EN.pdf]official rules[/url]. As mentioned above, you can earn up to 10 bonus entries by trading Indrik Feathers and Indrik Berries for Event Tickets, so don’t miss out on your chance to win one of the hundreds of amazing prizes!

[h1]Share Your Stories[/h1]
During the #SlayDragonsSaveCats promotion, we want to hear and share your tales of adventure and personal stories of pet welfare. Have you taken up arms and spells to slay a mighty Dragon solo? Do you have a beloved rescue pet? Do you yourself work with or for animals in need? We’d love to share those experiences with the rest of the [i]ESO[/i] community via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url], so don’t hesitate to send them our way using the #SlayDragonsSaveCats hashtag. 

Finally, we’ll be running a ton of unique real-world events and livestreams during the promotion all over the globe to support the cause. If you’d like to join in on the fun, keep an eye out on our social channels for future announcements!

[h1]Slay Dragons for a Cause[/h1]
During the #SlayDragonsSaveCats promotion, you can help the Khaiiti people rid their homeland of the Dragon menace while also supporting pets in need in real life! Do your part for this great cause and help raise up to $200,000 for Best Friends Animal Society and FOUR PAWS. Remember, there’s also five amazing in-game events to take part in and a massive Sweepstakes competition to enter, too. Phew!

Are you going to take part in [i]ESO[/i]’s end-of-year fun? Let us know via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url], and don’t forget to use the #SlayDragonsSaveCats hashtag!

notes.title: Work Together & Unlock Exclusive Rewards during Dragon Rise
notes.content:
[i]Explore Elsweyr, slay Dragons, and complete the upcoming Dragonhold Prologue quest and you’ll unlock amazing new rewards for all Elsweyr players including collectibles, XP buffs, and more![/i]

[h1]Dragons over Elsweyr[/h1]
The Dragon Rise event kicks off on Thursday, October 3, at 10:00AM EDT and runs until Monday, October 14, at 10:00AM EDT. During the event, there are three exclusive rewards up for grabs:
[list][*]Green Dragon Imp pet [/*][*]Grim Harvester Costume [/*][*]Dragon’s Treasure Trove furnishing [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/d922cd5fdddce69083bb05b98e8e40e63659d63a.jpg[/img]				    						  																																			      						    						      						        			  
[i]A new pet, costume, and furnishing can be unlocked![/i]

The final reward is more than an audacious display of wealth you can place in your home, however. It also features a series of lootable bags  that provide all kinds of amazing items, including a new target dummy. However,  that’s not all, as during Dragon Rise you can also unlock bonus XP and gold acquisition for the whole Northern Elsweyr zone!

To unlock these rewards, all [i]Elsweyr [/i]players must work together to complete different activities and fill the three Dragon Rise meters:
[list][*]Explore Elsweyr and earn the Northern Elsweyr Pathfinder  Achievement to unlock the primary rewards[/*][list][*]Check your in-game Journal for help completing this Achievement[/*][/list][*]Slay Dragons to unlock a zone-wide XP boost (Northern Elsweyr only)[/*][list][*]Since the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter’s release, you’ve already bested over 1 million Dragons, so what’s a few more?[/*][/list][*]Complete the [i]Dragonhold [/i]Prologue quests (from October 8) to unlock a zone-wide gold acquisition boost (Northern Elsweyr only)[/*][/list]
As you complete the different objectives, you can check  everybody’s progress by visiting the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/dragonrise]Dragon Rise page[/url].  If you’ve already unlocked the Northern Elsweyr Pathfinder Achievement, don’t worry, it’ll still count, and you can continue to do your part by participating  in the other two objectives.

In addition to unlocking a zone-wide XP boost, slaying Dragons also help increase the donation amount for the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats  campaign[/url]. Help pets in need while you help yourself to bonus XP—a win-win  scenario!
  
Finally, as you defeat Northern Elsweyr’s Dragons and  bosses, you have a chance to acquire a Nafaalilargus’s Strongbox as a bonus  reward, including items such as crafting materials, style pages, gear sets, and  more!

[h1]Elsweyr Chapter Sale[/h1]  
If you’ve yet to explore the home of the Khajiit, now is the perfect time to grab the Chapter with a 50% sale on all editions of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i], including the [i]Standard Edition[/i], [i]Standard Edition Digital Upgrade[/i], [i]Digital Collector’s Edition[/i], and [i]Digital Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/i].

[i]Elsweyr[/i] brings a massive new zone to explore, the deadly Necromancer Class to master, and continues the year-long Season of the  Dragon adventure.

This sale is live now and lasts only until October 8 (October 16 if on PlayStation®4), so visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url] to get  started.

[h1]Dragonhold Prologue Quests[/h1]  
We are thrilled to announce that the [i]Dragonhold [/i]Prologue quests will be live on Tuesday, October 8, at 10:00AM EDT. Because it’s part of the  base game, you don’t need to have owned or completed any of the previous Chapter or DLCs to check them out. 

In these two new quests, you must assist the returning Sai Sahan explore the lost histories of the Dragonguard in the hopes of acquiring an ancient relic to help turn the tides of battle against the Dragons that  threaten all of Elsweyr.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/718e00d45d722fe7488f9a16ab2dbf8e639f0af1.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        			  
[i]Join forces with  Sai Sahan to find an ancient relic[/i]
 
As you complete the prologue questline, you’ll earn rewards  such as the Dragonhorn Curio memento and Dragonguard Banner furnishing, and as  part of the Dragon Rise event, you’ll be one step closer to unlocking the gold  buff for the Northern Elsweyr zone. By the way, you can get your very own [url=https://gear.bethesda.net/products/the-horn-of-jadarri]Horn of Ja’Darri[/url]  on the Bethesda Gear Store right now!

[h1]Earn Event Tickets[/h1]  
During the Dragon Rise event, all regular monsters in the Northern Elsweyr zone have a rare chance to drop [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]Event  Tickets[/url] when defeated. However, should you slay a boss monster in the same zone, an Event Ticket drop is guaranteed! Don’t forget to loot everything you  defeat. You can earn two Event Tickets this way each day of the event.
 
During the event period, the Impresario will stock the following items:
[list][*]Cadwell style pages[/*][*]Abnur Tharn style pages[/*][*]The Onyx Indrik Pet[/*][*]All four Indrik Feathers[/*][*]All four Onyx Indrik Berries (including the final one, allowing you to summon your Onyx Indrik!)[/*]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/dcce5a5ca47125044101b515438912edc671f6a2.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Onyx Indrik mount[/i]

Finally, every time you spend Event Tickets you’ve earned by doing in-game events (and not purchased directly from the Crown Store), you’ll earn bonus entries into the Season of the Dragon Sweepstakes, up to a maximum of 10! Check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/slaydragonssavecats]#SlayDragonsSaveCats page[/url] for more information on the Sweepstakes and its prizes, and view the [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Events/SlayDragonsSaveCats/Sweepstakes/Rules/ZeniMax_ESO_Q4_2019_Sweepstakes_Official_Rules_EN.pdf]official rules here[/url].

[h1]Explore Elsweyr, Unlock New Rewards![/h1]
As you can see, you have a lot of reasons to explore Northern Elsweyr during the Dragon Rise in-game event, and this is only the start of the #SlayDragonsSaveCats end-of-year promotion! If you’ll be touring the home of the Khajiit and slaying Dragons when the event kicks off this Thursday, let us know via Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Dragon Rise event kicks off on Thursday, October 3, at 10:00AM EDT and runs until Monday, October 14, at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Dragonhold & Update 24 Preview
notes.content:
[i]The Season of the Dragon saga reaches its epic conclusion with Dragonhold, The Elder Scrolls Online’s latest DLC story zone. Learn about this new adventure and all the changes coming with Update 24 in this preview article![/i]

The [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC game pack provides a new zone to explore, a new main questline to complete, new mechanics and challenges to experience, and more. Update 24 is a free game update that arrives alongside the DLC and includes the first wave of our announced performance improvements, Twitch Drops for consoles, and additional fixes and balance changes.

[h1]A Land in Ruins[/h1]
The ancient Khajiiti kingdom known as Pellitine lies in shambles. Devastated by a terrible plague and its purging fire decades ago, Southern Elsweyr devolved into a lawless region beset by slavers, pirates, and brigands. As refugees from the surrounding land slowly make their way to the zone’s capital of Senchal, the city’s few remaining defenders muster for their last stand against the chaos.

However, worse things threaten the people of Pellitine. The Dragons, free from the Halls of Colossus, have brought their rage south. Bolstered by a cult of worshipers known as the Order of the New Moon, they devastate the region and continue their secret schemes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/d94a5ba4cd544d9357da15f0225013a8b7275ecf.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]All manner of rogues thrive in the ruined kingdom[/i]

These challenges and more await those willing to venture into the scorched confines of Southern Elsweyr. Consisting of three unique biomes (including scorched-but-recovering wilds, old-growth forests, and tropical grasslands) and packed with new delves, world bosses, quests, and Dragon hunts, this new zone contains plenty to keep you engaged. 

The odds are stacked against you, but rest assured, the benefits gained by exploring Southern Elsweyr make it all worth it. The [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC boasts more rewards than any previous DLC story zone, including new titles (such as the much-requested “Pirate” title), tons of new collectibles (including a mix of costumes, mementos, and outfit styles), item sets, and more. Pellitine might be in ruins, but untold riches await those who know where to look!
 
[h1]Restore the Dragonguard[/h1]
In the [i]Dragonhold[/i] main questline, you work with fan-favorite character Sai Sahan (returning for this storyline) to gather a rag-tag group of pirates and adventurers and restore the ancient order known as the Dragonguard. Once thought lost to history, this ancient organization of Dragon hunters must return to aid the Khajiit of Elsweyr against the Dragon threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/08984ecd965cb2912a99dd0d45ce6078f17e2d61.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Face the Dragon threat with new and returning allies[/i]

The Redguard swordmaster is not your only companion in this endeavor, however. When you start the zone’s main story, a powerful and famous ally from Elder Scrolls lore joins you. No spoilers, sorry! Together, you and your new allies must seek out the secrets of the lost Dragonguard order and fight against the machinations of the mighty Dragon Laatvulon and his New Moon cultists.

[h1]The Season of the Dragon Finale[/h1]
Dragonhold also brings the year-long Season of the Dragon saga to its epic conclusion. Starting with the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC and continuing with the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter and [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC, the story that began at the start of the year reaches its climax in this final 2019 DLC.

In addition to its typical main-story quest content, Dragonhold features bonus quests that let you and your allies put an end to the machinations of the Dragon Kaalgrontiid (from the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter main story). You delayed the terrible Dragon’s plans in [i]Elsweyr[/i]. Now, in Southern Elsweyr, his schemes must be stopped for good before he can gain the power of the gods! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/837a4cc0f7529f8fc6cdb155adf43e729f574379.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        			  
[i]Kaalgrontiid  returns in fury[/i]
  
To unlock the Season of the Dragon finale quests, you must complete both the [i]Elsweyr[/i] and [i]Dragonhold[/i] main story questlines. You don’t have to complete the stories from this year’s two Dungeon DLCs, but you should if you want to see the whole picture!

[h1]Update 24’s Base-Game Improvements[/h1]  
In addition to the new DLC game pack, we are also launching a massive base-game patch, free to all players, that features the first wave of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56681]previously announced performance improvements[/url]. This first batch of changes includes a memory management overhaul, the first phase of combat ability performance improvements, and a complete redesign of the Looking for Group system. 
  
These changes will reduce the amount of crashes/dashboarding, improve combat responsiveness, and improve the reliability and speed of the Group Finder. We know that the [i]ESO[/i] community has  long requested a performance update, so we are thrilled to launch the first part of what will be a massive, year-long series of improvements with Update 24! 

[h1]Twitch Drops for Consoles[/h1]  
Update 24 also features the introduction of Twitch Drops for console players, allowing you to earn Twitch Drops for your Xbox One or PlayStation®4 account simply by watching Drop-enabled [i]ESO [/i]streams! Note that while this addition is scheduled for Q4 2019, it might not be immediately available upon U24 console launch, so stay tuned for announcements in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1a08222bc3cc4e3aef613c246f2334bfb92aa81e.jpg[/img]
[i]Soon, PlayStation[/i]®[i]4 and Xbox One players will be able to receive Twitch Drops![/i]

[h1]Your Adventure Ends … for Now![/h1]  
With [i]Dragonhold[/i] and Update 24, your incredible year-long adventure reaches its exciting conclusion with an incredible new zone, story, and a host of improvements that’ll keep [i]ESO[/i] going strong  for years to come! It’s time to travel to the scorched lands of Southern Elsweyr, reforge the ancient order of Dragon hunters, and bring hope back to  the people of Pellitine. Keep an eye on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] and our social channels for more information on the DLC and your chance to check it all  out early when it comes to the Public Test Server on Monday, September 16!
  
Are you excited to explore the new zone and finally put an  end to Kaalgrontiid’s schemes? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!
  
[i]Bringing the year-long Season of the Dragon adventure to its stunning conclusion, the Dragonhold DLC game pack is coming soon to PC/Mac, PlayStation[/i]®[i]4, and Xbox One. It will be  available in the in-game Crown Store or free as part of an ESO Plus[/i]™[i] membership. Included with the new DLC will be Update 24, a free base-game update for all ESO players.[/i]

notes.title: Get the Imperial City DLC Free & Earn Bonus Rewards During the Celebration Event
notes.content:
[i]Take the fight to the heart of the Empire during the  Imperial City Celebration Event and you can acquire the DLC game pack free from  the in-game Crown Store while earning bonus rewards![/i]

[h1]Control the Capital [/h1]  
The Imperial Celebration Event begins on Thursday, September  5, at 10:00AM EDT and runs until Monday, September 16, at 10:00AM EDT. 
  
To take part in the “liberation” of the Imperial City, you  must first own the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack or have access to it via  ESO Plus™ membership. Lucky for you, beginning in tandem with the event, this  DLC game pack will be [b]completely free[/b]! That’s right, from now on (and  for the foreseeable future), you can acquire the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game  pack for zero crowns from the DLC section of the Crown Store. This includes  access to the Imperial City zone and story, including the sewers, city  districts, and both the White-Gold Tower and Imperial City Prison dungeons.
  
In addition to this, we’re also putting the [i]Imperial City  Collector’s Bundle[/i] on sale in the in-game Crown Store for 3,000 crowns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/35656d703ebd8cbb19e575a4a2af689413279e22.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]The Imperial City Collector’s Bundle[/i]

The [i]Imperial City[/i] [i]Collector’s Bundle[/i] includes the Mind-Shriven Horse mount, the Mind-Shriven skin, the Daedrat pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls in addition to the DLC game pack itself. 

To enter the city, open your Alliance War menu, select the Imperial City category, choose either a Champion Point or non-Champion Point server, and select “Enter Campaign.”

[h1]Loot the Imperial City [/h1]
As you explore, quest, and battle throughout the Imperial City, you’ll earn bonus rewards for many of the DLC’s activities, including:
[list][*]Double the amount of Tel Var Stones dropped from all monsters[/*][*]Double the chance of picking up either the Stonefire Scamp pet or the Soul-Shriven skin[/*][*]Double the amount of Key Fragments[/*][*]Double the amount of materials dropped by Trove Scamps[/*][*]Double Tel Var Stones from sacks obtained from Cunning Scamps[/*][*]Double the amount of drops from bosses (including within the Imperial City itself and its dungeons)[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3561d8c0b4d9cd919c978a23e08193c861be5609.jpg[/img]						      						    						      						        																																					      						    						      						        
[i]Free the capital from the Daedric influence and earn bonus rewards[/i]

You can earn these rewards by participating in all aspects of the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC, including the sewers, city districts, and dungeons.

[h1]Acquire Event Tickets[/h1]
During the Imperial City Celebration Event, you can earn new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/eventtickets]Event Tickets[/url] by completing the following activities: 
[list][*]Defeating the final boss of either the Imperial City Prison dungeon or White-Gold Tower dungeon[/*][/list]
[b]OR[/b]
[list][*]Slaying a patrolling monster in the Imperial City streets or mini-boss within the Imperial City sewers. [/*][/list]
When completing one of the above activities, you’ll earn two Event Tickets per day. The Imperial City Celebration Event is your first opportunity to acquire the [b]Onyx Berries of Growth[/b] for 10 Event Tickets from the Impresario vendor. When you combine this berry with the other three from the other Q3 events (one still to be announced!), you can evolve your Nascent Indrik mount into the Onyx Indrik.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/dcce5a5ca47125044101b515438912edc671f6a2.jpg[/img]				    						      						      																																			      						    						      						        
[i]The majestic Onyx Indrik mount[/i]

In addition to Indrik berries and feathers, the Impresario will also trade the following items for Event Tickets:
[list][*]A selection of Imperial- and Daedric-themed Furnishings[/*][*]The Stonefire Scamp pet[/*][*]The Soul-Shriven skin[/*][/list]

[h1]Fight in the Shadow of the White-Gold Tower[/h1]
Besieged by monstrous Daedra and under constant assault from the three Alliances, now is the time to storm the Imperial City and make your claim to the Ruby Throne. Don’t forget, once the event begins on Thursday, September 5, the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC will be free in the in-game Crown Store! Are you planning to invade the capital during the upcoming Celebration Event? Let us know on @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
