notes.title: Scalebreaker DLC Game Pack & Update 23 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Continue your Season of the Dragon adventure with Scalebreaker, a new dungeon DLC pack for The Elder Scrolls Online. Discover two new stories that tie into the events of ESO: Elsweyr and the free Update 23 base-game patch.[/i]

The [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC dungeon pack and Update 23 bring exciting new adventures and improvements to [i]ESO[/i]:
[list][*]Two new Season of the Dragon dungeons: Lair of Maarselok and Moongrave Fane[/*][*]Eight new item sets and five new collectibles[/*][*]Update to Undaunted Keys[/*][*]Guild Trader multi-bidding[/*][*]Multi-crafting[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]purchase with crowns[/url] from the in-game Crown Store. You can read the patch notes for both [i]Scalebreaker[/i] and Update 23 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h1]Scalebreaker DLC Game Pack[/h1]
The [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC game pack brings two new Season of the Dragon dungeons, expanding upon the events of both [i]Wrathstone[/i] and [i]Elsweyr[/i]. The Dragons are free from the Halls of Colossus, and now you must deal with the fallout of their release. While these stories are part of the year-long saga, you can enjoy both without having completed either of the year’s earlier content—enjoy!

[b]Lair of Maarselok[/b]
For centuries, Maarselok slept deep in the mountains between Elsweyr and Grahtwood. However, upon the opening of the Halls of Colossus, this monstrous Dragon has awoken, and now threatens to spread his corruption into the domain of the Wood Elves. Only with the help of the Warlock Carindon and the forest spirit Selene can you defeat this terrifying new Dragon!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/fb64c5276c7a8b2d3bed5b3c666e465966294b28.jpg[/img]  																																																															      						    						      						        
[i]Hunt the great Dragon Maarselok![/i]

[b]Moongrave Fane[/b]
Hidden within a fallen Khajiiti temple, the vampires of the Hollowfang prepare to perform a terrible ritual. Joined by the former Dragonguard Grundwulf, they wish to drain the blood from a captured Dragon! You and your team must fight your way into the fallen ruin and put a stop to their plan before it’s too late. 

Both dungeons can be attempted in Normal and Veteran difficulties, with a Veteran Hard Mode option available for those looking for a challenge. Brave delvers can discover new rewards up for grabs in both dungeons, too, including new item sets, Achievements, collectibles, and more. 

Finally, you can also earn a unique tablet collectible by completing both dungeons (on Normal or Veteran difficulty), allowing you to unlock an additional wing within the Hall of the Lunar Champion home. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/544e7b0f217ca64ed064db9bbfd0cb41d21c10be.jpg[/img]   						    						      																																							      						    						      						        
[i]Expand your mansion![/i]

Don’t forget, you can unlock the free Hall of the Lunar Champion home by completing the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter’s main story quest titled “Two Queens.” The third and final tablet required to completely unlock the mansion will be available with the upcoming [i]Dragonhold[/i] DLC—stay tuned!

For more information on [i]Scalebreaker[/i]’s dungeons, check out our previews of both the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56765]Lair of Maarselok[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56655]Moongrave Fane[/url]. 

[h1]Purchase Details[/h1]
The [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC).

Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC dungeons until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

[b]Scalebreaker Collector’s Bundle[/b]
The [i]Scalebreaker Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Ancient Dragon Hunter Horse mount, the Ancient Dragon Hunter Wolf pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Scalebreaker Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/68ce14f6a764b06420eb827a25923752bea3ab0f.jpg[/img]     						        																																																															      						    						      						        [i]The Scalebreaker Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h1]Enter a Scalebreaker Dungeon and Get a Free Hat[/h1]
After you gain access to the [i]Scalebreaker[/i] dungeons, you can explore the Lair of Maarselok or Moongrave Fane by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances in the Grahtwood (Lair of Maarselok) and Northern Elsweyr (Moongrave Fane)[/*][/list]
Upon entering one of the two new dungeons, you shall receive a Dread-Aurelian Mask, completely free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6141e752103205d51e1e6f83106c894ebfcb73f3.jpg[/img]																	      						    						      						        
[i]The Dread-Aurelian Mask[/i]

To get the accompanying shoulders, you need to complete both dungeons on Veteran difficulty—good luck!

[h1]Update 23 Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h1]
In addition to the DLC game pack, we’ve also launched Update 23, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players. This update brings a host of fixes, ability changes, and improvements to some of the game’s core elements, including crafting, Guild Traders, and the Undaunted. 

[b]Undaunted Keys and Merchants[/b]
With Update 23, Undaunted Keys are now a currency and are no longer stored within your inventory, making them easier to manage. In addition to this, you can now trade your Undaunted Keys to the three Undaunted dungeon quest givers to receive reward coffers. If you choose, you can spend more keys on specific coffers that give you a better chance at receiving the monster shoulders you want.

[b]Multi-Crafting[/b]
This update also implements an improvement to the crafting system, allowing you to craft, deconstruct, extract, and refine multiple items at once. You no longer have to perform these actions individually, dramatically speeding up the process.

[b]Guild Trader Multi-Bidding[/b]
Finally, Update 23 also introduces multi-bidding for Guild Trader locations. Guild Leaders can now bid on more than one trader each week. This change reduces the chance of missing a Guild Trader location each week and allows you to assign priority to the different locations based on how much you bid on each one. Don’t worry, when you win a location, all other bids are refunded. 

You can find more information on all of these new quality-of-life improvements in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56683]preview article[/url]. 

[h1]Dragons in Tamriel[/h1]
The Season of the Dragon continues with the [i]Scalebreaker[/i] DLC game pack, as Tamriel reels from the opening of the Halls of Colossus. Are you ready and willing to enter Moongrave Fane or the Lair of Maarselok to deal with the threats within? New stories await! Let us know if you’ll be jumping into the two new dungeons or checking out the Update 23 improvements on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

[i]The Scalebreaker DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and is coming August 27 for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. It is available free with ESO Plus membership or purchased with crowns from the in-game Crown Store.[/i]

notes.title: Earn All-New Rewards During the Orsinium Celebration Event
notes.content:
[i]Venture into the snow-capped mountains of Wrothgar during the Orsinium Celebration Event for bonus rewards in the zone and Maelstrom Arena.[/i]
  
The Orsinium Celebration Event will kick off from Thursday, August 8, at 10:00AM EDT and run until Monday, August 19, at 10:00AM EDT. During this time, you can buy the [i]Orsinium[/i] DLC game pack on sale and  enjoy bonus and new rewards while exploring the home of the Orcs!

[h1]Pick Up Orsinium DLC Game Pack on Sale[/h1]  
Starting this Thursday, you can pick up the [i]Orsinium[/i] DLC game pack at a hefty 60% discount. The DLC game pack includes access to the Wrothgar zone and story as well as the Maelstrom Arena. Additionally, you can  pick up the Pariah’s Pinnacle home (both furnished and unfurnished) at a  discount! 
  
If you’re an ESO Plus[b]™[/b] member, you can acquire the [i]Orsinium Collector’s Bundle[/i] at 60% off. This bundle includes the DLC game pack in addition to the Cave Bear mount, a Cave Bear Cub pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls—ideal companions and equipment for your adventures into Wrogthar’s perilous steppes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c0756e4885336e36bd4fa1e001b9cae1a76fb106.jpg[/img]																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Orsinium Collector’s Bundle[/i]

ESO Plus members can also take advantage of a special deal on the Malacath furnishing bundle, Summit Lord’s Silken Robes costume, and Craglorn Welwa pet. 

All of these deals are available from the event’s start on August 8 until its end on August 19, so don’t miss out!

[h1]Earn New Rewards[/h1]
During the event, you can earn the following bonus rewards when adventuring in Wrothgar:
[list][*]Double items harvested from crafting nodes[/*][list][*]Including Jewelry seams, but not including nodes spawned from Survey Reports[/*][/list][*]Double the rewards received from chests in Maelstrom Arena for both Veteran and Normal difficulties[/*][list][*]Including Transmute Crystals and Maelstrom weapons![/*][/list][*]Double the number of reward boxes received by completing Wrothgar's daily quest[/*][/list]
We’ve also added some new rewards exclusive to this event: Maelstrom Weapon Outfit Styles and Orsinium Furnishings.

[b]Maelstrom Weapon Outfit Styles[/b]
Throughout the event, when you complete a run through the Maelstrom Arena, you have a chance to receive a Maelstrom Weapon Outfit Style page. Should you complete the arena on Veteran difficulty, you are guaranteed a page! If you haven’t yet conquered [i]ESO[/i]’s toughest solo challenge, consider this, in addition to the double Malestrom weapon rewards, the perfect opportunity to finally give it a go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e05942ab70f0097a8f7fcde7eee25334e0c17aa3.jpg[/img]	      						        																																																													      						    						      						        
[i]The Maelstrom Weapon Style in action![/i]

When earned by completing the arena, the pages can be traded or sold, but the Impresario also stocks account-bound pages for five Event Tickets each, too. 

[b]Orsinium Furnishings[/b]
For this event only, a select group of Orc-themed Furnishings (note: not recipes) are available at the Impresario, with prices varying between one or two Event Tickets each.

[h1]Get Event Tickets[/h1]
The Orsinium Celebration Event also provides you with an opportunity to earn Event Tickets. During the event, you can earn Event Tickets for the following activities:
[list][*]Two Event Tickets per day for completing any Wrothgar Delve Daily[/*][/list]
[b]OR[/b]
[list][*]Two Event Tickets per day for completing any Wrothgar World Boss Daily[/*][/list]
Note that you can earn only two tickets per day, meaning how you earn both tickets is up to you! You can earn up to 24 total tickets during this event. 

This event is also your first opportunity to earn the [i]Onyx Berries of Bloom[/i] by purchasing them from the Impresario for 10 tickets. These berries, when combined with the three berries from the other Q3 events (some yet to be announced), eventually allow you to evolve your Nascent Indrik into the mysterious Onyx Indrik.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/dcce5a5ca47125044101b515438912edc671f6a2.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Earn the next set of berries needed to unlock this mount![/i]

As usual, the Impresario continues to allow you to purchase all four Indrik Feathers for 10 Event Tickets each in addition to the last event’s berries (Onyx Berries of Budding), and Event Tickets are also available for purchase from the in-game Crown Store. 

[h1]Return to the Home of the Orcs[/h1]
With the Orsinium Celebration Event, now is the perfect time to once again venture into the realm of Wrothgar and the ancestral home of the Orcs. Don’t forget, if you’ve yet to experience this fan-favorite zone and storyline, you can enjoy great deals on the [i]Orsinium[/i] DLC game pack and the [i]Collector’s Bundle[/i] (ESO Plus members only) in the Crown Store, too!

Are you ready to return to this ancient, war-torn land? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Begin Your Life of Crime with the Return of the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration Event!
notes.content:
[i]Commit crimes in the name of the Dark Brotherhood or Thieves Guild during our celebration event and you’ll earn bonus rewards.[/i]

[h1]Steal & Slay for Bonus Rewards[/h1]
The Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration Event returns this Tuesday, July 2, at 10:00AM EDT and runs until Monday, July 15, at 10:00AM EDT. Throughout the event, you can earn the following bonus rewards for certain criminal activities in both Hew's Bane and the Gold Coast:
[list][*]Double reward drops for defeating World Bosses[/*][*]Double reward drops for defeating Delve bosses[/*][*]Double rewards for Gold Coast Delve and World Boss dailies[/*][*]Double Defiled Whiskers drops from Maw of Lorkhaj bosses[/*][*]Increased rewards for completing Heists[/*][*]Increased rewards for completing Sacraments[/*][*]Double harvesting resources from regular crafting nodes (not nodes from Survey Reports)[/*][/list]
Note that the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] and [i]Dark Brotherhood [/i]repeatable quests (the ones you get from the Tip Board or “Marked for Death” ledger) do not have bonus rewards during the event period.

[h1]Criminal Companions[/h1]
Throughout this event, you can acquire both the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] and [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] DLC game packs at a discount, with both available in the in-game Crown Store for 800 crowns. 

In addition to the base DLC game packs, ESO Plus members can acquire the [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] Collector’s Bundle and the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] Collector’s Bundle for 1,600 crowns each. 
									      						    						      						        																																																												      						    						      						        			
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/9365f3cd1a9ce3fa91bb12ee8ed82c1c417ececd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ed3f05514e1abffaf827c4fb1c68d04f0d1e1fee.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/af7f80ba2a823d991b9c0bac933040abc2c3521f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7f5103748d6451950858730b2788ec96db597c4c.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]The Dark Brotherhood and Thieves Guild Collector’s Bundles[/i]

The [i]Thieves Guild[/i] Collector's Bundle includes the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC game pack, the Hammerfell Camel mount, the Kindlespit Dragon Frog pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. The [i]Dark Brotherhood [/i]Collector's Bundle includes the DLC game pack, Highland Wolf mount, the Sylvan Nixad pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. 

Finally, we’re also putting a collection of [i]Thieves Guild[/i]- and [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i]-themed personalities and costumes on sale for the duration of the event—don’t miss out! 

[h1]Snatch Up Event Tickets[/h1]
This celebration is also your first opportunity to earn Event Tickets this quarter in addition to being your first chance to acquire the Berries you need for an all-new Indrik evolution: the Onyx Indrik. 

As you participate in the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration, you can earn Event Tickets for the following activities:
[list][*]One Event Ticket for the first Sacrament completed each day[/*][list][*]Sacraments are unlocked by reaching Dark Brotherhood Rank 2 and completing the quest “A Lesson in Silence”[/*][/list][/list][list][*]One Event Ticket for the first Heist completed each day[/*][list][*]Heists are unlocked by reaching Thieves Guild Rank 3 and completing the quest “The Long Game”[/*][/list][/list]
Note that you can earn only two tickets per day per account, and they’ll reset at 1:00AM EDT each morning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/dcce5a5ca47125044101b515438912edc671f6a2.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Summon the shadowy Onyx Indrik[/i]

Once you have acquired 10 Event Tickets, you can trade them in to the Impresario (located at a special booth in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon) for either an Indrik Feather or the new [b]Onyx Berries of Bloom[/b]. You can acquire 28 Event Tickets during this event, and the Impresario will continue to sell all Feathers throughout, meaning if you’re still working on getting your Nascent Indrik, you have a chance to catch up! For more information on acquiring the Indrik Berries, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]announcement article[/url].

[h1]Gather Your Crew[/h1]
With the return of the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration, there’s never been a better time to begin your life of crime! Let us know if you’re ready to sneak, steal, and stab your way to the top on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration event begins on Tuesday, July 2, at 10:00AM EDT and will end on Monday, July 15, at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Receive an Epic Khajiiti Statue When You Gift Furnishings This Month
notes.content:
[i]Gift furnishings to friends and Guildmates to receive an exclusive Senche-raht statue![/i]

There’s nothing like a fully decorated home to lift your spirits after a long day’s adventuring in Tamriel. In fact, your home can serve many different purposes, including crafting hub, storage location, training arena, and of course, a hearth to socialize and relax.

A good home is important, so starting today and continuing until August 1, you can help your friends and Guildmates decorate their abodes by gifting fabulous furnishings via the in-game Housing Editor or [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore/category/62]Furniture section[/url] of the Crown Store. Gift a total of at least 1,000 Crowns worth of furnishings, split across at least two different individual accounts, and you’ll receive the Senche-raht Statue, Battle-Bound as a unique collectible reward!

To ensure you qualify for the reward, here’s what you need to know:
[list][*]Gifting must occur between 2:00AM EDT today June 24, 2019, and 2:00AM EDT on August 1, 2019.[/*][*]You must send a furnishings gift to at least two different individual accounts via the Housing Editor or the Furniture section of the Crown Store.[/*][*]The total value of all gifts must be at least 1,000 Crowns or more on the same platform and region.[/*][list][*]Note: NOT 1,000 Crowns per gift, but 1,000 Crowns total. Two individual gifts that are valued at 500 Crowns each would count, as would three gifts each valued at 400 Crowns to three different acounts. However, if you sent a gift worth 500 Crowns on the PC NA server and another worth 500 Crowns on the Xbox One NA server, it would not count. [/*][/list][*]You will receive your Senche-raht statue collectible by August 16, 2019[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1ddd2f90fe39a6ac49b73e81e63776e089375fd9.jpg[/img]																													      						    						      						        			
[i]Perfect for guarding the entrance to your home[/i]

[h1]Gifting Housing Editor Items[/h1]  
You can find furnishings (and bundles!) in the Furniture  section of the in-game Crown Store, and you can also gift individual items from  a massive selection by using the Housing Editor. To gift a furnishing item from  the Housing Editor, follow the instructions below:
[list][*]Travel  to a house and open the Housing Editor. [/*][*]Select  Browse to open the Housing menu and then select the Purchase tab.[/*][*]Look  for the item you wish to gift and select it.[/*][*]Select  the Gift option from the preview window.[/*][*]Enter  your recipients UserID, Gamertag, or PSN ID, depending on your platform, and personalize  your gift with a custom-made or a pre-selected message.[/*][/list]
That’s it! All you need to do is gift 1,000 Crowns worth of  items total to two or more friends and you’ll be eligible to receive the  statue. 
  
In addition to the massive selection of items and bundles  already available, we’ve also adding a new, limited-time bundle to the Crown  Store: The Intrepid Gourmet Furnishing Pack. You can pick up or gift this  bundle for only 700 Crowns, but be quick: it’ll be available only from now until July 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b03cea355490325dc7d79233aa68beb25dcfc2e7.jpg[/img]																						      						    						      						        
[i]The Intrepid Gourmet Furnishing Pack[/i]

This promotion has already begun and will run until August 1, 2019, at 2:00AM EDT. If you’re interested in acquiring this amazing statue, or simply want to help your friend make their house a home, don’t miss out on this special offer!

Are you planning to send some furnishings to your friends? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr & Update 22 Now Live on All Platforms
notes.content:
[i]Continue your Season of the Dragon adventure with Elsweyr, the latest Chapter in the Elder Scrolls Online saga! Discover the new zone, story, and Necromancer class in addition to a massive free base-game update.[/i]

We are thrilled to announce that The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr and Update 22 are both now live for all platforms, including PC/Mac, PlayStation®4, and Xbox One. This Chapter and free base-game update brings an exciting world to explore, captivating stories to experience, and a brand-new class to master. 

https://youtu.be/1oPeOjvn9gQ
									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        [h1]Elsweyr Chapter[/h1]
Dragons stalk the skies over Elsweyr, and the Khajiit struggle to defend their homeland from both invading Imperials and the monstrous beasts. While featuring a strong stand-alone story in its own right, [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] continues the Season of the Dragon adventure that started with the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC and continues throughout the rest of the year’s updates.

This new Chapter includes:
[list][*]A zone to explore: Elsweyr[/*][*]A story detailing the efforts to protect the Khajiiti homeland from the Dragons[/*][*] A class to master: the Necromancer[/*][*]A 12-player Trial: Sunspire[/*][*]A massive collection of side quests and stunning locations to explore[/*][*]Item sets, collectibles, and more[/*][/list]
[b]Explore a New Zone[/b]
In the northern region of Elsweyr known as Anequina, discover a world made up of dusty canyons, fertile moon-sugar fields, tepid rainforests, and bone-dry grasslands. Within this diverse environment, you can experience the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56101]home of the Khajiit[/url] and discover the remnants of their ancient culture.

https://youtu.be/BlBBUmWFDkU
								      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      						    						      						        
Anequina is not without its dangers, however, and in this zone, you encounter new World Bosses, Public Dungeons, and Delves scattered throughout the landscape, in addition to a host of side quests to complete and amazing locations to explore. 

[b]Save the Khajiit[/b]
The great northern city of Rimmen now lies under the control of the Usurper Queen Euraxia, and Elsweyr’s scattered defenders struggle to contend with her Euraxian legions and ever-growing undead army. To make matters worse, Dragons roam the skies above Elsweyr, forming a troubling alliance with the Usurper Queen. 

In this epic story, you must work with both local and foreign allies to remove Euraxia from her seat of power and break her hold over Elsweyr. Of course, your journey does not end here, as this story is part of the year-long Season of the Dragon adventure, continuing throughout the rest of 2019! 

[b]Become a Necromancer[/b]
Manipulate the souls of the dead to empower yourself and your allies with the Necromancer, [i]ESO[/i]’s first new class since [i]ESO: Morrowind[/i]. With the Necromancer, you have access to three unique Skill Lines that allow you to assault your enemies, bolster your defense, and heal your allies.

https://youtu.be/Nlc7FjDJTEY

To boost the power of your abilities. But be wary, necromancy is [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56159]largely forbidden in Tamriel[/url], and should you openly practice the dark arts, you might attract the attention of the less-enlightened. 

[b]Fell Monstrous Dragons[/b]
With the Halls of Colossus opened, Dragons strike from above. Overwhelming the region’s scattered defenders, these legendary monsters threaten to burn down the ancestral home of the Khajiit. When exploring Elsweyr, you can encounter Dragons in world events called Dragon Hunts, within the zone’s Trial called Sunspire, and throughout the [i]Elsweyr[/i] main story, as well. 
									      						    						      						        																																				      						    						      						        
Be warned: You’re no Dovahkiin, and to defeat a Dragon in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], you must gather your most powerful allies and strike as one!

[b]Free Sunspire[/b]
Three Dragons, one claiming to be the avatar of Alkosh himself, have occupied the great Temple of the First Cat. In this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56237]new 12-player Trial[/url], you and your team must fight your way through the Dragons’ disciples and put a stop to the false gods’ plans. Challenging boss fights and unique rewards await those brave enough to stand up to the golden Dragon, Nahvintaas. 

[h1]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h1]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] is available in multiple editions, including a Standard Edition, Collector's Editions, and Upgrade Editions for those who already own the [i]ESO[/i] base game. Note that to run [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i], your machine needs to meet the game's requirements for [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0000_pc%20en.jpg]PC[/url] or [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0001_mac%20en.jpg]Mac[/url].

In addition to the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Digital Collector's Edition[/i] and [i]Digital Collector's Edition Upgrade[/i] includes a host of unique digital items, including a mount, pet, outfit style, and more.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/01/d2e684b19fca6218912291763c667b32.png]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/01/d2e684b19fca6218912291763c667b32.png[/img]																[/url]	
																																			      						    						      						        
Finally, if you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] by June 4, you’ll also receive additional bonus items, including a costume, pet, XP scrolls, treasure maps, a Baandari Pedlar Crown Crate, and Rahd-m’Athra mount!

For more information on the [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] editions and pre-purchase items, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55537][i]Elsweyr [/i]editions and pre-purchase rewards article[/url]. It's not too late to pre-purchase [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]ESO: Elsweyr [/i]now[/url] and receive the above bonus items, even if you're on PC/Mac!

[h1]Traveling to Elsweyr[/h1]
Once you purchase [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i], there’s a few ways you can travel to and begin your adventures in the ancestral home of the Khajiit. You can explore Elsweyr with an existing character or a new one, and there’s no level requirements for this new zone and adventure.

[b]Wayshrine Travel[/b]
Easy! You can instantly travel to Elsweyr with any of your existing characters by using the Rimmen Wayshrine. To do so, open your map, select the Elsweyr zone, and then select the Wayshrine icon (it should be the only one available).

[b]Start from the Main Quest[/b]
You can pick up the first quest before even reaching Elsweyr by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From that menu, you can select Elsweyr, acquire the first quest titled “A Rage of Dragons," and begin your adventure. It will point you in the right direction.

[b]New Characters[/b]
Any new characters created in [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] can go through the new tutorial. Once complete, you enter the new zone. A world of adventure awaits!

[h1]Update 22[/h1]
In addition to the new Chapter, we have also released Update 22, a new base-game patch that brings a host of new features, changes, and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players (no Chapter purchase needed). 

[b]Guild Finder System[/b]
With Update 22, we have added a new Guild Finder tool to help you both join a Guild and find new members for one. As a Guild leader, you can use the Guild Finder to advertise your Guild based on its unique characteristics and what kind of players you’re looking for. If you’re looking for a Guild to join, you can browse open Guilds and filter your search to find one based on your specific needs.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/b2e3ded1a3e3dba04abbc4e6d321b9f8.jpg]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/b2e3ded1a3e3dba04abbc4e6d321b9f8.jpg[/img]																[/url]	

[i]Set your Guild Listing and choose from many options[/i]

You can filter Guilds by activities (such as PvP, Trials, Trading, or Roleplaying, and much more) and by play style (casual, balanced, or hard-core). Guilds can even set specific Alliances, Champion Point requirements, or roles. With this new system, Guilds can easily find like-minded players to join their ranks!

[b]Weapons Artifacts Come to Cyrodiil[/b]
If you’re a veteran of the Alliance War, Update 22 introduces a system that is sure to shake up Cyrodiil: Weapon Artifacts. Now, at random points during an ongoing Alliance War campaign (about four to five times a day), a powerful weapon will spawn in the PvP zone. The first warrior to reach the Weapon Artifact and use it gains a deadly new Skill Line.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/ae84fe438c51e3f9df9ef251bb1c7417.jpg]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/ae84fe438c51e3f9df9ef251bb1c7417.jpg[/img]																[/url]	

[i]Wield the mighty Volendrung[/i]

These new abilities come at a cost, however, because if you don’t continually earn Alliance Points, it’ll slowly drain your life away! You can find a tutorial for the first Weapon Artifact, called Volendrung, in each Alliance starter gate (near the quest boards). 

[b]Summerset Moves to the Crown Store[/b]
As of today, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Digital Upgrade[/i] and [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Digital Collector’s Edition[/i] will no longer be available in The Elder Scrolls Online Store and on Steam Store. Instead, the [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter is being added to the in-game Crown Store as a DLC item. This means that if you are an ESO Plus member, you’ll now automatically have access to the [i]Summerset [/i]zone and story. 

In addition to this, we’re adding a separate Summerset Collector’s Bundle to the in-game Crown Store that includes pre-purchase and Collector’s Edition bonus items. 

[h1]The Season of the Dragon Continues[/h1]
Elsweyr burns as the Season of the Dragon heats up with this newest Chapter in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online [/i]saga. The Usurper Queen and her army of the undead threatens the people of Elsweyr, and a rage of Dragons brings ruin from above. Warriors are needed to help defend the ancestral home of the Khajiit, and dark new powers await those who heed the call. Are you excited to enter Elsweyr and master the necromantic arts? Tell us on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr and Update 22 is now [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]live on all platforms.[/url][/i]

[b]Explore a New Zone[/b]
In the northern region of Elsweyr known as Anequina, discover a world made up of dusty canyons, fertile moon-sugar fields, tepid rainforests, and bone-dry grasslands. Within this diverse environment, you can experience the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56101]home of the Khajiit[/url] and discover the remnants of their ancient culture.

https://youtu.be/BlBBUmWFDkU
								      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      						    						      						        
Anequina is not without its dangers, however, and in this zone, you encounter new World Bosses, Public Dungeons, and Delves scattered throughout the landscape, in addition to a host of side quests to complete and amazing locations to explore. 

[b]Save the Khajiit[/b]
The great northern city of Rimmen now lies under the control of the Usurper Queen Euraxia, and Elsweyr’s scattered defenders struggle to contend with her Euraxian legions and ever-growing undead army. To make matters worse, Dragons roam the skies above Elsweyr, forming a troubling alliance with the Usurper Queen. 

In this epic story, you must work with both local and foreign allies to remove Euraxia from her seat of power and break her hold over Elsweyr. Of course, your journey does not end here, as this story is part of the year-long Season of the Dragon adventure, continuing throughout the rest of 2019! 

[b]Become a Necromancer[/b]
Manipulate the souls of the dead to empower yourself and your allies with the Necromancer, [i]ESO[/i]’s first new class since [i]ESO: Morrowind[/i]. With the Necromancer, you have access to three unique Skill Lines that allow you to assault your enemies, bolster your defense, and heal your allies.

https://youtu.be/Nlc7FjDJTEY

To boost the power of your abilities. But be wary, necromancy is [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56159]largely forbidden in Tamriel[/url], and should you openly practice the dark arts, you might attract the attention of the less-enlightened. 

[b]Fell Monstrous Dragons[/b]
With the Halls of Colossus opened, Dragons strike from above. Overwhelming the region’s scattered defenders, these legendary monsters threaten to burn down the ancestral home of the Khajiit. When exploring Elsweyr, you can encounter Dragons in world events called Dragon Hunts, within the zone’s Trial called Sunspire, and throughout the [i]Elsweyr[/i] main story, as well. 
									      						    						      						        																																				      						    						      						        
Be warned: You’re no Dovahkiin, and to defeat a Dragon in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], you must gather your most powerful allies and strike as one!

[b]Free Sunspire[/b]
Three Dragons, one claiming to be the avatar of Alkosh himself, have occupied the great Temple of the First Cat. In this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/56237]new 12-player Trial[/url], you and your team must fight your way through the Dragons’ disciples and put a stop to the false gods’ plans. Challenging boss fights and unique rewards await those brave enough to stand up to the golden Dragon, Nahvintaas. 

[h1]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h1]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] is available in multiple editions, including a Standard Edition, Collector's Editions, and Upgrade Editions for those who already own the [i]ESO[/i] base game. Note that to run [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i], your machine needs to meet the game's requirements for [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0000_pc%20en.jpg]PC[/url] or [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0001_mac%20en.jpg]Mac[/url].

In addition to the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Digital Collector's Edition[/i] and [i]Digital Collector's Edition Upgrade[/i] includes a host of unique digital items, including a mount, pet, outfit style, and more.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/01/d2e684b19fca6218912291763c667b32.png]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/01/d2e684b19fca6218912291763c667b32.png[/img]																[/url]	
																																			      						    						      						        
Finally, if you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] by June 4, you’ll also receive additional bonus items, including a costume, pet, XP scrolls, treasure maps, a Baandari Pedlar Crown Crate, and Rahd-m’Athra mount!

For more information on the [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] editions and pre-purchase items, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55537][i]Elsweyr [/i]editions and pre-purchase rewards article[/url]. It's not too late to pre-purchase [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]ESO: Elsweyr [/i]now[/url] and receive the above bonus items, even if you're on PC/Mac!

[h1]Traveling to Elsweyr[/h1]
Once you purchase [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i], there’s a few ways you can travel to and begin your adventures in the ancestral home of the Khajiit. You can explore Elsweyr with an existing character or a new one, and there’s no level requirements for this new zone and adventure.

[b]Wayshrine Travel[/b]
Easy! You can instantly travel to Elsweyr with any of your existing characters by using the Rimmen Wayshrine. To do so, open your map, select the Elsweyr zone, and then select the Wayshrine icon (it should be the only one available).

[b]Start from the Main Quest[/b]
You can pick up the first quest before even reaching Elsweyr by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From that menu, you can select Elsweyr, acquire the first quest titled “A Rage of Dragons," and begin your adventure. It will point you in the right direction.

[b]New Characters[/b]
Any new characters created in [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] can go through the new tutorial. Once complete, you enter the new zone. A world of adventure awaits!

[h1]Update 22[/h1]
In addition to the new Chapter, we have also released Update 22, a new base-game patch that brings a host of new features, changes, and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players (no Chapter purchase needed). 

[b]Guild Finder System[/b]
With Update 22, we have added a new Guild Finder tool to help you both join a Guild and find new members for one. As a Guild leader, you can use the Guild Finder to advertise your Guild based on its unique characteristics and what kind of players you’re looking for. If you’re looking for a Guild to join, you can browse open Guilds and filter your search to find one based on your specific needs.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/b2e3ded1a3e3dba04abbc4e6d321b9f8.jpg]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/b2e3ded1a3e3dba04abbc4e6d321b9f8.jpg[/img]																[/url]	

[i]Set your Guild Listing and choose from many options[/i]

You can filter Guilds by activities (such as PvP, Trials, Trading, or Roleplaying, and much more) and by play style (casual, balanced, or hard-core). Guilds can even set specific Alliances, Champion Point requirements, or roles. With this new system, Guilds can easily find like-minded players to join their ranks!

[b]Weapons Artifacts Come to Cyrodiil[/b]
If you’re a veteran of the Alliance War, Update 22 introduces a system that is sure to shake up Cyrodiil: Weapon Artifacts. Now, at random points during an ongoing Alliance War campaign (about four to five times a day), a powerful weapon will spawn in the PvP zone. The first warrior to reach the Weapon Artifact and use it gains a deadly new Skill Line.

[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/ae84fe438c51e3f9df9ef251bb1c7417.jpg]																[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/cms/2019/05/ae84fe438c51e3f9df9ef251bb1c7417.jpg[/img]																[/url]	

[i]Wield the mighty Volendrung[/i]

These new abilities come at a cost, however, because if you don’t continually earn Alliance Points, it’ll slowly drain your life away! You can find a tutorial for the first Weapon Artifact, called Volendrung, in each Alliance starter gate (near the quest boards). 

[b]Summerset Moves to the Crown Store[/b]
As of today, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Digital Upgrade[/i] and [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Digital Collector’s Edition[/i] will no longer be available in The Elder Scrolls Online Store and on Steam Store. Instead, the [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter is being added to the in-game Crown Store as a DLC item. This means that if you are an ESO Plus member, you’ll now automatically have access to the [i]Summerset [/i]zone and story. 

In addition to this, we’re adding a separate Summerset Collector’s Bundle to the in-game Crown Store that includes pre-purchase and Collector’s Edition bonus items. 

[h1]The Season of the Dragon Continues[/h1]
Elsweyr burns as the Season of the Dragon heats up with this newest Chapter in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online [/i]saga. The Usurper Queen and her army of the undead threatens the people of Elsweyr, and a rage of Dragons brings ruin from above. Warriors are needed to help defend the ancestral home of the Khajiit, and dark new powers await those who heed the call. Are you excited to enter Elsweyr and master the necromantic arts? Tell us on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr and Update 22 is now in Early Access on PC/Mac, and it is coming soon to Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on June 4.[/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]Pre-purchase ESO: Elsweyr now[/i][/url][i] to receive unique bonus rewards and gain immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra in-game mount (conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]
									      																													  [url=/en-us/news/category/Elsweyr]Elsweyr[/url]																  [url=/en-us/news/category/announcements]Announcements[/url]																  [url=/en-us/news/category/update22]Update 22[/url]

notes.title: Elsweyr and Update 22 Now Live on PTS!
notes.content:
[i]Explore Elsweyr and help us improve both the new Chapter and Update 22 on the Public Test Server. Read on to find out how you can join in and help us test this new adventure.[/i]

We are thrilled to announce that [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] and Update 22 are now both live on the Public Test Server. This test includes the entire new Chapter and the Update 22 base game patch and is limited to PC/Mac players only. 

If you’ve tested the game previously, either for the [i]Morrowind[/i] or [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter, you can get into this new test from the ESO launcher with no invite required. Just enable “Show Public Test Environment" from your launcher settings. If you haven’t tested a Chapter for us before, but have played [i]ESO[/i] this last year, you’ll receive (or have already received!) an email invite with the details. Because this is such a large test, invites will be sent out over the next few days, so don’t worry if you don’t immediately get yours. 

Please note that anybody can [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/20663/]install and get into the Public Test Environment[/url] and check out the Update 22 base game content, but if they were not invited to this new test or were not a previous tester, they won’t have access to the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter.

To avoid story spoilers, you must agree to a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) upon login. This NDA is specific to the [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i] main quest and its story, but you are free to stream and talk about anything you experience in the new zone with the exception of the Chapter's main storyline beyond the first quest “A Rage of Dragons.” You can share any side quests you enjoy, but please be careful when discussing things that might be considered a spoiler—don’t ruin the fun! We’ll let you know when the NDA is lifting in the future.

All PTS testers will have a watermark visible while playing. To reiterate: You can share almost all of your [i]ESO:[/i] [i]Elsweyr[/i] gameplay publicly, including side quests, the Necromancer class, the Sunspire Trial, open world adventures, Dragon Hunt Events, Delves, World Bosses, Public Dungeons, and anything in the base game, but please refrain from sharing any details related to the main quest beyond “A Rage of Dragons” and its storyline.

Your feedback is extremely important to us, and we truly value comments and bug reports when testing this new Chapter. Please note that we are guaranteed to make adjustments throughout the testing period, so keep an eye out on the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]PTS forum[/url] (you'll need to log into the forums in order to participate) for the latest patch notes.

Here’s what you can experience when testing the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter:
[list][*]A massive new zone, Elsweyr[/*][*]A new main story quest (partly under NDA)[/*][*]The Necromancer class[/*][*] A new Trial, Sunspire[/*][*]New Dragon Hunt Events[/*][*]New World Bosses, Delves, Public Dungeons, and side quests[/*][*]Powerful new item sets[/*][/list]
During the test, you can also check out some of Update 22’s new features, too:
[list][*]The new Daedric Artifacts system in the Alliance War[/*][*]A Guild Finder tool[/*][*]Two new home to explore[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
Starting right now, you can jump into [i]ESO: Elsweyr[/i], see the new zone, test out the Necromancer class, and help us prepare this latest Season of the Dragon adventure for PC/Mac Early Access on May 20 and full release for all platforms on June 4! Will you be logging in to the Public Test Environment and taking your first steps into Elsweyr? Let us know on @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Celebrate 5 Years of ESO With our In-Game Extravaganza Event!
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online is turning five! To celebrate this momentous milestone, we’re running a five-week in-game event, featuring a ton of different activities and rewards. Learn all the details and celebrate with us![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1abea67aa8467591b5c0bc4c339f610ad11c40ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]5 Years Young![/h1]
The [i]ESO [/i]5-Year Anniversary Event begins on April 4 at 10:00AM EDT and will run until May 9 at 10:00AM EDT. To get started, pick up the Jubilee Cake Voucher quest starter from the Crown Store (it’s free) and use it to find the renowned Chef Donolon. Complete his quest and gather the ingredients required to bake and then acquire the new Jubilee Cake 2019 memento. 

When you place and eat a slice of the cake, you’ll immediately receive a two-hour, 100% XP buff (and obtain your first 2 Event Tickets).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7849e09856ed946a9c1d805631e57a2fbdbddeab.jpg[/img]																																      		    		      		        
[i]The XP-boosting (and delicious) Jubilee Cake 2019[/i]

During each week of the event, we’ll be highlighting different types of daily quests, and you can participate in those daily quests to earn unique rewards. This is the only in-game event we’re running in Q2 of 2019 and is the only time you can pick up the new Indrik Berries required to evolve your Nascent Indriks into the brand-new Luminous Indrik (more on that below).

[h1]5 Weeks of Fun[/h1]
Each week for the first four weeks, you’ll be encouraged to participate in a different activity for special rewards. Each time you complete one of the week’s daily activities, you’ll earn an Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box, containing rare crafting ingredients (even Aetheric Ciphers!), recipes, and on occasion, a Motif Chapter for almost any motif in the game, including Worm Cult. However, each unique week also has a chance to grant you a specific new Outfit Style. Finally, on the fifth week, all the previous activities and rewards are up for grabs, allowing you to catch up!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/99c903ee95c4d9cbe8d79c853c7f3682052d831d.jpg[/img]																																      		    		      		        
[i]Dress like a companion![/i]

Here’s the different activities and rewards you’ll earn each week of the event. Each new week begins at 10:00AM EDT.

[h1][b]Week 1 [/b][/h1]
[b] April 4 – April 10[/b]

Do your writs! Complete daily crafting writs to earn Gift Boxes that have a chance to also include pages of the Prophet Outfit Style.

[h1][b]Week 2 [/b][/h1]
[b] April 11 – April 17[/b]

Clear out Tamriel’s Delves and monsters. Complete daily quests to defeat Delves and World Bosses to earn the Gift Boxes that have a chance to also include pages of the Lyris Titanborn Outfit Style. This includes Delve and World Boss dailies from all of the game’s DLCs and Chapters in addition to the Delve daily offered by the Undaunted (note, not Pledges).

[h1][b]Week 3 [/b][/h1]
[b] April 18 – April 24[/b]

Fight your fellow players! Complete Alliance War and Battlegrounds daily quests to earn Gift Boxes that have a chance to also include Abnur Tharn Outfit Style pages. This includes Cyrodiil Town dailies, all Board missions, the Cyrodiil dailies, the Battlegrounds dailies, and Imperial City dailies.

[h1][b]Week 4 [/b][/h1]
[b] April 25 – May 1[/b]

Put your team to the test in Dungeons and Trials. Complete daily quests for any of Tamriel’s Dungeons and Trials to earn Gift Boxes that have a chance to include the Sai Sahan Outfit Style pages.

[h1][b]Week 5[/b][/h1]
[b] May 2 - May 9 (ends at 10:00AM EDT)[/b]

Your choice! Complete [b]any[/b] of the daily quests found in Tamriel to earn Gift Boxes that can contain any of the above rewards (all four unique styles). This is your opportunity to catch up and choose your own adventure!

If you don’t get lucky and get all the pages you want from your Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes, you can also buy the Outfit Styles for each week from the Impresario.

[h1]Earn Event Tickets & Acquire New Rewards[/h1]
Throughout the entire event, you’ll earn two Event Tickets the first time you use the Jubilee Cake 2019 each day, with the timer resetting at 2:00AM EDT. This means by the end of the event, you could have earned a total of 72 tickets!

Don’t forget, you’re capped at 12 Event Tickets per account, but you’ll have ample opportunity to spend them with a huge select of new rewards. Here’s all the new and exciting items you can spend your Event Tickets on at the Impresario’s tent during the event:

[b]Luminous Indrik Mount Berries[/b]
Each week, a new Indrik Berry will be added to the Impresario’s stock, starting with the Luminous Berries of Bloom the first week, and then the Luminous Berries of Budding, Luminous Berries of Growth, and Luminous Berries of Ripeness in subsequent weeks. Once you’ve collected all four unique Berries (you only need one of each), you’ll be able to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]evolve your Nascent Indrik[/url] into a Luminous Indrik mount!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/33b9ec31895fe1878ad5eca7ffd08850ca3e3826.jpg[/img]																																      		    		      		        
[i]Summon your own Luminous Indrik[/i]

Keep in mind that this five-week event is your first and only opportunity to pick up the Indrik Berries you’ll need to summon the Luminous Indrik - don’t miss out!

[b]Companion Outfit Style Pages[/b]
During the event, you’ll also be able to spend event tickets on the weekly Outfit Style pages, with pages from the Prophet Outfit Style being available from Week 1, and the others coming available in their subsequent weeks.  Note that while a specific week’s Outfit Style pages won’t be available in a week that features a different activity and style, during Week 5, ALL Outfit Style pages will be made available for purchase with Event Tickets again, giving you an opportunity to catch up. Finally, Outfit Style pages purchased with Event Tickets cannot be traded. 

[b]Shimmering Indrik Pet[/b]
During Week 5, the Shimmering Indrik Pet will also be available for purchase with Event Tickets from the Impresario. This adorable companion can be acquired for 10 Event Tickets. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/d7fea61904ededb2403d9172fa45bacb5d7fb342.jpg[/img]																															      		    		      		        
[i]This adorable lil’ Indrik is only 10 Event Tickets![/i]

Phew! As usual, the Impresario will continue to stock all four Nascent Indrik Feathers (so you can get a new Nascent Indrik mount), and you can continue to buy Event Tickets from the Crown Store if desired.

[h1]Celebrate Your Way![/h1]
There’s many different ways you can play [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], but during our 5-Year Anniversary Event , you can take part in everything the game has to offer while earning brand-new rewards for doing so. Don’t forget, there’s also cake! How will you be celebrating this incredible milestone? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]! 

[i]The ESO [/i]5-Year Anniversary Event[i] will begin on April 4 at 10:00AM EDT and will run until May 9 at 10:00AM EDT. Let’s party![/i]

notes.title: Dragons Are Unleashed on The Elder Scrolls’ 25th Anniversary & You Can Play Free!
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls is 25 years old, and you can celebrate this amazing milestone with us by unleashing Dragons upon Elsweyr, picking up ESO on sale, or even joining our Free Play Event![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/ad3327bcb7cc284eff423303940301445e6f4a3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Turns 25![/h1]
It has been 25 years since [i]The Elder Scrolls: Arena[/i]’s release in 1994, and we are thrilled to be part of this incredible milestone with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. To celebrate this amazing anniversary, you can begin your journey to the Khajiiti homeland with the Elsweyr Prologue, enjoy sales on the [i]ESO[/i] base game and [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter, and try the game out free, no strings attached, during our Free Play Event. Check out all the details below!

[h1]Unleash Dragons with the Elsweyr Prologue[/h1]
In the [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/dlc/wrathstone]Wrathstone DLC game pack[/url][/i], you began your Season of the Dragon adventure by delving into two challenging dungeons and collecting both halves of the mysterious Wrathstone tablet. With the Elsweyr Prologue, [b]going live later today[/b], you can discover the true purpose of the Wrathstone, and, as shown in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qcDY-5GjGaE][i]Elsweyr[/i] Cinematic Trailer[/url], unleash Dragons upon the unsuspecting Khajiit of Elsweyr. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/39713e22f75bc607e9d5565602af7b8430bdb615.jpg[/img]																																      		    		      		        
[i]Explore the Halls of Colossus in the Elsweyr Prologue [/i]

The Prologue is part of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] base game, meaning you don’t need the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC or a [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/chapter/elsweyr]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/url][/i] pre-purchase to experience this part of the story. 

You can begin this new adventure in two ways: 
[list][*]Get the FREE Crown Store Quest Starter item, the [b]Sealed Imperial Summons[/b], and use it from your inventory.[/*][list][*]You can find this within the Quest Starter category. [/*][/list][*]Venture to the first major city of your alliance and look for the Imperial messenger, [b]Anais Davaux[/b], near the Impresario’s tent. [/*][list][*]Aldmeri players can find her outside the northern gates of Vulkhel Guard.[/*][*]Daggerfall players can find her on approach to Daggerfall City from the east.[/*][*]Ebonheart players can find her at Davon’s Watch near the east gate. [/*][/list][/list]
Completing the Prologue quests grants you the Dragon Flight Illusion Gem memento reward, allowing you to summon a spectral group of mini-dragons!

If you wish to continue aiding the Khajiiti effort against the Dragons, you may undertake daily quests from Zahiri, who sets up camp near Abnur Tharn's camp at the Grahtwood entrance to Elsweyr. You may do every quest she offers once per day, and each rewards you with a cache of treasures from the Northern Elsweyr Defense Force. These caches can include Runebox fragments for the Guar Stomp emote!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/9ed04e0d09d9000863111933a2ad7743f9b798ce.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Summon spectral dragons![/i]

[h1]Play For Free[/h1]
Starting this Thursday, March 28, and running until Wednesday, April 3, you can play [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] free on all platforms. 

Because the Free Play Event includes access to the base game, this means that as a free play player, you can check out the Elsweyr Prologue Quest and begin the adventure that eventually takes you to the home of the Khajiit in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] (now [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]available for pre-purchase[/url])! 

In addition to access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, the Free Play Event also allows you to visit the [i]Morrowind[/i] zone, giving you the opportunity to explore Tamriel and the island home of the Dark Elves. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6f66e5b5d0af589982e78d9e357d5bba8a0161cc.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Travel to the home of the Dark Elves[/i]

Once the event starts, visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Free Play page[/url] to select your platform and enter Tamriel. Note that a PlayStation®Plus membership is required to participate on PlayStation®4, and an Xbox Live Gold membership is required for Xbox One.

[h1]Pick Up ESO on Sale[/h1]
In addition to the Free Play Event and Prologue Quest, later today, we’ve also putting [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] base game and [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i] on sale for all platforms. Visit our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url] or your preferred retailer for details (sales should go live as the day continues). Note that the sale ends at a different time depending on the product:
[list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i] is on sale until April 2[/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Standard Edition[/i] (the base game) is on sale until April 9[/*][/list]

[h1]Celebrating the Elder Scrolls[/h1]
We’re thrilled to take part in this amazing milestone for The Elder Scrolls and continue to bring new and exciting adventures to Tamriel. If you’ve never had the chance to check out [i]ESO[/i] for yourself, thanks to this Free Play Event and sale, there’s never been a better time to visit Tamriel’s 2nd Era and explore a world without limits. 

Don’t forget, you can continue the adventure you start with the Elsweyr Prologue Quest by pre-purchasing [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i], coming June 4. The Season of the Dragon is just heating up!

notes.title: Revel in the Ridiculous with the Return of the Jester’s Festival Event!
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate the absurd during the next Jester’s Festival event and reap ridiculous rewards, including new collectibles, bonus XP, and more! Find out everything you need to know right here. There’s pie![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1172b1919483f9f532a0f2d9afbfdfea39ab8bf8.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Silly Season Returns[/h1]
The Jester's Festival kicks off on Thursday, March 21, at 10:00AM EDT and will run until Tuesday, April 2, at 10:00AM EDT. If you’d like to take part in this frivolous event, travel to the pavilions located outside the cities of Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, and Daggerfall. Once you find a pavilion, talk to one of the three Jesters convincingly dressed as Jorunn the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric to get started.

Complete the intro quest titled “The Jester's Festival" to acquire the delicacy known as the Pie of Misrule. (If you completed the quest last year, you won't need to do so again.) When you use this mouthwatering Memento during the event, you'll receive a two-hour 100% XP buff. You can continue to enjoy the pie once the event is over, but you will no longer receive the bonus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/c81e2c593db993a4b95258981b32aab3fec81a17.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        			  
[i]Save Princess from  a perniciously porky fate![/i]
  
Throughout the event, your characters can receive a daily  quest from a Jester at each of the three different locations, allowing them to  complete three preposterous quests per day.

[h1]Ridiculous Rewards[/h1]
When you complete a Jester’s daily quest, you’ll receive a  Jester’s Festival Reward Box, containing fun consumables, recipes, valuable  items, and furnishings. The [b]first time[/b] you complete the daily quest for [b]each  Jester each day [/b](regardless of character), you’ll receive a Jester’s  Festival Stupendous Box instead! 
  
This Jester’s Festival Stupendous Box has a chance to  contain unique rewards, including:
  [list][*]Cadwell’s Kitchen Arms Style Pages[/*][list][*]Arm yourself with the weapons of the rag-tag knight himself![/*][/list][*]Parts of New Mementos![/*][list][*]Collect the different parts for two new Mementos: the Festive Noise Maker or Jester’s Festival Joke Popper.[/*][/list][*]Jokey Stealies[/*][list][*]Valuable-but-silly items you can sell to vendors for gold.[/*][/list][*]Runeboxes[/*][list][*]Tradeable runeboxes containing last year’s Mementos: the Jester’s Scintillator and Cherry Blossom Branch.[/*][/list][/list]
If you’ve earned all three Stupendous Reward Boxes in a day  and you decide to do the quests again with a different character, you’ll  receive the regular Jester’s Festival Reward Box. You can keep earning three  regular Jester’s Festival Reward Boxes with your different characters  throughout the day, with both the Stupendous Reward Boxes and the regular  Reward Boxes resetting daily at 2:00AM EDT. 
  
Finally, Jester Festival Reward Boxes will always contain one  last reward: the [b]Jester’s Festival Pie[/b].

[h1]Share the Fun… with Pie![/h1]
Although the pies you receive from Reward Boxes certainly  look delicious, in the right hands, they’re one of Tamriel’s most-feared  projectiles! 
  
By adding these tasty missiles to your Quickbar, they become  instruments of maniacal merriment, allowing you to throw them at any of Tamriel’s  inhabitants, including NPCs, guards, or even your fellow players. Spare none  your sticky, delicious wrath! Warning: Some targets, such as city guards, might  object to your revelry.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/9070652f9139665b362e595752cc0abe83e42088.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        			  
[i]“Take that! And  that! EAT IT!”[/i]
  
Of course, while covering your friends, enemies, and hapless  bystanders in dessert is its own reward, we’ve also added a host of new  pie-related Achievements to this year’s event:
[list][*][b]The Three Fillings War[/b] – Throw 10 Pies at players that are in a different Alliance[/*][*][b]The Upper Crust[/b] – Throw a pie at each of the Alliance Leaders[/*][*][b]More Than You Can Chew[/b] – Throw 10 Pies at Guards[/*][*][b]Dessert Domination[/b] – Complete the above Achievements[/*][*][b]Messy Business[/b] – Kill 10 players while they are covered in pie in Cyrodiil[/*][/list]
With these Achievements come special rewards. By completing the  Messy Business and The Upper Crust Achievements, you’ll earn the “Empieror” and  “Tin Soldier” titles respectively. Finally, by acquiring Dessert Domination,  you’ll receive the Obnoxious Mute Face Paint collectible! 
  
The Achievements from previous events will still be available  this year for everybody, too, including the Lord or Lady of Misrule  Achievement, rewarding you with a title and hat, and the Royal Jester  Achievement, rewarding you with a title and unlocking the ability to acquire  unique furnishings. Check your in-game Journal for everything.

[h1]Snag and Spend Event Tickets[/h1]
As you take part in the Jester’s Festival, you’ll earn two  Event Tickets the first time you complete a Jester’s daily quest each day, with  a total of 24 tickets available to be earned by the event’s end. 
  
During the event, you can buy Indrik Feathers, Dawnwood  Berries of Bloom,[b] [/b]Dawnwood Berries of Budding, Dawnwood Berries of  Growth, and the new [b]Dawnwood Berries of Ripeness[/b] from the Impresario  merchant. This is the final berry you’ll need to evolve your existing Nascent  Indrik into the Dawnwood Indrik! To summon your new, fancy Indrik, simply have  all four berries in your inventory and use one of them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6d1a1f101086064fe22d3455a86d1c2dd32f56ee.jpg[/img]																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]The even-more majestic Dawnwood Indrik[/i]

When spending Event Tickets, please double-check the name of the berries you’re about to purchase. You need only one of each to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]evolve your Indrik[/url]. Please also note that this is your last chance to acquire all the berries required to make this specific evolution. Once this event ends, the Impresario will [b]no longer stock these berries[/b] – don’t miss out!

If you’ve earned more than enough Event Tickets this quarter, you can also acquire the Springtide Indrik pet for 10 Event Tickets – the first pet Indrik available in game! In addition, you can acquire any of Cadwell’s Kitchen Arms Style pages for five Event Tickets each, giving you an alternate way to earn them other than the Stupendous Boxes (or simply snatch up any you are missing). You’ll find both of these new types of items for sale from the Impresario.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/e2058598d2483fa4367e6e0a8ac81aeb5d417669.jpg[/img]														      		    		   

[h1]New Crown Store Items[/h1]
With the Jester’s Festival event, we’re bringing back a host of fan-favorite items including the Madcap Jester Monkey and Jester Personality in addition to adding new items such as the Pebble Pal (yes, it’s a pet rock), Cadwell’s Kitchen Style pack, and a selection of novelty stick mounts.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/55491183ad4b2f36be2709d8bbf82b0dc5959704.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/54902160c1615850d369c1239d00564e72bc324b.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/2aa424b1750eec180e4d908eabae65b24cf59e65.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8f2de1cda86e4f3c346a1e54913c3a7c0d4e8fd9.jpg[/img][/url]																							      		    		      		        
[i]The Novelty Stick Horse mount & Pebble Pal Pet[/i]

Additionally, during this event, we’re adding Event Tickets to the in-game Crown Store. You can find them in the Events category. Check out this month’s [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55821]Crown Store Showcase[/url] for more information on when all of these fantastic items will be available.

[h1]Revel in the Ridiculous[/h1]
Enjoy bonuses to XP, acquire Event Tickets, earn exclusive rewards, AND cover your enemies (and friends) in delicious, sticky pie—what’s not to love this Jester’s Festival? Are you planning to join in on the raucous revelries this year? Head on over to Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]@TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url] and tell us how you’ll be celebrating!

[i]This Jester's Festival kicks off on Thursday, March 21, at 10:00AM EDT and will run until Tuesday, April 2, at 10:00AM EDT. Have fun![/i]

notes.title: ESO Live: March 15 @ 6PM EDT – New Loremaster & Update 21 Improvements
notes.content:
[i]Learn how the team designed Update 21’s quality-of-life improvements and get to know the new Loremaster in our latest ESO Live.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/ab11faadb70a411d7e1d7e26619dd19a0d439749.jpg[/img]

Join us this Friday at 6PM EDT as Senior Systems Designer Michael Edwards and Lead UI Designer Bobby Weir drop by to talk with Community Managers Jessica Folsom and Gina Bruno about two of Update 21’s most-loved features: the Zone Guide and Guild Trader UI update. Then, ZOS’s new Loremaster Leamon Tuttle joins them to chat about his background, what it means to be a Loremaster, and his thoughts on Elder Scrolls lore in general. If you love Elder Scrolls lore AND quality-of-life improvements, this is the show for you!
