The show will go live this Friday at 6PM EDT on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XAkfoIphJ7w]YouTube[/url], [url=https://mixer.com/bethesda]Mixer[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/306130/The_Elder_Scrolls_Online/]Steam[/url]—see you there!

notes.title: The Thieves Guild & Dark Brotherhood Celebration Brings Bonus Loot for Tamriel’s Criminals
notes.content:
[i]There’s never been a better time to be bad! Earn bonus rewards when you commit crimes in the name of the Dark Brotherhood or Thieves Guild during our celebration event.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a81f126f53b8de71e9b08236527497bd67cc71b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crime Pays[/h1]
The Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration Event starts Thursday, March 7, at 10:00AM EST and runs until Monday, March 18, at 10:00AM EDT. During this period, you can earn the following bonus rewards for certain criminal activities in both Hew's Bane and the Gold Coast:
[list][*]Double reward drops for defeating World Bosses[/*][*]Double reward drops for defeating Delve bosses[/*][*]Double Defiled Whiskers drops from Maw of Lorkhaj bosses[/*][*]Increased rewards for completing Heists[/*][*]Increased rewards for completing Sacraments[/*][*]Double harvesting resources from regular crafting nodes (not nodes from Survey Reports)[/*][/list]	

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/aa1e1f7ee64f24ffea20a23f08c84a5fdb0aea9c.jpg[/img]

Note that the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood repeatable quests do not have bonus rewards during the event period.

[h1]Become a Master Thief or Assassin[/h1]
Throughout this dark event, you can acquire both the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] and [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] DLC game packs for a steal, with both available in the in-game Crown Store for 1,000 crowns. 

Even better, you can snatch up the [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i] Collector’s Bundle and the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] Collector’s Bundle for 2,000 crowns each. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4df4bc4f60bca11e47861da5ff4e1b843ae86169.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/ff3444bfb256421fa5f82aa864bb3a12c7ef58b8.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/07be4c3b84efdeb8a696c6a36def3da631653f63.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/03734e100a0f9a02e76a08e809afc7cec6b6c60c.jpg[/img][/url]
																															      		    		      		        
[i]The Dark Brotherhood and Thieves Guild Collector’s Bundles[/i]

The [i]Thieves Guild[/i] Collector's Bundle includes the [i]Thieves Guild[/i] DLC game pack, the Hammerfell Camel mount, the Kindlespit Dragon Frog pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. The [i]Dark Brotherhood [/i]Collector's Bundle includes the DLC game pack, Highland Wolf mount, the Sylvan Nixad pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. 

Finally, we’re also putting a collection of Thieves Guild- and Dark Brotherhood-themed Crown Store items up for sale, including furnishings, homes, and Motif Styles. Check out the Crown Store starting on March 7 to grab a bargain. 

[h1]Steal Your Event Tickets[/h1]
As you participate in the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration, you’ll also earn Event Tickets for the following activities:
[list][*]One Event Ticket for the first Sacrament completed each day[/*][list][*]Sacraments are unlocked by reaching Dark Brotherhood Rank 2 and completing the quest “A Lesson in Silence”[/*][/list][*]One Event Ticket for the first Heist completed each day[/*][list][*]Heists are unlocked by reaching Thieves Guild Rank 3 and completing the quest “The Long Game"[/*][/list][/list]
You can earn a total of two Event Tickets per day per account, with a possible total of 24 by the end.

Throughout the event, you can buy Indrik Feathers, Dawnwood Berries of Bloom (introduced with January’s Midyear Mayhem),[b] [/b]Dawnwood Berries of Budding[b] [/b](introduced with the Morrowind Celebration), and [b]new Dawnwood Berries of Growth[/b] from the Impresario merchant. When spending Event Tickets, please double-check the name of the berries you’re about to purchase. You need only one of each to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]evolve your Indrik[/url].

[h1]Stick to the Shadows[/h1]
The risks are great, but during the Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration, the rewards are even greater, meaning there’s never been a better time to begin your life of crime! Are you excited to return to the Gold Coast and Hew’s Bane? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Thieves Guild and Dark Brotherhood Celebration event begins on Thursday, March 7, at 10:00AM EST and will end on Monday, March 18, at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Wrathstone DLC Game Pack & Update 21 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Begin your Season of the Dragon story with Wrathstone, a new DLC game pack for The Elder Scrolls Online. Learn about this challenging new dungeon content and the free Update 21 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/24eedafc07488b5dcc339e2470890cb7d574b833.jpg[/img]

The [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC dungeon pack and update brings new adventures and improvements to [i]ESO[/i]:
[list][*]Two dungeons: Frostvault & Depths of Malatar[/*][*]The start of the Season of the Dragon adventure[/*][*]A new Battleground: Eld Angvar[/*][*]Updated PvP rewards[/*][*]The Zone Guide[/*][*]A Guild Trader UI update[/*][/list]
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]purchase with crowns[/url] from the in-game Crown Store.

[url=https://youtu.be/JddpbOp_SwU]Check out the official Wrathstone Launch Trailer here![/url]

[h1]Wrathstone DLC Game Pack[/h1]
The [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC Game Pack introduces two challenging, brand-new dungeons that take your team through Tamriel’s hidden ruins to collect both halves of the mysterious Wrathstone tablet. This DLC also kicks off the year-long Season of the Dragon storyline that continues with the upcoming [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/chapter/elsweyr]Elsweyr Chapter[/url][/i], arriving this June, and runs throughout 2019. 

[b]Frostvault[/b]

In Frostvault, you must work with the Redguard treasure hunter [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55757]Tharayya[/url] to explore a lost Dwarven vault, embedded deep within Eastmarch’s frozen glaciers. Standing in your way is a menacing Goblin tribe, ageless Dwarven automatons, and deadly traps. You need to make use of long-deactivated machines to break into the vault and claim its secrets for yourself.

[b]Depths of Malatar[/b]

What dangers lurk within the Depths of Malatar? Venture deep into this lost Ayleid ruin and discover the fate of an Imperial cohort that first discovered its entrance centuries ago. However, more than soldiers await you deep within the sunken city of Garlas Malatar, as shining Daedric guardians protect the ancient relics within!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/170f9b9470363e188b1114f456b3e0dd6648b29c.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]Explore the sunken ruins of Malatar[/i]

Both dungeons are available in Normal and Veteran difficulties, with a Veteran Hard Mode option if you truly wish to challenge your team. Should you complete these dungeons, in addition to claiming both halves of the Wrathstone tablet, you can earn powerful armor sets, Monster Masks, and unique collectibles, including a new skin and pet. 

For more, check out our in-depth previews of both [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55643]Depths of Malatar[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55773]Frostvault[/url]. 

[h1]Purchase Details[/h1]
The [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members or can be purchased for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store, where it’s listed under DLC. 

Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC dungeons until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

[b]Wrathstone Collector’s Bundle[/b]

The [i]Wrathstone Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Treasure Hunter’s Horse mount, the Carnelian Theodolite pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Wrathstone Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/e8afa40cc3922dd8f105e16f2c994c0a141cbf58.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]The Wrathstone Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h1]Enter a Wrathstone Dungeon & Receive a Free Hat[/h1]
After you gain access to the [i]Wrathstone[/i] dungeons, you can explore both Frostvault and Depths of Malatar by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances in both the Gold Coast (Depths of Malatar) and Eastmarch (Frostvault)[/*][/list]
Upon entering one of the two new dungeons, you receive an Ayleid Royal Crown hat, completely free.
					      		    		      		        																									[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/bec221a92ff8d821d3485f91400f18d5063fe899.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]This courtly crest is perfect for the ancient aristocrat within you![/i]

[h1]New Battleground and PvP Rewards[/h1]
The Update 21 base-game patch (free for all [i]ESO[/i] players) brings a new Battleground to conquer and new rewards for PvP activities. For starters, the Battlegrounds map Eld Angvar pits you against your fellow players in a mysterious Ayleid world between worlds. This arena puts you into the fight quickly by using a series of portals, and it has two unique variants depending on the game mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/462b047419bdb3fa8f6bb49f8bb6c3cf4170042f.jpg[/img]			      		    		      		        																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]Battle in the void[/i]

In addition to the Battlegrounds map, Update 21 also provides additional PvP rewards, including a unique pet for those who fight for control of Cyrodiil and colorful, team-based weapon Outfit styles for Battlegrounds brawlers. 

Find out more about the new Battleground and PvP rewards in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55747]preview article[/url].

[h1]Zone Guide and Guild Trader UI Update[/h1]
Update 21 also introduces some big changes and quality-of-life improvements for Tamriel’s explorers and traders. The [b]Zone Guide [/b]tool[b] [/b]helps you track your progress in any of Tamriel’s zones, including Zone Story Quests completed, Wayshrines unlocked, Points of Interest visited, and much more. It can even help you find almost everything in a zone via quest markers. This tool is perfect if you need help completing a zone or simply want to find something interesting to do. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0836d1749341efcedb923b7702b6363b30227e13.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]If you have coin, you can find wares[/i]

If you enjoy trading goods with your fellow players in [i]ESO[/i], Update 21’s [b]Guild Trader UI[/b] improvement dramatically overhauls how you find and purchase items. The biggest addition is the ability to search a Guild Trader for specific items rather than having to navigate through multiple menus, and it allows you to effortlessly find the items or materials you wish to acquire. In addition to this, we’ve also revamped the Guild Trader categories, making for a much smoother trading experience. 

You can read more about these Update 21 base-game changes in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55747]preview article[/url]. 

[h1]Your Adventure Begins Now[/h1]
With the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC game pack, your epic, year-long Season of the Dragon storyline begins now. Starting today, you can enter these two challenging new dungeons and claim both halves of the powerful and mysterious Wrathstone, but be warned: what you uncover could have consequences for all of Tamriel! For more on everything coming with [i]Wrathstone[/i] and Update 21, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes[/url] forum. Are you planning to venture deep into the Frostvault or Depths of Malatar dungeons? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url] – don’t forget to use the #SeasonOfTheDragon hashtag!

[i]The [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/dlc/wrathstone]Wrathstone DLC game pack[/url] is now live on PC/Mac and is coming to PlayStation®4 and Xbox One on March 12. It is available free for ESO Plus members or can be purchased [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]with crowns[/url] from the in-game Crown Store.[/i]

notes.title: Return to Vvardenfell & Earn Bonus Rewards During the Morrowind Celebration Event
notes.content:
[i]Explore the home of the Dark Elves during the Morrowind  Celebration Event and you can earn additional rewards for dailies, Event  Tickets, and more![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/b953dc047705aa56b787a4bed0b5fa44b6f85ba1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Under the Shadow of Red Mountain[/h1]
The Morrowind Celebration Event begins on Thursday, February  7 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Monday, February 18 at 10:00AM EST. During  this time, as you explore the island of Vvardenfell, you’ll earn double the  rewards for certain activities, including:
[list][*]Double drops from resource nodes[/*][list][*]Including Jewelry seams, but does not include nodes spawned from Survey Reports and Fishing Holes[/*][/list][*]Double drops from all bosses (including the Halls of Fabrication Trial)[/*][*]Double reward boxes from all Daily Quests in the zone[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/c30cf32f0c1bfa56ac824def7d200379e3d079df.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]Explore a Vivec City still under construction[/i]

To get started exploring the home of the Dark Elves, you can pick up the zone quest and travel to Vvardenfell by accessing the Stories section of your Collections UI, selecting [i]Morrowind[/i] under Zone DLC, and finally clicking the “Accept Quest” button. Alternatively, you can use a Wayshrine to teleport directly to Seyda Neen. 

[h1]Morrowind on Sale[/h1]
If you don’t have access to the zone, the [i]Morrowind[/i] DLC will be on sale in the Crown Store throughout the event period for 1750 crowns (a 50% discount). This includes access to the [i]Morrowind[/i] zone and story content (note, not the Warden Class). 

In addition to this, the Morrowind Collector’s Pack Bundle will be on sale for 1050 crowns (also a 50% discount). The Morrowind Collector’s Pack Bundle does not include the zone DLC, but features a bunch of useful and fun items, including all of the following [i]Morrowind[/i]-themed collectibles: 
[list][*][b]Mount: Dwarven War Horse[/b] - This loyal horse has been trained for warfare and will stick with you through every kind of conflict. [/*][*][b]Pet: Dwarven Spider[/b] - A loyal Dwarven Spider liberated from a Dwemer ruin and converted using the "Neramo Method."[/*][*][b]Bear Skin: Slate-Gray Summoned Bear[/b] - The greatest Wardens summon the mightiest animals. [/*][*][b]Emotes: PvP Taunts[/b] - Celebrate your victory in the battlegrounds with this bundle of exclusive emotes: Belly Laugh, Kiss This, Teatime, Go Quietly.[/*][*][b]Outfit Style: Morag Tong[/b] - Allows you to convert your gear to the Morag Tong style.[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/67a376448108e4d44a8b285e238d9565528d9a55.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]The mighty Dwarven War Horse[/i]

In addition to the above, the adorable Vvardvark pet will be on sale, and both the Lord Vivec Furnishing Bundle and Telvanni Tower home (both furnished and unfurnished versions) will be returning to the Crown Store for a limited time.

[h1]Earn Event Tickets[/h1]
As you participate in the Morrowind Celebration Event, you’ll also earn Event Tickets for the following activities:
[list][*]One Event Ticket for the first World Boss Daily Quest completed each day[/*][*]One Event Ticket for the first Delve Daily Quest completed each day[/*][/list]
You can earn a total of two Event Tickets per day per account, with a possible total of 26 by the event’s end.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/bfd4f3e64a72462a80496f8874975b528a9910a5.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Earn Event Tickets by completing Daily Quests[/i]

Throughout the event, you will be able to buy Indrik Feathers, Dawnwood Berries of Bloom (introduced with January’s Midyear Mayhem event), and the [b]new Dawnwood Berries of Budding [/b]from the Impresario merchant. When spending your Event Tickets, be sure to double-check the name of the berries you’re about to purchase. You only need one of each in order to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]evolve your Indrik[/url].

[h1]Vivec’s Power Wanes [/h1]
The Warrior-Poet himself, the demi-god known as Vivec, needs your help to reclaim his lost strength and uncover the mysterious forces working against him and the island of Vvardenfell. Will you come to the aid of all of Morrowind and return to the home of the Dark Elves? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. 

[i]The Morrowind Celebration event begins on Thursday, February 7 at 10:00AM EST and will end on Monday, February 18 at 10:00AM EST. [/i]

notes.title: Wrathstone & Update 21 Preview
notes.content:
[i]The Season of the Dragon starts here! Preview the exciting new dungeons arriving with the Wrathstone DLC pack and learn about the big base-game changes coming as part of Update 21.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/2a04ce920f7232d269df001675b07b52139252a1.jpg[/img]

The [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC game pack is coming soon, and it will be available free to all ESO Plus members and for purchase for Crowns from the in-game Crown Store. This new DLC dungeon pack sends you and your team deep into Tamriel’s hidden past with two brand-new dungeons: Depths of Malatar and Frostvault.

Update 21 arrives alongside the new dungeon pack and brings a series of improvements and new features free for all players, including a new Battlegrounds map and PvP rewards, Passive Ability changes, a Guild Trader update, and much more!

[h1]Uncover the Wrathstone[/h1]
As revealed in our [i][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qcDY-5GjGaE]Elsweyr cinematic trailer[/url][/i], the Imperial Chancellor Abnur Tharn, using the Wrathstone tablet, has opened the Halls of Colossus and unleashed a horde of merciless Dragons upon Elsweyr and beyond. But how did he get his hands on both halves of the powerful relic? These two new dungeons tell the first part of the Season of the Dragon story and show how you and the famous Redguard scholar Tharayya (returning for both dungeons!) discover these long-hidden relics. 

The entrance to the [b]Frostvault[/b] has been uncovered, and this previously lost Dwarven vault is open for explorers and treasure hunters alike. While your reasons for venturing deep into this frozen dungeon might differ from Tharayya’s, you must both contend with a local Goblin tribe that has made the ruins their home. Be warned, it’s still a Dwarven complex, and dangerous automatons and deadly traps await those who manage to delve into the heart of this ancient facility. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/ec85b37050b76d1a522110fc2f6097649f91c916.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]Beware the guardians of Malatar[/i]

What secrets lie within the sunken [b]Depths of Malatar[/b]? In this dungeon, you, the ever-inquisitive Tharayya, and the spirit of her lost husband must venture into a secret Imperial fort and discover the ancient Ayleid ruin beneath it. You and your team, however, are not the first to try to uncover the secrets of Malatar. A Lost Imperial legion and shining Daedric agents stand between you and an ancient power that brought ruin upon its original inhabitants. 

Both Frostvault and Depths of Malatar can be completed in Normal, Veteran, and Veteran Hard Mode difficulties, and should you complete these 4-player challenges, you’ll be rewarded with powerful new item sets and unique collectibles, including a new skin and a non-combat pet! Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you’ll earn the Ayleid Royal Crown hat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0d38317ae141d433f51c1cecc344ca5373b76dc6.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]Fit for a king![/i]

[h1]New Battlegrounds & PvP Rewards[/h1]
Update 21 also brings a host of changes to [i]ESO[/i]’s PvP as part of its base-game update. Most notably, this includes an incredible [b]new battleground: Eld Angvar[/b]. This new arena is located somewhere in a place between worlds, so be sure to watch your feet as you move between the map’s platforms! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1d46a7e2f954d575b34ffd4a205a9ad51fdc908c.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Fight in a world outside of Tamriel[/i]

This update also introduces [b]new PvP rewards[/b], including the Elinhir Arena Lion pet (earned with Arena Gladiator’s Proofs) and weapon Outfit Styles that resemble the three Battlegrounds teams: Pit Daemons, Stormlords, and Firedrakes. 

[h1]Base Game Additions & Improvements[/h1]
In order to help you find and complete more of [i]ESO[/i]’s zone content, Update 21 introduces the new [b]Zone Guide[/b] system. This new tool can be accessed from your Group & Activity Finder or map, and it allows you to see your progress in any of Tamriel’s zones or beyond, tracking activities such as Zone Story Quests, Wayshrines, Delves, Striking Locals, Skyshards, and much more. You can even use this new tool to give you a quest marker to your next objective in order, starting with the zone’s quests. With this new system, everybody that enters Tamriel can easily find their next adventure or help them finally 100% complete a zone.  

Update 21 will also introduce improvements to the [b]Guild Trader UI[/b], giving you the ability to search for specific item names, see an item’s price per unit, and view your previous searches. We’ve also overhauled the UI in general and reworded item categories to better reflect what people are looking for, making the overall experience much more user-friendly. Finally, this update also introduces a host of changes to [b]Racial Passive Abilities[/b]. These Abilities have been updated to allow more playstyles to benefit from the bonuses they provide, as well as ensuring each Race has a unique gameplay advantage. For more information, you can read about the Combat Team’s changes to Racial Passives on the forums. 

There are tons more updates, fixes, and additions coming with Update 21, and both the update and [i]Wrathstone[/i] are available on PTS (PC/Mac only) right now, so why not log in and test it all out for yourself?

[h1]Begin the Season of the Dragon[/h1]
With the exciting new [i]Wrathstone[/i] dungeon pack and a host of new additions and quality-of-life gameplay improvements coming in Update 21, the year-long Season of the Dragon begins to take flight. Are you ready to brave the dungeons of Frostvault and Depths of Malatar and acquire both parts of the Wrathstone? Let us know on Twitter @[url=http://www.twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url], [url=http://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url] using the #SeasonOfTheDragon hashtag!

[i]Part of the Season of the Dragon year-long adventure, the Wrathstone DLC game pack is coming soon for ESO Plus members and the in-game Crown Store. This new DLC game pack arrives with Update 21, a free base-game update for all ESO players.[/i]

notes.title: Elsweyr Editions & Pre-Purchase Rewards
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr is coming to PC/Mac, Xbox  One, and PlayStation®4 on June 4, and it is now available for pre-purchase. Find  out which version of ESO’s latest Chapter is best for you![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/058f0ad3938e7163d60c7642322717d73657dcbc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pre-Purchase Elsweyr Now[/h1]
[i]Elsweyr[/i] is now available for pre-purchase on relevant  digital platforms and storefronts, including the [url=https://account.elderscrollsonline.com/store]ESO Store[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=elder+scrolls+online]Steam[/url],  [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/home/games]PlayStation[i]®[/i]Store[/url],  and [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/microsoft-store]Microsoft Store[/url]. You  can view and select your desired pre-purchase version, platform, and retailer  on our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url].  The game will launch on all platforms on June 4, but the digital PC/Mac version  of the game will enter Early Access on May 20. 
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Standard Edition[/i]  will be available in physical stores at launch on June 4 – check your local  retailers for details.
 
[h1]Pre-Purchase Rewards[/h1]
If you pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i],  you’ll receive the following in-game rewards at launch:
[list][*][b]Noble Clan Chief costume[/b] - The clans of Anequina in  northern Elsweyr are largely nomadic, but they nonetheless have hereditary  aristocracies who express their wealth and power through the splendor of their  clothing.[/*][*][b]Blue Dragon Imp pet[/b] - A clever Illusion Imp that's found a  way to get free handouts and a warm place to sleep.[/*][*][b]A Baandari Pedlar Crown Crate[/b] - A mystery collection of  Baandari items![/*][*][b]Elsweyr Treasure Maps bundle [/b]– A collection of three Treasure  Maps that will lead you to hidden riches.[/*][*][b]Crown Experience Scrolls (x2) [/b]– 100% XP scrolls, created  by a Priestess of Meridia, to help you get started on your adventures.[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7c49b87ced0492d29a0e1f841566f399c44b4da7.png[/img]																																		      		    		      		        			  
[i]Pre-purchase  digital content[/i]
  
In addition to the above, digital pre-purchases of the full [i]Elsweyr  Collector’s Edition[/i] and [i]Standard Edition[/i] (not Upgrades) provides  immediate access to [i]ESO[/i] base game, [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter, and [i]Summerset[/i]  Chapter. The [i]Collector’s Edition[/i] will also include the Collector’s  Edition items for each Chapter, too. Note that these editions will continue to  include [i]Morrowind[/i] and [i]Summerset[/i] post-launch, but the only way to  get immediate access before launch is by digitally pre-purchasing them. 
  
Finally, all digital pre-purchases will also receive  immediate access to an otherworldly in-game steed: the Rahd-m’Athra mount. Physical pre-orders of [i]Elsweyr[/i] will still receive the Rahd-m’Athra mount reward, but not until the game launches on June 4.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7c87941f19fae658f930b6fa0ea429717b6fd173.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]Get instant access to the Rahd-m’Athra mount with digital pre-purchase![/i]

[h1]Choose your Elsweyr Edition[/h1]
Whether you’re an existing player or a newcomer, there’s a version of [i]Elsweyr [/i]that’s perfect for you. Check out the below infographic and information on the unique editions for everything you need to know!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/16259f43b26108d0257109b071c02d911fc73668.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i] Elsweyr’s editions and features[/i]

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Collector’s Edition[/h1]
If you’re a new player who wants access to the base game, the all-new [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, and the [i]Morrowind [/i]and [i]Summerset[/i] Chapters, this version is for you. In addition to this, you’ll also receive immediate access to the [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/25909]Morrowind[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26343]Summerset[/url][/i] Collector’s Edition items and a colorful selection of unique [i]Elsweyr[/i]-themed digital items at launch:
[list][*][b]Senche-raht mount [/b]- Largest of all the furstocks, or "breeds" of Khajiit, the Senche-raht is fully intelligent, and in combat often serves simultaneously as warrior and mount.[/*][*][b]Ashen Scar Jerboa pet -[/b] There are many in the Ashen Scar, and if you catch one when it's small, it makes for a pleasant, fuzzy friend.[/*][*][b]Archaic Lore Tablets memento [/b]- Invoke these Tablets of Archaic Lore and they glow with the wisdom of ancient knowledge![/*][*][b]Khajiiti Culture Emote Pack [/b]- Cat-Folk Pack that includes the Cat Contemplation, Feline Hygiene, and Pedlar Beckoning emotes.[/*][*][b]Dragonbone Outfit Style [/b]-[b] [/b]Allows you to convert your gear to the Dragonbone style.[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/aff26b607ec8a3771b5c25a06f324dabc46d866f.png[/img]																																		      		    		      		        			  
[i]Collector’s Edition digital items[/i]
  
The [i]Elsweyr Collector’s Edition[/i] is available  digitally only. When pre-purchasing the [i]Collector’s Edition[/i], you’ll get  immediate access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, the [i]Morrowind[/i] and [i]Summerset[/i]  Chapter, and their associated Collector’s Edition items (the [i]Elsweyr[/i]  Chapter and it’s CE items will be available at launch), allowing you to get a  head-start on your adventures in Tamriel! 
  
Pre-purchases of the [i]Collector’s Edition[/i] will also  receive all the digital items included in the pre-purchase section at launch, plus  immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra in-game mount. 

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Digital Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/h1]
If you’re an existing [i]ESO[/i] player, you can purchase  the [i]Digital Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/i] for access to the new Chapter  and the following in-game goodies at launch: 
[list][*][b]Senche-raht mount[/b] - Largest of all the furstocks, or "breeds" of Khajiit, the Senche-raht is fully intelligent, and in combat often serves simultaneously as warrior and mount.[/*][*][b]Ashen Scar Jerboa pet[/b] - There are many in the Ashen Scar, and if you catch one when it's small, it makes for a pleasant, fuzzy friend.[/*][*][b]Archaic Lore Tablets memento[/b] - Invoke these Tablets of Archaic Lore and they glow with the wisdom of ancient knowledge![/*][*][b]Khajiiti Culture Emote Pack[/b] - Cat-Folk Pack that includes the Cat Contemplation, Feline Hygiene, and Pedlar Beckoning emotes.[/*][*][b]Dragonbone Outfit Style[/b] - Allows you to convert your gear to the Dragonbone style.[/*][/list]

The [i]Elsweyr Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/i] is available  digitally only. Pre-purchases of the [i]Elsweyr Collector’s Edition Upgrade [/i]will  also receive all the digital items included in the pre-purchase section,  including immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra in-game mount.

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Standard Edition[/h1]
If you’re a new player, the[i] Elsweyr Standard Edition [/i]includes  access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter, [i]Summerset[/i]  Chapter, and [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter. It is available for pre-purchase digitally  now and in physical format at launch – check your local retailers. 
  
Pre-purchases will also receive all the items included in  the pre-purchase section at launch, plus immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra  in-game mount (digital pre-purchases only). When pre-purchasing the Standard  Edition digitally, you’ll enjoy immediate access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, [i]Morrowind[/i]  Chapter, and [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter.

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Digital Upgrade[/h1]
Existing [i]ESO[/i] players can also get access to the new  Chapter by picking up [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Upgrade[/i]. This  version includes the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter, and it is only available  digitally. 
  
Pre-purchases will also receive all the digital items  included in the pre-purchase section at launch, plus immediate access to the  Rahd-m’Athra in-game mount.

[h1]Explore Tamriel Today![/h1]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/i] is coming soon for  PC/Mac, Xbox One, and PlayStation[i]®[/i]4, but you can get immediate access to  the game AND ride in style upon the amazing the Rahd-m’Athra mount if you  pre-purchase today. Are you excited to visit the home of the Khajiit? Let us  know which edition of [i]Elsweyr[/i] you’ll be picking up on Twitter @[url=http://www.twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url],  [url=http://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url],  and [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url] using  the #SeasonOfTheDragon hashtag! 
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr is coming to PC/Mac, Xbox  One and PlayStation®4 on June 4. PC/Mac players can take part in Early Access  starting May 20.  [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Pre-purchase Elsweyr now[/url]  to receive unique bonus rewards and gain immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra  in-game mount (conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Announcing The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr & the Season of the Dragon
notes.content:
[i]We are excited to announce the next Chapter in The Elder Scrolls Online saga, The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr, coming to PC/Mac, Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on June 4. Learn about this brand-new adventure and the year-long Season of the Dragon storyline here.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/dba46dcf97130e1c743e1742db40c0dcda891a1a.jpg[/img]			      		    		      		        																																																																														      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																										      		    		      		        	

[h1]The Season of the Dragon[/h1]
Keep both eyes on the skies! During the Season of the Dragon, you can experience a year-long interconnected adventure that begins very soon with the [i]Wrathstone[/i] DLC game pack and continues through the upcoming [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter and beyond. Here’s the Season of the Dragon schedule:
[list][*][i]Wrathstone [/i]DLC dungeon pack[/*][*][i]Elsweyr [/i]Chapter[/*][*]Unannounced Q3 DLC dungeon pack[/*][*]Unannounced Q4 DLC story zone[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1ebba6a5108f86d7667f48c8bb3ce0f970e0ec72.jpg[/img]																																			      		    		      		        
[i]The Season of the Dragon is here![/i]

As always, each release will feature an incredible stand-alone story, but the Season of the Dragon brings it all together as part of an epic adventure that runs throughout the entire year – a first for [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]!

[url=https://youtu.be/qcDY-5GjGaE]Click here to check out the Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr – Cinematic Announce Trailer.[/url]


[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr[/h1]
The Dragons have returned to Tamriel. Unleashed upon the world by the unwitting Abnur Tharn and the Imperial usurper queen Euraxia, the great Kaalgrontiid and his followers hunt from the skies and threaten to burn down the ancestral home of the Khajiit. 

[i]Elsweyr[/i] is packed with new stories, adventures, and challenges, including:
[list][*]A whole new zone to explore: Elsweyr[/*][*]An epic main story quest line that ties into the Season of the Dragon[/*][*]A powerful new Class: Necromancer[/*][*]A challenging new 12-player Trial: Sunspire[/*][*]Massive new world events: Dragon Attacks[/*][*]A huge amount of unique delves, public dungeons, and stand-alone quests[/*][*]A host of updates and quality-of-life improvements[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/342eb706b15015bcb7f0780bc6349d661e5371ef.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Explore the stunning (and dangerous) land of Elsweyr[/i]

Previously, you have been able to explore the province of Elsweyr in [i]The Elder Scrolls: Arena[/i] and its outer edges in [i]ESO[/i]’s regions of Reaper’s March and Khenarthi’s Roost, but in this new adventure, you can fully experience the home of Tamriel’s beloved cat people. In [i]Elsweyr[/i], you can traverse both fertile grasslands and scorching deserts, interact with moon-sugar farmers and wandering nomads, or confront merciless Imperial occupiers and roaming bandits. In this new Chapter, you can truly dive into the life, history, culture, and mythology of the Khajiit and their homeland.

Of course, in addition to exploring this new zone, you’ll also be called upon to defend the Khajiiti people against a devastating new threat: Dragons. However, in this Chapter you’re no Dragonborn, and you’ll need to work with your fellow players and powerful allies in order to take these winged beasts down.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0c9b6aa2ce4014ecbd8abd56fb0c7194c65cfb38.jpg[/img]																																			      		    		      		        
[i]Command the undead with the Necromancer Class[/i]

Finally, [i]Elsweyr [/i]also introduces the highly anticipated Necromancer Class to [i]ESO[/i]. With this dark, mysterious new Class, you will be able to command the dead and cast powerful elemental spells to overcome your foes and bolster your defenses. With the Necromancer, death itself is a weapon!

[h1]Pre-Purchase Elsweyr Now[/h1]
You can pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr [/i]now to receive unique rewards at launch, including the Noble Clan Chief costume, Blue Dragon Imp pet, Treasure Maps, a Baandari Pedlar Crown Crate, and Experience Scrolls. In addition to this, for digital pre-purchases only, you’ll receive immediate access to the Rahd-m’Athra mount! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7c87941f19fae658f930b6fa0ea429717b6fd173.jpg[/img]																																			      		    		      		        			  
[i]The otherworldly  Rahd-m’Athra mount[/i]
  
[i]Elsweyr[/i] will be available in the following editions:
        [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr Standard Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr  Digital Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr [i]Digital [/i]Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr [i]Digital [/i]Collector’s Edition Upgrade[/i][/*][/list]
The [i]Elsweyr Collector’s Edition[/i] comes with all the  pre-purchase bonuses in addition to a host of unique digital goodies. For more  information on each version of [i]Elsweyr[/i] and to find out which one is  right for you, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55537]editions article[/url], and you can pre-purchase [i]Elsweyr[/i] on our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Buy Now page[/url] right now!

[h1]Tamriel Burns[/h1]
The Season of the Dragon year-long adventure is unlike  anything we’ve ever released before, and [i]Elsweyr[/i] is a huge part of this epic  tale. We can’t wait to reveal everything that is coming to[i] ESO[/i]’s newest  Chapter and this massive, interconnected story, so keep an eye out for more  information in the coming months. 

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Elsweyr is coming to PC/Mac, Xbox  One, and PlayStation®4 on June 4. PC/Mac players can take part in Early Access  starting May 20.  [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Pre-purchase  Elsweyr now[/url] to receive unique bonus rewards and gain immediate access to  the Rahd-m’Athra in-game mount (conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Fight for your Alliance (or yourself) during the Midyear Mayhem PvP event!
notes.content:
[i]March into Cyrodiil and the Battlegrounds to contend with your fellow players during the action-packed Midyear Mayhem encore event. Learn about how you can earn double XP, Alliance Points, and additional rewards right here![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/c23cc228818e4be7011232c689c2770b8da6fd10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Midyear in Morningstar[/h1]
The Midyear Mayhem encore event begins on Thursday, January 10 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Monday, January 21 at 10:00AM EST. Throughout this merciless event, you’ll win bonus rewards by participating in the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and the fight to control the Imperial City. Here’s how you can get in on the action: 
[list][*]Navigate to the in-game Crown Store and acquire and activate the “Details on the Midyear Mayhem" ticket[/*]  
[*]Travel to your faction's main gate in Cyrodiil from the Alliance War menu[/*]  [*]Locate the NPC called “Predicant Maera" and acquire the quest titled “Midyear Mayhem"[/*][/list]
[list][*]Note if you already completed the quest last year, you  won't need to do it again[/*][/list]
[*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box[/*]
[*]Use the scroll to activate a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:[/*]
[list][*]Alliance Points gained[/*]
[*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*][/list][/list]

As always, you can keep the Scroll of Pelinal’s Ferocity and re-use it throughout the event. If you’ve lost your scroll, don’t worry, you can acquire another from Predicant Maera for 100 gold or 100 Alliance Points. 

[h1]Star-Made Glory[/h1]
As in previous events, you can earn a unique Midyear Mayhem collectible available only during this event: the Midyear Victor’s Laurel Wreath. 

To unlock this collectible, complete these seven Midyear Mayhem Achievements: 
[list][*][b]Mayhem Connoisseur: [/b]Receive the blessing of      the Whitestrake at one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]  [*][b]Echo of Pelinal's Fury:[/b] Read a Scroll of      Pelinal's Ferocity during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]  [*][b]Hand of the Whitestrake:[/b] Acquire your 25th      Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box.[/*]  [*][b]Wrath of the Whitestrake:[/b] Defeat 50 opponents      during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]  [*][b]Pelinavant the Scourge:[/b] Win a Battleground      match during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]  [*][b]Pelinaline the Bloody:[/b] Capture a Keep in      Cyrodiil during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]  [*][b]Pelinerrif Insurgent:[/b] Capture an Imperial      District during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*] [/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/ee56aaa30b9c544a40624597208d3701c12b744c.jpg[/img]	      		    		      		        																																													      		    		      		        
[i]The Star-Made Knight[/i]

Note that access to the [i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack is required in order to earn all of the above Achievements.

[h1]The Spoils of Victory[/h1]
When battling your fellow players in PvP during the Midyear Mayhem event, you’ll receive Pelinal’s Midyear Boon Boxes when you receive your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers AND as rewards from various PvP daily quests. These dailies include the repeatable Town, Battle, Bounty, Conquest, Scouting, and Warfront quests in Cyrodiil and the Battlegrounds repeatable quests. 

Pelina’s Midyear Boon Boxes have a chance to contain the following items: 
[list][*]Transmute Crystals[/*]  [*]Alchemy reagents[/*]  [*]PvP consumables such as repair kits, forward camps, and      siege weapons[/*]  [*]Motif pages for the Alliance and Akaviri styles[/*]  [*]Style items for your Alliance[/*]  [*]Akaviri style items[/*]  [*]Coldharbour siege weapons[/*]  [*]Prismatic Runestones[/*]  [*]Books of Pelinal housing items[/*] [/list]
In addition to this, during the event, harvesting nodes for both Cyrodiil and the Imperial City will drop double their regular resources, and the Cyrodiil merchant known as “The Golden” will stock Alliance War Legendary-quality jewelry (necklaces during the first weekend and rings during the second). Note that The Golden will not stock the PvP rings and necklaces introduced with Update 20. This includes Indomitable Fury, Spell Strategist, Battlefield Acrobat, Soldier of Anguish, Steadfast Hero, and Battalion Defender sets.

[h1]Claim Event Tickets[/h1]
Throughout Midyear Mayhem you can also earn Event Tickets and purchase the first of the Indrik Berries required to [b]evolve your Nascent Indrik[/b] mount into a [b]Dawnwood Indrik[/b] mount. This event’s berries are called [b]Dawnwood Berries of Bloom[/b].
[list][*]To earn Event Tickets during this event, complete any of the following PvP daily quests:[/*][*]Battleground quests from Battlemaster Rivyn[/*][*]Scouting, Bounty, Battle, Warfront, and Conquest Missions[/*][*]Elder Scroll capture and recapture quests[/*][*]Town quests in Vlastarus, Bruma, Cropsford, Cheydinhal, and Chorrol[/*][/list]
When you complete one of these quests, you’ll receive two Event Tickets in addition to your regular rewards. Note that you can earn only two tickets per day per account and they’ll reset at 1:00AM EST each morning.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6d1a1f101086064fe22d3455a86d1c2dd32f56ee.jpg[/img]      		    		      		        																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]Earn Indrik Berries for the Dawnwoond Indrik mount[/i]

Once you have acquired 10 Event Tickets, you can trade them in to the Impresario (located at a special booth in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon) for either an Indrik Feather or the new [b]Dawnwood Berries of Bloom[/b]. You can acquire 22 Event Tickets during this event, and the Impresario will continue to sell all Feathers throughout, meaning if you’re still working on getting your Nascent Indrik, you have a chance to catch up! For more information on acquiring the Indrik Berries, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55477]announcement article[/url].

[h1]Prepare for Battle[/h1]
Gather your forces and make ready for war - Midyear Mayhem is back! Bring ruin upon your enemies in Cyrodiil, the Battlegrounds, and the Imperial City to earn bonus rewards not available during any other event. Are you preparing to battle your fellow players and pick up your Indrik Berries? Let us know on Twitter @[url=http://www.twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=http://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Midyear Mayhem encore event begins on Thursday, January 10 at 10:00AM EST and will end on Monday, January 21 at 10:00AM EST. If your taste for battle is not sated after this event, don’t worry, we plan to bring Midyear Mayhem back again later in the year![/i]

notes.title: Get ready for ESO’s Next Big Announcement!
notes.content:
[i]The cat's out of bag! Ready yourself, adventurer. A massive announcement for The Elder Scrolls Online is on the way! Find out how you can learn about the upcoming ESO Chapter and what's coming to the game in 2019. [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/d67216c6074713b1381f2211b6ecd99973f80921.jpg[/img]

Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]Twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url] on [b]Tuesday, January 15 at 5:00PM EST[/b] to be one of the first to learn about the next exciting adventure in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. Join us as Creative Director Rich Lambert announces what is coming to [i]ESO[/i] in 2019 live to the world from the Twitch studio in San Francisco. 

Want to earn some amazing goodies? In addition to Twitch Drops (PC/Mac only), you and your fellow viewers could unlock amazing rewards for all, simply by watching the stream. As the show hits certain peak concurrent viewer count milestones, the following rewards will be unlocked:
[list][*][b]55k concurrent viewers[/b]: A unique Wallpaper based on the next Chapter’s concept art[/*][*][b]70k concurrent viewers[/b]: A Hot Pepper Bantam Guar pet for all [i]ESO[/i] players across all platforms[/*][*][b]90k concurrent viewers[/b]: Rich will commit to getting an [i]ESO[/i] tattoo somewhere (SFW) on his body![/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6d2a3a550903ebedc238055ea0a1c6528078dad3.jpg[/img]		      		    		      		        																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]The Hot Pepper Bantam Guar pet[/i]

However, that’s not all! Drop in early to check out the [i]ESO[/i] pre-stream show (full details coming soon), and be sure to stick around after the show as special community guests discuss the latest news with Rich and [i]ESO[/i] Community Managers Jessica Folsom and Gina Bruno!

It’ll be an amazing night of announcements, big-time reveals, and laughs, so be sure to join us on Tuesday, January 15 at 5:00PM EST for all the fun. See you there!

notes.title: Celebrate the New Life Festival for Bonus Rewards & XP!
notes.content:
[i]Earn bonus rewards, get double XP, and celebrate the end of the year in style during the New Life Festival. Learn about all the quests, collectibles, Achievements, and more you can enjoy during this end-of-year event![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/489000ebfa9219811d7c66bbffab475c0ae9a452.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Festival Returns[/h1]
The New Life Festival begins this Thursday, December 13, at 10:00AM EST and will run until Wednesday, January 2, at 10:00AM EST. If you’d like to take part in the festivities, pick up the New Life Festival Scroll from the in-game Crown Store and use it to find the New Life Herald, Breda, located south of Windhelm, Eastmarch. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6ae085dee366da43e04f5dfe9c7c9bfa67fd767b.jpg[/img]		      		    		      		        																																																												      		    		      		        
[i]Share a mead with Breda, the New Life Herald[/i]

Complete the initial quest titled “The New Life Festival” to unlock a host of New Life-themed and festive daily quests (nine in total) that have you bring cheer to every corner of Tamriel. Once you’ve completed your first New Life Festival quest, you’ll also have unlocked the Breda’s Bottomless Mead Mug collectible, which, in addition to greatly improving the mirth of those who imbibe, provides a two-hour, 100% boost to XP gains during the event period. This boon will stack with any other XP bonuses your character currently has, including those from XP scrolls or ESO Plus membership.

[h1]Receive Gift Boxes[/h1]
By taking part in the New Life Festival and completing the Herald’s quests, you’ll earn New Life Festival Gift Boxes. These celebratory containers house random items, including crafting materials, consumables, and style items. If you’re fortunate, you might also receive one of these rarer rewards, too: 
[list][*]Skinchanger Motif chapters[/*]  [*]New Life recipes[/*]  [*]New Life collectibles (packaged in Runeboxes and      tradeable):[/*]  [list][*]Sword-Swallower's Blade memento[/*]   [*]Juggler's Knives memento[/*]   [*]Fire-Breather's Torches memento[/*]   [*]Mud Ball Pouch memento[/*]   [*]Nordic Bather's Towel costume[/*]   [*]Colovian Filigreed Hood hat[/*]   [*]Colovian Fur Hood hat[/*]  [/list][*]A selection of lights, lamps, and lanterns for your home      to celebrate the Signal Fire Sprint[/*]  [*]Draughts of Stealth and Escape to celebrate the Trial of      Five-Clawed Guile[/*] [/list]
[b]New Life Charity Writs[/b]

In addition to the above rewards, New Life Festival Gift Boxes can now also include New Life Charity Writs! These new, event-exclusive writs task you with creating simple furnishing items to donate in the spirit of the season. Once you’ve completed one of these new writs, you can turn it into any writ return location for its item type. If you don’t have the recipe required to craft the writ, visit the relevant crafting vendor to pick it up. 

Of course, performing this good deed is its own reward, but in addition to a philanthropic sense of satisfaction, if you complete 12 Charity Writs on a single character, you’ll unlock the “Newly Charitable” Achievement, granting you the incredible Crystalfrost skin!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/88d3c737b630fe612ea3b0c2b639c2312ed9fc80.jpg[/img]					      		    		      		        																																																										      		    		      		        
[i]The Crystalfrost skin[/i]

[h1]Bring New Life to your Home[/h1]
Starting December 13, you can turn your house into a festive holiday home with exclusive furnishing items from Heralda Garscroft, the Holiday Achievement Furnisher. You can find her in Grahtwood, Stormhaven, and Deshaan. Here’s how you can unlock these uniquely merry furnishings: 
[list][*][b]The New Life Bonfire[/b] – Available for 10,000      gold once you complete the “Snow Bare Plunge" achievement[/*]  [*][b]The New Life Celebrant's Standard[/b] – Available      for 2,500 gold once you complete the “New Life Celebrant" achievement[/*] [/list]
Check the Achievement section of your Journal to review progress. 

[h1]Get Your Final Indrik Feather & Bonus Sweepstake Entry[/h1]
During the event, you can also earn Event Tickets and purchase the final Indrik Feather required to [b]unlock the Nascent Indrik mount[/b] (along with a #OurElderScrolls Sweepstakes bonus entry). This event’s feather is called the [b]Opaline Indrik Feather[/b].

To earn Event Tickets during this event, simply complete one of the nine New Life Festival daily quests. In addition to the New Life Festival Gift Box, you’ll receive one Event Ticket. Note that you can earn only one ticket per day per account, and they’ll reset at 1:00AM EST each morning. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a95625de83a18fd4f3d70e2d872664b945808fab.jpg[/img]					      		    		      		        																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]Get the last Indrik Feather to unlock this beautiful mount[/i]

Once you have acquired 10 Event Tickets, you can trade them in to the Impresario (located at a special booth in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon) for the Opaline[b] [/b]Indrik Feather. You can acquire 20 Event Tickets during this event, and the Impresario will continue to sell all previous Feathers throughout, meaning if you’ve missed some, you have a chance to catch up during the New Life Festival! For more information on acquiring the Nascent Indrik mount, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54935]announcement article[/url]. 

As with previous events, you can earn bonus entries into the #OurElderScrolls Sweepstakes by acquiring Indrik Feathers. For your chance to win amazing prizes, including a Grand Prize trip to BE3 2019, make sure you’ve entered by filling out [url=https://woobox.com/g2w7rq?]this form[/url]. For more information and official rules, visit the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/ourelderscrolls]#OurElderScrolls page[/url]. 

Finally, in addition to your Event Ticket, when you turn in your first New Life Festival daily quest, you will also receive a Mysterious Reward Box. Originally part of the earlier Undaunted Celebration, these boxes have a chance to include rare styles and collectibles. 

[h1]Seasonal Crown Store Items[/h1]
Throughout the event period, you can also acquire some merry seasonal items from the in-game Crown Store, including the beloved Garland Dapple Gray mount, the Winter Broadbrim Hat Pack, Sun’s Dusk Winter Hood, and Winter Scout’s Pack. These returning items are now on sale and can only be found in the Crown Store for a limited time. 

Don’t forget, you can now acquire the Enchanted Snow Globe Home, too. The entrance to this magical, wintery home can actually be found within the New Life tent, so don’t hesitate to check it out for yourself. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/bf2cfcd384eb3b9f735721801e1f5ced5cf86f39.jpg[/img]					      		    		      		        																																																											      		    		      		        
[i]The amazing Enchanted Snow Globe Home[/i]

In addition to the sale, from now until 2:00AM EST on January 1, 2019, you can earn a Snowcap Fledgling Gryphon pet when you gift Crown Store items this month. Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55273]announcement article[/url] for all the details.

[h1]Spread Holiday Cheer[/h1]
The New Life Festival begins soon, and it brings the spirit of the holiday season to all of Tamriel. How are you planning to bring in the New Year? Let us know if you’re going to make merry this holiday season on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url].

[i]The New Life Festival begins this Thursday, December 13, at 10:00AM EST and will run until Wednesday, January 2, at 10:00AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Experience The Elder Scrolls Online for Free this Week!
notes.content:
[i]Play The Elder Scrolls Online and experience Tamriel like never before during our Free Play Event![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a9c347537cb33d8ae61a8fd7ff1555f3a8db05ea.jpg[/img]

The Free Play Event will begin on Thursday, December 6 and will run through Tuesday, December 11. During this period, you can join millions of other adventurers in exploring Tamriel free on PC/Mac with no strings attached.

Here’s how you can take part in this event:
[list] [*]Navigate to the [u][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/freeplay]Free Play page[/url][/u][/*] [*]Select your platform[/*] [*]Download the game for your desired platform[/*] [*]Create an [i]ESO[/i] account and play![/*][/list]
During the Free Play Event, you’ll get access to ESO’s base game and [i]Morrowind[/i] DLC, allowing you to explore a massive world filled with beauty and adventure as you fight to restore the demi-god Vivec’s lost powers and reclaim your stolen soul from the Daedric Prince Molag Bal. In addition to this, [i]ESO[/i]’s base game also includes access to Cyrodiil, a massive open-world PvP zone, and the Battlegrounds, a fast-paced 4v4v4 PvP arena. Even if you already own [i]ESO[/i] but never acquired the [i]Morrowind[/i] DLC or Chapter, you’ll be able to travel to Vvardenfell and experience the home of the Dark Elves during the event period. 

All new [i]ESO[/i] accounts receive 500 free crowns for use in the in-game Crown Store, allowing you to pick up some useful items that include XP Scrolls, consumables, or even collectibles. Any characters and progression earned from previous trial events will remain, and if you decide to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]buy [i]ESO[/i][/url] after the event, you’ll be able to continue your adventures without interruption.

The [i]ESO[/i] game client is approximately 80 GB in size, so ensure you have enough space on your machine's hard drive for the download.

[h1]Welcome to ESO[/h1]
A whole world of adventure awaits you in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], so be sure to visit our Free Play page to get started. During the event, you can also [url=https://woobox.com/g2w7rq?]sign up[/url] for the #OurElderScrollsSweepstakes for a chance to win some amazing prizes, including a Grand Prize trip to BE3 2019. For more information and official rules, check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/ourelderscrolls]#OurElderScrolls[/url] page. Are you going to visit Tamriel during the Free Play Event? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Earn an In-Game Pet When You Gift Crown Store Items in December
notes.content:
[i]In the spirit of the holiday season, you will receive an in-game pet as a gift from us when you use the Crown Store Gifting system to bring joy to others.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a99a963a79b286ff5894c9b757d38ddef200eeaf.jpg[/img]

Has your guildie or friend had their eye on a fancy pet or mount? Perhaps you want to help a new player get off to a fast start with some XP Scrolls? During the month of December, we’re rewarding everybody who loves to gift their fellow players Crown Store items with a brand-new pet!

This holiday season, when you gift 1000 Crowns or more worth of items to two or more different [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] players, we’ll send you an adorable Snowcap Fledgling Gryphon pet!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4c15a8aa7f69452bb95fe7cd1596b00a9e5af149.jpg[/img]
					      		    		      		        
Here’s everything you need to know:

[list][*]Gifting must occur between 2:00 AM EST on December 1, 2018 and 2:00AM EST on January 1, 2019[/*][*]You must send a gift to at least two different individual accounts[/*][*]The total value of all gifts must be at least 1000 Crowns or more on the [b]same platform and region[/b][/*][list][*][b]Note[/b]: NOT 1000 Crowns per gift, but 1000 Crowns total. Two individual gifts that are valued at 500 Crowns each would count, as would three gifts each valued at 400 Crowns. However, if you sent a gift worth 500 Crowns on the PC NA server and another worth 500 Crowns on the Xbox One NA server, it would not count.  [/*][/list][*]You will receive your Snowcap Fledgling Gryphon pet after the promotion’s end by January 4, 2019. [/*][/list]

[h1]How to Gift[/h1]
To send your friend a gift, navigate to the item you wish to buy in the Crown Store and select the “Purchase as Gift" option, then enter their UserID, Gamertag, or PSN ID, depending on your platform. You can then personalize your gift with a custom-made or a pre-selected message. Note that homes cannot be gifted. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/796fbcd70f4a03870fb66d46d4faea7cfccf9957.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Gift consumables, collectibles, and more![/i]

You can view all the currently available items, including pets, mounts, costumes, and more on our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store page,[/url] and you can stock up on Crowns on our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crowns]Buy Crowns page[/url]. 

Don’t forget, this promotion kicks off on December 1, 2019 at 2:00AM EST and it will run until January 1, 2019 at 2:00AM EST. Happy gifting!

notes.title: Delve into the Undaunted Celebration Event & Earn Bonus Rewards
notes.content:
[i]Take on Tamriel’s dungeons and earn bonus rewards during the Undaunted Celebration Event. Learn everything you need to know to get started, including how to earn more Event Tickets! [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/724305e39729758c56a25e2a5e8d50af8ca4e991.jpg[/img]

[h1]We Are Undaunted![/h1]
The Undaunted Celebration Event kicks off on Thursday, November 29 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Wednesday, December 5 at 10:00AM EST. During the event period, you can complete a random dungeon using the Dungeon Finder (Normal or Veteran) to earn Mysterious Reward Boxes, with a max of one box rewarded per character per day. 

A Mysterious Reward Box has a chance to include some useful items and collectibles, including style pages, costumes, pets, mounts, and (in some rare cases) homes. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/25dabf03c51bf0139b206103e4048a0570558993.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/fd61ae1fdbfb34e2a9f5c8e2df828b8859b7e60d.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/dffb12ac2aceb0c64e36a05c97d24efb76ef1d36.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1930a993d71e38af016662a49d03604a543a1f16.jpg[/img][/url]																													      		    		      		        
[i]Frostbane Saber Cat mount & Grand Topal Hideaway home[/i]

If you’re lucky enough, you might even win the ultra-rare jackpot prize and receive [b]over 130 mounts at once[/b]! This jackpot reward even includes mounts from previous Crown Crate seasons. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/e92dc9629831656cce8651b582343cb576cf575c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/74af5e5278d49a653c537efd05302bb382316035.jpg[/img][/url]	[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/78743b9446a3697e98fcf107b29002b2e590355a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8fd830afaed0f301ce2641c3bd74227c317798b9.jpg[/img][/url]																												      		    		      		        
[i]Dwarven Horse & Hollowjack Daedra-Skull Wolf mounts (available as part of the jackpot prize)[/i] 

Here’s what you need to do to participate:
[list][*]Navigate to the Group & Activity Finder[/*]  [*]Select Dungeon Finder[/*]  [*]Select either Random Normal Dungeon or Random Veteran      Dungeon[/*]  [*]Select your role (DPS, healing, or tanking) and queue up[/*] [/list]
In order to earn a Mysterious Reward Box, you will need to complete the dungeon by defeating its final boss.

[b]Note[/b]: You receive Mysterious Reward Boxes as part of your character's daily random dungeon rewards. Once one of your characters has completed their dungeon daily and has received the rewards, you will not be able to get additional ones for that same character for 20 hours (the typical dungeon daily cooldown).

[h1]Event Tickets & Sweepstakes Entries[/h1]
During the Undaunted Celebration Event, you can earn additional Event Tickets and pick up the third of the four Indrik Features (along with a #OurElderScrolls Sweepstakes bonus entry) required to summon the Nascent Indrik Mount. This event’s feather is called the [b]Onyx Indrik Feather[/b].

To earn Event Tickets during this event, complete a dungeon by defeating its final boss. In addition to the regular rewards the boss drops, you’ll receive three Event Tickets. Note that you can only earn these three tickets once per day per account and they’ll reset at 1:00AM EST each morning.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1c45bad4823810292727503f05eb06bde985ee76.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Don’t miss out on your Indrik Mount![/i]

Once you have acquired 10 Event Tickets, you can trade them in to the Impresario (located at a special booth in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon) for the Onyx Indrik Feather. For more information on acquiring the Nascent Indrik mount, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54935]announcement article[/url].

Don’t forget, you can earn bonus entries into the #OurElderScrolls Sweepstakes by collecting Indrik Feathers. For your chance to win some amazing prizes, including a Grand Prize trip to BE3 2019, make sure you’ve entered by filling out [url=https://woobox.com/g2w7rq?]this form[/url]. For more information and official rules, check out the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/ourelderscrolls]#OurElderScrolls page[/url] for everything you need to know. Good luck!

[h1]Get Ready for Adventure[/h1]
Ready your party and prepare your supplies, the Undaunted Celebration Event is about to begin. Tamriel’s dungeons are fraught with danger, but the rewards for delving into these 4-player challenges have never been greater. Are you excited for the Undaunted Celebration? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]! 

[i]The Undaunted Celebration Event begins on Thursday, November 29 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Wednesday, December 5 at 10:00AM EST. [/i]

notes.title: Explore a Mechanical Marvel during the Clockwork City Celebration Event!
notes.content:
[i]Return to Sotha Sil’s greatest creation during the Clockwork City Celebration Event and earn double rewards from daily quests, bosses, and resource nodes. This is also your next opportunity to earn Event Tickets and Indrik Feathers – read more here![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7c4089a1634fd96f31d583a92dacb2dec2d20274.jpg[/img]

[h1]Return to the City[/h1]
The Clockwork City Celebration Event begins on Thursday, November 15 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Monday, November 26 at 10:00AM EST. During this period, you can earn additional rewards for the following activities within the zone: 
[list][*]Double items harvested from crafting nodes[/*][list][*]Including Jewelry seams, but does not include nodes spawned from Survey Reports and Fishing Holes[/*][/list][*]Double the reward boxes from completing Daily Quests[/*][*]Double the drops from bosses[/*][list][*]Including World Bosses, Delve Bosses, Trials Bosses, and Quest Bosses[/*][/list][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4005f57f975c2c3f4091e3039a8ec1e98e1d1727.jpg[/img]																																	      		    		      		        
[i]Battle the Imperfect for double rewards![/i]

To enter the city and begin your adventure: 
[list][*]Find Divayth Fyr's messenger in Mournhold's City Center and acquire the quest “To The Clockwork City"[/*][*]Travel to the Clockwork City and the Brass Fortress directly via your map[/*][/list][list][*]Like Coldharbour, it is located “outside" Tamriel on the world map[/*][/list]
Finally, if you’re entering the Brass Fortress for the first time, you’ll also receive the Scintillant Dovah-Fly pet completely free – even if you’ve gained access via the ESO Plus Free Trial!

[h1]Get Your Event Tickets[/h1]
During the Clockwork City Celebration Event, you have another chance to pick up Event Tickets and acquire the second of the four Indrik Feathers needed to summon your very own Indrik mount.

To earn Event Tickets during the event, complete the zone’s Daily Quests (located within the Brass Fortress). You will receive two Event Tickets from the first Daily Quest you complete each day in addition to the other regular rewards. Note that the Event Tickets are tied to the Daily Quest timer, meaning they’ll reset at 1:00AM EST.

Don’t forget, once you have acquired 10 Event Tickets, you can trade them in to the Impresario (located at a special booth in Daggerfall in Glenumbra, Davon's Watch in Stonefalls, and Vulkhel Guard in Auridon) for an Indrik Feather. For more information on acquiring the Nascent Indrik mount, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54935]announcement article[/url]. 

[h1]Pick Up Clockwork City on Sale[/h1]
If you don’t already own the [i]Clockwork City[/i] DLC game pack, you can acquire it during the event for a discounted price. The standard DLC game pack will be on sale for 1400 crowns (30% off) from November 15 until November 27, and the [i]Clockwork City [/i]Collector’s Bundle will be available for 2400 crowns (40% off) from November 15 until November 21. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/27e21a2ce427c48b05b6f130d4282fca123831c8.jpg[/img]																																		      		    		      		        
[i]The Clockwork City Collector’s Bundle[/i]

The [i]Clockwork City[/i] Collector’s Bundle includes the DLC game pack, the Clockwork Skeevaton pet, the Kagouti Fabricant mount, and Five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find both the base DLC game pack and the Collector’s Bundle in the Featured section of the Crown Store. 

Don’t forget, the ESO Plus Trial Event will also begin on November 15, giving you an opportunity to try out ESO Plus membership and gain access to the [i]Clockwork City[/i] DLC game pack completely free! Find everything you need to know about the ESO Plus Trial Event in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55165]announcement article[/url]. 

[h1]Explore the Clockwork God’s Legacy[/h1]
Hidden from the prying eyes of both mortals and Daedra alike, the Clockwork City is a realm outside of Tamriel designed and built by Sotha Sil himself. It is a place as mysterious as it is dangerous, filled with factotum servants and vicious fabricant monsters. Are you planning to return to the Clockwork City? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]! 

[i]The Clockwork City Celebration Event begins on Thursday, November 15 at 10:00AM EST and will run until Monday, November 26 at 10:00AM EST.[/i]

notes.title: Enjoy The Benefits of Membership During our ESO Plus Free Trial!
notes.content:
[i]Curious about ESO Plus[/i]™[i]? You can check out select ESO Plus  benefits during the upcoming free trial with no strings attached! If you’re  already a member, learn about the all-new rewards coming for all existing ESO  Plus members.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6bfd688821cb1f87779723280a848c26bfbc85d7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Check out ESO Plus[/h1]
The ESO Plus Free Trial Event begins on Thursday, November 15 at  10:00AM EST and will run until Wednesday, November 21 at 10:00AM EST. During  the event, you can try out ESO Plus completely free with absolutely no strings  attached (and no credit card required), giving you access to the following  benefits: 
                [list][*]Full access to DLC game packs – new zones, quests, dungeons, and  more[/*][list][*]Includes the [i]Imperial City[/i], [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Thieves  Guild[/i], [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i], [i]Shadows of the Hist[/i], [i]Horns  of the Reach[/i], [i]Clockwork City, Dragon Bones[/i], [i]Morrowind (zone  and story), Wolfhunter, and Murkmire[/i][/*][/list][*]A Craft Bag offering you unlimited storage for all of your  crafting materials[/*][*]Double Bank space for all the characters on your account[/*][*]10% increase to Experience and Gold acquisition, Crafting  Inspiration, and Trait Research rates[/*][*]Double Furnishings and Collectibles space in player housing[/*][*]Exclusive ability to dye costumes[/*][*]Double Transmute Crystal storage[/*][/list]
Note that the monthly crown stipend and upcoming ESO Plus  deals are available to paid members only. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7a6fb2d8cc5f2f8944b17cc24e815666717c9dd6.jpg[/img]			      		    		      		        																																																												      		    		      		        
[i]Get access to the Craft Bag![/i]

If you don’t own the [i]Clockwork City[/i] DLC game pack, this is the perfect opportunity to earn Event Tickets and its associated Indrik Feather during the upcoming Clockwork City Celebration Event (more details soon). For more information about how you can unlock the new Indrik mount simply by playing the game, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54935]announcement article[/url].

Here's what you need to do to try out ESO Plus and enjoy some of the above benefits completely free:
[list][*]Log into [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i].[/*][*]Navigate to the Crown Store.[/*][*]Select the ESO Plus tab.[/*][*]Select “Free Trial!”[/*][/list]
You don't need to provide a credit card or any other account info to check out ESO Plus. Simply go to the in-game Crown Store and activate it. Easy!

[h1]New Rewards for Members[/h1]
As [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/54825]previously announced[/url], we’re continuously working to improve the value of ESO Plus and show our appreciation for our many existing members. So, from November 13, as an existing paid member, you’ll be able to benefit from an increase of the monthly crown stipend from 1500 to 1650 crowns and enjoy a host of new, exclusive rewards every month. 

These new membership-only features include special deals, unique items (including free collectibles), and timed Crown Store exclusives. For example, starting November 13, ALL ESO Plus members will be able to acquire the Molag Bal statuette for FREE until December 6! For more information on what is coming to the Crown Store exclusively for ESO Plus members, check out our latest [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/55169]Crown Store Showcase article[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/857f1ec39d45dd99546e3b7e8121387051054061.jpg[/img]				      		    		      		        																																																										      		    		      		        
[i]The Molag Bal statuette – perfect for the coffee table[/i]
