notes.title: Prepare for Battle! The Midyear Mayhem PvP Event Returns
notes.content:
[i]Glory awaits those who fight for themselves or their Alliance during the Midyear Mayhem PvP event. Celebrate the legendary warrior Pelinal Whitestrake and earn double XP, Alliance Points, and bonus rewards by taking part in ESO's PvP game modes![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/cd0a8c78a0862be99bd331b4d849f64d108a9033.jpg[/img]

[h1]Capture Bonus XP and AP[/h1]
	The Midyear Mayhem event begins on Thursday, July 26 at 10:00AM EDT and will end on Monday, August 6 at 10:00AM EDT. During this time, you can win honor and bonus rewards by following the steps below:
[list]	[*]Visit the in-game Crown Store and acquire and activate the “Details on the Midyear Mayhem" ticket[/*]	[*]Travel to your Alliance War faction's main gate in Cyrodiil using the Alliance War menu[/*]	[*]Find the NPC called “Predicant Maera" and pick up the quest “Midyear Mayhem"	[list]		[*]Note if you already completed the quest last year, you won't need to do it again[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Complete the quest to receive your Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and a Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box[/*]	[*]Use the scroll to enjoy a two-hour, 100% buff in the Alliance War, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds to:	[list]		[*]Alliance Points gained [/*]		[*]XP gains for PvP player kills[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0b200db0d0e44baf00fee9ac3c70bd8548e51657.jpg[/img]

	You are able to keep the Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity and re-use it for the duration of the event. If you already completed the quest in last year's event, the scroll you received then will work, too. If you previously earned the scroll and misplaced it, don't worry, you can pick up another from Predicant Maera for 100 gold or 100 Alliance Points.

	To ensure you're able to take the field, we are opening up two additional 7-day CP Alliance War campaigns during the event, and have additional ones ready to go if needed. There's never been a better time to fight for control of the Imperial province.

[h1]Become the Star-Made Knight[/h1]
	Those who claim victory on the field of battle can earn themselves a special collectible that is only available during the Midyear Mayhem event: the Midyear Victor's Laurel Wreath.

	To earn this glorious headdress, you must unlock the “Star-Made Knight" achievement by completing each of the seven Midyear Mayhem event Achievements:
[list]	[*][b]Mayhem Connoisseur: [/b]Receive the blessing of the Whitestrake at one of the Alliance Gates during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]	[*][b]Echo of Pelinal's Fury:[/b] Read a Scroll of Pelinal's Ferocity during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]	[*][b]Hand of the Whitestrake:[/b] Acquire your 25th "Pelinal's Midyear Boon Box".[/*]	[*][b]Wrath of the Whitestrake:[/b] Defeat 50 opponents during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]	[*][b]Pelinavant the Scourge:[/b] Win a Battleground match during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]	[*][b]Pelinaline the Bloody:[/b] Capture a Keep in Cyrodiil during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*]	[*][b]Pelinerrif Insurgent:[/b] Capture an Imperial District during the Midyear Mayhem.[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/382a644e6ff919751b24b93db0b1c2679b0b45fc.jpg[/img]

	These Achievements require you to participate in both the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and Imperial City matches. This means you must own the 	[i]Imperial City[/i] DLC game pack in order to earn all the required Achievements.

[h1]To the Victor go the Spoils[/h1]
	As you earn glory in PvP, you'll receive Pelina's Midyear Boon Boxes in addition to your regular Rewards for the Worthy containers. This year, you can also earn the Boon Boxes from the repeatable Town, Battle, Bounty, Conquest, Scouting, and Warfront quests in Cyrodiil as well as the Battlegrounds repeatable quests, too.

	These unique event boxes contain Tel Var Stones and a chance to receive one of these items:
[list]	[*]Transmute Crystals[/*]	[*]Alchemy reagents[/*]	[*]PvP consumables such as repair kits, forward camps, and siege weapons[/*]	[*]Motif pages for the Alliance and Akaviri styles[/*]	[*]Style items for your Alliance[/*]	[*]Akaviri style items[/*]	[*]Coldharbour siege weapons[/*]	[*]Prismatic Runestones[/*]	[*]Books of Pelinal housing items[/*][/list]
	During the event, all nodes in Cyrodiil and the Imperial City will drop double their regular resources, and the Cyrodiil PvP merchant Adhazabi Aba-daro (known as “The Golden") will stock Alliance War Legendary-quality jewelry. In the first week of the event, you are able to purchase necklaces, and in the second week, you can acquire rings. You can find Adhazabi in the Western Elsweyr Gate, Northern High Rock Gate, or Southern Morrowind Gate once you enter Cyrodiil.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/f1310517ab9ee8dd964b2bae75e0c9ffbb978eab.jpg[/img]

	Finally, you can get into the spirit of the Midyear Mayhem event and truly honor Pelinal Whitestrake by picking up the Star-Made Wolfshead costume from the in-game Crown Store from July 26 until July 30.

[h1]Take On Your Fellow Players[/h1]
	Glory awaits those who fight in the Alliance War, Battlegrounds, and Imperial City. Are you readying yourself for war? Whether you're fighting for your Alliance, your team, or yourself, now is the time to strike out and dive into 	[i]ESO[/i]'s exciting PvP. Let us know whether you're planning to take on your fellow players during the Midyear Mayhem event on Twitter @[url=http://www.twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=http://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

	[i]The Midyear Mayhem event begins on Thursday, July 26 at 10:00AM EDT and will end on Monday, August 6 at 10:00AM EDT.[/i]

notes.title: Trial ESO Plus or Get Crown Crates Free During our Bonus Event
notes.content:
[i]Thinking about ESO Plus™ membership? Take part in our upcoming Bonus Event to enjoy select ESO Plus benefits free. Already a member? You can earn up to six Psijic Vault Crown Crates simply by logging into the game! Read on to learn more about the next ESO Plus Bonus Event.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/5d416e809364a994a6d48b2247542b0fc4bcc0c7.jpg[/img]

	The ESO Plus Bonus Event begins on Tuesday, July 10 at 10:00AM EDT and will run until Monday, July 16 at 10:00AM EDT. During the event, ESO Plus members can earn up to six free Crown Crates just by logging into the game. If you're not already a member, don't worry, you can trial select ESO Plus benefits completely free for the event period. No strings attached!

[h1]Earn Up to 6 Crown Crates[/h1]
	To show our appreciation for existing ESO Plus members, we're giving out up to six free Psijic Vault Crown Crates during the event.

	The Psijic Vault Crown Crates contain a host of strange and powerful items hidden from Tamriel for centuries by the monastic order. These items include fantastic beasts, mysterious collectibles and styles, and a selection of useful consumables.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/2c62734aed50090f51ae4392f678578180528eae.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Psijic Horse Exemplar mount[/i][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/303be53d18e31f58fc1c7bba45dfdb8ca9002b83.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Skein Scorpion pet[/i][/b]

	You can discover some of items available in Psijic Vault Crown crates in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26413]announcement article[/url].

	To take part in the ESO Plus Bonus Event, log into the game with an active paid ESO Plus membership (the free trial does not count, sorry) each day from July 10 until July 15. Note that in order to qualify, each unique login must occur within a 24-hour time period that starts at 10:00AM EDT and ends at 10:00AM EDT the next day. If you remain logged in over a two-day period, it will only count as a single entry. You must log completely out of the game and back in – only logging out to the character select screen will not work. The free Crown Crates will be delivered to your account by Friday, July 20. Check your Crown Crates menu!

[h1]Trial ESO Plus Free[/h1]
	During the event period, you can enjoy select ESO Plus benefits free for a limited time with no strings attached. This includes the following:
[list]	[*]Full access to DLC game packs – new zones, quests, dungeons, and more	[list]		[*]Includes the [i]Imperial City[/i], [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Thieves Guild[/i], [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i], [i]Shadows of the Hist[/i], [i]Horns of the Reach[/i], [i]Clockwork City, Dragon Bones[/i], and [i]Morrowind (zone and story)[/i][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A Craft Bag offering you unlimited storage for all of your crafting materials[/*]	[*]Double Bank space for all the characters on your account[/*]	[*]10% increase to Experience and Gold acquisition, Crafting Inspiration, and Trait Research rates[/*]	[*]Double Furnishings and Collectibles space in player housing[/*]	[*]Exclusive ability to dye costumes [/*]	[*]Double Transmute Crystal storage[/*][/list]
	(Note that the monthly stipend of 1500 Crowns available to paid members only.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a4bfaf78bf5f6a2fd8b6f3ac3e19035aa2504eb7.jpg[/img]

	Here's what you need to do to trial ESO Plus and enjoy some of the above benefits completely free:
[list]	[*]Log into [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i].[/*]	[*]Navigate to the Crown Store.[/*]	[*]View the “Featured" category.[/*]	[*]Find and select the ESO Plus Free Trial.[/*][/list]
	You don't need to provide credit card or any other account info to check out ESO Plus. Simply go to the in-game Crown Store and activate it. Easy!

[h1]Giving Back to ESO Plus Members[/h1]
	We love sharing and celebrating ESO Plus with the community. Are you thinking about picking up membership? Test it out yourself for free! Let us know if you're going to check out ESO Plus or earn some free Crown Crates this event on Twitter @	[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url].

	[i]The ESO Plus Bonus Event begins at 10:00AM EDT Tuesday, June 10 and ends at 10:00AM EDT Monday July 16 on all platforms. [/i]

notes.title: Wolfhunter & Update 19 Preview
notes.content:
[i]Are you predator or prey? Answer the call of the Great Hunt and face Hircine's beasts in Wolfhunter, The Elder Scrolls Online's next DLC game pack. Scout out two brand-new dungeons and Update 19 in this preview article.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/66de3b0a38778d0c6801a24918cbe24557d59da8.jpg[/img]

	The 	[i]Wolfhunter[/i] DLC game pack will be free to all ESO Plus members and available for purchase from the in-game Crown Store. This new DLC game pack challenges teams with two exciting werewolf-themed dungeons: March of Sacrifices and Moon Hunter Keep.

	Update 19 will be available alongside the new dungeon pack and brings a series of improvements and new features free for all players, including a new Battlegrounds map, Alliance War changes, a new Skill respec update, and improvements to the Werewolf Skill Line!

[h1]Confront Hircine's Legacy[/h1]
	When decreed by Hircine, the Daedric Prince hosts the Great Hunt within his realm. In 	[b]March of Sacrifices[/b], you and your team must escape Hircine's Hunting Grounds, a place of perpetual conflict between predator and prey, by participating in his dangerous game. Your target: A powerful Indrik. Your rewards: A boon from the Daedric Prince himself!

	However, you are not the only hunters competing to win Hircine's favor, and you'll quickly discover that many have been invited to participate. Be warned: As you stalk and fight your way through this extraordinary Daedric realm, you might find that you yourselves are the ones hunted!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/6dad262a49a0de9ea100e1e0455846c14e52809a.jpg[/img]

	In the second dungeon, an ancient werewolf of incredible power named Vykosa has captured [b]Moon Hunter Keep[/b] and destroyed the Order of the Silver Dawn's garrison. Now, Vykosa draws more and more of Tamriel's were-beasts to her cause, and she has begun to amass a monstrous army.

	You and your team must enter the once-proud headquarters of the Order, battle your way through hordes of were-beasts and other monsters, make your way to the heart of the keep, and confront Vykosa herself before she threatens all of Tamriel.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/5d99be9b2104901d51ff83e7584c2cb10e3277c5.jpg[/img]

	Of course, both [b]March of Sacrifices[/b] and [b]Moon Hunter Keep[/b] are packed full of ferocious new monsters and bosses (including the new werewolf behemoth!) and they can both be completed in Normal, Veteran, and Veteran Hard Mode to challenge you and your group. Should you and your team face Hircine's beasts and survive, you can earn new gear sets, monster masks, and unique collectibles. In addition to this, once you enter either of the two new dungeons, you will receive the Werewolf Hunter Hat, only available in the [i]Wolfhunter[/i] DLC game pack!

[h1]New Battleground & PvP Update[/h1]
	Update 19 is a free base-game update for all [i]ESO[/i] players arriving alongside the [i]Wolfhunter[/i] DLC. This update includes an all-new Battlegrounds map and AvA additions for Tamriel's PvPers. Don't forget, since Update 18, Battlegrounds were moved to the base game and can be enjoyed by all!

	[b]Istirus Outpost (Battleground)[/b]

	This new arena is located along Cyrodiil's southwest border, and features fortified stone structures and walls that should seem familiar to those who fight in the Alliance War. Istirus Outpost, however, has some unique twists that set it apart from other arenas. Firstly, the map is only semi-symmetrical, meaning how you navigate the arena will differ depending on your team. In previous Battlegrounds, each team has been able to move around the arena more-or-less the same way, but now you must develop your map knowledge early to ensure you can navigate it as quickly as possible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/f400700e708b660824b4e4aed1cf97555ff20a7e.jpg[/img]

	[b][/b]To help with this, Istirus Outpost is also the first Battleground to allow players to mount. This'll bring a faster pace to the arena, but it will also be welcome relief for Stamina PvPers who no longer need to expend resources to get to the fight. Mount up!

	[b]AvA Changes and Additions[/b]

	Update 19 also shakes up the open-world PvP of the Alliance War with the addition of Keep Recall Stones. These new items give you and your fellow warriors the ability to traverse Cyrodiil like never before. Finally, Update 19 reintroduces keep degradation and condenses both the levels for Keeps and Resources. With these changes, it is as important as ever to capture Resources, giving small group or solo players meaningful ways to contribute to the war. Keep an eye out for new AvA and Battlegrounds rewards, too, including the Gladiator costume and all-new Battlegrounds Outfit styles!

[h1]Base-Game Update[/h1]
	In addition to the new PvP features, Update 19 also brings a host of quality-of-life improvements and additions.

	[b]Respec 2.0[/b]

	With Update 19, you are able to make smaller, more precise changes to your Skills thanks to the updated respec system. With this update, when you reset your Skill Points, you are able to remove Skills individually and are not forced to re-add all of them from scratch, much like how you respec your Champion Points. You can clear all your Skill Points like normal if desired, but this new system will mean that if you only want to make a small change to your character's Abilities, you can!

	[b]Werewolves Updated[/b]

	If you have a character that carries the curse of lycanthropy, you can enjoy a series of broad improvements and changes to how the Werewolf Skill Line plays with Update 19. These changes place an emphasis on improving their ferocity and momentum in combat, and they affect both the Skill Line's Passive and Active Abilities. For example, the Blood Rage Passive will now increase the duration of your transformation when you deal damage instead of when you take it, and the Roar Active Ability is now instant cast.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a8c9bed1bf47109685233780bdff005e9906c374.jpg[/img]

	There are many more updates, improvements, and fixes coming with Update 19, including some Class changes based on feedback from the 	[i]ESO[/i] community. For more details on what is coming, be sure to check out the Patch Notes forum when they go live!

[h1]Join the Great Hunt [/h1]
	With the 	[i]Wolfhunter[/i] DLC game pack and Update 19, Hircine's curse has taken hold in Tamriel and beyond. Are you prepared to face the March of Sacrifices and Moon Hunter Keep dungeons? Whether you are man or beast, let us know on Twitter @[url=http://www.twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=http://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

	[i]The Wolfhunter DLC game pack is coming soon for ESO Plus members and the in-game Crown Store. This new DLC game pack will arrive with Update 19, a free base-game update for all ESO players.[/i]

notes.title: ESO: Summerset & Update 18 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Explore the home of the High Elves in The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset, the latest Chapter in The Elder Scrolls Online saga. Find out everything you need to know about this new adventure and Update 18 in this launch article![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/5c2e5c313c152f8ba1341cb38da42a136025ef5b.jpg[/img]

	We are thrilled to announce that [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i] and Update 18 are now both live on PC and Mac.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/91575844d4bbc5c98f28740e5017724527561850.jpg[/img]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/CnpTgepe1tA]Click here to view the full Summerset - Official Cinematic Trailer.[/url][/b]

	Don't forget, there's still time to 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]pre-purchase [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i][/url][i] [/i]to receive the Queen's Bounty Pack, the Nightmare Senche mount, and a bonus copy of the [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter (digital pre-purchases only).

[h1]Summerset Chapter[/h1]
	For the first time in history, Queen Ayrenn of the Aldmeri Dominion has decreed that Summerset's borders are to be opened to foreigners. However, a mysterious threat looms over the island, and Daedric forces have begun to emerge from the shadows. Travel to the island of Summerset, gather your allies, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of Tamriel.

	This new Chapter includes:
[list]	[*]A new zone to explore: Summerset[/*]	[*]An epic new story featuring new and returning characters such as Razum-dar[/*]	[*]The Psijic Order guild & Skill Line[/*]	[*]A new crafting system: Jewelry Crafting[/*]	[*]A new 12-player Trial: Cloudrest[/*]	[*]New item sets, collectibles, and styles[/*][/list]
	[b]Explore a Massive New Zone [/b]

	On the island of Summerset, you will find shining cities, a pristine wilderness, and the ancient culture of the proud High Elves. However, upon closer examination, you'll also discover many dangers: monstrous beasts, long-forgotten ruins, ancient enemies, and a dark malevolence that lurks beneath the surface of the fabled land.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a686e7b97384dffdc0f1c01db3ff3eb564d4807a.jpg[/img]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/apvtUsvnj7w]Click here to view the full Journey to Summerset Trailer.[/url][/b]

	As you explore the island, you'll discover World Bosses, Public Dungeons, Delves, a new group challenge called Abyssal Geysers, and all manner of quests and adventures. You can read more about some of the adventures you can have when traveling through Summerset in 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26395]our preview article[/url].

	[b]Experience an Epic New Story[/b]

	An ancient evil plots from the shadows, and Queen Ayrenn needs your help to investigate the rising threat on Summerset and put a stop to it before it can spread to all of Tamriel. As you and your companions investigate, you shall encounter both new and familiar allies, travel all over the Isle of Summerset, and confront a deadly Daedric conspiracy.

	[b]Join the Psijic Order[/b]

	350 years ago, the mysterious organization known as the Psijic Order and their island home of Artaeum vanished from the face of Tamriel. In this new Chapter, you can travel to the island's new location, become a member of their ancient monastic order, and help the Psijics seal destructive time breaches that threaten reality itself!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/61eb75c8d40ef8fef8e2d270af028190773c3a1f.jpg[/img]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/EbwxHi-63Ag]Click here to view the full Join the Psijic Order Trailer.[/url][/b]

	The Psijics are masters of mysticism and the Old Ways, and should you become a member, you'll unlock a brand-new Skill Line. These powerful Abilities can be acquired by any of your [i]ESO[/i] characters and allow you to control time itself! Lean more about the Psijic Order Skill Line in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26381]our preview article[/url].

	[b]Craft Your Own Jewelry[/b]

	With [i]ESO: Summerset[/i], you'll be able to create your own custom-made rings and necklaces. Jewelry Crafting Stations can now be found throughout Summerset and the rest of Tamriel, and you'll be able to acquire specific Jewelry Trait items and materials by completing set activities.

	Find out everything you need to know about Jewelry Crafting with 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26357?Check-out-Jewelry-Crafting-With-this-Preview-&-Guide]our preview and guide[/url].

	[b]Save Cloudrest[/b]

	The city of Cloudrest has gone dark, and Summerset's gryphon-riding knight protectors, the Welkynar, have vanished. In this 12-player Trial, you and your team must enter the city, battle your way through the shadows, and put a stop to the ancient foe at the heart of its corruption. Discover the dangers you must face atop Eton Nir with our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26389?Face-the-Welkynar-in-Cloudrest,-The-Elder-Scrolls-Online%E2%80%99s-Newest-Trial]Cloudrest preview article[/url].

[h1]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h1]
	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i] is available in multiple editions, including a Standard Edition, Collector's Editions, and Upgrade Editions for those who already own the [i]ESO[/i] base game. Note that in order to run [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i], your machine needs to meet the game's requirements for [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0000_pc%20en.jpg]PC[/url] or [url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Chapter/Summerset/System/system%20requirements%20_0001_mac%20en.jpg]Mac[/url].

	In addition to the 	[i]Summerset[/i] Chapter, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Digital Collector's Edition[/i] and [i]Digital Collector's Edition Upgrade[/i] includes a host of unique digital items, including a unique mount, pet, outfit style and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/343b2ff7e1e299f66c24c9e9f224801848a4f8d2.jpg[/img]

	The 	[i]Physical Collector's Edition[/i] includes the above digital items and additional physical goodies, including a Mephala Statue, Razum-dar's Journal, a Map of Summerset, and a Steelbook Case.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/10108cba8762719fa05a1513efab47e76b333082.png[/img]

	Finally, if you pre-purchase 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset [/i]by June 5, you shall also receive the Queen's Bounty Pack (including a unique costume, pet, XP scrolls, treasure maps, and a Psijic Vault Crown Crate), Nightmare Senche mount, and bonus [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter (digital pre-purchases only).

	For more information on the 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i] editions and pre-purchase items, check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26343]Summerset editions and pre-purchase rewards article[/url]. It's not too late to pre-purchase [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]ESO: Summerset[/i] now[/url] and receive the above bonus items, even if you're on PC/Mac!

[h1]Getting to Summerset Isle[/h1]
	Once you have purchased 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i], there are a few ways you can travel to the home of the High Elves. You can begin your adventures in Summerset with any of your existing characters or make a brand new one and go through the new tutorial.

	[b]Wayshrine Travel[/b]

	Travel to Summerset with any of your existing characters by using the Shimmerene Wayshrine. To do so, open your map, select Summerset, and then select the Wayshrine icon (it should be the only one available on the island).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/9cb6d243cd0ddfffbd587c8338d93427d50e22ec.jpg[/img]

	[b]Start from the Main Quest[/b]

	You can pick up the first quest before even setting foot on Summerset by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From that menu, you can select Summerset, acquire the first quest, titled “The Queen's Decree", and begin your adventure. It will point you in the right direction.

	[b]New Characters[/b]

	Any new characters created in 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i] will be able to go through the new tutorial. Once complete, you'll find yourself just outside the city of Shimmerene. Take a look around and you might be able to find Razum-dar himself!

[h1]Update 18[/h1]
	[i]ESO: Summers[/i]et goes live in tandem with the free base-game Update 18. This update brings a host of new features, changes, and improvements that all [i]ESO[/i] players can enjoy without needing to purchase the new Chapter first.

	This new base-game update includes:
[list]	[*]Crown Store Gifting & Daily Rewards[/*]	[*]PvP additions & Combat changes[/*]	[*]Battlegrounds moving to base game[/*]	[*][i]Morrowind[/i] zone, content, & Warden class moving to Crown Store[/*][/list]
	[b]Morrowind Moves to the Crown Store[/b]

	With Update 18, some aspects of the 	[i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter have move to the in-game Crown Store and base game. Firstly, Battlegrounds is now base-game feature, meaning that all can now enjoy the 4v4v4 arena. In addition to this, the Vvardenfell zone and story content is moving to the in-game Crown Store on June 5, meaning you can get access to Vvardenfell with Crowns or via ESO Plus membership. Finally, on June 5, the Warden class will also be available for Crowns in the in-game Crown Store. You can read more about this move in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26355]this preview article[/url].

	[b]Crown Store Gifting[/b]

	With Crown Store Gifting, you are now able to buy items from the Crown Store and have them sent directly to a friend or guild mate. Some conditions apply, so be sure to check out our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26375]Update 18 preview article[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/38ea5053ec7636acdacc6213468f05d6744f0cdf.jpg[/img]

	[b]Daily Rewards[/b]

	With the Daily Rewards system, you receive unique rewards each day you log in. These rewards typically include consumables or currencies, but there will be milestone rewards that can include rarer items, too. Note that the first round of rewards will begin on June 5 for all platforms, not May 21. You can find more information about Daily Rewards in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26375]Update 18 preview[/url].

	[b]PvP Additions and Improvements[/b]

	Update 18 also includes a host of PvP improvements, such as the addition of Cyrodiil's new Conquest quest board. The first time you complete one of these new quests each day, you'll receive a container that includes a “Gladiator's Proof." Collect 20 of these items and you'll be able to create the Arena Gladiator helmet, a unique collectible can only be acquired by taking part in the Alliance War.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/136c9c146aba5d0097b99ef8908d98441dc97dfb.jpg[/img]

	Changes were made to AvA to ensure all players get the Alliance Points they deserve. There have also been tweaks to catapults, keep defenders, and more to ensure that the battle to control Cyrodiil is as fierce as ever. Finally, for Battlegrounds, we've added a special random queue daily reward that has a chance to award rare Outfit Style pages. Don't hesitate to 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26367]check out our Update 18 PvP preview[/url] for more information.

	[b]Combat Changes[/b]

	With Update 18, we've made combat changes that help you play the way you want to play. Two-handed weapons now count as two items for set bonuses, allowing you greater flexibility with regards to your gear. We've also revisited tanking and healing tools in an effort to ensure all classes can be successful in those roles. Finally, we've updated basic attacks to better emphasize that Light Attacks are meant to deal damage while Heavy Attacks are for restoring resources. Check out the 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26375]Update 18 preview article[/url] for more.

	All of the above Update 18 changes and additions (and more) can be found in greater detail in our 	[url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url].

[h1]A New Chapter in the Elder Scrolls Online Saga[/h1]
	Dark forces conspire from the shadows and threaten to overwhelm the home of the High Elves. In 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i], you can explore an idyllic world like no other, but dangerous new challenges await those who set foot on the ancient island paradise. Will you heed the Queen's call and travel to the Isle of Summerset? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url] using the #Summerset hashtag!

	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset is now in Early Access on PC/Mac and will arrive on Xbox One and PlayStation®4 June 5. [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]Pre-purchase ESO: Summerset[/i][/url][i] through June 5 to receive the Queen's Bounty Pack bonus reward and gain immediate access to the ESO base game and Morrowind Chapter (digital pre-purchases only – conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Get a Free Pet During the Morrowind Last Chance Event!
notes.content:
[i]Your chance to get the Morrowind Chapter free with your pre-purchase of the upcoming The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset Chapter is ending soon. Already own Morrowind? You're in for a treat! To thank all of our current Morrowind players, we're giving out a free Vvardvark pet and temporarily bringing back Dwarven Crown Crates. Check out this article to learn more about our Morrowind Last Chance event.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/3baa4c1a006744f508956f0b39c7589f5833f786.jpg[/img]

[h1]Free (Adorable) Vvardvark Pet[/h1]
	During the event period, by simply logging into the game while owning a copy of 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i], you'll receive a free Dozen-Banded Vvardvark. Vvardvarks might be the ill-advised result of Telvanni experiments, but they sure do make adorable pets!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a85d6dddcf3c61962fd63cf920d1448a96057f49.jpg[/img]

	To ensure you receive your free pet, you must log into the game while owning 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i] at any point [b]from now[/b] until Monday, May 21 at 2:59AM EDT (Sunday May 20 at 11:59PM PDT). If you logged in during the event period, you'll receive this spiny-tonged little monster by May 29!

	Don't forget, if you don't already own 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i], you can acquire it for free when you [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]pre-purchase[/url] a digital copy of [i]ESO: Summerset[/i]. Even better, upon pre-purchase, you can begin playing [i]ESO[/i] and [i]ESO[/i]: [i]Morrowind [/i]right away. No need to wait until [i]ESO: Summerset[/i] launches on June 5!

[h1]Dwarven Crown Crates Return[/h1]
	If you missed your chance to get some of the wonders found within the Dwarven Crown Crates, you'll have another opportunity to pick them up from the Crown Store between Monday, May 14 at 10:00 AM EDT and Monday, May 21 at 10:00 AM EDT.

	These crates include some truly unique items, including these marvelous mechanical mounts:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0da44563921d45f94c1778d88c88b51aa36c2fd4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/192a131e87ce53ddc209523442da1bf17ef313b9.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/3b94e7f37dd7ad82add556edddd5780001f5b01a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8baa40fae6331d450039e4d4f2e9718a3ba34944.jpg[/img][/url]

	[i]Dwarven Senche & Dwarven Wolf mounts[/i]

	You can read more about the Dwarven Crown Crates in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26101]preview article[/url]. During this time, Dwarven Crown Crate items will also be available for individual purchase with Crown Gems, allowing you to pick up any of the items you may have missed last year (Radiant Apex rewards not included). You'll be able to find these items under their respective categories within the Crown Crates section of the Crown Store.

[h1]Last Chance Crown Store Items[/h1]
	Finally, this is also your last chance to grab some Vvardenfell-themed Crown Store items. The following items will be no longer be available in the in-game Crown Store as of Monday, May 21 at 10:00 AM EDT.

	[i]Telvanni Wizard-Lord Robe costume, Bitter Coast Cliff Strider pet & Amber Ash Hopper pet[/i]

[h1]Vardenfell Awaits[/h1]
Changes are 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26355]coming to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Morrowind[/i][/url], but you can still grab it free right now with a digital [i]ESO: Summerset[/i] pre-purchase. Will you take your first steps in Vvardenfell during this last-chance event? Or have you already explored the home of the Dark Elves and want an adorable new pet? Show us screenshots of your characters with this adorable new pet on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url] using the #Morrowind hashtag!

notes.title: Try ESO Plus or Earn Free Crown Crates During Our Bonus Event
notes.content:
[i]The ESO Plus Bonus Event returns! Throughout this event, you can enjoy select benefits of an ESO Plus membership for free, and current ESO Plus members can earn up to six free Crown Crates. Read on to learn more[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7ecee732e1a83520bd97c54f8de917d8197bb398.jpg[/img]

	The next ESO Plus Bonus Event will begin at 10:00AM EDT on Tuesday, April 24 and run until 10:00AM EDT on Monday, April 30. During the event, ESO Plus members can earn up to six free Crown Crates just by logging into the game. If you're not already a member, don't worry, you can trial select ESO Plus benefits 	[b]completely free[/b] for the event period. No strings attached!

[h1]EARN FREE CROWN CRATES[/h1]
	To show our appreciation to existing ESO Plus members, we're giving out up to six free Scalecaller Crown Crates during the event period.

	The fearsome Scalecaller Crown Crates contain a selection of rare collectibles and useful consumables that you can't find anywhere else in Tamriel. In these crates, you can find menacing beasts like the Frostbane Horse, top-tier experience scrolls, or even unique costumes, collectibles, and skins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/78a4cd60c50500998ec55d30dc34069274292552.jpg[/img]
[i]Forstbane Horse Mount[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/51691de1aebf549c0e5eac69fadf02fb0923ab30.jpg[/img]
[i]Bone Dragon Summon Memento[/i]

	Find out more about the Scalecaller Crown Crate season in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26329]announcement article[/url].

	To participate in the ESO Plus Bonus Event, simply log into the game with an active paid ESO Plus membership (the free trial membership does not count) each day from April 24 until April 30. Note that in order to qualify, each unique login must occur within a 24-hour time period that starts at 10:00AM EDT and ends at 9:59AM EDT the next day. If you remained logged in over a two-day period, it will only count as one entry! You must 	[i]completely[/i] log out and back into the game; logging out just to the character select screen will not work.

	When the event concludes, you'll receive one crate for each day you logged in, up to a maximum of six, by May 16.

[h1]CHECK OUT ESO PLUS[/h1]
	If you've never experienced ESO Plus, you can check out almost everything it has to offer for FREE for a limited time with our trial. You'll find that an ESO Plus membership certainly 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/esoplusguide]has its benefits[/url], including:
[list]	[*]Full access to DLC game packs – new zones, quests, dungeons and more!	[list]		[*]Includes the [i]Imperial City[/i], [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Thieves Guild[/i], [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i], [i]Shadows of the Hist[/i], [i]Horns of the Reach[/i], [i]Clockwork City[/i] and [i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game packs[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A Craft Bag offering you unlimited storage for all of your crafting materials[/*]	[*]Double Bank space for all the characters on your account[/*]	[*]10% increase to Experience and Gold acquisition, Crafting Inspiration, and Trait Research rates[/*]	[*]Double Furnishings and Collectibles space in player housing[/*]	[*]Exclusive ability to dye costumes[/*]	[*]Double Transmute Crystal storage[/*]	[*]Monthly stipend of 1500 Crowns (available to paid members only)[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0f9339fef752d7f115dc9989090a987cdb92c885.jpg[/img]

	Here's how to get the ESO Plus trial and enjoy a week of benefits:
[list]	[*]Log into [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i].[/*]	[*]Navigate to the Crown Store.[/*]	[*]View the “Featured" category.[/*]	[*]Find and select the ESO Plus Free Trial.[/*][/list]
	Note that you do not need to provide credit card or any other account info in order to enjoy the ESO Plus trial. Simply go to the in-game Crown Store and activate it, no commitment required. It's that easy!

[h1]CELEBRATING ESO PLUS & ITS MEMBERS[/h1]
	We're thrilled to once again bring back the ESO Plus Bonus Event. Are you planning to enjoy the trial and check out what an ESO Plus membership has to offer? Or maybe you're more interested in those bonus Crown Crates? Let us know on Twitter @	[url=https://twitter.com/tesonline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Celebrate ESO’s 4-Year Anniversary With Us!
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online turns four! Join us in celebration of this amazing milestone by taking part in our in-game event and enjoying XP buffs, unique rewards, and cake![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8bcb44a71aff31a795c79785dbbfe0106f5d6644.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ache for Cake![/h1]
	Are you ready to celebrate another year of 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]? Let's party! Here's everything you need to know to join in the festivities during our in-game anniversary event:
[list]	[*]The anniversary event begins on Wednesday, April 4 at 10:00AM EDT and runs until Monday, April 16 at 10:00AM EDT.	[list]		[*]To join the event, visit the famous Chef Donolon in Vulkhel Guard, Daggerfall, or Davon's Watch and complete his Anniversary quest “Ache for Cake." You can get directions to Chef Donolon's location by obtaining a Jubilee Cake Voucher free of charge from the in-game Crown Store.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]When you complete “Ache for Cake" you'll receive the brand-new, [b]three-tiered[/b] Anniversary Jubilee Cake. It'll be added to your Mementos within your Collectibles UI.[/*]	[*]Activate the cake to place it in front of your character, then use it to enjoy a tasty slice and receive a two-hour 100% XP buff that stacks with any other active XP bonuses that your character might currently be enjoying (such as those from scrolls or ESO Plus membership).[/*][/list]
[h1]More Rewards[/h1]
	It's 	[i]ESO[/i]'s anniversary, but during this event, everybody gets presents! Throughout the event, any daily or weekly quest you complete will earn you an Anniversary Gift Box (in addition to their regular rewards). These reward boxes contain crafting materials (ore, ingredients, runes, etc.) and a single rare crafting item (Nirncrux, style items, motif pages, etc.) Note: Gift Boxes cannot be earned by completing infinitely repeatable quests.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4751b027a826c3c00060f2caae1d7e00b9a397cc.jpg[/img]

	Rarer rewards include hard-to-get motif pages previously only available in Vvardenfell, the 	[i]Horns of the Reach[/i] dungeons, and the Clockwork City. Even rarer, you could receive a motif page for the [b]brand-new Worm Cult style[/b], a look that can [i]only[/i] be found in the Anniversary Gift Boxes!

[h1]Get Your Dailies[/h1]
	To help you identify what daily and weekly quests are available to you, we have also added the “Adventurer's Almanac, 2nd Edition" to the game. Upon reading it, if you have completed the Mages Guild quest line, the new book will be added to your Eidetic Memory and be accessible from your Journal at any time. You can find the book somewhere near Chef Donolon in each capital city.

	The book contains everything you need to know about the available weekly and daily quests, including their location, activity type, requirements, and recommended level of experience to complete. There's always adventure to be had in Tamriel, and now, you'll always be able to find it!

[h1]ESO Turns Four![/h1]
	In these four years, we've been proud to hit some big-time milestones, including 10 million players last year. That said, the 	[i]ESO[/i] community has hit some pretty amazing milestones of their own. Check out these incredible in-game statistics from PC/Mac launch until today:
[list]	[*]Total number of monsters killed: 15,881,472,493[/*]	[*]Total number of players killed: 1,346,033,201 [/*]	[*]Total number of Soul Gems used: 1,183,836,570[/*]	[*]Total number of quests completed: 2,064,266,404 [/*]	[*]Total number of items crafted: 7,415,834,454[/*]	[*]Total number of achievements earned: 1,145,234,018[/*][/list]
	And, finally, here's some additional numbers that might surprise:
[list]	[*]Most popular race: High Elf (14.98% of all characters) [/*]	[*]Most popular Alliance: Ebonheart Pact (36.33% of all characters)[/*]	[*]Most PvP Kills by Alliance: Ebonheart Pact (122,490,253 kills)[/*]	[*]Highest unpaid bounty: 248,655,731 gold [/*]	[*]Highest paid bounty: 362,324 gold[/*][/list]
	           We're very excited to celebrate this anniversary with the 	[i]ESO[/i] community, and we know that we couldn't have done it without your dedication and support. Thank you! How are you planning to celebrate [i]ESO[/i]'s four-year anniversary? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Enjoy Frivolous Fun During the Jester’s Festival Event!
notes.content:
[i]Revel in a prank-filled celebration of the absurd and the foolish during the Jester's Festival event. Check out this article for everything you need to know in order to participate in the peculiar and preposterous fun![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/849d0172b6bb48eff4caea9bf6c029c681c26c32.jpg[/img]

[h1]Jester's Festival Frivolities[/h1]
	The Jester's Festival begins on Thursday, March 29 at 10:00AM EDT and will run until Monday, April 2 at 10:00AM EDT. If you want to take part in the silly season, make your way to the pavilions located outside the cities of Ebonheart, Vulkhel Guard, and Daggerfall.

	When you arrive, strike up a conversation with one of the three Jesters dressed as either Jorunn the Skald-King, Queen Ayrenn, or High King Emeric (don't worry, they're not the real thing). Complete the intro quest titled “The Jester's Festival" to acquire the powerful 	[i]not-a-Daedric artifact[/i] known as the Pie of Misrule. Note that if you completed the quest last year, you won't need to do so again. When you activate this delicious memento during the event, you'll receive a two-hour 100% XP buff. Once the event ends, you keep the pie, but it loses its XP “buffinating" properties. Sorry!

	But don't worry, that's not all! Each day, you can talk to one of the Jesters to receive a unique daily task. Upon completion, you'll receive the Jester's Fesitval Box. This prodigiously prestigious package can contain the following weird and wonderful items:
[list]	[*]A host of fun consumables[/*]	[*]Unique Jester's Festival mementos:	[list]		[*]Cherry Blossom Branch[/*]		[*][b]New[/b] Scintillator Memento[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Jester's Festival Housing items:	[list]		[*]Jester's Standard[/*]		[*][b]New[/b] Jester's Coffer that pops confetti![/*]		[*][b]New [/b]Recipe for Jester's Pavilion furnishing, allowing you build your own pavilion tent![/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1b29ebdfc27bb81a65aa5ac7aa1c6afb4f48432f.jpg[/img]

	In addition to the above, there's a selection of Jester's Festival Achievements that you can earn throughout the event period. These Achievements even have unique rewards, including the Crown of Misrule hat and the Royal Jester title!

	Finally, during the event, you can also acquire Jester's Large (15,000 gold) and Small Trees (5,000 gold) from the Achievement Vendor, Heralda Garscroft, found in Alliance Capitals.

[h1]Absurd New Crown Store Items[/h1]
	To help you get in the spirit of the silly season, the in-game Crown Store will also feature some Jester's Festival-themed items, including:
[list]	[*]Royal Court Jester costume (at 50% off!)[/*]	[*]Jester's Festival Hat Pack[/*]	[*]Masqued “Unicorn" Steed[/*]	[*]Madcap Jester Monkey pet[/*]	[*]The Jester personality[/*][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4ccf8d8b4c1abd16ad1598498693ca06e1bf8137.jpg[/img]

[h1]Celebrate the Preposterous[/h1]
	The Jester's Festival will come to its 	[i]inevitable and ignoble end[/i] on Monday, April 2, at 10:00AM EDT, so be sure to make the most of it!

	Are you going to revel in the absurd and the foolish during this year's Jester's Festival? Share your stories and screenshots of frivolous fun with us on, 	[url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url], and Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]@TESOnline[/url].

notes.title: ESO: Summerset Editions & Pre-Purchase Rewards
notes.content:
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset is coming to PC/Mac on May 21. Here's everything you need to know about each of the different Chapter editions and the bonus rewards you'll get for pre-purchasing.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0f06bf5563c4ff49745ce103aadbc517d4e3a3f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pre-Purchase Rewards[/h1]
	You can pre-purchase 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/i] via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus][i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] official site[/url]. When pre-purchasing the new[i] Summerset [/i]Chapter, there's a host of unique in-game rewards you can receive.

[h1]Queen's Bounty Pack[/h1]
	All pre-purchases (physical or digital) will receive the Queen's Bounty Pack. This pack contains the following items:	[b][/b]
[list]	[*][b]Court of Bedlam Costume[/b]: An exclusive costume with a sinister style, available to all classes.[/*]	[*][b]Pocket Salamander Pet[/b]: Express your inner newt with this non-combat in-game pet.[/*]	[*][b]Treasure Maps[/b]: These three ancient maps lead to caches of loot: gear, gold, and other forgotten riches.[/*]	[*][b]Psijic Vault Crown Crate[/b]: Open for a chance at Psijic-themed mounts, pets, costumes, and more.[/*]	[*][b]Experience Scrolls[/b]: Receive a 50% experience boost for two hours with these two Experience Scrolls.[/*][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/33f05a9ee07e01cefa44d5a3c511cbbf66cdbc16.jpg[/img]

	You will receive the Queen's Bounty Pack when 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i] launches on May 21 for PC/Mac.

[h1]Immediate Access to the ESO base game[/h1]
	If you are a new player who has pre-purchased 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i] digitally, you will receive immediate access to the [i]ESO[/i] base game and can start playing right away. Access to the [i]Summerset[/i] Chapter will be available on launch day.

[h1]Immediate Access to ESO: Morrowind[/h1]
	For a limited-time only, digital pre-purchases will also immediately receive full access to the 	[i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter as a bonus.

	The	[i] Morrowind[/i] Chapter [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/chapter/morrowind]contains the following[/url]:
[list]	[*]The zone of Vvardenfell[/*]	[*]A unique story, where you must help the demi-god Vivec restore his lost power[/*]	[*]The Warden class[/*]	[*]A unique Trial, Halls of Fabrication[/*]	[*]… and more![/*][/list]
	Don't forget, while all pre-purchases receive the Queen's Bounty Pack, only digital pre-purchases receive 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i]. notes.title: Announcing The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset
notes.content:
[i]We are thrilled to announce that the newest Elder Scrolls Online Chapter, The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset, will be released for PC/Mac on May 21 and Xbox One and PlayStation®4 on June 5. Experience the beautiful Isle of Summerset for the first time since The Elder Scrolls: Arena and explore the home of the High Elves.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/00e181a64480928b50d6356b39d4147799a495f1.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset[/h1]
	By the decree of Queen Ayrenn, Summerset Isle is now open to foreigners, but a Daedric threat looms over the breathtaking home of the High Elves. Travel to the Summerset Isle, reunite with old friends, and unravel a shadowy conspiracy that threatens all of Tamriel.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/gluw-ZhAgps]Click here[/url] to watch the full Summerset Cinematic Teaser.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/34cd7e04072fbe484d5d9622a0912956ccd0e466.jpg[/img]

	This latest Chapter is packed with exciting new features and challenges for new and veteran players alike. In 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i], you can:
[list]	[*]Explore a whole new zone, Summerset Isle[/*]	[*]Experience an epic main story quest line, concluding the narrative that began in the [i]ESO[/i] base game and continued through [i]Clockwork City[/i] [/*]	[*]Join the mysterious Psijic Order for the first time in an Elder Scrolls game and explore their island home of Artaeum[/*]	[*]Learn a brand-new Psijic Order combat Skill Line, and wield powers over time itself[/*]	[*]Master a new Jewelry Crafting Skill Line[/*]	[*]Face the challenges of Cloudrest, a new 12-player Trial[/*]	[*]Take on new group PvE challenges, including the Abyssal Geysers[/*]	[*]…and more![/*][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8d2072449fb9b3ccd0aa58b38d2cf796f9e5f0c7.jpg[/img]

	[i]A Beautiful New World to Explore[/i]

	[url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/sCdHwOC0lLE]Click here[/url] for a first look at some of Summerset's beautiful locations and hidden dangers in our new gameplay trailer.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/9631fb0ac89121a6044b64a0334876d9d8d368f8.jpg[/img]

	You can learn more about 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i]'s features on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/updates/chapter/summerset][i]Summerset[/i] Chapter page[/url].

	Excited to explore the home of the High Elves? 	[b]Pre-purchase now[/b] to receive the [b]Queen's Bounty Pack[/b], as well as immediate access to the [b]Nightmare Senche Mount[/b] and a bonus copy of the [b][i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter[/b] (digital pre-purchases only). [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]Visit our pre-purchase page[/url] or check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26343][i]ESO: Summerset[/i] Editions & Pre-Purchase Details[/url] for the full story on [i]ESO: Summerset[/i]'s different versions (including a Collector's Edition packed full of exclusive goodies) and pre-purchase rewards.

[h1]Play The Summerset Prologue Quest Now[/h1]
	Begin your journey to the home of the High Elves today with the Summerset prologue quest and help Vanus Galerion investigate a report of a mysterious prophecy.

	You can begin this new quest in-game now by acquiring the Mage's Message Stone free from the in-game Crown Store. Use the stone from within your Inventory to receive an urgent message from Vanus and acquire the quest titled “Through a Veil Darkly." You can also find Vanus inside any of the Mages Guildhalls found within Tamriel's Alliance capitals.

	Once complete, you'll receive the Wyrd Elemental Plume memento and be all set for the coming adventures.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8c8bf6b9050006ef51cf39f1cb8894080dbd56f9.jpg[/img]

	[i]Deadly New Challenges Await[/i]


	Are you excited to explore the home of the High Elves? Tell us what you're most looking forward to about 	[i]ESO: Summerset[/i] on [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], using the hashtag #Summerset!

	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Summerset is coming to PC/Mac on May 21 and Xbox One and PlayStation®4 June 5. Pre-purchase ESO: Summerset now to receive the Queen's Bounty Pack bonus reward and gain immediate access to the ESO base game and Morrowind Chapter (digital pre-purchases only – conditions apply). Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Dragon Bones DLC Game Pack & Update 17 Now Live On PC/Mac
notes.content:
[i]Ancient monsters rise to plague Tamriel anew in Dragon Bones, The Elder Scrolls Online's newest DLC game pack. Check out everything you need to know about this new adventure and Update 17 in our launch article![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/70061b833a7b6ed6827257a4117a708d23f5009d.jpg[/img]

	We are thrilled to announce that the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack and Update 17 are both live on PC/Mac. This new adventure and base-game update includes:
[list]	[*]Two new dungeons: Scalecaller Peak and Fang Lair[/*]	[*]The Outfit System[/*]	[*]Home Storage[/*]	[*]A new Level-Up Experience[/*]	[*]Combat improvements[/*]	[*]Two new Battlegrounds: Deeping Drome and Mor Khazgur[/*][/list]
	This new DLC is available free-of-charge for all ESO Plus™ members or for purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. The Update 17 base-game patch arrives free for all 	[i]ESO[/i] players. Want to celebrate the release of [i]Dragon Bones[/i] with us? [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/media/post/1183?Dragon-Bones]Download the official wallpaper.[/url]


[h1]Dragon Bones DLC Game Pack[/h1]
	With the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack, you will be able to explore two all-new four-player dungeons.

	[b]Scalecaller Peak[/b]

	Zaan the Scalecaller has returned with a new patron, the Daedric Prince of Pestilence, Peryite. With her new master's help, she threatens to unleash a deadly new plague upon all of Tamriel. You must enter the long-abandoned temple of Scalecaller, battle your way through plague-twisted monsters and cultists, face the resurrected Dragon Priest, and put a stop to her vile plans.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/43cf2bdc78fe33e527d322372a778646a03fbaa1.jpg[/img]

	[b]Fang Lair[/b]

	The lost Dwarven ruins of Fang Lair were once the final resting place of the mighty dragon Thurvokun. Now, it is inhabited by a dangerous Necromancer cult and their monstrous creations. However, the Blackmarrow Cult wants more than lost treasure: they aim to reanimate the bones of the long-dead Dragon himself! Make your way through the lost site and stop the powerful Necromancer Orryn the Black before he can bring his terrible new weapon to bear on the people of Tamriel.

	Both of these new dungeons can be completed in normal or veteran difficulties and contain a veteran hard mode option for those groups who truly want to be challenged. Each dungeon has its own unique rewards, too, including new gear sets, monster sets, achievements, costumes and skins, and, of course, trophies.


[h1]Purchase Details[/h1]
	The 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack is completely free to ESO Plus members or available for purchase for 1500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store. To buy the pack, navigate to the in-game Crown Store and find it in the DLC section.

	Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC game pack until it is renewed or purchased with crowns. You will not lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access. 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i] is not required in order to purchase and enjoy the [i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack.

	[b]Dragon Bones Collector's Bundle[/b]

	In addition to the DLC game pack, the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] Collector's Bundle is available for 4000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/10a2f3a02c461c464e45bc7d87fd66fdfa90490f.jpg[/img]

	This bundle includes the DLC game pack, the Fang Lair Courser mount, the Small Bone Dragon Construct pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] Collector's Bundle in the Featured section of the Crown Store.


[h1]Explore New Dungeons & Earn a Free Hat[/h1]
	Once you have access to the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack, you can delve into Fang Lair or Scalecaller Peak by the following methods:
[list]	[*]By teleporting directly to the two new dungeons from your map[/*]	[*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*]	[*]By walking up to the dungeons and clicking on the entrance in Bangkorai (Fang Lair) and in Stormhaven (Scalecaller Peak) [/*][/list]
	Are you inspired by the venerable Dragon Priests of legend? You can dress like the ancient stewards of the dragons with the Renegade Dragon Priest Mask. This new hat will be automatically added to your Collections the first time you set foot in either one of the two new dungeons, completely free!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/c9d74b0a971cc1fbcba920203b75ab123c991b28.jpg[/img]


[h1]Update 17 For All[/h1]
	The Update 17 base-game patch will also arrive alongside the 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i] DLC game pack as a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players. This update contains a host of amazing new features and improvements to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] that everybody can enjoy.

	[b]Outfit System[/b]

	Be who you want to be with the new Outfit System! Now, you can completely customize almost every aspect of your appearance with unique Outfits, regardless of the gear you are wearing. You will have one free Outfit that you can customize at a cost of gold, but should you wish, you can purchase additional Outfits and Outfit Change Tokens (allowing you to save gold) from the in-game Crown Store. To begin customizing your Outfit, locate a new Outfit Station (previously known as Dye Stations).

	Check out our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26295?Outfit-System:-Basics-Guide]Outfit System Basics Guide[/url] for everything you need to know!

	[b]Home Storage[/b]

	With Update 17, we are also introducing a new home furnishings type: storage containers. With storage containers, you can finally store bankable items in your own homes, freeing up space from your bank, inventory, or craft bag. You can earn the first of these by leveling a character to level 18 and receiving it as a level-up reward, but there are seven additional containers you can acquire from in-game vendors and the Crown Store.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/23ef63fac3fc822602534c970569f420b3461cb0.jpg[/img]

	You can learn more about Home Storage in this 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26303?Enjoy-a-New-Level-Up-Experience,-Home-Storage,-and-Outfits-with-Update-17]feature article[/url].

	[b]New Level-Up Experience[/b]

	In order to help players better understand the game and how to develop their characters, we've introduced a new level-up experience. Now, when you level up in 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], you'll receive unique rewards and helpful gameplay tips to help you on your adventures. In addition to this, we've created a new Skills Advisor tool that you can use to help pick your character's skills and abilities based on a desired archetype.

	You can find out more about this new system in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26303?Enjoy-a-New-Level-Up-Experience,-Home-Storage,-and-Outfits-with-Update-17]feature article[/url].

	[b]Combat Improvements[/b]

	In addition to the new features above, we've made some dramatic changes to 	[i]ESO[/i]'s combat system. These changes include improvements to Synergies, the removal of area-of-effect caps, changes to block costs, changes to cast-time abilities and interrupts, and changes to how Heavy Attacks and the Off Balance mechanic work.

	These changes are designed to make combat in 	[i]ESO[/i] even more responsive, tactical, and skillful, and you can learn more about them in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26307]feature article[/url].


[h1]New PvP Battlegrounds For You To Conquer[/h1]
	Update 17 will also arrive with two brand-new PvP Battlegrounds. These new arenas will test you and your PvP team in new and different ways.

	[b]Mor Khazgur[/b]

	This Orc stronghold has seen more than its fair share of conflict over the ages, but thanks to its precarious ledges and limited visibility, it is now the perfect arena for 4v4v4 battles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/8a8c34ae23c872f8a08abcd965e530614ceda958.jpg[/img]

	[b]Deeping Drome[/b]

	Set deep beneath Tamriel, this cavernous arena is illuminated by the glow of the surrounding mushrooms, lighting your way through its tight corners and winding pathways.

	You and your allies can access both Battlegrounds via the regular Grab Bag Battlegrounds queue in your Group & Activity Finder. Note that you must have 	[i]ESO: Morrowind[/i] installed in order to participate in Battlegrounds matches.


[h1]Ancient Threats Rise Again[/h1]
	The dead don't always stay dead. In 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i], long-forgotten powers have returned to once again plague Tamriel. Will you answer the call of the Undaunted and venture into Scalecaller Peak and Fang Lair? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

	The dead don't always stay dead. In 	[i]Dragon Bones[/i], long-forgotten powers have returned to once again plague Tamriel. Will you answer the call of the Undaunted and venture into Scalecaller Peak and Fang Lair? Let us know on Twitter @[url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Earn Free Crown Crates or Trial ESO Plus During Our Bonus Event
notes.content:
[i]The ESO Plus Bonus Event is returning! During the event, everyone can enjoy select benefits of an ESO Plus membership for free, and ESO Plus members can earn up to six free Crown Crates. Read on for all the details![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/406d62b1266d9a4da3521ea6bb9c9568191776bc.jpg[/img]

	The ESO Plus Bonus Event will begin at 10:00AM EST on Tuesday, January 9 and run until 10:00AM EST on Monday, January 15. During the event, ESO Plus members can earn up to six free Crown Crates just by logging into the game. If you're not already a member, join us to enjoy select benefits of ESO Plus [b]completely free[/b]. Read on for all the details!

[h1]Earn Free Crown Crates[/h1]
	To show our appreciation to existing ESO Plus members, we're giving out up to six free Flame Atronach Crown Crates during the event period.

	The Flame Atronach Crown Crates contain a red-hot selection of rare collectibles and useful consumables that you can't find anywhere else in Tamriel. In these crates, you can find eye-catching mounts like the Flame Atronach Horse, top-tier experience scrolls, or even unique costumes and skins.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/976ca2976fb73332ae5b77c5c83802968b401608.jpg[/img]

[i]Flame Atronach Horse mount[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a48c00fc1f1efde72513a28decf3ff3bc04af593.jpg[/img]

	 [i]Infernal Epidermis skin[/i]

	Find out more about the Flame Atronach Crown Crate season in our 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26249]announcement article[/url].

	To participate in the ESO Plus Bonus Event, simply log into the game with an active paid ESO Plus membership (free trial membership does not count) each day from January 9 until January 15. Note that in order to qualify, each unique login must occur within a 24-hour time period that starts at 10:00AM EST and ends at 9:59AM EST the next day. If you remained logged in over a two-day period, it will only count as one entry! 	If you've never experienced ESO Plus, you can check out almost everything it has to offer for FREE for a limited time with our trial. We think you'll find that an ESO Plus membership certainly 	[url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/guides/esoplusguide]has its benefits[/url], including:

[list]		[*]Includes the [i]Imperial City[/i], [i]Orsinium[/i], [i]Thieves Guild[/i], [i]Dark Brotherhood[/i], [i]Shadows of the Hist[/i], [i]Horns of the Reach[/i], and [i]Clockwork City[/i] DLC game packs[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A Craft Bag offering you unlimited storage for all of your crafting materials[/*]	[*]Double Bank space for all the characters on your account[/*]	[*]10% increase to Experience and Gold acquisition, Crafting Inspiration, and Trait Research rates[/*]	[*]Double Furnishings and Collectibles space in player housing[/*]	[*]Exclusive ability to dye costumes[/*]	[*]Double Transmute Crystal storage[/*]	[*]Monthly stipend of 1500 Crowns (available to paid members only)[/*][/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7a6fb2d8cc5f2f8944b17cc24e815666717c9dd6.jpg[/img]

	Here's how to get the ESO Plus trial and enjoy a week of benefits:
[list]	[*]Log into [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i].[/*]	[*]Navigate to the Crown Store.[/*]	[*]View the “Featured" category.[/*]	[*]Find and select the ESO Plus Free Trial.[/*][/list]
	It's that easy to enjoy select ESO Plus benefits for the duration of the event!

[h1]Something for Everyone[/h1]
	We're thrilled to bring back the ESO Plus Bonus Event. What aspects of ESO Plus do you find the most useful? Is it the double bank space, or perhaps the Craft Bag? Are you planning to enjoy the trial and check out what ESO Plus membership has to offer? Let us know on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/tesonline]@TESOnline[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]!

	[i]The ESO Plus Bonus Event begins at 10:00AM EST Tuesday, January 9 and ends at 10:00AM EST Monday January 15 on all platforms. [/i]

notes.title: Spread Holiday Cheer During The New Life Festival
notes.content:
[i]Celebrate the end of another fantastic year in The Elder Scrolls Online with the New Life Festival. This merry event returns with a host of fun quests and festive holiday rewards for all. Find out below how you can celebrate New Life with us and earn free XP-boosting collectibles, acquire style materials and pages, unlock unique furnishings, and more![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/0a05ebebcdec1d3a96921fcf9edbacecf5b45ce8.jpg[/img]

	[i]The New Life Festival celebrates the death of the old year, and the birth of the new, so it's a holiday of hope and new beginnings. It also marks the Winter Solstice, when Magnus the Sun begins his return, and the days once more start to grow longer.[/i]


[h1]Celebrate New Life With an XP Boost[/h1]
	The New Life Festival begins at 10:00AM EST on Thursday, December 14 and will run until 10:00AM EST on Tuesday, January 2, 2018. In order to join the festivities, acquire the free New Life Festival Scroll from the Crown Store. Use the scroll to find the New Life Herald Breda in a tent just south of Windhelm, Eastmarch. She will give you the initial quest, “The New Life Festival", which will unlock a series of nine uniquely festive daily quests.

	If you are having trouble traveling to Windhelm, you can take a boat or cart from the Alik'r Desert or Malabal Tor, travel by road from The Rift, or teleport to a fellow player or guildmate that's already in the area.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/78e65a1fb7928b4e8551118c9daad1b1e4df0db3.jpg[/img]

	Each daily quest has you travel to a specific location to participate in the local traditions of each of Tamriel's nine races. The quests are as follows:
[list]	[*]Castle Charm Challenge (Breton)[/*]	[*]Fish Boon Feast (Argonian)[/*]	[*]Lava Foot Stomp (Dunmer)[/*]	[*]Mud Ball Merriment (Bosmer)[/*]	[*]Signal Fire Sprint (Redguard)[/*]	[*]Snow Bear Plunge (Nord)[/*]	[*]Stonetooth Bash (Orc)[/*]	[*]The Trial of Five-Clawed Guile (Khajiit)[/*]	[*]War Orphan's Sojourn (Altmer)[/*][/list]
	The first time you complete a New Life Festival quest, you'll unlock the 	[b]Breda's Bottomless Mead Mug[/b] collectible. This mug doesn't only provide a nice swig of ale, but it also confers a two-hour 100% XP boost on your character! This XP boost will stack with any other XP bonuses your character might currently be enjoying (such as those from scrolls or ESO Plus membership).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/f51c49bf61efc02015c65fe6b5d27f63a023913f.jpg[/img]

	Breda's Bottomless Mead Mug can be used almost anywhere in Tamriel, except for Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds, so you won't need to return to Breda's tent for an XP buff top off during the festivities. Note that once the New Life Festival ends, you can continue to enjoy the tasty beverage, but it will no longer bestow the XP boost.


[h1]Unwrap New Life Festival Gift Boxes[/h1]
	Of course, it wouldn't be a New Life Festival without gift-giving! Every time you complete one of Breda's daily quests, you will receive a New Life Festival Gift Box.

	A New Life Festival Gift Box typically contains random items such as crafting materials, consumable mementos, and Wolfsbane Incense, the Skinchanger style item. However, they will also have a chance to contain rarer items, including:
[list]	[*]Skinchanger Motif chapters[/*]	[*]New Life recipes[/*]	[*]New Life collectibles:	[list]		[*]Sword-Swallower's Blade memento[/*]		[*]Juggler's Knives memento[/*]		[*]Fire-Breather's Torches memento[/*]		[*]Mud Ball Pouch memento[/*]		[*]Nordic Bather's Towel costume[/*]		[*]Colovian Filigreed Hood hat[/*]		[*]Colovian Fur Hood hat[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A wide variety of lights, lamps, and lanterns for your home to celebrate the Signal Fire Sprint[/*]	[*]Roguish Draughts of Stealth and Escape to celebrate the Trial of Five-Clawed Guile[/*][/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/b1d3a10a256cca3e94a3707202de63c7e2f450e7.jpg[/img]

	All of the above collectibles come packaged in Runeboxes which can be traded with other players or, in 	[i]keeping with the spirit of the season[/i], presented as gifts. The New Life Festival Gift Boxes are a great way to spread some holiday cheer.


[h1]Deck Your Home's Halls![/h1]
	Finally, during the New Life Festival, you can make your house a holiday home with two merry new furnishings from Heralda Garscroft, the Holiday Achievement Furnisher. Each new furnishing has a cost in gold, and requires a specific New Life Festival achievement to be unlocked:
[list]	[*][b]The New Life Bonfire[/b] – Available for 10,000 gold once you complete the “Snow Bare Plunge" achievement [/*]	[*][b]The New Life Celebrant's Standard[/b] – Available for 2,500 gold once you complete the “New Life Celebrant" achievement[/*][/list]
	You can find Heralda in Grahtwood, Stormhaven, and Deshaan. If you're unsure whether you've completed the required achievements, check the Achievements section of your Journal for more information. The New Life Festival achievements can be found under Holiday Events.


[h1]Join the Festivities[/h1]
	The New Life Festival celebrates the beginning of the new year as well as years past. Join in the merriment by visiting Breda and picking up her holiday quests. And don't forget, there are a host of New Life Festival-themed items available in the in-game Crown Store this month, including an especially festive holiday mount. Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/26261]Crown Store Showcase[/url] for all the details!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/26c17b5c54a4ce328632f86b1cb6c116c629d760.jpg[/img]

	Are you going to take part in the New Life Festival? Share your festivities with us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]@TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/?hl=en]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline/]Facebook[/url]! We can't wait to see everybody get into the spirit of the season. Happy holidays!

notes.title: Earn Bonus Rewards With the #10MillionStories Dungeon Event
notes.content:
[i]Get your squad together. The #10MillionStories in-game dungeon event is about to begin. Group up and take on a random dungeon every day to earn additional sweepstakes entries, consumables, collectibles, and a jackpot that could get you 20 of the game's rarest mounts or houses![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/c54f3db899f468e81f1236f70e9f35cff9f03743.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dive into Tamriel's Dungeons for Big Rewards[/h1]
	The #10MillionStories in-game dungeon event begins November 30 at 10:00AM EST and lasts until December 6 at 10:00AM EST, and it is open to everybody who plays 	[i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. To participate, complete a random dungeon via the Dungeon Finder (Normal or Veteran) to earn a Mysterious Reward Box. (You can obtain one Mysterious Reward Box per character per day.)

	Mysterious Reward Boxes contain a variety of in-game rewards, such as Dye Stamps, Crown Repair Kits, or Crown Mimic Stones. They also contain rarer rewards, ranging from in-game valuables like Treasure Maps, Transmute Crystals, or Crown Experience Scrolls – or, rarely, a Costume, Pet, or even a Mount from a curated selection of both past and brand-new Crown Store collectibles.

	You can see just some of the fantastic prizes you can discover below:

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/7e5a7215f44f26e69eba9cf4d4340ae755b17351.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/e3478182a10023e0dc3d07cd36e0e02a46908997.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/43b65e5cc354cdd538e936d5b7798480d4f80faf.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/abe3bec7e7807c420138ca032899ef43e5bf1172.jpg[/img][/url]

	[i]Imperial War Horse mount and Blacksmith costume[/i]


[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/a26044507f6fadbdc9b3923804529df6a3969697.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/d21cebd5746b91fb93280a53e078b88fd3a8ecb2.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/1f60d22d8d3e7125af6126308fe4f4eb9489b1ea.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6349516/4296f7cda6d8447bb0f44417d3f9a4a0fdbbce59.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Imperial War Mastiff pet and Dark Shaman costume[/i]


	If you're lucky enough to hit the jackpot, you could even receive a 	[b]pack of 20 homes or 20 mounts[/b]! These packs include some of our rarest and most valuable items, such as the Grand Topal Hideaway home or Great Elk mount!
